| Bulk partial failures | Requester | In‑app + Email | “Some items failed; see CSV.” | Per run |
| Bulk completed | Requester | In‑app | “**{action}** completed: {success}/{total}.” | Real‑time |
| Ownership reassigned | Old/New owners | In‑app | “Jobs reassigned to **{user}**.” | Dedupe 1h |

All via `communications‑be`, respecting preferences & policy.

---

### 12) Analytics (Events & Schemas)

All events include `{ts, actor_id, org_id, plan_tier}`.

- `bulk.selection.created.v1` — `{selection_id, filters, count}`  
- `bulk.preview.generated.v1` — `{selection_id, action, would_change, blocked}`  
- `bulk.approval.requested.v1` — `{approval_id, selection_id, action, sla_hours}`  
- `bulk.approval.decided.v1` — `{approval_id, decision:'approved'|'rejected'}`  
- `bulk.execute.started.v1` — `{bulk_id, selection_id, action}`  
- `bulk.execute.progress.v1` — `{bulk_id, processed, success, failed}`  
- `bulk.execute.completed.v1` — `{bulk_id, success, failed}`  
- `bulk.ownership.changed.v1` — `{count, from_user, to_user}`  
- `team.queue.assignment.changed.v1` — `{assignee, count}`

**Example — `bulk.execute.completed.v1`**
```json
{
  "event":"bulk.execute.completed.v1",
  "bulk_id":"blk_77af",
  "selection_id":"sel_9a7f",
  "action":"PAUSE",
  "success":207,
  "failed":7,
  "ts":"2025-11-11T10:05:31Z",
  "actor_id":"cli_123",
  "org_id":"org_42",
  "plan_tier":"Enterprise"
}
```

Team analytics KPIs derived from events + jobs state snapshots.

---

### 13) Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)

- Keyboard access to selection, filters, and action buttons; large targets for multi‑select.  
- Progress & results streamed via `aria-live="polite"`; final status summary as a list.  
- Approvals dialogs trap focus; decision buttons labeled; reason text associated via `aria-describedby`.  
- Charts paired with text KPIs; color not the sole carrier of meaning.

---

### 14) Performance (Targets & Tactics)

- **SLOs:** selection build < **700 ms** (p95), preview < **900 ms**, execute enqueue < **1.0 s**.  
- Server streams progress via SSE/WebSocket; client virtualizes log output.  
- Chunk large selections (e.g., 100‑item batches); backpressure aware.  
- Cache saved selections; memoize previews for unchanged params.  
- Pre‑fetch approver chain & policies for approval builder.

---

### 15) Security (RBAC/ABAC, Idempotency, Audit)

- **RBAC:** `BULK_OPERATIONS` scope required; fine‑grained actions (`BULK_PAUSE`, `BULK_ASSIGN`, …).  
- **ABAC:** constraints by team, business unit, category; cross‑unit ops require elevated scope.  
- **Idempotency:** all execute endpoints require `Idempotency-Key`; replay returns previous result.  
- **Rate limits:** selections 30/min; previews 20/min; executes 10/min; chain length capped (e.g., 3).  
- **Audit:** log selection filters, previews, executed diffs, approver decisions, and actor IP/user‑agent.  
- **Privacy:** no PII in bulk logs; job titles only; redact internal notes where configured.

---

### 16) Observability, Audit & Compliance

- Dashboards: selection counts by filter, approval SLAs, failure/rollback rates, ownership changes.  
- Alerts: spike in failures, SLA breaches, repeated idempotency replays.  
- Compliance: approval policies per category/region; immutable decision records; exportable CSVs for auditors.

---

### 17) Sources & Cross‑References (Project Knowledge)

- Format & completeness rules: Master continuation prompt (17‑section template).  
- Related: CL‑1 (interview/pause safeguards), CL‑2 (invitation context), CL‑11 (template reuse), JOB‑5 (lifecycle actions).  
- Route‑group conventions: combined FE folder structure `(dashboard)/jobs/*`.

---

# SECTION D: PROPOSALS & APPLICATIONS (PROP-1 through PROP-8), (CL-3, FR-3)

## PROP-1 — Submit Proposal (Freelancer)

**ID:** PROP-1  
**Persona:** Freelancer  
**Description:** Comprehensive proposal submission wizard allowing freelancers to create compelling proposals with cover letters, pricing, milestones, screening question answers, work sample attachments, and real-time quality feedback before submission.

### Preconditions & Triggers
- **Triggers:**
  - User clicks "Submit Proposal" button on job detail page
  - User navigates to `(dashboard)/proposals/submit/[jobId]`
  - User receives job invitation and clicks "Apply Now"
  - User views matching job notification and clicks "Submit Proposal"
  - User loads saved draft proposal
- **Preconditions:**
  - User is authenticated
  - User has Freelancer or Hybrid account type
  - User profile is at least 60% complete
  - User has sufficient connects to submit (checked before submission)
  - Job is open and accepting proposals
  - User has not already submitted a proposal for this job
  - User's account is in good standing (not suspended)

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/page.tsx` — Main proposal submission form
- `(dashboard)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/cover-letter/page.tsx` — Dedicated cover letter editor
- `(dashboard)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/pricing/page.tsx` — Pricing & milestones setup
- `(dashboard)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/questions/page.tsx` — Screening questions
- `(dashboard)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/attachments/page.tsx` — Work sample uploads
- `(dashboard)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/review/page.tsx` — Preview before submit
- `(dashboard)/proposals/drafts/[draftId]/page.tsx` — Continue saved draft

**Mobile:**
- `(mobile)/(app)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/index.tsx` — Simplified submission (single page)
- `(mobile)/(app)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/cover-letter.tsx` — Cover letter editor
- `(mobile)/(app)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/pricing.tsx` — Pricing setup
- `(mobile)/(app)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/questions.tsx` — Answer questions
- `(mobile)/(app)/proposals/submit/[jobId]/attachments.tsx` — Upload files
- `(mobile)/(app)/proposals/drafts/[draftId]/index.tsx` — Draft editor

#### System Touchpoints
- **proposals-be:**
  - `proposal/entity.go` — Core proposal entity
  - `cover_letter/entity.go` — Cover letter management
  - `milestone/entity.go` — Milestone definitions
  - `attachment/entity.go` — Work sample attachments
  - `question_answer/entity.go` — Screening Q&A
  - POST `/v1/proposals` — Create proposal (draft)
  - PUT `/v1/proposals/{id}` — Update proposal
  - POST `/v1/proposals/{id}/cover-letter` — Add/update cover letter
  - POST `/v1/proposals/{id}/milestones` — Add milestone
  - PUT `/v1/proposals/{id}/milestones/{milestone_id}` — Update milestone
  - DELETE `/v1/proposals/{id}/milestones/{milestone_id}` — Remove milestone
  - POST `/v1/proposals/{id}/milestones/reorder` — Reorder milestones
  - POST `/v1/proposals/{id}/attachments` — Upload attachment
  - DELETE `/v1/proposals/{id}/attachments/{attachment_id}` — Remove attachment
  - POST `/v1/proposals/{id}/answers` — Answer screening question
  - PUT `/v1/proposals/{id}/answers/{answer_id}` — Update answer
  - POST `/v1/proposals/{id}/submit` — Submit proposal (deduct connects)
  - POST `/v1/proposals/{id}/draft` — Save as draft
  - GET `/v1/proposals/{id}/quality-score` — Get quality score
  - POST `/v1/proposals/{id}/ai/suggestions` — Request AI improvements
- **subscriptions-be:**
  - GET `/v1/connects/balance` — Check available connects
  - POST `/v1/connects/reserve` — Reserve connects (hold)
  - POST `/v1/connects/deduct` — Deduct connects on submit
  - POST `/v1/connects/release` — Release reserved connects (cancel)
  - GET `/v1/connects/cost?job_id={id}` — Get connects cost for job
- **storage-be:**
  - POST `/v1/storage/attachments` — Upload work samples
  - DELETE `/v1/storage/attachments/{id}` — Delete attachment
  - GET `/v1/storage/attachments/{id}` — Fetch attachment metadata
- **jobs-be:**
  - GET `/v1/jobs/{id}` — Fetch job details
  - GET `/v1/jobs/{id}/screening-questions` — Get required questions
  - GET `/v1/jobs/{id}/eligibility` — Check if freelancer eligible
- **validation-be:**
  - POST `/v1/validation/content` — Validate cover letter (profanity, PII)
  - POST `/v1/validation/pricing` — Validate proposed pricing
- **ai-assist-be:**
  - POST `/v1/ai/proposals/improve-cover-letter` — Get cover letter suggestions
  - POST `/v1/ai/proposals/suggest-milestones` — Suggest milestone breakdown
  - POST `/v1/ai/proposals/pricing-analysis` — Analyze competitiveness
- **events:**
  - Publish: `proposal.created.v1`, `proposal.draft.saved.v1`, `proposal.updated.v1`, `proposal.submitted.v1`, `cover_letter.created.v1`, `cover_letter.updated.v1`, `proposal.milestone.created.v1`, `proposal.milestone.updated.v1`, `proposal.milestone.reordered.v1`, `proposal.milestone.removed.v1`, `question.answered.v1`, `answer.updated.v1`

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**A1: Start Proposal Creation**
1. User views job detail page and clicks "Submit Proposal" button
2. System checks user eligibility:
   - Verify user is freelancer
   - Check profile completeness (min 60%)
   - Verify user hasn't already submitted proposal for this job
   - Check account status (not suspended)
   - Fetch connects cost: `GET /v1/connects/cost?job_id={id}`
   - Fetch connects balance: `GET /v1/connects/balance`
3. If eligible, navigate to `(dashboard)/proposals/submit/[jobId]`
4. System fetches:
   - Job details: `GET /v1/jobs/{id}`
   - Screening questions: `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/screening-questions`
   - User's saved templates (if any)
5. System creates draft proposal: `POST /v1/proposals`
   - Backend generates proposal_id
   - Initial status: DRAFT
   - Auto-saves enabled from this point
6. Display proposal submission wizard (Step 1: Cover Letter)

**A2: Write Cover Letter (Step 1)**
1. User sees cover letter editor:
   - **Job Overview Card** (top):
     - Job title
     - Client name and rating
     - Budget range
     - Deadline
     - Required skills
   - **Connects Cost Badge:**
     - "This proposal costs 4 connects"
     - Current balance: "You have 12 connects"
   - **Cover Letter Editor:**
     - Rich text editor with basic formatting
     - Character counter: "0 / 5000 characters (min 50)"
     - Tone selector: Professional | Friendly | Technical | Casual
     - Word count display
     - Real-time save indicator
2. **Template Options:**
   - If user has saved templates:
     - "Load from Template" dropdown
     - User selects template
     - System loads template content
   - "Save as Template" button (appears after writing)
3. **AI Assistance (if enabled):**
   - "✨ Improve with AI" button appears
   - User clicks to get suggestions
   - System calls: `POST /v1/ai/proposals/improve-cover-letter`
   - Display AI suggestions sidebar:
     - **Tone Analysis:** "Your tone is very formal. Consider being more conversational."
     - **Clarity Score:** "78/100 - Good, but could be clearer"
     - **Suggested Edits:**
       - "Original: I am very interested"
       - "Suggested: I'm excited to help with..."
       - [Accept] [Reject] buttons for each
     - **Personalization Tips:**
       - "Mention the client's company name"
       - "Reference specific project details from the job description"
       - "Highlight relevant experience from your profile"
4. User writes/edits cover letter
5. **Real-time Validation:**
   - As user types, system performs checks:
     - Word count validation (min 50, max 5000)
     - PII detection: `POST /v1/validation/content`
       - If email/phone found: Warning "⚠️ Don't share contact info in cover letter"
     - Profanity check
       - If profanity detected: Error "Contains inappropriate language"
     - External link detection
       - If links found: Warning "⚠️ Avoid external links in cover letter"
   - Display validation messages inline
6. **Quality Indicators:**
   - System calculates and displays real-time metrics:
     - **Personalization Score:** 0-100
       - Checks for client name mentions
       - References to job specifics
       - Relevant experience mentions
     - **Readability Score:** Flesch reading ease
     - **Length:** Too short, Just right, Too long
7. **Auto-save Draft:**
   - System auto-saves every 30 seconds: `PUT /v1/proposals/{id}/cover-letter`
   - Display save indicator: "✓ Saved 5 seconds ago"
8. User clicks "Save & Continue"
9. System validates cover letter:
   - Meets minimum length
   - No profanity
   - No PII violations
10. If valid, progress to Step 2
11. If invalid, display errors and prevent progression

**A3: Set Pricing & Timeline (Step 2)**
1. Display pricing form based on job type:

   **If Fixed-Price Job:**
   - **Proposed Budget:**
     - Amount input field
     - Currency selector (defaults to job currency)
     - Budget range guidance:
       - "Client's budget: $2,000 - $5,000"
       - "Your bid: $______"
       - Competitiveness indicator: "Lower than average" | "Competitive" | "Higher than average"
   - **Milestone Breakdown (Optional but Recommended):**
     - "Add Milestones" button
     - User clicks to add milestone
     - **For each milestone:**
       - Milestone description (text, max 500 chars)
       - Amount ($)
       - Due date (date picker)
       - Deliverables (text, optional)
       - [Remove] button
     - Drag handle to reorder milestones
     - **Auto-validation:**
       - Sum of milestones must equal proposed budget
       - Display running total: "Total: $3,500 / $5,000"
       - If sum doesn't match: Warning "Milestones must add up to proposed budget"
     - **AI Milestone Suggestions:**
       - "✨ Suggest Milestones" button
       - System analyzes job and suggests breakdown: `POST /v1/ai/proposals/suggest-milestones`
       - Display suggestions:
         - "Milestone 1: Design & Planning - $1,200 - Week 1-2"
         - "Milestone 2: Development - $2,500 - Week 3-6"
         - "Milestone 3: Testing & Launch - $1,300 - Week 7-8"
       - [Accept All] [Customize] [Reject] buttons

   **If Hourly Job:**
   - **Hourly Rate:**
     - Rate input field ($/hour)
     - Market rate guidance:
       - "Average for this category: $45/hr"
       - "Your rate: $____/hr"
       - Competitiveness indicator
   - **Estimated Hours:**
     - Hours input
     - Calculation display: "$50/hr × 40 hours = $2,000"
   - **Availability:**
     - Hours per week available
     - Preferred schedule (dropdown)
   
2. **Timeline:**
   - Estimated project duration (dropdown or custom input)
     - "Less than 1 week"
     - "1-2 weeks"
     - "2-4 weeks"
     - "1-3 months"
     - "3-6 months"
     - "6+ months"
     - "Custom" → Date range picker
   - Proposed start date (date picker)
     - Defaults to "Available immediately"
   - Estimated completion date (auto-calculated based on duration, or manual)
3. **Validation:**
   - Check amount is within reasonable range:
     - Fixed-price: Min $5, Max $1,000,000
     - Hourly: Min $5/hr, Max $500/hr
   - For fixed-price: Validate milestones sum correctly
   - Check timeline is reasonable for job scope
   - If outside job budget range:
     - Warning: "⚠️ Your bid is outside client's budget range"
     - Explanation field: "Explain why (optional)"
4. **Pricing Analysis (if AI enabled):**
   - System analyzes competitiveness: `POST /v1/ai/proposals/pricing-analysis`
   - Display insights:
     - "Your bid is 15% higher than average for similar jobs"
     - "Freelancers with similar profiles typically bid $3,500-$4,200"
     - "Win rate for this price range: ~25%"
   - Suggestions:
     - "Consider lowering to $4,000 for better competitiveness"
     - "Or highlight unique value to justify higher rate"
5. User fills pricing information
6. User clicks "Save & Continue"
7. System validates pricing
8. If valid, progress to Step 3

**A4: Answer Screening Questions (Step 3)**
1. If job has screening questions:
   - Display all questions in order
   - **For each question:**
     - Question text
     - Question type indicator (Text, Multiple Choice, Yes/No, File Upload)
     - Required indicator (if mandatory)
     - Character/word limit (for text questions)
   
   **Question Types:**
   - **Text Question:**
     - Text area input
     - Character counter
     - Validation: Min/Max length
   - **Multiple Choice:**
     - Radio buttons or checkboxes
     - Single select or multi-select (per question config)
   - **Yes/No:**
     - Toggle or radio buttons
   - **File Upload:**
     - File picker
     - Supported types: PDF, DOC, DOCX, images
     - Max size: 10MB
   - **Numeric:**
     - Number input with validation
   
2. User answers each question
3. **Real-time Validation:**
   - Check required questions are answered
   - Validate text length
   - Validate file types and sizes
   - Check answer format (for numeric, date, etc.)
4. **Auto-save:**
   - System saves answers as user types: `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/answers`
   - Display save indicator
5. **Question Insights (if applicable):**
   - For some questions, display guidance:
     - "Tip: Be specific about your experience"
     - "Good answer length: 100-300 words"
6. User completes all required questions
7. System validates all answers
8. User clicks "Save & Continue"
9. If all required questions answered, progress to Step 4
10. If missing required answers:
    - Highlight unanswered questions in red
    - Scroll to first unanswered
    - Display error: "Please answer all required questions"

2. If job has NO screening questions:
   - Skip this step automatically
   - Progress directly to Step 4

**A5: Attach Work Samples (Step 4)**
1. Display attachments section:
   - **Upload Area:**
     - Drag-and-drop zone
     - "Or click to browse" link
     - Supported formats: Images, PDFs, DOC, DOCX, PPT, PPTX, XLS, XLSX
     - Max file size: 25MB per file
     - Max attachments: 10
   
2. **Upload Methods:**
   - **Drag & Drop:**
     - User drags files into drop zone
     - Visual feedback (highlight zone)
     - System uploads: `POST /v1/storage/attachments`
   - **File Browser:**
     - User clicks "Browse Files"
     - System file picker opens
     - User selects files
     - System uploads
   - **Portfolio Linking:**
     - "Link from Portfolio" button
     - Display user's existing portfolio items
     - User selects items to link
     - No upload needed (reference existing)
   
3. **Upload Process:**
   - For each file:
     - Display upload progress bar
     - Show file name, size, type
     - Calculate upload percentage
     - If upload fails:
       - Display error under file
       - [Retry] button
       - Max 3 retries
   
4. **Uploaded Files Management:**
   - Display list of uploaded files:
     - **For each file:**
       - Thumbnail preview (for images, PDFs)
       - File name (editable)
       - File size
       - **Title** input (optional, max 100 chars)
       - **Description** text area (optional, max 500 chars)
       - **Drag handle** for reordering
       - [View] button → Preview modal
       - [Remove] button → Delete confirmation
   
5. **File Validation:**
   - Check file type is allowed
   - Check file size ≤ 25MB
   - Check total attachments ≤ 10
   - Scan for viruses/malware
   - If validation fails:
     - Display error
     - Prevent upload
     - Explain issue
   
6. **Reordering:**
   - User drags files to reorder
   - System saves order: `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/attachments/reorder`
   - First attachment is primary (shown first to client)
   
7. **Attachment Tips:**
   - Display helpful tips:
     - "Add 2-3 relevant work samples"
     - "Showcase work similar to this job"
     - "Include case studies or results"
     - "Organize by most impressive first"
   
8. User finishes adding attachments (optional, can skip)
9. User clicks "Save & Continue"
10. Progress to Step 5

**A6: Review & Preview (Step 5)**
1. Display comprehensive proposal preview:
   - **Section Navigation:**
     - Quick links to each section
     - Edit buttons for each section
   
   - **Cover Letter Section:**
     - Full formatted cover letter
     - Word count display
     - Tone badge
     - Personalization score
     - [Edit Cover Letter] button
   
   - **Pricing Section:**
     - Proposed amount or hourly rate
     - Timeline
     - Milestones (if applicable):
       - Table with columns: Description | Amount | Due Date
       - Total row
     - [Edit Pricing] button
   
   - **Screening Answers Section:**
     - All questions with answers
     - Completeness check: "5/5 questions answered ✓"
     - [Edit Answers] button
   
   - **Attachments Section:**
     - Grid of attached work samples
     - Thumbnails with titles
     - [Edit Attachments] button
   
   - **Profile Preview:**
     - "How clients see your profile" section
     - Profile snippet (as shown to client)
     - Rating, success rate, reviews count
     - Skills, portfolio highlights
     - [View Full Profile] link

2. **Quality Score:**
   - System calculates overall quality: `GET /v1/proposals/{id}/quality-score`
   - Display quality score: 0-100
   - Breakdown:
     - Cover Letter: 85/100
     - Pricing: 70/100
     - Profile Match: 90/100
     - Completeness: 100/100
   - Overall: 86/100 - "Excellent"
   - **If score < 60:**
     - Warning: "Your proposal could be improved"
     - Suggestions for improvement:
       - "Add more detail to cover letter"
       - "Your pricing is significantly higher than budget"
       - "Complete your profile skills section"

3. **Final Checks:**
   - System performs pre-submission validation:
     - Cover letter meets requirements ✓
     - Pricing is set ✓
     - Required questions answered ✓
     - No content violations ✓
     - User has sufficient connects ✓
   - Display checklist with checkmarks
   - If any item fails, highlight and block submission

4. **Connects Summary:**
   - Display connects cost breakdown:
     - "This proposal costs 4 connects"
     - Current balance: "You have 12 connects"
     - After submission: "You'll have 8 connects remaining"
   - If insufficient connects:
     - Error: "You don't have enough connects"
     - [Buy Connects] button → Navigate to subscription page

5. **Preview as Client Sees:**
   - "Preview Client View" button
   - Opens modal showing proposal exactly as client will see it
   - Helps user understand presentation
   - Includes profile, cover letter, pricing, attachments

6. User reviews all sections
7. User can edit any section (navigates back to that step)
8. When satisfied, user clicks "Submit Proposal"

**A7: Submit Proposal**
1. User clicks "Submit Proposal" button
2. Display confirmation modal:
   - **Modal Header:** "Submit this proposal?"
   - **Summary:**
     - Job title
     - Proposed amount or hourly rate
     - Quality score badge
   - **Connects Cost:**
     - "This will deduct 4 connects from your balance"
     - Before: 12 connects
     - After: 8 connects
   - **Important Notes:**
     - "Once submitted, you cannot withdraw for 24 hours"
     - "Client will be notified immediately"
     - "You can track proposal status in your dashboard"
   - **Buttons:**
     - [Cancel] - Close modal
     - [Submit Proposal] - Proceed with submission

3. User clicks "Submit Proposal" in modal
4. System performs final validation:
   - Check all required fields filled
   - Validate content one more time
   - Verify connects balance hasn't changed
   - Verify job is still open
   - Check user hasn't already submitted (race condition check)

5. If all checks pass:
   - System reserves connects: `POST /v1/connects/reserve`
   - System submits proposal: `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/submit`
   - Backend performs:
     - Mark proposal status: DRAFT → SUBMITTED
     - Deduct connects: `POST /v1/connects/deduct`
     - Emit event: `proposal.submitted.v1`
     - Trigger notifications:
       - Notify client (email, in-app)
       - Notify user (confirmation email)
     - Index proposal for client search
     - Calculate match score (job vs proposal)
     - Update freelancer stats (total proposals +1)
     - Update job stats (proposals count +1)

6. Display success modal:
   - **Success Message:**
     - "🎉 Proposal Submitted Successfully!"
     - "Job: [Job Title]"
     - "Proposal ID: #12345"
   - **Next Steps:**
     - "The client has been notified"
     - "You'll be notified when the client reviews your proposal"
     - "Expected response time: 2-5 days"
   - **Actions:**
     - [View Proposal] → Navigate to proposal detail page
     - [Submit Another] → Back to job search
     - [Go to Dashboard] → Navigate to dashboard
   - **Auto-redirect:** After 5 seconds, navigate to proposal detail page

7. Navigate to: `(dashboard)/proposals/[proposalId]`

**A8: Save as Draft (Alternate Flow)**
1. At any step, user can click "Save as Draft"
2. System saves current progress: `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/draft`
3. No connects are deducted
4. Display toast: "Draft saved successfully"
5. User can navigate away
6. Draft appears in `(dashboard)/proposals/drafts`
7. Draft expires after 30 days (auto-deleted)
8. User can return later to complete and submit

### Edge Cases & Alternate Flows

**B1: Insufficient Connects**
- When user clicks "Submit Proposal" and has insufficient connects:
  - Display error modal:
    - "You Don't Have Enough Connects"
    - "This proposal requires 4 connects, but you only have 2"
    - "Connects Balance: 2"
    - "Connects Needed: 4"
    - "Options:"
      - [Buy Connects] → Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/subscription`
      - [Save as Draft] → Save without submitting
      - [Cancel] → Close modal
- Prevent submission until connects purchased

**B2: Job Closed Before Submission**
- If job closes while user is writing proposal:
  - System detects on submission attempt
  - Display error modal:
    - "This Job is No Longer Accepting Proposals"
    - "The client has closed this job"
    - "Your draft has been saved"
    - "Options:"
      - [View Similar Jobs] → Search similar open jobs
      - [Save Draft] → Keep draft for reference
      - [Delete Draft] → Discard proposal
- Do NOT deduct connects
- Refund if connects were reserved

**B3: Duplicate Proposal**
- If user tries to submit second proposal for same job:
  - System detects duplicate
  - Display error:
    - "You've Already Submitted a Proposal"
    - "You submitted a proposal on [Date]"
    - "Proposal Status: [Status]"
    - "Options:"
      - [View Existing Proposal] → Navigate to proposal detail
      - [Withdraw and Resubmit] → If allowed, withdraw old and submit new
      - [Cancel] → Close modal
- Prevent duplicate submission

**B4: Cover Letter Validation Failures**
- **Too Short:**
  - Error: "Cover letter must be at least 50 words (currently: 32)"
  - Highlight word count in red
  - Prevent progression
- **Too Long:**
  - Warning at 4,500 words: "Approaching character limit"
  - Error at 5,000: "Cover letter exceeds maximum length"
  - Prevent submission
- **PII Detected:**
  - Warning: "⚠️ We detected contact information (email/phone)"
  - Highlight detected PII
  - Explanation: "Avoid sharing contact info before hiring"
  - Allow user to proceed (soft warning) or edit
- **Profanity:**
  - Error: "Cover letter contains inappropriate language"
  - Block submission until fixed
  - Don't specify exact word (privacy)
- **External Links:**
  - Warning: "⚠️ Avoid adding external links in cover letter"
  - Soft warning, user can proceed

**B5: Milestone Validation Errors**
- **Sum Doesn't Match Budget:**
  - Error: "Milestone total ($4,200) doesn't match proposed budget ($5,000)"
  - Highlight total in red
  - Options:
    - Adjust milestones
    - Adjust budget
    - Remove milestone breakdown
- **Too Many Milestones:**
  - Limit: 20 milestones max
  - Error: "You can add up to 20 milestones"
  - Disable "Add Milestone" button
- **Invalid Dates:**
  - If due date is in past:
    - Error: "Due date cannot be in the past"
  - If dates are out of order:
    - Warning: "Milestone 2 due before Milestone 1"
    - Suggest reordering

**B6: Attachment Upload Failures**
- **File Too Large:**
  - Error: "File exceeds maximum size (25MB)"
  - Display file size
  - Suggest compressing or using different file
- **Invalid File Type:**
  - Error: "File type not supported (.exe)"
  - List supported types
- **Virus/Malware Detected:**
  - Error: "File failed security scan"
  - Block upload
  - Don't upload malicious file
- **Storage Limit Reached:**
  - Error: "You've reached your storage limit"
  - [Upgrade Plan] or [Delete Old Files]
- **Network Error:**
  - Display: "Upload failed. Try again."
  - [Retry] button
  - Max 3 retries
  - If still failing: "Unable to upload. Check your connection."

**B7: Screening Question Validation**
- **Required Question Unanswered:**
  - Error: "Please answer all required questions"
  - Highlight unanswered questions in red
  - Scroll to first missing answer
  - Prevent progression
- **Answer Too Short:**
  - Error: "Answer must be at least 50 characters"
  - Character counter in red
- **Answer Too Long:**
  - Error: "Answer exceeds maximum length (1000 characters)"
  - Prevent typing beyond limit

**B8: Network/Connection Issues**
- **Auto-save Failure:**
  - If auto-save fails:
    - Display warning: "⚠️ Unable to save. Check your connection."
    - Store draft locally (localStorage)
    - Retry save when connection restored
    - Notify user when save succeeds
- **Submission Failure:**
  - If submission API fails:
    - Display error modal:
      - "Submission Failed"
      - "There was a problem submitting your proposal"
      - "Your draft is saved. You can retry."
      - [Retry Submission] [Save and Exit]
    - Do NOT deduct connects on failure
    - Log error for debugging

**B9: Job Budget Mismatch**
- If user's bid is outside job's stated budget:
  - Display warning:
    - "⚠️ Your Bid is Outside Client's Budget"
    - "Client's budget: $2,000-$5,000"
    - "Your bid: $7,000"
    - "This may reduce your chances of being selected"
    - "Explain Your Pricing:" (text area)
  - Optional explanation field
  - Allow submission (soft warning)

**B10: AI Assistance Unavailable**
- If AI service is down:
  - Hide "✨ Improve with AI" buttons
  - Display subtle notice: "AI assistance temporarily unavailable"
  - Allow user to continue without AI
  - Don't block submission
- If AI returns no suggestions:
  - Display: "Your content looks great! No suggestions at this time."

**B11: Template Loading**
- **Load Template:**
  - User selects template from dropdown
  - Display confirmation: "Load template? This will replace your current cover letter."
  - [Load Template] [Cancel]
  - If loaded, replace content
  - Mark as template-based (for analytics)
- **Save as Template:**
  - User clicks "Save as Template"
  - Display modal:
    - "Template Name:" (input, required)
    - "Description:" (optional)
    - "Category:" (dropdown, optional)
    - [Save Template] [Cancel]
  - System saves: `POST /v1/proposals/templates`
  - Display toast: "Template saved successfully"

**B12: Profile Completeness Warning**
- If user's profile is < 80% complete:
  - Display banner:
    - "⚠️ Complete Your Profile"
    - "Clients prefer complete profiles. Your profile is 65% complete."
    - [Complete Profile] [Dismiss]
  - Soft warning, doesn't block submission
  - Track dismissals (don't annoy repeatedly)

**B13: Edit After Submission Started**
- If user navigates back after clicking "Submit":
  - Cancel submission in progress
  - Display toast: "Submission cancelled. Make your edits."
  - Allow editing
  - User must re-submit

**B14: Session Timeout**
- If user's session expires during proposal creation:
  - Auto-save draft to localStorage
  - Display: "Your session expired. Please log in again."
  - After login, restore draft from localStorage
  - Merge with server draft (if exists)

**B15: Concurrent Editing (Multiple Tabs)**
- If user has proposal open in multiple tabs:
  - Detect version conflicts
  - Display warning: "This proposal is open in another tab"
  - Options:
    - Use this version (discard other)
    - Use other version (refresh this tab)
  - Prevent data loss

**B16: Price Significantly Higher Than Average**
- If bid > 50% above average for category:
  - Display warning modal:
    - "Your Bid is Significantly Higher"
    - "Average bid for similar jobs: $3,200"
    - "Your bid: $6,500 (103% higher)"
    - "Suggestions:"
      - "Lower your bid for better competitiveness"
      - "Justify your pricing in the cover letter"
      - "Highlight unique expertise or faster delivery"
    - [Edit Pricing] [Continue Anyway]
  - Allow user to proceed or edit

**B17: Withdraw Draft**
- If user wants to delete draft:
  - Display confirmation:
    - "Delete this draft?"
    - "This action cannot be undone"
    - [Delete] [Cancel]
  - On confirm:
    - System deletes draft
    - No connects affected (never submitted)
    - Display toast: "Draft deleted"
    - Navigate to job search or drafts list

#### Notifications

**Draft Auto-Saved:**
- **In-app:** Toast: "Draft saved automatically" (subtle, doesn't interrupt)

**Proposal Submitted Successfully:**
- **Email:** Subject: "Your proposal has been submitted to TechCorp Inc."
  - Body: "Congratulations! You've submitted your proposal for 'Full-Stack Developer for E-commerce Platform'. The client has been notified and will review your proposal soon. Track your proposal status here: [Link]"
- **In-app:** Banner: "🎉 Proposal submitted! Track status in your dashboard."
- **Push (mobile):** "Proposal submitted successfully to TechCorp Inc."

**Insufficient Connects:**
- **In-app:** Error modal: "You don't have enough connects. Buy connects to submit."

**Job Closed Before Submission:**
- **In-app:** Error modal: "This job is no longer accepting proposals. Your draft has been saved."
- **Email:** "Job '[Title]' closed before you could submit. Your draft is saved in case the job reopens."

**Duplicate Proposal Attempt:**
- **In-app:** Warning: "You've already submitted a proposal for this job on [Date]."

**Cover Letter Auto-Improvement Suggestion:**
- **In-app:** Notification dot on "AI Improve" button when suggestions available
- No email/push (in-session only)

**Draft Expiring Soon:**
- **Email (7 days before expiry):** "Your draft proposal for '[Job Title]' will expire in 7 days. Complete and submit soon."
- **In-app:** Banner on draft: "⚠️ Expires in 7 days"

#### Analytics

**Events to Track:**
- `proposal_submission.started` - { job_id, user_id, source }
- `proposal_submission.step_completed` - { step_number, step_name, job_id, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.draft_saved` - { proposal_id, completion_percentage, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.submitted` - { proposal_id, job_id, budget, timeline, quality_score, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.abandoned` - { step_number, job_id, user_id, reason }
- `proposal_submission.cover_letter.ai_suggestions_requested` - { proposal_id, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.cover_letter.ai_suggestions_applied` - { proposal_id, suggestion_type, count, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.cover_letter.template_used` - { template_id, proposal_id, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.cover_letter.template_saved` - { template_id, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.milestones.ai_suggested` - { proposal_id, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.milestones.added` - { proposal_id, milestone_count, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.pricing.outside_budget` - { proposal_id, budget_diff_percent, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.attachments_uploaded` - { proposal_id, file_count, total_size, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.questions_answered` - { proposal_id, question_count, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.preview_viewed` - { proposal_id, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.insufficient_connects` - { proposal_id, connects_needed, connects_available, user_id }
- `proposal_submission.error` - { error_type, step, proposal_id, user_id }

**Metrics to Track:**
- Proposal submission funnel conversion (start → submit)
- Step completion rates (each step)
- Average time per step
- Draft save rate
- Template usage rate
- AI suggestion request rate
- AI suggestion acceptance rate
- Milestone usage rate (fixed-price jobs)
- Attachment upload rate
- Quality score distribution
- Pricing competitiveness (inside vs outside budget)
- Submission success rate (attempts vs actual submissions)
- Error rate by type and step
- Abandonment rate by step
- Average proposal quality score at submission
- Mobile vs web submission comparison

### Accessibility

**Keyboard Navigation:**
- Tab through all form fields in logical order
- Enter to submit from any input field (moves to next step)
- Escape to cancel modals/dialogs
- Arrow keys in rich text editor
- Ctrl+S to save draft
- Alt+N to move to next step
- Alt+P to move to previous step
- Shift + Tab for reverse navigation

**Screen Reader:**
- Announce wizard progress ("Step 1 of 5: Cover Letter")
- Read validation errors immediately when they occur
- Announce AI suggestions availability
- Describe file upload status (uploading, uploaded, failed)
- Announce connects deduction clearly before submission
- Read quality score and breakdown
- Announce successful submission

**Visual:**
- High contrast mode support for all text and UI elements
- Clear step indicators with checkmarks for completed steps
- Error messages in red with warning icons
- Success messages in green with checkmarks
- Focus indicators on all interactive elements (blue outline)
- Minimum font size 16px
- Color is not the only indicator (use icons + text)

**ARIA:**
- `role="progressbar"` for wizard steps with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`
- `role="form"` on proposal submission form
- `aria-label` on all form inputs ("Cover letter text", "Proposed budget", etc.)
- `aria-required="true"` on required fields
- `aria-invalid="true"` on fields with errors
- `aria-describedby` linking inputs to error/help messages
- `aria-live="polite"` for auto-save notifications
- `aria-live="assertive"` for critical errors (insufficient connects, submission failure)
- `role="alert"` for validation error messages
- `aria-expanded` on collapsible sections (AI suggestions, milestone breakdown)
- `aria-busy="true"` during file uploads and submission

### Performance

**Optimization:**
- Lazy load rich text editor (load only when user focuses on cover letter)
- Debounce auto-save (30 seconds after last keystroke)
- Debounce AI suggestions (1 second after typing stops)
- Debounce quality score calculation (2 seconds)
- Cache job details (avoid re-fetching on step navigation)
- Cache connects balance (5 min TTL, refresh on submission)
- Optimize file uploads (chunk large files, compress images)
- Progressive enhancement (form works without JavaScript for basic submission)
- Prefetch Step 2 data while user is on Step 1
- Store draft progress in localStorage (instant recovery on page reload)

**Bundle Size:**
- Code split wizard steps (load step 2-5 only when needed)
- Lazy load AI assistant module
- Lazy load file uploader library
- Lazy load template selector
- Async load quality score calculator
- Main proposal bundle: < 100KB (gzipped)
- Rich text editor: Loaded on demand
- File uploader: Loaded on demand

**Monitoring:**
- Track proposal submission load time (p50, p95, p99)
- Track API response times for each endpoint
- Track AI suggestion latency
- Track file upload success rate
- Track auto-save reliability
- Alert if submission API > 2 seconds (p95)
- Alert if auto-save failure rate > 1%
- Alert if file upload failure rate > 5%
- Track step navigation performance

### Security

**Access Control:**
- Only authenticated freelancers can submit proposals
- Users can only edit their own proposals
- Verify user owns draft before allowing edits
- JWT token required for all API calls
- Verify job is still open before submission

**Rate Limiting:**
- Proposal submission: 20 per day per user
- AI suggestions: 50 per hour per user
- File uploads: 100 per hour per user
- Draft saves: 120 per hour per user
- Prevents spam and abuse

**Input Validation:**
- **Client-side (UX):**
  - Real-time validation for immediate feedback
  - Character limits enforced
  - File type/size checks before upload
- **Server-side (Security):**
  - Re-validate all inputs on backend
  - Sanitize rich text content (remove scripts, dangerous HTML)
  - Validate file types and sizes on server
  - Scan uploaded files for malware
  - Check for SQL injection, XSS in text inputs
  - Verify pricing amounts are within acceptable ranges
  - Validate milestone math (sum matches budget)
  - Ensure connects balance hasn't changed (prevent race conditions)

**Content Moderation:**
- Real-time profanity check in cover letter
- PII detection (emails, phones, external links)
  - Warn user, don't block (soft validation)
  - Track violations for repeat offenders
- Scam pattern detection (too good to be true pricing, urgency language)
- Duplicate proposal detection
- Flag proposals for manual review if quality score too low or pricing suspicious

**Data Privacy:**
- Encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit
- Don't log full cover letter content in analytics (only metadata)
- User can delete draft at any time (hard delete, not soft)
- GDPR compliance: User can request full data export/deletion
- Connects deduction is transactional (all-or-nothing, no partial deductions)

#### Sources

**Backend:** proposals-be.user-stories.md (Proposal domain, CoverLetter domain, Attachment domain, QuestionAnswer domain, Milestone domain, Connect domain), proposals-be.database-design.md (proposals table, cover_letters table, attachments table, question_answers table, milestones table, connects table), proposals-be-folder-structure.md (proposal/, cover_letter/, attachment/, question_answer/, milestone/, connect/)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/proposals/submit/[jobId] route, (mobile)/(app)/proposals/submit routes, hooks/proposals/use-proposal-submission.ts, hooks/proposals/use-cover-letter.ts, hooks/proposals/use-milestones.ts, hooks/proposals/use-attachments.ts, components/proposals/submission/)

## PROP-2 — View & Manage Proposals

**ID:** PROP-2  
**Persona:** Freelancer  
**Description:** Comprehensive proposal management dashboard allowing freelancers to view, filter, track, and manage all their submitted proposals across different stages and statuses.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- **Triggers:**
  - User clicks "My Proposals" in navigation
  - User navigates to `(dashboard)/proposals`
  - User clicks "View All Proposals" from dashboard widget

  - User clicks proposal link from email notification
- **Preconditions:**
  - User is authenticated
  - User has Freelancer or Hybrid account type

#### System Touchpoints
- **proposals-be:**
  - `proposal/entity.go` — Core proposal entity
  - `proposal_status/entity.go` — Status management
  - `withdrawal/entity.go` — Withdrawal logic
  - `archive/entity.go` — Archive management
  - `pipeline/entity.go` — Pipeline stages
  - GET `/v1/proposals/my-proposals` — List all proposals (with filters, pagination, sorting)
  - GET `/v1/proposals/{id}` — Fetch proposal details
  - GET `/v1/proposals/{id}/stats` — Fetch proposal statistics (views, messages, timeline)

5. User makes changes to:
   - Cover letter
   - Pricing/budget
   - Timeline
   - Screening answers
   - Attachments
6. System auto-saves every 30 seconds
7. Display "Last saved" timestamp
8. User clicks "Save Changes" or "Submit Proposal"
9. If "Save Changes":
   - System calls: `PATCH /v1/proposals/{id}`
   - Display toast: "Changes saved"
   - Stay on edit page
10. If "Submit Proposal":
    - Navigate to review screen (same as PROP-1 Step 5)
    - Follow submission flow

**A5: Withdraw Proposal**
1. User clicks [Withdraw] button
2. System checks if withdrawal is allowed:
   - Status must be: Pending, Submitted, or Under Review
   - Cannot withdraw if: Accepted, Contract Started, or Declined
3. Navigate to `(dashboard)/proposals/[proposalId]/withdraw` or show modal
4. Display withdrawal form:
   
   **Withdrawal Modal:**
   - **Header:** "Withdraw Proposal?"
   - **Warning:** 
     - "⚠️ Once withdrawn, you cannot resubmit"
     - "Connects may be refunded based on timing"
   
   - **Refund Information:**
     - Connects spent: 4
     - Potential refund:
       - If < 24 hours: Full refund (4 connects)
       - If 24-72 hours: Partial refund (2 connects)
       - If > 72 hours: No refund
     - Your withdrawal: 36 hours after submission
     - **Refund: 2 connects**
   
   - **Reason (required):**
     - Dropdown:
       - Found another opportunity
       - Job requirements changed
       - Budget doesn't work
       - Timeline doesn't work
       - Client unresponsive
       - Personal reasons
       - Other (text field)
   
   - **Message to Client (optional):**
     - Text area: "Optionally, let the client know why you're withdrawing"
     - Max 500 characters
     - Template suggestions:
       - "Thank you for considering my proposal. I've accepted another project."
       - "I appreciate the opportunity, but the timeline doesn't work for me."
   
   - **Confirmation:**
     - Checkbox: "I understand this action cannot be undone"
   
   - **Buttons:**
     - [Cancel] - Close modal, no action
     - [Withdraw Proposal] - Primary, red, destructive action

5. User fills reason and optional message
6. User checks confirmation box
7. User clicks "Withdraw Proposal"
8. System performs withdrawal:
   ```typescript
   POST /v1/proposals/{id}/withdraw
   Body: {
     reason: "found_another_opportunity",
     message_to_client: "Thank you for considering...",
     confirmed: true
   }
   ```
9. Backend processes:
   - Update proposal status: PENDING → WITHDRAWN
   - Calculate connects refund
   - Refund connects: `POST /v1/connects/refund`
   - Send notification to client: `POST /v1/communications/notify`
   - Emit event: `proposal.withdrawn.v1`
   - Create activity log entry
10. Display success screen:
    - "✅ Proposal Withdrawn"
    - "Your proposal has been withdrawn successfully"
    - "Connects refunded: 2"
    - "New connects balance: 40"
    - Message to client: Sent ✅
    - [View Withdrawn Proposals] button
    - [Browse Jobs] button
    - Auto-redirect to proposals dashboard after 5 seconds
11. Update proposals list (remove from pending, add to withdrawn)
12. Send confirmation email to freelancer

**A6: Archive Proposal**
1. User clicks "Archive" from proposal menu
2. System checks if archive is allowed:
   - Can archive: Accepted, Declined, Withdrawn, Expired
   - Cannot archive: Active, Pending
3. Display confirmation modal:
   - "Archive this proposal?"
   - "Archived proposals won't appear in your active list"
   - "You can restore them anytime from the Archived tab"
   - [Cancel] | [Archive]
4. User confirms
5. System calls: `PATCH /v1/proposals/{id}/archive`
6. Backend:
   - Update status: ADD archived flag
   - Emit event: `proposal.archived.v1`
7. Display toast: "Proposal archived"
8. Remove from current view
9. Proposal appears in Archived tab
10. User can restore later from `(dashboard)/proposals/archived`

**A7: Pipeline Stage Management**
1. User views proposals in pipeline/kanban view
2. Display stages as columns:
   - **Draft** (3)
   - **Submitted** (8)
   - **Viewed** (12)
   - **Interview** (5)
   - **Offer** (2)
   - **Hired** (15)
   - **Declined** (7)
3. Each column shows proposal cards (mini version)
4. User can drag-drop proposals between stages
5. System detects drag event
6. Display drop zones (highlight valid stages)
7. User drops proposal in new stage
8. System calls: `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/pipeline/move`
   ```json
   {
     "from_stage": "submitted",
     "to_stage": "interview",
     "notes": "Client scheduled interview"
   }
   ```
9. Backend validates stage transition
10. Update proposal stage
11. Emit event: `proposal.pipeline.moved.v1`
12. Display toast: "Proposal moved to Interview stage"
13. Update UI immediately (optimistic update)
14. Track stage duration for analytics

**A8: Bulk Actions**
1. User selects multiple proposals (checkboxes)
2. Display bulk action bar at bottom:
   - "3 proposals selected"
   - [Archive Selected]
   - [Withdraw Selected]
   - [Export Selected]
   - [Mark as Favorite]
   - [Deselect All]
3. User clicks bulk action
4. Display confirmation modal (for destructive actions)
5. User confirms
6. System processes batch:
   ```typescript
   POST /v1/proposals/bulk/archive
   Body: {
     proposal_ids: ["id1", "id2", "id3"]
   }
   ```
7. Backend processes each proposal
8. Return success/failure for each
9. Display results:
   - "✅ 2 proposals archived successfully"
   - "❌ 1 proposal failed (reason: already archived)"
10. Update UI to reflect changes
11. Clear selection

**A9: Export Proposals**
1. User clicks "Export" button
2. Display export modal:
   
   **Export Options:**
   - **Format:**
     - ○ CSV
     - ○ PDF
     - ○ Excel
   
   - **Data to Include:**
     - ☑ Proposal details
     - ☑ Job information
     - ☑ Client information
     - ☑ Status and timeline
     - ☑ Connects spent
     - ☐ Full cover letters
     - ☐ Messages
     - ☐ Analytics
   
   - **Filters:**
     - Export current filter: "Pending proposals from last 30 days"
     - Or: Export all proposals
   
   - **Date Range:**
     - From: Oct 1, 2025
     - To: Nov 7, 2025
   
   - [Cancel] | [Generate Export]

3. User selects options and clicks "Generate Export"
4. System calls: `POST /v1/proposals/export`
   ```json
   {
     "format": "pdf",
     "filters": {...},
     "include_fields": ["details", "job_info", "client_info"]
   }
   ```
5. Backend generates export (async job):
   - Queue export task
   - Return job_id
6. Display progress:
   - "⏳ Generating your export..."
   - Progress bar (if available)
   - "This may take a few minutes"
7. When complete:
   - Display success: "✅ Export ready!"
   - [Download] button
   - Email link to download (if large file)
8. User downloads file
9. Log export event for analytics

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**Empty State (No Proposals):**
- Display empty state illustration
- Title: "No proposals yet"
- Message: "Start applying to jobs to build your pipeline"
- Actions:
  - [Browse Jobs] button (primary)
  - [Learn How to Write Great Proposals] link (help article)
- Show sample proposal card (template/example)

**Job Closed Before Viewing:**
- User opens proposal detail
- System detects job is closed: `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/status` returns "CLOSED"
- Display warning banner:
  - "⚠️ This job has been closed by the client"
  - "You can still view your proposal, but no further action is possible"
  - Options:
    - [Archive Proposal] button
    - [Find Similar Jobs] button
- Disable edit/withdraw buttons
- Mark proposal as "Job Closed" in list view

**Client Deleted Job:**
- System detects job is deleted (404 response)
- Display error banner:
  - "❌ This job posting has been removed"
  - "Your proposal is no longer active"
  - "Connects: Refunded automatically"
- Auto-archive proposal
- Show in proposals list with special badge: "Job Removed"

**Proposal Expiration:**
- Proposals expire after 90 days if no response
- 7 days before expiry:
  - Send notification: "Proposal expires in 7 days"
  - Show countdown in proposal card
  - Option to "Extend" proposal (if feature available)
- On expiry:
  - Auto-update status: PENDING → EXPIRED
  - Send notification: "Proposal expired"
  - Move to Expired filter
  - Suggest archiving or applying to similar jobs

**Concurrent Edits (Draft):**
- User opens draft on Device A
- User also opens same draft on Device B
- User edits on Device A and saves
- User tries to save on Device B
- System detects conflict:
  - "⚠️ This draft was updated on another device"
  - "Your changes may overwrite recent updates"
  - Options:
    - [View Latest Version] - Discard local changes
    - [Merge Changes] - Attempt auto-merge
    - [Overwrite] - Force save (dangerous)
- Recommend using latest version to avoid data loss

**Network Error During Submission:**
- User clicks "Submit Proposal" (from draft)
- Network request fails mid-flight
- System detects network error
- Display error:
  - "❌ Submission failed due to network error"
  - "Your draft has been saved"
  - "Please check your connection and try again"
- [Retry] button
- Draft remains in DRAFT status
- No connects deducted

**Withdrawal After Client Viewed:**
- User attempts to withdraw proposal
- System checks: Client has viewed proposal 3 times
- Display additional warning:
  - "ℹ️ The client has viewed your proposal 3 times"
  - "They may be interested. Consider waiting for a response."
  - "Are you sure you want to withdraw?"
- User can proceed or cancel
- If proceeds: Follow standard withdrawal flow

**Multiple Proposals to Same Client:**
- User tries to submit proposal
- System detects user has active proposals to same client for different jobs
- Display info banner (not blocking):
  - "ℹ️ You have 2 other active proposals to this client"
  - [View Other Proposals] link
- Allow submission (not an error)
- In proposals list, group by client option

**Proposal Quality Too Low:**
- User submits proposal
- System calculates quality score: 42/100
- Display warning modal:
  - "⚠️ Your proposal quality score is low (42/100)"
  - "Low-quality proposals are less likely to be accepted"
  - "Issues detected:"
    - "Cover letter is too short (< 100 words)"
    - "No relevant skills mentioned"
    - "No attachments included"
  - "Recommendations:"
    - "Expand your cover letter"
    - "Add relevant portfolio samples"
    - "Personalize your message to the client"
  - Options:
    - [Improve Proposal] - Return to edit
    - [Submit Anyway] - Proceed (not recommended)
- Track submissions despite warnings

**Connects Insufficient (Edge Case):**
- User starts editing draft
- User submits proposal
- Between start and submit, connects were spent elsewhere
- System detects insufficient connects at submission
- Display error:
  - "❌ Insufficient Connects"
  - "This proposal requires 4 connects"
  - "Your current balance: 2 connects"
  - "Draft saved. Purchase more connects to submit."
- [Buy Connects] button
- Draft remains saved
- No deduction attempt

**Client Requests Changes:**
- Client sends message: "Can you adjust your timeline?"
- Notification received
- User views message in proposal detail
- User can:
  - Reply in messages
  - Edit proposal (if still in editable window)
  - Create counter-offer (PROP-4)
- System tracks negotiation thread

**Duplicate Proposal Detection:**
- User tries to submit proposal to same job twice
- System detects: `proposal_id exists for user_id + job_id`
- Display error:
  - "❌ You've already submitted a proposal for this job"
  - "Submitted on: Nov 3, 2025"
  - "Proposal ID: #12345"
  - "[View Existing Proposal] button"
- Block duplicate submission
- Offer to edit existing proposal instead

**Filter Persistence:**
- User applies filters
- User navigates away
- User returns to proposals page
- System restores previous filters from:
  - URL params (if present)
  - Or localStorage (fallback)
  - Or default (all proposals)
- Display same filtered view as before

**Slow Network / Loading States:**
- User opens proposals dashboard
- API calls are slow (> 2 seconds)
- Display loading skeletons:
  - Summary cards: Shimmer placeholders
  - Proposals list: Card skeletons
- Show progressive loading:
  - Load summary first (faster query)
  - Then load proposals list
- If timeout (> 10 seconds):
  - Display error: "Taking longer than usual"
  - [Retry] button
  - Option to load cached data (if available)

**Mobile: Swipe Actions:**
- User swipes left on proposal card
- Reveal quick action buttons:
  - [Archive] - Gray
  - [Withdraw] - Red (if applicable)
- User swipes right:
  - [Star/Favorite] - Yellow
  - [Message] - Blue
- Tap action to execute
- Confirm if destructive (withdraw)

**Mobile: Filter Bottom Sheet:**
- User taps "Filter" button
- Display bottom sheet (slides up from bottom)
- Scrollable filter options
- Apply button fixed at bottom
- Swipe down or tap outside to close
- Filters applied immediately on "Apply"

#### Accessibility

**Keyboard Navigation:**

  - `n` - New proposal
  - `f` - Open filters

  - `v` - Toggle view (card/table)

**Screen Reader:**

- Read proposal cards in logical order
- Announce action results: "Proposal withdrawn successfully"

**Visual:**

- Clear focus indicators (blue outline)

  - Green (Accepted) has checkmark icon
  - Red (Declined) has X icon
  - Yellow (Pending) has clock icon

**ARIA:**
- `role="table"` on table view with proper headers

#### Performance

**Optimization:**
- Lazy load proposal cards (virtual scrolling for 100+ proposals)
- Image lazy loading (client avatars, attachments)
- Paginate API calls (20 per page)
- Cache proposals list (5 min TTL)
- Debounce search input (300ms)
- Prefetch proposal details on hover (web)
- Optimize re-renders (React.memo on cards)
- Bundle split: Proposals page separate chunk

**Loading States:**
- Skeleton loaders for initial load
- Shimmer effect on cards
- Progressive loading (summary first, then list)
- Optimistic updates (withdraw, archive)
- Background refresh (pull-to-refresh on mobile)

**Monitoring:**
- Track page load time (target: < 2s)
- Track time to interactive (target: < 3s)
- Track API response times (p50, p95, p99)
- Alert if load time > 5s (p95)
- Alert if API errors > 1%

#### Security

**Access Control:**
- JWT authentication required
- Only proposal owner can view/edit
- Row-level security on API
- Cannot view other users' proposals

**Rate Limiting:**
- 100 proposals list requests per minute
- 500 detail page views per hour
- 20 withdrawals per day
- 50 bulk actions per hour

**Input Validation:**
- Sanitize search queries (SQL injection prevention)
- Validate proposal IDs (UUID format)
- Verify proposal ownership before mutations
- CSRF token on all POST/PATCH/DELETE

**Backend:** proposals-be.user-stories.md (proposal/, withdrawal/, archive/, pipeline/), proposals-be.database-design.md (proposals, proposal_status, withdrawals, archives)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/proposals routes, hooks/proposals/, components/proposals/)

## PROP-3: Proposal Quality Score & Evaluation

**ID:** PROP-3  
**Persona:** Client, Freelancer  
**Microservices:** proposals-be, users-be, jobs-be, ml-be

---

#### Preconditions & Triggers

**Entry Points:**
- Client views proposal details page
- Client viewing proposals list (scores shown in card/row)
- Freelancer views own proposal after submission
- Admin reviewing flagged proposals

**Prerequisites:**
- Proposal must be submitted (status = SUBMITTED/UNDER_REVIEW/SHORTLISTED/etc.)
- Quality scoring has been computed (triggered automatically on submission)
- User authenticated with appropriate permissions

**Triggering Events:**
- proposal.submitted.v1 → triggers automatic quality scoring
- proposal.updated.v1 → triggers rescore if significant changes
- proposal.viewed.v1 → may trigger quality visibility rules
- Client navigating to proposals list or detail

---

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `/(dashboard)/proposals/[id]` - Proposal detail page with quality score
- `/(dashboard)/proposals/[id]/quality` - Detailed quality breakdown
- `/(dashboard)/jobs/[id]/proposals` - Client view with quality scores
- `/(dashboard)/quality-insights` - Freelancer quality dashboard

**Mobile Routes:**
- `/(tabs)/proposals/[id]` - Proposal detail with quality badge
- `/(tabs)/proposals/quality/[id]` - Quality breakdown modal
- `/(tabs)/jobs/[id]/proposals` - Client view with quality indicators
- `/(tabs)/insights/quality` - Quality performance metrics

**Components:**
```
components/
└── proposals/
    ├── quality/
    │   ├── QualityScoreCard.tsx          # Overall score display (web + mobile)
    │   ├── QualityBreakdown.tsx          # Detailed breakdown panel
    │   ├── QualityBadge.tsx              # Compact badge for lists
    │   ├── QualityChart.tsx              # Radar/bar chart visualization
    │   ├── QualityTrends.tsx             # Historical quality trends
    │   ├── QualityInsights.tsx           # AI-powered improvement suggestions
    │   ├── QualityComparison.tsx         # Compare with other proposals
    │   ├── SkillMatchIndicator.tsx       # Skill matching visualization
    │   └── QualityImprovementTips.tsx    # Actionable improvement tips
```

---

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend APIs:**
```
proposals-be:
- GET /v1/proposals/:id/quality → Get quality score
- GET /v1/proposals/:id/quality/breakdown → Detailed metrics
- GET /v1/proposals/:id/quality/history → Historical scores
- POST /v1/proposals/:id/quality/rescore → Manual rescore (admin)

ml-be:
- POST /v1/scoring/proposal → Calculate quality score (internal)
- GET /v1/scoring/proposal/:id/insights → AI suggestions
- GET /v1/scoring/benchmarks → Get scoring benchmarks

users-be:
- GET /v1/users/:id/reputation → Freelancer reputation impact
- GET /v1/users/:id/quality-stats → Aggregate quality stats

jobs-be:
- GET /v1/jobs/:id/requirements → Job requirements for matching
```

**Event Flow:**
```
1. proposal.submitted.v1 (proposals-be)
   └→ quality.scoring.triggered.v1 (proposals-be)
      └→ ml-be calculates score
         └→ quality.score.calculated.v1
            └→ proposals-be updates proposal_quality_scores table
               └→ quality.score.updated.v1 (notify freelancer)

2. Client views proposal
   └→ proposal.viewed.v1
      └→ quality.score.viewed.v1 (analytics)
```

---

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

##### **1. Automatic Quality Scoring (Backend - Triggered on Submission)**

**Step 1.1: Proposal Submission Triggers Scoring**
- Freelancer submits proposal
- proposals-be publishes `proposal.submitted.v1`
- Quality scoring service listens and triggers calculation

**Step 1.2: ML-Based Quality Calculation**
```
Quality Score Components (0-100):
├── Completeness (25 points)
│   ├── Cover letter length & quality (10 pts)
│   ├── Attachments/portfolio items (5 pts)
│   ├── Screening questions answered (5 pts)
│   └── Profile completeness (5 pts)
│
├── Skill Match (25 points)
│   ├── Required skills coverage (15 pts)
│   ├── Preferred skills coverage (7 pts)
│   └── Relevant experience years (3 pts)
│
├── Professionalism (20 points)
│   ├── Grammar & spelling (8 pts)
│   ├── Tone analysis (6 pts)
│   ├── Formatting quality (3 pts)
│   └── Professionalism signals (3 pts)
│
├── Relevance (15 points)
│   ├── Job description keyword match (8 pts)
│   ├── Industry alignment (4 pts)
│   └── Project type fit (3 pts)
│
├── Pricing (10 points)
│   ├── Price competitiveness (5 pts)
│   ├── Value proposition clarity (3 pts)
│   └── Budget alignment (2 pts)
│
└── Engagement Signals (5 points)
    ├── Response time (2 pts)
    ├── Custom proposal vs template (2 pts)
    └── Early submission bonus (1 pt)
```

**Step 1.3: Score Persistence**
- Score stored in `proposal_quality_scores` table
- Breakdown stored as JSONB
- Historical scores maintained for trending

**Step 1.4: Notification to Freelancer**
- In-app notification with score
- Email with improvement tips if score < 70

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**Case 1: Low Quality Score (<50)**
- Freelancer sees prominent warning in proposal detail
- Email sent with specific improvement actions
- Proposal may be deprioritized in client search results
- Freelancer prompted to revise before final submission

**Case 2: Quality Score Unavailable**
- Scoring in progress (show loading state)
- Technical error in scoring (show fallback message)
- Proposal too old (pre-dating quality system)

**Case 3: Manual Rescore Request (Admin)**
- Admin can trigger rescore via Admin Panel
- Useful if ML model updated or freelancer disputes score
- API: `POST /v1/proposals/:id/quality/rescore`

**Case 4: Quality Score Changes After Edit**
- Freelancer edits proposal
- If changes are significant (>10% content change), trigger rescore
- Notify freelancer of new score

**Case 5: Client Filtering by Quality**
- Client can filter proposals by quality tier
- Filter options: Excellent (85+), Good (70-84), Fair (50-69), Poor (<50)
- API: `GET /v1/jobs/:jobId/proposals?quality_min=70`

**Case 6: Quality Score Privacy**
- Freelancer can always see own quality score
- Client can see quality score for proposals to their jobs
- Other freelancers cannot see competitor quality scores
- Quality scores not shown in public profiles

**Case 7: Disputed Quality Score**
- Freelancer can appeal quality score
- Opens support ticket with justification
- Admin reviews and may adjust or explain
- Flow: Proposal detail → "Dispute Score" button → Support form

---

#### Notifications

**In-App:**
- "Your proposal scored 85 (Excellent)! 🎉" (after submission)
- "Your proposal quality could be improved. See suggestions." (if <70)
- "Quality score updated: 78 → 82" (after edit & rescore)

**Email:**
- Subject: "Your Proposal Quality Score: 85 (Excellent)"
- Content: Score, breakdown, top 3 strengths, improvement tips
- CTA: "View Full Report" → links to quality page

**Push (Mobile):**
- "Proposal scored 85! Top 15% quality ⭐"
- Tap → Opens proposal detail with quality tab

#### Analytics

**Events to Track:**
```javascript
// Quality score generated
track('quality_score_calculated', {
  proposal_id: 'prop_123',
  freelancer_id: 'user_456',
  job_id: 'job_789',
  overall_score: 85,
  completeness: 23,
  skill_match: 25,
  professionalism: 18,
  relevance: 12,
  pricing: 7,
  engagement: 4,
  quality_tier: 'excellent' // excellent|good|fair|poor
});

// Freelancer views quality breakdown
track('quality_breakdown_viewed', {
  proposal_id: 'prop_123',
  freelancer_id: 'user_456',
  score: 85,
  view_type: 'detailed' // compact|detailed
});

// Client views quality score
track('client_quality_score_viewed', {
  proposal_id: 'prop_123',
  client_id: 'user_999',
  job_id: 'job_789',
  score: 85
});

// Client filters by quality
track('proposals_filtered_by_quality', {
  client_id: 'user_999',
  job_id: 'job_789',
  quality_min: 70,
  quality_max: 100,
  result_count: 12
});

// Improvement suggestion clicked
track('quality_improvement_clicked', {
  proposal_id: 'prop_123',
  freelancer_id: 'user_456',
  suggestion_type: 'enhance_cover_letter',
  potential_gain: 5
});

// Quality score disputed
track('quality_score_disputed', {
  proposal_id: 'prop_123',
  freelancer_id: 'user_456',
  score: 72,
  reason: 'Skills undervalued'
});
```

**Metrics:**
- Average quality score by freelancer tier
- Quality score distribution (histogram)
- Correlation: quality score vs. proposal acceptance rate
- Time to calculate score (performance)
- Rescore frequency and reasons
- Dispute rate and resolution outcomes

---

#### Accessibility

**Keyboard Navigation:**
- Tab through quality breakdown items
- Enter to expand/collapse sections
- Arrow keys to navigate chart data points
- Ctrl+Q to open quality modal (if on proposal page)

**Screen Reader:**
- "Quality score: 85 out of 100, Excellent tier"
- "Completeness: 23 out of 25 points, 92 percent"
- "Your proposal ranks in the top 15 percent"
- Announce each breakdown category with score and percentage
- Read improvement suggestions in priority order

**Visual:**
- Color-blind safe tier colors:
  - Excellent: Dark blue + star icon
  - Good: Blue + checkmark icon
  - Fair: Orange + warning icon
  - Poor: Red + alert icon
- High contrast mode support
- Chart data available in table format
- Progress bars with numerical labels
- Minimum font size: 14px (mobile), 16px (web)

**ARIA:**
- `role="meter"` on score displays
- `aria-label="Quality score 85 out of 100"`
- `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` on progress bars
- `aria-describedby` linking score to explanation
- `aria-live="polite"` for score updates

---

#### Performance

**Optimization:**
- Quality scores cached (60 min TTL)
- Breakdown computed on-demand (not always with list)
- Lazy load quality chart (only when tab active)
- Prefetch quality data on hover (web)
- Compress quality breakdown JSON
- Index on proposal_quality_scores.proposal_id

**Loading States:**
- Skeleton loader for quality card
- Shimmer on chart while loading
- Fallback: "Quality score calculating..."
- Progressive enhancement (show score first, then breakdown)

**Monitoring:**
- Track quality calculation time (target: <2s, p95)
- Alert if scoring fails > 1% of submissions
- Monitor cache hit rate (target: >80%)

---

#### Security

**Access Control:**
- Freelancer can view own proposal quality scores (always)
- Client can view quality scores for proposals to their jobs (always)
- Admin can view all quality scores
- Quality calculation is server-side only (no client manipulation)

**Rate Limiting:**
- Manual rescore requests: 5 per hour per admin
- Quality breakdown API: 60 per hour per user
- Prevent score manipulation attacks

**Data Privacy:**
- Quality breakdown may contain sensitive data (skills, pricing)
- Never expose competitor quality scores publicly
- Audit log for quality score accesses

---

#### Sources

**Backend:**  
- proposals-be.database-design.md (proposal_quality_scores, proposal_skill_matches, proposal_ai_suggestions)
- proposals-be.user-stories.md (quality scoring flows)
- ml-be (quality calculation algorithms)

**Frontend:**  
- combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/proposals/[id]/quality routes, components/proposals/quality/)

## PROP-4: Proposal Review & Client Actions (Shortlist, Interview, Feedback)

**ID:** PROP-4  
**Persona:** Client  
**Microservices:** proposals-be, notifications-be, comms-be, calendar-be

---

#### Preconditions & Triggers

**Entry Points:**
- Client receives notification of new proposal
- Client browsing proposals list for their job
- Client searching for talent
- Client dashboard showing active proposals

**Prerequisites:**
- Client has active job posting with proposals
- Proposal status = SUBMITTED or UNDER_REVIEW
- Client authenticated and authorized for job

**Triggering Events:**
- proposal.submitted.v1 → notification to client
- Client clicks on proposal from list
- Client searches/filters proposals
- Client navigating from email notification

---

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `/(dashboard)/jobs/[id]/proposals` - Proposals list for a job
- `/(dashboard)/proposals/[id]` - Single proposal review page
- `/(dashboard)/proposals/[id]/interview` - Schedule interview
- `/(dashboard)/proposals/[id]/feedback` - Provide feedback
- `/(dashboard)/jobs/[id]/shortlist` - Shortlist management

**Mobile Routes:**
- `/(tabs)/jobs/[id]/proposals` - Proposals list
- `/(tabs)/proposals/[id]` - Proposal detail
- `/(tabs)/proposals/[id]/interview` - Interview modal
- `/(tabs)/proposals/[id]/feedback` - Feedback form
- `/(tabs)/jobs/[id]/shortlist` - Shortlist view

**Components:**
```
components/
└── proposals/
    ├── review/
    │   ├── ProposalReviewCard.tsx        # Main review interface
    │   ├── ProposalComparison.tsx        # Side-by-side comparison
    │   ├── ProposalTimeline.tsx          # Activity timeline
    │   ├── ClientActions.tsx             # Action buttons (shortlist/reject/etc)
    │   ├── ProposalNotes.tsx             # Private client notes
    │   └── ProposalAnnotations.tsx       # Highlight/comment on proposal
    ├── shortlist/
    │   ├── ShortlistPanel.tsx            # Shortlist sidebar/modal
    │   ├── ShortlistCard.tsx             # Shortlisted proposal card
    │   ├── ShortlistReorder.tsx          # Drag-drop reordering
    │   ├── ShortlistComparison.tsx       # Compare shortlisted
    │   └── ShortlistActions.tsx          # Bulk actions
    ├── interview/
    │   ├── InterviewScheduler.tsx        # Schedule interface
    │   ├── InterviewCalendar.tsx         # Calendar view
    │   ├── InterviewTypeSelector.tsx     # Video/phone/in-person
    │   ├── InterviewReminder.tsx         # Reminder settings
    │   └── InterviewStatus.tsx           # Interview status display
    └── feedback/
        ├── FeedbackForm.tsx              # Client feedback form
        ├── FeedbackRating.tsx            # Star ratings
        ├── FeedbackCategories.tsx        # Category tags
        └── FeedbackVisibility.tsx        # Public/private toggle
```

---

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend APIs:**
```
proposals-be:
- GET /v1/jobs/:jobId/proposals → List proposals
- GET /v1/proposals/:id → Get proposal details
- POST /v1/proposals/:id/shortlist → Add to shortlist
- DELETE /v1/proposals/:id/shortlist → Remove from shortlist
- PUT /v1/jobs/:jobId/shortlist/reorder → Reorder shortlist
- POST /v1/proposals/:id/reject → Reject proposal
- POST /v1/proposals/:id/feedback → Submit feedback
- GET /v1/proposals/:id/feedback → Get feedback
- POST /v1/proposals/:id/interview → Request interview
- GET /v1/proposals/:id/interviews → List interviews
- PUT /v1/proposals/:id/interview/:interviewId/schedule → Schedule
- POST /v1/proposals/:id/notes → Add private notes

comms-be:
- POST /v1/conversations/proposal/:id/message → Send message
- GET /v1/conversations/proposal/:id → Get conversation

calendar-be:
- POST /v1/calendar/interviews → Create interview event
- GET /v1/calendar/availability → Get availability

notifications-be:
- POST /v1/notifications/proposal-shortlisted → Notify freelancer
- POST /v1/notifications/interview-requested → Notify freelancer
```

**Event Flow:**
```
1. Client shortlists proposal
   └→ proposal.shortlisted.v1
      └→ notifications-be sends notification
      └→ analytics tracks shortlist event

2. Client requests interview
   └→ interview.requested.v1
      └→ comms-be creates conversation
      └→ calendar-be creates calendar event
      └→ notifications-be notifies freelancer

3. Client provides feedback
   └→ proposal.feedback.submitted.v1
      └→ notifications-be notifies freelancer (if public)
      └→ analytics aggregates feedback
```

**Step 4.3: Send Interview Request**
- API: `POST /v1/proposals/:id/interview`
- Creates interview record with status = REQUESTED
- Sends notification to freelancer
- Creates calendar hold (pending freelancer acceptance)

**Step 4.4: Freelancer Accepts/Declines**
- Freelancer selects one of the proposed times
- API: `PUT /v1/proposals/:id/interview/:interviewId/accept`
- Calendar event confirmed
- Both parties receive calendar invite + meeting link
- Status updated to SCHEDULED

**Step 4.5: Track Interview Status**
- View in proposal detail: "Interview Status: Scheduled"
- View in calendar: Interview appears with link
- Reminders sent 24h and 1h before interview

##### **7. Client Accepts Proposal (Hire)**

**Step 7.1: Click "Accept Proposal"**

- Briefly: Creates contract, sets milestones/terms, activates escrow

- Job status may change to IN_PROGRESS or FILLED

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**Case 1: Shortlist Full (Max 15)**
- Cannot add more to shortlist
- Error: "Shortlist full. Remove one to add another."
- Client must remove one or increase limit (premium feature)

**Case 2: Proposal Withdrawn During Review**
- Freelancer withdraws proposal while client reviewing
- Client sees banner: "This proposal was withdrawn by the freelancer"
- Actions disabled (can't shortlist, interview, accept)

**Case 3: Interview Scheduling Conflict**
- Freelancer declines all proposed times
- Client receives notification: "John declined interview times"
- Option to suggest new times or message freelancer

**Case 4: Feedback Without Decision**
- Client can provide feedback even without accepting/declining
- Useful for freelancers to improve future proposals
- Visibility: Private or shared

**Case 5: Multiple Clients (Team)**
- If job has hiring team, any team member can shortlist/interview
- Feedback aggregated from all team members
- Final accept/decline requires hiring manager approval

**Case 6: Proposal Expired**
- Job deadline passed or job closed
- Cannot shortlist, interview, or accept expired proposals
- Client can still view and provide feedback

#### Accessibility

**Keyboard:**
- Tab through proposals list
- Enter to open proposal detail
- Arrow keys for navigation
- Shortcuts:
  - `s` - Shortlist proposal
  - `i` - Request interview
  - `m` - Message freelancer
  - `a` - Accept proposal
  - `d` - Decline proposal

**Screen Reader:**
- "Proposal from John Smith, quality score 87 out of 100"
- "Skills match: 95 percent"
- "Click to shortlist proposal"
- Announce status changes: "Proposal shortlisted"

**Visual:**
- Color-blind safe status colors
- High contrast action buttons
- Focus indicators
- Minimum touch targets (44px mobile)

**ARIA:**
- `role="list"` on proposals list
- `role="listitem"` on each proposal card
- `aria-label` on action buttons
- `aria-live="polite"` for status updates

---

#### Performance

**Optimization:**
- Lazy load proposals list (virtual scrolling)
- Prefetch proposal details on hover
- Cache shortlist (5 min TTL)
- Debounce search/filter (300ms)
- Optimize images (freelancer avatars)

**Loading:**
- Skeleton loaders for proposals list
- Progressive loading (summary first)
- Optimistic updates (shortlist add/remove)

**Monitoring:**
- Track page load time
- API response times (p50, p95, p99)
- Alert if > 3s load time

---

#### Security

**Access Control:**
- Only job owner/hiring team can view proposals
- Cannot view proposals for other clients' jobs
- Row-level security enforced

**Rate Limiting:**
- Shortlist actions: 30 per hour
- Interview requests: 10 per hour
- Feedback submissions: 20 per hour

**Input Validation:**
- Sanitize feedback text
- Validate proposal IDs
- CSRF tokens on mutations

---

#### Sources

**Backend:**  
- proposals-be.user-stories.md (shortlist, interview, feedback flows)
- proposals-be.database-design.md (shortlists, interviews, proposal_feedback)

**Frontend:**  
- combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/proposals routes, components/proposals/review/)
