## PROP-5: Proposal Conversation & Pre-Hire Messaging

**ID:** PROP-5  
**Persona:** Client, Freelancer  
**Microservices:** comms-be, proposals-be, notifications-be, moderation-be

---

#### Preconditions & Triggers

**Entry Points:**
- Client clicks "Message" on proposal
- Freelancer receives message notification from client
- Client/freelancer navigating from notification
- From proposal detail page messaging section

**Prerequisites:**
- Proposal exists and is submitted (status ≥ SUBMITTED)
- User authenticated
- Conversation created (auto-created on first message)
- Not blocked/restricted users

**Triggering Events:**
- Client clicks "Message Freelancer" button
- Freelancer receives "New message about your proposal"
- proposal.conversation.message.sent.v1 event
- Real-time message delivery via WebSocket/SSE

---

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `/(dashboard)/proposals/[id]/conversation` - Dedicated conversation page
- `/(dashboard)/proposals/[id]` - Proposal detail with inline chat
- `/(dashboard)/messages/proposal/[proposalId]` - From main messages center
- `/(dashboard)/jobs/[id]/proposals` - Quick message modal from list

**Mobile Routes:**
- `/(tabs)/proposals/[id]/chat` - Full-screen chat
- `/(tabs)/messages/proposal/[proposalId]` - From messages tab
- `/(tabs)/proposals/[id]` - Proposal detail with chat preview

**Components:**
```
components/
└── proposals/
    └── conversation/
        ├── ProposalChat.tsx               # Main chat interface
        ├── ProposalChatBubble.tsx         # Message bubble
        ├── ProposalChatInput.tsx          # Message input with attachments
        ├── ProposalChatHeader.tsx         # Chat header (participant info)
        ├── ProposalChatTimeline.tsx       # Chronological message timeline
        ├── ProposalChatAttachment.tsx     # File attachment display
        ├── ProposalMessageReactions.tsx   # Emoji reactions
        ├── ProposalTypingIndicator.tsx    # "John is typing..."
        ├── ProposalReadReceipts.tsx       # Read status indicators
        ├── ProposalQuickReplies.tsx       # Suggested quick replies
        ├── ProposalChatContext.tsx        # Proposal summary in chat
        └── ProposalChatModeration.tsx     # PII/spam warnings
```

---

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend APIs:**
```
comms-be:
- POST /v1/conversations/proposal/:proposalId/messages → Send message
- GET /v1/conversations/proposal/:proposalId → Get conversation
- GET /v1/conversations/proposal/:proposalId/messages → List messages
- PUT /v1/conversations/proposal/:proposalId/messages/:msgId/read → Mark read
- POST /v1/conversations/proposal/:proposalId/typing → Typing indicator
- DELETE /v1/conversations/proposal/:proposalId/messages/:msgId → Delete message (sender only)
- POST /v1/conversations/proposal/:proposalId/block → Block user (report)

moderation-be:
- POST /v1/moderation/text/pii-check → Check for PII in message
- POST /v1/moderation/text/profanity-check → Check for profanity
- POST /v1/moderation/links/verify → Verify external links safety

proposals-be:
- GET /v1/proposals/:id → Get proposal context for chat header
- GET /v1/proposals/:id/conversation/stats → Get conversation stats

notifications-be:
- POST /v1/notifications/message-received → Notify recipient
```

**Event Flow:**
```
1. User sends message
   └→ comms-be.proposal.message.sent.v1
      ├→ moderation-be checks content
      ├→ notifications-be sends notification
      ├→ WebSocket broadcasts to recipient
      └→ analytics tracks message

2. User types message
   └→ comms-be.typing.indicator.v1
      └→ WebSocket broadcasts typing status

3. User reads message
   └→ comms-be.message.read.v1
      └→ WebSocket updates read receipt
      └→ analytics tracks engagement
```

---

##### **3. Real-Time Features**

**Feature 3.1: Typing Indicator**

##### **4. Safety & Moderation**

**Step 4.1: PII Detection**
- Before sending, client-side checks for PII patterns
- Server-side validation via moderation-be
- Patterns: Email addresses, phone numbers, external links
- Warning shown if detected

**Shape (PII Warning):**
```
┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ⚠ Warning: Personal Info Detected    │
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Your message contains what looks like │
│ an email address or phone number.     │
│                                       │
│ Sharing personal contact info outside │
│ Skillsier is against our Terms and    │
│ may result in account suspension.     │
│                                       │
│ Please keep all communication on      │
│ the platform until you've hired the   │
│ freelancer and signed a contract.     │
│                                       │
│ [Edit Message]  [Send Anyway (Risk)]  │
└───────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Step 4.2: Link Moderation**
- External links checked against safe list
- Suspicious links blocked or warned
- Platform links (skillsier.com) allowed

**Step 4.3: Profanity & Spam Detection**
- Message scanned for profanity/hate speech
- Spam patterns detected (mass copy-paste)
- Blocked if violation detected
- User warned to rephrase

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**Case 1: Blocked User**
- If user blocks other user, cannot send messages
- Existing conversation visible but input disabled
- Message: "You've blocked this user. Unblock to message."

**Case 2: Proposal Withdrawn/Declined**
- Conversation remains accessible (read-only)
- Cannot send new messages
- Banner: "This proposal is no longer active"

**Case 3: Spam/Abuse Report**
- User can report message/conversation
- Triggers moderation review
- May result in warning, suspension, or ban

**Case 4: Message Deleted**
- Sender can delete own message within 5 minutes
- Shows "[Message deleted]" placeholder
- Cannot delete after read by recipient

**Case 5: Offline Messaging**
- If recipient offline, message queued
- Delivered when recipient comes online
- Status: "Sent ✓" → "Delivered ✓✓" when online

**Case 6: Conversation Archive**
- After contract created or proposal declined, conversation archived
- Still accessible from proposal detail
- Cannot start new conversations for archived proposals

#### Accessibility

**Keyboard:**
- Tab to navigate messages
- Enter to send message
- Shift+Enter for new line
- Arrow keys to navigate message history
- Escape to close chat modal (if modal)

**Screen Reader:**
- "Message from John Smith, 2 hours ago: Thanks for your proposal..."
- "Your message: Happy to answer, sent 1 hour ago, read"
- "John is typing"
- Announce new messages: "New message received from John Smith"

**Visual:**
- High contrast bubbles (client vs. freelancer)
- Color-blind safe read receipts (checkmarks instead of just color)
- Clear focus indicators
- Sufficient text size (16px minimum)

**ARIA:**
- `role="log"` on message list (auto-updates)
- `aria-live="polite"` for new messages
- `aria-label="Message input"` on textarea
- `aria-label="Send message"` on send button
- `aria-label="Typing indicator"` on typing status

---

#### Performance

**Optimization:**
- Lazy load message history (paginated, load more on scroll up)
- WebSocket for real-time messages (fallback to polling)
- Compress images before upload
- Cache conversation (5 min TTL)
- Debounce typing indicator (every 3 seconds max)
- Virtual scrolling for long conversations (>100 messages)

**Loading:**
- Skeleton loaders for initial load
- Optimistic UI for sent messages
- Progressive image loading

**Monitoring:**
- WebSocket connection stability
- Message delivery latency (p50, p95, p99)
- Alert if delivery time > 5s

---

#### Security

**Access Control:**
- Only proposal participants can access conversation
- Cannot view other users' conversations
- Row-level security on comms-be

**Rate Limiting:**
- 60 messages per hour per user per conversation
- 10 typing events per minute
- Prevent spam flooding

**Content Security:**
- All messages scanned for PII, profanity, spam
- External links sanitized
- Attachments virus-scanned
- Report/block functionality

**Encryption:**
- Messages encrypted in transit (TLS)
- Stored encrypted at rest
- PII redacted from logs

- moderation-be (PII/spam detection)

## PROP‑6 — Withdraw, Revise & Resubmit Proposal — *Control the lifecycle without surprises*

> **Scope note:** This is the *original* end‑to‑end journey for a freelancer to **withdraw**, **revise allowed fields**, and **resubmit/reactivate** a proposal.  
> It references but does **not** re‑document: PROP‑1 (compose/submit), PROP‑4 (Boost bidding), PROP‑5 (Messaging), CL‑journeys (client triage), CTR/WRK (post‑hire).


## 2) Goal
Provide a transparent, policy‑aware path to withdraw a submitted proposal, optionally revise allowed fields, and resubmit/reactivate within defined windows, while protecting client context, connects spend, and analytics integrity.

## 3) Actor / Persona
- **Primary:** Freelancer (proposal owner)  
- **Secondary:** Client (read‑only updates), System services (proposals‑be, jobs‑be, financial‑be, notifications‑be, audit‑be)

## 4) Preconditions & Triggers
**Preconditions**
- Proposal in **SUBMITTED** (or **WITHDRAWN** for Reactivate); Job is **OPEN**.  
- User is the **owner** (RBAC); no active **hire/offer** tied to this proposal.  
- If resubmitting: **cooldown** elapsed, **resubmit window** valid, **locked fields** enforced.

**Triggers**
- From **Proposal Detail** or **My Proposals** → actions: *Withdraw*, *Edit*, *Resubmit/Reactivate*.  
- From **notification deep‑link** (policy update, analytics suggestion).

---

## 5) Primary Screens (Routes)
**Web (Next.js)**  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/page.tsx` — List (filters, quick actions)  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/page.tsx` — Detail (owner view)  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/withdraw/page.tsx` — Withdraw wizard  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/edit/page.tsx` — Revise allowed fields (ETag required)  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/resubmit/page.tsx` — Review changes → Resubmit  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/revisions/page.tsx` — History & Diffs  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/(error|loading).tsx`

**Mobile (Expo Router)**  
- `app/(tabs)/(authenticated)/(proposals)/index.tsx` — List  
- `app/(tabs)/(authenticated)/(proposals)/[proposalId].tsx` — Detail  
- `app/(tabs)/(authenticated)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/withdraw.tsx`  
- `app/(tabs)/(authenticated)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/edit.tsx`  
- `app/(tabs)/(authenticated)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/resubmit.tsx`  
- `app/(tabs)/(authenticated)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/revisions.tsx`

> **Route alignment:** Uses canonical `(proposals)` group with modal or page variants for confirm flows.

---

## 6) System Touchpoints (Backend & APIs)
**proposals‑be (lifecycle & revisions)**  
- `GET /v1/proposals/{id}` — detail for owner  
- `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/withdraw` — withdraw (reason, refund preview?)  
- `PATCH /v1/proposals/{id}` — revise subset; **If‑Match: ETag** for concurrency  
- `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/resubmit` — commit changes & notify client  
- `GET /v1/proposals/{id}/revisions` — history & diffs  
- `GET /v1/proposals/{id}/policy` — cooldown, resubmit window, locked fields

**financial‑be (connects & boost refund references)**  
- `GET /v1/proposals/{id}/boost/status` — show/cancel impact notice (read‑only)  
- Refund logic follows PROP‑4 policy (informational banner)

**jobs‑be**  
- `GET /v1/market/jobs/{jobId}/state` — avoid actions on closed/paused

**notifications‑be / audit‑be**  
- `POST /v1/notifications/send` — client/system notifications  
- `POST /v1/audit/log` — immutable audit entries

**Events (publish)**  
- `proposal.withdrawn.v1`, `proposal.revision.saved.v1`, `proposal.resubmitted.v1`

---

## 7) Key Components (Frontend)
- `<LifecycleActions />` (Withdraw/Edit/Resubmit buttons + guards)  
- `<WithdrawWizard />` (reason, policy, refund preview, confirm)  
- `<RevisionForm />` (field gating, diff preview, ETag header)  
- `<ResubmitReview />` (ChangeSummaryDiff + confirm)  
- `<PolicyBanner />` (cooldown & window, countdown)  
- `<BoostImpactNote />` (read‑only)  
- `<RevisionHistoryTable />` (CSV export, virtualization)

Hooks: `useProposal(id)`, `usePolicy(id)`, `useRevisions(id)`, `useBoostStatus(id)`, `useWithdraw()`, `useResubmit()`.

---

## 8) Flows — Happy Paths

### HP‑A: Withdraw a submitted proposal
1. Open Proposal Detail → click **Withdraw**.  
2. Load policy; show **refund/boost** notes if relevant.  
3. Confirm → `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/withdraw` → status **WITHDRAWN**.  
4. Create audit row; optional client notification with banner in client view.  
5. Toast “Withdrawn”; list updates (order by recent activity).

### HP‑B: Revise allowed fields, then resubmit
1. Click **Edit** → `PATCH /v1/proposals/{id}` with **If‑Match: ETag**.  
2. Navigate to **Resubmit** screen; show **ChangeSummaryDiff**.  
3. Confirm → `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/resubmit` → status **RESUBMITTED**.  
4. Client notified with “updated” badge; audit & analytics events created.

### HP‑C: Reactivate after withdraw (no changes)
1. From Withdrawn state click **Reactivate** (policy‑gated).  
2. Confirm → `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/resubmit` with flag `reactivate=true`.  
3. Status returns to **SUBMITTED**; boost remains **NONE** (must restart).

---

## 9) Branches & Edge Cases
- **B1: Cooldown not elapsed** → block with countdown.  
- **B2: Resubmit window expired** → disable actions; suggest new proposal.  
- **B3: Locked fields edited** → show which fields are immutable.  
- **B4: Job closed/paused** → block withdraw/resubmit; message why.  
- **B5: Offer pending/hired** → block; link to contract.  
- **B6: Nothing changed** on resubmit → explain & block.  
- **B7: ETag mismatch** → reload & reapply; keep local draft.  
- **B8: Boost cancellation failure** (display only) → surface banner; retry job server‑side.  
- **B9: Offline** → queue edit; mark as **stale**; resubmit once online.

---

- KPIs: resubmit conversion %, cooldown violations, edit→resubmit ratio.

---

## 14) Accessibility
- All dialogs labeled; focus management; table semantics for history.  
- Clear text + icon status indicators; screen‑reader announcements.

---

## 15) Performance
- p95 policy fetch ≤ 300ms; revisions page ≤ 500ms; resubmit ≤ 400ms.  
- Virtualize diffs/history; throttle refetch; cache boost status.

---

## 16) Security & Audit
- RBAC: owner only; server validates job & proposal state.  
- ETag on edits; idempotency keys on resubmit; immutable audit entries.  
- No sensitive proposal content in audit payloads.

---

## 17) Sources & Cross‑References (Project Knowledge)
- Enhancements: Withdraw/Resubmit policy, history/export, notifications, client view consistency, boost handling.  
- See **PROP‑1** (compose), **PROP‑4** (boost), **PROP‑5** (messaging), **CL** (client triage).

## PROP‑7 — Proposal Insights, Alerts & Smart Follow‑Ups — *See signals → act wisely*



## 2) Goal
Help freelancers understand **engagement signals** (opens, shortlist, messages), compare performance across proposals, and take **next‑best actions** (nudged follow‑ups, clarify items, attach samples) without spamming clients.

## 3) Actor / Persona
- **Primary:** Freelancer  
- **Supporting:** proposals‑be (analytics), communications‑be (send follow‑up), notifications‑be (alerts), jobs‑be (state), financial‑be (boost linkage)

## 4) Preconditions & Triggers
**Preconditions**
- Proposal is **SUBMITTED/RESUBMITTED**. Analytics collection on.

**Triggers**
- User clicks **Insights** tab on a proposal.  
- Alert banner (anomaly/quiet period/boost lift) deep‑links into Insights.  
- Aggregate insights page opened from **My Proposals**.

---

## 5) Primary Screens (Routes)
**Web**  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/insights/page.tsx` — Per‑proposal insights  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/insights/page.tsx` — Aggregate (my proposals)  
- Error/loading variants per route

**Mobile**  
- `app/(tabs)/(authenticated)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/insights.tsx`  
- `app/(tabs)/(authenticated)/(proposals)/insights.tsx`

---

## 6) System Touchpoints (APIs)
- `GET /v1/proposals/{id}/insights` — KPIs, timeseries, shortlist, messages, interviews  
- `GET /v1/proposals/{id}/insights/boost-lift` — correlation with boosts  
- `GET /v1/proposals/{id}/insights/anomaly` — spikes/drops  
- `POST /v1/communications/follow-ups` — send suggested follow‑up (routes through PROP‑5 messaging)  
- `POST /v1/reminders` — schedule “remind me to follow‑up”  
- `GET /v1/proposals/insights?mine=1&range=...` — aggregate table

Events: `proposal.insights.viewed.v1`, `proposal.followup.sent.v1`, `proposal.reminder.scheduled.v1`.

---

## 7) Components (Frontend)
- `<InsightSummary />`, `<FunnelChart />`, `<TrendChart />`, `<HeatmapChart />`  
- `<BoostCorrelationCard />`, `<AnomalyAlert />`, `<PrivacyNote />`  
- `<FollowUpSuggestions />`, `<FollowUpComposer />`, `<ReminderScheduler />`  
- `<ExportMenu />` (CSV/JSON), `<DateRangePicker />`

Hooks: `useProposalInsights`, `useAggregateInsights`, `useFollowUpSuggestions`, `useAnomaly`, `useBoostLift`, `useReminder()`.

---

## 8) Flows — Happy Paths

### HP‑A: Review insights & send a smart follow‑up
1. Open **Insights**; KPIs/time series render.  
2. A suggestion appears: *“Client viewed 2×; clarify timeline?”*  
3. Compose follow‑up using template → send via communications‑be.  
4. Success toast; thread lives under PROP‑5; analytics recorded.

### HP‑B: Schedule a reminder
1. Click **Remind me**; choose **3 days**.  
2. `POST /v1/reminders` created; calendar entry visible in notifications center.  
3. On due date, banner deep‑links to composer.

### HP‑C: Aggregate insights & export
1. Open **My Proposal Insights** (30d).  
2. Filter **Submitted** + **Boosted only**; compare lift.  
3. Export CSV; open in spreadsheet for deeper analysis.

---

## 9) Branches & Edge Cases
- **B1: Privacy/opt‑out signals** hidden with explanation.  
- **B2: Job closed** → follow‑up disabled; show dimmed state.  
- **B3: Huge date ranges** → cap & guide.  
- **B4: Offline** → shows last 24h cache with “stale” note.  
- **B5: SCA/permissions** not required; insights are read‑only.  
- **B6: Rate‑limit follow‑ups** to avoid spam; cooldowns enforced.

---

│ [ Export CSV ]                                                            │

## 11) Mobile Experience
- Compact cards with KPIs; swipe to **Follow‑up**; deep‑links to message thread.  
- Pull‑to‑refresh; toasts for sends; offline caching.

---

## 12) Notifications
- **Anomaly detected**, **Quiet period**, **Reminder due**.  
- Deep‑links to Insights or Composer; quiet hours respected.

---

- `proposal.insights.viewed.v1`, `proposal.followup.sent.v1`, `proposal.reminder.scheduled.v1`.

- Charts with text alt summaries; keyboard navigation; color + text signals.

## PROP‑8 — Team Collaboration & Co‑Authoring — *Work together, present as one*


## 2) Goal
Allow agencies/teams to co‑author proposals without leaking internal collaboration to clients, while keeping permissions tight and economics (connects & revenue split) auditable.

## 3) Actor / Persona
- **Primary:** Team Lead (proposal owner)  
- **Secondary:** Team Members (Editor/Commenter/Viewer), Billing Admin (connects policy), Client (public view only)

## 4) Preconditions & Triggers
**Preconditions**
- Org/team exists; user is **LEAD** or allowed **TEAM_MEMBER**.  
- Draft or submitted proposal available (or create new as Team).

**Triggers**
- Toggle **Enable Team Collaboration** on proposal.  
- Choose **Team** mode when creating a new proposal.  
- From proposal → open **Team** tab: members, notes, split, history.

---

## 5) Primary Screens (Routes)
**Web**  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/team/page.tsx` — Collaborators (invite, roles, remove)  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/team/split/page.tsx` — Revenue/Effort split  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/team/notes/page.tsx` — Internal private notes  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/team/history/page.tsx` — Activity timeline  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/transfer/page.tsx` — Ownership transfer  
- `(dashboard)/(proposals)/create?mode=team` — New team proposal

**Mobile**  
- `app/(tabs)/(authenticated)/(proposals)/[proposalId]/team/index.tsx` — Members  
- `.../team/split.tsx`, `.../team/notes.tsx`, `.../team/history.tsx`, `.../transfer.tsx`

---

## 6) System Touchpoints (APIs)
**proposals‑be — collaboration**  
- GET/POST team, invite/change‑role/remove, transfer lead  
- GET/POST notes, GET activity timeline, WS draft‑locks  
- GET/PATCH public display profile (Agency/Individual)

**financial‑be — connects & revenue**  
- GET/POST connects policy; POST connects charge; POST revenue allocation preview

**jobs‑be / admin‑be / notifications‑be / audit‑be**  
- Job state checks; policy gates; notifications; audit logs

---

## 7) Components (Frontend)
- `<CollaboratorsTable />`, `<InviteMemberForm />`, `<ChangeRoleDialog />`  
- `<SplitEditor />`, `<AllocationPreview />`  
- `<InternalNotesBoard />`, `<ActivityTimeline />`  
- `<DraftLockBadge />` (live WS locks), `<OwnershipTransferDialog />`  
- `<PublicProfilePicker />`, `<ConnectsUsageCard />`

Hooks: `useTeam(proposalId)`, `useDraftLocks`, `useNotes`, `useActivityTimeline`, `useSplit`, `useConnectsPolicy`, `usePublicProfile`, `useTransfer()`.

---

## 8) Flows — Happy Paths

### HP‑A: Enable collaboration & invite members
1. Open **Team** tab → **Enable collaboration**.  
2. Invite member by username/email with role (**EDITOR/COMMENTER/VIEWER**).  
3. Member accepts; appears in table; audit & notification sent.

### HP‑B: Configure revenue/effort split & connects policy
1. Open **Split**; add rows until **revenuePct totals 100%**.  
2. Preview allocation for potential offer.  
3. Open **Connects policy**; choose **Org pays** or **Member pays**; save.

### HP‑C: Co‑author safely with locks & internal notes
1. Editor opens cover letter section → lock appears to other viewers.  
2. Leave **private internal notes** with attachments; mentions notify teammates.  
3. Changes saved; history reflects edits & notes.

### HP‑D: Transfer ownership
1. Lead opens **Transfer ownership**; pick new lead; confirm.  
2. Lead role updated; billing contact & public display profile re‑validated.  
3. Team notified; audit logged.

---

## 9) Branches & Edge Cases
- **B1: Not owner** → invite/role/transfer blocked (403).  
- **B2: Plan/limit exceeded** → upsell & block.  
- **B3: Split totals ≠ 100%** → prevent save; show diff.  
- **B4: Connects insufficient** for chosen payer → block and guide.  
- **B5: Draft lock storms** → throttle & auto‑clear ghost locks.  
- **B6: Job closed** → notes allowed; resubmits blocked.  
- **B7: Self‑transfer** blocked; require different member.  
- **B8: Attachment too large** in notes → block/quarantine.  
- **B9: Offline** → local drafts for notes; sync later.

---

# Section E) Contracts & Workroom

### CTR-1 — Contract Lifecycle

**ID:** CTR-1  
**Persona:** Client, Freelancer  
**Preconditions:** Job proposal accepted, terms agreed  
**Triggers:** Client creates contract after hiring freelancer

**Primary Screens:**
- **Web:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts` — Contracts list
- **Web:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]` — Contract details
- **Web:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/workroom` — Workroom
- **Mobile:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts` — Contracts overview
- **Mobile:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]` — Contract view

**System Touchpoints:**
- **contracts-be/contract** — POST /v1/contracts (create contract)
- **contracts-be/contract** — GET /v1/contracts/{contract_id} (get contract details)
- **contracts-be/contract** — PUT /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/status (activate, pause, complete)
- **contracts-be/milestone** — POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/milestones (add milestones for fixed)
- **contracts-be/timesheet** — GET /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/timesheets (for hourly)
- **payments-be/escrow** — POST /v1/escrow/fund (fund escrow for contract)

**Flow Steps:**

1. **Contract creation (by client):**
   - Client accepts proposal or clicks "Hire" on talent profile
   - **Contract creation form:**
     - **Contract type:** Fixed Price or Hourly
     - **Project title:** "Website Redesign"
     - **Description:** Detailed scope of work
     - **Start date:** Select date
     - **End date (optional):** Select date
     - **Budget:** $5,000 (fixed) or $50/hour (hourly)
     - **Payment terms:** Milestone-based (fixed) or Weekly (hourly)
     - **Attached files:** SOW, requirements docs
   - **POST /v1/contracts:**
     ```json
     {
       "job_id": "uuid",
       "freelancer_id": "uuid",
       "client_id": "uuid",
       "contract_type": "FIXED_PRICE",
       "title": "Website Redesign",
       "description": "Full redesign of company website...",
       "budget": 5000,
       "currency": "USD",
       "start_date": "2025-11-10",
       "end_date": "2025-12-20",
       "payment_terms": "MILESTONE_BASED",
       "milestones": [
         {
           "title": "Design mockups",
           "amount": 1500,
           "due_date": "2025-11-20"
         },
         {
           "title": "Frontend development",
           "amount": 2500,
           "due_date": "2025-12-10"
         },
         {
           "title": "Final delivery",
           "amount": 1000,
           "due_date": "2025-12-20"
         }
       ],
       "terms_and_conditions": "Standard Skillsier terms apply...",
       "attachments": ["file_uuid_1", "file_uuid_2"]
     }
     ```
   - Contract created with status **"PENDING"**

2. **Freelancer reviews and accepts contract:**
   - Freelancer receives notification: "You have a new contract offer"
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]`
   - **Contract details displayed:**
     - Client name, company
     - Contract type, budget, timeline
     - Milestones (if fixed) or hourly rate
     - Payment schedule
     - Terms & conditions
     - Attached documents
   - **Actions:** "Accept" or "Request Changes"
   - Freelancer clicks **"Accept"**
   - **PUT /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/status:**
     ```json
     {
       "status": "ACCEPTED",
       "accepted_at": "2025-11-07T10:00:00Z",
       "accepted_by": "freelancer_uuid"
     }
     ```
   - Contract status → **"ACCEPTED"**

3. **Contract activation & funding (client):**
   - After freelancer acceptance, client must **fund escrow**
   - Navigate to contract page
   - **"Fund contract" button** visible
   - Click → Redirect to payment flow
   - **POST /v1/escrow/fund:**
     ```json
     {
       "contract_id": "uuid",
       "amount": 5000,
       "payment_method_id": "pm_uuid",
       "release_schedule": "MILESTONE_BASED"
     }
     ```
   - Funds held in escrow
   - Contract status → **"ACTIVE"**
   - Both parties receive notification: "Contract is now active"

4. **Work begins (workroom access):**
   - Both client and freelancer access **workroom**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/workroom`
   - **Workroom features:**
     - **Messages:** Real-time chat (integrated from communications-be)
     - **Files:** Shared document storage (storage-be)
     - **Milestones:** Track progress (fixed contracts)
     - **Timesheets:** Log hours (hourly contracts)
     - **Activity feed:** All contract-related activities
   - Freelancer uploads deliverables, logs time
   - Client reviews progress, provides feedback

5. **Contract pause (either party):**
   - Either party can **request pause** (mutual agreement required)
   - Click "Pause contract" → Modal: "Reason for pause?"
   - **PUT /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/pause:**
     ```json
     {
       "paused_by": "client_uuid",
       "pause_reason": "Client requested revisions",
       "paused_at": "2025-11-15T12:00:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - Contract status → **"PAUSED"**
   - Other party receives notification: "Contract pause requested"
   - Other party must **approve pause**
   - **Timers stop** (hourly contracts)
   - **No payments released** during pause

6. **Resume contract:**
   - When ready, either party clicks **"Resume contract"**
   - **PUT /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/resume:**
     ```json
     {
       "resumed_by": "freelancer_uuid",
       "resumed_at": "2025-11-18T09:00:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - Contract status → **"ACTIVE"**
   - Work resumes, timers restart

7. **Contract completion:**
   - **Fixed:** All milestones completed and approved
   - **Hourly:** Work period ends or client ends contract
   - Client clicks **"Complete contract"**
   - **PUT /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/complete:**
     ```json
     {
       "completed_by": "client_uuid",
       "completed_at": "2025-12-20T17:00:00Z",
       "completion_notes": "All deliverables received. Excellent work!"
     }
     ```
   - Contract status → **"COMPLETED"**
   - Final payments released from escrow
   - Both parties prompted to **leave review** (REV-1)

8. **Contract termination (early end):**
   - Either party can **request termination**
   - Click "End contract early" → Modal with reasons
   - **PUT /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/terminate:**
     ```json
     {
       "terminated_by": "client_uuid",
       "termination_reason": "PROJECT_CANCELLED",
       "termination_notes": "Business priorities changed",
       "requested_at": "2025-11-25T14:00:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - Other party receives notification: "Contract termination requested"
   - **Dispute resolution** may be triggered (if disagreement on payment)
   - System calculates prorated payment
   - Contract status → **"TERMINATED"**

**Branches & Edge Cases:**

- **Request changes:** Freelancer can request contract modifications before accepting
- **Changes flow:** Client edits contract → Freelancer re-reviews → Accept
- **Escrow failure:** If funding fails, contract status → "PENDING_FUNDING"
- **Partial funding:** For milestones, fund milestone-by-milestone (optional)
- **Auto-activation:** Contract auto-activates once escrow funded (no manual step)
- **Contract amendments:** Mid-contract changes require mutual agreement (CTR-5)
- **Multiple contracts:** Client can have multiple active contracts with same freelancer
- **Contract templates:** Client can create from template (CTR-7)
- **Expired offer:** Contract offer expires after 7 days if not accepted
- **Declined contract:** Freelancer declines → Client notified, can revise and resend
- **Dispute initiation:** Either party can open dispute (CL-9) during active contract
- **Pause duration:** Paused contracts auto-resume after 30 days (configurable)
- **Pause rejection:** If pause rejected, contract remains active
- **Completion disagreement:** If one party marks complete, other must confirm
- **Early completion:** Contract can be completed before end date
- **Extension:** End date can be extended by mutual agreement
- **Budget increase:** Budget can be increased mid-contract (amendment flow)
- **Workroom access:** Workroom accessible even after contract completion (90 days)
- **Contract history:** Full activity log visible in contract timeline
- **Contract export:** Can export contract details as PDF
- **Contract notifications:** Email + in-app for all status changes

**Notifications:**

- **Email + Push (freelancer):** "New contract offer from [Client]"
- **Email + Push (client):** "Freelancer accepted your contract offer"
- **Email + Push (both):** "Contract is now active"
- **Email + Push (requester):** "Contract pause approved" or "Contract pause rejected"
- **Email + Push (both):** "Contract completed"
- **Email + Push (both):** "Contract termination requested"
- **In-app:** All contract status changes generate in-app notifications

**Analytics:**

- contracts.contract\_created (contract\_type, budget, duration\_days)
- contracts.contract\_offer\_sent (contract\_id, freelancer\_id)
- contracts.contract\_accepted (contract\_id, time\_to\_accept\_hours)
- contracts.contract\_declined (contract\_id, decline\_reason)
- contracts.contract\_funded (contract\_id, amount, escrow\_status)
- contracts.contract\_activated (contract\_id, activation\_time)
- contracts.contract\_paused (contract\_id, pause\_reason, paused\_by)
- contracts.contract\_resumed (contract\_id, pause\_duration\_days)
- contracts.contract\_completed (contract\_id, completion\_time, on\_budget)
- contracts.contract\_terminated\_early (contract\_id, termination\_reason)
- contracts.contract\_changes\_requested (contract\_id, change\_type)
- contracts.contract\_workroom\_accessed (contract\_id, user\_role)
- contracts.contract\_timeline\_viewed (contract\_id)
- contracts.contract\_exported (contract\_id, export\_format)

**Sources:** contracts-be.user-stories.md (Section 1: Contract lifecycle), combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/contracts routes), payments-be.user-stories.md (escrow funding).

---

### CTR-2 — Deliverables & Docs (Workroom Files)

**ID:** CTR-2  
**Persona:** Client, Freelancer  
**Preconditions:** Contract is active  
**Triggers:** Freelancer uploads deliverable, client shares reference document

**Primary Screens:**
- **Web:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/workroom/files` — File manager
- **Web:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/workroom/files/[fileId]` — File detail
- **Mobile:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/workroom/files` — Files list

**System Touchpoints:**
- **storage-be/asset** — POST /v1/assets/upload (upload file)
- **storage-be/asset** — GET /v1/assets/{asset_id} (get file details)
- **storage-be/asset** — GET /v1/assets/{asset_id}/download (download file)
- **contracts-be/deliverable** — POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/deliverables (mark as deliverable)
- **contracts-be/deliverable** — PUT /v1/deliverables/{deliverable_id}/status (approve/reject)

**Flow Steps:**

1. **Upload file to workroom:**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/workroom/files`
   - Click **"Upload files"** button
   - **File picker opens:**
     - Drag & drop or browse files
     - Multiple files supported
     - Max file size: 500MB per file
     - Supported: All file types (images, docs, videos, archives, etc.)
   - Select files → Upload begins
   - **POST /v1/assets/upload:**
     ```json
     {
       "files": [
         {
           "filename": "homepage-mockup.psd",
           "size": 45000000,
           "mime_type": "image/vnd.adobe.photoshop"
         }
       ],
       "context": {
         "contract_id": "uuid",
         "upload_type": "DELIVERABLE"
       }
     }
     ```
   - **Progress bar** shows upload percentage
   - **Virus scan** runs automatically (storage-be)
   - Upload completes → File appears in workroom files list

2. **Mark file as deliverable:**
   - After upload, freelancer can **mark as deliverable**
   - Click file → **"Mark as deliverable"** button
   - **Modal:**
     - **Deliverable name:** "Homepage Design"
     - **Description:** "Initial design mockup for homepage"
     - **Linked milestone:** Select milestone (if fixed contract)
     - **Status:** "PENDING_REVIEW"
   - **POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/deliverables:**
     ```json
     {
       "contract_id": "uuid",
       "asset_id": "file_uuid",
       "name": "Homepage Design",
       "description": "Initial design mockup for homepage",
       "milestone_id": "milestone_uuid",
       "status": "PENDING_REVIEW",
       "submitted_at": "2025-11-15T14:00:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - **Client receives notification:** "New deliverable submitted for review"

3. **Client reviews deliverable:**
   - Client navigates to workroom files
   - **Deliverables filter:** Show only "Pending review" files
   - Click deliverable → File preview + actions
   - **File preview:**
     - Image preview (for images)
     - Document viewer (for PDFs, DOCs)
     - Download button
     - Version history (if multiple uploads)
   - **Review actions:** "Approve" or "Request Changes"

4. **Approve deliverable:**
   - Client clicks **"Approve"**
   - **Confirmation:** "Approve this deliverable?"
   - **PUT /v1/deliverables/{deliverable_id}/status:**
     ```json
     {
       "status": "APPROVED",
       "approved_by": "client_uuid",
       "approved_at": "2025-11-16T10:00:00Z",
       "approval_notes": "Looks great!"
     }
     ```
   - Deliverable status → **"APPROVED"**
   - **If linked to milestone:** Milestone marked as complete (triggers payment)
   - Freelancer receives notification: "Deliverable approved!"

5. **Request changes:**
   - Client clicks **"Request Changes"**
   - **Modal:**
     - **Feedback:** Text area for detailed feedback
     - **Specific issues:** Checklist or bullet points
     - **Optional:** Annotate file (draw on images/docs)
   - **PUT /v1/deliverables/{deliverable_id}/status:**
     ```json
     {
       "status": "CHANGES_REQUESTED",
       "feedback": "Please adjust the color scheme and add logo to header.",
       "requested_by": "client_uuid",
       "requested_at": "2025-11-16T11:00:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - Freelancer receives notification: "Changes requested on deliverable"
   - Freelancer can **upload revised version** (creates new version)

6. **Upload revised version:**
   - Freelancer clicks **"Upload revision"** on deliverable
   - Upload new file (same filename or different)
   - **POST /v1/deliverables/{deliverable_id}/versions:**
     ```json
     {
       "deliverable_id": "uuid",
       "asset_id": "new_file_uuid",
       "version_number": 2,
       "revision_notes": "Adjusted color scheme and added logo",
       "uploaded_at": "2025-11-17T09:00:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - Deliverable status → **"PENDING_REVIEW"** (again)
   - Client notified: "Revised deliverable submitted"
   - **Version history** shows all versions (v1, v2, etc.)

7. **Organize files with folders:**
   - Workroom files can be **organized in folders**
   - Click **"New folder"** → Enter name: "Design Assets"
   - Drag & drop files into folder
   - **Folder structure:**
     - /Design Assets
     - /Development Files
     - /References
     - /Final Deliverables
   - Folders sync across client and freelancer views

8. **File sharing & permissions:**
   - Files uploaded to workroom visible to **both parties by default**
   - **Optional:** Mark file as "Private" (visible only to uploader)
   - **Share with others:** Invite team members to workroom (requires contract permissions)
   - **Download permissions:** Client can restrict downloads (watermarked previews only)

**Branches & Edge Cases:**

- **File size limit:** Max 500MB per file, 10GB total per contract
- **File type restrictions:** Executables (.exe, .bat) blocked for security
- **Virus scan failure:** If file flagged, upload rejected with explanation
- **Duplicate files:** System detects duplicates, offers to skip or replace
- **File versioning:** Up to 10 versions per deliverable retained
- **Download tracking:** System logs who downloaded which files
- **Thumbnail generation:** Auto-generate thumbnails for images, videos, PDFs
- **File comments:** Can comment on files for feedback (inline annotations)
- **Bulk download:** Select multiple files → "Download all as ZIP"
- **File search:** Search files by name, type, date, uploader
- **File deletion:** Can delete files (soft delete, recoverable for 30 days)
- **Storage quota:** Each contract has 10GB storage, upgradeable
- **Large file handling:** Files >100MB use chunked upload (resumable)
- **File expiry:** Workroom files accessible for 90 days after contract completion
- **File export:** Can export all workroom files at contract end
- **Deliverable deadline:** Can set due dates for deliverables (reminders)
- **Deliverable templates:** Create deliverable checklists (e.g., "Logo deliverable must include AI, PNG, SVG")
- **File notifications:** Optional notifications for every file upload (can be noisy, disabled by default)
- **Mobile optimization:** Mobile apps support camera upload, document scanning

**Notifications:**

- **Email + Push (client):** "New deliverable submitted for review"
- **Email + Push (freelancer):** "Deliverable approved" or "Changes requested on deliverable"
- **Email + Push (both):** "New file uploaded to workroom" (if enabled)
- **In-app:** Real-time file upload progress notifications

**Analytics:**

- workroom.file\_uploaded (contract\_id, file\_type, file\_size\_mb)
- workroom.file\_downloaded (contract\_id, file\_id, downloaded\_by)
- workroom.deliverable\_marked (contract\_id, deliverable\_id, milestone\_id)
- workroom.deliverable\_approved (contract\_id, deliverable\_id, time\_to\_approve\_hours)
- workroom.deliverable\_changes\_requested (contract\_id, deliverable\_id, feedback\_length)
- workroom.deliverable\_revised (contract\_id, deliverable\_id, version\_number)
- workroom.folder\_created (contract\_id, folder\_name)
- workroom.file\_moved\_to\_folder (contract\_id, file\_id, folder\_id)
- workroom.file\_deleted (contract\_id, file\_id, deleted\_by)
- workroom.bulk\_download\_executed (contract\_id, file\_count)
- workroom.file\_commented (contract\_id, file\_id, comment\_length)
- workroom.deliverable\_deadline\_set (contract\_id, deliverable\_id, deadline\_date)
- workroom.storage\_quota\_reached (contract\_id, used\_gb)

**Sources:** storage-be.user-stories.md (Section 1: Asset Upload & Management), contracts-be.user-stories.md (Section 4: Deliverables), combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/workroom/files routes).

### CTR-3 — Milestones (Fixed Price Contracts)

**ID:** CTR-3  
**Persona:** Client, Freelancer  
**Preconditions:** Fixed-price contract is active  
**Triggers:** Milestone created during contract setup, milestone work begins

**Primary Screens:**
- **Web:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/milestones` — Milestones list
- **Web:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/milestones/[milestoneId]` — Milestone detail
- **Mobile:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/milestones` — Milestones overview

**System Touchpoints:**
- **contracts-be/milestone** — POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/milestones (create milestone)
- **contracts-be/milestone** — GET /v1/milestones/{milestone_id} (get milestone details)
- **contracts-be/milestone** — PUT /v1/milestones/{milestone_id}/status (submit, approve, reject)
- **contracts-be/milestone** — POST /v1/milestones/{milestone_id}/fund (fund specific milestone)
- **payments-be/escrow** — POST /v1/escrow/release (release payment for milestone)

**Flow Steps:**

1. **Milestones defined at contract creation:**
   - During contract creation (CTR-1), client defines **milestones**
   - **Example milestones:**
     - Milestone 1: "Design Mockups" — $1,500 — Due: Nov 20
     - Milestone 2: "Frontend Development" — $2,500 — Due: Dec 10
     - Milestone 3: "Final Delivery & Testing" — $1,000 — Due: Dec 20
   - **Each milestone includes:**
     - Title
     - Description
     - Amount ($)
     - Due date
     - Deliverable requirements
   - Milestones sum to total contract budget

2. **View milestones:**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/milestones`
   - **Milestones list:**
     - **Status indicators:** Pending, In Progress, Submitted, Approved, Paid
     - **Progress bar:** Overall milestone completion percentage
     - **Timeline view:** Milestones on a visual timeline
   - Click milestone → View details

3. **Work on milestone (freelancer):**
   - Freelancer marks milestone as **"In Progress"**
   - **PUT /v1/milestones/{milestone_id}/status:**
     ```json
     {
       "status": "IN_PROGRESS",
       "started_at": "2025-11-10T09:00:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - Milestone status → **"IN_PROGRESS"**
   - Freelancer uploads deliverables to workroom (CTR-2)
   - Links deliverables to milestone

4. **Submit milestone for review:**
   - Freelancer completes work
   - Navigate to milestone page
   - Click **"Submit for review"**
   - **Modal:**
     - **Deliverables:** Select uploaded files to link
     - **Completion notes:** "All design mockups completed as per requirements"
     - **Attach proof:** Screenshots, links, etc.
   - **PUT /v1/milestones/{milestone_id}/status:**
     ```json
     {
       "status": "SUBMITTED",
       "submitted_at": "2025-11-20T16:00:00Z",
       "deliverable_ids": ["file_uuid_1", "file_uuid_2"],
       "completion_notes": "All design mockups completed..."
     }
     ```
   - Milestone status → **"SUBMITTED"**
   - **Client receives notification:** "Milestone submitted for review"

5. **Client reviews milestone:**
   - Client navigates to milestone page
   - **Review panel:**
     - Milestone description & requirements
     - Linked deliverables (clickable to view)
     - Freelancer's completion notes
     - Timeline (on time / late)
   - Client reviews deliverables
   - **Actions:** "Approve & Release Payment" or "Request Changes"

6. **Approve milestone & release payment:**
   - Client clicks **"Approve & Release Payment"**
   - **Confirmation modal:**
     - "Release $1,500 to freelancer?"
     - "Payment will be processed from escrow"
   - Client confirms
   - **PUT /v1/milestones/{milestone_id}/status:**
     ```json
     {
       "status": "APPROVED",
       "approved_at": "2025-11-21T10:00:00Z",
       "approved_by": "client_uuid"
     }
     ```
   - **Payment release triggered:**
     - **POST /v1/escrow/release:**
       ```json
       {
         "contract_id": "uuid",
         "milestone_id": "uuid",
         "amount": 1500,
         "recipient_id": "freelancer_uuid",
         "release_reason": "MILESTONE_APPROVED"
       }
       ```
   - Milestone status → **"APPROVED"**
   - **Freelancer receives notification:** "Milestone approved! Payment on the way."
   - Payment processes (2-3 business days) → FIN-2

7. **Request changes on milestone:**
   - Client clicks **"Request Changes"**
   - **Modal:**
     - **Feedback:** Detailed explanation of required changes
     - **Priority:** Low / Medium / High
     - **Extend deadline (optional):** Add 5 days
   - **PUT /v1/milestones/{milestone_id}/status:**
     ```json
     {
       "status": "CHANGES_REQUESTED",
       "feedback": "Please revise color scheme and add more contrast",
       "requested_by": "client_uuid",
       "requested_at": "2025-11-21T11:00:00Z",
       "deadline_extension_days": 5
     }
     ```
   - Milestone status → **"CHANGES_REQUESTED"**
   - Freelancer receives notification: "Changes requested on milestone"
   - Freelancer uploads revisions, **resubmits milestone**

8. **Add milestone mid-contract:**
   - Client can add new milestone during contract (with freelancer agreement)
   - Navigate to milestones page → **"Add milestone"**
   - Enter milestone details + additional funding required
   - **POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/milestones:**
     ```json
     {
       "title": "Additional Feature: Contact Form",
       "description": "Add contact form to homepage",
       "amount": 500,
       "due_date": "2025-12-15",
       "requires_funding": true
     }
     ```
   - Freelancer receives notification: "New milestone added to contract"
   - Freelancer must **accept** new milestone
   - Client funds additional escrow for new milestone

**Branches & Edge Cases:**

- **Milestone dependencies:** Milestone 2 can't start until Milestone 1 approved (optional setting)
- **Partial payment:** Some contracts allow partial milestone payments (50% on submit, 50% on approval)
- **Milestone editing:** Milestones can be edited (title, description, amount) before work starts (requires mutual agreement)
- **Milestone deletion:** Can delete milestone if not yet started (refund to escrow)
- **Late submission:** If milestone submitted past due date, flag as "Late"
- **Auto-reminder:** Freelancer receives reminder 2 days before milestone due date
- **Overdue milestones:** If milestone overdue by 7+ days, client can request termination
- **Milestone bonus:** Client can add bonus payment for exceptional work
- **Milestone rejection:** Client can reject milestone (rare, usually triggers dispute)
- **Milestone resubmissions:** No limit on resubmissions, but each tracked
- **Payment hold:** Client can hold payment for 5 days even after approval (inspection period)
- **Milestone completion order:** Milestones don't have to be completed in order (unless dependencies set)
- **Bulk milestone creation:** Can import milestones from template or CSV
- **Milestone templates:** Common milestone templates (e.g., "Logo Design" has standard 3 milestones)
- **Milestone progress tracking:** Freelancer can update milestone progress (0-100%)
- **Milestone analytics:** Track average time to complete each milestone type

**Notifications:**

- **Email + Push (freelancer):** "New milestone added to contract"
- **Email + Push (freelancer):** "Milestone due in 2 days"
- **Email + Push (client):** "Milestone submitted for review"
- **Email + Push (freelancer):** "Milestone approved! Payment on the way."
- **Email + Push (freelancer):** "Changes requested on milestone"
- **Email + Push (both):** "Milestone overdue" (if >7 days late)

**Analytics:**

- milestones.milestone\_created (contract\_id, milestone\_amount, due\_date)
- milestones.milestone\_started (milestone\_id, start\_date)
- milestones.milestone\_submitted (milestone\_id, days\_to\_submit)
- milestones.milestone\_approved (milestone\_id, time\_to\_approve\_hours)
- milestones.milestone\_changes\_requested (milestone\_id, request\_count)
- milestones.milestone\_resubmitted (milestone\_id, resubmission\_count)
- milestones.milestone\_paid (milestone\_id, amount, payment\_date)
- milestones.milestone\_late\_submission (milestone\_id, days\_late)
- milestones.milestone\_deadline\_extended (milestone\_id, extension\_days)
- milestones.milestone\_added\_mid\_contract (contract\_id, milestone\_id)
- milestones.milestone\_bonus\_added (milestone\_id, bonus\_amount)
- milestones.milestone\_progress\_updated (milestone\_id, progress\_percentage)

**Sources:** contracts-be.user-stories.md (Section 3: Milestones), payments-be.user-stories.md (Section 2: Escrow & Release), combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/milestones routes).

### CTR-4 — Time Tracking (Hourly Contracts)

**ID:** CTR-4  
**Persona:** Freelancer (primarily), Client (review)  
**Preconditions:** Hourly contract is active  
**Triggers:** Freelancer starts work, logs hours manually

**Primary Screens:**
- **Web:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/timesheets` — Timesheet list
- **Web:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/timesheets/[timesheetId]` — Timesheet detail
- **Web:** `/app/(dashboard)/time-tracker` — Manual time entry
- **Mobile:** `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/timesheets` — Timesheets (mobile)
- **Mobile:** `/app/(dashboard)/time-tracker` — Time tracker widget

**System Touchpoints:**
- **contracts-be/timesheet** — POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/timesheets (create timesheet entry)
- **contracts-be/timesheet** — GET /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id} (get timesheet details)
- **contracts-be/timesheet** — PUT /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id} (update hours, memo)
- **contracts-be/timesheet** — PUT /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/status (submit for approval)
- **contracts-be/timesheet** — POST /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/approve (client approves)

**Flow Steps:**

1. **Start timer (automatic tracking):**
   - Freelancer navigates to `/app/(dashboard)/time-tracker`
   - Select **contract** from dropdown
   - Enter **task description:** "Frontend development - Homepage"
   - Click **"Start Timer"**
   - **Timer starts:**
     - Visual timer displays (HH:MM:SS)
     - Timer runs in background (persists across page navigation)
     - **POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/timesheets/start:**
       ```json
       {
         "contract_id": "uuid",
         "task_description": "Frontend development - Homepage",
         "start_time": "2025-11-15T09:00:00Z"
       }
       ```
   - Timer visible in **nav bar** (always accessible)

2. **Pause / Resume timer:**
   - Freelancer takes break
   - Click **"Pause"** → Timer pauses
   - **PUT /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/pause:**
     ```json
     {
       "paused_at": "2025-11-15T10:30:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - Timer shows "Paused" status
   - Click **"Resume"** → Timer continues
   - System tracks **active time only** (pauses excluded)

3. **Stop timer & save:**
   - Freelancer finishes task
   - Click **"Stop Timer"**
   - **Summary modal:**
     - Total time: 2h 15m
     - Task description (editable)
     - Date: 2025-11-15
     - **Optional:** Add memo / notes
   - Click **"Save"**
   - **PUT /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/stop:**
     ```json
     {
       "stopped_at": "2025-11-15T11:15:00Z",
       "total_hours": 2.25,
       "memo": "Completed homepage layout and navigation"
     }
     ```
   - Timesheet entry saved

4. **Manual time entry:**
   - Freelancer forgot to track time automatically
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/time-tracker` → **"Add manual entry"**
   - **Manual entry form:**
     - **Contract:** Select from active contracts
     - **Date:** 2025-11-14
     - **Start time:** 09:00 AM
     - **End time:** 01:30 PM (or enter duration: 4.5 hours)
     - **Task description:** "Backend API integration"
     - **Memo (optional):** Additional notes
   - Click **"Save"**
   - **POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/timesheets:**
     ```json
     {
       "contract_id": "uuid",
       "date": "2025-11-14",
       "start_time": "09:00",
       "end_time": "13:30",
       "total_hours": 4.5,
       "task_description": "Backend API integration",
       "memo": "Connected user authentication endpoints",
       "entry_type": "MANUAL"
     }
     ```
   - Timesheet entry created

5. **View weekly timesheet:**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/timesheets`
   - **Weekly view:**
     - Calendar week selector (Mon-Sun)
     - **Daily breakdown:**
       - Monday: 6 hours (3 entries)
       - Tuesday: 8 hours (4 entries)
       - Wednesday: 5 hours (2 entries)
       - Total week: 19 hours
     - **Each entry shows:**
       - Task description
       - Duration
       - Memo
       - Status (Draft, Submitted, Approved)
   - Click entry to **edit** (if status = Draft)

6. **Edit / Delete entry:**
   - Click timesheet entry → **Edit modal**
   - **Can edit:**
     - Task description
     - Memo
     - Duration (if manual entry)
   - **Can't edit:** Date, start/stop times (for automatic entries)
   - Click **"Save changes"**
   - **PUT /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}**
   - **Delete:** Click "Delete entry" → Confirmation → DELETE /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}

7. **Submit weekly timesheet:**
   - End of week, freelancer submits for client approval
   - Navigate to timesheets page
   - Click **"Submit week for approval"**
   - **Confirmation:**
     - "Submit 19 hours for approval?"
     - "Total amount: $950 (19h × $50/hour)"
   - Click "Submit"
   - **PUT /v1/timesheets/weekly/submit:**
     ```json
     {
       "contract_id": "uuid",
       "week_start_date": "2025-11-11",
       "week_end_date": "2025-11-17",
       "total_hours": 19,
       "total_amount": 950,
       "entries": ["timesheet_id_1", "timesheet_id_2", ...]
     }
     ```
   - Timesheet status → **"PENDING_APPROVAL"**
   - **Client receives notification:** "Freelancer submitted timesheet for approval"

8. **Client reviews & approves timesheet:**
   - Client navigates to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/timesheets`
   - **Pending timesheets** highlighted
   - Click timesheet → **Review panel:**
     - List of all entries (task, duration, memo)
     - Total hours & amount
     - Option to **filter/sort** by date or task
     - Can **question entry** (comment on specific line item)
   - Click **"Approve timesheet"**
   - **POST /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/approve:**
     ```json
     {
       "approved_by": "client_uuid",
       "approved_at": "2025-11-18T10:00:00Z",
       "approval_notes": "Looks good, approved!"
     }
     ```
   - Timesheet status → **"APPROVED"**
   - **Payment triggered:** Funds released from escrow to freelancer
   - Freelancer receives notification: "Timesheet approved! Payment on the way."

**Branches & Edge Cases:**

- **Weekly limit:** Some contracts have weekly hour limits (e.g., max 40h/week)
- **Overtime:** Hours beyond limit require client pre-approval
- **Timesheet edits after submission:** Can't edit once submitted (must contact support)
- **Client disputes entry:** Client can flag entry → Freelancer notified → Resolve dispute
- **Partial approval:** Client approves some entries, rejects others
- **Rejection reason:** Client provides feedback: "Please provide more detail on this task"
- **Resubmit:** Freelancer edits rejected entries, resubmits
- **Auto-submit:** Optional setting to auto-submit timesheets every Friday
- **Minimum billing increment:** Some contracts bill in 15-min or 30-min increments (round up)
- **Break deduction:** System auto-deducts breaks (e.g., lunch) if timer runs >6 hours
- **Idle detection:** If no activity for 10 minutes, prompt "Are you still working?" → Auto-pause if no response
- **Screenshot tracking:** Optional (for some contracts) — Take random screenshots during tracking
- **Activity monitoring:** Track keyboard/mouse activity (controversial, optional, client-enabled)
- **Timezone handling:** Timesheets recorded in freelancer's timezone, displayed in both timezones
- **Billing cycle:** Weekly, Bi-weekly, or End-of-month billing (configurable)
- **Invoice generation:** Approved timesheets auto-generate invoices (FIN-2)
- **Timesheet export:** Export timesheets as PDF or CSV
- **Timesheet history:** View all past timesheets (searchable, filterable)
- **Mobile time tracker:** Mobile app has widget for quick start/stop

**Notifications:**

- **Email + Push (client):** "Freelancer submitted timesheet for approval"
- **Email + Push (freelancer):** "Timesheet approved! Payment on the way."
- **Email + Push (freelancer):** "Client questioned a timesheet entry" (if disputed)
- **Push (freelancer):** "Timer still running! Did you forget to stop?" (after 8+ hours)
- **In-app:** Real-time timer status visible in nav bar

**Analytics:**

- timesheets.timer\_started (contract\_id, task\_description)
- timesheets.timer\_paused (timesheet\_id, duration\_before\_pause\_minutes)
- timesheets.timer\_stopped (timesheet\_id, total\_duration\_hours)
- timesheets.manual\_entry\_created (contract\_id, hours)
- timesheets.entry\_edited (timesheet\_id, field\_changed)
- timesheets.entry\_deleted (timesheet\_id, hours)
- timesheets.weekly\_timesheet\_submitted (contract\_id, total\_hours, total\_amount)
- timesheets.timesheet\_approved (timesheet\_id, time\_to\_approve\_hours)
- timesheets.timesheet\_entry\_disputed (timesheet\_id, entry\_id)
- timesheets.timesheet\_resubmitted (timesheet\_id, resubmission\_count)
- timesheets.timesheet\_exported (contract\_id, export\_format)
- timesheets.idle\_prompt\_shown (timesheet\_id)
- timesheets.weekly\_limit\_exceeded (contract\_id, hours\_over\_limit)

**Sources:** contracts-be.user-stories.md (Section 5: Time Tracking & Timesheets), combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/timesheets, time-tracker routes).

## CTR-5 — Contract Amendments & Modifications

**Persona:** Client, Freelancer  
**Journey ID:** CTR-5

### Preconditions & Triggers

- **Contract state:** Active, In Progress
- **Trigger:** Need to modify contract terms (rate, scope, budget, timeline)
- **Permission:** Both parties can propose amendments

### Primary Screens (Web + Mobile)

**Web:**
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments` — Amendments list
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments/create` — Create amendment
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments/[amendmentId]` — Amendment detail
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments/propose` — Propose amendment
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments/[amendmentId]/approve` — Approve amendment
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments/[amendmentId]/reject` — Reject amendment

**Mobile:**
- `/app/(tabs)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments` — Amendments list
- `/app/(tabs)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments/create` — Create amendment
- `/app/(tabs)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments/[amendmentId]` — Amendment detail

#### System Touchpoints

- **contracts-be:** `/amendment/*` — Amendment domain
- **financial-be:** `/escrow/*` — Budget adjustments, escrow modifications
- **communications-be:** `/notifications/*` — Amendment notifications
- **utility-be:** `/audit/*` — Amendment audit trail

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

1. **Identify need for amendment:**
   - Freelancer realizes project scope increased
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]` → Click **"Request Amendment"**
   - System displays contract summary with current terms

2. **Choose amendment type:**
   - Amendment type options:
     - **Scope Change** — Modify deliverables or tasks
     - **Budget Increase** — Add more funds
     - **Rate Adjustment** — Change hourly/fixed rate
     - **Timeline Extension** — Extend deadline
     - **Deliverable Change** — Add/remove milestones
     - **Terms Modification** — Other contract terms
   - Freelancer selects **"Scope Change"**

3. **Compose amendment proposal:**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments/create`
   - **Amendment form:**
     - **Title:** "Additional Feature Development"
     - **Amendment Type:** Scope Change (auto-filled)
     - **Description (required):**
       ```
       Client requested adding user authentication module and admin dashboard.
       This was not part of the original scope.
       ```
     - **Justification:**
       ```
       These features require approximately 40 additional hours of development.
       Original contract covered only the basic API endpoints.
       ```
     - **Proposed Changes:**
       - **Scope:** Add 2 new deliverables:
         - Deliverable 4: User Authentication System
         - Deliverable 5: Admin Dashboard UI
       - **Budget Impact:** +$2,000 (40 hours × $50/hour)
       - **Timeline Impact:** +2 weeks (extend end date from Nov 30 to Dec 14)
       - **New End Date:** 2025-12-14
     - **Supporting Documents:** Upload SOW amendment, wireframes, specifications
   - Click **"Propose Amendment"**
   - **POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/amendments:**
     ```json
     {
       "contract_id": "uuid",
       "amendment_type": "SCOPE_CHANGE",
       "title": "Additional Feature Development",
       "description": "Client requested adding user authentication...",
       "justification": "These features require approximately 40 additional hours...",
       "changes": {
         "scope": {
           "added_deliverables": [
             {"id": 4, "name": "User Authentication System", "value": 1000},
             {"id": 5, "name": "Admin Dashboard UI", "value": 1000}
           ]
         },
         "budget": {
           "original_amount": 5000,
           "amendment_amount": 2000,
           "new_total": 7000
         },
         "timeline": {
           "original_end_date": "2025-11-30",
           "extension_days": 14,
           "new_end_date": "2025-12-14"
         }
       },
       "budget_impact": 2000,
       "timeline_extension_days": 14,
       "new_end_date": "2025-12-14",
       "supporting_documents": ["doc_url_1", "doc_url_2"],
       "proposed_by": "freelancer_uuid",
       "requires_client_approval": true,
       "requires_freelancer_approval": false
     }
     ```
   - Amendment created with status **"PENDING_APPROVAL"**
   - **Event published:** `amendment.proposed.v1`

4. **Client receives notification:**
   - **Email + Push notification:** "Freelancer proposed a contract amendment"
   - Email contains:
     - Amendment title & description
     - Financial impact: +$2,000
     - Timeline impact: +2 weeks
     - **CTA button:** "Review Amendment"
   - Client clicks → Redirected to amendment detail page

5. **Client reviews amendment:**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments/[amendmentId]`
   - **Amendment detail page:**
     - **Header:**
       - Amendment #1 — Proposed by Freelancer
       - Status: **Pending Your Approval**
       - Proposed on: Nov 10, 2025
     - **Changes summary:**
       - **Scope Changes:**
         - ➕ Added: Deliverable 4 — User Authentication System ($1,000)
         - ➕ Added: Deliverable 5 — Admin Dashboard UI ($1,000)
       - **Budget Impact:**
         - Original: $5,000
         - Amendment: +$2,000
         - **New Total: $7,000** (40% increase)
       - **Timeline Impact:**
         - Original End Date: Nov 30, 2025
         - Extension: +14 days
         - **New End Date: Dec 14, 2025**
     - **Justification:**
       - Displays freelancer's reasoning
     - **Supporting Documents:**
       - 📄 SOW Amendment.pdf
       - 🖼️ Wireframes_v2.png
     - **Action buttons:**
       - **Approve Amendment** (green)
       - **Reject Amendment** (red)
       - **Request Clarification** (gray)
   - Client reviews carefully

6. **Client approves amendment:**
   - Click **"Approve Amendment"**
   - **Confirmation modal:**
     - "Approve Amendment #1?"
     - "By approving, you agree to:"
     - ✅ Increase contract budget by $2,000
     - ✅ Extend contract deadline by 14 days
     - ✅ Add 2 new deliverables
     - **Action required:** Additional funds will be held in escrow
     - Input field: **Approval Notes (optional)**
       - "Approved. These features are essential for the project."
     - Checkbox: ☑ "I have reviewed the changes and agree to the amended terms"
     - **Button:** "Confirm Approval"
   - Click "Confirm Approval"
   - **POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/amendments/{amendment_id}/approve:**
     ```json
     {
       "amendment_id": "uuid",
       "approved_by": "client_uuid",
       "approval_notes": "Approved. These features are essential...",
       "approved_at": "2025-11-11T14:30:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - Amendment status → **"APPROVED"** (both parties approved)
   - **Event published:** `amendment.approved.v1`

7. **System applies amendment:**
   - **Automatic application triggered** (since both parties approved)
   - **POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/amendments/{amendment_id}/apply**
   - **System actions:**
     - **Update contract terms:**
       - Budget: $5,000 → $7,000
       - End date: Nov 30 → Dec 14
       - Add 2 new milestones (Deliverables 4 & 5)
     - **Create contract version:** Contract v1 → v2
     - **Adjust escrow:**
       - Calculate additional funds needed: $2,000
       - **Call financial-be:** POST /v1/escrow/adjust
       - Request additional deposit from client
     - **Update audit trail:**
       - Record all changes with timestamp, proposer, approver
     - **Notify both parties:**
       - Email + Push: "Amendment #1 has been applied"
   - Contract status remains **"ACTIVE"** with updated terms
   - **Event published:** `amendment.applied.v1`

8. **View amendment history:**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments`
   - **Amendments list:**
     - **Amendment #1** — Scope Change — **Applied** — Nov 11, 2025
       - Budget Impact: +$2,000
       - Timeline Impact: +14 days
       - Proposed by: Freelancer
       - Approved by: Client
       - Applied on: Nov 11, 2025
     - **Action:** Click to view full details
   - **Audit trail:**
     - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/audit-trail`
     - See complete history:
       - Nov 10, 10:00 AM — Amendment proposed by Freelancer
       - Nov 11, 2:30 PM — Amendment approved by Client
       - Nov 11, 2:31 PM — Amendment applied by System
       - Nov 11, 2:32 PM — Budget increased $5K → $7K
       - Nov 11, 2:32 PM — End date extended to Dec 14
       - Nov 11, 2:33 PM — Deliverables 4 & 5 added

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Client rejects amendment:**
   - Client clicks "Reject Amendment"
   - **Rejection modal:**
     - "Reject Amendment #1?"
     - **Rejection Reason (required):**
       - "The budget increase is too high. Can we discuss a lower amount?"
     - Click "Submit Rejection"
   - **POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/amendments/{amendment_id}/reject:**
     ```json
     {
       "amendment_id": "uuid",
       "rejected_by": "client_uuid",
       "rejection_reason": "The budget increase is too high...",
       "rejected_at": "2025-11-11T14:00:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - Amendment status → **"REJECTED"**
   - Freelancer receives notification with rejection reason
   - **Event published:** `amendment.rejected.v1`

2. **Request clarification:**
   - Client clicks "Request Clarification"
   - Opens messaging panel
   - Client types: "Can you provide a detailed breakdown of the 40 hours?"
   - Message sent via communications-be
   - Freelancer responds with breakdown
   - Client can then approve/reject

3. **Multiple amendments pending:**
   - Contract can have multiple pending amendments
   - Amendments applied in chronological order
   - If conflicting changes, system flags for resolution

4. **Partial approval (bilateral):**
   - Some amendments require both parties' approval
   - Freelancer proposes rate increase
   - **Both must approve:**
     - Freelancer already approved (as proposer)
     - Client must approve
   - Amendment status: "PENDING_CLIENT_APPROVAL"
   - Once client approves → Auto-apply

5. **Amendment withdrawal:**
   - Proposer can withdraw amendment before approval
   - Navigate to amendment detail → Click "Withdraw Amendment"
   - Confirmation → POST /v1/amendments/{amendment_id}/withdraw
   - Amendment status → **"CANCELLED"**
   - Counterparty notified

6. **Budget impact validation:**
   - System validates client has sufficient funds
   - If budget increase > available balance:
     - Warning: "You need to add $2,000 to your account to approve this amendment"
     - Redirect to payment method page

7. **Timeline conflict:**
   - If extension pushes end date beyond platform limits (e.g., >2 years):
     - Error: "Extension exceeds maximum contract duration"
     - Suggest alternative solution

8. **Amendment to fixed-price contract:**
   - Add/remove milestones
   - Adjust milestone values
   - Recalculate total contract value

9. **Amendment to hourly contract:**
   - Adjust hourly rate
   - Modify weekly hour limits
   - Change billing cycle

10. **Amendment affects escrow:**
    - Budget increase → Client deposits additional funds
    - Budget decrease → Refund excess to client
    - Rate change → Recalculate hourly limits

11. **Amendment notification preferences:**
    - Users can configure: Email, Push, SMS for amendment requests
    - Urgency: Standard vs. Important (requires immediate attention)

12. **Amendment templates:**
    - Common amendment types pre-filled
    - "Extend deadline by 1 week" → Auto-populates fields
    - "Increase budget by 20%" → Auto-calculates amounts

13. **Amendment version control:**
    - Each amendment creates a new contract version
    - Contract v1 → Amendment #1 → Contract v2
    - Can view historical versions
    - Can't revert to old versions (audit compliance)

14. **Amendment approval delegation:**
    - For organizations, approval can be delegated
    - Primary contact proposes → Manager approves
    - RBAC rules enforced

15. **Amendment expiry:**
    - Amendments can have expiry dates
    - If not approved within 7 days → Auto-expire
    - Proposer must re-submit

16. **Amendment conflict resolution:**
    - If both parties propose conflicting amendments:
     - System flags conflict
     - Requires discussion/negotiation
     - Must withdraw one before proceeding

17. **Amendment impact preview:**
    - Before proposing, see impact:
     - "This will increase your project cost by 40%"
     - "New deadline is 2 weeks later"
    - Helps proposer make informed decision

18. **Amendment history export:**
    - Export amendment history as PDF
    - Includes all proposals, approvals, rejections
    - Legal compliance requirement

19. **Amendment fee (platform):**
    - Some platforms charge fee for amendments
    - E.g., "Amendment processing fee: $10"
    - Disclosed before submission

20. **Amendment cancellation:**
    - If amendment applied but causes issues:
     - Support can reverse (with both parties' consent)
     - Creates reversal amendment
     - Audit trail maintained

21. **Multi-stage amendments:**
    - Complex amendments may require multiple approvals:
     - Financial review
     - Legal review
     - Manager approval
    - Status: "PENDING_MULTI_APPROVAL"

22. **Amendment analytics:**
    - Track amendment patterns:
     - Most common amendment types
     - Average approval time
     - Rejection reasons
    - Help improve contract scoping

23. **Amendment reminders:**
    - If pending >3 days → Reminder sent
    - "You have 1 pending amendment to review"

24. **Amendment partial implementation:**
    - If amendment approved but can't be fully applied:
     - E.g., escrow adjustment fails
     - Status: "PARTIALLY_APPLIED"
     - Manual intervention required

25. **Amendment audit compliance:**
    - All amendments logged for regulatory compliance
    - Immutable audit trail
    - Can't be deleted or modified

26. **Amendment notification to stakeholders:**
    - For enterprise clients, notify all stakeholders:
     - Project manager
     - Finance team
     - Legal team

27. **Amendment impact on payment schedule:**
    - If milestone dates change → Update payment schedule
    - If budget increases → Adjust installment amounts

28. **Amendment comments thread:**
    - Amendments can have discussion threads
    - "Can we reduce the timeline extension to 10 days instead of 14?"
    - Negotiation happens in-platform

29. **Amendment comparison view:**
    - Side-by-side view:
     - **Before:** Original terms
     - **After:** Proposed changes
    - Easy visualization

30. **Amendment escalation:**
    - If amendment rejected multiple times:
     - Suggest dispute resolution
     - Escalate to support

#### Notifications

**Freelancer:**
- **Email + Push:** "Client approved your amendment! Changes applied."
- **Email + Push:** "Client rejected your amendment" (includes reason)
- **Push:** "Client requested clarification on your amendment"
- **Email:** Weekly summary: "You have 2 pending amendments"

**Client:**
- **Email + Push:** "Freelancer proposed a contract amendment (Action required)"
- **Email + Push:** "Amendment has been applied to your contract"
- **Push:** "Amendment will expire in 24 hours if not reviewed"
- **In-app:** Red badge on contracts tab: "1 pending amendment"

**Both:**
- **Email (legal):** "Contract version updated to v2 (Amendment #1 applied)"
- **Email (monthly):** "Amendment history report" (for compliance)

#### Analytics

- contracts.amendments.proposed (contract\_id, amendment\_type, budget\_impact, timeline\_impact)
- contracts.amendments.approved (amendment\_id, approver\_role, time\_to\_approve\_hours)
- contracts.amendments.rejected (amendment\_id, rejection\_reason, rejector\_role)
- contracts.amendments.applied (amendment\_id, financial\_impact, version\_change)
- contracts.amendments.withdrawn (amendment\_id, withdrawal\_reason)
- contracts.amendments.expired (amendment\_id, days\_pending)
- contracts.amendments.clarification\_requested (amendment\_id, clarification\_type)
- contracts.amendments.escrow\_adjusted (amendment\_id, adjustment\_amount)
- contracts.amendments.approval\_time\_exceeded (amendment\_id, days\_exceeded)
- contracts.amendments.bilateral\_approval\_completed (amendment\_id, total\_approval\_time\_hours)
- contracts.amendments.conflict\_detected (contract\_id, conflicting\_amendment\_ids)
- contracts.amendments.template\_used (template\_id, amendment\_type)
- contracts.amendments.version\_created (contract\_id, old\_version, new\_version)
- contracts.amendments.fee\_charged (amendment\_id, fee\_amount)
- contracts.amendments.reversal\_requested (amendment\_id, reversal\_reason)
- contracts.amendments.multi\_approval\_stage\_completed (amendment\_id, stage\_name, stage\_number)
- contracts.amendments.reminder\_sent (amendment\_id, reminder\_type, days\_pending)
- contracts.amendments.partial\_application (amendment\_id, failure\_reason)
- contracts.amendments.stakeholder\_notified (amendment\_id, stakeholder\_role, stakeholder\_count)
- contracts.amendments.discussion\_thread\_created (amendment\_id, participant\_count)
- contracts.amendments.comparison\_viewed (amendment\_id, viewer\_role)
- contracts.amendments.escalated (amendment\_id, escalation\_reason, rejection\_count)
- contracts.amendments.history\_exported (contract\_id, export\_format, amendment\_count)
- contracts.amendments.impact\_previewed (contract\_id, amendment\_type, proposed\_changes)
- contracts.amendments.delegation\_used (amendment\_id, delegator\_id, delegatee\_id)

#### Sources

**Backend:** contracts-be.user-stories.md (Section 8: Contract Changes Domain — Amendments & Extensions), contracts-be.database-design.md (Section 9: Contract Amendments table)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/amendments routes), hooks/use-contract-amendments.ts
