## CTR-6 — Workroom Activity Feed & Notifications

**Persona:** Client, Freelancer  
**Journey ID:** CTR-6

### Preconditions & Triggers

- **Contract state:** Active
- **Trigger:** Real-time updates needed for contract activity
- **Access:** Both client and freelancer can view workroom activity

### Primary Screens (Web + Mobile)

**Web:**
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/workroom` — Main workroom with activity feed
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/activity` — Dedicated activity feed page
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/notifications` — Notification settings

**Mobile:**
- `/app/(tabs)/contracts/[contractId]/workroom` — Workroom with activity
- `/app/(tabs)/contracts/[contractId]/activity` — Activity feed

#### System Touchpoints

- **contracts-be:** `/workroom/*`, `/activity/*` — Workroom management
- **communications-be:** `/notifications/*`, `/realtime/*` — Real-time notifications, WebSocket
- **storage-be:** `/files/*` — File activity tracking
- **utility-be:** `/audit/*` — Activity audit trail

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

1. **Access workroom:**
   - Freelancer navigates to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/workroom`
   - **Workroom dashboard displays:**
     - **Left sidebar:** File browser, deliverables list
     - **Center panel:** Activity feed
     - **Right sidebar:** Contract details, participants
   - **Activity Feed** section shows recent activities

2. **View activity feed:**
   - **Activity feed displays chronologically (newest first):**
     - **Today:**
       - 2:30 PM — 📄 Client uploaded "Requirements_v3.pdf"
       - 11:45 AM — ✅ Freelancer submitted Milestone 2
       - 10:15 AM — 💬 Client commented: "Looks good! Minor changes needed"
     - **Yesterday:**
       - 4:20 PM — ⏱️ Freelancer logged 4.5 hours
       - 2:00 PM — 📝 Freelancer updated deliverable description
       - 9:30 AM — 🔔 Contract started
     - **Last Week:**
       - Nov 4 — 💰 Client funded $5,000 to escrow
       - Nov 3 — ✍️ Contract signed by both parties
       - Nov 2 — 📨 Freelancer accepted contract
   - **Each activity shows:**
     - **Icon** (file, milestone, comment, etc.)
     - **Actor** (who performed the action)
     - **Action** (what happened)
     - **Timestamp** (relative time: "2 hours ago", "Yesterday")
     - **Details link** (click to view more)

3. **Real-time activity updates:**
   - Client uploads a file while freelancer is viewing workroom
   - **WebSocket connection** (via communications-be)
   - **Real-time update:**
     - Activity feed **auto-refreshes**
     - New activity appears at top with **animation** (fade-in)
     - **Toast notification:** "Client uploaded a new file"
   - **No page refresh needed**

4. **Filter activity feed:**
   - Click **"Filter"** button on activity feed
   - **Filter options:**
     - **Activity Type:**
       - ☑ Files (uploads, downloads, deletions)
       - ☑ Milestones (submissions, approvals, rejections)
       - ☑ Comments & Messages
       - ☑ Time Tracking
       - ☑ Contract Changes (amendments, status changes)
       - ☑ Payments (escrow, releases, refunds)
       - ☑ Participants (added, removed)
     - **Date Range:**
       - Last 7 days
       - Last 30 days
       - Custom range (date picker)
     - **Actor:**
       - All participants
       - Client only
       - Freelancer only
       - System only
   - Select: **Activity Type: Milestones** + **Date Range: Last 7 days**
   - Click "Apply Filters"
   - **GET /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/activity?type=MILESTONE&date_from=2025-11-01&date_to=2025-11-07**
   - **Filtered activity feed displays:**
     - Nov 7, 11:45 AM — ✅ Freelancer submitted Milestone 2
     - Nov 5, 3:30 PM — ✅ Client approved Milestone 1
     - Nov 3, 10:00 AM — 📝 Milestone 1 created

5. **Search activity feed:**
   - Enter search query in activity feed search box: "requirements"
   - **GET /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/activity/search?q=requirements**
   - **Search results:**
     - Nov 7, 2:30 PM — 📄 Client uploaded "Requirements_v3.pdf"
     - Nov 5, 9:00 AM — 📄 Client uploaded "Requirements_v2.pdf"
     - Nov 3, 4:15 PM — 📄 Freelancer uploaded "Requirements_Analysis.docx"
   - Click result → Jump to activity detail

6. **View activity detail:**
   - Click activity: "Client uploaded Requirements_v3.pdf"
   - **Activity detail modal:**
     - **Header:**
       - 📄 File Upload
       - By: John Doe (Client)
       - On: Nov 7, 2025, 2:30 PM
     - **Details:**
       - **File Name:** Requirements_v3.pdf
       - **File Size:** 2.3 MB
       - **Uploaded to:** /Project Documents/
       - **Version:** 3
       - **Previous Version:** Requirements_v2.pdf (Nov 5)
       - **Changes:** Updated Section 4 (Database Schema)
     - **Actions:**
       - 📥 Download File
       - 👁️ View File
       - 💬 Comment on File
       - 📜 View Version History
     - **Activity Context:**
       - Related milestone: Milestone 2 (Database Design)
       - Related discussion: "Database Schema Discussion" thread
   - Click "Download File" → File downloaded

7. **Comment on activity:**
   - From activity detail modal, click "Comment on File"
   - **Comment box appears:**
     - "Add a comment about this file..."
     - Type: "Thanks for uploading! I'll review this by EOD."
     - Click "Post Comment"
   - **POST /v1/contracts/{contract_id}/activity/{activity_id}/comments:**
     ```json
     {
       "activity_id": "uuid",
       "comment": "Thanks for uploading! I'll review this by EOD.",
       "commenter_id": "freelancer_uuid",
       "commented_at": "2025-11-07T14:45:00Z"
     }
     ```
   - Comment posted
   - **New activity created:**
     - "Freelancer commented on Requirements_v3.pdf"
   - Client receives **push notification:** "Freelancer commented on your file"

8. **Configure activity notifications:**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/notifications`
   - **Notification settings page:**
     - **Activity Notifications:**
       - ☑ File uploads / updates
       - ☑ Milestone submissions / approvals
       - ☑ Comments & replies
       - ☑ Time tracking (daily summary)
       - ☐ Contract status changes (already enabled globally)
       - ☑ Payment events
       - ☐ Participant changes
     - **Notification Channels:**
       - ☑ Email (immediate)
       - ☑ Push (immediate)
       - ☐ SMS (critical only)
       - ☑ In-app (always)
     - **Digest Settings:**
       - **Frequency:** Daily Digest (at 8:00 AM)
       - **Include:** Unread activities, pending actions
       - **Format:** Summary email with activity count
   - Freelancer unchecks "Time tracking" (too frequent)
   - Click "Save Preferences"
   - **PUT /v1/users/{user_id}/notification-preferences:**
     ```json
     {
       "contract_id": "uuid",
       "preferences": {
         "file_activity": {"email": true, "push": true, "sms": false},
         "milestone_activity": {"email": true, "push": true, "sms": false},
         "comments": {"email": true, "push": true, "sms": false},
         "time_tracking": {"email": false, "push": false, "sms": false},
         "payments": {"email": true, "push": true, "sms": false}
       },
       "digest": {
         "enabled": true,
         "frequency": "DAILY",
         "time": "08:00"
       }
     }
     ```
   - Preferences saved
   - Confirmation: "Notification preferences updated"

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Empty activity feed:**
   - New contract with no activity yet
   - Display: "No activity yet. Upload a file or submit a milestone to get started."

2. **Activity pagination:**
   - More than 50 activities → Paginate
   - "Load More" button at bottom
   - Or infinite scroll (mobile)

3. **Activity grouping:**
   - Group related activities:
     - "Freelancer uploaded 3 files" (instead of 3 separate entries)
     - Click to expand and see individual files

4. **System-generated activities:**
   - Automated activities (e.g., "Contract auto-renewed")
   - Icon: 🤖 System
   - Different styling (gray background)

5. **Deleted activity visibility:**
   - If file is deleted, activity remains but shows:
     - "📄 Client uploaded 'Requirements.pdf' (File deleted)"
     - Can't download anymore

6. **Private activities:**
   - Some activities visible only to certain roles:
     - E.g., "Admin flagged contract for review" (only visible to admin)
   - RBAC enforced

7. **Activity export:**
   - Export activity feed as PDF or CSV
   - Button: "Export Activity Log"
   - Includes all activities (no pagination limit)

8. **Activity mention notifications:**
   - If comment mentions user: "@JohnDoe"
   - User receives **direct notification:**
     - "Freelancer mentioned you in a comment"

9. **Activity reminder:**
   - If pending action (e.g., "Client hasn't approved milestone for 3 days")
   - Activity feed shows reminder:
     - "⏰ Reminder: Milestone 2 awaiting approval"

10. **Activity time zone handling:**
    - Timestamps displayed in user's local timezone
    - Hover to see UTC time

11. **Activity read/unread status:**
    - Unread activities highlighted with blue dot
    - Clicking activity marks as read
    - Counter: "5 unread activities"

12. **Activity conflict alerts:**
    - If conflicting activities:
     - E.g., "Freelancer and Client both edited same file"
     - Alert icon: ⚠️
     - Suggest resolution

13. **Activity performance optimization:**
    - Lazy loading: Load activities as user scrolls
    - Cache recent activities in browser
    - WebSocket for real-time, REST API for history

14. **Activity privacy settings:**
    - User can hide certain activities from feed:
     - E.g., "Don't show time tracking in activity feed"

15. **Activity favorites/pinning:**
    - Pin important activities to top:
     - "📌 Pinned: Contract amendment approved"

16. **Activity search autocomplete:**
    - Search suggests terms as user types:
     - "req..." → "requirements", "request", "required documents"

17. **Activity filter presets:**
    - Predefined filters:
     - "Show only my activities"
     - "Show pending actions"
     - "Show last week"

18. **Activity keyboard shortcuts:**
    - `n` — Next activity
    - `p` — Previous activity
    - `r` — Refresh feed
    - `f` — Open filter
    - `/` — Focus search

19. **Activity notification sound:**
    - Optional sound on new activity
    - Settings: "Play sound for new activities"
    - Desktop only

20. **Activity dark mode:**
    - Activity feed respects user's theme preference
    - Icons/colors adjusted for dark background

21. **Activity accessibility:**
    - Screen reader support
    - Keyboard navigation
    - ARIA labels for all activity types

22. **Activity rate limiting:**
    - Prevent spam from excessive activities
    - E.g., max 100 time tracking entries per day

23. **Activity deduplication:**
    - If same action repeated quickly:
     - "Freelancer updated file 5 times" (grouped)

24. **Activity rollback:**
    - For admins, ability to rollback certain activities:
     - E.g., "Undo file deletion"
     - Creates new activity: "Admin restored file"

25. **Activity insights:**
    - Analytics panel:
     - "Most active day: Nov 7 (25 activities)"
     - "Most common activity: File uploads (40%)"

26. **Activity subscription:**
    - "Subscribe to this activity type"
    - Get immediate notifications only for subscribed types

27. **Activity mobile optimization:**
    - Mobile: Simplified activity cards (less detail)
    - Tap to expand full details

28. **Activity feed widget:**
    - Dashboard widget showing recent contract activities
    - Across all contracts

29. **Activity integration with calendar:**
    - Key activities auto-add to user's calendar:
     - "Milestone deadline: Nov 15"

30. **Activity feed tour (first-time users):**
    - Tooltip tour explaining activity feed features
    - "This is your activity feed. Stay updated on all contract events."

#### Notifications

**Real-time (via WebSocket):**
- **Push (both):** New activity appears instantly in feed
- **Toast notification:** "Client uploaded a file" (non-intrusive, auto-dismiss after 5s)

**Activity Digests:**
- **Email (daily):** "Your daily activity summary for Project X"
  - Subject: "5 new activities in your contract"
  - Body: Summary of activities with links

**Mention Notifications:**
- **Email + Push:** "@You were mentioned in a comment"

**Reminder Notifications:**
- **Email + Push:** "Reminder: Milestone awaiting your approval"

## CTR-7 — Contract Templates & SOWs

**Persona:** Client, Freelancer, Admin  
**Journey ID:** CTR-7

### Preconditions & Triggers

- **Trigger:** User wants to create contract using predefined template
- **Access:** Clients can create contracts from templates, Admins can manage templates
- **Context:** Speeds up contract creation, ensures consistency

### Primary Screens (Web + Mobile)

**Web:**
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/templates` — Template library
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/templates/[templateId]` — Template detail & preview
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/templates/create` — Create custom template
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/templates/[templateId]/edit` — Edit template
- `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/create?template=[templateId]` — Create contract from template

**Mobile:**
- `/app/(tabs)/contracts/templates` — Template library
- `/app/(tabs)/contracts/templates/[templateId]` — Template preview

#### System Touchpoints

- **contracts-be:** `/template/*` — Template management domain
- **contracts-be:** `/contract/*` — Contract creation from templates
- **storage-be:** `/files/*` — Template documents
- **utility-be:** `/audit/*` — Template usage tracking

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

1. **Browse template library:**
   - Client navigates to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/templates`
   - **Template library page displays:**
     - **Header:**
       - Title: "Contract Templates"
       - Subtitle: "Choose a template to quickly create contracts"
       - Button: "+ Create Custom Template" (if has permission)
     - **Categories:**
       - 📝 Standard Templates (Platform-provided)
       - 🏢 My Organization's Templates
       - ⭐ My Saved Templates
       - 🌍 Public Templates (from community)
     - **Search & Filter:**
       - Search bar: "Search templates..."
       - Filters: Contract Type, Category, Industry, Pricing Model
   - **Template grid displays:**
     - Each template card shows:
       - **Template name:** "Website Development (Fixed-Price)"
       - **Category:** Web Development
       - **Contract Type:** Fixed-Price
       - **Usage count:** "Used 1,247 times"
       - **Preview button:** "Preview Template"
       - **Use button:** "Use This Template"

2. **Preview template:**
   - Client clicks "Preview Template" on "Website Development (Fixed-Price)"
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/templates/[templateId]`
   - **Template detail page:**
     - **Header:**
       - Template Name: "Website Development (Fixed-Price)"
       - Category: Web Development | Fixed-Price
       - Created by: Skillsier (System Template)
       - Last updated: Oct 15, 2025
       - Usage count: 1,247
       - Rating: ⭐ 4.8/5 (from 340 reviews)
     - **Template Description:**
       ```
       Comprehensive template for website development projects. Includes milestones
       for design, development, testing, and deployment. Suitable for small to 
       medium-sized websites.
       ```
     - **Template Details:**
       - **Contract Type:** Fixed-Price
       - **Estimated Duration:** 4-8 weeks
       - **Price Range:** $2,000 - $15,000
       - **Milestones:** 4 (Design, Development, Testing, Deployment)
       - **Deliverables:** 6 predefined deliverables
       - **Payment Terms:** 30% upfront, 30% mid-project, 40% on completion
     - **Template Structure Preview:**
       - **Milestone 1 — Design Phase (25%)**
         - Deliverable 1.1: Wireframes & Mockups
         - Deliverable 1.2: Design approval
       - **Milestone 2 — Development Phase (40%)**
         - Deliverable 2.1: Frontend implementation
         - Deliverable 2.2: Backend implementation
       - **Milestone 3 — Testing Phase (20%)**
         - Deliverable 3.1: QA testing results
       - **Milestone 4 — Deployment (15%)**
         - Deliverable 4.1: Live website
         - Deliverable 4.2: Documentation
     - **Standard Clauses Included:**
       - ✅ IP Rights Transfer
       - ✅ Confidentiality (NDA)
       - ✅ Warranty (30-day bug fixes)

     - **Action Buttons:**

       - Save to My Templates
       - Clone & Customize
       - View Contract Example (sample contract using this template)

3. **Use template to create contract:**
   - Client clicks **"Use This Template"**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/create?template=[templateId]`
   - **Contract creation form (pre-filled with template data):**
     - **Step 1: Basic Information**
       - **Job Title:** (user fills) "E-Commerce Website Development"
       - **Template Used:** Website Development (Fixed-Price) (read-only, indicated)
       - **Contract Type:** Fixed-Price (from template, can't change)
       - **Description:** (user fills or edits)
     - **Step 2: Scope & Milestones** (pre-populated from template)
       - **Milestone 1 — Design Phase**
         - **Value:** 25% → User enters: $1,250 (based on $5,000 total)
         - **Deliverables:**
           - Deliverable 1.1: Wireframes & Mockups (pre-filled, user can edit)
           - Deliverable 1.2: Design approval (pre-filled, user can edit)
         - **Deadline:** (user sets) Nov 20, 2025
       - **Milestone 2 — Development Phase**
         - **Value:** 40% → $2,000
         - **Deliverables:** (pre-filled, user can edit)
       - **Milestone 3 — Testing Phase**
         - **Value:** 20% → $1,000
       - **Milestone 4 — Deployment**
         - **Value:** 15% → $750
       - **Total Contract Value:** $5,000 (calculated)
       - **Option to add/remove milestones:** "+ Add Milestone" or "Remove"
     - **Step 3: Terms & Conditions** (from template)
       - **Payment Terms:** 30% upfront, 30% mid-project, 40% on completion (pre-filled, can edit)
       - **IP Rights:** Full transfer to client (pre-selected checkbox)
       - **Confidentiality:** NDA required (pre-selected)
       - **Warranty:** 30-day bug fix warranty (pre-selected)
       - **Additional Terms:** (user can add custom terms)
     - **Step 4: Invite Freelancer**
       - **Freelancer:** (user selects from search or invites specific freelancer)
       - **Message to Freelancer:** (optional)
     - **Review Summary:**
       - All details displayed
       - Estimated project duration: 6 weeks (based on milestones)
       - **Escrow deposit required:** $1,500 (30% upfront)
   - Client reviews and clicks **"Create Contract & Invite Freelancer"**

4. **Template saves user time:**
   - **POST /v1/contracts (using template):**
     ```json
     {
       "template_id": "uuid",
       "job_title": "E-Commerce Website Development",
       "description": "...",
       "contract_type": "FIXED_PRICE",
       "total_value": 5000,
       "milestones": [

       ],
       "terms": {
         "payment_terms": "30_30_40",
         "ip_rights": "FULL_TRANSFER",
         "nda_required": true,
         "warranty_days": 30
       },
     ```

   - **Analytics tracked:** Template usage count incremented

5. **Client creates custom template (for future use):**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/templates/create`
   - **Create Custom Template form:**
     - **Template Name:** "SaaS MVP Development"
     - **Category:** Software Development
     - **Contract Type:** Fixed-Price
     - **Description:** "Template for SaaS MVP projects with 3-month delivery"
     - **Visibility:**
       - ◉ Private (only I can use)
       - ○ Organization (my team can use)
       - ○ Public (anyone can use)
     - **Structure:**
       - Define milestones, deliverables, payment terms (similar to contract creation)
     - **Standard Clauses:**
       - Select from clause library:
         - ☑ IP Rights Transfer
         - ☑ NDA
         - ☐ Non-Compete (optional)
         - ☑ Termination

       - ☑ Project name
       - ☑ Milestone values
       - ☑ Timelines
       - ☐ Payment terms (locked)
   - Click **"Save Template"**
   - **POST /v1/templates:**
     ```json
     {
       "name": "SaaS MVP Development",
       "category": "SOFTWARE_DEVELOPMENT",
       "contract_type": "FIXED_PRICE",
       "description": "...",
       "visibility": "PRIVATE",
       "structure": {
         "milestones": [...],
         "deliverables": [...],
         "payment_terms": "30_30_40"
       },

     }
     ```
   - Template created
   - **Event published:** `template.created.v1`
   - Confirmation: "Template saved! You can now use it to create contracts."

6. **Admin manages system templates:**
   - Admin navigates to `/admin/contracts/templates`
   - **Admin Template Management:**
     - List of all templates (system, organization, public)
     - Can **edit**, **publish**, **unpublish**, **delete** templates
     - Can **feature** templates (appear first in library)
     - Can **review** public templates submitted by users
     - **Analytics:**
       - Most used templates
       - Template success rates (contracts created → contracts completed)
       - User feedback on templates

7. **Template versioning:**
   - Client edits their custom template
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/contracts/templates/[templateId]/edit`
   - Make changes (e.g., add new milestone)
   - Click "Save as New Version"
   - **PUT /v1/templates/{template_id}:**
     ```json
     {
       "version": 2,
       "changes": {
         "milestones": {
           "added": ["Milestone 5 — Maintenance"]
         }
       },
       "updated_by": "client_uuid"
     }
     ```
   - New version created (v2)
   - Contracts created from old version (v1) remain unchanged
   - New contracts use v2

8. **Clone & customize template:**
   - User finds a public template they like: "Mobile App Development"
   - Click **"Clone & Customize"**
   - Template cloned to user's "My Saved Templates"
   - User can edit cloned template without affecting original
   - **POST /v1/templates/{template_id}/clone:**
     ```json
     {
       "original_template_id": "uuid",
       "new_name": "My Custom Mobile App Template",
       "cloned_by": "user_uuid"
     }
     ```
   - Cloned template saved
   - User navigates to template edit page to customize

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Template not found:**
   - User clicks deleted/unpublished template link
   - Error: "Template not found or no longer available"
   - Redirect to template library

2. **Template customization limits:**
   - Some templates lock certain fields (e.g., payment terms)
   - User tries to edit locked field → Disabled with tooltip: "This field is locked by template creator"

3. **Template usage limit:**
   - Some premium templates require subscription
   - Free user tries to use premium template:
     - Modal: "Upgrade to Pro to use this template"
     - CTA: "Upgrade Now"

4. **Template rating & feedback:**
   - After using template to create contract:
     - "How was this template? Rate it!"
     - Star rating (1-5)
     - Optional feedback: "What did you like/dislike?"
   - **POST /v1/templates/{template_id}/feedback**

5. **Template search & filter:**
   - Search query: "web development fixed price"
   - **GET /v1/templates/search?q=web+development+fixed+price&type=FIXED_PRICE**
   - Results sorted by relevance & usage count

6. **Template favorites:**
   - User clicks "Save to My Templates" on public template
   - Template added to favorites
   - Quick access from "My Saved Templates" tab

7. **Template recommendations:**
   - Based on user's job postings history:
     - "You often hire for web development. Try these templates:"
     - AI-suggested templates

8. **Template preview before use:**
   - "View Contract Example" button
   - Shows sample contract generated from template
   - Helps user understand final output

9. **Template SOW (Statement of Work) attachment:**
   - Template can include SOW document template
   - When contract created from template → SOW auto-attached

10. **Template milestones calculation:**
    - User enters total contract value: $10,000
    - Template has percentage-based milestones (25%, 40%, 20%, 15%)
    - System auto-calculates milestone values:
      - Milestone 1: $2,500
      - Milestone 2: $4,000
      - Milestone 3: $2,000
      - Milestone 4: $1,500

11. **Template clause library:**
    - Admins maintain library of standard clauses
    - Templates reference clauses by ID
    - If clause updated, all templates using it are updated

12. **Template audit trail:**
    - Track all changes to template
    - "Version History" tab shows:
      - v1 — Nov 1, 2025 — Created by Admin
      - v2 — Nov 5, 2025 — Added Milestone 5 by Admin
      - v3 — Nov 10, 2025 — Updated payment terms by Admin

13. **Template multi-language support:**
    - Templates available in multiple languages
    - User's language preference auto-selects template language

14. **Template legal compliance:**
    - Templates reviewed by legal team
    - "Legally reviewed" badge on compliant templates
    - Non-compliant templates flagged for users

15. **Template usage analytics for creators:**
    - Template creator can see:
      - Usage count
      - Success rate (% of contracts completed)
      - Average ratings
      - Feedback comments

16. **Template export/import:**
    - Export template as JSON
    - Import template from JSON (for migration or backup)

17. **Template collaboration (for orgs):**
    - Multiple team members can edit organization templates
    - Version control prevents conflicts

18. **Template deprecation:**
    - Admin deprecates outdated template
    - Users with active contracts from deprecated template not affected
    - New contracts can't use deprecated template

19. **Template pricing tiers:**
    - Free templates: Limited features
    - Pro templates: Advanced clauses, unlimited customization
    - Enterprise templates: Custom legal review

20. **Template quick actions:**
    - From template card, dropdown menu:
      - Use Template
      - Preview
      - Save to Favorites
      - Clone
      - Share (generate shareable link)

21. **Template comparison:**
    - Select 2-3 templates → Click "Compare"
    - Side-by-side comparison of features, milestones, terms

22. **Template AI suggestions:**
    - When creating contract, AI suggests template:
      - "Based on your job description, we recommend: 'Website Development (Fixed-Price)'"

23. **Template usage limits (rate limiting):**
    - Prevent abuse: Max 50 contracts from template per day

24. **Template notification for updates:**
    - User favorited a template
    - Template creator updates template (new version)
    - User notified: "Template 'X' has been updated. Review changes?"

25. **Template deletion protection:**
    - Can't delete template if active contracts using it
    - Must wait until all contracts completed or archive template instead

26. **Template preview customization:**
    - Preview template with user's data (e.g., company name pre-filled)
    - Helps visualize final contract

27. **Template tags:**
    - Templates tagged with keywords (e.g., #webdev, #saas, #hourly)
    - Improves search & discoverability

28. **Template community ratings:**
    - Public templates: Community can rate & review
    - Top-rated templates featured in library

29. **Template usage report:**
    - Monthly report for template creators:
      - "Your template 'X' was used 47 times this month"
      - Average contract value: $4,200
      - Feedback summary

30. **Template SOW generator:**
    - Advanced templates include SOW generator
    - Automatically creates detailed SOW based on contract details

## CL‑5 — Hire · Contract Generation & Funding**

> **Scope note:** CL‑5 focuses strictly on **hire → contract generation → escrow funding → e‑signature → activation**.  
> It **does not** repeat material already covered in **CTR‑1…CTR‑7** (full lifecycle, workroom collaboration, milestones management, hourly tracking, amendments, activity feed, templates). When needed, those sections are referenced only.

## 2) Goal
Convert an accepted proposal into an enforceable, **funded** contract with mutual **e‑signatures**, ensuring legal validity and payment readiness before work starts.

## 3) Actor / Persona
- **Primary:** Client Owner / Client Admin / Hiring Manager (initiates hire, funds escrow, signs).  
- **Secondary:** Freelancer (counter‑sign); Billing Admin (secondary approver for funding); System (risk/KYC, payment orchestration).

## 4) Preconditions & Triggers
**Preconditions**
- Proposal is **hirable** (accepted/ready in JOB‑3 context).  
- Client has a valid **payment method** or can add one in‑flow.  
- Org profile & tax details completed if policy requires.  
- For **Fixed**: client can fund **at least first milestone** (or total).  
- For **Hourly**: billing authorization is allowed for the org’s plan.

**Triggers**
- Client clicks **Hire** from proposal/applicant screen.  
- Client opens an existing **contract draft** to complete sign/fund.  
- System prompts hire due to SLA/hold (e.g., offer accepted, pending contract).

---

## 5) Primary Screens (Routes)

**Web (Next.js App Router)**  
- `(contracts)/new/from-proposal/[proposalId]/page.tsx` — Contract Create Wizard (prefilled).  
- `(contracts)/[contractId]/page.tsx` — Contract details (Sign & Fund panels).  
- `(contracts)/[contractId]/escrow/page.tsx` — Escrow & Funding.  
- `(billing)/payment-methods/page.tsx` — List payment methods.  
- `(billing)/payment-methods/add/page.tsx` — Add method (PSP redirect/token).  
- `(contracts)/[contractId]/summary/page.tsx` — Activation summary (handoff to workroom).

**Mobile (Expo Router)**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(contracts)/new/from-proposal/[proposalId].tsx` — Create Wizard.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(contracts)/[contractId].tsx` — Details (tabs: Agreement | Milestones | Escrow).  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(contracts)/[contractId]/escrow.tsx` — Escrow.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(billing)/payment-methods/index.tsx` — Methods.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(billing)/payment-methods/add.tsx` — Add method.

> **Route alignment:** Uses canonical `(contracts)` and `(billing)` groups from the combined FE structure. After activation, navigation deep‑links into **workroom** (see CTR‑2/3/4).

---

## 6) System Touchpoints (Microservices & APIs)

**proposals‑be**
- `GET /v1/proposals/{{proposal_id}}` — hydrate contract draft (title, scope, rate/amount, attachments).

**contracts‑be**
- `POST /v1/contracts` — create from proposal (type `FIXED|HOURLY`, parties, base terms, milestone seed).  
- `GET /v1/contracts/{{contract_id}}` — read contract.  
- `PUT /v1/contracts/{{contract_id}}/sign` — capture e‑signature `{{role: CLIENT|FREELANCER, signature}}`.  
- `PUT /v1/contracts/{{contract_id}}/status` — transition to `ACTIVE` once sign+fund gates met.  
- `POST /v1/contracts/{{contract_id}}/milestones` — seed milestones on creation (full operations in CTR‑3).

**financial‑be**
- `GET /v1/payment-methods` — list methods.  
- `POST /v1/payment-methods` — add method (PSP tokenization).  
- `POST /v1/escrow/fund` — fund escrow (contract or milestone).  
- `GET /v1/escrow/{{contract_id}}` — escrow status / ledger.

**communications‑be**
- Notifications (hire started, sign requests, fund success/fail, activation).

**admin‑be / policies**
- Funding approvals, KYC/AML checks, restricted categories.

**analytics‑be / audit‑be**
- Events & immutable audit entries (see §13, §16).

---

## 7) Frontend Components & Hooks

**Components (Web)**
- `ContractCreateWizard` — stepper: Parties → Terms → Milestones (seed) → Review.  
- `TermsEditor` — type (Fixed/Hourly), start date, NDA, IP, jurisdiction.  
- `MilestoneSeed` — add/reorder simple milestones (detailed mgmt = CTR‑3).  
- `SignPanel` — agreement preview (PDF), sign CTA, signature status chips.  
- `EscrowCard` — amount selector, method selector, KYC prompts, fund CTA.  
- `PaymentMethodList` / `PaymentMethodAdd` — billing UX.

**Hooks (shared)**
- `useProposal(proposalId)` / `useContract(contractId)` / `useEscrow(contractId)`  
- `usePaymentMethods()` / `useFunding()` — tokenization + fund.  
- `useApprovals()` — optional funding approver chain.  
- `useActivationGate()` — computes **ready to activate** from signatures + escrow.

**State & Validation**
- Local draft state with server validation on each step; currency rounding; sums == budget.  
- Idempotency tokens for create/fund to avoid double posts.

---

## 8) Flow — Happy Paths

### A) Fixed‑Price with upfront funding
1. **Launch Hire** → `ContractCreateWizard` opens (prefilled from proposal).  
2. **Set Terms**: Fixed, start date, NDA/IP.  
3. **Seed Milestones**: create 1–N milestones; totals validated.  
4. **Create Contract (Draft)** → `POST /v1/contracts` → `contract_id`.  
5. **Client Signs** → `PUT /v1/contracts/{{id}}/sign` (`CLIENT`).  
6. **Fund Escrow**: choose method; optionally fund **first milestone** only. → `POST /v1/escrow/fund`.  
7. **Freelancer Signs** (prompted via notification).  
8. **Activation Gate** passes (CLIENT_SIGNED + FUNDED + FREELANCER_SIGNED) → `PUT status ACTIVE`.  
9. **Handoff** to workroom summary (files, milestones, tracking links — detailed in CTR‑2/3/4).

### B) Hourly with authorization (no upfront escrow)
1–5. Same as above except **type = HOURLY** and **no milestones**.  
6. **Authorize Billing**: capture billing authorization (plan‑specific).  
7–8. Signatures captured → **ACTIVE**.  
9. Handoff to time tracking setup (CTR‑4).

---

## 9) Branches & Edge Cases

- **B1 — No Payment Method**: redirect to add method; return to escrow step.  
- **B2 — KYC Required / High‑Risk**: block fund; show checklist (ID, business docs); resume after success.  
- **B3 — Funding Failure**: declined/insufficient; retry or switch method; keep signature state.  
- **B4 — Multi‑Currency**: show FX rate + fee disclosure; confirm before fund.  
- **B5 — Freelancer Declines**: contract remains `CLIENT_SIGNED`; after N hours → auto‑expire & refund escrow.  
- **B6 — Approval Chain**: org requires Billing Admin approval before fund; queue request; SLA countdown.  
- **B7 — Partial Funding**: allow **first milestone only**; block activation until sign+fund conditions met.  
- **B8 — Duplicate Create**: idempotency key prevents second draft when user double‑submits.  
- **B9 — Refund Before Activation**: client cancels → automatic escrow refund to source (minus fees if policy).  
- **B10 — Mobile Offline**: queue signature/funding intent; sync on reconnect; visible state pills.

## 14) Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
- Keyboard access across stepper, sign, and fund buttons; visible focus rings.  
- Agreement preview has **tagged PDF** and “Download” alternative; long text supports screen readers.  
- Error text bound via `aria-describedby`; invalid inputs flagged with `aria-invalid="true"`.  
- Live regions for **status** changes: “Signature captured”, “Escrow funded”.  
- Color not the only indicator; include icons/labels for state chips.

## 15) Performance
- **Targets:** p95 contract create < **500 ms**; fund ack < **3 s**; agreement preview LCP < **2.0 s**.  
- Streaming PDF preview; code‑split sign/fund panels; SWR for escrow status.  
- Optimistic UI on `create` and `sign` with rollback on error; debounce network calls.  
- Cache payment methods (10 min TTL); prefetch escrow after funding to reflect balance quickly.

## 16) Security, Approvals & Audit
- **RBAC:** only contract parties + Billing Admins may view/fund; approvers need `FUND_APPROVE`.  
- **KYC/AML:** block funding until checks pass; store verification references only.  
- **PCI:** card data via PSP tokens; no PAN stored; strict content‑security policies on payment iframe.  
- **Idempotency:** `POST /contracts` and `/escrow/fund` require `Idempotency-Key`.  
- **Audit:** record all transitions (create, sign, fund, activate) with `actor`, diffs, IP, user‑agent.  
- **Privacy:** PII minimized in events; escrow reference tokens only.

## CL‑6 — Workroom · Collaboration & Files**

> **Scope note:** CL‑6 covers **Workroom collaboration** (shared workspace, conversation threads, file sharing/management, activity timeline, lightweight deliverable handoff).  
> It **does not** repeat material already covered in **CTR‑1…CTR‑7**. Specifically:
> - Deliverables & detailed file semantics → **CTR‑2** (do not duplicate)  
> - Milestones flow & releases (fixed) → **CTR‑3** (refer only)  
> - Time tracking diary & screenshots (hourly) → **CTR‑4** (refer only)  
> - Amendments, activity feed internals, templates & SOWs → **CTR‑5/6/7** (refer only)  

## 2) Goal
Provide a **single shared workspace** for clients and freelancers to coordinate work: discuss tasks, exchange files, maintain context via an activity timeline, and hand off deliverables for review — while delegating deep file semantics and payment/release mechanics to CTR‑2/3/4.

## 3) Actor / Persona
- **Primary:** Client (Owner/Admin/Manager), Freelancer (Individual/Agency) — contract participants.  
- **Secondary:** Client Team Members with “Workroom Access”, Compliance reviewers (read‑only).  
- **Out‑of‑scope actors here:** Arbitrators, Financial ops (covered in CL‑9, FIN sections).

## 4) Preconditions & Triggers
**Preconditions**
- Contract is **ACTIVE** (see CL‑5) and both parties have access.  
- Organization policies allow messaging and file exchange for this contract.  
- If required: NDA acknowledged; restricted file types configured.

**Triggers**
- After activation, users enter **Workroom** from contract detail.  
- Push notification deep‑links to a specific thread or file.  
- System posts an automated activity (e.g., “Milestone 1 funded”) and users reply.

---

## 5) Primary Screens (Routes)

**Web (Next.js App Router)**  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/page.tsx` — Workroom home (Threads + Files + Activity).  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/threads/[threadId]/page.tsx` — Focused conversation thread.  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/files/page.tsx` — Files view (grid/list, versions, tags).  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/activity/page.tsx` — Activity timeline with filters.  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/deliverables/page.tsx` — Deliverables summary (handoff → **CTR‑2/3**).

**Mobile (Expo Router)**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId].tsx` — Home (tabs: Chat | Files | Activity).  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId]/thread/[threadId].tsx` — Thread.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId]/files.tsx` — Files.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId]/activity.tsx` — Activity.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId]/deliverables.tsx` — Deliverables roll‑up (links to CTR‑2).

> **Route alignment:** Uses canonical `(workroom)` group. Deep‑links from notifications land on `/thread/...` or `/files` directly.

## 6) System Touchpoints (Microservices & APIs)

**communications‑be — threads & messages**  
- `POST /v1/threads` — create thread `{contract_id, title?, participants?}`  
- `GET /v1/threads?contractId=...` — list threads (with last message).  
- `GET /v1/threads/{id}/messages` — paginated messages.  
- `POST /v1/threads/{id}/messages` — send `{text, attachments[], mentions[]}`  
- `POST /v1/messages/{id}/react` — reactions; `POST /v1/messages/{id}/pin` — pin/unpin.  
- **Realtime:** `WS /realtime` topic `workroom.{contractId}` for message & typing events.

**storage‑be — files & versions (high‑level only; deep semantics in CTR‑2)**  
- `POST /v1/files/upload-url` — presigned URL for chunked upload `{contract_id, kind:'file'|'image'}`  
- `POST /v1/files` — register file `{contract_id, name, size, checksum, tags[]}`  
- `GET /v1/files?contractId=...` — list files; `GET /v1/files/{id}` — metadata & versions.  
- `POST /v1/files/{id}/versions` — add version (server performs virus scan).  
- `POST /v1/files/{id}/share` — adjust access (participants only; no public links by default).

**contracts‑be — context & participants**  
- `GET /v1/contracts/{id}` — context header (title, type, current milestone).  
- `GET /v1/contracts/{id}/participants` — client/freelancer members & roles.  
- `POST /v1/contracts/{id}/pinned` — workroom pins (links/files/messages).

**analytics‑be / audit‑be** — event ingest & immutable trail.  
**admin‑be** — content policy, restricted file types, retention.  
**notifications‑be** — message/file/deliverable notifications & digests.

**Example — send message with file attachment**  
```http
POST /v1/threads/abc/messages
{ "text": "Please review the draft",
  "attachments": ["file_9xz7"],
  "mentions": ["usr_freelancer1"] }
→ 201 { "message_id":"msg_1", "status":"SENT" }
```

**Example — presigned upload**  
```http
POST /v1/files/upload-url
{ "contract_id":"c_123","name":"wireframes.pdf","size":5242880 }
→ 200 { "upload_url":"https://s3/...","file_token":"up_456","chunk_size":5242880 }
```

## 7) Frontend Components & Hooks

**Components (Web)**  
- `WorkroomHeader` — contract context, participants, quick actions (pin, invite team read‑only).  
- `ThreadList` + `ThreadItem` — threads with unread counts, last activity.  
- `ThreadView` — messages (virtualized), composer, emoji/attachments, mentions.  
- `FilesPanel` — grid/list, tag filters, version badges, quick preview, upload dropzone.  
- `ActivityPanel` — event stream (messages, file edits, milestones funded, etc.), filters.  
- `DeliverablesCard` — thin roll‑up of deliverables (detailed flows in **CTR‑2/3**).  
- `PinBar` — pinned items (links/messages/files).

**Components (Mobile)**  
- `ChatThreadMobile`, `ComposerSheet`, `FilePickerSheet` (camera/gallery/doc), `PreviewModal`.  
- `FilesListMobile` — quick tags, offline queued uploads indicator.  
- `ActivityListMobile` — infinite scroll, deep‑links.

**Hooks (shared)**  
- `useWorkroom(contractId)` — context & participants.  
- `useThreads(contractId)` / `useThread(threadId)` — list + messages + realtime.  
- `useUpload(contractId)` — chunked uploads, progress, retry, virus‑scan status.  
- `useFiles(contractId)` — list, versions, tags, preview cache.  
- `usePins(contractId)` — pinned CRUD.  
- `useTimeline(contractId)` — activity fetch & filter.  
- `useMentions(contractId)` — user search, notification hints.

**Empty/Loading States**  
- Empty workroom: CTA to start first thread or upload initial brief.  
- Files: skeleton grid; show “no files yet” with upload dropzone.  
- Activity: no events → explain sources (messages, file edits, milestones).

## 8) Flow — Happy Paths

### HP‑A: Start collaboration (thread + brief)
1. **Enter Workroom** → `WorkroomHeader` loads context/participants.  
2. Click **New Thread** → title “Kickoff”.  
3. Post **Welcome message** + attach project brief (`useUpload` → presigned URL → register file).  
4. Mention `@assignee` to notify.  
5. System posts an **activity event** (“file uploaded”, “thread created”).

### HP‑B: Share & iterate on files
1. Drag‑drop `wireframes.pdf` → upload progress, virus scan, **preview** available.  
2. Add **tags**: `design`, `v1`. Pin file to header.  
3. Later upload new version → `POST /files/{id}/versions` → **version badge** updates; previous remains accessible.  
4. Thread message auto‑links to the file/version; activity timeline reflects both actions.

### HP‑C: Submit a deliverable for review (handoff)
1. Freelancer clicks **Submit Deliverable** from Files/Thread (thin UI) → **hand off to CTR‑2** form.  
2. Client receives **notification** and deep‑link to the deliverable review (CTR‑2).  
3. Result (approved/changes requested) flows back as activity events in CL‑6.

### HP‑D: Organize with pins and timeline
1. Client **pins** “Definition of Done” message + the `v2` design file.  
2. Activity filter set to `files+pins` for the weekly sync; export timeline snapshot (PDF/CSV).

### HP‑E: Mobile quick workflow
1. Open **Chat** tab → dictate voice message → auto‑transcribe to text.  
2. Tap **+** → capture photo of sketch → upload; connection drops → queued; auto‑resume later.  
3. Receive push → tap to open pinned file preview.

---

## 9) Branches & Edge Cases

- **B1: File policy violation** — blocked (type/size); show policy link & allowed list.  
- **B2: Virus detected** — quarantine file; notify uploader & other party; allow resubmit new version.  
- **B3: Permission error** — team member without Workroom access sees read‑only; upload disabled.  
- **B4: Realtime disconnect** — fall back to polling; show reconnection banner.  
- **B5: Message content flagged** — policy scanner blocks; editable draft remains.  
- **B6: Version conflict** — simultaneous uploads; server serializes versions; UI shows both with timestamps.  
- **B7: Large file (>2GB)** — force chunked multipart; resume via `upload_id`.  
- **B8: External reviewers** — org policy may enable **temporary view‑only links** (time‑boxed; watermark); default **off**.  
- **B9: Timezone & scheduling** — meeting links created in thread (integration optional) — activity records link, not calendar details.  
- **B10: Retention/Deletion** — files subject to retention policy; delete = soft delete with audit; recover within window.

## 14) Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
- Chat: semantic list for messages; **aria‑live** polite for new messages; keyboard focus preserved on new content.  
- Files: keyboard navigable grid/list with visible focus; preview reader‑friendly (text layer/alt text).  
- Mentions & reactions are accessible via keyboard and aria labels.  
- Color not sole indicator: pins & version badges include icon + text.  
- Motion reduced for large streams; respect OS reduced‑motion.

---

## 15) Performance
- **Realtime** over WebSocket; fall back to SSE/polling.  
- **Uploads:** chunked (e.g., 5–10 MB), parallel chunks, resume with `upload_id`; server‑side antivirus async with quarantine UI.  
- **Lists:** virtualized threads/messages; image thumbnails cached (CDN).  
- **Prefetch:** contract context/participants and last 20 messages on enter; lazy fetch older.  
- **Targets:** p95 message send ack < **250 ms**; file upload throughput ≥ **20 MB/s** on fast networks; activity filter < **400 ms**.

---

## 16) Security, Policy & Audit
- **RBAC:** only contract participants and permitted client team members can access Workroom; file share defaults to **participants‑only**.  
- **RLS** on messages/files by `contract_id`; all operations audited (create, read, update, delete).  
- **Content safety:** message & file name scanning; block high‑risk content; virus scanning on all uploads.  
- **Encryption:** files at rest (KMS) + in transit; signed URLs with short TTL; watermark previews if policy requires.  
- **Retention:** org‑configurable data retention & legal hold; export on request (GDPR).  
- **Idempotency:** message send & upload register endpoints accept idempotency keys to prevent duplicates.

## CL‑7 — Timesheets (Hourly) — *Review → Approve/Dispute → Process Payment → Analytics*

> **Scope note:** CL‑7 is the **client-side** journey for **reviewing, approving, disputing, and processing weekly timesheets** for **Hourly** contracts.  
> It **does not** repeat what’s already covered in **CTR‑4** (time capture, diary, screenshots upload, tracker UX) or **CTR‑2/3** (deliverables/milestones). Where needed, those are referenced.

## 2) Goal
Give clients a fast, auditable way to **review weekly time**, **approve or dispute hours** (fully or partially), and **trigger payment processing**, with optional **screenshot verification** and **team-level analytics**.

## 3) Actor / Persona
- **Primary:** Client Owner / Client Admin / Hiring Manager (approver).  
- **Secondary:** Freelancer (submitter), Finance/AP (billing oversight), Compliance (policy checks).

## 4) Preconditions & Triggers
**Preconditions**
- Contract is **ACTIVE** and of type **HOURLY** (CL‑5 result).  
- Time has been **tracked and submitted** by freelancer (CTR‑4 covers tracking mechanics).  
- Org policy for **auto‑approval window** (e.g., N days after period end) configured.  
- If screenshots required: capture policy is **ON** for the contract/org.

**Triggers**
- Weekly timesheet period ends (e.g., Mon–Sun); system creates a **review task** for approvers.  
- Approver opens **Timesheets** overview or a **contract’s timesheet** directly from Workroom.  
- Notification for **“Timesheet submitted”** or **“Auto‑approval impending”**.

---

## 5) Primary Screens (Routes)

**Web (Next.js App Router)**  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/timesheet/page.tsx` — Contract timesheet (current week view).  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/timesheet/[week]/page.tsx` — Specific week details.  
- `(billing)/timesheets/page.tsx` — Org overview (all contracts, filters, bulk approve).  
- `(billing)/timesheets/[week]/page.tsx` — Weekly roll‑up across contracts.  
- `(billing)/timesheets/reports/page.tsx` — Exports & analytics drill‑downs.  
- `(contracts)/[contractId]/disputes/new?pageFrom=timesheet` — Start dispute (handoff to **CL‑9**).

**Mobile (Expo Router)**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId]/timesheet.tsx` — Contract timesheet (tabs: Week | Screenshots | Notes).  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(billing)/timesheets/index.tsx` — Org overview (filters, bulk).  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(billing)/timesheets/[week].tsx` — Weekly details view.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(contracts)/[contractId]/dispute.tsx` — Dispute launcher.

> **Route alignment:** Uses canonical `(workroom)` for contract scope and `(billing)` for cross‑contract operations.

## 6) System Touchpoints (Microservices & APIs)

**contracts‑be (hourly worklogs & timesheets)**  
- `GET /v1/contracts/{id}/timesheets?week=YYYY‑WW` — fetch period summary (by day, total, caps).  
- `GET /v1/contracts/{id}/worklogs?from&to` — granular entries for drill‑down.  
- `PUT /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/approve` — approve all or selected entries.  
- `POST /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/dispute` — create dispute for sub‑set with reasons (→ **CL‑9**).  
- `POST /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/comment` — approver notes (visible to freelancer).  
- `GET /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/screenshots?day=YYYY‑MM‑DD` — signed URLs (if enabled).

**financial‑be (billing & payouts)**  
- `POST /v1/billing/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/invoice` — queue invoice/payment after approval.  
- `GET /v1/billing/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/status` — processing state (queued/paid/held).  
- `POST /v1/billing/holds` — place/remove hold for disputed amount.

**storage‑be (artifacts)**  
- `GET /v1/artifacts/{screenshot_id}` — signed URL download/preview (watermark if policy).

**admin‑be / policies**  
- `GET /v1/policies/timesheets` — auto‑approval SLA, min description per block, screenshot requirement, weekly caps.

**notifications‑be**  
- Send events: submitted, reminder, approved, disputed, paid.

**analytics‑be**  
- Event ingestion (see §13).

**Example — approve subset**  
```http
PUT /v1/timesheets/ts_9ab/approve
{ "approve_entries": ["we_001","we_002"], "comment": "Approved 6h; disputing Friday." }
→ 200 { "approved_hours": 6.0, "pending_hours": 2.0 }
```

**Example — create dispute (handoff)**  
```http
POST /v1/timesheets/ts_9ab/dispute
{ "entries": ["we_003","we_004"], "reason_code": "insufficient_description", "note": "Please expand notes." }
→ 201 { "dispute_id": "dp_77z", "status": "OPEN" }
```

## 7) Frontend Components & Hooks

**Components (Web)**  
- `TimesheetWeekHeader` — contract, week picker, status chips (Submitted/Approved/Disputed/Auto‑approve in Nh).  
- `TimesheetGrid` — day columns (Mon–Sun), entry rows, totals, caps, inline notes.  
- `ScreenshotSampler` — per‑day carousel/grid with zoom; redaction overlay if policy.  
- `ApproverToolbar` — Approve All / Approve Selected / Dispute Selected / Comment.  
- `OrgTimesheetsTable` — cross‑contract list with filters (assignee, status, hours, caps), bulk actions.  
- `ExportBar` — CSV/PDF export with chosen columns.

**Mobile Components**  
- `TimesheetWeekMobile` (summary cards), `ScreenshotsMobile` (swipe gallery), `ApproveBar` (sticky CTA).

**Hooks**  
- `useTimesheet(contractId, week)` — fetch + cache summary & entries.  
- `useScreenshots(contractId, week)` — lazy load thumbs, signed URLs on demand.  
- `useApprove(timesheetId)` / `useDispute(timesheetId)` — mutations with optimistic UI.  
- `useOrgTimesheets(filters)` — overview & bulk actions.  
- `usePolicies()` — reads auto‑approval SLA and requirements.

**Validation & State**  
- Prevent approval if entries breach **min description** policy.  
- Enforce weekly **cap** (e.g., 40h) — excess hours highlighted; auto‑approve never exceeds cap.  
- Idempotency key included in approve/dispute calls.

---

## 8) Flow — Happy Paths

### HP‑A: Approve a contract’s weekly timesheet
1. Open `(workroom)/[contractId]/timesheet` → current week loads with totals and status.  
2. Skim **TimesheetGrid**; open **ScreenshotSampler** for spot checks (policy‑driven).  
3. Add **comment** (“All good”) → `POST /comment`.  
4. Click **Approve All** → `PUT /approve` → status `APPROVED`.  
5. System queues **invoice/payment** → `POST /billing/timesheets/{id}/invoice` → status `QUEUED` then `PAID` later.

### HP‑B: Partial approval with dispute
1. Select Friday entries lacking details; click **Dispute Selected**.  
2. Choose **reason code** (“insufficient_description”), add note.  
3. System creates **dispute** (CL‑9) and places a **hold** for disputed amount.  
4. Remaining entries → **Approve Selected** → immediate invoice for approved portion.  
5. Activity timeline reflects decisions; freelancer notified with dispute details.

### HP‑C: Bulk approve across contracts
1. Go to `(billing)/timesheets/[week]` → filter `Submitted`, contract tags `frontend`.  
2. Spot check screenshots in modal (sample 1 per hour).  
3. **Approve N timesheets** → bulk progress with per‑contract outcomes; CSV of failures.

### HP‑D: Auto‑approval window
1. Approver inactive; SLA (e.g., 5 days after week end) elapses.  
2. System auto‑approves compliant entries up to **weekly cap**; non‑compliant (policy breaches) remain **PENDING**.  
3. Notifications summarize actions; payment queue created accordingly.

---

## 9) Branches & Edge Cases

- **B1: Over‑cap hours** — Cap applied; approver can override if role allows; override audited.  
- **B2: Missing screenshots (required)** — Entries flagged; cannot auto‑approve; manual approval allowed with reason (audited).  
- **B3: Timezone differences** — Entries normalized to contract timezone; per‑day split handled server‑side.  
- **B4: Rounding policy** — 5, 6, or 15‑minute increments; UI displays both raw and rounded totals.  
- **B5: Duplicate entries** — Idempotency + server de‑dup; UI shows warning.  
- **B6: Payment hold** — Finance places org hold; invoice queued but held until cleared.  
- **B7: Screenshot redaction** — Sensitive regions auto‑blurred per policy; approver can request unredacted with justification (audited).  
- **B8: Offline mobile** — Approvals queued; sync on reconnection with conflict resolution.  
- **B9: Reopen after approval** — Allowed within X hours; creates **adjustment** entry and notifies freelancer.  
- **B10: Multi‑contract agency** — Agency manager submits single weekly sheet; approver sees per‑member breakdown.

## 1) CL‑9 — Disputes & Resolution — *Raise → Evidence → Mediate → Decide → Settle*

> **Scope note:** CL‑9 defines the **end‑to‑end dispute & resolution experience** for clients (and counterpart visibility for freelancers).  
> It **does not** duplicate Section E details already documented in **CTR‑2/3/4/6** (deliverables, milestones, hourly time capture, activity feed internals).  
> CL‑9 focuses on: *escalation from CL‑6/CL‑7, evidence submission, mediation workflow, decisions, refunds/holds, resolution tracking.*


## 2) Goal
Provide a fair, auditable, and timely process to **resolve conflicts** on fixed or hourly contracts, with **structured evidence**, **policy‑aware mediation**, **funds holds/refunds**, and **transparent outcomes**.

## 3) Actor / Persona
- **Primary (Client side):** Client Owner/Admin/Manager (opens disputes, submits evidence, proposes settlement).  
- **Secondary (Counterparty):** Freelancer/Agency (responds, adds evidence, counter‑proposal).  
- **Mediation:** Skillsier Mediator/Compliance (assigned when policy or parties request).  
- **Financial ops (system):** Holds, refunds, chargebacks, payout adjustments.

## 4) Preconditions & Triggers
**Preconditions**
- Contract is **ACTIVE** (CL‑5) or **SUSPENDED** (optional) and within dispute‑eligible window.  
- Funds are **in escrow** (fixed) or **pending invoice** (hourly).  
- Org has accepted dispute policy and allowed categories.

**Triggers**
- From **CL‑7 Timesheets**: Approver disputes selected hourly entries.  
- From **CL‑6 Workroom** / **CTR‑2 Deliverables**: Client rejects deliverable and escalates to dispute.  
- Automated trigger: chargeback alert or ToS violation flag (system opens case).

---

- `(mobile)/(app)/(billing)/holds.tsx` — Holds list (read‑only for most roles).

> **Route alignment:** Dispute UIs live under `(contracts)`; cross‑contract financial effects under `(billing)`.

## 6) System Touchpoints (Microservices & APIs)

**contracts‑be — disputes core**  
- `POST /v1/contracts/{id}/disputes` — open dispute.  
- `GET /v1/contracts/{id}/disputes` — list.  
- `GET /v1/disputes/{dispute_id}` — details & timeline.  
- `POST /v1/disputes/{id}/evidence` — upload evidence metadata (files via storage, link references).  
- `POST /v1/disputes/{id}/message` — structured messages (position statements).  
- `POST /v1/disputes/{id}/offer` — settlement offer `{amount, currency, terms}`.  
- `POST /v1/disputes/{id}/accept` | `POST /v1/disputes/{id}/reject` — resolve via mutual agreement.  
- `POST /v1/disputes/{id}/escalate` — request mediator assignment.  
- `POST /v1/disputes/{id}/decision` — mediator decision (authorized role).  
- `GET /v1/disputes/{id}/status` — status & deadlines.

**financial‑be — money movement**  
- `POST /v1/billing/holds` — create/remove hold (hourly/escrow).  
- `POST /v1/escrow/release` — partial/full release to freelancer.  
- `POST /v1/escrow/refund` — partial/full refund to client.  
- `POST /v1/payouts/adjustment` — clawback/adjust payout (if needed).  
- `GET /v1/billing/transactions?disputeId=...` — ledger.

**storage‑be — evidence**  
- `POST /v1/files/upload-url` (kind:`evidence`) → `POST /v1/files` register; AV scan; immutable hash.

**admin‑be — policy & SLA**  
- `GET /v1/policies/disputes` — windows, categories, evidence min set, redaction rules.  
- `POST /v1/mediators/assign` — assign mediator; SLA clock start.

**notifications‑be**  
- Dispute opened/response required/offer proposed/decision posted/payout executed.

**analytics‑be / audit‑be**  
- Events + immutable decision/audit trail.

**Example — open fixed dispute**  
```http
POST /v1/contracts/c_123/disputes
{ "type":"FIXED", "milestone_id":"m_1", "reason_code":"quality_issue",
  "summary":"Design assets not following brief", "requested_refund":1500,
  "evidence_ids":["file_ab1","file_ab2"] }
→ 201 { "dispute_id":"dp_77z","status":"OPEN","hold_id":"hold_9k3" }
```

**Example — hourly dispute from timesheet**  
```http
POST /v1/contracts/c_456/disputes
{ "type":"HOURLY", "timesheet_id":"ts_9ab",
  "entries":["we_003","we_004"], "reason_code":"insufficient_description" }
→ 201 { "dispute_id":"dp_11q","status":"OPEN","hold_id":"hold_2p9" }
```

## 7) Frontend Components & Hooks

**Web Components**  
- `DisputeWizard` — type selection (Fixed/Hourly) → reason → scope (milestone/entries) → evidence → summary.  
- `DisputeHeader` — status chips (OPEN | MEDIATION | DECIDED | SETTLED), clocks, amounts held.  
- `DisputeTimeline` — messages, evidence uploads, offers, system events (holds, decisions).  
- `EvidenceGallery` — previews, versions, redact overlay (policy), hash & AV badges.  
- `OfferPanel` — propose/accept/reject offer, counters, e‑signature for agreements.  
- `DecisionPanel` — decision view (amounts, rationale), settlement execution state.  
- `FinancialEffectsCard` — holds, refunds, releases, ledger links.

**Mobile Components**  
- `DisputeWizardMobile`, `TimelineMobile`, `EvidenceSheet`, `OfferSheet`.

**Hooks (shared)**  
- `useDisputes(contractId)` / `useDispute(disputeId)` — data & SSE for live updates.  
- `useEvidence(disputeId)` — presigned uploads, progress, AV status.  
- `useOffers(disputeId)` — create/accept/counter.  
- `usePolicy('disputes')` — SLA windows, categories, redaction defaults.  
- `useFinancialEffects(disputeId)` — hold/refund/release (read‑only for clients).

**State & Validation**  
- Require at least **one evidence item** for certain reasons per policy.  
- Prevent duplicate disputes for identical scope (same milestone/entries).  
- Idempotency keys for **open**, **offer**, **decision** mutations.

---

## 8) Flow — Happy Paths

### HP‑A: Fixed‑price deliverable dispute → mediated partial refund
1. Client from Deliverable review (CTR‑2) clicks **Escalate to Dispute**. Wizard opens prefilled with milestone.  
2. Client selects **reason** + uploads annotated evidence (brief excerpts, screenshots).  
3. System **holds** escrow amount for the disputed scope.  
4. Freelancer posts counter‑evidence; client & freelancer exchange **offers**.  
5. Parties **escalate to mediation**; mediator reviews evidence & timeline.  
6. **Decision**: partial refund $1,000 back to client; $500 released to freelancer.  
7. `financial‑be` executes **refund** + **release**, timeline updates. Case `DECIDED` → `SETTLED`.

### HP‑B: Hourly timesheet partial dispute from CL‑7
1. From Timesheet view, client disputes 2 entries; CL‑7 calls `POST /disputes`.  
2. System places a **hold** for those hours; remaining approved hours are **invoiced**.  
3. Freelancer clarifies notes; client **accepts offer** to pay 50% of disputed hours.  
4. Hold partially released → invoice adjustment; dispute `SETTLED` mutually.

### HP‑C: Auto‑resolve after SLA
1. Client opens dispute; freelancer does not respond within N days.  
2. Policy auto‑resolution triggers: **refund** of held amount to client.  
3. Notifications & ledger entries recorded; case closed.

---

## 9) Branches & Edge Cases

- **B1: Duplicate dispute scope** — blocked with link to existing case.  
- **B2: Out‑of‑window** — creation blocked; show policy window and suggest non‑dispute remediation (workroom chat).  
- **B3: Evidence violation** — file contains PII/malware; quarantined; user prompted to re‑upload redacted.  
- **B4: Chargeback** — external chargeback opens **linked dispute**; payouts **held** pending outcome.  
- **B5: Currency mismatch** — decision in contract currency; refunds/adjustments handled with FX at settlement time.  
- **B6: Arbitration** — severe cases escalate to **Arbitration** stage; mediator assigns external arbitrator; timelines extended.  
- **B7: Confidential evidence** — visible to mediator only; counterparty sees redacted summary.  
- **B8: Legal hold** — retention override; deletion disabled; watermark on downloads.  
- **B9: Partial milestone already released** — only remaining escrow is holdable; show remaining amount; may require **payout clawback** if policy allows.  
- **B10: Mobile offline** — wizard supports offline drafting of summary/evidence references; submit on reconnect.

## CL‑10 — Close, Review & Rehire — *Complete → Review → Testimonial → Rehire → Archive*

> **Scope note:** CL‑10 focuses on **end‑of‑contract wrap‑up for clients**: close contract, leave feedback, request testimonial, and rehire.  
> It **does not** repeat underlying lifecycle details already in **CTR‑1** (state machine & closure rules), nor delivery/time capture in **CTR‑2/3/4**, nor deep notification/feed internals in **CTR‑6**. It references those sections where needed.

## 2) Goal
Provide a clear, policy‑aware client flow to **finish work cleanly**, ensure all **payments** are settled, collect **ratings & feedback** that drive marketplace trust, optionally **request a testimonial**, and enable **rehire** paths without friction — finishing with **archive** for tidy records.

## 3) Actor / Persona
- **Primary:** Client Owner / Client Admin / Hiring Manager (initiates close & review).  
- **Secondary:** Freelancer/Agency (acks closure, writes counter‑review), Finance (final funds), Compliance (policy).

## 4) Preconditions & Triggers
**Preconditions**
- Contract is **ACTIVE** or **READY_TO_CLOSE** with:  
  - Fixed: all milestones **approved & released** (or marked complete) — see CTR‑3.  
  - Hourly: last timesheet **approved** (or auto‑approved) — see CTR‑4.  
- **No open disputes** blocking closure (see CL‑9).  
- Org policy allows closure (e.g., minimum review requirement off/on).

**Triggers**
- Client presses **Close Contract** on contract page/workroom header.  
- System prompts closure after final approval (nudge).  
- Budget exhausted or end date reached → reminder to close.

## 6) System Touchpoints (Microservices & APIs)

**contracts‑be**  
- `GET /v1/contracts/{id}` — status, type, totals, pending checks.  
- `POST /v1/contracts/{id}/close/checks` — server validation (disputes, unpaid items, approvals).  
- `PUT /v1/contracts/{id}/close` — transition to `CLOSED` (with reason & metadata).  
- `POST /v1/contracts/{id}/archive` — archive/unarchive toggles.

**financial‑be**  
- `POST /v1/escrow/release` — release any remaining fixed escrow (if applicable).  
- `POST /v1/billing/finalize` — finalize hourly payouts for last period.  
- `GET /v1/billing/summary?contractId=...` — outstanding amounts/holds.  

**reviews‑be**  
- `POST /v1/reviews` — submit rating & feedback `{{from_user, to_user, contract_id, rating, comment, tags[]}}`.  
- `GET /v1/reviews/window?contractId=...` — time left to submit/edit.  
- `POST /v1/testimonials/request` — send testimonial request (off‑platform friendly).  
- `POST /v1/testimonials/record` — store received testimonial & link to profile (moderation).

**notifications‑be**  
- Close prompt, review reminders, testimonial requests, rehire nudges.

**analytics‑be / audit‑be**  
- Events + immutable audit trail (close, review, testimonial, archive).

---

## 7) Frontend Components & Hooks

**Components (Web)**  
- `CloseContractWizard` — steps: Checks → Review → Testimonial → Rehire → Archive.  
- `ClosureChecksCard` — unpaid items, disputes, final tips, last message prompt.  
- `ReviewForm` — star rating, public feedback, private feedback to Skillsier, skill tags.  
- `TestimonialRequest` — email/name fields (optional), preview, send.  
- `RehirePanel` — options: Invite to job, New job from contract, Direct contract (if policy).  
- `ArchivePanel` — archive toggle, retention summary, download artifacts link.  
- `ProgressToast` — async transitions (close, submit review).

**Mobile components**  
- `CloseWizardMobile`, `ReviewFormMobile`, `RehireSheet`, `ArchiveSwitch`.

**Hooks**  
- `useClosure(contractId)` — pulls checks, drives step gating.  
- `useReview(contractId, toUser)` — submit/edit review.  
- `useTestimonial()` — request/record flows.  
- `useRehire(contractId, freelancerId)` — create invite/new job.  
- `useArchive(contractId)` — archive toggle.  

**Validation**  
- Prevent `close` if server checks fail; CTA shows blocking items.  
- Review rating required (configurable min length for comment).  
- Testimonial request limited by policy (frequency, consent).

---

## 8) Flow — Happy Paths

### HP‑A: Fixed‑price contract — clean close with review & rehire
1. **Start**: Client clicks **Close Contract** → `CloseContractWizard` loads checks.  
2. **Checks pass**: no disputes, escrow $0, all milestones approved/released.  
3. **Review**: client posts `5★`, public comment, private note, skill tags.  
4. **Testimonial**: request sent to freelancer’s client stakeholder (optional).  
5. **Rehire**: choose **New job from contract** → opens `(jobs)/new/from-contract/[id]` prefilled with skills/rate.  
6. **Archive**: toggle **Archive Contract** → hides from active lists; still searchable.  
7. **Close**: `PUT /close` → contract becomes `CLOSED`; feed & notifications fire.

### HP‑B: Hourly contract — finalize last week then close
1. **Checks** reveal **pending hourly period** → CTA **Finalize last week** opens Timesheet (CL‑7).  
2. After approval & billing finalize, back to wizard → checks now pass.  
3. Proceed with **Review**, optional **Testimonial**, **Rehire**, **Archive**, then **Close**.

### HP‑C: Close from Workroom prompt
1. After final delivery approval (CTR‑2), banner suggests closing.  
2. Click **Close** → wizard; quick **Review**; **Invite to existing job** selected for rehire.  
3. Close completes; Workroom becomes read‑only; archive optional.

---

## 9) Branches & Edge Cases

- **B1: Open dispute** — `checks` blocks close; link to CL‑9 case; allow “Close after settlement” automation.  
- **B2: Remaining escrow** — wizard offers **Release now** or **Refund** (per policy) before closing.  
- **B3: Auto‑close** — after N days of inactivity & paid out; sends reminders; auto‑closes with neutral feedback window.  
- **B4: Dual‑blind reviews** — reviews hidden until both sides submit or window ends (then revealed).  
- **B5: Edit window** — review editable for X hours; after lock, only report abuse/moderation path.  
- **B6: Testimonial bounce** — external request undeliverable; resend or share link (expires).  
- **B7: Compliance wording** — profanity/PII filters on public comment; ask to edit before submit.  
- **B8: Archive undo** — unarchive restores to recent list; respects retention.  
- **B9: Agency rehire** — pick **member** to rehire; panel lists available agency members.  
- **B10: Multi‑currency** — review unaffected; rehire job currency defaults to client org.

## 15) Performance
- Prefetch checks & review window on entering wizard; lazy load testimonial panel.  
- Optimistic UI on review submit; rollback on moderation failure.  
- Cache templates for **rehire new job** form to render < 400 ms.  
- Targets: close checks < **300 ms**; review submit ack < **400 ms**.

## 16) Security, Policy & Audit
- **RBAC:** only contract client roles may close; freelancer cannot force close (they can **request close**).  
- **Moderation:** public feedback passes profanity/PII filters; quarantine if failed; show “needs edit”.  
- **Idempotency:** close, review submit, testimonial request all require idempotency keys.  
- **Audit:** immutable records for checks, close, review, testimonial, archive with actor/IP/UA.  
- **Privacy:** private note stored confidentially (not shown to counterparty).  
- **Retention:** archive affects visibility only; data retained per org policy & legal hold.

## FR‑5 — Accept Contract & Start Work — *Review → Sign → Ready → Begin*


> **Scope note:** FR‑5 is the **freelancer‑side** journey that starts when a client issues an offer/contract (from CL‑5) and ends when the freelancer is **ready to work**.  
> It covers: **review contract → e‑signature → readiness checks → work diary setup (hourly) → begin first deliverable (fixed).**  
> It **does not** duplicate: CTR‑2/3 (deliverables & milestones details), CTR‑4 (time tracker UX, diary internals), CTR‑6 (activity feed internals). FR‑6 handles **Delivery/Timesheets** after work begins.


## 2) Goal
Enable freelancers to **understand terms**, **sign electronically**, and complete any **policy or tooling setup** (KYC, device/tracker binding) so the contract can **activate** and the freelancer can **start work immediately** with confidence.

## 3) Actor / Persona
- **Primary:** Freelancer / Agency Manager (accepts contract).  
- **Secondary:** Client (notified upon sign/activation), Billing Admin (hourly authorization visibility), System (KYC, policy gates).

## 4) Preconditions & Triggers
**Preconditions**
- Offer created from CL‑5 → `CONTRACT` exists with state `AWAITING_FREELANCER_SIGNATURE` or `AWAITING_SIGNATURES`.  
- For **Fixed**: client typically has funded escrow for first milestone (activation requires both sign + fund).  
- For **Hourly**: client’s billing authorization is set per org policy.  

**Triggers**
- Push/email **“Offer available — review & sign”** deep‑link to contract.  
- Opening contract from **Inbox/Workroom/Contracts list**.  
- System reminder when offer approaches **expiry**.

---

## 5) Primary Screens (Routes)

**Web (Next.js App Router)**  
- `(contracts)/[contractId]/accept/page.tsx` — Offer & Agreement review, **Sign** CTA, readiness checklist.  
- `(contracts)/[contractId]/page.tsx` — Contract overview (status chips, “Go to Workroom”).  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/page.tsx` — Workroom home (Chat | Files | Activity).  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/timesheet/setup/page.tsx` — Hourly diary quick setup (policy summary, device binding).  
- `(tools)/tracker/download/page.tsx` — Desktop tracker download & pairing (if required by policy).  
- `(profile)/compliance/kyc/page.tsx` — KYC tasks if needed.

**Mobile (Expo Router)**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(contracts)/[contractId]/accept.tsx` — Compact accept screen (agreement preview + Sign).  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId].tsx` — Workroom (tabs).  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId]/timesheet-setup.tsx` — Hourly setup.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(tools)/tracker.tsx` — Mobile tracker pairing or web timer enable.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(profile)/kyc.tsx` — KYC tasks.

> **Route alignment:** Uses canonical `(contracts)`, `(workroom)`, `(tools)`, `(profile)` groups from the combined FE structure.

## 6) System Touchpoints (Microservices & APIs)

**contracts‑be**  
- `GET /v1/contracts/{id}` — hydrate agreement (type, rate/budget, IP/NDA, terms).  
- `PUT /v1/contracts/{id}/sign` — record freelancer e‑signature `{role:'FREELANCER'}`.  
- `GET /v1/contracts/{id}/readiness` — server gate summary `{kyc_ok, client_funded, hourly_authorized, device_ok}`.  
- `PUT /v1/contracts/{id}/activate` — transition when all gates satisfied (system‑driven normally).  
- `POST /v1/contracts/{id}/tracker/devices` — register tracker device `{device_id, os, version}` (if required).

**financial‑be**  
- `GET /v1/escrow/{contract_id}` — check fixed funding status.  
- `GET /v1/billing/authorization?contractId=...` — hourly authorization status.

**admin‑be / compliance**  
- `GET /v1/kyc/status` — verification tasks; `POST /v1/kyc/submit` — submission.

**notifications‑be**  
- Offer available, sign completion, activation, missing setup reminders.

**analytics‑be / audit‑be**  
- Event capture & immutable audit (see §13/§16).

## 7) Frontend Components & Hooks

**Components (Web)**  
- `OfferSummary` — rate/budget, schedule, IP/NDA, termination, jurisdiction.  
- `AgreementPreview` — scrollable PDF with “open in new tab” & download.  
- `ReadinessChecklist` — KYC • Funding • Authorization • Device • Policy Acknowledgments.  
- `SignPanelFreelancer` — sign capture, signature style, legal consent checkbox.  
- `WorkDiarySetup` (hourly) — tracker download/pair, timezone, screenshot frequency info, idle detection toggle.  
- `StartWorkCTA` — deep‑link to Workroom + first task/deliverable.

**Mobile Components**  
- `AcceptContractMobile`, `AgreementSheet`, `ChecklistMobile`, `SetupDiaryMobile`.

**Hooks**  
- `useContract(contractId)` / `useReadiness(contractId)` — compute activation gate.  
- `useSign(contractId)` — sign mutation with optimistic chip update.  
- `useTrackerBinding(contractId)` — device register & health.  
- `useKyc()` — compliance tasks.  
- `useWorkroomLaunch(contractId)` — post‑activation navigation logic.

**State & Validation**  
- Require “I agree to the terms” checkbox.  
- Block **Start Work** until activation state = `ACTIVE`.  
- Idempotency headers on sign & device register to prevent duplicates.

---

## 8) Flow — Happy Paths

### HP‑A: Fixed‑price — Sign after client funds → start first deliverable
1. Open **Accept Offer** → review **OfferSummary** & **AgreementPreview**.  
2. `ReadinessChecklist` shows **Funding ✓** (client already funded first milestone).  
3. Click **Sign as Freelancer** → `PUT /sign` → signature captured.  
4. Backend auto‑**activates** contract (**CLIENT_SIGNED + FUNDED + FREELANCER_SIGNED**).  
5. **Start Work** → navigates to `(workroom)/[contractId]` → CTA **“Submit Milestone 1 plan”** (handoff to CTR‑2/3).

### HP‑B: Hourly — Sign + work diary setup
1. Accept screen shows hourly rate & weekly cap; sign the agreement.  
2. Checklist shows **Authorization ✓** (client side), **Device ✗**.  
3. Click **Set up Work Diary** → choose **Desktop tracker** or **Web Timer**; register device via `POST /tracker/devices`.  
4. Quick test capture (CTR‑4 handles full capture workflow); readiness flips to **✓**.  
5. Contract **activates**; **Start Work** → Workroom opens with “Start tracking” banner.

### HP‑C: Agency acceptance with assignee
1. Agency manager signs; wizard prompts **Assign member** (optional).  
2. Choose member → Workroom shows **Assignees**; begin work.  
3. Member receives notification & deep‑link.

---

## 9) Branches & Edge Cases

- **B1: Client not funded (fixed)** — readiness shows **Funding ✗**; advise client; allow **Notify Client** action.  
- **B2: KYC required** — block sign until basic KYC submitted; progress persists; return to accept after completion.  
- **B3: Terms changed** — server requires re‑scroll & re‑sign; old signature superseded, audit trail preserved.  
- **B4: Device blocked** — outdated tracker or rooted environment; show remediation.  
- **B5: Timezone** — diary timezone differs from contract; enforce explicit confirm.  
- **B6: Idle detection restricted** — OS privacy prompt fails; allow Web Timer fallback.  
- **B7: Offer expiry** — banner shows countdown; after expiry, accept disabled; route back to client chat.  
- **B8: Offline mobile** — allow offline reading; sign queues with timestamp & device attestation; server validates on sync.  
- **B9: Agency multiple assignees** — policy may limit to one active assignee; UI enforces.  
- **B10: Accessibility alternative** — provide **No‑screenshot** mode request for sensitive environments (policy‑gated).
