## FR‑6 — Delivery (Fixed) / Timesheets (Hourly) — *Produce → Submit → Respond → Complete*

> **Scope note:** FR‑6 is the **freelancer‑side** journey for **doing and submitting work** once FR‑5 (Accept & Start Work) is complete.  
> • **Fixed‑Price:** preparing & submitting deliverables for client review, handling feedback & resubmissions.  
> • **Hourly:** tracking time (CTR‑4 owns capture UX), adding notes & artifacts, **submitting weekly timesheets**.  
> This spec **does not duplicate** the deep semantics already defined in **CTR‑2 (Deliverables & Files)**, **CTR‑3 (Milestones)**, or **CTR‑4 (Time Tracking)**. It focuses on freelancer-facing flows, UI, and handoffs.


## 2) Goal
Enable freelancers to confidently **submit work** (files, links, notes) or **submit hours** with policy compliance, communicate with the client in context, and respond to feedback or disputes — with clear status and minimal friction.

## 3) Actor / Persona
- **Primary:** Freelancer / Agency Member (producer & submitter).  
- **Secondary:** Client approver (receives submissions), Agency Manager (reviews member submissions), Finance (payment schedule visibility).

## 4) Preconditions & Triggers
**Preconditions**
- Contract is **ACTIVE** (FR‑5).  
- **Fixed:** Current milestone is **FUNDED** (or policy allows unfunded draft submission).  
- **Hourly:** Tracker enabled or web timer allowed; week in progress or ready to submit.

**Triggers**
- Freelancer clicks **Submit Deliverable** from Workroom.  
- Daily/weekly reminder to **add notes** and **submit timesheet** before cutoff.  
- Client requests **revision** → freelancer notified to resubmit.

---

## 5) Primary Screens (Routes)

**Web (Next.js App Router)**  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/deliverables/new/page.tsx` — New Deliverable form (fixed).  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/deliverables/[deliverableId]/page.tsx` — Deliverable detail (status, revisions).  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/files/page.tsx` — Referenced files (CTR‑2).  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/timesheet/page.tsx` — Current week entries & notes (hourly).  
- `(workroom)/[contractId]/timesheet/submit/page.tsx` — Review & submit week (hourly).

**Mobile (Expo Router)**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId]/deliverables/new.tsx` — New Deliverable.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId]/deliverables/[deliverableId].tsx` — Detail & resubmit.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(workroom)/[contractId]/timesheet.tsx` — Week view with notes & submit.  
- `(mobile)/(app)/(tools)/tracker.tsx` — Tracker pairing/start (CTR‑4 referenced).

> **Route alignment:** Uses `(workroom)` group. Deep links from notifications open deliverable detail or timesheet submit view directly.

## 6) System Touchpoints (Microservices & APIs)

**contracts‑be — deliverables & timesheets (surface)**  
- `POST /v1/contracts/{id}/deliverables` — create deliverable draft `{title, notes, attachments[]}`.  
- `PUT /v1/deliverables/{deliverable_id}/submit` — submit for review.  
- `GET /v1/deliverables/{deliverable_id}` — status, review history, revisions.  
- `POST /v1/deliverables/{id}/resubmit` — resubmission with changes.
- `GET /v1/contracts/{id}/timesheets?week=YYYY‑WW` — current week summary & entries.  
- `PUT /v1/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/submit` — submit week (freelancer action).

**storage‑be — files & artifacts**  
- `POST /v1/files/upload-url` → `POST /v1/files` register, virus scan, checksum; optional versioning.  
- `GET /v1/files/{id}` — metadata & signed download URLs.

**communications‑be — workroom context**  
- `POST /v1/threads/{id}/messages` — post submission note or revision reply (auto-link to deliverable/timesheet).

**financial‑be — effects (read-only for freelancer here)**  
- `GET /v1/escrow/{contract_id}` — milestone funding signal.  
- `GET /v1/billing/timesheets/{timesheet_id}/status` — processing state after client approval.

**notifications‑be** — submission, revision requested, timesheet reminders, approval/changes, paid.

**analytics‑be / audit‑be** — events & immutable trail.

- `useTimesheetWriter(contractId, week)` — entries & submit.  
- `useUploads(contractId)` — presigned URL, progress, AV result.  
- `usePolicyHints(contractId)` — min description per block, screenshot requirement, file restrictions.

**State & Validation**  
- Require at least one **attachment or link** for deliverable (policy‑gated).  
- For hourly submit: warn if **missing notes** or **screenshot compliance** not met (cannot block unless policy).  
- Idempotency key on submit/resubmit to avoid duplicate sends.

---

## 8) Flow — Happy Paths

### HP‑A (Fixed): Submit deliverable, one‑round feedback, approve
1. From Workroom, open **New Deliverable**; attach `design_v2.zip` and add notes.  
2. **Submit** → client notified; deliverable shows `SUBMITTED`.  
3. Client requests **Changes** with inline comments; status `CHANGES_REQUESTED`.  
4. Freelancer updates files → **Resubmit** with change log (“Fixed spacing, compressed images”).  
5. Client **Approves** in CTR‑2; milestone auto‑eligible for release (CTR‑3); freelancer sees **Approved**.

### HP‑B (Hourly): Track → review → submit week
1. Track time during week (CTR‑4).  
2. On Friday, open **TimesheetWeekEditor**: review entries, add per‑day notes, ensure caps respected.  
3. **Submit Week** → status `SUBMITTED`; client notified (CL‑7 flow).  
4. After client **approval**, billing shows `QUEUED` → `PAID`; Workroom timeline reflects payment.

### HP‑C (Agency): Member submits, manager reviews
1. Member drafts deliverable; **Agency Manager** reviews in Workroom, adds comments.  
2. Member **submits**; approval cycle continues as HP‑A.  
3. For hourly, manager pre‑checks notes before submission (optional policy).

---

## 9) Branches & Edge Cases

- **B1: File policy violation** — restricted type/size; block with guidance.  
- **B2: Virus detected** — quarantine; require clean resubmission.  
- **B3: Unfunded milestone** — submission allowed as **DRAFT**; cannot **Submit** until funded (policy).  
- **B4: Late submission** — after milestone due date; show warning; still allowed.  
- **B5: Screenshot requirement (hourly)** — non‑compliant blocks **auto‑approval** (not submission); banner explains.  
- **B6: Over weekly cap** — warn & highlight; still allow submit; client sees over‑cap flag.  
- **B7: Merge versions** — server serializes concurrent file version uploads; UI shows vN with timestamps.  
- **B8: Network/offline** — queue submissions; retries with backoff; preserve attachments on device.  
- **B9: Dispute** — if client disputes (CL‑9), deliverable/timesheet shows **Linked Dispute** banner; follow CL‑9 path.  
- **B10: Withdraw submission** — allowed until client view? (policy); creates new draft state, keeps history.

## 11) Mobile Experience (Patterns)
- Camera/gallery integration for quick artifact capture; background uploads with progress.  
- Offline drafts saved locally; sync on reconnect.  
- Timesheet: swipe per‑day to expand notes; sticky **Submit** bar; spot‑check screenshots (thumbnails).

---

## 12) Notifications
- **Deliverable submitted** → Client & approvers.  
- **Changes requested** → Freelancer with highlights.  
- **Approved** → Freelancer; banner suggests next milestone.  
- **Timesheet due soon** → Reminders at T‑24h/T‑4h before cutoff.  
- **Timesheet approved/paid** → Status update & receipt link.  
- **Dispute opened** → Linked banner & CTA to CL‑9.

All via `notifications‑be`, respecting preferences & throttles.

---

## 13) Analytics (Events & Schemas)
All include `{{ ts, actor_id, org_id, contract_id }}`.

- `deliverable.created.v1` — `{{ deliverable_id, has_attachments }}`  
- `deliverable.submitted.v1` — `{{ deliverable_id, attachments_count }}`  
- `deliverable.resubmitted.v1` — `{{ deliverable_id }}`  
- `timesheet.submitted.v1` — `{{ timesheet_id, hours, notes_completeness }}`  
- `timesheet.reminder.sent.v1` — `{{ week }}`  
- `workroom.comment.posted.v1` — `{{ thread_id, kind:'deliverable'|'timesheet' }}`

**KPIs:** deliverable resubmission rate, review turnaround time, on‑time timesheet submission %, screenshot compliance %, first‑pass approval rate.

---

## 14) Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
- Forms fully keyboard navigable; file inputs labeled; progress bars with `aria-valuenow`.  
- Status chips announced via `aria-live`; focus managed on submit & errors.  
- Timesheet grid described with table semantics; alternatives for screenshot thumbnails (alt text).

---

## 15) Performance
- Uploads: chunked, parallel parts, resume; server AV async with UI polling.  
- Prefetch deliverable templates & DoD checklist; cache week metadata.  
- Virtualize long entry/day lists; debounce notes typing; optimistic submit.  
- Targets: first interaction < **400 ms**; submit ack < **500 ms**; preview open < **600 ms**.

---

## 16) Security, Policy & Audit
- **RBAC/RLS:** Only contract participants may create/submit; agency manager can view members.  
- **Idempotency:** submit/resubmit guarded.  
- **Content safety:** AV, PII redaction tools; file type restrictions per policy.  
- **Audit:** immutable records for submit/resubmit with file hashes.  
- **Privacy:** screenshot handling per CTR‑4 policy; watermark previews if required.

- **CTR‑3** — Milestones (funding & release logic).  
- **CTR‑4** — Time Tracking (capture & screenshots).

# SECTION F: FINANCIALS (FIN-1 through FIN-8), (FR-7, CL-8, FIN-9)

## FIN-1 — Wallet & Balance

**Persona:** Client, Freelancer  
**Journey ID:** FIN-1

### Preconditions & Triggers

- **User authenticated** with verified payment method or payout account
- **Trigger:** User wants to view balance, transaction history, or manage wallet
- **Platform:** Web + Mobile

### Primary Screens (Web + Mobile)

**Web:**
- `/app/(dashboard)/wallet` — Wallet overview
- `/app/(dashboard)/wallet/balance` — Balance details
- `/app/(dashboard)/wallet/transactions` — Transaction history
- `/app/(dashboard)/wallet/topup` — Add funds to wallet
- `/app/(dashboard)/wallet/withdraw` — Withdraw funds

**Mobile:**
- `/app/(tabs)/wallet` — Wallet home
- `/app/(tabs)/wallet/balance` — Balance & transactions
- `/app/(tabs)/wallet/topup` — Add funds
- `/app/(tabs)/wallet/withdraw` — Withdraw

#### System Touchpoints

- **financial-be:** `/wallet/*`, `/balance/*`, `/transactions/*` — Wallet management
- **payment-be:** `/payments/*`, `/payouts/*` — Payment processing (Stripe, PayPal, Wire)
- **contracts-be:** `/escrow/*` — Escrow funds
- **communications-be:** `/notifications/*` — Financial notifications
- **utility-be:** `/audit/*` — Financial audit trail

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

1. **View wallet dashboard:**
   - User navigates to `/app/(dashboard)/wallet`
   - **Wallet dashboard displays:**
     - **Header:**
       - Title: "My Wallet"
       - **Available Balance:** $2,450.00
       - **Pending Balance:** $1,200.00 (in escrow for active contracts)
       - **Total Balance:** $3,650.00
     - **Quick Actions:**
       - ➕ Add Funds
       - 💸 Withdraw
       - 📊 View Transactions
       - ⚙️ Payment Settings
     - **Balance Breakdown:**
       - **Available:** $2,450.00 (can be withdrawn)
       - **In Escrow:** $1,200.00 (locked for 2 active contracts)
       - **Pending Clearance:** $0.00 (payments being processed)
       - **Reserved:** $0.00 (reserved for platform fees, etc.)
     - **Recent Transactions (last 5):**
       - Nov 7, 2:30 PM — ✅ Payment received — +$500 — "Milestone 3 approved"
       - Nov 6, 4:15 PM — 💰 Withdrawal — -$1,000 — "Withdrew to Bank ****1234"
       - Nov 5, 10:00 AM — 🔒 Escrow hold — -$600 — "Contract funded (Project X)"
       - Nov 4, 3:45 PM — ✅ Payment received — +$250 — "Bonus payment"
       - Nov 3, 9:00 AM — 📥 Deposit — +$2,000 — "Added funds via Credit Card"
       - **Link:** "View All Transactions"
     - **Currency:** USD (can change in settings if multi-currency supported)
     - **Wallet ID:** WALLET-ABC123 (for support reference)

2. **View detailed balance:**
   - Click **"Available Balance"** → Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/wallet/balance`
   - **Balance detail page:**
     - **Available Balance: $2,450.00**
       - Description: "Funds available for withdrawal or new contracts"
       - Source breakdown:
         - From completed milestones: $2,000
         - From bonuses/tips: $250
         - From refunds: $200
         - From deposits: $0 (used already)
     - **In Escrow: $1,200.00**
       - Description: "Funds locked for active contracts (released upon milestone approval)"
       - Breakdown by contract:
         - **Contract #1** (Project Alpha) — $600 (Milestone 2 pending approval)
         - **Contract #2** (Project Beta) — $600 (Milestone 1 in progress)
       - **Estimated release date:** Nov 15 (if milestones approved on time)
     - **Pending Clearance: $0.00**
       - Description: "Payments being processed (typically 3-5 business days)"
     - **Reserved: $0.00**
       - Description: "Funds reserved for fees, disputes, or chargebacks"
     - **Graph:** Balance over time (last 30 days)
       - Line chart showing balance fluctuations

3. **View transaction history:**
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/wallet/transactions`
   - **Transaction history page:**
     - **Filters:**
       - **Date Range:** Last 30 days (dropdown: Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last 3 months, Custom)
       - **Transaction Type:** All (dropdown: Payments, Withdrawals, Deposits, Escrow, Refunds, Fees)
       - **Status:** All (dropdown: Completed, Pending, Failed)
       - **Search:** "Search by description or transaction ID"
     - **Transaction list (table view):**
       - **Columns:** Date | Description | Type | Amount | Status | Balance After | Actions
       - **Example rows:**
         | Date | Description | Type | Amount | Status | Balance | Actions |
         |------|-------------|------|--------|--------|---------|---------|
         | Nov 7, 2:30 PM | Milestone 3 approved | Payment In | +$500.00 | ✅ Completed | $2,450 | View Details |
         | Nov 6, 4:15 PM | Withdrew to Bank ****1234 | Withdrawal | -$1,000.00 | ✅ Completed | $1,950 | View Receipt |
         | Nov 5, 10:00 AM | Escrow hold (Project X) | Escrow Out | -$600.00 | 🔒 Locked | $950 | View Contract |
         | Nov 4, 3:45 PM | Bonus payment | Payment In | +$250.00 | ✅ Completed | $1,550 | View Details |
         | Nov 3, 9:00 AM | Added funds via Credit Card | Deposit | +$2,000.00 | ✅ Completed | $1,300 | View Receipt |
     - **Pagination:** 20 transactions per page, "Load More" button or pagination controls
     - **Export:** Button: "Export as CSV" or "Export as PDF" (for accounting purposes)
     - **Total Summary:**
       - Total In (period): +$2,750
       - Total Out (period): -$1,600
       - Net Change: +$1,150

4. **View individual transaction detail:**
   - Click "View Details" on "Milestone 3 approved" transaction
   - **Transaction detail modal:**
     - **Header:**
       - Transaction ID: TXN-987654321
       - Date: Nov 7, 2025, 2:30 PM
       - Status: ✅ Completed
     - **Details:**
       - **Type:** Payment In
       - **Amount:** +$500.00
       - **Description:** "Milestone 3 approved for Contract #5678"
       - **Related To:**
         - **Contract:** "Website Redesign" (#5678) [Link to contract]
         - **Milestone:** Milestone 3 — "Frontend Development"
         - **Client:** John Doe (@johndoe)
       - **Payment Method:** Escrow release (from client's escrowed funds)
       - **Processing Time:** Instant
       - **Platform Fee:** -$25.00 (5% of $500)
       - **Net Amount:** $475.00 (received into wallet)
       - **Balance After:** $2,450.00
     - **Timeline:**
       - Nov 7, 1:00 PM — Milestone submitted by freelancer
       - Nov 7, 2:00 PM — Milestone approved by client
       - Nov 7, 2:30 PM — Payment released from escrow
       - Nov 7, 2:31 PM — Payment credited to freelancer wallet
     - **Actions:**
       - 🖨️ Download Receipt (PDF)
       - 📧 Email Receipt to myself
       - ❓ Contact Support (if issue)

5. **Add funds to wallet (Client):**
   - Client wants to add funds for future contracts
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/wallet/topup`
   - **Add Funds page:**
     - **Amount:**
       - Input field: "$___" (enter amount)
       - Quick amounts: $100 | $500 | $1,000 | $2,500 | $5,000
       - Minimum: $10
     - **Payment Method:**
       - ◉ Credit/Debit Card (Visa ending ****1234) [Primary]
       - ○ PayPal (@user@example.com)
       - ○ Bank Transfer (Add new method)
       - **Link:** "Add New Payment Method"
     - **Fees:**
       - Payment processing fee: $2.90 + 2.9% (e.g., for $500 → $17.45 fee)
       - **Total Charge:** $517.45 (for $500 deposit)
     - **Note:** "Funds will be available immediately in your wallet"
   - Client enters: **$500**
   - Selects: **Credit Card**
   - Clicks **"Add Funds"**
   - **Payment confirmation:**
     - Redirected to payment processor (Stripe) for 3D Secure authentication
     - Enters card CVV: 123
     - Clicks "Confirm Payment"
   - **POST /v1/wallet/deposit:**
     ```json
     {
       "amount": 500,
       "currency": "USD",
       "payment_method_id": "pm_123",
       "payment_method_type": "CREDIT_CARD",
       "user_id": "client_uuid"
     }
     ```
   - Payment processed successfully
   - **Event published:** `wallet.deposit.completed.v1`
   - Redirected back to wallet dashboard
   - **Balance updated:** $2,450 → $2,950
   - **Confirmation notification:** "Successfully added $500 to your wallet"
   - **Email receipt sent**

6. **Withdraw funds (Freelancer):**
   - Freelancer wants to withdraw available balance
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/wallet/withdraw`
   - **Withdraw Funds page:**
     - **Available Balance:** $2,450.00
     - **Amount to Withdraw:**
       - Input field: "$___"
       - Quick options: $500 | $1,000 | All ($2,450)
       - Minimum: $10
       - Maximum: $2,450 (available balance)
     - **Withdrawal Method:**
       - ◉ Bank Account (BOA ****5678) [Primary]
       - ○ PayPal (@freelancer@example.com)
       - ○ Wire Transfer (Add new method)
       - **Link:** "Manage Payout Methods"
     - **Processing Time:**
       - Bank Transfer: 1-3 business days
       - PayPal: Instant (may have fees)
       - Wire: 1-2 business days
     - **Fees:**
       - Bank Transfer: Free (for balances > $50), $2 fee (for balances < $50)
       - PayPal: 1% fee (max $10)
       - Wire: $25 fee
     - **Tax Information:**
       - Note: "Withdrawals are subject to tax reporting (1099 form)"
       - Link: "View Tax Center"
   - Freelancer enters: **$1,000**
   - Selects: **Bank Account**
   - Clicks **"Withdraw"**
   - **Confirmation modal:**
     - "Withdraw $1,000 to Bank ****5678?"
     - "Funds will arrive in 1-3 business days"
     - "No fees applied"
     - **Checkbox:** ☑ "I confirm the withdrawal details are correct"
     - **Button:** "Confirm Withdrawal"
   - Clicks "Confirm Withdrawal"
   - **POST /v1/wallet/withdraw:**
     ```json
     {
       "amount": 1000,
       "currency": "USD",
       "payout_method_id": "pm_789",
       "payout_method_type": "BANK_ACCOUNT",
       "user_id": "freelancer_uuid"
     }
     ```
   - Withdrawal request created
   - **Event published:** `wallet.withdrawal.initiated.v1`
   - **Balance updated:** Available: $2,450 → $1,450 (pending withdrawal shows as -$1,000)
   - **Confirmation:** "Withdrawal request submitted. Funds will arrive in 1-3 business days."
   - **Email notification sent**

7. **Track withdrawal status:**
   - Freelancer checks withdrawal status
   - Navigate to `/app/(dashboard)/wallet/transactions` → Filter: "Withdrawals"
   - **Withdrawal entry:**
     - Date: Nov 7, 3:00 PM
     - Description: "Withdrawal to Bank ****5678"
     - Amount: -$1,000.00
     - Status: ⏳ **Pending** (Processing)
     - **Actions:** "View Status"
   - Click "View Status"
   - **Withdrawal status detail:**
     - **Status:** Processing
     - **Timeline:**
       - ✅ Nov 7, 3:00 PM — Withdrawal requested
       - ✅ Nov 7, 3:05 PM — Request approved by system
       - 🔄 Nov 8 (estimated) — Processing with bank
       - ⏳ Nov 10 (estimated) — Funds arrive in bank account
     - **Expected Arrival:** Nov 10, 2025
     - **Action:** "Cancel Withdrawal" (only if not yet processing)

8. **Wallet activity notifications:**
   - Freelancer receives push notification: "Your withdrawal of $1,000 has been processed and is on the way!"
   - Nov 10: Email: "Your withdrawal has arrived in your bank account ****5678"
   - Transaction status updated: ⏳ Pending → ✅ Completed

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Insufficient balance for withdrawal:**
   - Freelancer tries to withdraw $3,000 (but only has $2,450)
   - Error: "Insufficient available balance. You can withdraw up to $2,450."

2. **Pending withdrawals limit:**
   - Max 1 pending withdrawal at a time
   - If user tries to withdraw again: "You already have a pending withdrawal. Please wait until it completes."

3. **Minimum withdrawal amount:**
   - Min withdrawal: $10
   - If user enters $5: "Minimum withdrawal amount is $10"

4. **Wallet balance with escrow:**
   - User sees: Available: $500, In Escrow: $2,000
   - Can only withdraw $500
   - If tries to withdraw $2,500: "You have $2,000 in escrow that cannot be withdrawn yet"

5. **Failed payment (deposit):**
   - Credit card declined during deposit
   - Error: "Payment failed. Please try a different payment method."
   - **Event published:** `wallet.deposit.failed.v1`
   - No balance change

6. **Failed withdrawal (payout):**
   - Bank rejects payout (invalid account)
   - Email: "Your withdrawal failed. Please update your payout method."
   - Funds returned to wallet
   - **Event published:** `wallet.withdrawal.failed.v1`

7. **Currency conversion:**
   - If multi-currency supported:
     - User's wallet in USD
     - Contract paid in EUR
     - System auto-converts EUR → USD at current exchange rate
     - Transaction shows: "€450.00 (converted to $500.00 at rate 1.11)"

8. **Wallet holds (disputes):**
   - If dispute opened, funds may be held
   - Balance shows: "Reserved: $500 (dispute on Contract #1234)"
   - Can't withdraw reserved funds

9. **Wallet negative balance (rare):**
   - If chargeback occurs after withdrawal
   - Balance can go negative: -$50
   - User must deposit to clear negative balance before withdrawing again

10. **Wallet transaction limits:**
    - Daily withdrawal limit: $10,000
    - Monthly deposit limit: $50,000
    - Exceeding limit: "You've reached your daily withdrawal limit. Try again tomorrow."

11. **Wallet verification required:**
    - For withdrawals > $2,000, identity verification needed
    - Prompt: "Verify your identity to withdraw this amount" → Redirect to KYC

12. **Wallet auto-withdrawal:**
    - Users can enable "Auto-withdraw to bank account"
    - Settings: "Auto-withdraw when balance exceeds $1,000"
    - System auto-triggers withdrawal

13. **Wallet refund (from client):**
    - Client cancels contract → Escrow refunded
    - Transaction: "Refund from Contract #1234 — +$600"

14. **Wallet bonus/credits:**
    - Platform gives promotional credit: "$50 bonus"
    - Balance shows: "Bonus Credits: $50 (can only be used for platform fees)"

15. **Wallet transaction fee visibility:**
    - Each transaction shows fees clearly:
      - Gross: $500
      - Platform Fee: -$25 (5%)
      - Net: $475

16. **Wallet split payments:**
    - For agencies, wallet can have split rules:
      - 80% to freelancer, 20% to agency
      - Automatic split on payment receipt

17. **Wallet freeze (security):**
    - Suspicious activity detected
    - Wallet frozen (can't withdraw)
    - Email: "Your wallet has been temporarily frozen. Contact support."

18. **Wallet low balance alert:**
    - Client has < $100 in wallet
    - Notification: "Your wallet balance is low. Add funds to avoid contract delays."

19. **Wallet transaction dispute:**
    - User disputes transaction: "I didn't authorize this withdrawal"
    - Click "Dispute Transaction" → Opens support ticket

20. **Wallet statement generation:**
    - Monthly/quarterly wallet statement (PDF)
    - Shows all transactions, balance changes, fees
    - For accounting/tax purposes

21. **Wallet multi-account (organizations):**
    - Organizations can have shared wallet
    - Multiple users access same wallet
    - RBAC controls who can withdraw

22. **Wallet transaction reversal:**
    - Support can reverse erroneous transactions
    - Creates adjustment transaction: "Reversal for TXN-123"

23. **Wallet scheduled withdrawals:**
    - User sets recurring withdrawal: "Every Friday, withdraw $500"
    - System auto-processes

24. **Wallet balance alerts:**
    - User sets alert: "Notify me when balance exceeds $2,000"
    - Push notification sent when threshold reached

25. **Wallet tax withholding:**
    - For international freelancers, tax withheld
    - Transaction shows: "Gross: $500, Tax Withheld: -$50, Net: $450"

26. **Wallet payout method validation:**
    - Before first withdrawal, payout method verified
    - Micro-deposit test (for bank accounts)

27. **Wallet fraud protection:**
    - Large/unusual transactions flagged
    - "Verify this withdrawal via email/SMS"

28. **Wallet balance reconciliation:**
    - Daily balance reconciliation
    - If discrepancy: "Balance mismatch detected. Support notified."

29. **Wallet overdraft protection:**
    - Prevent negative balance
    - If transaction would cause negative balance → Blocked

30. **Wallet inactivity fee:**
    - If wallet inactive for >12 months → Monthly fee ($5)
    - Email warning before first fee

#### Notifications

**Deposit (Client):**
- **Email + Push:** "Successfully added $500 to your wallet"
- **Email:** Receipt (PDF attached)

**Withdrawal (Freelancer):**
- **Email + Push:** "Withdrawal request submitted ($1,000 to Bank ****5678)"
- **Push:** "Withdrawal processing" (day 1)
- **Email + Push:** "Withdrawal completed! Funds arrived in your account" (day 3)

**Balance Alerts:**
- **Push:** "Your wallet balance is low ($50 remaining)"
- **Email (monthly):** "Your wallet statement for November 2025 is ready"

**Failed Transactions:**
- **Email + Push:** "Withdrawal failed. Please update your payout method."
- **Email + SMS:** "Suspicious activity detected. Verify your identity."

**Escrow Release:**
- **Push:** "Payment released from escrow (+$500)"
- **Email:** "Milestone approved. Funds available in your wallet."

#### Analytics

- wallet.dashboard\_viewed (user\_role, available\_balance, escrow\_balance)
- wallet.balance\_details\_viewed (balance\_type, view\_duration\_seconds)
- wallet.transactions\_viewed (date\_range, transaction\_types\_filtered, transactions\_displayed)
- wallet.transaction\_detail\_viewed (transaction\_id, transaction\_type, transaction\_amount)
- wallet.deposit\_initiated (amount, payment\_method\_type, fee\_amount)
- wallet.deposit\_completed (amount, net\_amount, processing\_time\_seconds)
- wallet.deposit\_failed (amount, payment\_method\_type, failure\_reason)
- wallet.withdrawal\_initiated (amount, payout\_method\_type, fee\_amount)
- wallet.withdrawal\_completed (amount, net\_amount, processing\_time\_days)
- wallet.withdrawal\_failed (amount, payout\_method\_type, failure\_reason)
- wallet.withdrawal\_cancelled (withdrawal\_id, cancellation\_reason, user\_initiated)
- wallet.transaction\_exported (export\_format, transaction\_count, date\_range)
- wallet.transaction\_searched (search\_query, results\_count)
- wallet.transaction\_filtered (filter\_type, filter\_value, results\_count)
- wallet.transaction\_disputed (transaction\_id, dispute\_reason, transaction\_amount)
- wallet.balance\_alert\_triggered (alert\_type, threshold\_amount, current\_balance)
- wallet.auto\_withdrawal\_executed (amount, payout\_method\_id, auto\_withdrawal\_rule)
- wallet.payout\_method\_added (payout\_method\_type, verification\_required)
- wallet.payout\_method\_verified (payout\_method\_id, verification\_method)
- wallet.wallet\_frozen (freeze\_reason, balance\_at\_freeze)
- wallet.wallet\_unfrozen (unfreeze\_reason, duration\_frozen\_hours)
- wallet.escrow\_released (contract\_id, milestone\_id, amount\_released)
- wallet.refund\_processed (contract\_id, refund\_amount, refund\_reason)
- wallet.statement\_generated (statement\_period, transaction\_count, statement\_format)
- wallet.currency\_converted (original\_currency, original\_amount, converted\_currency, converted\_amount, exchange\_rate)
- wallet.fee\_charged (fee\_type, fee\_amount, transaction\_id)
- wallet.negative\_balance\_detected (balance\_amount, last\_transaction\_id)
- wallet.inactivity\_fee\_charged (fee\_amount, months\_inactive)
- wallet.overdraft\_protection\_triggered (attempted\_transaction\_amount, available\_balance)

#### Sources

**Backend:** financial-be.user-stories.md (Wallet domain), payment-be (Payment processing), contracts-be (Escrow management)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/wallet routes), hooks/use-wallet.ts, hooks/use-transactions.ts

## FIN-2 — Invoices & Payments

**ID:** FIN-2  
**Persona:** Client, Freelancer, System  
**Preconditions:** Contract exists, milestone completed or timesheet approved  
**Triggers:** Milestone approved, timesheet approved, manual invoice creation

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/financial/invoices` — Invoices list
- `(dashboard)/financial/invoices/[invoiceId]` — Invoice detail
- `(dashboard)/financial/invoices/[invoiceId]/pay` — Pay invoice
- `(dashboard)/financial/invoices/create` — Create manual invoice
- `(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/invoices` — Contract invoices

**Mobile:**
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/invoices/` — Invoices list
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/invoices/[invoiceId]/` — Invoice detail
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/invoices/[invoiceId]/pay/` — Pay invoice
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/invoices/` — Contract invoices

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend Microservices:**
- `financial-be/invoice` — Invoice CRUD, generation, PDF
- `financial-be/payment` — Payment processing
- `contracts-be/contract` — Contract reference
- `contracts-be/milestone` — Milestone reference
- `contracts-be/timesheet` — Timesheet reference
- `users-be/user` — User details
- `notifications-be/notifications` — Invoice notifications
- `storage-be/documents` — PDF storage

**Databases:**
- `financial_db.invoices` — Invoice records
- `financial_db.invoice_line_items` — Line items
- `financial_db.payments` — Payment records
- `contracts_db.contracts` — Contract data
- `contracts_db.milestones` — Milestone data
- `contracts_db.timesheets` — Timesheet data

#### Flow Steps

#### System-Generated Invoice (Milestone/Timesheet)

1. **Trigger event:**
   - Milestone approved → `milestone.approved.v1`
   - Timesheet approved → `timesheet.approved.v1`

2. **System generates invoice:**
   - `financial-be/invoice` receives event
   - Creates invoice record with unique number (e.g., INV-2025-001234)
   - Status: `PENDING`
   - Calculates amounts:
     - Subtotal (milestone amount or timesheet hours × rate)
     - Platform fees
     - Taxes (if applicable)
     - Total amount

3. **Generate line items:**
   - For milestone: "Milestone: [name]" — Amount
   - For timesheet: "[Hours] hours @ $[rate]/hour" — Amount
   - Platform fee line item
   - Tax line item (if applicable)

4. **Generate PDF:**
   - Invoice header (invoice number, date, due date)
   - Client details (name, organization, address)
   - Freelancer details (name, address, tax ID if provided)
   - Line items table
   - Subtotal, fees, taxes, total
   - Payment instructions
   - Store PDF in `storage-be`

5. **Send notification:**
   - Email to client: "Invoice INV-001234 for $500 is ready"
   - Email to freelancer: "Invoice INV-001234 sent to client"
   - Push notification to client
   - In-app notification

6. **Client views invoice:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/invoices/[invoiceId]`
   - Displays invoice details:
     - Invoice number and date
     - Contract reference
     - Billing period
     - Status badge
     - Line items breakdown
     - Subtotal, fees, taxes, total
     - Due date
     - Payment status
   - Actions available:
     - Download PDF
     - Pay Now
     - Mark as Paid (if external payment)
     - Dispute Invoice

7. **Client pays invoice:**
   - Click "Pay Now"
   - Redirect to `(dashboard)/financial/invoices/[invoiceId]/pay`
   - Payment method selection:
     - Saved payment methods
     - Add new payment method (card, bank)
     - Pay from wallet balance
   - Review payment summary
   - Click "Process Payment"

8. **Payment processing:**
   - `financial-be/payment` processes payment:
     - Charge payment method via gateway (Stripe/PayPal)
     - If 3D Secure required → Handle challenge
     - Deduct from wallet (if selected)
     - Create payment record
     - Update invoice status: `PAID`

9. **Payment success:**
   - Update wallet balances:
     - Deduct from client wallet (if used)
     - Add to freelancer available balance (after escrow release)
     - Add platform fee to platform balance
   - Record transaction in ledger
   - Generate payment receipt (PDF)
   - Send notifications:
     - Email to client: "Payment processed for INV-001234"
     - Email to freelancer: "Payment received for INV-001234"
     - Push notifications

10. **Invoice status updated:**
    - Status: `PAID`
    - `paid_at` timestamp recorded
    - Amount paid = total amount
    - Invoice locked (no further edits)

#### Manual Invoice Creation (Freelancer)

1. **Freelancer creates invoice:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/invoices/create`
   - Select client (from past/current contracts)
   - Select contract (optional link)
   - Enter invoice details:
     - Invoice date
     - Due date (default: 14 days)
     - Billing period
     - Currency
   - Add line items:
     - Description
     - Quantity/Hours
     - Rate
     - Amount
   - System calculates:
     - Subtotal
     - Platform fee (5%)
     - Taxes (if applicable)
     - Total

2. **Review and submit:**
   - Preview invoice
   - Click "Send Invoice"
   - Confirm recipient email

3. **Invoice sent:**
   - Status: `PENDING`
   - PDF generated
   - Email sent to client
   - Invoice appears in client's invoices list

4. **Client receives and pays:**
   - Same flow as system-generated invoice (steps 6-10)

#### Invoice Viewing (Both Roles)

1. **View invoices list:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/invoices`
   - Display table/cards with:
     - Invoice number
     - Client/Freelancer name
     - Issue date
     - Due date
     - Amount
     - Status (Pending, Paid, Overdue, Cancelled)
   - Filters:
     - Status
     - Date range
     - Client/Freelancer
     - Contract
   - Sort options:
     - Date (newest/oldest)
     - Amount (high/low)
     - Status
   - Search by invoice number

2. **View invoice detail:**
   - Click invoice → Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/invoices/[invoiceId]`
   - Full invoice information displayed
   - Actions based on role and status:
     - **Client + Pending:** Pay Now, Mark as Paid, Dispute
     - **Client + Paid:** Download Receipt, View Payment
     - **Freelancer + Pending:** Send Reminder, Cancel Invoice
     - **Freelancer + Paid:** Download PDF, View Payment
     - **Both:** Download PDF, View Contract

3. **Download PDF:**
   - Click "Download PDF"
   - `financial-be/invoice` generates fresh PDF (if needed)
   - Returns signed URL from `storage-be`
   - Browser downloads invoice

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Payment failure:**
   - Payment gateway returns error
   - Status remains `PENDING`
   - Error message displayed: "Payment failed: [reason]"
   - Retry options:
     - Try different payment method
     - Update payment details
     - Pay later
   - Email notification: "Payment failed for INV-001234"

2. **Insufficient wallet balance:**
   - Client selects "Pay from wallet"
   - Wallet balance < invoice amount
   - Error: "Insufficient balance. Please add funds or select another payment method."
   - Options:
     - Add funds to wallet
     - Use different payment method
     - Pay partial amount from wallet + card

3. **Overdue invoice:**
   - Current date > due date AND status = `PENDING`
   - Status automatically becomes `OVERDUE`
   - Visual indicator (red badge)
   - Daily reminder emails to client (up to 3 reminders)
   - Freelancer can send manual reminder

4. **Invoice dispute:**
   - Client clicks "Dispute Invoice"
   - Enter dispute reason
   - Invoice status: `DISPUTED`
   - Payment frozen
   - Notification to freelancer and admin
   - Dispute resolution process initiated
   - Admin reviews and resolves

5. **Partial payment:**
   - Client pays less than invoice total
   - Status: `PARTIALLY_PAID`
   - Amount due = total - amount paid
   - Invoice remains active
   - Client can pay remaining balance
   - Notification to freelancer: "Partial payment received"

6. **Invoice cancellation:**
   - Freelancer cancels invoice (before payment)
   - Status: `CANCELLED`
   - Notification to client
   - Invoice locked
   - If payment was attempted → Refund initiated

7. **Void invoice:**
   - Admin voids invoice (after payment)
   - Status: `VOID`
   - Refund processed to client
   - Invoice marked as void
   - New invoice may be generated

8. **Multiple invoices per contract:**
   - Contract can have many invoices
   - Each milestone generates separate invoice
   - Monthly timesheets generate monthly invoices
   - View all contract invoices: `(dashboard)/contracts/[contractId]/invoices`

9. **Invoice amendments:**
   - If invoice not paid, freelancer can edit
   - Edit line items, amounts, due date
   - Version tracked
   - Client notified of changes

10. **Tax calculation:**
    - System determines tax jurisdiction (client location)
    - Applies appropriate tax rate
    - VAT/GST for EU/international
    - Sales tax for US (state-dependent)
    - Tax amount shown separately
    - Tax ID included if freelancer provided

11. **Currency conversion:**
    - If contract currency ≠ platform default currency
    - Convert amounts at current exchange rate
    - Display both currencies
    - Exchange rate locked at invoice generation
    - Fees calculated in platform currency

12. **Invoice reminders:**
    - Freelancer can send manual reminder
    - Click "Send Reminder"
    - Email sent to client: "Reminder: Invoice INV-001234 is due"
    - Limited to 1 reminder per day

13. **Bulk invoice operations:**
    - Select multiple invoices
    - Actions:
      - Export to CSV
      - Download PDFs (ZIP)
      - Mark as paid (admin only)
      - Send reminders

14. **Invoice numbering:**
    - Sequential numbering: INV-YYYY-NNNNNN
    - Unique per platform
    - Cannot be changed
    - Gaps allowed (deleted/cancelled invoices)

15. **Invoice templates:**
    - Freelancer can customize invoice branding
    - Upload logo
    - Custom footer text
    - Payment terms
    - Stored in financial profile

16. **Recurring invoices:**
    - For retainer contracts
    - Set up recurring schedule (weekly, monthly)
    - Auto-generated on schedule
    - Can be edited/cancelled

17. **Invoice exports:**
    - Export to accounting software (QuickBooks, Xero)
    - CSV format with all line items
    - Filter by date range, status
    - For tax reporting

18. **Late payment fees:**
    - If enabled in contract
    - Automatic late fee added after grace period
    - Configurable fee (% or flat)
    - New line item added to invoice

19. **Multi-currency invoicing:**
    - Freelancer bills in their currency
    - Client sees amount in their currency
    - Platform handles conversion
    - Exchange rate applied at payment

20. **Invoice preview before sending:**
    - Preview PDF before finalizing
    - Check all amounts, taxes
    - Edit if needed
    - Then send

#### Notifications

**Invoice Generated:**
- **Email (Client):** "New invoice INV-001234 for $500 from [Freelancer Name]"
- **Email (Freelancer):** "Invoice INV-001234 sent to [Client Name]"
- **Push (Client):** "New invoice: $500 due on [Date]"

**Invoice Paid:**
- **Email (Client):** "Payment confirmation for INV-001234 - Receipt attached"
- **Email (Freelancer):** "Payment received for INV-001234 - $475 added to your balance"
- **Push (Both):** "Invoice paid successfully"

**Invoice Overdue:**
- **Email (Client):** "Reminder: Invoice INV-001234 is overdue"
- **Email (Freelancer):** "Invoice INV-001234 is overdue"
- **Push (Client):** "Overdue invoice: $500"

**Payment Failed:**
- **Email (Client):** "Payment failed for INV-001234. Please update payment method."
- **Push (Client):** "Payment failed - retry required"

**Invoice Disputed:**
- **Email (Freelancer):** "Invoice INV-001234 has been disputed by client"
- **Email (Admin):** "Invoice dispute requires review"
- **Push (Freelancer):** "Invoice disputed"

#### Analytics

- invoice.generated (invoice_id, contract_id, amount, currency, invoice_type, generated_by)
- invoice.viewed (invoice_id, viewer_role, view_duration_seconds)
- invoice.pdf_downloaded (invoice_id, download_by_role)
- invoice.paid (invoice_id, payment_amount, payment_method, processing_time_seconds)
- invoice.payment_failed (invoice_id, payment_method, failure_reason, retry_count)
- invoice.overdue (invoice_id, days_overdue, amount_due)
- invoice.reminder_sent (invoice_id, reminder_type, recipient_role)
- invoice.disputed (invoice_id, dispute_reason, dispute_amount)
- invoice.cancelled (invoice_id, cancellation_reason, cancelled_by)
- invoice.partial_payment (invoice_id, amount_paid, amount_remaining)
- invoice.amended (invoice_id, amendment_type, changes_made)
- invoice.voided (invoice_id, void_reason, refund_amount)
- invoice.exported (export_format, invoice_count, date_range)
- invoice.tax_calculated (invoice_id, tax_jurisdiction, tax_amount, tax_rate)
- invoice.currency_converted (invoice_id, from_currency, to_currency, exchange_rate)
- invoice.recurring_created (invoice_id, schedule_frequency, next_invoice_date)

#### Sources

**Backend:** financial-be.user-stories.md (Invoice domain, Payment domain), contracts-be.user-stories.md (Contract/Milestone/Timesheet reference)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/financial/invoices routes), hooks/use-invoices.ts, hooks/use-payment.ts

## FIN-3 — Methods & Payouts

**ID:** FIN-3  
**Persona:** Client, Freelancer  
**Preconditions:** User account active, identity verified (for payouts)  
**Triggers:** Add payment method, add payout method, request payout, verify method

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/financial/payment-methods` — Payment methods list (client)
- `(dashboard)/financial/payment-methods/add` — Add payment method
- `(dashboard)/financial/payment-methods/[methodId]` — Payment method detail
- `(dashboard)/financial/payout-methods` — Payout methods list (freelancer)
- `(dashboard)/financial/payout-methods/add` — Add payout method
- `(dashboard)/financial/payout-methods/[methodId]` — Payout method detail
- `(dashboard)/financial/wallet/withdraw` — Request payout

**Mobile:**
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/financial/payment-methods/` — Payment methods list
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/financial/payment-methods/add/` — Add payment method
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/financial/payout-methods/` — Payout methods list
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/financial/payout-methods/add/` — Add payout method
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/wallet/withdraw/` — Request payout

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend Microservices:**
- `financial-be/payment_method` — Payment method CRUD
- `financial-be/payout_method` — Payout method CRUD
- `financial-be/payout` — Payout processing
- `financial-be/wallet` — Wallet balance check
- `users-be/kyc` — KYC verification check
- `notifications-be/notifications` — Method verification, payout notifications
- Third-party: Stripe, PayPal, banking APIs

**Databases:**
- `financial_db.payment_methods` — Payment methods
- `financial_db.payout_methods` — Payout methods
- `financial_db.payouts` — Payout records
- `financial_db.wallets` — Wallet balances
- `users_db.kyc_verifications` — KYC status

#### Flow Steps

#### Add Payment Method (Client)

1. **Navigate to add payment method:**
   - Go to `(dashboard)/financial/payment-methods/add`
   - Select method type:
     - Credit/Debit Card
     - Bank Account (ACH)
     - PayPal
     - Apple Pay / Google Pay

2. **Add credit card:**
   - Stripe Elements integration (PCI compliant)
   - Enter card details:
     - Card number
     - Expiry date
     - CVV
     - Cardholder name
     - Billing address
   - Optional: "Save as default payment method" checkbox
   - Click "Add Card"

3. **Tokenization:**
   - Frontend sends card data directly to Stripe
   - Stripe returns payment method token
   - Token sent to `financial-be/payment_method`
   - Backend stores:
     - Token
     - Last 4 digits
     - Card brand (Visa, Mastercard, etc.)
     - Expiry month/year
     - NOT full card number (PCI compliance)

4. **Verification (3D Secure):**
   - If required by card issuer
   - Redirect to bank's 3D Secure page
   - User completes challenge (OTP, biometric)
   - Return to platform
   - Status: `VERIFIED`

5. **Success:**
   - Method status: `ACTIVE`
   - If "default" selected → Set as default
   - Notification: "Credit card added successfully"
   - Redirect to payment methods list

6. **Add bank account:**
   - Select "Bank Account (ACH)"
   - Enter bank details:
     - Account number
     - Routing number
     - Account holder name
     - Account type (Checking/Savings)
   - Click "Add Bank Account"

7. **Micro-deposit verification:**
   - Backend sends 2 small deposits (e.g., $0.32, $0.45)
   - Status: `PENDING_VERIFICATION`
   - Email: "Please verify your bank account"
   - User waits 1-2 business days

8. **Verify micro-deposits:**
   - Go to `(dashboard)/financial/payment-methods/[methodId]`
   - Status shows "Verification Pending"
   - Enter 2 deposit amounts
   - Click "Verify"
   - Backend validates amounts
   - If correct → Status: `VERIFIED`
   - If incorrect → Allow 2 more attempts

9. **Add PayPal:**
   - Select "PayPal"
   - Click "Connect PayPal"
   - OAuth flow: Redirect to PayPal
   - User authorizes platform
   - Return with token
   - Backend stores PayPal account ID
   - Status: `ACTIVE`

#### Add Payout Method (Freelancer)

1. **Navigate to add payout method:**
   - Go to `(dashboard)/financial/payout-methods/add`
   - Select method type:
     - Bank Account (Direct Deposit)
     - PayPal
     - Wire Transfer
     - Crypto Wallet (if supported)

2. **Add bank account:**
   - Enter bank details:
     - Country
     - Bank name
     - Account holder name
     - Account number
     - Routing/Sort code/SWIFT
     - IBAN (for international)
     - Currency
   - Upload proof (optional):
     - Void check
     - Bank statement
   - Click "Add Bank Account"

3. **KYC requirement:**
   - If payout method > $2000/month threshold
   - System checks `users-be/kyc` status
   - If not verified → Prompt:
     - "Identity verification required for payouts"
     - Redirect to KYC flow
     - After verification → Return to add payout method

4. **Verification:**
   - Micro-deposit verification (same as payment methods)
   - Or instant verification via Plaid/Stripe
   - Status: `PENDING_VERIFICATION` → `VERIFIED`

5. **Add PayPal payout:**
   - Enter PayPal email
   - Click "Add PayPal"
   - Backend verifies email format
   - Status: `ACTIVE` (instant)
   - No verification needed if PayPal account exists

6. **Wire transfer details:**
   - For large payouts (>$10,000)
   - Enter:
     - Bank name and address
     - SWIFT/BIC code
     - Intermediary bank details (if any)
     - Reference instructions
   - Status: `ACTIVE`
   - Manual verification by admin (for first use)

#### Request Payout (Freelancer)

1. **Initiate withdrawal:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/wallet/withdraw`
   - Display available balance: "$1,500.00"
   - Display pending balance: "$500.00" (in escrow)
   - Enter withdrawal amount: "$1,000.00"
   - Select payout method:
     - Verified bank account
     - PayPal
   - System calculates fee:
     - ACH: $0 (free for US)
     - Wire: $25 (flat fee)
     - PayPal: 2% (capped at $20)
   - Display net amount: "$1,000.00 - $0 fee = $1,000.00"
   - Click "Request Withdrawal"

2. **Validation:**
   - Check available balance ≥ amount
   - Check payout method is verified
   - Check KYC status
   - Check withdrawal limits:
     - Daily: $10,000
     - Monthly: $50,000
   - All checks pass → Proceed

3. **Payout created:**
   - `financial-be/payout` creates payout record
   - Status: `PENDING`
   - Deduct from available balance
   - Move to pending balance (temporary hold)
   - Estimate arrival: "3-5 business days"
   - Generate payout ID: PO-2025-001234

4. **Confirmation:**
   - Email: "Withdrawal request received - $1,000 to Bank ****5678"
   - Push notification: "Withdrawal processing"
   - Display payout status in wallet

5. **Processing:**
   - Backend queues payout
   - Daily batch processing (10am UTC)
   - Connect to banking API (Stripe Payouts, PayPal Payouts)
   - Initiate transfer
   - Status: `PROCESSING`

6. **Transfer in progress:**
   - Status: `IN_TRANSIT`
   - Email: "Your withdrawal is on the way"
   - Typical timeline:
     - ACH: 3-5 business days
     - PayPal: Instant - 1 day
     - Wire: 1-2 business days
     - International wire: 3-7 business days

7. **Transfer completed:**
   - Banking API confirms arrival
   - Status: `COMPLETED`
   - Remove from pending balance
   - Email: "Withdrawal completed! Funds arrived in your account"
   - Push notification: "Funds deposited to Bank ****5678"

8. **Payout history:**
   - View all payouts: `(dashboard)/financial/wallet` → "Payout History" tab
   - Display:
     - Payout ID
     - Amount
     - Payout method
     - Status
     - Requested date
     - Completed date
     - Fees

#### View & Manage Payment Methods

1. **Payment methods list (Client):**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/payment-methods`
   - Display all saved methods:
     - Card: "**** **** **** 1234" | Visa | Exp: 12/25 | Default
     - Bank: "Bank of America ****5678" | Verified
     - PayPal: "user@email.com" | Connected
   - Actions for each:
     - Set as Default
     - Remove
     - View Details

2. **Set default payment method:**
   - Click "Set as Default" on any method
   - Confirm dialog
   - Backend updates default flag
   - Success message: "Default payment method updated"
   - Used for future invoices/payments

3. **Remove payment method:**
   - Click "Remove"
   - Confirm dialog: "Are you sure? This cannot be undone."
   - Validation:
     - Cannot remove if it's the only method
     - Cannot remove if it's default (set another as default first)
     - Cannot remove if there are pending charges
   - If valid → Soft delete
   - Stripe token invalidated
   - Success: "Payment method removed"

4. **View method details:**
   - Click on payment method
   - Display full details:
     - Method type
     - Last 4 digits / email
     - Added date
     - Verification status
     - Default status
     - Usage history (transactions using this method)

5. **Payout methods list (Freelancer):**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/payout-methods`
   - Display all payout methods:
     - Bank: "Chase Bank ****9876" | Verified | Default
     - PayPal: "freelancer@email.com" | Active
   - Actions:
     - Set as Default
     - Remove
     - Verify (if pending)

6. **Verify pending payout method:**
   - Method status: `PENDING_VERIFICATION`
   - Click "Verify" button
   - Verification flow (micro-deposits or instant)
   - Once verified → Can be used for payouts

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Card declined:**
   - During 3D Secure or initial authorization
   - Error: "Card declined by issuer"
   - Prompt to try different card
   - Method not saved

2. **Micro-deposit verification failed:**
   - User enters wrong amounts
   - Allow 3 attempts total
   - After 3 failures → Method locked
   - User must re-add bank account

3. **Insufficient funds for payout:**
   - User tries to withdraw more than available
   - Error: "Insufficient balance. Available: $500"
   - Adjust withdrawal amount
   - Or wait for pending payments to clear

4. **Payout method not verified:**
   - User tries to request payout with unverified method
   - Error: "Please verify your bank account first"
   - Redirect to verification flow

5. **KYC not completed:**
   - Large payout request (>$2000)
   - User not verified
   - Block payout
   - Error: "Identity verification required for withdrawals over $2000"
   - Redirect to KYC flow

6. **Payout failure:**
   - Bank rejects transfer (invalid account, closed, etc.)
   - Status: `FAILED`
   - Funds returned to available balance
   - Email: "Withdrawal failed. Please check payout method details."
   - Retry available

7. **Daily withdrawal limit exceeded:**
   - User tries to withdraw $11,000 (limit: $10,000/day)
   - Error: "Daily withdrawal limit exceeded. Please try again tomorrow or withdraw less."
   - Display remaining limit

8. **Monthly withdrawal limit exceeded:**
   - Cumulative withdrawals in month exceed $50,000
   - Error: "Monthly limit reached. Contact support for higher limits."
   - Option to request limit increase

9. **Multiple default payment methods:**
   - System should prevent, but if occurs → Fix automatically
   - Mark most recently set as default
   - Log issue for admin review

10. **Payment method expiration:**
    - Card expiry date < current date
    - Status: `EXPIRED`
    - Email notification: "Your payment method expires soon"
    - Prompt to update

11. **Auto-update card details (Stripe):**
    - If card issuer updates card number (lost/stolen)
    - Stripe automatically updates token
    - Backend syncs new details
    - User notified: "Payment method updated"

12. **Payout method country restrictions:**
    - Some countries not supported for payouts
    - Error: "Payouts to [country] are not currently supported"
    - Alternative: PayPal or other methods

13. **Currency conversion for payout:**
    - Freelancer in EUR, platform in USD
    - Convert at current exchange rate
    - Display both amounts: "$1,000 = €920"
    - Fee may apply: FX margin (1-2%)

14. **Bank account ownership mismatch:**
    - Bank account name ≠ User profile name
    - Verification rejected
    - Error: "Bank account must match your registered name"
    - Update profile or use different account

15. **PayPal account disconnected:**
    - User revokes OAuth access
    - Status: `INACTIVE`
    - Notification: "PayPal connection lost. Please reconnect."
    - Reconnect button

16. **Duplicate payment method:**
    - User tries to add same card twice
    - Check last 4 digits + expiry
    - Error: "This payment method is already saved"
    - Prevent duplicate

17. **Fraud detection triggered:**
    - Large payout request from new account
    - Suspicious pattern detected
    - Payout held for manual review
    - Status: `UNDER_REVIEW`
    - Email: "Withdrawal under security review (24-48 hours)"

18. **Auto-withdrawal feature:**
    - Freelancer can enable auto-withdrawal
    - Settings: "Auto-withdraw when balance exceeds $1,000"
    - Select payout method
    - Select frequency (daily, weekly, monthly)
    - System auto-creates payouts

19. **Split payout (agencies):**
    - Agency contract with revenue split
    - Payout split: 80% freelancer, 20% agency
    - Two separate payouts created
    - Both parties notified

20. **Tax withholding on payout:**
    - International freelancers
    - Platform withholds tax (e.g., 30% for US 1099)
    - Display: Gross: $1,000, Tax: -$300, Net: $700
    - Tax withheld transferred to tax authority

#### Notifications

**Payment Method Added:**
- **Email:** "New payment method added to your account"
- **Push:** "Payment method added successfully"

**Payment Method Verification:**
- **Email:** "Please verify your bank account - check for micro-deposits"
- **Email (success):** "Bank account verified successfully"

**Payout Requested:**
- **Email:** "Withdrawal request received - $1,000 to Bank ****5678"
- **Push:** "Withdrawal processing"

**Payout Completed:**
- **Email:** "Withdrawal completed! Funds arrived in your account"
- **Push:** "Funds deposited to Bank ****5678"

**Payout Failed:**
- **Email:** "Withdrawal failed. Please update your payout method."
- **Push:** "Withdrawal failed - action required"

**Card Expiring Soon:**
- **Email (30 days before):** "Your payment method expires soon. Please update."

#### Analytics

- payment_method.added (method_type, user_role, is_default, verification_required)
- payment_method.verified (method_id, method_type, verification_method, verification_time_seconds)
- payment_method.verification_failed (method_id, failure_reason, attempt_number)
- payment_method.set_default (method_id, previous_default_id)
- payment_method.removed (method_id, method_type, removal_reason)
- payment_method.expired (method_id, expiry_date)
- payout_method.added (method_type, country, currency, verification_required)
- payout_method.verified (method_id, method_type, verification_time_days)
- payout_method.removed (method_id, method_type, removal_reason)
- payout.requested (payout_amount, payout_method_type, fee_amount, net_amount)
- payout.processing (payout_id, estimated_arrival_days)
- payout.completed (payout_id, payout_amount, processing_time_days)
- payout.failed (payout_id, failure_reason, retry_available)
- payout.cancelled (payout_id, cancellation_reason, user_initiated)
- withdrawal_limit.exceeded (limit_type, limit_amount, attempted_amount)
- auto_withdrawal.enabled (threshold_amount, frequency, payout_method_id)
- auto_withdrawal.executed (payout_amount, trigger_reason)

## FIN-4 — Tax Center

**ID:** FIN-4  
**Persona:** Freelancer, Client, System  
**Preconditions:** User account active, earnings/payments exist  
**Triggers:** Tax year end, manual tax form submission, 1099 threshold reached, tax document request

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/financial/tax` — Tax center overview
- `(dashboard)/financial/tax/forms` — Tax forms list (W-9, 1099, W-8BEN)
- `(dashboard)/financial/tax/forms/w9` — W-9 form submission
- `(dashboard)/financial/tax/forms/upload` — Upload tax form
- `(dashboard)/financial/tax/1099-reporting` — 1099 reporting (admin)
- `(dashboard)/financial/reports/tax` — Tax reports

**Mobile:**
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/financial/tax/` — Tax center
- `(tabs)/(dashboard)/financial/tax/forms/` — Tax forms list

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend Microservices:**
- `financial-be/tax` — Tax calculation, forms, reporting
- `financial-be/tax_profile` — Tax profile CRUD
- `users-be/user` — User profile data
- `contracts-be/contract` — Contract earnings data
- `storage-be/documents` — Form storage
- `notifications-be/notifications` — Tax notifications
- Third-party: IRS e-file API (for 1099 filing)

**Databases:**
- `financial_db.tax_profiles` — Tax profiles
- `financial_db.tax_forms` — Submitted forms
- `financial_db.tax_withholdings` — Tax withholdings
- `financial_db.tax_documents` — Generated documents (1099)
- `financial_db.transactions` — Earnings data

#### Flow Steps

#### Tax Profile Setup (Freelancer)

1. **Navigate to tax center:**
   - Go to `(dashboard)/financial/tax`
   - If first visit → Prompt: "Complete your tax profile"
   - Click "Set Up Tax Profile"

2. **Enter tax information:**
   - Tax residency country: [Dropdown]
   - Tax ID type:
     - US: SSN or EIN
     - International: TIN, VAT, etc.
   - Tax ID number: [Input, masked for privacy]
   - State/Province (if applicable)
   - VAT/GST registration:
     - "Are you VAT/GST registered?" [Yes/No]
     - If Yes → Enter VAT/GST number

3. **US Tax Profile (W-9 equivalent):**
   - Legal name (as appears on tax return)
   - Business name (if DBA/LLC)
   - Tax classification:
     - Individual/Sole Proprietor
     - C Corporation
     - S Corporation
     - Partnership
     - Trust/Estate
     - LLC (select classification)
   - Address
   - Sign W-9 (electronic signature)

4. **International Tax Profile (W-8BEN):**
   - Country of citizenship
   - Permanent residence address
   - Mailing address (if different)
   - Date of birth
   - Foreign tax identifying number
   - Tax treaty benefits:
     - "Claim tax treaty benefits?" [Yes/No]
     - If Yes → Select treaty country
     - Enter article and rate
   - Sign W-8BEN (electronic signature)

5. **Save tax profile:**
   - Click "Submit Tax Information"
   - Validation:
     - All required fields filled
     - Tax ID format valid
     - Signature provided
   - Status: `SUBMITTED`
   - Backend creates/updates tax profile

6. **Confirmation:**
   - Success message: "Tax profile saved"
   - Display profile status: "Active" or "Under Review"
   - Email confirmation with PDF copy

#### W-9 Form Submission

1. **Submit W-9:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/tax/forms/w9`
   - If already submitted → Display current W-9
   - Click "Submit New W-9" or "Update W-9"

2. **Fill W-9 form:**
   - Pre-filled from tax profile (if exists)
   - Edit fields if needed:
     - Name
     - Business name
     - Tax classification
     - Address
     - TIN/SSN/EIN
   - Certifications:
     - "I certify that the TIN shown is correct"
     - "I am not subject to backup withholding"
   - Electronic signature

3. **Submit:**
   - Click "Submit W-9"
   - Generate PDF
   - Store in `storage-be`
   - Update tax profile: `w9_submitted = true`, `w9_submitted_at = now()`
   - Status: `SUBMITTED`

4. **Confirmation:**
   - Email: "W-9 form submitted successfully"
   - PDF attached
   - Update tax center dashboard

#### 1099 Generation (System - Year End)

1. **System trigger (January 31):**
   - Tax year ended (December 31)
   - System identifies freelancers meeting 1099 threshold
   - Threshold: $600+ earned in tax year
   - Query all contracts completed in tax year
   - Aggregate earnings per freelancer

2. **Data aggregation:**
   - For each qualifying freelancer:
     - Total payments received (gross)
     - Total platform fees paid
     - Total net earnings
     - Payer information (platform legal entity)
     - Payee information (freelancer from tax profile)

3. **Generate 1099-NEC:**
   - Form fields:
     - Payer: Skillsier Inc. + TIN
     - Recipient: Freelancer name + SSN/EIN
     - Box 1: Nonemployee compensation (total earnings)
     - State tax info (if applicable)
   - Generate PDF
   - Store in `storage-be`
   - Create record in `tax_documents` table

4. **Deliver 1099 to freelancer:**
   - Email: "Your 2024 1099-NEC is ready"
   - Downloadable PDF link
   - Available in tax center: `(dashboard)/financial/tax/forms`

5. **E-file with IRS:**
   - Batch all 1099s
   - Format for IRS FIRE system
   - Submit electronically
   - Receive confirmation
   - Status: `FILED`

6. **Copy to state (if required):**
   - Some states require copy (e.g., CA)
   - Generate state-specific forms
   - File with state tax authority

#### Tax Report Generation (User-Initiated)

1. **Request tax report:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/reports/tax`
   - Select tax year: [Dropdown: 2024, 2023, 2022...]
   - Select report type:
     - Earnings summary
     - Expense summary (platform fees)
     - Tax withholdings
     - Comprehensive tax report
   - Date range (for mid-year reports)
   - Click "Generate Report"

2. **System generates report:**
   - Query transactions for selected period
   - Aggregate data:
     - Total earnings (by month, quarter)
     - Earnings by client
     - Earnings by project/category
     - Platform fees paid
     - Tax withheld (if any)
     - Net earnings
   - Generate PDF or CSV

3. **Download report:**
   - Display download link
   - Email: "Your tax report for 2024 is ready"
   - Store for 7 years (compliance)

#### Tax Withholding (International Freelancers)

1. **Withholding determination:**
   - If freelancer is non-US resident
   - AND no tax treaty OR treaty rate > 0%
   - Platform withholds tax on payments
   - Default rate: 30% (US withholding)
   - Treaty rate: Lower (e.g., 15%, 10%, 0%)

2. **Withholding calculation:**
   - Payment to freelancer: $1,000
   - Withholding rate: 30%
   - Tax withheld: $300
   - Net paid to freelancer: $700

3. **Withholding record:**
   - Create record in `tax_withholdings` table
   - Fields:
     - User ID
     - Payment ID
     - Amount withheld
     - Tax year
     - Rate
     - Status
4. **Freelancer visibility:**
   - Each payment shows withholding:
     - Gross: $1,000
     - Tax withheld: -$300 (30%)
     - Net: $700
   - Monthly withholding summary in tax center
   - Annual 1042-S form (withholding certificate) provided

5. **Tax remittance:**
   - Platform remits withheld taxes to IRS quarterly
   - Generate 1042 form (annual return)
   - E-file with IRS

#### Upload Tax Documents

1. **Manual upload:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/tax/forms/upload`
   - Select form type:
     - W-9
     - W-8BEN
     - VAT certificate
     - Other
   - Upload file (PDF, JPG, PNG)
   - Max size: 10MB
   - Click "Upload"

2. **Processing:**
   - Virus scan
   - Store in `storage-be`
   - Update tax profile
   - Status: `UNDER_REVIEW` (for admin verification)

3. **Admin review:**
   - Admin views uploaded form
   - Validates information
   - Approves or rejects
   - If approved → Status: `VERIFIED`
   - If rejected → Email with reason, request resubmission

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Missing tax profile:**
   - User has earnings > $600
   - No W-9/tax profile on file
   - Block payout
   - Email: "Tax information required before withdrawal"
   - Redirect to tax profile setup

2. **Tax ID mismatch:**
   - Tax ID in profile ≠ Tax ID on W-9
   - Reject submission
   - Error: "Tax ID does not match your profile"
   - Update profile or correct W-9

3. **Backup withholding:**
   - Freelancer fails to provide valid TIN
   - Or IRS notifies backup withholding required
   - Platform withholds 24% of all payments
   - Notification: "Backup withholding in effect. Please update tax information."

4. **1099 threshold not met:**
   - Freelancer earned < $600 in tax year
   - No 1099 generated
   - Email: "You earned $450 in 2024. No 1099 required, but records available in Tax Center."

5. **Late 1099 correction:**
   - Error discovered after 1099 filed
   - Generate 1099-C (corrected form)
   - E-file correction with IRS
   - Send corrected form to freelancer
   - Email: "Corrected 1099 attached"

6. **State tax withholding:**
   - Some states require withholding (e.g., NY, CA)
   - Calculate state withholding separately
   - Display both federal and state withholding
   - Remit to state tax authority

7. **Multi-state earnings:**
   - Freelancer worked in multiple states
   - Allocate earnings by state
   - Generate state-specific tax documents
   - Provide state-by-state breakdown

8. **VAT/GST handling:**
   - EU/international freelancers
   - Reverse charge mechanism for B2B
   - No VAT charged if reverse charge applies
   - Invoice shows: "VAT Reverse Charge - Customer to account for VAT"

9. **Tax treaty benefits denied:**
   - Freelancer claims treaty but IRS denies
   - Revert to 30% withholding
   - Notify freelancer
   - Option to appeal or provide additional documentation

10. **Self-employed tax estimates:**
    - Freelancer requests quarterly tax estimates
    - System calculates estimated tax liability
    - Suggests quarterly payment amounts
    - Generate vouchers for IRS payments

11. **Tax document retention:**
    - Platform stores tax documents for 7 years
    - Users can download past years' 1099s
    - Search/filter by tax year

12. **Tax ID verification:**
    - IRS TIN matching service
    - Validate TIN against IRS database
    - If mismatch → Notify user, request correction

13. **Form expiry:**
    - W-8BEN expires after 3 years
    - Email notification 30 days before expiry
    - Prompt to resubmit

14. **Audit support:**
    - User requests audit-ready reports
    - Generate comprehensive package:
      - All invoices
      - All payments
      - Tax forms
      - Transaction ledger
    - Export as ZIP

15. **Tax advisory content:**
    - Tax center includes educational resources
    - Links to IRS publications
    - "Estimated tax calculator"
    - "Tax deductions for freelancers" guide

#### Notifications

**Tax Profile Required:**
- **Email:** "Please complete your tax profile to continue earning"
- **Push:** "Tax information needed"

**W-9 Submitted:**
- **Email:** "W-9 form received and verified - confirmation attached"

**1099 Available:**
- **Email (Jan 31):** "Your 2024 1099-NEC is ready - download now"
- **Push:** "Tax form available"

**Tax Withholding Applied:**
- **Email (per payment):** "Payment processed: $700 net after $300 tax withholding"

**W-8BEN Expiring:**
- **Email (30 days before):** "Your W-8BEN expires soon. Please resubmit."

**Backup Withholding Activated:**
- **Email:** "Backup withholding (24%) is now in effect. Update your tax information."

#### Analytics

- tax_profile.created (user_country, tax_id_type, vat_registered)
- tax_profile.updated (updated_fields[], update_reason)
- w9.submitted (submission_method, previously_submitted)
- w9.verified (verification_time_days)
- w9.rejected (rejection_reason)
- w8ben.submitted (treaty_claimed, treaty_country, treaty_rate)
- w8ben.verified (verification_time_days)
- w8ben.expiring_soon (days_until_expiry)
- form_1099.generated (tax_year, earnings_amount, recipient_count)
- form_1099.delivered (delivery_method, recipient_id)
- form_1099.downloaded (tax_year, download_date)
- form_1099.corrected (correction_reason, original_amount, corrected_amount)
- tax_withholding.calculated (payment_id, withholding_rate, withholding_amount)
- tax_withholding.remitted (remittance_amount, tax_authority, remittance_date)
- backup_withholding.activated (activation_reason, affected_user_id)
- tax_report.generated (report_type, tax_year, report_format)
- tax_report.downloaded (report_type, download_date)
- tin_verification.requested (tin_type, verification_status)
- tin_verification.failed (failure_reason, retry_available)

#### Sources

**Backend:** financial-be.user-stories.md (Tax domain), users-be.user-stories.md (Compliance/Tax Profile)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/financial/tax routes), hooks/use-tax.ts, components/tax-forms/

## FIN-5 — Connects Purchase & Balance

**Persona:** Freelancer  
**Preconditions:** Freelancer account with verified payment method  
**Triggers:** Running low on connects, need to submit proposals, subscription renewal

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/financial/connects` — Connects overview and balance
- `(dashboard)/financial/connects/purchase` — Purchase connects
- `(dashboard)/financial/connects/transactions` — Transaction history

**Mobile:**
- `financial/connects` — Connects overview
- `financial/connects/purchase` — Purchase screen
- `financial/connects/history` — Usage history

#### System Touchpoints

- **subscriptions-be:** Connect packages, balance, purchases, transactions
- **financial-be:** Payment processing for connect purchases
- **proposals-be:** Connect reservation and consumption
- **notifications-be:** Low balance alerts, purchase confirmations

#### Flow Steps

1. **View balance:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/connects`
   - Display:
     - Current balance (available + reserved)
     - Available connects
     - Reserved connects (pending proposals)
     - Monthly grant from subscription
     - Next grant date
     - Usage summary (this month, last 30 days)
   - BE: `GET /v1/connects/balance`

2. **View packages:**
   - Click "Purchase Connects"
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/connects/purchase`
   - Display package options:
     - **Starter:** 10 connects — $14.99 (most popular for beginners)
     - **Value:** 40 connects + 10 bonus — $49.99 (17% savings)
     - **Professional:** 80 connects + 20 bonus — $99.99 (best value, 25% savings)
     - **Ultimate:** 200 connects + 80 bonus — $249.99 (33% savings, recommended for agencies)
   - Each package shows:
     - Connect count + bonus
     - Total price
     - Price per connect
     - Savings percentage
     - Validity period (12 months)
   - BE: `GET /v1/connects/packages`

3. **Select package:**
   - Click on package card
   - Review selection:
     - Package name and connects
     - Price breakdown
     - Payment method (default card)
     - Terms: "Connects expire 12 months from purchase"
   - Apply promo code (optional)
   - Click "Purchase"

4. **Process payment:**
   - BE: `POST /v1/connects/purchase`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "package_id": "uuid",
       "payment_method_id": "uuid",
       "promo_code": "CONNECT20",
       "idempotency_key": "uuid"
     }
     ```
   - Process payment via financial-be
   - Add connects to balance
   - Create transaction record
   - Publish event: `connects.purchased.v1`

5. **Confirmation:**
   - Success message: "Purchase complete! 50 connects added to your account"
   - Display:
     - New balance
     - Amount charged
     - Receipt link
     - Expiry date (12 months from now)
   - Email receipt
   - Push notification

6. **View transaction history:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/financial/connects/transactions`
   - Display ledger:
     - Date
     - Type (Purchase, Grant, Usage, Refund, Expiration)
     - Amount (+/- connects)
     - Balance after
     - Reference (proposal ID for usage, package for purchase)
     - Status
   - Filters:
     - Date range
     - Transaction type
     - Amount range
   - Export CSV
   - BE: `GET /v1/connects/transactions?page=1&limit=50&type=PURCHASE`

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Insufficient funds:**
   - Payment method declined
   - Error: "Payment failed. Please update your payment method."
   - Redirect to add/update payment method
   - Retry purchase

2. **Low balance warning:**
   - Available connects ≤ 10
   - Banner on dashboard: "You're running low on connects. Purchase more to keep submitting proposals."
   - Email notification
   - Push notification
   - Badge on connects icon

3. **Depleted balance:**
   - Available connects = 0
   - Block proposal submission
   - Modal: "You need connects to submit proposals. Purchase now to continue."
   - Direct link to purchase page
   - Email: "Your connects balance is zero"

4. **Monthly grant:**
   - Subscription includes monthly grant (e.g., 50 connects/month for Pro plan)
   - Auto-allocated on billing date
   - Notification: "Your monthly 50 connects have been added"
   - Grant visible in transaction history
   - Type: `GRANT`, Source: `SUBSCRIPTION`

5. **Connect reservation:**
   - On proposal submit, reserve connects
   - Available decreases, reserved increases
   - If proposal accepted/rejected/withdrawn, release reservation
   - Consumed only when proposal is shortlisted or after 24 hours
   - Display reserved count separately

6. **Connect refund:**
   - Proposal rejected within 24 hours
   - Job closed before shortlisting
   - Job marked as spam
   - Auto-refund connects
   - Notification: "1 connect refunded for job #12345"
   - Transaction type: `REFUND`

7. **Connect expiry:**
   - Connects purchased more than 12 months ago expire
   - Batch job runs nightly
   - Expire oldest connects first (FIFO)
   - Notification 30 days before expiry: "20 connects will expire on Dec 31"
   - Email 7 days before expiry
   - On expiry: Deduct from balance, create expiration transaction
   - Type: `EXPIRATION`

8. **Promo code:**
   - Apply promo code at checkout
   - Validate:
     - Code exists and active
     - Not expired
     - User eligible
     - Usage limit not exceeded
   - Discount types:
     - Percentage off (e.g., 20% off)
     - Fixed amount (e.g., $10 off)
     - Bonus connects (e.g., buy 50 get 10 free)
   - Show savings: "You saved $9.99"

9. **Bundle recommendations:**
   - Based on usage patterns
   - If user buys 10 connects frequently, suggest Value pack
   - "You've purchased 30 connects this month. Save 17% with the Value pack!"

10. **Connect usage analytics:**
    - Average usage per proposal
    - Connect efficiency (proposals accepted / connects spent)
    - Monthly trend
    - Burn rate projection
    - Recommendation: "At current rate, you'll need to recharge in 15 days"

11. **Gifted connects:**
    - Admin can grant connects
    - Reasons: compensation, promotion, bonus
    - Transaction type: `ADMIN_ADJUSTMENT`
    - Email: "You've been granted 20 connects as a thank you!"

12. **Subscription tier benefits:**
    - Display included connects per tier
    - Free: 0/month
    - Basic: 10/month
    - Plus: 30/month
    - Pro: 50/month
    - Show upgrade CTA if on lower tier

13. **Connect transfer (future):**
    - Agency/team accounts
    - Transfer connects between team members
    - Requires approval
    - Audit log

14. **Bulk purchase discount:**
    - For agencies/high-volume users
    - Custom packages > 200 connects
    - Contact sales for pricing
    - Link: "Need more? Contact us for bulk discounts"

15. **Connect rollover:**
    - Monthly grants do NOT roll over
    - Purchased connects do NOT roll over beyond 12 months
    - Clear messaging on purchase screen

#### Notifications

**Low Balance Warning:**
- **Email:** "You have 8 connects left. Purchase more to continue submitting proposals."
- **Push:** "Running low on connects"
- **Banner:** Persistent dashboard banner

**Depleted Balance:**
- **Email:** "Your connects balance is zero. Purchase now to submit proposals."
- **Push:** "You're out of connects!"
- **Modal:** Blocking modal on proposal submit

**Purchase Confirmation:**
- **Email:** "Purchase confirmed: 50 connects added. Receipt attached."
- **Push:** "50 connects added to your account"

**Monthly Grant:**
- **Email:** "Your monthly 50 connects have been added"
- **Push:** "Monthly connects granted"

**Expiring Soon:**
- **Email (30 days):** "20 of your connects will expire on Dec 31. Use them before they're gone!"
- **Email (7 days):** "Final reminder: 20 connects expiring in 7 days"
- **Push (7 days):** "Connects expiring soon"

**Connect Refund:**
- **Email:** "1 connect refunded for job #12345"
- **In-app:** Transaction notification

#### Analytics

- connect.balance.viewed (available_count, reserved_count, low_balance)
- connect.package.viewed (package_id, package_tier)
- connect.purchase.initiated (package_id, amount, has_promo)
- connect.purchase.completed (package_id, amount, payment_method, discount_applied)
- connect.purchase.failed (package_id, failure_reason)
- connect.reserved (proposal_id, amount_reserved)
- connect.consumed (proposal_id, amount_consumed, balance_after)
- connect.refunded (proposal_id, refund_reason, amount_refunded)
- connect.expired (amount_expired, expiry_date)
- connect.granted (grant_reason, amount_granted, granted_by)
- connect.low_balance.warning (threshold_reached, balance)
- connect.depleted (proposal_blocked)
- connect.transactions.viewed (filter_type, date_range)
- connect.promo_code.applied (promo_code, discount_amount)

#### Sources

**Backend:** subscriptions-be.user-stories.md (Connects domain), proposals-be.user-stories.md (Connect reservation/consumption), financial-be.user-stories.md (Payment processing)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/financial/connects routes), hooks/use-connects.ts, components/connects/
