### REV-3 — Reputation Score & Badges

**Persona:** Freelancer OR Client  
**ID:** REV-3  
**Feature Epic:** Reviews & Reputation  
**Description:** User views their reputation score, understands how it's calculated, sees badge awards/revocations, and tracks reputation history over time.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- User has published reviews (received)
- Reputation score has been calculated (automatic after first review)
- User is authenticated

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/reputation` - Reputation dashboard
- `(dashboard)/reputation/history` - Score history (timeline)
- `(dashboard)/reputation/badges` - Earned badges
- `(dashboard)/profile` - Public profile (displays reputation & badges)
- `(dashboard)/reputation/insights` - Detailed breakdown & recommendations

**Mobile Routes:**
- `(tabs)/(profile)` - Profile with reputation summary
- `(tabs)/(reputation)` - Reputation dashboard
- `(tabs)/(reputation)/history` - History timeline
- `(tabs)/(reputation)/badges` - Badge collection

#### System Touchpoints
- **reviews-be:** GetReputationQuery, GetReputationHistoryQuery, GetReputationComponentsQuery, GetUserBadgesQuery, CheckBadgeEligibilityQuery
- **users-be:** GetUserProfileQuery
- **rating-be:** GetRatingAggregatesQuery (from reviews-be)

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: View Reputation Dashboard**
- User navigates to "Reputation" from main nav or profile
- Display hero section:
  - **Overall Reputation Score:** Large prominent number (e.g., "87.5")
  - Visual progress bar (0-100 scale)
  - Percentile ranking: "Top 15% on Skillsier"
  - Trend indicator: "+2.3 this month" with up/down arrow
  - Badge showcase: Display up to 3 primary badges
  - Quick stats: "Based on 42 reviews"

**Step 2: Understand Score Components**
- Expandable section: "How is my score calculated?"
- Breakdown into components:
  - **Rating Component (60%):** Average from multi-dimensional ratings
    - Show: "4.7 / 5.0 stars"
    - Impact: "+56.4 points"
  - **Volume Component (20%):** Number of reviews + recency
    - Show: "42 reviews (15 in last 90 days)"
    - Impact: "+18.2 points"
  - **Recency Component (15%):** Recent positive reviews boost
    - Show: "3 recent 5-star reviews"
    - Impact: "+12.9 points"
  - **Consistency Component (5%):** Low variance in ratings
    - Show: "Variance: 0.2 (excellent consistency)"
    - Impact: "+4.0 points"
- Interactive sliders/charts to visualize each component

**Step 3: View Reputation History**
- Timeline chart showing score changes over time (line graph)
- X-axis: Time (months)
- Y-axis: Reputation score (0-100)
- Hover over data points to see:
  - Date
  - Score at that time
  - Event that caused change: "New 5-star review" or "Badge awarded"
- Filters:
  - Last 30 days, 6 months, 1 year, All time
  - Show events: Reviews, Badges, Milestones

**Step 4: View Earned Badges**
- "Badges" section displaying all earned badges
- Each badge card shows:
  - Badge icon (visual)
  - Badge name: "Top Rated", "Rising Talent", "Expert Verified"
  - Badge level: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum
  - Earned date: "Earned on Jan 15, 2025"
  - Criteria met: "Awarded for 50+ reviews with 4.8+ average rating"
  - Expiry (if temporary): "Renews every 6 months"
  - Status: Active, Expired, Revoked
- Badge categories:
  - **Performance:** Top Rated, 100% Job Success
  - **Achievement:** Rising Talent, Veteran Freelancer
  - **Verification:** Expert Vetted, Identity Verified
  - **Engagement:** Responsive (replies within 24h), High Availability

**Step 5: Badge Eligibility Tracking**
- "Progress to Next Badge" section
- Show badges user is close to earning:
  - Badge name + level
  - Progress bar: "75% to Gold Top Rated"
  - Criteria remaining: "Need 10 more reviews with 4.8+ rating"
  - Estimated time: "On track to earn in 2 months"
  - CTA: "Learn how to improve"

**Step 6: Reputation Insights & Recommendations**
- "Improve Your Reputation" section
- AI-powered recommendations:
  - "Respond to all reviews to boost engagement"
  - "Aim for 5 more reviews this month to improve volume component"
  - "Maintain consistent quality to protect your score"
- Links to actionable steps:
  - "View unanswered reviews" (list of reviews without responses)
  - "Request reviews from past clients" (bulk reminder tool)
  - "Complete profile to earn badges" (profile completion %)

**Step 7: Public Profile Display**
- Visit own public profile to see how reputation displays to others
- Badge carousel on profile header
- Reputation score visible (unless user hides it - rare option)
- "Top Rated" badge highlighted prominently
- Reviews section integrated with reputation context

**Step 8: Share Reputation & Badges**
- "Share" button on reputation dashboard
- Options:
  - Share on social media (LinkedIn, Twitter)
  - Generate shareable link: "View my Skillsier reputation"
  - Embed badge on external website (widget code)
  - Download badge images (PNG, SVG)

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: New User (No Reputation Yet)**
- Empty state: "Your reputation score will appear after you receive your first review"
- Show default score: "Start at 50.0 (platform baseline)"
- CTA: "Complete your first job to get reviewed!"

**B2: Low Reputation Score (<40)**
- Warning message: "Your reputation is below average. Focus on quality to improve."
- Highlight: "Low scores may affect job opportunities"
- Link to: "Tips to improve your reputation"
- Recommendations:
  - Improve communication
  - Deliver on time
  - Request feedback mid-project

**B3: Reputation Dropped Significantly**
- Alert: "Your reputation dropped by 10 points this month"
- Show cause: "Recent 2-star review" (link to review)
- Suggestion: "Respond to the review to provide context"
- Encourage learning: "View similar cases and how others improved"

**B4: Badge Revoked**
- Notification: "Your [Badge Name] badge was revoked"
- Reason: "Criteria no longer met (rating dropped below 4.7)"
- Display: Badge shown in "Expired" state with strikethrough
- Path to re-earn: "Maintain 4.8+ rating for 30 days to re-earn"

**B5: Badge Renewed**
- For temporary badges (e.g., Top Rated renews every 6 months):
  - Auto-check eligibility 7 days before expiry
  - If eligible: Auto-renew and notify
  - If not eligible: Notify user 7 days early: "Your Top Rated badge expires in 7 days. You need 5 more reviews to renew."

**B6: Badge Level Upgrade**
- User earns higher level of existing badge (e.g., Bronze → Silver Top Rated)
- Celebration notification: "Congratulations! You've upgraded to Silver Top Rated!"
- Confetti animation (optional)
- Share prompt: "Share your achievement"

**B7: Reputation Plateau**
- If score hasn't changed in 3+ months:
  - Insight: "Your reputation has been stable. Aim for 10 more reviews to boost further."
  - Suggest: "Take on new projects to gain more reviews"

**B8: Reputation Frozen (Dispute/Investigation)**
- If under investigation for fake reviews:
  - Show: "Reputation calculation paused pending review"
  - Explanation: "We're investigating unusual activity. This typically resolves in 5-7 days."
  - Hide public score during freeze

**B9: Appeal Badge Revocation**
- "Appeal" button on revoked badge
- Form to explain why badge should be reinstated
- Admin reviews appeal within 5 business days
- Outcome notification sent via email

**B10: Reputation Export**
- "Export Report" button
- Generate PDF with:
  - Current score + historical chart
  - All badges earned
  - Review summary
  - Dimensional ratings breakdown
- Useful for portfolio or external profiles

**B11: Compare to Platform Average**
- Toggle: "Compare to Average" (on reputation dashboard)
- Show platform avg: "Platform average: 72.3"
- Comparison: "You're 15.2 points above average"

**B12: Reputation Privacy Settings**
- User can hide reputation score from public profile (rare)
- Badges always visible (cannot be hidden)
- Warning: "Hiding your score may reduce trust with clients"

**B13: Bayesian Prior Explanation**
- Tooltip: "What is Bayesian adjustment?"
- Explanation: "New users start at 50.0 (platform baseline). Your score adjusts as you receive reviews."
- Benefit: "Prevents unfair penalties for users with few reviews"

**B14: Time Decay Impact**
- Show: "Reviews older than 2 years have reduced weight"
- Chart: Weight decay curve over time
- Explanation: "Recent performance matters more"

**B15: Outlier Handling**
- If user has one very low review among many high reviews:
  - System applies outlier dampening
  - Tooltip: "Outlier reviews have reduced impact"
  - Show: "1 outlier review excluded from calculation"

**B16: Reputation Recalculation Frequency**
- Updated: Every 24 hours (nightly job)
- Real-time for new reviews: Score updates within 5 minutes of review publish
- Manual recalc button: "Refresh Now" (rate-limited to once per hour)

**B17: Top Rated Eligibility Rules**
- Display: "Top Rated" criteria:
  - Min 50 reviews
  - Min 4.7 average rating
  - Min 10 reviews in last 90 days
  - Max variance: 0.3
  - Consistency: 95%+ positive reviews
- Progress bar for each criterion

**B18: Badge Catalog Browsing**
- "Browse All Badges" link
- View all available badges (earned + unearned)
- Filter by category, level, status
- "Locked" badges show requirements to unlock

**B19: Gamification Elements**
- Achievements unlocked: "First 10 Reviews", "Perfect Month", "Top 10% Reputation"
- Leaderboard (optional): "See where you rank"
- Streak tracker: "20-day streak of 5-star reviews"

**B20: Mobile Badge Widgets**
- On mobile profile: Badge carousel (swipeable)
- Tap badge to see details and share
- Long-press to view badge history (awards/revocations)

**B21: Reputation API Access (Future)**
- Developer: Can fetch own reputation via API
- Use case: Display on personal website or portfolio
- API key required, rate-limited

**B22: Historical Data Retention**
- Reputation history retained indefinitely
- Older than 5 years: Archived but accessible
- User can download full history anytime

**B23: Badge Expiry Countdown**
- For temporary badges: Show "Renews in 14 days"
- Reminder 7 days before expiry
- If not renewed: Badge moves to "Expired" but remains visible with date

**B24: Reputation Consistency Variance**
- Show variance metric: "0.2 (excellent)"
- Explanation: "Low variance means consistent quality"
- If high variance: "Your ratings vary widely. Aim for more consistency."

**B25: Badge Sharing Tracking**
- Analytics on badge shares (social, embed, download)
- Show: "Your Top Rated badge has been shared 15 times"

#### Notifications

**Reputation Score Updated:**
- **Email (monthly digest):** "Your reputation score: 87.5 (+2.3 this month)"
- **Push (significant change only):** "Your reputation dropped by 5 points"
- **In-app:** "New reputation score calculated"

**Badge Awarded:**
- **Email:** "Congratulations! You've earned the [Badge Name] badge!"
- **Push:** "You unlocked a new badge: [Badge Name]!"
- **In-app:** Badge award modal with confetti animation

**Badge Revoked:**
- **Email:** "Your [Badge Name] badge was revoked. [Reason] Here's how to re-earn it."
- **Push:** "Badge revoked: [Badge Name]"
- **In-app:** "Badge status changed" notification

**Badge Expiring Soon:**
- **Email (7 days before):** "Your [Badge Name] badge expires in 7 days. Here's how to renew."
- **Push:** "Badge expiring soon"

**Badge Renewed:**
- **Email:** "Your [Badge Name] badge has been renewed!"
- **In-app:** "Badge renewed ✓"

**Top Rated Eligibility Met:**
- **Email:** "You're now eligible for Top Rated! Claim your badge."
- **Push:** "You earned Top Rated status!"
- **In-app:** "New badge available: Top Rated"

**Reputation Milestone:**
- **Email:** "Milestone reached: Top 10% reputation on Skillsier!"
- **Push:** "You're in the top 10%!"
- **In-app:** Achievement unlocked notification

#### Analytics

- reputation.dashboard.viewed
- reputation.components.expanded (component_name)
- reputation.history.viewed (time_range)
- reputation.insights.viewed

- badge.progress.viewed (badge_id)
- badge.shared (badge_id, share_platform)
- badge.appeal.submitted (badge_id, appeal_reason)

### REV-4 — Helpful Votes & Featured Reviews

**Persona:** Platform Users (Clients, Freelancers, Public)  
**ID:** REV-4  
**Feature Epic:** Reviews & Reputation  
**Description:** Users can vote reviews as helpful, change votes within 24h, and admins can feature high-quality reviews for prominent display.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- User is viewing published reviews (on profiles or job postings)
- Reviews are publicly visible

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/reviews/[id]` - Review detail with helpful vote buttons
- `(dashboard)/profile/[user-id]` - User profile showing reviews with votes
- `(dashboard)/jobs/[id]` - Job post showing freelancer reviews
- `(dashboard)/reviews/featured` - Featured reviews showcase

**Mobile Routes:**
- `(tabs)/(reviews)/[id]` - Review detail
- `(tabs)/(profile)/[user-id]` - Profile with reviews
- `(tabs)/(jobs)/[id]` - Job with reviews

#### System Touchpoints
- **reviews-be:** VoteHelpfulCommand, ChangeHelpfulVoteCommand, GetReviewQuery, FeaturedReviewsQuery, FeatureReviewCommand (admin)
- **users-be:** GetUserProfileQuery

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: View Review with Helpful Vote Option**
- User reads a published review on any profile or job post
- Below review text, display:
  - "Was this review helpful?"
  - Two buttons: "👍 Yes" and "👎 No"
  - Vote count: "25 of 30 found this helpful"
  - Percentage: "(83%)"

**Step 2: Cast Helpful Vote**
- User clicks "👍 Yes" or "👎 No"
- Button highlights (filled color)
- Vote count updates immediately (optimistic UI)
- Backend records vote with user_id, review_id, vote_type
- Toast notification: "Thanks for your feedback!"

**Step 3: Change Vote (Within 24 Hours)**
- User can click opposite button to change vote
- Example: Voted "Yes" → clicks "No" → vote changes
- Confirmation modal: "Change your vote to 'Not Helpful'?"
- Vote count updates
- After 24 hours: Buttons disabled, vote locked
- Message: "You voted this helpful" (no change option)

**Step 4: View Helpful Vote Insights (Review Owner)**
- Review owner sees: "Your review was marked helpful by 25 people"
- Helpful percentage: "83% helpful rating"
- Insight: "High-quality reviews boost your reputation"

**Step 5: Featured Reviews (Admin)**
- Admin selects high-quality reviews for featuring
- **Admin Panel:** Featured Reviews Management
  - Search reviews by user, rating, helpful votes
  - Preview review
  - Click "Feature Review" button
  - Select category: "Top Quality", "Client Praise", "Detailed Feedback"
  - Set placement: Homepage, Profile Highlight, Category Page
  - Set expiry: 7 days, 30 days, or No Expiry
  - Optionally pin to top of profile

**Step 6: Featured Review Display (Public)**
- Featured reviews displayed prominently:
  - **Homepage:** "Featured Success Stories" carousel
  - **Profile:** "Highlighted Review" section at top
  - **Category Pages:** "What Clients Say" section
- Badge: "⭐ Featured Review" on review card
- Featured reviews have higher visibility in search results

**Step 7: Featured Review Analytics (Admin)**
- Dashboard showing featured review performance:
  - Impressions: How many times viewed
  - Clicks: How many times profile clicked from featured review
  - Helpful votes: Votes received while featured
  - Conversions: Jobs/hires influenced by featured review (if trackable)

**Step 8: Unfeature Review (Admin or Auto-Expiry)**
- Admin can manually unfeature review anytime
- Auto-expiry: After set duration, review automatically unfeatured
- Notification to review owner: "Your review was featured and has expired"

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: User Not Authenticated**
- Guest users see vote counts but cannot vote
- Hover over vote button: Tooltip "Sign in to vote"
- Clicking button redirects to login

**B2: User Votes on Own Review**
- Block: Cannot vote on reviews you wrote
- Button disabled with tooltip: "You cannot vote on your own review"

**B3: User Votes on Review They Received**
- Allow: Review owners CAN vote on reviews about them
- No restrictions (honest feedback welcomed)

**B4: Vote Locked After 24 Hours**
- Buttons disabled, grayed out
- Tooltip: "Vote locked after 24 hours"
- Display: "You voted this helpful on [date]"

**B5: Change Vote Multiple Times Within 24h**
- User can toggle vote Yes → No → Yes → No unlimited times
- Each change tracked (final vote at 24h cutoff is recorded)
- Rate limit: Max 5 changes per 10 minutes (prevent spam)

**B6: Helpful Vote Count Zero**
- Display: "Be the first to find this helpful!"
- Encourages first vote

**B7: Negative Helpful Ratio (<30%)**
- If review has low helpful percentage (e.g., 5 of 20 found helpful = 25%):
  - Badge: "Few found this helpful"
  - May be deprioritized in display order

**B8: High Helpful Ratio (>90%)**
- Badge: "Most found this helpful"
- Boost in display order (algorithm prioritization)

**B9: Featured Review Already Featured**
- Admin tries to feature already-featured review:
  - Warning: "This review is already featured in [category]"
  - Option: "Update placement or category"

**B10: Featured Review Expired**
- Auto-expiry triggers
  - Remove "Featured" badge
  - Revert to normal display order
  - Notify admin (optional)

**B11: Featured Review Owner Deleted Account**
- Featured review remains visible (anonymized)
- Show: "Former User" as author
- Featured badge remains

**B12: Featured Review Flagged/Moderated**
- If featured review is flagged for policy violation:
  - Auto-unfeature immediately
  - Move to moderation queue
  - Notify admin

**B13: User Tries to Vote on Deleted Review**
- Review removed: Vote buttons disappear
- If user previously voted: Show "This review is no longer available"

**B14: Spam Voting Prevention**
- Rate limit: Max 50 votes per hour per user
- If exceeded: "You're voting too quickly. Try again later."
- Suspicious patterns (e.g., voting on all reviews by one user): Flag for review

**B15: Bot Detection**
- CAPTCHA for rapid voting
- Honeypot fields on vote form
- IP-based rate limiting

**B16: Featured Review Selection Criteria**
- Admin guidance: Feature reviews that are:
  - Detailed (>200 characters)
  - High rating (4+ stars)
  - High helpful votes (>80%)
  - Recent (< 6 months old)
  - Diverse (represent different user types/categories)

**B17: Featured Review Rotation**
- Homepage carousel rotates featured reviews every 5 seconds
- User can manually navigate with arrows
- Click review to view full detail + profile

**B18: Featured Review Quota**
- Max 10 featured reviews per category at a time
- If admin tries to feature 11th: "Unfeature an existing review first"

**B19: Featured Review Notification to Owner**
- Email: "Your review has been featured on Skillsier!"
- Includes: Category, placement, expiry date
- CTA: "View featured review"

**B20: Featured Review Public API**
- Public endpoint: /api/v1/featured-reviews
- Returns list of currently featured reviews
- Used for embedding on external sites or partner platforms

**B21: Helpful Vote Breakdown (Admin)**
- Admin sees full vote breakdown:
  - Total votes
  - Helpful vs. Not Helpful ratio
  - Vote trends over time
  - Geographic distribution (optional)

**B22: Anonymous Voting**
- Votes are anonymous to review owner
- Owner sees count but not who voted
- Admin can see voter IDs (for abuse investigation)

**B23: Featured Review Badge on Profile**
- Profile displays: "X Featured Reviews" badge
- Clicking shows all featured reviews by that user

**B24: Mobile Swipe to Vote**
- Mobile UI: Swipe right on review card to vote "Helpful"
- Swipe left to vote "Not Helpful"
- Haptic feedback on vote

**B25: Featured Review Analytics Export**
- Admin can export featured review performance data
- CSV format with: Review ID, Category, Impressions, Clicks, Conversions, Helpful votes

#### Notifications

**Review Featured:**
- **Email (review owner):** "Your review has been featured! [Category] It will be displayed for [duration]."
- **In-app:** "Your review is now featured ⭐"

**Review Unfeatured:**
- **Email (review owner):** "Your featured review has expired. Thanks for sharing quality feedback!"
- **In-app:** "Featured review expired"

**Helpful Vote Milestone:**
- **Email (review owner, at 10, 50, 100 votes):** "Milestone: Your review has been marked helpful by 50 people!"
- **In-app:** "Your review reached 50 helpful votes!"

**High Helpful Ratio:**
- **Email (review owner, if >90% helpful):** "Your review has a 95% helpful rating - great work!"

#### Analytics

- review.helpful.vote.cast (review_id, vote_type, voter_type)
- review.helpful.vote.changed (review_id, old_vote, new_vote, time_since_original)
- review.helpful.vote.locked (review_id, final_vote)
- review.helpful.percentage.calculated (review_id, helpful_percentage)
- review.featured (review_id, category, placement, duration)
- review.unfeatured (review_id, reason, time_featured_days)
- featured.review.viewed (review_id, viewer_type, placement)
- featured.review.clicked (review_id, placement, conversion_type)
- featured.review.carousel.navigated (direction, review_id)
- review.helpful.milestone.reached (review_id, milestone_count)
- review.helpful.spam.detected (user_id, vote_count_per_hour)
- review.helpful.api.accessed (endpoint, request_count)
- featured.review.analytics.exported (date_range, review_count)

#### Sources

**Backend:** reviews-be.user-stories.md (Helpful votes domain, Featured reviews domain, Review display, Admin tools)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/reviews routes), hooks/use-helpful-vote.ts, hooks/use-featured-reviews.ts, components/review/helpful-vote-buttons/, components/review/featured-badge/

### REV-5 — Flag & Moderate Reviews

**Persona:** Platform Users (Flagging), Admins & Moderators (Moderation)  
**ID:** REV-5  
**Feature Epic:** Reviews & Reputation (Safety & Governance)  
**Description:** Users can flag reviews for policy violations, and moderators review flagged content, apply moderation states, handle appeals, and maintain safety.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- User encounters a review that violates guidelines
- Review is publicly visible
- Moderator has appropriate permissions

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes (User):**
- `(dashboard)/reviews/[id]` - Review detail with "Report" button
- `(dashboard)/reviews/flag/[id]` - Flag submission form

**Web Routes (Admin/Moderator):**
- `(admin)/moderation/reviews/queue` - Moderation queue
- `(admin)/moderation/reviews/[id]` - Review moderation detail
- `(admin)/moderation/reviews/history` - Moderation history
- `(admin)/moderation/appeals/queue` - Appeal queue
- `(admin)/moderation/appeals/[id]` - Appeal detail

**Mobile Routes (User):**
- `(tabs)/(reviews)/[id]` - Review with report option
- `(tabs)/(reviews)/flag/[id]` - Flag form modal

#### System Touchpoints
- **reviews-be:** FlagReviewCommand, AutoFlagReviewCommand, GetFlagQuery, ListFlagsQuery, ApplyModerationStateCommand, LiftModerationCommand, SubmitAppealCommand, ResolveAppealCommand, GetModerationHistoryQuery
- **users-be:** GetUserProfileQuery
- **admin-be:** GetModeratorPermissionsQuery
- **communications-be:** SendModerationNotification

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path - User Flagging)

**Step 1: User Identifies Violating Review**
- User reads review that contains inappropriate content
- Examples: Spam, personal attacks, discriminatory language, fake review, PII exposure

**Step 2: Access Flag Form**
- Click "Report" button (flag icon) below review
- Modal or dedicated page opens: "Report This Review"
- Show review context (excerpt) for reference

**Step 3: Select Flag Reason**
- Dropdown or radio buttons with predefined reasons:
  - **Spam or Fake** - Review appears to be fake or spam
  - **Inappropriate Language** - Contains profanity, insults, or personal attacks
  - **Discriminatory Content** - Contains hate speech or discrimination
  - **Unrelated to Work** - Review is not about work performed
  - **Personal Information (PII)** - Contains private contact info or sensitive data
  - **Harassment or Threats** - Contains threatening language
  - **Other** - Specify below
- If "Other" selected: Text field for explanation (required)

**Step 4: Provide Additional Details**
- Text area: "Please explain why you're reporting this review"
- Max 500 characters
- Optional: Upload evidence (screenshots, files) - max 3 files, 5MB each
- Checkbox: "I confirm this report is made in good faith"

**Step 5: Submit Flag**
- Click "Submit Report"
- Confirmation: "Thank you. We'll review this within 24-48 hours."
- Review goes into moderation queue with priority based on reason:
  - **Critical:** Threats, harassment, discriminatory content
  - **High:** PII, inappropriate language
  - **Normal:** Spam, unrelated content
- User receives email confirmation

**Step 6: Wait for Moderation Decision**
- User notified when decision is made (typically 24-48h)
- Possible outcomes:
  - **Flag Upheld:** Review removed or moderated
  - **Flag Dismissed:** Review remains, no policy violation found
  - **Partial Action:** Review edited/redacted but not removed

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path - Moderator Review)

**Step 7: Moderator Accesses Queue**
- Moderator logs into admin panel
- Navigate to "Moderation Queue" → "Reviews"
- View list of flagged reviews sorted by:
  - Priority: Critical, High, Normal
  - Date: Oldest first
  - Auto-flagged: AI-detected violations (highlighted)
- Filter options: Flag reason, priority, date range, moderator assigned

**Step 8: Review Flagged Content**
- Click on flagged review to open detail view
- Display:
  - Full review text
  - All dimension ratings
  - Flag reason(s) - may have multiple flags from different users
  - Flagger count: "3 users reported this review"
  - AI confidence score (if auto-flagged): "95% confidence - profanity detected"
  - Flagged phrases highlighted in review text
  - Review history: Previous versions (if edited)
  - User context: Reviewer's other reviews, reputation score, account age
  - Reviewee context: Profile, reviews received, disputes

**Step 9: Make Moderation Decision**
- Moderator selects action from dropdown:
  - **Dismiss Flag** - No policy violation found
  - **Redact PII** - Auto-redact sensitive info only
  - **Quarantine Review** - Hide temporarily pending further investigation
  - **Limit Visibility** - Show only to contract parties, not public
  - **Remove Review** - Permanent deletion (severe violations only)
  - **Suspend Reviewer** - Take action on user account (escalate to admin-be)
- Add reason (required): Text field explaining decision
- Attach internal notes (optional, not visible to users)
- Click "Apply Action"

**Step 10: Notify Users**
- **If Flag Upheld (Review Removed):**
  - Email to reviewer: "Your review was removed for violating guidelines. [Reason] You may appeal within 7 days."
  - Email to reviewee: "A review about you was removed after investigation."
  - Email to flagger: "Thank you for reporting. Action has been taken."
- **If Flag Dismissed:**
  - Email to flagger: "After review, no policy violation found. Review remains active."
  - No notification to reviewer/reviewee

**Step 11: Log Moderation Action**
- All actions logged in append-only moderation history
- Record includes:
  - Moderator ID
  - Action taken
  - Reason
  - Timestamp
  - Review snapshot (before/after)
  - Hash chain for immutability

**Step 12: Monitor Post-Moderation**
- Track:
  - Appeal submissions (if user appeals removal)
  - Repeat offenses (if same user flagged again)
  - False flag patterns (if flagger reports many valid reviews)

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path - Appeal)

**Step 13: User Appeals Moderation Decision**
- If review was removed, reviewer receives email with "Appeal" link
- User clicks appeal link → Opens appeal form
- Appeal deadline: 7 days from notification
- Form fields:
  - Reason for appeal (text area, max 1000 characters)
  - Upload evidence (optional) - max 3 files
  - Checkbox: "I confirm I have read the review guidelines"

**Step 14: Submit Appeal**
- Click "Submit Appeal"
- Confirmation: "Your appeal has been submitted. Typical response time: 3-5 business days."
- Appeal enters appeal queue (separate from flag queue)

**Step 15: Moderator Reviews Appeal**
- Senior moderator or admin reviews appeal
- Access: Admin Panel → Appeals Queue
- Display:
  - Original review
  - Moderation decision and reason
  - Appeal reason
  - Evidence uploaded
  - Moderation history for this review
- Decision options:
  - **Approve Appeal:** Restore review (undo removal)
  - **Deny Appeal:** Uphold original decision
  - **Partial Reinstatement:** Restore with edits/redactions

**Step 16: Notify Appeal Outcome**
- **If Approved:**
  - Email to reviewer: "Your appeal was approved. Your review has been restored."
  - Email to reviewee: "A review about you has been reinstated after appeal."
  - Review goes live again
- **If Denied:**
  - Email to reviewer: "Your appeal was denied. [Reason] This decision is final."

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: User Already Flagged This Review**
- Block duplicate flags from same user
- Message: "You've already reported this review. We're reviewing it."
- Show status: "Under review"

**B2: Review Already Removed**
- If review was removed before user flags:
  - Message: "This review is no longer available"
  - No flag submission option

**B3: Auto-Flagging by AI**
- System automatically flags reviews containing:
  - Profanity (regex + ML model)
  - PII patterns (phone, email, address)
  - Hate speech keywords
  - Spam indicators (repeated text, external links)
- Auto-flagged reviews bypass flag form, go straight to queue
- High confidence (>95%): Auto-quarantine immediately, human review required
- Medium confidence (70-95%): Queue for review but remain public
- Low confidence (<70%): Log but no action

**B4: Multiple Users Flag Same Review**
- Aggregate flags into single queue item
- Display: "5 users reported this review"
- Show all flag reasons
- Priority escalates with more flags

**B5: Flag Spam Detection**
- User flags many reviews in short time (>10 in 1 hour):
  - Rate limit: "You're flagging too quickly. Please slow down."
  - Flag user for review (potential abuse)
- User consistently flags valid reviews:
  - Reduce flag weight in priority algorithm
  - Possible warning: "Your recent flags have been dismissed. Please review guidelines."

**B6: Moderator Bias/Conflict of Interest**
- If review involves user known to moderator:
  - Moderator must disclose: "I have a connection to this user"
  - Reassign to different moderator
- Audit logs track moderator patterns (e.g., always dismissing certain flag types)

**B7: Expedited Review for Critical Flags**
- Threats, harassment, doxxing flagged as "Critical"
- Notification sent to on-call moderator immediately
- Target response time: <2 hours

**B8: Review Has Multiple Policy Violations**
- E.g., Contains both PII and inappropriate language
- Moderator can apply multiple actions:
  - Redact PII + Quarantine for further review
- Record all actions separately

**B9: False Flag Pattern**
- User repeatedly flags competitor's positive reviews:
  - System detects pattern (e.g., 10 flags all on reviews for one user)
  - Flag user account for admin review
  - Possible suspension for abuse

**B10: Review Edited After Flagging**
- If reviewer edits review text after being flagged:
  - System shows both versions to moderator
  - Moderator reviews latest version
  - If issue resolved by edit: Dismiss flag
  - If issue persists: Apply moderation

**B11: Moderator Workload Management**
- Assign flags to moderators based on:
  - Language proficiency (for non-English reviews)
  - Category expertise
  - Current workload
- Round-robin or skills-based assignment

**B12: Appeal Deadline Missed**
- If user submits appeal >7 days after notification:
  - Reject with message: "Appeal deadline has passed (7 days)"
  - Rare exception: Admin can manually accept late appeal

**B13: Multiple Appeals on Same Review**
- User cannot submit multiple appeals
- If second appeal attempted: "You've already appealed this decision"

**B14: Review Reinstated After Appeal**
- If reinstated, review retains original publish date
- No re-notification to reviewee (already notified once)
- Audit log records reinstatement

**B15: Evidence Upload Virus/Malware**
- All evidence files scanned before storage
- If malware detected:
  - File rejected: "File upload failed security scan"
  - Flag user account for admin review (possible security threat)

**B16: PII Redaction Automation**
- AI detects PII in review text
- Moderator option: "Auto-Redact PII"
- System replaces:
  - Emails: `[email redacted]`
  - Phones: `[phone redacted]`
  - Addresses: `[address redacted]`
  - External URLs: `[link removed]`
- Reviewer notified: "Your review was edited to remove personal information"

**B17: Moderation State History**
- Review can have multiple state changes:
  - Clean → Quarantined → Clean (after appeal)
- Full history visible to admins
- State machine enforces valid transitions

**B18: Bulk Moderation Actions**
- Moderator can select multiple flagged reviews (same violation type)
- Apply action to all: "Dismiss All" or "Redact All PII"
- Confirmation required for bulk actions

**B19: Review Compliance Export (GDPR)**
- User requests data export including flagged reviews
- System exports:
  - All flags submitted by user
  - All moderation actions on user's reviews
  - Appeal history
- JSON or PDF format

**B20: Review Erasure (GDPR Right to Be Forgotten)**
- User requests review deletion (GDPR)
- System:
  - Anonymizes review (removes reviewer identity)
  - Redacts all PII
  - Retains anonymized review for platform integrity (ratings still count)
- Cannot fully delete review if impacts reviewee's reputation

**B21: Admin Override**
- Senior admin can override moderator decisions
- Requires justification
- Audit log records override with reason

**B22: Moderation Analytics Dashboard**
- Admin views:
  - Flags per day/week/month (trend chart)
  - Average resolution time
  - Flag accuracy: % upheld vs. dismissed
  - Moderator performance: Flags resolved, avg time, accuracy
  - Top flag reasons (pie chart)
  - Auto-flag accuracy: % AI flags upheld by human

**B23: Review Quarantine Expiry**
- Quarantined reviews auto-expire after 30 days if not resolved
- System prompts: "30 quarantined reviews pending decision"
- Moderator must resolve or extend quarantine

**B24: Moderator Training Mode**
- New moderators can practice with historical flags (sandbox)
- Compare decisions to senior moderator outcomes
- Feedback on accuracy before full queue access

**B25: Public Transparency Report**
- Platform publishes quarterly report:
  - Total flags received
  - % upheld vs. dismissed
  - Most common violation types
  - Average resolution time
- Builds trust with users

#### Notifications

**Flag Submitted:**
- **Email (flagger):** "Thank you for reporting a review. We'll review within 24-48 hours. [Ticket ID]"
- **In-app:** "Report submitted ✓"

**Flag Resolved (Upheld):**
- **Email (flagger):** "Action taken on your report. The review has been [removed/redacted/limited]."
- **Email (reviewer):** "Your review was [action taken] for violating guidelines. [Reason] Appeal within 7 days."
- **Email (reviewee):** "A review about you was [action taken] after investigation."
- **In-app (all parties):** Notification with details

**Flag Resolved (Dismissed):**
- **Email (flagger):** "After review, no policy violation found. Review remains active."

**Review Auto-Flagged:**
- **Email (moderator, if critical):** "URGENT: Review auto-flagged for [reason]. Review immediately."

**Appeal Submitted:**
- **Email (appellant):** "Appeal received. Typical response time: 3-5 business days. [Ticket ID]"
- **In-app:** "Appeal submitted ✓"

**Appeal Approved:**
- **Email (appellant):** "Your appeal was approved. Your review has been restored."
- **Email (reviewee):** "A review about you has been reinstated after appeal."

**Appeal Denied:**
- **Email (appellant):** "Your appeal was denied. [Reason] This decision is final."

**PII Redacted:**
- **Email (reviewer):** "Your review was edited to remove personal information. [Details]"

**Account Action (Repeat Offender):**
- **Email (user):** "Your account has received a warning for repeated policy violations. [Details]"

**Moderation Queue Reminder:**
- **Email (moderator, daily digest):** "You have X pending flags to review. [Oldest: 3 days]"

#### Analytics

- review.flagged (review_id, flag_reason, flagger_type, priority)
- review.auto_flagged (review_id, detection_type, confidence_score)
- flag.resolved (flag_id, resolution, resolution_time_hours, moderator_id)

- review.moderation.applied (review_id, moderation_state, moderator_id, reason)

- review.quarantined (review_id, reason, expected_resolution_days)
- review.removed (review_id, removal_reason, moderator_id)

#### Sources

# SECTION H: STORAGE & DOCUMENTS

This section covers file management, uploads, downloads, sharing, virus scanning, and document organization across the Skillsier platform.

---

### STG-1 — Upload Files (Single & Multi-part)

**Journey ID:** STG-1  
**Persona:** Any User (Client, Freelancer, Admin, Support)  
**Preconditions:** Authenticated user with storage quota available  
**Triggers:** User uploads file(s) via drag-drop, file picker, or paste in various contexts (contract attachments, workroom documents, profile documents, proposals, messages, support tickets)

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/contracts/[id]/workroom` - Contract workroom file upload
- `(dashboard)/contracts/[id]/attachments` - Contract attachments
- `(dashboard)/proposals/[id]/edit` - Proposal attachments
- `(dashboard)/messages/[id]` - Message attachments
- `(dashboard)/profile/documents` - Profile documents
- `(dashboard)/storage` - Main storage dashboard
- `(admin)/support/tickets/[id]` - Support ticket attachments

**Mobile Routes:**
- `mobile/(tabs)/contracts/[id]/workroom` - Mobile workroom upload
- `mobile/(tabs)/storage` - Mobile storage management
- `mobile/(tabs)/messages/[id]` - Mobile message attachments

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend Microservices:**
- **storage-be**: `/file/upload`, `/upload/session`, `/upload/chunk`, `/blob`, `/virus-scan`
- **contracts-be**: Link files to contracts, workrooms, attachments
- **communications-be**: Notifications for upload status
- **users-be**: Check user quota, storage limits

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: Initiate Upload**
- User selects file(s) via:
  - Drag & drop zone
  - File picker dialog
  - Paste from clipboard (images)
  - Camera capture (mobile)
- System validates:
  - File type against whitelist (MIME type check)
  - File size against user tier limits (FREE: 100MB, BASIC: 500MB, PRO: 2GB, ENTERPRISE: 5GB)
  - User quota available (storage space remaining)
  - Rate limit not exceeded (100 uploads/hour)

**Step 2: Pre-upload Validation**
- Frontend performs client-side checks:
  - File extension matches MIME type
  - No malicious file names (scripts, executables)
  - Total batch size within limits
  - Duplicate detection (by hash if available)
- Display upload preview modal with:
  - File list with thumbnails
  - Size breakdown
  - Estimated upload time
  - Storage usage impact
  - Cancel/Proceed buttons

**Step 3: Choose Upload Method**
- **Small files (<10MB)**: Direct upload (single POST)
- **Large files (>10MB)**: Multi-part chunked upload
  - Request upload session: `POST /v1/storage/upload/session`
  - Receive session_id, chunk_size (5MB), total_chunks
  - Generate presigned URLs for each chunk

**Step 4: Upload Progress**
- For single upload:
  - Show linear progress bar
  - Upload speed indicator
  - Cancel button
  - POST file to presigned S3 URL directly
- For multi-part upload:
  - Upload chunks in parallel (max 3 concurrent)
  - Display per-chunk progress
  - Show overall percentage
  - Enable pause/resume
  - Store progress in localStorage for recovery
  - On pause: Save session_id, completed_chunks[]
  - On resume: Fetch session status, resume from last chunk

**Step 5: Server-Side Processing**
- Backend receives upload completion event
- Generates content hash (SHA-256)
- Checks for de-duplication:
  - If hash exists: Link existing blob, create new file metadata
  - If new: Store blob, create file + blob records
- Triggers async jobs:
  - Virus scan (ClamAV)
  - Content extraction (OCR for PDFs/images, EXIF for photos)
  - Media processing (thumbnails for images, transcode for videos)
  - DLP scan (detect SSN, credit cards, API keys)

**Step 6: Virus Scanning**
- File enters "SCANNING" status
- Display scanning indicator to user
- Backend scans file with ClamAV
- Results:
  - **CLEAN**: File becomes "ACTIVE", processing continues
  - **INFECTED**: File quarantined, user notified, upload fails
  - **SCAN_FAILED**: File enters "PENDING_RESCAN", retry queue

**Step 7: Attach to Entity**
- After scan passes, link file to entity:
  - Contract attachment: `POST /v1/contracts/{id}/attachments`
  - Workroom document: `POST /v1/contracts/{id}/workroom/documents`
  - Proposal attachment: `POST /v1/proposals/{id}/attachments`
  - Message attachment: Link via `attachment_ids[]`
  - Profile document: `POST /v1/users/me/documents`
- Create entity reference record in storage-be
- Update entity with file_id

**Step 8: Post-Upload Actions**
- Show success notification with:
  - "File uploaded successfully"
  - File name + thumbnail
  - Quick actions (View, Download, Share, Delete)
- Refresh file list in context
- Update storage usage indicator
- If in workroom: Notify contract parties
- If in message: Send real-time message event
- Generate audit log entry

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: File Type Blocked**
- User uploads .exe, .bat, .sh, .scr
- Frontend blocks before upload
- Show error: "File type not allowed. Permitted types: documents, images, videos, archives"
- Suggest: "Convert to PDF or ZIP archive"

**B2: File Too Large**
- File exceeds tier limit
- Show modal: "File too large"
  - "Your file (2.5GB) exceeds your plan limit (2GB)"
  - "Upgrade to ENTERPRISE for 5GB files"
  - [Upgrade Plan] [Choose Different File]

**B3: Quota Exceeded**
- User storage full
- Show error: "Storage quota exceeded"
  - "You've used 50GB / 50GB"
  - "Delete old files or upgrade your plan"
  - [Manage Storage] [Upgrade Plan]

**B4: Rate Limit Hit**
- User uploads >100 files in 1 hour
- Show: "Upload limit reached. Try again in 45 minutes."
- Display countdown timer

**B5: Upload Interrupted**
- Network drops mid-upload
- Multi-part upload paused automatically
- Show: "Upload paused due to connection loss"
- On reconnect: "Resume upload?"
- Retrieve session, resume from last chunk

**B6: Duplicate File**
- Hash matches existing file
- Show modal: "File already exists"
  - "This file was uploaded on [date]"
  - Options:
    - "Use existing" (link existing blob)
    - "Upload anyway" (create new metadata record)
    - "Rename and upload"

**B7: Virus Detected**
- Scan finds malware
- File quarantined immediately
- Email: "File upload failed - virus detected"
  - "File: contract_proposal.pdf contained malware"
  - "Your file has been quarantined for security"
  - "Contact support if you believe this is an error"
- In-app: Red banner "Upload failed - security threat detected"
- Admin notified if flagged as targeted attack

**B8: Scan Timeout**
- Large file scan takes >5 minutes
- File stays in "SCANNING" with warning
- User can cancel and delete
- Backend retries scan after 1 hour
- If fails 3 times: Manual admin review

**B9: Processing Failed**
- Thumbnail generation fails
- OCR extraction fails
- Show warning: "File uploaded but preview unavailable"
- File still usable, just no preview

**B10: Mobile Photo Upload**
- User uploads from camera roll
- EXIF data detected with GPS coordinates
- Show privacy prompt: "This photo contains location data. Remove before uploading?"
  - [Remove Location Data] [Keep As-Is]
- If removed: Strip EXIF before upload

**B11: Concurrent Upload Conflict**
- Two users upload to same entity simultaneously
- Both succeed, both files attached
- No conflict (additive operation)
- Both parties see both files

**B12: Session Expired**
- Multi-part upload session >24 hours old
- Show error: "Upload session expired. Please restart upload."
- Clear localStorage, start fresh

**B13: Chunk Upload Fails**
- Single chunk fails (network error, S3 error)
- Retry chunk up to 3 times with exponential backoff
- If all retries fail: Pause upload, show error
- User can resume or cancel

**B14: File Name Sanitization**
- File has special characters: `file<script>.pdf`
- Backend sanitizes to: `file_script_.pdf`
- User notified: "File name was sanitized for security"

**B15: Batch Upload**
- User uploads 50 files at once
- Show batch progress:
  - "Uploading 50 files: 23/50 complete"
  - List view with per-file status
  - Overall progress bar
- Pause/cancel entire batch or individual files

**B16: Presigned URL Expired**
- URL expires before upload completes
- Backend detects, generates new URL
- Frontend automatically retries with new URL
- Transparent to user

**B17: Storage Tiering**
- File uploaded successfully
- After 30 days of no access: Auto-move to WARM tier
- After 365 days: Auto-move to COLD tier
- User notified if retrieval will have delay

**B18: Version Conflict**
- User uploads new version of existing file
- System detects by name match in same folder
- Prompt: "File.pdf already exists. Replace or create version?"
  - [Replace] [Create Version] [Rename]
- If version: Increment version number, link previous_version_id

**B19: Upload to Archived Entity**
- User tries to upload to closed contract
- Block upload with error: "Cannot upload to archived contract"
- Suggest: "Reopen contract to add files"

**B20: Admin Override**
- Admin uploads file that fails DLP scan
- Show admin-only prompt: "DLP alert: File contains sensitive data. Proceed anyway?"
  - [Override and Upload] [Cancel]
- If override: Log admin action, flag for audit

**B21: Mobile Background Upload**
- User starts upload, backgrounds app
- iOS/Android background task continues upload
- Push notification on completion or failure
- If OS kills task: Resume on app reopen

**B22: Clipboard Paste (Images)**
- User pastes image from clipboard
- Auto-detect paste event
- Show quick modal: "Upload pasted image?"
  - Preview thumbnail
  - Auto-generated name: `pasted-image-{timestamp}.png`
  - [Rename] [Upload] [Cancel]

**B23: Cross-Origin Upload**
- User drags file from external website
- CORS check fails
- Show error: "Cannot upload file from external source. Download first, then upload."

**B24: Encrypted File Upload**
- User uploads password-protected ZIP/PDF
- Scan cannot penetrate encryption
- Flag as "ENCRYPTED_UNSCANNED"
- Warn user: "Encrypted files cannot be scanned for viruses. Upload at your own risk."
- Require user confirmation

**B25: Contract Limit Reached**
- Contract has 100 attachments (limit)
- Block upload: "Maximum attachments reached for this contract (100)"
- Suggest: "Delete old files or create new contract"

#### Notifications

**Upload Started (Multi-part):**
- **In-app:** Toast "Uploading {filename}... {progress}%"

**Upload Completed:**
- **In-app:** Success toast "{filename} uploaded successfully"
- **Email (if critical):** "Document uploaded to Contract #{contract_id}"
- **Push (mobile):** "Upload complete: {filename}"

**Upload Failed:**
- **In-app:** Error toast "Upload failed: {reason}"
- **Email (if virus):** "Security alert: Virus detected in {filename}"

**Virus Detected:**
- **Email (user):** "File upload blocked - malware detected"
- **Email (admin):** "ALERT: Virus detected in upload by {user_email}"

**Scan Complete (Clean):**
- **In-app:** "File scanned and ready to use"

**Quota Warning:**
- **Email (80% quota):** "Storage nearly full: 40GB / 50GB used"
- **In-app:** Banner "80% of storage used. Upgrade or delete files."

**Upload Paused:**
- **In-app:** "Upload paused. Resume when ready."

**Upload Resumed:**
- **In-app:** "Resuming upload from {chunk}/{total_chunks}"

**Processing Complete:**
- **In-app:** "{filename} processed: thumbnail ready"

**Background Upload Complete (Mobile):**
- **Push:** "Upload finished: {filename}"

#### Analytics

- storage.upload.initiated (file_size, file_type, entity_type, entity_id, tier)
- storage.upload.validation.passed (file_size, file_type, mime_type)
- storage.upload.validation.failed (fail_reason, file_type, file_size)
- storage.upload.method.selected (method: 'single' | 'multipart', file_size)
- storage.upload.chunk.uploaded (chunk_number, chunk_size, session_id)
- storage.upload.progress (percentage, bytes_uploaded, upload_speed_mbps)
- storage.upload.paused (chunk_number, session_id)
- storage.upload.resumed (chunk_number, session_id)
- storage.upload.completed (file_id, file_size, duration_seconds, method)
- storage.upload.failed (fail_reason, file_size, stage: 'validation' | 'upload' | 'processing')
- storage.virus_scan.started (file_id, file_size)
- storage.virus_scan.completed (file_id, scan_result, scan_duration_ms)
- storage.virus.detected (file_id, virus_name, user_id)
- storage.upload.deduplicated (existing_file_id, new_file_id)
- storage.quota.exceeded (used_bytes, limit_bytes, tier)
- storage.rate_limit.hit (uploads_in_hour, user_id)
- storage.file.attached (file_id, entity_type, entity_id)
- storage.batch.upload.started (file_count, total_size_bytes)
- storage.batch.upload.completed (file_count, success_count, fail_count, duration_seconds)
- storage.presigned_url.generated (file_id, action: 'upload')
- storage.presigned_url.expired (file_id, time_since_generation)
- storage.mobile.background.upload (file_id, completed: boolean)
- storage.clipboard.paste.uploaded (file_size, mime_type)
- storage.duplicate.detected (existing_file_id, action_taken)
- storage.version.created (file_id, version_number, previous_version_id)

### STG-2 — Download & View Files

**Journey ID:** STG-2  
**Persona:** Any User with file access (Client, Freelancer, Admin, Support)  
**Preconditions:** User has permission to view/download file  
**Triggers:** User clicks download button, views file preview, or shares file link

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/storage/files/[id]` - File detail view
- `(dashboard)/contracts/[id]/workroom` - Workroom file list
- `(dashboard)/contracts/[id]/attachments` - Contract attachments
- `(dashboard)/messages/[id]` - Message attachment viewer
- `(dashboard)/profile/documents` - Profile documents

**Mobile Routes:**
- `mobile/(tabs)/storage/files/[id]` - Mobile file viewer
- `mobile/(tabs)/contracts/[id]/files` - Mobile contract files

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend Microservices:**
- **storage-be**: `/file/download`, `/file/presigned-url`, `/file/preview`, `/asset/thumbnail`
- **contracts-be**: Verify file access permissions
- **users-be**: Check user access level, log download activity

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: Request File Access**
- User clicks file name or download icon
- Frontend sends: `GET /v1/storage/files/{file_id}`
- Backend checks:
  - File exists and not soft-deleted
  - User has permission (entity-level access)
  - File not quarantined
  - File scan status is "CLEAN"

**Step 2: Authorization Check**
- Backend evaluates access rules:
  - **Contract attachment**: User is client/freelancer on contract
  - **Workroom document**: User is contract party
  - **Message attachment**: User is sender/recipient
  - **Profile document**: User is owner or admin
  - **Shared file**: User has active share link or explicit share permission
- If denied: Return 403 with reason

**Step 3: Generate Download URL**
- Backend generates presigned URL:
  - For S3/MinIO: Presigned GET URL (1-hour expiry)
  - For images/PDFs: Also generate preview URL (inline viewing)
  - Include security headers (Content-Disposition, Content-Type)
  - Add watermark for confidential files (optional)
- Log download request:
  - file_id, user_id, accessed_at, ip_address, user_agent
- Increment download_count

**Step 4: User Chooses Action**
- Frontend displays modal or inline viewer:
  - **Preview** (for images, PDFs, videos, audio)
  - **Download** (save to device)
  - **Share** (generate share link)
  - **Copy Link** (for quick sharing)

**Step 5: Preview File (If Chosen)**
- For **images**:
  - Display in lightbox with zoom, rotate, next/prev
  - Load different sizes based on viewport (thumbnail → medium → large)
  - Show EXIF metadata (camera, date, location if not stripped)
- For **PDFs**:
  - Embed PDF.js viewer with page navigation
  - Allow annotations (if enabled)
  - Show page count, zoom controls
- For **videos**:
  - Load video player with controls
  - Show different quality options (if transco ded: 480p, 720p, 1080p)
  - Track playback position for resume
- For **audio**:
  - Show audio waveform player
  - Display metadata (artist, album, duration)
- For **documents (DOCX, XLSX)**:
  - Convert to preview format (HTML/images via LibreOffice)
  - Show read-only view with formatting
- For **archives (ZIP, TAR)**:
  - Show file list inside archive
  - Allow extracting individual files
- For **code files**:
  - Syntax-highlighted preview
  - Line numbers, copy code button

**Step 6: Download File (If Chosen)**
- Frontend redirects to presigned URL
- Browser downloads file with original filename
- Show download progress (if browser supports)
- Mobile: Save to device storage or app sandbox
- Log download completion event

**Step 7: Post-Download**
- Update UI:
  - Show "Downloaded" checkmark icon
  - Increment download count display
  - Add to user's recent downloads list
- Send analytics event
- If mobile: Show notification "Downloaded: {filename}"

**Step 8: Offline Access (Mobile)**
- User toggles "Make Available Offline"
- File downloaded to secure app storage
- File accessible even without internet
- Auto-sync updates when online

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: File Not Found**
- File deleted or ID invalid
- Show error: "File not found or has been deleted"
- Redirect to storage dashboard

**B2: Access Denied**
- User lacks permission
- Show: "You don't have permission to access this file"
- Explain why: "This file is restricted to contract parties only"
- Suggest: "Contact the file owner to request access"

**B3: File Quarantined**
- File flagged by virus scan or moderator
- Show: "File unavailable - security review in progress"
- Admin can override to download with warning

**B4: Presigned URL Expired**
- User clicks old download link (>1 hour)
- Backend detects expired URL
- Auto-generate new URL transparently
- Retry download automatically

**B5: Large File Download**
- File >500MB
- Show warning: "Large file (2.1GB). Download may take time."
- Show estimated time based on connection speed
- Enable pause/resume for downloads (if browser supports)

**B6: Mobile Cellular Warning**
- User on cellular data, file >50MB
- Prompt: "This file is 85MB. Continue on cellular data?"
  - [Use WiFi] [Download Anyway]
- Remember preference per session

**B7: Storage Tiering Delay**
- File in COLD storage tier
- Show: "File is archived. Retrieval in progress..."
- Estimated time: 5-15 minutes
- Email when ready: "Your file is ready to download"
- User can queue download and come back later

**B8: Preview Generation Failed**
- PDF preview conversion fails
- Show: "Preview unavailable. Download to view."
- Provide direct download button

**B9: Virus Re-scan During Download**
- File flagged during download attempt
- Abort download immediately
- Show: "Download blocked - security check required"
- File quarantined pending review

**B10: Concurrent Downloads**
- User downloads 20 files simultaneously
- Browser limits concurrent downloads (usually 6)
- Queue remaining downloads
- Show progress: "Downloading 6 of 20 files..."

**B11: Download Failure**
- Network error mid-download
- Show retry prompt: "Download failed. Retry?"
- Auto-retry up to 3 times

**B12: Rate Limit Hit**
- User exceeds 1000 downloads/hour
- Block with: "Download limit reached. Try again in 30 minutes."
- Admin exempt from limit

**B13: Version History Download**
- User views file with versions
- Show version dropdown: "Version 3 (latest), Version 2, Version 1"
- Each version downloadable separately
- Highlight differences if available

**B14: Watermarked Download**
- File marked as confidential
- Apply watermark:
  - Text overlay: "{user_email} - Downloaded {date}"
  - Semi-transparent diagonal stamp
- Warn user: "This file is watermarked with your identity"

**B15: Encrypted File**
- File uploaded encrypted
- Download as-is (still encrypted)
- No preview available
- Show: "Encrypted file - preview unavailable"

**B16: External Share Access**
- User accesses via public share link (unauthenticated)
- Check link not expired/revoked
- Show CAPTCHA if suspicious activity
- Limit download speed for anonymous users
- Log IP, referrer, user-agent

**B17: Bulk Download (ZIP)**
- User selects multiple files (10+)
- "Download as ZIP" option
- Backend creates temporary ZIP archive
- Generate presigned URL for ZIP
- ZIP expires in 1 hour
- Show: "Preparing download (5 files, 123MB)..."

**B18: Mobile Viewer**
- Native file viewers on mobile
  - PDFs open in native PDF viewer
  - Images in gallery
  - Videos in native player
- "Open In..." option for other apps
- Share sheet integration

**B19: File Locked (In Use)**
- File locked by another user for editing
- Show: "File is locked by {user_name}"
- Preview available, download enabled
- Editing blocked

**B20: Browser Compatibility**
- Old browser lacks preview support
- Detect browser capabilities
- Fallback to download-only mode
- Show: "Preview not supported in this browser"

**B21: Private Browsing Mode**
- User in incognito/private mode
- Previews work, but no caching
- Downloads go to default folder
- No offline access

**B22: Admin Download Audit**
- Admin downloads sensitive file
- Send alert email to file owner
- Log in audit trail with reason
- Show admin: "This download is audited"

**B23: Auto-Play Media**
- Video/audio files auto-play on preview
- User preference saved
- Mobile: Respect data-saver mode

**B24: Multi-Language Support**
- File has text in multiple languages
- OCR detects languages
- Show detected languages in metadata
- Enable translation preview (optional)

**B25: File Info Popover**
- User hovers over file name
- Show quick info:
  - File size, type
  - Upload date, uploader
  - Last modified
  - Download count
  - Scan status
  - [View Details] [Download] [Share]

#### Notifications

**Download Complete:**
- **In-app:** Toast "Downloaded: {filename}"
- **Mobile:** System notification "Download complete"

**Download Failed:**
- **In-app:** "Download failed: {reason}"
- **Email (critical):** "Failed to download {filename} - Contact support"

**File Ready (From Archive):**
- **Email:** "Your file is ready to download: {filename}"
- **Push:** "{filename} retrieved from archive"

**Large Download Warning:**
- **In-app:** Modal "Large file download - Estimated time: 15 minutes"

**Virus Re-detected:**
- **Email:** "Security alert: File {filename} blocked during download"

**Watermarked File:**
- **In-app:** "This download is watermarked with your identity"

**Share Link Accessed:**
- **Email (owner):** "{user_email} downloaded your shared file: {filename}"

**Rate Limit:**
- **In-app:** "Download limit reached. Resets in {time}"

#### Analytics

- storage.file.viewed (file_id, view_type: 'preview' | 'download', entity_type)
- storage.file.preview.opened (file_id, file_type, preview_method)
- storage.file.downloaded (file_id, file_size, file_type, download_duration_ms)
- storage.file.download.failed (file_id, fail_reason, stage)
- storage.presigned_url.generated (file_id, action: 'download', expiry_minutes)
- storage.presigned_url.accessed (file_id, ip_address, user_agent, authenticated)
- storage.access.denied (file_id, user_id, reason)
- storage.file.quarantine.blocked (file_id, reason)
- storage.preview.generated (file_id, preview_type, generation_time_ms)
- storage.preview.failed (file_id, fail_reason)
- storage.download.queued (file_id, queue_position)
- storage.bulk.download (file_count, total_size_bytes, format: 'zip')
- storage.version.downloaded (file_id, version_number)
- storage.watermark.applied (file_id, user_id, watermark_text)
- storage.mobile.offline.saved (file_id, file_size)
- storage.share_link.accessed (share_id, file_id, ip_address, authenticated: boolean)
- storage.rate_limit.hit (action: 'download', user_id)
- storage.archive.retrieval.started (file_id, storage_class)
- storage.archive.retrieval.completed (file_id, retrieval_time_seconds)
- storage.file.metadata.viewed (file_id)
- storage.captcha.shown (share_id, ip_address)
- storage.external.share.download (share_id, file_id, referrer)

#### Sources

**Backend:** storage-be.user-stories.md (File domain, Presigned URL domain, Asset domain, Media domain)  
**Backend:** storage-be.database-design.md (files table, presigned_urls table, file_access_logs table, file_versions table)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/storage routes, hooks/storage/use-file-download.ts, hooks/storage/use-presigned-url.ts, components/storage/file-viewer/, components/storage/media-player/)

### STG-3 — Organize Files (Folders, Tags, Search)

**Journey ID:** STG-3  
**Persona:** Any User organizing their files  
**Preconditions:** User has uploaded files  
**Triggers:** User wants to organize storage, create folders, tag files, or search for files

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/storage` - Main storage dashboard with folder tree
- `(dashboard)/storage/folders/[id]` - Folder contents view
- `(dashboard)/storage/search` - Advanced file search
- `(dashboard)/storage/tags` - Tag management

**Mobile Routes:**
- `mobile/(tabs)/storage` - Mobile storage view with folders
- `mobile/(tabs)/storage/search` - Mobile file search

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend Microservices:**
- **storage-be**: `/folder`, `/file/tag`, `/file/search`, `/file/metadata`
- **search-be**: Full-text search indexing (Elasticsearch/Meilisearch)

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: Access Storage Dashboard**
- User navigates to storage page
- Display folder tree on left sidebar:
  - Root folders (Home, Contracts, Proposals, Documents, etc.)
  - Nested user-created folders
  - Shared folders (if any)
  - Special folders (Recent, Starred, Trash)
- Main area shows:
  - Breadcrumb navigation
  - Current folder files (grid or list view)
  - Storage usage bar
  - Quick filters (File type, Date, Size, Tags)

**Step 2: Create Folder Structure**
- User clicks "New Folder"
- Modal appears:
  - Folder name input
  - Parent folder selector
  - Color/icon picker (optional)
  - Visibility settings (Private, Shared, Team)
  - [Create] [Cancel]
- Backend creates folder:
  - `POST /v1/storage/folders`
  - Generates folder_id
  - Sets parent_folder_id
  - Returns folder object
- Update UI with new folder in tree

**Step 3: Move Files to Folders**
- User selects file(s) via checkbox
- Clicks "Move" or drags to folder
- If drag: Show drop zone highlight on hover
- Modal: "Move {count} files to:"
  - Folder tree picker
  - Search folders by name
  - [Move Here] [Cancel]
- Backend: `PATCH /v1/storage/files/{id}/move`
  - Updates file.folder_id
  - Validates: No circular references (folders can't contain themselves)
  - Validates: User owns both source and destination
- Update UI: Remove from source, add to destination

**Step 4: Tag Files**
- User selects file(s)
- Clicks "Add Tags"
- Tag input with autocomplete:
  - Shows existing tags as suggestions
  - Supports multi-select
  - Create new tag on-the-fly
  - Color coding by tag type (contract, client, project, etc.)
- Apply tags: `POST /v1/storage/files/{id}/tags`
  - Creates/links tags to file
  - Tags are user-scoped (personal taxonomy)
- Display tags as badges on file cards
- Enable tag-based filtering

**Step 5: Search Files**
- User enters search query in search bar
- Search supports:
  - **File name**: Partial match, fuzzy search
  - **Tags**: #tag syntax
  - **File type**: type:pdf, type:image
  - **Size**: size:>10MB, size:<1MB
  - **Date**: uploaded:today, modified:last-week, uploaded:2024-01-15
  - **Content** (OCR text): Full-text search in PDFs/images
  - **EXIF data**: camera:Canon, location:Paris
  - **User**: uploaded_by:john@example.com
- Backend: `GET /v1/storage/files/search?q={query}`
  - Parses query into filters
  - Searches Elasticsearch index
  - Returns ranked results with highlighting
- Display results:
  - Grid/list with relevance score
  - Highlight matching terms
  - Group by folder or date
  - Faceted filters on left (File type, Date range, Tags)

**Step 6: Advanced Filters**
- User opens filter panel
- Multi-dimensional filters:
  - **File Type**: Checkboxes for each type
  - **Upload Date**: Date range picker
  - **Size Range**: Slider (0-5GB)
  - **Tags**: Multi-select tag chips
  - **Scan Status**: Clean, Scanning, Quarantined
  - **Uploaded By**: User picker (for shared folders)
  - **Entity Type**: Contract, Proposal, Message, etc.
- Apply filters: `GET /v1/storage/files?filter[type]=pdf&filter[size]=>10MB`
- Results update in real-time
- Save filter presets for quick access

**Step 7: Sort & View Options**
- User chooses sort order:
  - Name (A-Z, Z-A)
  - Date uploaded (Newest, Oldest)
  - Date modified (Newest, Oldest)
  - Size (Largest, Smallest)
  - Download count (Most, Least)
- Toggle view mode:
  - **Grid**: Thumbnails with file names
  - **List**: Detailed table (Name, Size, Date, Tags, Actions)
  - **Compact**: Dense list for many files
- Save preferences per user

**Step 8: Bulk Actions**
- User selects multiple files
- Bulk action menu appears:
  - Move to folder
  - Add tags
  - Download as ZIP
  - Delete (soft delete)
  - Change visibility
  - Export metadata (CSV)
- Confirm bulk action
- Show progress: "Processing 25/50 files..."
- Complete with summary: "50 files moved successfully"

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: Folder Name Conflict**
- User creates folder with existing name
- Show error: "Folder 'Projects' already exists in this location"
- Suggest: "Rename to 'Projects 2' or merge folders?"

**B2: Move to Same Location**
- User moves file to current folder
- Show: "File is already in this folder"
- No action taken

**B3: Deep Nesting Limit**
- User tries to create folder >10 levels deep
- Block: "Maximum folder depth (10 levels) reached"
- Suggest: "Flatten your folder structure"

**B4: Circular Folder Reference**
- User moves parent folder into child folder
- Detect cycle, block operation
- Show: "Cannot move folder into its own subfolder"

**B5: Tag Length Limit**
- User creates tag >50 characters
- Truncate automatically
- Show warning: "Tag name shortened to 50 characters"

**B6: Too Many Tags**
- User applies >20 tags to one file
- Warn: "Maximum 20 tags per file"
- Suggest: "Use folders for broader organization"

**B7: Search No Results**
- Query returns zero matches
- Show: "No files found for '{query}'"
- Suggestions:
  - "Check spelling"
  - "Try broader search terms"
  - "Clear filters"
  - Show related searches

**B8: Slow Search (Large Account)**
- User has 50,000+ files, search takes >3s
- Show loading skeleton
- Stream results as they arrive
- Implement pagination (50 results per page)
- Cache frequent searches

**B9: Special Characters in Search**
- User searches: `file@2024!.pdf`
- Escape special chars
- Treat as literal search
- Support quotes for exact match: `"Annual Report 2024"`

**B10: Delete Folder with Files**
- User deletes folder containing 100 files
- Confirm: "Delete folder 'Contracts' and 100 files inside?"
  - "This will soft-delete all files (recoverable for 30 days)"
  - [Delete] [Cancel]
- Backend: Cascade soft-delete to all children
- Move to Trash folder (special system folder)

**B11: Restore from Trash**
- User views Trash folder
- Select files to restore
- "Restore" button
- Files return to original folder
- If original folder deleted: Move to root

**B12: Empty Trash**
- User clicks "Empty Trash"
- Confirm: "Permanently delete 25 files? This cannot be undone."
  - [Permanent Delete] [Cancel]
- Backend: Hard delete files and blobs (if not used elsewhere)

**B13: Shared Folder Access**
- User shares folder with team
- Recipient sees folder in "Shared with me"
- Permissions: View-only, Download, Edit
- Recipient cannot delete shared folder (only owner can)

**B14: Rename Folder**
- User renames folder
- Check for conflicts
- Update breadcrumbs and paths dynamically
- Emit event for real-time sync to other users

**B15: Move Folder (Drag & Drop)**
- User drags folder in tree
- Show valid drop zones (other folders)
- Block invalid drops (into child, into self)
- Update hierarchy on drop

**B16: Color-Code Folders**
- User assigns color to folder
- Color appears in folder tree and breadcrumbs
- Visual hierarchy for quick scanning
- Colors: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple, Gray

**B17: Folder Icons**
- User picks icon for folder (emoji or preset)
- Icon displays in tree
- Default icons by folder type (Contract folder = 📄, Image folder = 🖼️)

**B18: Duplicate File Name**
- User moves file to folder with same name
- Auto-rename: `document.pdf` → `document (1).pdf`
- Notify user: "File renamed to avoid conflict"

**B19: Search by Content (OCR)**
- User searches for text inside PDF
- OCR extraction must be complete
- If OCR pending: Show "Still processing. Try again later."
- If OCR failed: File not searchable by content

**B20: Export Search Results**
- User runs complex search
- "Export Results" button
- Generate CSV with: File Name, Size, Upload Date, Tags, Path, URL
- Email CSV or download directly

**B21: Save Search Filter**
- User creates complex filter
- "Save Filter" option
- Name filter: "Large PDFs from 2024"
- Appears in sidebar as quick link
- Click to instantly reapply filter

**B22: Recent Files**
- Special system folder: "Recent"
- Shows last 50 accessed files (any folder)
- Sorted by last_accessed_at
- Virtual folder (doesn't contain files, just links)

**B23: Starred Files**
- User stars important files
- Appears in "Starred" special folder
- Quick access to favorites
- Sync across devices

**B24: Mobile Folder Sync**
- Mobile app syncs folder structure
- Offline folders marked
- Auto-download starred files for offline
- Background sync when WiFi available

**B25: Folder Permissions**
- User creates folder with team access
- Set permissions per user:
  - View, Download, Upload, Edit, Delete
- Inherited by nested folders (unless overridden)
- Admin can override any permission

#### Notifications

**Folder Created:**
- **In-app:** Toast "Folder '{name}' created"

**Files Moved:**
- **In-app:** "{count} files moved to '{folder_name}'"

**Tags Applied:**
- **In-app:** "Tags added to {count} files"

**Bulk Action Complete:**
- **Email (large batch):** "Bulk operation complete: 500 files processed"
- **In-app:** Progress notification "Processing... 450/500"

**Search Saved:**
- **In-app:** "Search filter saved: '{filter_name}'"

**Trash Reminder:**
- **Email (weekly):** "Your Trash has 45 files. Empty to free space."

**Shared Folder Access:**
- **Email:** "{user_name} shared folder '{folder_name}' with you"
- **In-app:** Notification badge on storage icon

**Folder Deleted:**
- **In-app:** "Folder '{name}' moved to Trash (recoverable for 30 days)"

**Trash Emptied:**
- **In-app:** "Trash emptied. {count} files permanently deleted."

#### Analytics

- storage.folder.created (folder_name, parent_folder_id, visibility)
- storage.folder.renamed (folder_id, old_name, new_name)
- storage.folder.moved (folder_id, old_parent_id, new_parent_id)
- storage.folder.deleted (folder_id, file_count, deletion_type: 'soft' | 'hard')
- storage.file.moved (file_id, old_folder_id, new_folder_id)
- storage.file.tagged (file_id, tag_names, tag_count)
- storage.file.tag.removed (file_id, tag_name)
- storage.search.performed (query, filter_count, result_count, search_duration_ms)
- storage.search.no_results (query, filter_count)
- storage.search.filter.applied (filter_type, filter_value)
- storage.search.filter.saved (filter_name, filter_definition)
- storage.search.results.exported (query, result_count, export_format)
- storage.view.toggled (view_mode: 'grid' | 'list' | 'compact')
- storage.sort.changed (sort_by, sort_order)
- storage.bulk.action (action_type, file_count, success_count, fail_count)
- storage.folder.shared (folder_id, recipient_user_id, permission_level)
- storage.trash.viewed (file_count_in_trash)
- storage.trash.restored (file_count)
- storage.trash.emptied (file_count, storage_freed_bytes)
- storage.recent.viewed (file_count)
- storage.starred.toggled (file_id, starred: boolean)
- storage.ocr.search (query, file_id, match_count)
- storage.mobile.folder.synced (folder_id, file_count)
