### STG-4 — Share Files & Manage Permissions

**Journey ID:** STG-4  
**Persona:** Any User sharing files with others  
**Preconditions:** User owns or has permission to share files  
**Triggers:** User wants to grant access to files/folders to specific users or generate public links

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/storage/files/[id]/share` - Share file modal
- `(dashboard)/storage/folders/[id]/share` - Share folder modal
- `(dashboard)/storage/shares` - Manage all shares
- `(dashboard)/storage/shares/links` - Public link management

**Mobile Routes:**
- `mobile/(tabs)/storage/files/[id]/share` - Mobile share sheet
- `mobile/(tabs)/storage/shares` - Mobile shares list

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend Microservices:**
- **storage-be**: `/share`, `/share/link`, `/permission`, `/file/access`
- **communications-be**: Email notifications for share invites
- **users-be**: Validate recipient users

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: Initiate Sharing**
- User selects file(s) or folder
- Clicks "Share" button or right-click → Share
- Share modal opens with tabs:
  - **People**: Share with specific users/teams
  - **Link**: Generate public/private share links
  - **Advanced**: Permissions, expiry, password protection

**Step 2: Share with Specific Users (People Tab)**
- Input field: "Add people or teams"
- Autocomplete suggests:
  - Users from same organization
  - Teams user belongs to
  - Recent collaborators
  - Email addresses (external users)
- User selects recipients
- Set permission level per recipient:
  - **View Only**: Can view and download
  - **Comment**: View, download, comment
  - **Edit**: View, download, upload, edit metadata
  - **Full Access**: All above + delete, reshare
- Optional: Add message to recipients
- Optional: Set expiry date (1 day, 7 days, 30 days, custom, never)
- [Send Invites] [Cancel]

**Step 3: Backend Creates Shares**
- Frontend: `POST /v1/storage/shares`
  - Body: `{ file_id, recipient_user_ids[], permission_level, expires_at, message }`
- Backend validates:
  - User has reshare permission
  - Recipients exist (or are valid emails)
  - Permission level allowed
  - Quota not exceeded (max 100 shares per file)
- Create share records:
  - Generate share_id for each recipient
  - Link file_id, user_id, permission_level, expires_at
  - Set status: PENDING (for external emails), ACTIVE (for internal users)
- Emit events: `share.created.v1`

**Step 4: Notify Recipients**
- For internal users:
  - **In-app notification**: "{sender_name} shared '{file_name}' with you"
  - Badge on storage icon
  - Email notification (if enabled)
- For external users (email invites):
  - **Email**: "You've been invited to view '{file_name}' on Skillsier"
    - Message from sender
    - [View File] button (creates guest account on click)
    - Expires in {days}
- Recipients can:
  - Accept share (adds to their "Shared with me" folder)
  - Decline share
  - Report inappropriate content

**Step 5: Generate Share Link (Link Tab)**
- User switches to "Link" tab
- Options:
  - **Anyone with link** (public, no auth required)
  - **Organization only** (requires Skillsier login, same org)
  - **Specific people** (requires login, check against allowlist)
- Permission level: View, Download, Upload (for folders)
- Optional: Password protection (6+ characters)
- Optional: Expiry (1 day, 7 days, 30 days, custom, never)
- Optional: Download limit (max downloads: 10, 50, 100, unlimited)
- Optional: CAPTCHA for anonymous access (prevent bots)
- [Generate Link] [Cancel]

**Step 6: Backend Creates Share Link**
- Frontend: `POST /v1/storage/shares/links`
  - Body: `{ file_id, access_level: 'public' | 'org' | 'allowlist', permission, password_hash, expires_at, max_downloads }`
- Backend:
  - Generate unique token (URL-safe, 32 characters)
  - Create share link record
  - Store password hash (if provided)
  - Return shareable URL: `https://skillsier.com/s/{token}`

**Step 7: User Shares Link**
- Modal displays generated link
- Copy link button (clipboard API)
- QR code for mobile sharing
- Direct share buttons:
  - Email (opens mail client)
  - Slack (if integrated)
  - WhatsApp
  - Twitter/X
  - Copy to clipboard
- Show link details:
  - Created: {date}
  - Expires: {date}
  - Access level: {public/org/allowlist}
  - Downloads: 0 / {max}
- [Edit Link] [Revoke Link]

**Step 8: Recipient Accesses Link**
- Recipient clicks link: `GET https://skillsier.com/s/{token}`
- Backend validates:
  - Token exists and not revoked
  - Not expired
  - Download limit not exceeded
  - If password protected: Show password prompt
  - If CAPTCHA enabled: Show CAPTCHA challenge
  - If org-only: Require login, check org membership
- If valid:
  - Log access: share_id, ip_address, user_agent, accessed_at
  - Increment access_count, download_count
  - Generate presigned download URL
  - Show file preview or download prompt
- If invalid:
  - Show error: "Link expired", "Link not found", "Access denied"

**Step 9: Monitor Share Activity**
- User views "My Shares" page
- Lists all active shares (files shared by user):
  - File name + thumbnail
  - Shared with (user names or "Anyone with link")
  - Permission level
  - Access count / Download count
  - Expires in {time}
  - [View Activity] [Edit] [Revoke]
- Click "View Activity":
  - Show access log:
    - Who accessed (user or IP for public links)
    - When
    - Action (viewed, downloaded, edited)
    - Device / Location (IP geolocation)
  - Export activity log (CSV)

**Step 10: Manage Permissions**
- User clicks "Edit" on share
- Change permission level
- Change expiry date
- Add/remove recipients
- Revoke share for specific user
- Revoke all shares for file
- Backend: `PATCH /v1/storage/shares/{id}`
  - Update share record
  - Emit: `share.updated.v1`, `share.revoked.v1`
- Notify affected users:
  - **Email**: "Your access to '{file_name}' has been updated/revoked"

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: Share Quota Exceeded**
- User tries to share file with 101st person (limit: 100)
- Block: "Maximum share limit reached (100 shares per file)"
- Suggest: "Revoke old shares or use public link"

**B2: Reshare Not Allowed**
- User has View-only access, tries to reshare
- Block: "You don't have permission to share this file"
- Explain: "Ask the owner to grant you reshare permission"

**B3: External Email Share**
- User shares with external email
- Send email invite
- Recipient must create Skillsier guest account
- Guest account limited access (view-only, no platform features)
- Email must verify before accessing file

**B4: Password Protected Link**
- Recipient clicks link
- Prompt: "Enter password to access this file"
- 3 failed attempts: Lock for 15 minutes (per IP)
- After lock: Show CAPTCHA + password prompt

**B5: Link Expired**
- Recipient clicks expired link
- Show: "This link expired on {date}"
- If owner: "Regenerate link?"
- If recipient: "Contact file owner for new link"

**B6: Download Limit Reached**
- Link has max_downloads: 10, already downloaded 10 times
- Block: "Download limit reached"
- Owner notified: "Share link '{file_name}' has reached download limit"

**B7: Public Link CAPTCHA**
- Anonymous user accesses public link
- Show CAPTCHA (reCAPTCHA v3 or hCaptcha)
- If CAPTCHA score low: Show interactive CAPTCHA
- Prevent bot scraping

**B8: Suspicious Activity**
- 50+ access attempts from same IP in 1 hour
- Auto-block IP temporarily
- Email owner: "Suspicious activity detected on your share link"
- Show CAPTCHA on all subsequent attempts

**B9: Revoke Share**
- User revokes share for specific person
- Backend marks share as REVOKED
- Recipient loses access immediately
- Email recipient: "Your access to '{file_name}' has been revoked"
- If recipient has file cached (offline): Flag as invalid on next sync

**B10: Share Folder**
- User shares entire folder
- Prompt: "Share folder '{folder_name}' and all {count} files inside?"
- Permission applies to all current and future files
- Recipient sees folder in "Shared with me"
- Upload permission: Recipient can add files to folder

**B11: Inherit Permissions**
- Folder shared with Edit access
- All nested files/subfolders inherit permission
- User can override per-file
- Warning: "This will override folder permissions"

**B12: Conflicting Permissions**
- File shared with View, but parent folder shared with Edit
- Higher permission wins (Edit)
- Show icon indicating inherited permission

**B13: Share with Team**
- User shares with team (10 members)
- Creates 10 individual shares
- Team member added later: Auto-share
- Team member removed: Auto-revoke

**B14: Expiry Reminder**
- Share expires in 2 days
- Email owner: "Your share for '{file_name}' expires in 2 days. Extend?"
- Quick action link in email: [Extend by 30 days]

**B15: Bulk Revoke**
- User selects multiple shares
- "Revoke All" button
- Confirm: "Revoke {count} shares?"
- Batch revoke operation

**B16: Guest Account Limits**
- External user creates guest account via share invite
- Limitations:
  - Cannot create files
  - Cannot share further
  - Cannot access platform features (jobs, contracts)
  - Account auto-expires after 90 days inactivity
- Prompt to upgrade to full account

**B17: Organization-Only Link**
- User creates org-only link
- Recipient must belong to same organization
- Login required to access
- Check org membership via SSO or domain whitelist

**B18: Anonymous Access Tracking**
- Public link accessed anonymously
- Log IP address, referrer, user-agent
- Geolocation via IP lookup
- Show owner: "Accessed from {city, country}"

**B19: Share Removed File**
- User shares file, then deletes it
- Shares auto-revoked
- Recipients notified: "Shared file '{file_name}' has been deleted"

**B20: Accept/Decline Share**
- Internal user receives share invite
- Notification: [Accept] [Decline]
- If accept: File added to "Shared with me"
- If decline: Share removed, owner notified

**B21: Reshare Permission**
- User with Edit access tries to reshare
- Check if original share allows reshare
- If not: Block with message
- If yes: Create new share, track share_chain

**B22: Share Link Analytics**
- Owner views link analytics dashboard:
  - Total accesses
  - Unique IPs
  - Geographic distribution (map)
  - Device types (desktop, mobile, tablet)
  - Referrer sources
  - Peak access times
- Export report (PDF/CSV)

**B23: Mobile Share Sheet**
- iOS/Android native share sheet integration
- Share link via any app on device
- Quick share to recent contacts

**B24: Copy Link Notification**
- User copies share link
- Toast: "Link copied! Expires in {time}"
- If no expiry: "Link copied (no expiration)"

**B25: Admin Override**
- Admin force-revokes share (policy violation)
- Owner and recipient notified
- Reason logged in audit trail
- Cannot be restored by owner

#### Notifications

**Share Created:**
- **Email (recipient):** "{sender_name} shared '{file_name}' with you"
- **In-app (recipient):** Share invite notification with [Accept] [Decline]

**Share Accepted:**
- **In-app (owner):** "{recipient_name} accepted your share"

**Share Declined:**
- **In-app (owner):** "{recipient_name} declined your share"

**Share Revoked:**
- **Email (recipient):** "Your access to '{file_name}' has been revoked"

**Share Expired:**
- **Email (owner):** "Your share for '{file_name}' has expired"
- **Email (recipient):** "Your access to '{file_name}' has expired"

**Download Limit Reached:**
- **Email (owner):** "Share link download limit reached for '{file_name}'"

**Suspicious Activity:**
- **Email (owner):** "Suspicious activity detected on your share link - {access_count} attempts"

**Expiry Reminder:**
- **Email (owner, 2 days before):** "Share expires soon: '{file_name}' - [Extend Now]"

**Access Activity (Weekly Digest):**
- **Email (owner):** "Weekly share activity: {total_accesses} accesses, {unique_users} users"

**Share Link Accessed:**
- **In-app (owner, real-time if enabled):** "'{file_name}' accessed via link by {location}"

#### Analytics

- storage.share.created (file_id, recipient_type: 'user' | 'team' | 'external', permission_level)
- storage.share.accepted (share_id, recipient_user_id)
- storage.share.declined (share_id, recipient_user_id, decline_reason)
- storage.share.revoked (share_id, revoked_by, reason)
- storage.share.expired (share_id, days_active)
- storage.share_link.generated (file_id, access_level, expiry_days, password_protected)
- storage.share_link.accessed (share_link_id, ip_address, country, authenticated: boolean)
- storage.share_link.password.failed (share_link_id, ip_address, attempt_count)
- storage.share_link.captcha.shown (share_link_id, ip_address)
- storage.share_link.download_limit.reached (share_link_id, download_count)
- storage.share_link.revoked (share_link_id, revoked_by)
- storage.share.permission.changed (share_id, old_permission, new_permission)
- storage.share.activity.viewed (share_id, owner_user_id)
- storage.share.bulk.revoked (share_count, owner_user_id)
- storage.share.folder.created (folder_id, recipient_count, permission_level)
- storage.share.suspicious_activity (share_link_id, ip_address, access_count_1h)
- storage.share.guest_account.created (email, invited_by)
- storage.share.team.created (team_id, file_id, member_count)
- storage.share.analytics.viewed (share_link_id, metric_type)
- storage.share.mobile.native_sheet (platform, app_name)

#### Sources

**Backend:** storage-be.user-stories.md (Share domain, Share Link domain, Permission domain, Access Log domain)  
**Backend:** storage-be.database-design.md (shares table, share_links table, share_permissions table, share_access_logs table)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/storage/share routes, hooks/storage/use-share.ts, components/storage/share-modal/, components/storage/share-link/)

### STG-5 — File Lifecycle & Compliance

**Journey ID:** STG-5  
**Persona:** User, Admin, Compliance Officer  
**Preconditions:** Files stored in system  
**Triggers:** Automated lifecycle rules, compliance requirements, retention policies, legal holds

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/storage/lifecycle` - Lifecycle policy management (admin)
- `(dashboard)/storage/compliance` - Compliance dashboard (admin)
- `(admin)/storage/retention` - Retention policy configuration
- `(admin)/storage/legal-holds` - Legal hold management
- `(dashboard)/storage/files/[id]/compliance` - File compliance details

**Mobile Routes:**
- `mobile/(admin)/storage/compliance` - Mobile compliance view

#### System Touchpoints

**Backend Microservices:**
- **storage-be**: `/lifecycle`, `/retention`, `/legal-hold`, `/archive`, `/compliance`
- **admin-be**: Policy enforcement, audit logging

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: Configure Lifecycle Policies (Admin)**
- Admin navigates to lifecycle policy page
- View existing policies:
  - Default platform policies
  - Custom organization policies
  - Entity-specific rules (contracts, proposals)
- Click "Create Policy"
- Policy wizard:
  - **Name**: "Archive old contracts"
  - **Scope**: Select entity types (contracts, proposals, messages)
  - **Conditions**:
    - File age: >365 days since upload
    - Last accessed: >180 days
    - Entity status: closed/archived
    - File type: documents only (exclude images)
    - Size: any
  - **Actions**:
    - Move to COLD storage (archive tier)
    - Update visibility to "private"
    - Send notification to owner
    - Reduce redundancy (single copy)
  - **Schedule**: Daily at 2:00 AM UTC
  - [Create Policy] [Cancel]

**Step 2: Backend Applies Lifecycle Rules**
- Cron job runs daily (or triggered manually)
- Query files matching policy conditions
- For each matching file:
  - Check if exempt (legal hold, active contract)
  - Apply action:
    - Move blob to archive storage class (S3 Glacier)
    - Update file.storage_class = 'COLD'
    - Update file.lifecycle_rule_applied_at
    - Emit event: `file.archived.v1`
- Generate lifecycle report:
  - Files processed: 1,234
  - Storage freed: 45GB
  - Cost savings: $12/month
- Email admin: "Daily lifecycle job completed"

**Step 3: User Accesses Archived File**
- User tries to download archived file
- Backend detects storage_class = 'COLD'
- Initiate retrieval from Glacier:
  - Expedited (1-5 min, $$$)
  - Standard (3-5 hours, $)
  - Bulk (5-12 hours, ¢)
- Show user: "File is archived. Retrieval requested (est. 4 hours)"
- Email when ready: "Your file '{file_name}' is ready to download"
- Temporary availability: 24 hours in HOT tier, then back to COLD

**Step 4: Set Retention Policy**
- Admin creates retention policy (compliance-driven):
  - **Name**: "Financial Records Retention"
  - **Applies to**: Files tagged 'invoice', 'tax-document'
  - **Retention Period**: 7 years (legal requirement)
  - **Actions**:
    - Block deletion before retention period ends
    - Auto-delete after retention period (if no legal hold)
    - Immutable (prevent edits)
  - **Compliance**: GDPR, SOX, IRS requirements
- Save policy
- Backend: `POST /v1/storage/retention-policies`
  - Stores policy rules
  - Links to files via tags or entity types

**Step 5: Enforce Retention**
- User tries to delete file with retention policy
- Backend checks retention_until date
- If retention period not met:
  - Block deletion
  - Return 403: "File under retention policy. Cannot delete until {date}"
  - Frontend shows lock icon + tooltip: "Protected by retention policy"
- If retention period met and no legal hold:
  - Allow deletion

**Step 6: Apply Legal Hold**
- Legal/compliance officer places legal hold:
  - **Reason**: "Ongoing litigation - Case #12345"
  - **Scope**: All files related to contract_id = XYZ
  - **Effective Date**: Immediate
  - **Hold Duration**: Indefinite (until released)
  - **Authority**: Jane Doe, Legal Counsel
- Backend: `POST /v1/storage/legal-holds`
  - Create legal_hold record
  - Link to affected files
  - Update file.legal_hold_status = 'ACTIVE'
  - Emit: `legal_hold.applied.v1`
- All affected files:
  - Cannot be deleted
  - Cannot be modified
  - Immutable metadata
  - Visible lock icon with legal hold notice

**Step 7: Monitor Compliance**
- Admin views compliance dashboard:
  - **Files Under Legal Hold**: 234 files
  - **Files with Retention Policy**: 12,456 files
  - **Retention Compliance**: 98.7% (flagged: 165 overdue)
  - **Lifecycle Rules Active**: 5 policies
  - **Recent Deletions**: Audit log of permanent deletions
  - **Access Violations**: Unauthorized access attempts
- Drill down into each category
- Export compliance report (PDF with legal signature)

**Step 8: Auto-Delete After Retention**
- Retention period expires (7 years)
- No legal hold active
- Cron job runs daily:
  - Query files where retention_until < now AND legal_hold_status = NULL
  - Soft-delete files (move to trash)
  - 30-day grace period in trash
  - After 30 days: Permanent deletion
  - Emit: `file.retention.expired.v1`, `file.deleted.v1`
- Notify owner: "File '{file_name}' deleted due to expired retention policy"

**Step 9: Release Legal Hold**
- Legal officer releases hold:
  - **Reason**: "Litigation settled"
  - **Released By**: Jane Doe
  - **Release Date**: Today
- Backend: `PATCH /v1/storage/legal-holds/{id}/release`
  - Update legal_hold.status = 'RELEASED'
  - Update file.legal_hold_status = NULL
  - Emit: `legal_hold.released.v1`
- Files become eligible for deletion/modification again
- Audit log entry created

**Step 10: Compliance Audit Trail**
- Every action logged immutably:
  - File uploaded: user_id, timestamp, ip_address
  - File accessed: user_id, action (view/download), timestamp
  - File deleted: user_id, delete_reason, timestamp
  - Legal hold applied/released: officer_id, reason, timestamp
  - Retention policy applied: policy_id, timestamp
  - Lifecycle action: rule_id, action, timestamp
- Audit log queryable by:
  - Date range
  - User
  - File ID
  - Action type
  - Compliance event
- Export audit log: CSV, JSON, PDF
- Tamper-proof: Stored in append-only database or blockchain

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: Conflicting Policies**
- File matches multiple lifecycle rules
- Priority order:
  1. Legal hold (highest priority, blocks all other actions)
  2. Retention policy (prevents deletion)
  3. Lifecycle rules (archiving, tiering)
- Show admin: "File under legal hold - lifecycle actions suspended"

**B2: Legal Hold on Deleted File**
- User soft-deleted file
- Legal hold applied
- File immediately restored from trash
- Mark as legally protected
- Notify user: "File restored due to legal hold"

**B3: Retention Policy Retroactive**
- Admin creates retention policy for existing files
- Apply policy to all matching files (backfill)
- Show warning: "This will affect {count} existing files"
- Confirm: [Apply Retroactively] [Future Only]

**B4: User Tries to Edit Immutable File**
- File under retention policy with immutable flag
- User tries to rename or edit metadata
- Block: "File is immutable due to retention policy"
- Show read-only badge

**B5: Expedited Retrieval Quota**
- User requests expedited retrieval (expensive)
- Check user tier: Only PRO/ENTERPRISE allowed
- FREE tier: Must wait for standard retrieval (3-5 hours)

**B6: Archive Storage Cost Warning**
- User uploads large file (5GB)
- System estimates lifecycle cost:
  - "This file will cost $2/month in active storage"
  - "After 365 days, archived to COLD ($0.20/month)"
- User can override: "Keep in active storage always"

**B7: Retrieval Request Queue**
- 100 files requested for retrieval simultaneously
- Queue requests
- Process in batches (10 at a time)
- Show: "Your file is #45 in queue. Est. ready in 6 hours."

**B8: Legal Hold Expires (Time-Based)**
- Some legal holds have expiry dates
- Cron job releases holds automatically
- Notify legal officer: "Legal hold auto-released for Case #{case_number}"

**B9: Compliance Violation Detected**
- Automated scan detects violation:
  - File deleted before retention period
  - Legal hold bypassed (admin override)
  - Unauthorized access to protected file
- Trigger alert:
  - Email compliance officer immediately
  - Red flag in compliance dashboard
  - Create incident ticket
  - Log in audit trail with severity: CRITICAL

**B10: GDPR Right to Delete**
- User requests account deletion (GDPR)
- System must delete personal files
- But: Files under legal hold cannot be deleted
- Conflict resolution:
  - Anonymize file metadata (remove user link)
  - Retain file content for legal hold
  - User account deleted, files orphaned to "Legal Hold System Account"
- Notify user: "Some files retained due to legal obligations"

**B11: Retention Policy Update**
- Admin updates retention period: 7 years → 10 years
- Prompt: "Extend retention for {count} existing files?"
- If yes: Update retention_until dates
- Affected users notified: "Retention period extended"

**B12: Lifecycle Rule Dry Run**
- Admin tests new policy before applying
- "Dry Run" mode:
  - Show which files would be affected
  - Simulate actions
  - Display report: "1,234 files would move to COLD storage"
- No actual changes made
- Admin reviews, then activates policy

**B13: Manual Archive Override**
- User manually archives file (before policy triggers)
- Flag file.manual_archive = true
- Exempt from automatic lifecycle rules
- Admin can override if needed

**B14: Archive Retrieval Failed**
- Glacier retrieval fails (AWS error)
- Retry automatically (3 attempts)
- If all fail: Alert admin
- Notify user: "Retrieval failed. Support team notified."

**B15: Bulk Legal Hold**
- Place legal hold on entire folder or contract
- Apply to all nested files (current + future)
- Show: "Legal hold applied to {count} files in '{folder_name}'"

**B16: Compliance Report Scheduling**
- Admin schedules automated reports:
  - Daily, weekly, monthly
  - Email to compliance team
  - PDF format with charts
  - Include: retention status, legal holds, deletions, violations

**B17: File Restored from Archive**
- User retrieves archived file
- File temporarily moved to HOT tier
- After 24 hours of no access: Auto-return to COLD
- User can pin to HOT: "Keep in active storage"

**B18: Lifecycle Policy Conflict with Contract**
- Contract is active (ongoing work)
- Lifecycle rule tries to archive contract files
- Detect conflict:
  - Check contract.status != 'CLOSED'
  - Exempt from archiving
- Wait until contract closes

**B19: Retention Policy Cascade**
- Folder has retention policy
- All files in folder inherit policy
- New files uploaded: Auto-inherit
- User warned on upload: "Files in this folder are under retention policy"

**B20: Admin Force Delete**
- Admin needs to delete file under legal hold (exceptional case)
- Require multi-step confirmation:
  1. Enter admin password
  2. Enter legal hold case number
  3. Enter reason (audit trail)
  4. Secondary admin approval (if configured)
- Log action prominently in audit trail
- Email compliance officer immediately

**B21: Storage Tiering Notification**
- File about to be moved to COLD storage (7 days notice)
- Email owner: "File '{file_name}' will be archived in 7 days. Access now if needed."
- Owner can opt out: "Keep in active storage for 90 more days"

**B22: Lifecycle Analytics**
- Admin views lifecycle impact dashboard:
  - Storage cost savings over time
  - Files archived per month (chart)
  - Retrieval requests (frequency, cost)
  - Policy effectiveness (% files processed)
- Optimize policies based on data

**B23: Legal Hold Notification**
- When legal hold applied:
  - Email all file owners
  - In-app notification: "Your file is under legal hold"
  - Display reason and case number
  - Provide contact for questions

**B24: Compliance Certification**
- System generates compliance certificates:
  - "Files stored in accordance with [regulation]"
  - Digital signature from system
  - Issued to user/organization
  - Downloadable PDF
- Required for audits

**B25: Archive Redundancy**
- Critical files in archive tier
- Admin enables higher redundancy:
  - Standard: 1 copy in COLD
  - High: 3 copies across regions
- Higher cost, better durability
- For legal/compliance files

#### Notifications

**Lifecycle Rule Applied:**
- **Email (admin, weekly digest):** "Lifecycle report: {file_count} files archived, {cost_saved} saved"

**File Archived:**
- **In-app (owner):** "File '{file_name}' moved to archive storage"

**Archived File Ready:**
- **Email (user):** "Your file '{file_name}' is ready to download (available for 24 hours)"

**Retention Policy Applied:**
- **Email (admin):** "Retention policy '{policy_name}' applied to {file_count} files"

**Retention Period Expired:**
- **Email (owner):** "File '{file_name}' deleted due to expired retention policy"

**Legal Hold Applied:**
- **Email (file owner):** "Legal hold placed on your file '{file_name}'. Reason: {reason}. Case: {case_number}"
- **Email (legal officer):** "Legal hold applied to {file_count} files for Case {case_number}"

**Legal Hold Released:**
- **Email (file owner):** "Legal hold released on your file '{file_name}'"
- **Email (legal officer):** "Legal hold released for Case {case_number}"

**Compliance Violation:**
- **Email (compliance officer, immediate):** "ALERT: Compliance violation detected - {violation_type}"
- **In-app (admin):** Red banner "Compliance violation requires attention"

**GDPR Deletion Conflict:**
- **Email (user):** "Account deletion request processing. Some files retained due to legal holds."

**Retrieval Request Queued:**
- **In-app (user):** "File retrieval requested. Est. ready in {time}"

**Retention Period Extended:**
- **Email (file owner):** "Retention period extended to {new_date} for '{file_name}'"

**Lifecycle Policy Update:**
- **Email (admin):** "Lifecycle policy '{policy_name}' updated. {affected_count} files affected."

#### Analytics

- storage.lifecycle.policy.created (policy_name, scope, action_types)
- storage.lifecycle.policy.applied (policy_id, file_count, storage_freed_bytes, cost_saved)
- storage.lifecycle.file.archived (file_id, storage_class, reason)
- storage.retention.policy.created (policy_name, retention_days, entity_types)
- storage.retention.policy.applied (policy_id, file_count, retroactive: boolean)
- storage.retention.violation.detected (file_id, violation_type, user_id)
- storage.retention.period.expired (file_id, retention_days, auto_deleted)
- storage.legal_hold.applied (legal_hold_id, file_count, reason, case_number)
- storage.legal_hold.released (legal_hold_id, file_count, release_reason)
- storage.legal_hold.conflict.detected (file_id, conflict_type)
- storage.archive.retrieval.requested (file_id, retrieval_speed, user_id)
- storage.archive.retrieval.completed (file_id, retrieval_time_hours, cost)
- storage.archive.retrieval.failed (file_id, fail_reason, retry_count)
- storage.compliance.dashboard.viewed (admin_id, metric_viewed)
- storage.compliance.report.generated (report_type, file_count, format)
- storage.compliance.violation.logged (violation_type, severity, file_id)
- storage.audit_log.queried (query_filters, result_count, admin_id)
- storage.audit_log.exported (format, date_range, file_count)
- storage.immutable.edit.blocked (file_id, user_id, attempted_action)
- storage.gdpr.deletion.conflict (user_id, legal_hold_file_count)
- storage.admin.force_delete (file_id, admin_id, reason, approval_chain)
- storage.lifecycle.dry_run (policy_id, affected_file_count, cost_impact)
- storage.storage_class.changed (file_id, old_class, new_class, trigger: 'manual' | 'automatic')

#### Sources

**Backend:** storage-be.user-stories.md (Lifecycle domain, Retention domain, Legal Hold domain, Archive domain, Compliance domain, Audit domain)  
**Backend:** storage-be.database-design.md (lifecycle_policies table, retention_policies table, legal_holds table, file_lifecycle_logs table, audit_logs table)

# SECTION I) SEARCH & DISCOVERY

This section covers the comprehensive search system including job search, talent discovery, saved searches, search personalization, and recommendations.

---

### SRCH-1 — Search Jobs (Basic & Advanced)

**Persona:** Client, Freelancer, Public User  
**ID:** SRCH-1  
**Feature Epic:** Search & Discovery  
**Description:** User searches for jobs using text queries, filters, and advanced search criteria with faceted navigation and personalized results.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- No authentication required for basic search (public)
- Authentication required for saved searches and personalization
- Search index must be healthy and up-to-date
- User triggers search from:
  - Homepage search bar
  - Jobs browse page
  - Dedicated search page
  - Mobile app search tab

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/search/jobs` - Basic job search with filters
- `(dashboard)/search/jobs/advanced` - Advanced search interface
- `(dashboard)/search/saved` - Saved searches management
- `(dashboard)/search/personalization` - Personalization settings
- `(dashboard)/search/history` - Search history
- `(public)/search` - Public job search (unauthenticated)

**Mobile Routes:**
- `(tabs)/(search)/jobs` - Job search interface
- `(tabs)/(search)/saved` - Saved searches
- `(tabs)/(search)/history` - Recent searches

#### System Touchpoints
- **search-be:** ExecuteSearchQuery, SaveSearchCommand, GetFacetsQuery, ComputePersonalizedRankingQuery
- **indexing-be:** GetIndexHealthQuery, RefreshIndexCommand
- **taxonomy-be:** MapUserSkillCommand, GetTaxonomyQuery
- **analytics-be:** TrackSearchEvent, RecordSearchMetrics
- **recommendations-be:** GetRecommendedJobsQuery
- **notifications-be:** NotifySavedSearchMatch

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: Enter Search Query**
- User lands on search page
- Display search bar with:
  - Text input with placeholder: "Search for jobs, skills, or companies"
  - Autocomplete dropdown (triggers after 3 characters)
  - Recent searches section (authenticated users)
  - Popular searches (unauthenticated users)
- As user types, show real-time suggestions:
  - Skill matches (highlighted)
  - Job title matches
  - Company names
  - Location suggestions
  - "See all results for '{query}'" option

**Step 2: Execute Search**
- User presses Enter or clicks search button
- Show loading state with skeleton cards
- Backend performs:
  - Query normalization (synonyms, stemming)
  - Elasticsearch multi-match query across:
    - Job title (boost: 3x)
    - Job description (boost: 1x)
    - Required skills (boost: 2x)
    - Company name (boost: 1.5x)
  - Apply default filters (active jobs only)
  - Compute relevance score
  - Apply personalization boost (if authenticated)

**Step 3: Display Results**
- Show results grid with:
  - **Result count:** "1,247 jobs found for 'React Developer'"
  - **Sort dropdown:** Relevance (default), Date Posted, Budget (High-Low), Budget (Low-High)
  - **View toggle:** Grid view / List view
  - **Results per page:** 20 (configurable: 10, 20, 50)
- Each result card shows:
  - Job title (clickable)
  - Company name with logo
  - Budget range (if disclosed)
  - Location (with remote badge if applicable)
  - Key skills (max 5 tags)
  - Posted date (relative: "2 days ago")
  - Bookmark icon (heart)
  - Match score badge (authenticated users): "85% match"
  - "Featured" or "Urgent" badge (if applicable)

**Step 4: Apply Filters (Faceted Navigation)**
- Display filter sidebar with collapsible sections:

**Skills Filter:**
- Multi-select checkboxes
- Show count next to each skill: "React (247), Node.js (189)"
- Search within skills: "Find a skill..."
- Display top 10 skills, "Show more" expands
- Selected skills show as chips above results

**Budget Range Filter:**
- Dual-handle range slider
- Input fields for min/max
- Display distribution histogram
- Quick presets: "$500-$1K", "$1K-$5K", "$5K-$10K", "$10K+"

**Location Filter:**
- Autocomplete location search
- "Remote Only" checkbox
- Radius slider (if location selected): 10mi, 25mi, 50mi, 100mi, nationwide
- Multi-select locations with chips

**Job Type Filter:**
- Checkboxes: Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Freelance
- Multiple selection allowed

**Experience Level Filter:**
- Checkboxes: Entry Level, Intermediate, Expert, Not Specified

**Date Posted Filter:**
- Radio buttons: Last 24 hours, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Any time

**Hourly Rate Filter:**
- Dual-handle slider
- Quick presets: "$10-$25/hr", "$25-$50/hr", "$50-$100/hr", "$100+/hr"

**Client Rating Filter:**
- Star rating selector: 4+ stars, 3+ stars, Any
- Show client review count

**Additional Filters (Advanced Search):**
- Payment Verified: Yes/No toggle
- Company Size: Startup, Small, Medium, Large, Enterprise
- Industry: Multi-select dropdown
- Contract Duration: Short-term (<3mo), Medium-term (3-6mo), Long-term (6mo+)
- Featured Jobs: Toggle
- With Proposals: Less than 5, 5-10, 10-20, 20+ proposals

**Step 5: Filter Application & Real-time Updates**
- When user changes any filter:
  - Update URL query params (for sharing/bookmarking)
  - Show loading spinner on results grid
  - Execute new search query with updated filters
  - Update result count: "247 jobs found"
  - Update facet counts dynamically
  - Maintain scroll position
  - Update "Active Filters" chip section
- Active filters displayed as removable chips:
  - "React × | Node.js × | Remote × | $1K-$5K × | Clear all filters"

**Step 6: Save Search (Authenticated Users)**
- User clicks "Save Search" button (bell icon with plus)
- Modal appears:
  - **Search name:** Input field (auto-populated with query + top filter)
  - **Notification frequency:**
    - Radio buttons: Instant, Daily Digest, Weekly Digest, Off
  - **Alert criteria:**
    - Checkbox: "Only notify if budget > $X"
    - Checkbox: "Only notify for Featured jobs"
  - Buttons: "Save" / "Cancel"
- On save:
  - Search saved to user's profile
  - Confirmation toast: "Search saved! You'll receive alerts based on your settings."
  - Add to "Saved Searches" section in sidebar

**Step 7: Access Saved Searches**
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/search/saved`
- Display saved searches list with cards:
  - Search name (editable)
  - Query text + filter summary
  - Last matched: "3 new jobs today"
  - Notification setting badge
  - Actions: "Run Now", "Edit", "Delete"
  - Click card to execute search
- Receive notifications when new jobs match:
  - Email: "5 new jobs match your saved search 'React Remote $5K+'"
  - In-app notification with direct link
  - Push notification (mobile)

**Step 8: Personalized Results (Authenticated Users)**
- If user is authenticated, apply personalization boost:
  - **Profile match:** Boost jobs requiring user's skills (+20% score)
  - **Past behavior:** Boost similar jobs to previously bookmarked (+15%)
  - **Success rate:** Boost clients with high hire rate on user's skill level (+10%)
  - **Preference learning:** Boost budget ranges user typically applies to (+10%)
  - **Location preference:** Boost jobs in user's preferred locations (+5%)
- Display personalization indicator:
  - Info icon: "Results personalized based on your profile and activity"
  - Link to "Manage Personalization" settings

**Step 9: Search History (Authenticated Users)**
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/search/history`
- Display recent searches (last 50):
  - Search query text
  - Filters applied (summary)
  - Timestamp (relative)
  - Result count at time of search
  - Quick action: "Search Again" button
  - Delete icon for individual searches
  - "Clear All History" button
- Click any search to re-execute with same params

**Step 10: Advanced Search Interface**
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/search/jobs/advanced`
- Display comprehensive search builder:
  - **Boolean operators:** AND, OR, NOT
  - **Field-specific search:**
    - Title contains: "..."
    - Description contains: "..."
    - Company name: "..."
    - Skills: Multi-select with operators (ALL, ANY)
  - **Advanced filters:**
    - Exclude keywords: Text input
    - Must have attachments: Checkbox
    - Posted by verified clients only: Checkbox
    - Exclude jobs you've applied to: Checkbox
    - Exclude bookmarked jobs: Checkbox
  - **Date range picker:** Custom date range
  - **Save as template:** Reusable search template
- Generate query preview: "Your search: (title:senior AND skills:react) NOT company:competitor"

#### Edge Cases & Alternate Flows

**A1: No Results Found**
- Display empty state:
  - Icon: Magnifying glass with X
  - Message: "No jobs found for 'Blockchain Developer'"
  - Suggestions:
    - "Try broader search terms"
    - "Remove some filters"
    - "Check for typos"
    - "Browse similar searches: [Related Query 1] [Related Query 2]"
  - Button: "Clear All Filters"
  - Button: "View All Jobs"
  - If saved search: "Save this search to get notified when matching jobs are posted"

**A2: Typo / Spelling Correction**
- Detect potential typos (edit distance algorithm)
- Show: "Showing results for 'JavaScript'. Did you mean 'Java Script'?"
- Clickable link to search for suggested term
- Option: "Search instead for [original query]"

**A3: Query Too Broad**
- If search returns > 10,000 results:
  - Warning banner: "Your search is very broad. Consider using filters for better results."
  - Highlight recommended filters (most popular for similar queries)
  - Auto-suggest: "Try adding: [Skill Filter] or [Location Filter]"

**A4: Slow Search (Timeout)**
- If search takes > 5 seconds:
  - Show progress indicator: "Searching through thousands of jobs..."
- If timeout (> 15 seconds):
  - Error message: "Search is taking longer than expected. Please try:"
    - "Simplify your query"
    - "Reduce number of filters"
    - "Try again in a moment"
  - Button: "Retry Search"
  - Log analytics event: search.timeout

**A5: Search Index Unavailable**
- If Elasticsearch cluster is down:
  - Display maintenance message:
    - "Search is temporarily unavailable. We're working to restore it."
    - "Try again in a few minutes."
  - Show cached popular searches
  - Fallback: Browse by category links
  - Admin alert triggered immediately

**A6: Save Search Limit Reached**
- Free users: Max 5 saved searches
- Premium users: Max 50 saved searches
- On limit reached:
  - Modal: "You've reached your saved search limit (5/5)"
  - Options:
    - "Delete an existing search"
    - "Upgrade to Premium for unlimited saved searches"
  - List existing searches with delete option

**A7: Duplicate Saved Search**
- User tries to save search that matches existing one:
  - Detection: Compare query + filters hash
  - Modal: "You already have a similar saved search: '[Search Name]'"
  - Options:
    - "Update existing search"
    - "Save as new search anyway"
    - "Cancel"

**A8: Filter Conflict**
- User selects conflicting filters (e.g., Budget: $100-$500 AND Hourly Rate: $100+/hr)
- Show warning indicator: "⚠ Filter conflict detected"
- Tooltip: "Some filters may contradict each other and limit results"
- Suggest resolution: "Remove: [Filter 1] or [Filter 2]"

**A9: Location Not Found**
- User enters invalid location: "Asdfgh"
- Show: "Location not found. Did you mean: [Suggestions]"
- Allow manual entry anyway (free text search)
- Backend logs ambiguous location for improvement

**A10: Unauthorized Saved Search Access**
- Unauthenticated user clicks "Save Search"
- Modal: "Sign in to save searches and receive job alerts"
- Buttons: "Sign In" / "Create Account" / "Continue Without Saving"

**A11: Personalization Disabled**
- User navigates to `(dashboard)/search/personalization`
- Toggle: "Enable Personalized Results" (default: ON)
- If disabled:
  - Show: "Personalization paused. Results are generic."
  - Results show without any boosting
  - No "Match %" badges displayed
- Option: "Reset Personalization Data" (clears learned preferences)

**A12: Expired Saved Search Alert**
- Saved search hasn't found new matches in 90 days
- Email notification: "No recent matches for your saved search '[Name]'. Consider updating your criteria."
- In saved searches list: Yellow badge "No recent matches"
- Suggest: "Edit Search" to broaden criteria

**A13: Bulk Filter Application**
- User applies many filters rapidly (>5 in 3 seconds)
- Debounce search execution (wait for 500ms idle)
- Show: "Updating filters..." during debounce
- Execute single search after debounce complete
- Prevent rate limit issues

**A14: Mobile Responsive Filters**
- On mobile:
  - Filters in bottom sheet drawer (slide up)
  - Sticky "Apply Filters" button
  - Chip display for active filters (horizontal scroll)
  - Simplified filter UI (accordions)
  - "Quick Filters" section at top (Remote, Budget Range, Date)

**A15: Saved Search Notification Preferences**
- Navigate to notification settings from saved search
- Granular control:
  - Email: On/Off + Frequency
  - Push: On/Off
  - In-app: On/Off
  - SMS: On/Off (premium feature)
- Preview: "Test notification" button
- Quiet hours: Don't send between 10 PM - 8 AM

**A16: Search Query Expansion**
- Backend expands query with synonyms:
  - "JS" → "JavaScript"
  - "ML" → "Machine Learning"
  - "Frontend" → "Front-end, Front End, FE"
- Display: "Including results for: [Synonym 1], [Synonym 2]"
- User can exclude: Click "×" on expanded term

**A17: Collaborative Filtering Recommendations**
- Sidebar widget: "Users who searched for this also searched for:"
  - List of related queries (clickable)
  - "React Developer" users also searched:
    - "Node.js Backend Engineer"
    - "Full Stack Developer"
    - "Frontend Architect"
- Analytics: Track which related searches are clicked

**A18: Search Performance Monitoring**
- Admin dashboard view:
  - Search latency P95: Target < 300ms
  - Slow queries > 1s: Alert threshold
  - Zero-result rate: % of searches with no results
  - Filter usage heatmap
  - Top searched terms (last 24h)
  - Failed searches log
- Auto-optimization: Cache popular query results (TTL: 15m)

**A19: A/B Testing Search Ranking**
- Admin can enable A/B test:
  - Variant A: Relevance-based ranking
  - Variant B: Personalization-heavy ranking
  - Split: 50/50 user assignment
- Track metrics:
  - Click-through rate (CTR)
  - Application conversion rate
  - Time to first application
- Winning variant promoted after statistical significance

**A20: Search Analytics Export**
- User navigates to `(dashboard)/search/history`
- Button: "Export Search Data"
- Modal:
  - Date range picker
  - Format: CSV, JSON, Excel
  - Include: Queries, filters, result counts, timestamps
- Download report for personal tracking/analysis

**A21: Facet Value Truncation**
- If facet has > 100 unique values (e.g., Skills):
  - Show top 10 by popularity
  - "Show more" expands to 50
  - Search box: "Find a skill..."
  - Selected values always shown (even if not in top 10)
- Performance optimization: Don't load all facet values upfront

**A22: Search Intent Detection**
- AI analyzes query to detect intent:
  - "Senior React developer remote $100/hr" → Auto-apply filters:
    - Experience: Expert
    - Skills: React
    - Job Type: Remote
    - Hourly Rate: $100+
  - Show: "We applied filters based on your search. Adjust if needed."
  - User can accept or modify

**A23: Search Query History Sync**
- Sync search history across devices (authenticated users)
- Search on desktop → Appears in mobile history
- Privacy setting: "Sync search history" (default: ON)
- Option: "Clear history on all devices"

**A24: Featured Search Placement**
- Top of results: "Sponsored" or "Featured" jobs section
  - Clearly labeled: "Featured Jobs"
  - Max 3 featured jobs at top
  - Differentiated styling (light border, badge)
- User preference: "Hide featured jobs" (setting)

**A25: Search Tutorial (First-time Users)**
- On first search, show interactive tutorial:
  - Highlight search bar: "Enter keywords or skills"
  - Highlight filters: "Narrow results with filters"
  - Highlight save button: "Save searches for alerts"
  - "Skip Tutorial" option
  - Don't show again checkbox

#### Notifications

**Saved Search Match:**
- **Email (configurable frequency):** "5 new jobs match your saved search 'React Remote $5K+'"
- **Push:** "New job matches your saved search"
- **In-app:** Badge on "Saved Searches" nav item

**Slow Search Alert (Admin):**
- **Email (admin):** "Search latency exceeded threshold: P95 > 1s"
- **Slack (admin channel):** "#alerts: Search performance degraded"

**Search Index Health Alert (Admin):**
- **Email (admin, immediate):** "CRITICAL: Search index is unhealthy - Red status"
- **PagerDuty (admin):** On-call engineer alerted

**Saved Search Expiring:**
- **Email (user, 7 days before expiration):** "Your saved search expires in 7 days. Renew to keep receiving alerts."

**Search Limit Warning:**
- **In-app (modal):** "You've used 4/5 saved searches. Upgrade for unlimited."

#### Analytics

- search.query.executed (query_text, filter_count, result_count, latency_ms, user_authenticated)
- search.query.zero_results (query_text, filters_applied, suggestions_shown)
- search.filter.applied (filter_type, filter_value, result_count_change)
- search.filter.removed (filter_type, result_count_change)
- search.sort.changed (old_sort, new_sort)
- search.result.clicked (job_id, result_position, query_text, match_score)
- search.saved (search_id, query_text, filter_count, notification_frequency)
- search.saved.edited (search_id, changes_made)
- search.saved.deleted (search_id, days_since_created)
- search.saved.executed (search_id, new_results_count)
- search.history.viewed (history_item_count)
- search.history.rerun (original_query, days_since_original)
- search.personalization.toggled (enabled: boolean)
- search.personalization.reset (user_id)
- search.autocomplete.shown (query_partial, suggestion_count)
- search.autocomplete.selected (suggestion_text, query_partial)
- search.spell_correction.shown (original_query, suggested_query)
- search.spell_correction.accepted (original_query, corrected_query)
- search.facet.expanded (facet_name)
- search.facet.value.selected (facet_name, facet_value, result_count_before, result_count_after)
- search.advanced.opened (from_page)
- search.boolean.query.built (operators_used, field_specific_filters)
- search.timeout (query_text, latency_ms)
- search.error (error_type, query_text)
- search.export.requested (format, date_range, item_count)

#### Sources

**Backend:** search-be.user-stories.md (Query domain, Indexing domain, Facets domain, Personalization domain), taxonomy-be.user-stories.md (Skill mapping)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/search routes, hooks/search/use-search.ts, hooks/search/use-filters.ts, hooks/search/use-autocomplete.ts, components/search/)

### SRCH-2 — Search Talent (Freelancer Discovery)

**Persona:** Client  
**ID:** SRCH-2  
**Feature Epic:** Search & Discovery  
**Description:** Client searches for freelancers/talent using skills, experience, location, availability, rating, and other criteria to find the perfect match for their project.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- User must be authenticated as Client
- User must have active client profile
- Talent search index must be healthy
- User accesses from:
  - "Find Talent" navigation item
  - "Hire Freelancers" CTA on dashboard
  - "Browse Talent" from job posting flow

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/search/talent` - Main talent search
- `(dashboard)/search/talent/advanced` - Advanced talent search
- `(dashboard)/search/talent/saved` - Saved talent searches
- `(dashboard)/search/talent/matches` - AI-recommended matches
- `(dashboard)/search/talent/invitations` - Sent invitations tracker

**Mobile Routes:**
- `(tabs)/(search)/talent` - Talent search
- `(tabs)/(search)/talent/saved` - Saved searches
- `(tabs)/(hire)/matches` - Recommended talent

#### System Touchpoints
- **search-be:** ExecuteTalentSearchQuery, ComputeTalentMatchScore, GetTalentFacetsQuery
- **users-be:** GetFreelancerProfileQuery, GetAvailabilityQuery
- **recommendations-be:** GetRecommendedTalentQuery, ComputeSimilarityScore
- **contracts-be:** GetFreelancerSuccessStatsQuery
- **reviews-be:** GetFreelancerReputationQuery
- **analytics-be:** TrackTalentDiscoveryEvent
- **communications-be:** SendInvitationCommand

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: Enter Talent Search**
- Client navigates to talent search page
- Display search interface with:
  - **Search bar:** "Search by skills, name, or title"
  - **Autocomplete suggestions:**
    - Top skills
    - Freelancer titles
    - Previous searches
  - **Quick filters row:**
    - Available Now
    - Top Rated (4.5+)
    - Verified
    - Located Nearby
    - Within Budget

**Step 2: Execute Search**
- User enters query: "Senior React Developer"
- Backend performs Elasticsearch query across:
  - Professional title (boost: 3x)
  - Skills (boost: 2.5x)
  - Bio/Overview (boost: 1x)
  - Portfolio project descriptions (boost: 1.5x)
  - Specializations (boost: 2x)
- Apply default filters:
  - Profile complete (> 80%)
  - Active in last 30 days
  - Available for work OR open to offers

**Step 3: Display Talent Results**
- Show results grid with talent cards:
  - **Profile photo** (circular, verified badge overlay if verified)
  - **Name** (clickable to full profile)
  - **Professional title:** "Senior React Developer"
  - **Location:** City, Country (+ timezone if remote)
  - **Hourly rate:** "$85/hr" (or range: "$70-$100/hr")
  - **Availability badge:** "Available Now" (green) / "Available in 2 weeks" (yellow) / "Booked" (gray)
  - **Rating:** 4.8 ★ (127 reviews)
  - **Top skills:** React, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS (max 4 tags)
  - **Success rate:** "95% Job Success"
  - **Total earned:** "$150K+ earned" (milestone bracket)
  - **Match score:** "92% match" (authenticated clients with job context)
  - **Quick actions:**
    - "Invite to Job" button (primary)
    - "Save" (heart icon)
    - "Message" (chat icon)
  - **Portfolio preview:** Thumbnail of top project
  - **Recent work:** "Completed 15 jobs" / "Last active: 2 days ago"

**Step 4: Apply Talent-Specific Filters**

**Skills Filter:**
- Multi-select skills
- "Must have ALL" vs "Must have ANY" toggle
- Skill level requirement: Beginner, Intermediate, Expert
- Years of experience per skill: Slider (0-20 years)
- Display count next to each skill

**Hourly Rate Filter:**
- Dual-handle range slider: $10 - $200+/hr
- Input fields for custom min/max
- Quick presets: "$10-$30", "$30-$60", "$60-$100", "$100+"

**Availability Filter:**
- Radio buttons:
  - Available Now
  - Available This Week
  - Available This Month
  - Open to Offers (any time)
  - Show All

**Job Success Rate Filter:**
- Slider: 0% - 100%
- Quick presets: "90%+", "80%+", "Any"
- Tooltip: "% of successfully completed jobs"

**Rating Filter:**
- Star selector: 5★, 4.5★+, 4★+, 3.5★+, Any
- Include "No reviews yet" checkbox

**Location Filter:**
- Autocomplete city/country search
- Radius: Within 25mi, 50mi, 100mi, Same state, Same country, Worldwide
- Timezone filter: UTC offset range
- "Open to relocation" checkbox

**Experience Level Filter:**
- Checkboxes: Entry (0-2 yrs), Intermediate (2-5 yrs), Expert (5-10 yrs), Master (10+ yrs)

**Verification Status Filter:**
- Checkboxes:
  - Identity Verified
  - Payment Verified
  - Email Verified
  - Phone Verified
  - Background Check Complete

**Portfolio Filter:**
- "Has portfolio" toggle
- Minimum portfolio items: Slider (1-10)
- Industry filter: Multi-select (Tech, Healthcare, Finance, etc.)

**Total Earned Filter:**
- Range slider: $0 - $500K+
- Quick presets: "$10K+", "$50K+", "$100K+", "$250K+"
- Tooltip: "Total earnings on Skillsier"

**Activity Filter:**
- Last active: Last 24h, Last week, Last month, Last 3 months
- Average response time: < 1 hour, < 4 hours, < 24 hours

**Languages Filter:**
- Multi-select language + proficiency level
- Example: "English (Native), Spanish (Fluent)"

**Employment History Filter:**
- "Has employment history" toggle
- Minimum years of experience: Slider (0-20)

**Education Filter:**
- Degree level: High School, Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, Certification
- Field of study: Multi-select

**Step 5: Sort Results**
- Sort dropdown options:
  - Relevance (default)
  - Best Match (personalized score)
  - Highest Rated
  - Most Experienced
  - Most Earned
  - Lowest Hourly Rate
  - Highest Hourly Rate
  - Recently Active
  - Newest Members
  - Most Reviews
- Sort updates results in real-time
- URL updates with sort parameter

**Step 6: View Detailed Profile**
- Client clicks on talent card
- Navigate to full profile view (modal or new page):
  - Complete profile information
  - Extended skills list with proficiency
  - Full portfolio with project details
  - Work history
  - Education
  - Certifications
  - All reviews (paginated)
  - Availability calendar
- CTA buttons:
  - "Invite to Job" (select from client's open jobs)
  - "Send Message"
  - "Save to Favorites"
  - "Share Profile" (copy link)

**Step 7: Invite Freelancer to Job**
- Client clicks "Invite to Job" from talent card or profile
- Modal opens:
  - **Select job:** Dropdown of client's active job postings
  - **Personal message:** Text area (optional, max 500 chars)
    - Template suggestions: "I saw your profile and think you'd be great for..."
  - **Include budget:** Checkbox (attach proposed budget)
  - **Highlight match:** Auto-generated text: "This job requires React and Node.js, which match your top skills"
- Button: "Send Invitation"
- On success:
  - Toast: "Invitation sent to [Name]!"
  - Freelancer receives notification
  - Add to "Sent Invitations" tracker
  - Talent card shows: "Invited" badge (gray)

**Step 8: Save Favorite Freelancers**
- Client clicks heart icon on talent card
- Freelancer added to "Saved Talent" collection
- Toast: "Added to favorites"
- Access saved talent from `(dashboard)/search/talent/saved`
- Saved talent list shows:
  - All saved freelancers with notes field
  - Availability updates (notifications when available)
  - "Remove from favorites" option
  - Bulk actions: "Invite All to Job", "Export to CSV"

**Step 9: Save Talent Search**
- Client clicks "Save Search" button
- Modal:
  - **Search name:** Input (auto-generated from filters)
  - **Get notified when:**
    - New talent matches criteria
    - Saved talent becomes available
    - Saved talent lowers rate
  - **Notification frequency:** Instant, Daily, Weekly
- On save:
  - Confirmation: "Search saved! We'll notify you of new matches."
  - Add to sidebar "Saved Searches"
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/search/talent/saved` to manage

**Step 10: AI-Recommended Matches**
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/search/talent/matches`
- AI recommends talent based on:
  - Client's active job postings
  - Client's past hires (skill patterns)
  - Project budgets and complexity
  - Success rates with similar talent
  - Industry-specific matching
- Display recommended talent with:
  - **Match explanation:** "Recommended because: [Reason 1], [Reason 2], [Reason 3]"
  - **Confidence score:** "95% confident this is a good match"
  - **Which job:** "Best fit for: [Job Title]"
  - Actions: "Invite", "Not Interested", "Save"
- Learn from feedback:
  - Track accepted vs rejected recommendations
  - Improve future suggestions

#### Edge Cases & Alternate Flows

**B1: No Talent Found**
- Display empty state:
  - Icon: Search with magnifying glass
  - Message: "No freelancers match your criteria"
  - Suggestions:
    - "Try broader search terms"
    - "Remove some filters"
    - "Consider expanding location range"
    - "Browse recommended talent for your industry"
  - Buttons: "Clear Filters", "View All Talent", "Get AI Recommendations"

**B2: All Top Talent Unavailable**
- Top matches are all booked/unavailable
- Banner: "Top matches are currently unavailable. Try:"
  - "Bookmark them and get notified when available"
  - "Explore similar talent"
  - "Post a job and receive proposals"
- Show unavailable talent with "Notify Me" button

**B3: Budget Mismatch**
- Client's budget filter: $20-$40/hr
- Top talent hourly rates: $80-$120/hr
- Warning message: "Your budget may be lower than typical rates for this skill level. Consider:"
  - "Expanding budget range"
  - "Looking for less experienced talent"
  - "Posting a fixed-price job instead"
- Show talent anyway with "Above your budget" badge

**B4: Talent Profile Incomplete**
- Search result includes freelancer with <50% profile completion
- Show warning badge: "Incomplete Profile"
- Tooltip: "This freelancer hasn't completed their profile yet"
- Option to filter out incomplete profiles

**B5: Invitation Limit Reached**
- Free clients: 10 invitations per month
- Premium clients: 100 invitations per month
- On limit:
  - Modal: "You've reached your monthly invitation limit (10/10)"
  - Options:
    - "Upgrade to Premium for more invitations"
    - "Wait until [Date] for reset"
    - "Use messages instead" (unlimited)
  - Show invitation count in header: "7/10 invitations used"

**B6: Freelancer Already Invited**
- Client tries to invite same freelancer to same job again
- Disable "Invite" button
- Show: "Invited on [Date]" badge
- Option: "Send Follow-up Message"

**B7: Freelancer Blocked Client**
- Client searches for talent
- Result includes freelancer who blocked the client
- Don't show this freelancer in results (invisible filter)
- No indication to client (privacy)

**B8: Client Blocked by Freelancer**
- Client tries to invite/message blocked freelancer
- Error: "Unable to contact this freelancer"
- No specific reason given (privacy)

**B9: Saved Search Limit**
- Free clients: 3 saved talent searches
- Premium clients: 20 saved talent searches
- On limit: Prompt to upgrade or delete existing search

**B10: Timezone Compatibility Warning**
- Client in PST searches for talent in EST
- Show timezone badge: "UTC-5 (8 hour difference)"
- Highlight if outside desired working hours overlap
- Filter: "Similar timezone only" option

**B11: Freelancer Rate Increase**
- Saved freelancer increases rate: $50/hr → $75/hr
- Notification: "[Name] updated their rate to $75/hr"
- Update saved talent list with new rate
- Re-run budget filter to check if still matches

**B12: Invitation Expired**
- Freelancer doesn't respond to invitation in 14 days
- Mark invitation as "Expired" in tracker
- Option: "Send Reminder" (once per invitation)
- After 30 days: Remove from active invitations

**B13: Freelancer Declines Invitation**
- Freelancer clicks "Not Interested" on invitation
- Client receives notification: "[Name] declined your invitation to [Job]"
- Invitation marked as "Declined" in tracker
- Optionally: Freelancer can provide reason (not shared with client unless freelancer chooses)

**B14: Bulk Talent Invitation**
- Client selects multiple talent (checkboxes)
- Button: "Invite All to Job"
- Modal:
  - Select job (same job for all)
  - Personal message (same message for all, or customize per talent)
  - Confirm: "Invite [Count] freelancers to [Job]?"
- Rate limit check: Ensure doesn't exceed monthly limit

**B15: Talent Comparison View**
- Client selects up to 5 talent (checkboxes)
- Button: "Compare"
- Open comparison table:
  - Side-by-side columns for each talent
  - Rows: Skills, Rate, Availability, Rating, Success Rate, Total Earned, Response Time
  - Highlight best value in each category
  - Quick actions: "Invite", "Message", "View Profile"

**B16: Portfolio Deep Dive**
- Client clicks "View Portfolio" from talent card
- Modal or page with all portfolio items
- Filters:
  - By industry
  - By skill
  - By project type
- Sort by: Most recent, Most liked, Client rating
- Each item: Thumbnail, title, description, skills used, client review

**B17: Talent Search Analytics**
- Admin dashboard view:
  - Top searched skills
  - Average talent search latency
  - Zero-result search rate
  - Filter usage heatmap
  - Invitation acceptance rate
  - Conversion: Search → Invitation → Hire
- Optimize search ranking based on data

**B18: Similar Talent Suggestions**
- Client views specific freelancer profile
- Sidebar widget: "Similar Talent"
  - AI-recommended talent with similar skills/experience
  - Click to view profile
  - "See All Similar" button
- Algorithm: Content-based filtering using skill embeddings

**B19: Saved Talent Availability Alert**
- Client saves unavailable talent
- When talent updates availability to "Available Now":
  - Email: "[Name] is now available! Invite them to your job."
  - Push notification
  - In-app notification with "Invite Now" button

**B20: Talent Search Tutorial**
- First-time client searching for talent
- Interactive tutorial:
  - Highlight search bar: "Search by skills or job title"
  - Highlight filters: "Filter by budget, location, rating"
  - Highlight match score: "We calculate compatibility for you"
  - Highlight invite button: "Invite top matches directly"
  - "Skip" button always available

**B21: Search Feedback Loop**
- After client invites/hires from search results
- Prompt (once per week max): "How relevant were your search results?"
  - Thumbs up / Thumbs down
  - Optional text: "What could we improve?"
- Analytics: Track relevance feedback to improve ranking

**B22: Talent Search Export**
- Client navigates to search results
- Button: "Export Results"
- Modal:
  - Format: CSV, PDF
  - Include: Name, Skills, Rate, Rating, Profile Link
  - Max 100 results
- Download file for offline review/sharing with team

**B23: Team Collaboration on Talent Search**
- Client can share search results with team members
- Button: "Share with Team"
- Modal:
  - Select team members (multi-select)
  - Add note: "Please review these candidates for [Job]"
  - Permission: View only / Can invite
- Team members receive notification with link to search results

**B24: Talent Pool Creation**
- Client creates custom talent pool from search results
- Select multiple talent (checkboxes)
- Button: "Add to Talent Pool"
- Modal:
  - Create new pool or add to existing
  - Pool name: "Mobile Developers" (example)
  - Tags for organization
- Access pools from `(dashboard)/talent/pools`
- Use cases: Future projects, seasonal hiring, favorites segmentation

**B25: Negative Filtering**
- Client can exclude certain attributes:
  - "Exclude talent I've worked with before"
  - "Exclude talent with <80% success rate"
  - "Exclude talent with unverified identity"
  - "Exclude talent outside budget range"
- Advanced: Boolean NOT operators in advanced search

#### Notifications

**New Talent Matches Saved Search:**
- **Email (configurable frequency):** "3 new freelancers match your search '[Search Name]'"
- **Push:** "New talent matches your saved search"
- **In-app:** Badge on "Saved Searches"

**Saved Talent Now Available:**
- **Email (instant):** "[Name] is now available for work! Invite them to your project."
- **Push:** "[Name] is available"

**Invitation Accepted:**
- **Email:** "[Name] accepted your invitation to [Job]! Send a message to get started."
- **Push:** "Invitation accepted"
- **In-app:** Notification with "View Proposal" link

**Invitation Declined:**
- **Email:** "[Name] declined your invitation to [Job]"
- **In-app:** Notification

**Invitation Expiring Soon:**
- **Email (12 days after invite):** "Your invitation to [Name] expires in 2 days. Send a reminder?"

**Saved Talent Rate Changed:**
- **Email (weekly digest):** "Rate updates for your saved talent"

**Talent Search Limit Warning:**
- **In-app (banner):** "You've used 9/10 monthly invitations. Upgrade for unlimited."

#### Analytics

- talent_search.query.executed (query_text, filter_count, result_count, latency_ms)
- talent_search.query.zero_results (query_text, filters_applied)
- talent_search.filter.applied (filter_type, filter_value, result_count_change)

- talent_search.saved.created (search_id, filter_count, notification_frequency)
- talent_search.saved.executed (search_id, new_results_count)
- talent_search.favorite.added (freelancer_id)
- talent_search.favorite.removed (freelancer_id, days_saved)
- talent_search.comparison.viewed (freelancer_ids, comparison_count)
- talent_search.similar.clicked (original_freelancer_id, similar_freelancer_id)

- talent_search.match_recommendations.invited (freelancer_id, confidence_score)
- talent_search.match_recommendations.dismissed (freelancer_id, reason)
- talent_search.export.requested (format, result_count)
- talent_search.team_share.sent (team_member_count, search_id)
- talent_search.talent_pool.created (pool_name, freelancer_count)
- talent_search.feedback.submitted (relevance_score, feedback_text)
- talent_search.limit_reached (invitation_limit_type, user_tier)

- talent_search.tutorial.completed (user_id, steps_completed)
