### SRCH-3 — Browse & Search Portfolios

**Persona:** Client, Public User  
**ID:** SRCH-3  
**Feature Epic:** Search & Discovery  
**Description:** User browses and searches through freelancer portfolio projects to discover talent based on actual work samples, filtering by industry, skills, project type, and engagement metrics.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- No authentication required for browsing (public portfolios)
- Authentication required for saving/bookmarking portfolios
- Portfolio search index must be healthy
- User accesses from:
  - "Browse Portfolios" navigation item
  - "Explore Work" public page
  - Freelancer profile "View Portfolio" link
  - Search results "Portfolio" tab

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/search/portfolios` - Portfolio search with filters
- `(dashboard)/portfolios/[id]` - Individual portfolio project view
- `(dashboard)/portfolios/saved` - Saved portfolio items
- `(public)/portfolios` - Public portfolio browse
- `(public)/portfolios/[id]` - Public portfolio view
- `(dashboard)/portfolios/collections` - Curated collections

**Mobile Routes:**
- `(tabs)/(discover)/portfolios` - Portfolio browse
- `(tabs)/(discover)/portfolios/[id]` - Portfolio detail
- `(tabs)/(discover)/saved` - Saved items

#### System Touchpoints
- **search-be:** ExecutePortfolioSearchQuery, GetPortfolioFacetsQuery, ComputeEngagementScore
- **users-be:** GetFreelancerPublicProfileQuery
- **storage-be:** GetMediaPresignedUrlQuery
- **analytics-be:** TrackPortfolioViewEvent, RecordEngagementMetrics
- **recommendations-be:** GetSimilarPortfoliosQuery
- **social-be:** GetPortfolioLikesQuery, GetPortfolioCommentsQuery

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: Enter Portfolio Browse**
- User navigates to portfolios page
- Display hero section:
  - Large heading: "Discover Amazing Work"
  - Subheading: "Browse portfolios from talented freelancers worldwide"
  - Search bar: "Search portfolios by keyword, skill, or industry"
- Show featured/trending portfolios carousel (top 10)
- Display category pills for quick navigation:
  - Web Development, Mobile Apps, Graphic Design, Video Editing, Writing, Marketing, Data Science, 3D/Animation

**Step 2: Browse by Category**
- User clicks category pill (e.g., "Web Development")
- Filter applied automatically
- Display grid of portfolio thumbnails:
  - Large thumbnail image (16:9 aspect ratio)
  - Project title overlay (on hover/tap)
  - Freelancer avatar (small, bottom-left corner)
  - Skills used tags (max 3)
  - Engagement metrics: ❤️ 234 likes, 👁️ 1.2K views
  - "Featured" badge (if applicable)
- Masonry layout for varied heights
- Infinite scroll for pagination

**Step 3: Execute Portfolio Search**
- User enters search query: "E-commerce website"
- Backend Elasticsearch query across:
  - Project title (boost: 3x)
  - Project description (boost: 2x)
  - Skills/technologies used (boost: 2.5x)
  - Industry/category (boost: 2x)
  - Tags (boost: 1.5x)
- Show results count: "487 portfolios found"

**Step 4: Apply Portfolio Filters**

**Skills/Technologies Filter:**
- Multi-select checkboxes
- Auto-suggest popular skills for query
- Count next to each: "React (187), Node.js (145)"
- Search within skills

**Industry Filter:**
- Multi-select dropdown
- Options: Tech/SaaS, E-commerce, Healthcare, Finance, Education, Real Estate, Entertainment, Non-profit, Government, Other
- Count next to each industry

**Project Type Filter:**
- Checkboxes:
  - Website
  - Mobile App
  - Logo & Branding
  - Video/Animation
  - Writing/Content
  - Marketing Campaign
  - Data Analysis
  - Automation/Scripts
  - Other

**Media Type Filter:**
- Checkboxes:
  - Images only
  - Video
  - Live link/Demo
  - Case study (detailed)
  - Code repository

**Engagement Filter:**
- Likes: Min likes slider (0-1000+)
- Views: Min views slider (0-10K+)
- Comments: Min comments slider (0-100+)
- Sort by: Most liked, Most viewed, Most commented

**Client Rating Filter:**
- Only show projects with client reviews
- Star rating: 5★, 4.5★+, 4★+, Any
- "With testimonial" checkbox

**Freelancer Experience Filter:**
- Entry Level, Intermediate, Expert, Master
- Based on freelancer's profile tier

**Recency Filter:**
- Radio buttons:
  - Added in last 30 days
  - Added in last 90 days
  - Added in last year
  - Any time

**Featured Filter:**
- Toggle: "Featured portfolios only"
- Featured = admin-curated or high-engagement

**Step 5: Sort Results**
- Sort dropdown:
  - Relevance (default)
  - Most Recent
  - Most Liked
  - Most Viewed
  - Highest Rated
  - Trending (rising engagement)
- Update results in real-time

**Step 6: View Portfolio Detail**
- User clicks portfolio thumbnail
- Navigate to detailed view (modal or full page):
  
  **Header Section:**
  - Large hero image/video
  - Project title (prominent)
  - Freelancer info card:
    - Avatar + Name (clickable to profile)
    - Professional title
    - Rating ★ 4.9 (15 reviews)
    - "Hire Me" button
  - Project stats: 👁️ 1,247 views, ❤️ 89 likes, 💬 12 comments
  - Engagement actions:
    - Like button (heart, toggle)
    - Bookmark button (for later)
    - Share button (copy link, social)
  - Publication date: "Published 3 weeks ago"

  **Project Details Section:**
  - **About this project:** Rich text description (max 2000 chars)
    - Problem statement
    - Solution approach
    - Technologies used
    - Challenges overcome
    - Results/Impact
  - **Skills used:** Clickable tags (React, TypeScript, AWS, etc.)
  - **Industry:** E-commerce
  - **Project duration:** 6 weeks
  - **Project role:** Full Stack Developer
  - **Team size:** Solo / 3 people / 10+ people

  **Media Gallery:**
  - Images carousel (fullscreen lightbox on click)
  - Embedded videos (YouTube, Vimeo, or direct upload)
  - Live demo link button: "View Live Site" (opens in new tab)
  - Code repository link: "View on GitHub" (if shared)
  - Downloadable assets (if allowed): "Download High-Res Images"

  **Client Testimonial (if available):**
  - Client avatar + name (or "Anonymous Client")
  - Star rating
  - Review text: "Outstanding work! Delivered ahead of schedule..."
  - Date: "3 months ago"

  **Case Study (if detailed):**
  - Expandable sections:
    - Challenge
    - Strategy
    - Execution
    - Results (metrics, screenshots, testimonials)
  - Charts/graphs (if relevant)
  - Before/After comparisons

  **Tags & Keywords:**
  - All relevant tags for SEO and discoverability
  - Clickable (search portfolios with same tag)

  **Engagement Section:**
  - Like button with count
  - Comment section:
    - View all comments (threaded)
    - Add comment (if authenticated)
    - Upvote comments
    - Report inappropriate comments

  **Related Portfolios:**
  - "Similar Projects" widget
    - AI-recommended similar portfolios (same skills/industry)
    - Thumbnail grid (4-6 items)
    - Click to view

  **Freelancer's Other Work:**
  - "More from [Name]" widget
    - Thumbnail grid of other portfolio items
    - "View All" link to full portfolio

  **Footer Actions:**
  - "Hire [Name]" button (primary CTA)
  - "Send Message" button
  - "View Full Profile" button
  - "Report Portfolio" link (flag inappropriate content)

**Step 7: Engage with Portfolio**
- **Like:**
  - Click heart icon
  - Animate heart (fill + scale effect)
  - Increment like count
  - Add to user's "Liked Portfolios" collection
  - Notify freelancer (throttled, not on every like)
- **Bookmark:**
  - Click bookmark icon
  - Toast: "Saved to your collection"
  - Add to `(dashboard)/portfolios/saved`
- **Comment:**
  - Click comment field
  - Enter comment (max 500 chars)
  - Submit
  - Comment appears immediately (with user avatar)
  - Notify freelancer
- **Share:**
  - Click share button
  - Options:
    - Copy link
    - Share via: Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook
    - Email link
  - Track share analytics

**Step 8: Contact Freelancer from Portfolio**
- User clicks "Hire [Name]" from portfolio
- Modal/redirect:
  - Option 1: "Invite to Job" (if client has open jobs)
  - Option 2: "Send Message" (general inquiry)
  - Option 3: "Request Quote" (for specific project)
- Pre-filled message template:
  - "Hi [Name], I saw your portfolio project '[Project Title]' and I'm impressed! I have a similar project..."
- Send button
- On success: Navigate to conversation thread

**Step 9: Save Portfolio to Collection**
- Authenticated users can create collections
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/portfolios/collections`
- Actions:
  - "Create New Collection" button
  - Existing collections listed:
    - Collection name (editable)
    - Thumbnail grid of saved portfolios
    - Portfolio count: "12 items"
    - Actions: "View", "Edit", "Delete"
- From portfolio detail:
  - Bookmark dropdown: "Add to Collection..."
  - Select collection or create new
  - Toast: "Added to '[Collection Name]'"
- Use cases:
  - Inspiration boards
  - Comparison shopping (multiple freelancers)
  - Team collaboration (share collection)
  - Project mood boards

**Step 10: Curated Collections (Platform)**
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/portfolios/collections`
- Display curated collections by admins:
  - "Top 50 Portfolios of the Month"
  - "Best E-commerce Websites"
  - "Outstanding Mobile Apps"
  - "Creative Logo Designs"
- Each collection:
  - Title + description
  - Curator name (admin or featured freelancer)
  - Portfolio count
  - Featured thumbnail grid
  - "View Collection" button
- SEO-optimized landing pages for each collection

#### Edge Cases & Alternate Flows

**C1: No Portfolios Found**
- Display empty state:
  - Icon: Folder with magnifying glass
  - Message: "No portfolios match your search"
  - Suggestions:
    - "Try different keywords"
    - "Remove filters"
    - "Browse by category"
  - Button: "Clear Filters"
  - Show "Trending Portfolios" as fallback

**C2: Broken Media Links**
- Portfolio contains broken image/video links
- Show placeholder image: "Media unavailable"
- Log error for admin review
- Notify freelancer: "Some media in your portfolio is not loading"

**C3: Inappropriate Content Reported**
- User clicks "Report Portfolio"
- Modal:
  - Select reason:
    - Spam/Misleading
    - Stolen work (plagiarism)
    - Inappropriate/Offensive
    - Copyright violation
    - Other (text field)
  - Submit button
- On submit:
  - Confirmation: "Report submitted. We'll review it."
  - Admin receives flagged content notification
  - Suspend portfolio visibility pending review (if multiple reports)

**C4: Portfolio Missing Required Fields**
- Freelancer uploaded portfolio without title or description
- Show warning badge: "Incomplete"
- Reduced visibility in search results
- Freelancer notified: "Complete your portfolio to increase visibility"

**C5: Video Playback Issues**
- Embedded video fails to load
- Show: "Video unavailable. View on [Platform]" link
- Fallback: Thumbnail with play icon (opens external link)

**C6: Live Demo Link Broken**
- "View Live Site" link returns 404 or timeout
- Show warning: "Live demo may be unavailable"
- Provide archived screenshot (if available)
- Notify freelancer: "Your live demo link appears broken"

**C7: Unauthenticated User Tries to Save**
- User clicks bookmark without auth
- Modal: "Sign in to save portfolios"
- Buttons: "Sign In" / "Create Account" / "Continue Browsing"

**C8: Client Repeatedly Views Same Portfolio**
- Analytics: Track repeat views (don't inflate view count)
- Show "You've viewed this 3 times" badge (subtle)
- Suggest: "Ready to reach out?"

**C9: Portfolio Limit Reached (Freelancer)**
- Free freelancers: Max 5 portfolio items
- Premium freelancers: Max 50 portfolio items
- On limit:
  - Freelancer tries to add new portfolio
  - Modal: "Portfolio limit reached (5/5)"
  - Options: "Upgrade to Premium" / "Delete an existing item"

**C10: Bulk Portfolio Actions**
- Admin can bulk moderate portfolios:
  - Select multiple (checkboxes)
  - Actions: "Feature", "Hide", "Delete"
  - Confirmation modal with preview
  - Reason required for bulk actions

**C11: Portfolio Engagement Spike**
- Portfolio receives 1000+ views in 24 hours (viral)
- Auto-feature on homepage trending section
- Notify freelancer: "🎉 Your portfolio is trending!"
- Suggest: "Upgrade profile to capture more leads"

**C12: Plagiarism Detection**
- AI scans uploaded portfolio images for similarity to existing portfolios
- If high match (>90% similarity):
  - Flag for admin review
  - Hold publication pending verification
  - Notify freelancer: "Please confirm this is your original work"
- Freelancer can provide proof (project files, client testimonial, timestamps)

**C13: Portfolio Version History**
- Freelancer edits portfolio multiple times
- System tracks versions (up to 10)
- Freelancer can revert to previous version:
  - Navigate to portfolio edit page
  - "Version History" tab
  - List of past versions with timestamps
  - "Restore" button

**C14: Mobile-Optimized Viewing**
- Portfolio detail on mobile:
  - Fullscreen hero image (swipeable gallery)
  - Sticky "Hire" button at bottom
  - Collapsible sections (tap to expand)
  - Simplified layout for readability
  - Share button in header (native share sheet)

**C15: Accessibility Features**
- All images have alt text (required on upload)
- Video captions available
- Keyboard navigation support
- Screen reader-friendly structure
- High contrast mode option

**C16: Portfolio Analytics (Freelancer View)**
- Freelancer can view own portfolio stats:
  - Navigate to `(dashboard)/portfolios/[id]/analytics`
  - Metrics:
    - Total views (chart over time)
    - Unique visitors
    - Like count (chart)
    - Comment count
    - Profile visits from portfolio
    - Hire conversions (# of clients who hired after viewing)
    - Top referral sources
    - Geographic distribution of viewers
  - Export data as CSV

**C17: Portfolio Download (Client)**
- Client can request downloadable portfolio pack:
  - Button: "Download Portfolio" (if freelancer enabled)
  - Modal: "Request Download"
    - Message to freelancer (optional)
  - Freelancer receives request
  - Freelancer can approve/deny
  - On approval: Generate ZIP file with images, PDFs, links
  - Client receives download link via email

**C18: Portfolio Contest Integration**
- Platform runs portfolio contests (e.g., "Best Mobile App Design 2025")
- Freelancers opt-in to submit portfolio
- Public voting (one vote per user)
- Leaderboard display
- Winners featured on homepage + prizes

**C19: Portfolio Preview Before Publish**
- Freelancer creating/editing portfolio
- "Preview" button shows how it will appear to clients
- Can view in desktop and mobile layouts
- Make adjustments before publishing

**C20: SEO Optimization**
- Each portfolio has unique URL slug: `/portfolios/react-ecommerce-website-2024`
- Open Graph meta tags for social sharing
- Schema.org markup for rich snippets
- Sitemap generation for all public portfolios
- Freelancer can edit meta description

**C21: Portfolio License & Usage Rights**
- Freelancer specifies usage rights on upload:
  - All Rights Reserved (default)
  - Creative Commons (various types)
  - Public Domain
  - Commercial Use OK
- Display license badge on portfolio
- Clients can filter by license type

**C22: Portfolio Collaboration**
- Freelancer can tag collaborators on portfolio project:
  - Add collaborator (search by name/email)
  - Collaborator receives notification
  - Collaborator's profile linked from portfolio
  - Show: "Collaborated with [Name 1], [Name 2]"
- Both freelancers benefit from portfolio visibility

**C23: Portfolio Duplication (Freelancer)**
- Freelancer wants to create similar portfolio entry
- From existing portfolio: "Duplicate" button
- Creates copy with same structure
- Freelancer edits media and text
- Saves time for recurring project types

**C24: Portfolio Archiving (Freelancer)**
- Freelancer wants to hide old/irrelevant work
- Portfolio edit page: "Archive" button
- Archived portfolios:
  - Not visible in search
  - Not shown on public profile
  - Accessible from freelancer's private dashboard
  - Can be unarchived later
- Use case: Keep outdated work but don't show to clients

**C25: Portfolio Import (Freelancer Onboarding)**
- New freelancers can import portfolios:
  - From Behance, Dribbble, GitHub
  - Paste profile URL
  - System scrapes public projects
  - Preview imported items
  - Freelancer selects which to import
  - Bulk import with mapping to Skillsier format
- Speeds up onboarding process

#### Notifications

**Portfolio Liked:**
- **Email (weekly digest):** "Your portfolio received 47 new likes this week"
- **In-app:** "Your portfolio '[Title]' was liked by [User]" (for high-engagement users only)

**Portfolio Commented:**
- **Email (instant):** "[User] commented on your portfolio '[Title]'"
- **Push:** "New comment on your portfolio"
- **In-app:** Notification with direct link

**Portfolio Trending:**
- **Email (instant):** "🎉 Your portfolio is trending! It's received 1,247 views today."
- **Push:** "Your portfolio is trending"

**Portfolio Reported:**
- **Email (admin, instant):** "Portfolio reported: '[Title]' - Reason: [Reason]"

**Portfolio Featured:**
- **Email (freelancer):** "Congratulations! Your portfolio was featured in '[Collection Name]'"
- **Push:** "Your portfolio was featured"

**Portfolio Download Requested:**
- **Email (freelancer):** "[Client Name] requested to download your portfolio '[Title]'"
- **In-app:** Notification with "Approve/Deny" actions

**Saved Portfolio Updated:**
- **Email (weekly digest):** "Portfolios you saved were updated by their creators"

**Collection Shared with You:**
- **Email:** "[User] shared a portfolio collection with you: '[Collection Name]'"
- **In-app:** Notification with collection link

### SRCH-4 — Search Personalization & Recommendations

**Persona:** Client, Freelancer  
**ID:** SRCH-4  
**Feature Epic:** Search & Discovery  
**Description:** User manages search personalization settings, receives AI-powered recommendations, and experiences personalized search results based on profile, behavior, and preferences.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- User must be authenticated
- User must have profile with at least basic information
- Personalization engine must have sufficient data (cold start handling for new users)
- User triggers personalization from:
  - Search results page (personalization toggle)
  - Settings → Personalization
  - Dashboard "Recommended for You" widget
  - Onboarding flow

#### Primary Screens

**Web Routes:**
- `(dashboard)/search/personalization` - Personalization settings & controls
- `(dashboard)/recommendations` - Personalized recommendations dashboard
- `(dashboard)/recommendations/jobs` - Job recommendations (freelancer)
- `(dashboard)/recommendations/talent` - Talent recommendations (client)
- `(dashboard)/recommendations/portfolios` - Portfolio recommendations
- `(dashboard)/settings/personalization` - Privacy & data controls

**Mobile Routes:**
- `(tabs)/(settings)/personalization` - Personalization controls
- `(tabs)/(discover)/recommendations` - Recommendations feed

#### System Touchpoints
- **recommendations-be:** GetPersonalizedRecommendationsQuery, UpdateUserPreferencesCommand, ComputeMatchScoreQuery
- **search-be:** ApplyPersonalizationBoostCommand, GetPersonalizationProfileQuery
- **analytics-be:** TrackUserBehaviorEvent, BuildBehaviorProfileQuery
- **users-be:** GetUserProfileQuery, GetUserSkillsQuery
- **ml-be:** RunCollaborativeFilteringModel, ComputeEmbeddingsQuery
- **contracts-be:** GetUserContractHistoryQuery (for learning preferences)

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**Step 1: Initial Personalization Setup (New Users)**
- After user completes profile:
  - Modal: "Let's personalize your experience!"
  - Steps:
    1. "What are you looking for?" (Client: Talent / Projects, Freelancer: Jobs / Clients)
    2. "Select your interests" (Industry multi-select)
    3. "Preferred budget range" (Slider)
    4. "Work preferences" (Remote, On-site, Hybrid checkboxes)
    5. "How often do you want recommendations?" (Daily, Weekly, Never)
  - Button: "Save Preferences"
- On completion:
  - Toast: "Personalization enabled! Your recommendations will improve over time."
  - Redirect to recommendations dashboard

**Step 2: Access Personalization Settings**
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/search/personalization`
- Display settings dashboard with sections:

**A. Personalization Status:**
- Toggle: "Enable Personalized Results" (ON/OFF)
  - When OFF: See generic results, no behavior tracking for recommendations
  - When ON: Results boosted by preferences & behavior
- Status indicator: "Personalization strength: Strong" (Weak, Moderate, Strong)
  - Based on data available (profile completeness, interaction history)

**B. Your Preferences:**
- **Industries of interest:** Multi-select, editable
  - Show top 10, "Show all" expands
- **Skills you prefer:** Multi-select (for clients: skills they hire; for freelancers: skills they want to learn/use)
- **Budget preferences:**
  - Clients: Typical project budget range
  - Freelancers: Desired hourly/project rate
- **Location preferences:** Cities/countries of interest + Remote toggle
- **Work type:** Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Freelance
- **Availability:** How soon you want to start work (freelancers) / hire (clients)
- **Company size preference (freelancers):** Startup, Small, Medium, Large, Enterprise
- **Experience level preference (clients):** Entry, Intermediate, Expert

**C. Behavioral Learning:**
- Section: "We learn from your actions to improve recommendations"
- Display what the system tracks:
  - ✓ Jobs/profiles you view
  - ✓ Search queries
  - ✓ Filters you apply
  - ✓ Items you bookmark
  - ✓ Applications/invitations you send
  - ✓ Messages you engage with
  - ✓ Contracts you complete
- Toggle for each: "Include in personalization"
- Button: "View Data" - Shows detailed breakdown of tracked behavior

**D. Privacy Controls:**
- Toggle: "Use my data to improve site-wide recommendations" (opt-in for collaborative filtering)
- Toggle: "Show my activity in 'Trending' sections" (opt-in)
- Button: "Reset Personalization" - Clears all learned preferences, starts fresh
- Button: "Export My Data" - Download all personalization data (GDPR compliance)

**Step 3: Personalized Search Results**
- When personalization is enabled:
  - Search results show "% Match" badges
  - Tooltip on hover: "Match breakdown:
    - 40% Skills match your profile
    - 30% Budget within your range
    - 20% Similar to jobs you bookmarked
    - 10% Location preference"
  - Info banner at top: "Results personalized for you. Manage settings"
  - Sort option: "Best Match" (only available when personalized)

**Personalization Boosting Logic:**
- Backend applies score adjustments:
  - **Profile skills match:** +0% to +30% boost
  - **Previous behavior similarity:** +0% to +20% boost
  - **Budget/rate alignment:** +0% to +15% boost
  - **Location preference:** +0% to +10% boost
  - **Recency preference:** +0% to +10% boost (favor recent postings if user clicks recent items)
  - **Employer/client type preference:** +0% to +10% boost
  - **Engagement history:** +5% boost for similar entities user engaged with before
- Total boost: Up to +100% (capped)

**Step 4: Access Recommendations Dashboard**
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/recommendations`
- Display personalized recommendation feed with sections:

**For Freelancers:**

**A. Recommended Jobs:**
- "Jobs for You" section
- Show top 20 job matches
- Each job card displays:
  - Job title, client, budget
  - Match score: "94% match" (prominent)
  - Why recommended: "Matches your React and AWS skills"
  - Quick actions: "Apply", "Save", "Not Interested"
- Sort options: Best Match, Newest, Highest Budget
- Refresh button: "Get New Recommendations"

**B. Trending in Your Field:**
- Jobs currently receiving high engagement from freelancers with similar profiles
- Badge: "Trending 🔥"
- Algorithm: Collaborative filtering (freelancers like you are applying)

**C. Clients You Might Like:**
- List of clients who frequently hire for freelancer's skills
- Client card:
  - Company name, logo
  - Hire rate: "Hired 15 freelancers in the last 6 months"
  - Average budget: "$5K - $10K per project"
  - Rating: 4.8★ (based on freelancer reviews)
  - Action: "Follow" (get notified of new jobs)

**D. Skills to Learn:**
- AI suggests complementary skills based on job market trends
- "Freelancers with React also learn: TypeScript, Next.js, GraphQL"
- Link to learning resources or courses

**For Clients:**

**A. Recommended Talent:**
- "Talent for You" section
- Show top 20 freelancer matches
- Each card:
  - Freelancer name, photo, title
  - Match score: "91% match"
  - Why recommended: "Expert in skills your jobs require"
  - Key stats: Rating, success rate, hourly rate
  - Actions: "Invite", "Message", "Save"
- Sort: Best Match, Highest Rated, Most Affordable

**B. Similar to Talent You Hired:**
- Freelancers similar to past hires
- "Because you hired [Name], you might like:"
- Algorithm: Content-based filtering (skill embeddings)

**C. Popular Talent in Your Industry:**
- Top-rated freelancers in client's industry
- Badge: "Top Rated in [Industry]"

**D. Featured Portfolios:**
- Curated portfolio projects matching client's past job types
- "Portfolios you'll love" section

**Step 5: Interact with Recommendations**
- **Like/Save:** Click save icon, added to favorites
- **Not Interested:** Click dismiss icon
  - Modal: "Why not interested?"
    - Options: Not relevant, Out of budget, Wrong skills, Other (text)
  - Feedback recorded to improve future recommendations
  - Item hidden from feed
  - Similar items deprioritized
- **Apply/Invite:** Direct action from recommendation card
  - Tracking: Conversion from recommendation → application/invitation
- **View Details:** Click card to see full job/profile
  - Track whether user returns to recommendations feed (bounce vs conversion)

**Step 6: Recommendation Explanations**
- Each recommendation has "Why we recommended this" tooltip
- Click to expand:
  - Detailed breakdown of factors
  - "This job matches:
    - ✓ Your top 3 skills: React, Node.js, AWS
    - ✓ Your budget preference: $5K - $10K
    - ✓ Your location: Remote-friendly
    - ✓ Similar to 3 jobs you bookmarked"
  - Link: "Give feedback on this recommendation"

**Step 7: Feedback Loop**
- System learns from user actions:
  - **Positive signals:**
    - User applies to recommended job
    - User invites recommended talent
    - User bookmarks recommendation
    - User spends >30s viewing recommendation detail
  - **Negative signals:**
    - User clicks "Not Interested"
    - User skips recommendation (visible but no interaction)
    - User applies to non-recommended items frequently
  - **Neutral signals:**
    - User views but doesn't act
- Model retrains nightly with new behavior data
- User sees improved recommendations over time

**Step 8: Email Digest (Optional)**
- User opts in to email digests (daily/weekly)
- Email structure:
  - Subject: "Your personalized recommendations for [Date]"
  - Top 5 recommended jobs/talent
  - "New this week: X jobs matching your skills"
  - Trending items in your field
  - CTA: "View All Recommendations"
  - Footer: "Manage email preferences" link

**Step 9: Cold Start Problem Handling (New Users)**
- New users with minimal data:
  - Recommendations based purely on profile data (skills, location, budget)
  - Hybrid approach: Combine popular items + profile-based
  - Banner: "Your recommendations will improve as you interact with the platform"
  - Prompt to complete profile: "Add more skills to get better recommendations"
  - Use industry/category trends to fill gaps

**Step 10: Explainability & Transparency**
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/settings/personalization/how-it-works`
- Educational page:
  - Sections:
    - "How recommendations work" (algorithm explanation, non-technical)
    - "What data we use" (profile, behavior, preferences)
    - "How we protect your privacy" (data anonymization, storage)
    - "How to improve your recommendations" (tips: complete profile, interact more, update preferences)
  - FAQ accordion:
    - "Why am I seeing this recommendation?"
    - "Can I turn off personalization?"
    - "What happens to my data if I delete my account?"
    - "Do other users see my activity?"

#### Edge Cases & Alternate Flows

**D1: Personalization Disabled by User**
- User toggles personalization OFF
- Show confirmation modal: "Disable personalization?
  - You'll see generic search results
  - Recommendations will be based only on popularity
  - Your behavioral data will not be tracked"
- If confirmed:
  - Search results lose match % badges
  - Recommendations page shows popular items only
  - Analytics stops tracking for personalization
  - Existing data retained but not used

**D2: Insufficient Data for Personalization**
- New user or user with minimal interaction history
- Recommendations dashboard shows:
  - Banner: "Building your personalized feed... In the meantime, here are popular items."
  - Display most popular items (fallback)
  - Prompt: "Complete your profile and interact with the platform to get personalized recommendations"
  - Progress bar: "Personalization strength: 20%" (shows what's missing)

**D3: User Repeatedly Dismisses Recommendations**
- User clicks "Not Interested" on 80% of recommendations in a week
- System detects poor fit
- Show modal: "Your recommendations don't seem to be a good fit. Let's adjust!"
  - Button: "Update Preferences"
  - Redirect to personalization settings
  - Highlight: "Review your preferences to improve recommendations"
- Alternatively: A/B test different algorithms for this user

**D4: Conflicting User Preferences**
- User's stated preferences conflict with behavior:
  - Example: Prefers "$5K-$10K" budgets but only applies to "$1K-$3K" jobs
- System prioritizes behavioral data (revealed preferences > stated preferences)
- Show notification: "We noticed you've been applying to lower budget jobs. Update your budget preference?"
  - Options: "Update Preference" / "Keep Current" / "Dismiss"

**D5: Overfitting to Recent Behavior**
- User applies to several jobs in niche industry (e.g., crypto) but normally works in different field
- Risk: All future recommendations become crypto-focused
- Solution: Apply temporal decay (recent actions weighted more but not exclusively)
- Diversity injection: Always include 20% recommendations from broader profile, not just recent behavior

**D6: Recommendation Fatigue**
- User sees same recommendations repeatedly (stale feed)
- Detection: Same items shown >3 times over 2 weeks
- Solution:
  - Inject fresh items (recently posted jobs/profiles)
  - Expand recommendation radius (lower match threshold)
  - Show "New since your last visit" badge
  - Email prompt: "New opportunities match your profile!"

**D7: Privacy Concerns**
- User worried about data usage
- Navigate to `(dashboard)/settings/personalization/privacy`
- Options:
  - "Delete my personalization data" - Clears all, starts fresh
  - "Download my data" - Export JSON of all tracked data
  - "Opt out of collaborative filtering" - Don't use my behavior to recommend to others
  - "Limit data collection" - Only use profile data, not behavior
- Compliance: GDPR, CCPA data rights

**D8: A/B Testing Recommendation Algorithms**
- Admin runs A/B test:
  - Variant A: Collaborative filtering (similar users)
  - Variant B: Content-based filtering (similar items)
  - Variant C: Hybrid
- Users randomly assigned to variant
- Track metrics:
  - Recommendation click-through rate (CTR)
  - Application/invitation conversion rate
  - User satisfaction (feedback)
  - Time to hire/apply
- Winning variant deployed site-wide

**D9: Recommendations API for Third Parties**
- Platform exposes recommendation API (with user consent)
- Use case: Integrations with job boards, portfolio sites
- Endpoint: `GET /api/v1/recommendations?userId={id}&type=jobs&limit=10`
- Response: JSON array of recommended items
- Rate limit: 100 requests/hour per user
- Requires OAuth token with `recommendations:read` scope

**D10: Real-Time Recommendation Updates**
- User profile or preferences change (e.g., add new skill)
- Recommendations refresh immediately (WebSocket push or polling)
- Banner: "Your recommendations have been updated based on recent changes!"
- Smooth transition animation (no jarring reload)

**D11: Recommendation Notification Preferences**
- Navigate to notification settings
- Granular controls:
  - "New job recommendations" - Email, Push, SMS, In-app
  - "New talent recommendations" - Email, Push, In-app
  - "Trending in your field" - Email (weekly digest), Push
  - "Personalization tips" - Email (monthly), In-app
- Frequency options: Instant, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Never
- Quiet hours: "Don't send between 10 PM - 8 AM"

**D12: Diversity & Inclusion in Recommendations**
- Ensure recommendations don't reinforce bias
- Techniques:
  - Anonymize protected attributes (race, gender, age) in ranking
  - Calibrated recommendations (ensure diverse representation)
  - Audit for disparate impact (fairness metrics)
- Admin dashboard: "Recommendation fairness report"
  - Metrics: Gender distribution, geographic diversity, experience level distribution

**D13: Explainability for Rejected Recommendations**
- User clicks "Not Interested" on recommendation
- Follow-up modal: "Help us improve! Why not interested?"
  - Options:
    - Not relevant to my skills
    - Out of budget
    - Location doesn't work
    - Already applied/hired
    - Other (text field)
- Analytics: Track rejection reasons to identify systemic issues

**D14: Serendipity & Exploration**
- Avoid "filter bubble" effect (only showing similar items)
- Inject 10% random/diverse recommendations:
  - "Explore something new" section
  - Items outside typical profile but high quality
  - Badge: "Recommended for exploration 🌟"
- Encourage users to try different types of jobs/talent

**D15: Recommendation Performance Metrics (Admin)**
- Admin dashboard: `(admin)/recommendations/metrics`
- KPIs:
  - Recommendation CTR (% of users who click recommendations)
  - Conversion rate (click → application/invitation)
  - Recommendation coverage (% of users receiving recommendations)
  - Recommendation diversity (distribution of recommended items)
  - Model performance (precision, recall, NDCG)
  - User satisfaction (NPS score for recommendations)
- Charts: Trends over time, cohort analysis, A/B test results

**D16: Cold Start for New Jobs/Profiles**
- New job posted or new freelancer joins
- No historical data for collaborative filtering
- Solution: Content-based recommendations until sufficient data
  - Use skills, budget, location for initial recommendations
  - Promote new jobs/profiles temporarily (boost in ranking)
  - "New on Skillsier" badge

**D17: Recommendation Overlap with Saved Items**
- User receives recommendation for item already saved
- System detects and filters out already saved items from feed
- Alternatively: Show with "You saved this" badge as reminder

**D18: Multi-Device Sync**
- User interacts with recommendations on mobile
- Behavior syncs to web immediately (via backend state)
- Dismissed items on mobile don't reappear on web
- Bookmarked items sync across devices

**D19: Recommendation Expiry**
- Recommended jobs close or freelancers become unavailable
- System auto-removes expired recommendations from feed
- Replace with fresh recommendations dynamically
- No stale items shown

**D20: Recommendation Escalation for VIP Users**
- Premium or high-value users get enhanced recommendations:
  - Higher quality matches (stricter filtering)
  - Faster refresh rate (real-time updates)
  - Dedicated recommendations section
  - Personal recommendation manager (human-in-the-loop for enterprise clients)

**D21: Recommendation Widgets for Dashboard**
- Integrate recommendation widgets across platform:
  - Dashboard homepage: "Recommended for You" card (top 3 items)
  - Job posting success page: "Similar talent you might want to invite"
  - Freelancer application success page: "Other jobs you might like"
  - Sidebar persistent widget: "Quick recommendations"
- Each widget: CTA to full recommendations page

**D22: Feedback Loop Gamification**
- Encourage user engagement with recommendations:
  - Badge: "Recommendation Explorer" - Clicked 50 recommendations
  - Achievement: "Perfect Match" - Applied to 10 recommended jobs with 90%+ match
  - Leaderboard: "Top recommendation converters" (internal, for admins)
- Use gamification carefully (no exploitation)

**D23: Recommendation Transparency Report**
- User navigates to `(dashboard)/recommendations/report`
- Personal recommendation transparency report:
  - "Your recommendations over time" (chart)
  - "Top recommended skills for you" (tag cloud)
  - "Industries you're matched with most" (bar chart)
  - "Your recommendation accuracy" (% of recommendations you engaged with)
  - "Data sources used" (profile: 40%, behavior: 60%)
- Downloadable PDF report

**D24: Integration with External Calendars**
- Recommendations consider user's calendar availability
- If user has busy calendar (sync from Google/Outlook):
  - Freelancers: Deprioritize "Urgent" or "Full-time" jobs
  - Clients: Suggest talent with flexible availability
- Prompt: "Connect calendar to improve recommendations"

**D25: Ethical AI Considerations**
- Document recommendation algorithm decisions
- Ensure no discriminatory patterns (regular audits)
- Provide user recourse: "Challenge a recommendation" button
  - User explains why recommendation is unfair/biased
  - Admin reviews and adjusts algorithm if pattern found
- Transparency: "Our AI is designed to be fair and unbiased. Learn more."

#### Notifications

**New Recommendations Available:**
- **Email (configurable frequency):** "5 new job recommendations match your profile"
- **Push:** "New recommendations for you"
- **In-app:** Badge on "Recommendations" nav item

**Recommendation Accuracy Improved:**
- **Email (monthly):** "Your recommendation accuracy improved to 85% this month!"
- **In-app:** Celebration toast: "🎉 Your recommendations are getting better!"

**Personalization Tip:**
- **Email (monthly):** "Tip: Complete your profile to get better recommendations"
- **In-app:** Banner with tip

**Recommendation Expired:**

# SECTION J: SETTINGS, SECURITY & ACCOUNT

### ACC-1 — Profile & Account Settings

**ID:** ACC-1  
**Persona:** All Users (Client, Freelancer, Hybrid, Admin)  
**Description:** Comprehensive user profile and account settings management including personal information, preferences, display settings, and profile completion tracking.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- **Triggers:**
  - User navigates to "(dashboard)/settings" or "(dashboard)/settings/account"
  - User clicks "Settings" from navigation menu
  - User clicks "Edit Profile" from their profile page
  - System prompts user to complete profile (if incomplete)
  - Onboarding flow directs to profile completion
- **Preconditions:**
  - User is authenticated
  - Email is verified (for most settings changes)

#### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx` — Settings overview/hub
- `(dashboard)/settings/account/page.tsx` — Account settings main page
- `(dashboard)/settings/account/profile/page.tsx` — Profile information edit
- `(dashboard)/settings/account/email/change/page.tsx` — Change email
- `(dashboard)/settings/account/delete/page.tsx` — Delete account
- `(dashboard)/settings/account/deactivate/page.tsx` — Deactivate account
- `(dashboard)/settings/account/close/page.tsx` — Close account
- `(dashboard)/settings/account/data-export/page.tsx` — Export user data (GDPR)
- `(dashboard)/settings/preferences/appearance/page.tsx` — Appearance preferences
- `(dashboard)/settings/preferences/language/page.tsx` — Language and localization
- `(dashboard)/settings/preferences/accessibility/page.tsx` — Accessibility settings

**Mobile:**
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/index.tsx` — Settings main screen
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/account/index.tsx` — Account settings
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/account/profile.tsx` — Edit profile
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/account/email-change.tsx` — Change email
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/preferences/index.tsx` — Preferences hub
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/preferences/appearance.tsx` — Theme and display
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/preferences/language.tsx` — Language settings
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/accessibility/index.tsx` — Accessibility settings

#### System Touchpoints
- **users-be:**
  - `user/entity.go` — Core user data
  - `profile/entity.go` — Profile information
  - `preferences/entity.go` — User preferences
  - `user_settings/entity.go` — UI and accessibility settings
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}` — Fetch user data
  - PATCH `/v1/users/{id}` — Update user data
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/profile` — Fetch profile
  - PATCH `/v1/users/{id}/profile` — Update profile
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/preferences` — Fetch preferences
  - PUT `/v1/users/{id}/preferences` — Update preferences
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/change-email` — Initiate email change
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/verify-email` — Verify new email
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/deactivate` — Deactivate account
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/delete-account` — Delete account
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/data-export` — Request data export
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/data-exports` — List export requests
- **storage-be:**
  - POST `/v1/storage/upload` — Upload profile picture
  - GET `/v1/storage/files/{file_id}` — Retrieve profile picture
- **notifications-be:**
  - Publishes: `user.updated.v1`, `user.deactivated.v1`, `user.deleted.v1`, `email.change.requested.v1`

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**A1: View Settings Overview**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings`
2. System displays settings hub with:
   - Profile completion indicator (circular progress, percentage)
   - Quick access cards: Account, Security, Privacy, Notifications, Preferences
   - Recently changed settings (last 5)
   - Account status badge (Active, Verified, etc.)
3. System fetches: GET `/v1/users/me`, GET `/v1/users/me/preferences`
4. Display user summary: name, email, user type, join date

**A2: Edit Profile Information**
1. User clicks "Edit Profile" or navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/account/profile`
2. System displays profile form:
   - **Basic Info:** First Name, Last Name, Display Name, Professional Headline
   - **Contact:** Email (read-only, with "Change Email" link), Phone Number
   - **Location:** Country, City, Timezone
   - **About:** Bio/Summary (rich text, max 500 words)
   - **Profile Picture:** Upload/crop interface
   - **Social Links:** LinkedIn, GitHub, Portfolio website, etc.
3. User edits fields and uploads profile picture
4. System validates inputs:
   - Name: 2-100 characters
   - Phone: valid format with country code
   - Bio: max 500 words
   - Profile picture: max 5MB, JPG/PNG only
5. User clicks "Save Changes"
6. System:
   - Uploads profile picture to storage-be: POST `/v1/storage/upload`
   - Updates profile: PATCH `/v1/users/me/profile`
   - Recalculates profile completeness score
   - Publishes: `user.profile.updated.v1`
7. System displays success toast: "Profile updated successfully"
8. System refreshes profile completion indicator

**A3: Change Email**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/account/email/change`
2. System displays email change form:
   - Current email (read-only)
   - New email input
   - Password confirmation input
3. User enters new email and password
4. System validates:
   - New email is valid format and not already in use
   - Password is correct
5. User clicks "Request Change"
6. System:
   - Calls POST `/v1/users/me/change-email`
   - Sends verification emails to both old and new addresses
   - Displays pending state with instructions
7. User clicks verification link in new email
8. System verifies token: POST `/v1/users/me/verify-email`
9. System updates email and publishes: `user.email.changed.v1`
10. System sends confirmation to old email
11. System redirects to settings with success message

**A4: Update Preferences**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/preferences`
2. System displays preference categories:
   - **Appearance:** Theme (Light/Dark/Auto), Compact View, Sidebar Collapsed
   - **Language:** UI Language, Date Format, Number Format, Currency
   - **Timezone:** Auto-detect or manual selection
   - **Accessibility:** High Contrast, Large Text, Screen Reader Mode, Reduce Motion, Keyboard Shortcuts
   - **Beta Features:** Early access toggle
3. User changes preferences (e.g., switches theme to Dark)
4. System applies changes in real-time (for UI preferences)
5. User clicks "Save" (for backend preferences)
6. System calls: PUT `/v1/users/me/preferences`
7. System displays success feedback

**A5: Export User Data (GDPR)**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/account/data-export`
2. System displays:
   - Explanation of data export
   - List of data categories included
   - Previous export requests (if any) with status
3. User clicks "Request Data Export"
4. System:
   - Calls POST `/v1/users/me/data-export`
   - Queues export job (async processing)
   - Displays: "Your export is being processed. You'll receive an email when ready."
5. System processes export asynchronously:
   - Gathers data from all microservices
   - Packages into JSON/ZIP format
   - Uploads to storage-be
   - Sends email with download link
6. User receives email with download link (valid for 7 days)
7. User clicks link and downloads export file

**A6: Deactivate Account (Temporary)**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/account/deactivate`
2. System displays deactivation information:
   - What happens when deactivated (profile hidden, can't be contacted)
   - Reactivation process (can reactivate anytime by logging in)
   - Data retention policy
3. User selects reason for deactivation (optional)
4. User confirms deactivation
5. System calls: POST `/v1/users/me/deactivate`
6. System:
   - Sets account_status to 'DEACTIVATED'
   - Hides profile from public view
   - Pauses active contracts (if any)
   - Publishes: `user.deactivated.v1`
7. System logs user out and redirects to landing page
8. Confirmation email sent

**A7: Delete Account (Permanent)**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/account/delete`
2. System displays account deletion warning:
   - Permanent action, cannot be undone
   - Data retention policy (some data retained for legal/compliance reasons)
   - Option to export data first
   - Impact on active contracts, pending payments
3. User selects reason for deletion (required)
4. User checks "I understand this is permanent" checkbox
5. User enters password for confirmation
6. User clicks "Delete My Account"
7. System validates:
   - No active contracts with pending deliverables
   - No unpaid invoices
   - Password is correct
8. System calls: POST `/v1/users/me/delete-account`
9. System initiates deletion process:
   - Anonymizes personal data (GDPR-compliant)
   - Retains transaction history (financial/legal compliance)
   - Pseudonymizes reviews and ratings
   - Publishes: `user.deleted.v1` (triggers cascade across services)
10. System logs user out
11. Confirmation email sent to registered email

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: Profile Picture Upload Issues**
- **File too large:**
  - System displays: "File size exceeds 5MB limit. Please choose a smaller file."
  - Suggest image compression tools
- **Invalid file type:**
  - System displays: "Only JPG and PNG formats are supported."
- **Upload failure:**
  - System retries upload (up to 3 times)
  - If still fails: "Upload failed. Please try again later."
  - Allow user to save other profile changes without picture

**B2: Email Change Conflicts**
- **New email already in use:**
  - System displays: "This email is already associated with another account."
  - Suggest password reset if user forgot they have an account
- **Verification link expired:**
  - System displays: "This verification link has expired. Please request a new one."
  - Provide "Resend Verification" button
- **Old email verification fails:**
  - System sends additional verification to old email
  - Requires verification of both old and new emails for security

**B3: Account Deletion Blocked**
- **Active contracts:**
  - System displays: "You have active contracts. Complete or cancel them before deleting your account."
  - List active contracts with quick actions
- **Pending payments:**
  - System displays: "You have pending payments. Please resolve them before deleting your account."
  - Show payment summary and next steps
- **Disputed transactions:**
  - System displays: "Account deletion is temporarily blocked due to ongoing disputes."
  - Provide dispute resolution link

**B4: Data Export Issues**
- **Export in progress:**
  - System displays current export status
  - Prevent duplicate export requests within 24 hours
- **Export generation fails:**
  - System retries (up to 3 times)
  - If fails: Send email to user with support contact
  - Log error for admin investigation
- **Download link expired:**
  - System displays: "This download link has expired. Please request a new export."
  - Provide "Request New Export" button

**B5: Preference Conflicts**
- **Timezone detection fails:**
  - System defaults to UTC
  - Display warning: "We couldn't detect your timezone. Please set it manually."
- **Language not supported:**
  - System falls back to English
  - Display: "Your browser language is not supported yet. Using English."
- **Theme preference override:**
  - System respects OS-level dark mode if "Auto" selected
  - Provide explicit Light/Dark toggle to override

**B6: Profile Validation Errors**
- **Bio exceeds limit:**
  - Real-time character counter (500 words)
  - Disable "Save" button when limit exceeded
  - Display: "Bio is too long. Max 500 words allowed."
- **Invalid phone number:**
  - System validates phone format using libphonenumber
  - Display: "Please enter a valid phone number with country code."
- **Inappropriate content:**
  - System flags potential violations in bio/headline
  - Display: "Your profile contains content that may violate our terms. Please review."
  - Submit for manual review if user proceeds

**B7: Deactivation Issues**
- **Pending contracts:**
  - System allows deactivation but warns: "Active contracts will be paused. Reactivate before deadlines."
- **Recent reactivation:**
  - Rate limit: Can't deactivate again within 48 hours of reactivation
  - Display: "You recently reactivated your account. Please wait 48 hours before deactivating again."

**B8: Session Management During Changes**
- **Email change:**
  - Invalidate all sessions except current
  - Force re-login on other devices
- **Password reset triggered:**
  - Display: "Email change cancelled due to password reset. Please try again after resetting your password."
- **Account compromise detected:**
  - Lock account and require security verification before allowing changes

**B9: Profile Completeness Calculation**
- System calculates completeness score based on:
  - Basic info: 20% (name, email, phone, location)
  - Profile picture: 10%
  - Professional headline: 10%
  - Bio: 15%
  - Social links: 10%
  - Skills (for freelancers): 20%
  - Portfolio (for freelancers): 15%
- Display progress bar with suggestions for next steps
- Notify user when profile reaches 100% completion

**B10: Mobile-Specific Considerations**
- **Image upload:**
  - Allow camera capture or gallery selection
  - Provide in-app image cropping tool
- **Offline changes:**
  - Queue changes locally
  - Sync when connection restored
  - Display sync status indicator
- **Biometric authentication:**
  - Require biometric or PIN for sensitive changes (email, deletion)

#### Notifications

**Profile Updated:**
- **In-app:** Toast notification: "Profile updated successfully"
- **Email:** None (unless email changed)

**Email Change Requested:**
- **Email (to old address):** "You requested to change your email to {new_email}. Verify to confirm."
- **Email (to new address):** "Verify your new email address to complete the change"
- **In-app:** Banner: "Verify your new email to complete the change"

**Email Changed:**
- **Email (to old address):** "Your email was successfully changed to {new_email}"
- **Email (to new address):** "Your email was successfully verified"
- **In-app:** Success toast: "Email changed successfully"

**Data Export Ready:**
- **Email:** "Your data export is ready for download. Download link: {link} (expires in 7 days)"
- **In-app:** Notification: "Your data export is ready" with download button
- **Push (mobile):** "Your data export is ready"

**Account Deactivated:**
- **Email:** "Your Skillsier account has been deactivated. Log in anytime to reactivate."
- **In-app:** None (user is logged out)

**Account Deleted:**
- **Email:** "Your Skillsier account has been permanently deleted. We're sorry to see you go."
- **In-app:** None (user is logged out)

**Profile Incomplete Reminder:**
- **Email (7 days after signup):** "Complete your profile to get better opportunities"
- **In-app:** Banner: "Your profile is {X}% complete. Complete it to increase visibility."
- **Push (mobile):** "Complete your profile to stand out"

#### Analytics

- settings.viewed (user_id, section: 'account' | 'security' | 'privacy' | 'preferences')
- settings.profile.updated (user_id, fields_changed[])
- settings.profile_picture.uploaded (user_id, file_size, success)
- settings.email.change_requested (user_id)
- settings.email.changed (user_id)

- settings.appearance.theme_changed (user_id, theme: 'light' | 'dark' | 'auto')
- settings.language.changed (user_id, old_language, new_language)
- settings.accessibility.enabled (user_id, feature: 'high_contrast' | 'large_text' | 'screen_reader' | 'reduce_motion')
- settings.data_export.requested (user_id)
- settings.data_export.downloaded (user_id, export_id)
- settings.account.deactivated (user_id, reason)
- settings.account.reactivated (user_id, days_inactive)
- settings.account.deleted (user_id, reason)
- settings.profile_completeness.viewed (user_id, completeness_score)
- settings.profile_completeness.improved (user_id, old_score, new_score, actions_taken[])

#### Sources

**Backend:** users-be.user-stories.md (User domain, Profile domain, Preferences domain, User Settings domain), storage-be.user-stories.md (File upload), admin-be.user-stories.md (Privacy requests), users-be.database-design.md (users table, profiles table, preferences table, user_settings table, privacy_settings table)

### ACC-2 — Security Settings (2FA, Sessions, Trusted Devices)

**ID:** ACC-2  
**Persona:** All Users (Client, Freelancer, Hybrid, Admin)  
**Description:** Comprehensive security management including two-factor authentication (2FA), active session management, trusted device registration, login history tracking, and password management.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- **Triggers:**
  - User navigates to "(dashboard)/settings/security"
  - Security prompt after suspicious login detected
  - Admin requires 2FA for organization members
  - User receives "New device login" email and wants to review
  - Periodic security reminder (every 90 days)
- **Preconditions:**
  - User is authenticated
  - Email is verified
  - For 2FA setup: phone number verified (for SMS method)

#### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/settings/security/page.tsx` — Security overview
- `(dashboard)/settings/security/password/change/page.tsx` — Change password
- `(dashboard)/settings/security/two-factor/enable/page.tsx` — Enable 2FA
- `(dashboard)/settings/security/two-factor/methods/app/page.tsx` — Authenticator app setup
- `(dashboard)/settings/security/two-factor/methods/sms/page.tsx` — SMS 2FA setup
- `(dashboard)/settings/security/two-factor/backup-codes/page.tsx` — Backup codes
- `(dashboard)/settings/security/two-factor/disable/page.tsx` — Disable 2FA
- `(dashboard)/settings/security/sessions/page.tsx` — Active sessions
- `(dashboard)/settings/security/sessions/revoke-all/page.tsx` — Revoke all sessions
- `(dashboard)/settings/security/login-history/page.tsx` — Login history
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy-security/authorized-apps/page.tsx` — OAuth authorized apps

**Mobile:**
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/security/index.tsx` — Security main screen
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/security/password-change.tsx` — Change password
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/security/two-factor/index.tsx` — 2FA management
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/security/two-factor/setup.tsx` — 2FA setup wizard
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/security/two-factor/backup-codes.tsx` — Backup codes
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/security/sessions.tsx` — Active sessions
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/security/login-history.tsx` — Login history
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/biometric/index.tsx` — Biometric auth (Face ID/Touch ID)

#### System Touchpoints
- **users-be:**
  - `security/entity.go` — Security events, sessions, 2FA
  - `security/two_factor/entity.go` — 2FA methods
  - `security/sessions/entity.go` — Session management
  - `security/devices/entity.go` — Trusted devices
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/security/overview` — Security status
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/change-password` — Change password
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/mfa/enable` — Enable 2FA
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/mfa/disable` — Disable 2FA
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/mfa/app` — Setup authenticator app
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/mfa/sms` — Setup SMS 2FA
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/mfa/backup-codes` — Generate backup codes
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/mfa/verify` — Verify 2FA code
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/sessions` — List active sessions
  - DELETE `/v1/users/{id}/sessions/{session_id}` — Revoke session
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/sessions/revoke-all` — Revoke all sessions
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/login-history` — Fetch login history
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/security/events` — Fetch security events
  - POST `/v1/users/{id}/devices/register` — Register trusted device
  - DELETE `/v1/users/{id}/devices/{device_id}` — Revoke device
- **notifications-be:**
  - Publishes: `two_fa.enabled.v1`, `session.revoked.v1`, `password.changed.v1`, `suspicious_login.detected.v1`

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**A1: View Security Overview**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/security`
2. System displays security dashboard:
   - **2FA Status:** Enabled/Disabled badge, method if enabled
   - **Active Sessions:** Count with "View All" link
   - **Last Login:** Date, time, location, device
   - **Password Strength:** Indicator and last changed date
   - **Trusted Devices:** Count with "Manage" link
   - **Recent Security Events:** Last 5 events
   - **Security Score:** Overall score (0-100) with suggestions
3. System fetches: GET `/v1/users/me/security/overview`
4. Display security recommendations based on status

**A2: Change Password**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/security/password/change`
2. System displays password change form:
   - Current password input
   - New password input with strength meter
   - Confirm new password input
   - Password requirements checklist (8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special char)
3. User enters passwords
4. System validates in real-time:
   - Current password is correct
   - New password meets requirements
   - New password != current password
   - Passwords match
5. User clicks "Change Password"
6. System:
   - Calls POST `/v1/users/me/change-password`
   - Hashes new password
   - Invalidates all sessions except current
   - Publishes: `password.changed.v1`
7. System displays success message: "Password changed successfully. You've been logged out on all other devices."
8. System sends email notification to user

**A3: Enable 2FA (Authenticator App)**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/security/two-factor/enable`
2. System displays 2FA method selection:
   - Authenticator App (Recommended)
   - SMS
   - Email (least secure, backup only)
3. User selects "Authenticator App"
4. System redirects to `(dashboard)/settings/security/two-factor/methods/app`
5. System generates secret: POST `/v1/users/me/mfa/app`
6. System displays:
   - QR code (for scanning with authenticator app)
   - Manual entry code (if can't scan QR)
   - Instructions: "Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, Authy, or any TOTP app"
7. User scans QR code in authenticator app
8. System displays verification field: "Enter the 6-digit code from your app"
9. User enters 6-digit code
10. System verifies: POST `/v1/users/me/mfa/verify`
11. If valid:
    - System enables 2FA
    - Generates and displays backup codes (modal)
    - Publishes: `two_fa.enabled.v1`
    - Sends confirmation email
12. User saves backup codes (download or print)
13. System displays success: "2FA enabled. Your account is now more secure!"

**A4: Generate Backup Codes**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/security/two-factor/backup-codes`
2. System displays:
   - Warning: "Backup codes let you access your account if you lose your 2FA device"
   - Current backup codes (if any, partially masked)
   - "Generate New Codes" button
3. User clicks "Generate New Codes"
4. System prompts: "Are you sure? This will invalidate your current backup codes."
5. User confirms
6. System:
   - Calls POST `/v1/users/me/mfa/backup-codes`
   - Generates 10 single-use backup codes
   - Displays codes in modal
7. User downloads or prints codes
8. System confirms: "Backup codes generated. Store them safely."

**A5: View Active Sessions**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/security/sessions`
2. System fetches: GET `/v1/users/me/sessions`
3. System displays sessions list:
   - **Current Session:** Highlighted, marked "This Device"
   - **Other Sessions:** Device type, browser, OS, location, IP, last active time
   - Each session has "Revoke" button
4. System displays "Revoke All Other Sessions" button at top

**A6: Revoke Single Session**
1. User clicks "Revoke" on a specific session
2. System prompts: "Revoke session on {device}? This will log out that device."
3. User confirms
4. System:
   - Calls DELETE `/v1/users/me/sessions/{session_id}`
   - Invalidates session token
   - Publishes: `session.revoked.v1`
5. System removes session from list
6. System displays: "Session revoked"
7. Other device receives notification (if push enabled): "You've been logged out"

**A7: Revoke All Sessions**
1. User clicks "Revoke All Other Sessions"
2. System navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/security/sessions/revoke-all`
3. System prompts: "Log out all devices except this one?"
4. User confirms
5. System:
   - Calls POST `/v1/users/me/sessions/revoke-all`
   - Invalidates all session tokens except current
   - Publishes: `sessions.revoked_all.v1`
6. System displays: "All other devices have been logged out"
7. Other devices show login screen

**A8: View Login History**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/security/login-history`
2. System fetches: GET `/v1/users/me/login-history?limit=50`
3. System displays login history (last 50):
   - **Date & Time:** Formatted timestamp
   - **Status:** Success/Failed (with icon)
   - **Device:** Browser, OS, device type
   - **Location:** City, country (from IP geolocation)
   - **IP Address:** Partially masked (e.g., 192.168.x.x)
   - **Action:** "Revoke Device" if device is trusted
4. Failed login attempts highlighted in red
5. System displays suspicious activity warning if detected
6. User can filter by: Date range, Status, Device type

**A9: Register Trusted Device (Mobile)**
1. User navigates to `(mobile)/(app)/settings/biometric`
2. System checks device biometric capability
3. System displays:
   - "Enable Face ID / Touch ID for quick login"
   - "Skip 2FA on this device after biometric verification"
4. User enables biometric
5. System:
   - Prompts for biometric verification
   - Generates device fingerprint
   - Calls POST `/v1/users/me/devices/register`
   - Stores device as trusted
   - Publishes: `device.registered.v1`
6. System displays: "Biometric login enabled"
7. Next login: User can use biometric instead of password + 2FA

**A10: Disable 2FA**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/security/two-factor/disable`
2. System displays warning:
   - "Disabling 2FA makes your account less secure"
   - "You'll only need your password to log in"
3. System requires verification:
   - Password input
   - Current 2FA code input (or backup code)
4. User enters password and 2FA code
5. User clicks "Disable 2FA"
6. System:
   - Verifies password and 2FA code
   - Calls POST `/v1/users/me/mfa/disable`
   - Removes 2FA secret and backup codes
   - Publishes: `two_fa.disabled.v1`
7. System displays: "2FA disabled"
8. System sends email notification

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: 2FA Setup Issues**
- **QR code won't scan:**
  - Provide manual entry code
  - Display: "Can't scan? Enter this code manually: {code}"
- **Verification code invalid:**
  - Display: "Invalid code. Please try again."
  - Check time sync: "Make sure your device's time is correct"
  - Allow 3 attempts before rate limiting (30 second cooldown)
- **Lost authenticator app:**
  - Provide "Use Backup Code" option
  - If no backup codes: "Contact Support"
  - Support can disable 2FA after identity verification

**B2: Password Change Blocked**
- **Current password incorrect:**
  - Display: "Current password is incorrect"
  - Track failed attempts (lock after 5 failed attempts for 15 minutes)
- **New password too weak:**
  - Display requirements not met
  - Suggest stronger password
  - Block common passwords (from breach database)
- **Password too similar to old:**
  - Display: "New password is too similar to your current password"
- **Recent password change:**
  - Rate limit: Can't change password more than once per hour
  - Display: "You recently changed your password. Please wait 1 hour."

**B3: Session Management Edge Cases**
- **Session already revoked:**
  - Display: "This session was already revoked"
  - Refresh session list
- **Can't revoke current session:**
  - "Revoke" button disabled for current session
  - Display: "This is your current session. Log out instead."
- **Network error during revoke:**
  - Retry up to 3 times
  - If fails: "Failed to revoke session. Please try again."

**B4: Suspicious Activity Detection**
- **Login from new location:**
  - Send email: "New login from {location}. Was this you?"
  - Display security alert in-app
  - Require 2FA even if normally skipped on trusted device
- **Multiple failed login attempts:**
  - Lock account temporarily (15 minutes)
  - Send email: "Multiple failed login attempts detected"
  - Display: "Account temporarily locked. Try again in 15 minutes."
- **Impossible travel detected:**
  - If login from different countries within short timeframe
  - Require password + 2FA + email confirmation
  - Send security alert email

**B5: 2FA Recovery**
- **Lost 2FA device, no backup codes:**
  - Display: "Lost your 2FA device? Contact Support"
  - Provide support contact link
  - Support process:
    - Verify identity (government ID, answering security questions)
    - Temporarily disable 2FA (24-48 hour process)
    - Force password reset
    - Notify via email
- **Using backup code:**
  - Accept backup code instead of 2FA code
  - Display: "Backup code used. {X} codes remaining."
  - Prompt to generate new backup codes

**B6: Login History Anomalies**
- **IP geolocation fails:**
  - Display "Unknown Location" instead of city/country
  - Show IP address (partially masked)
- **Device fingerprint mismatch:**
  - Flag session as suspicious
  - Display warning icon
  - User can mark as "Not Me" to trigger security review

**B7: Biometric Authentication Issues (Mobile)**
- **Biometric hardware not available:**
  - Display: "Your device doesn't support biometric authentication"
  - Fall back to password + 2FA
- **Biometric verification fails:**
  - Allow 3 attempts
  - After 3 failures: Require password + 2FA
  - Display: "Biometric verification failed. Use password instead."
- **Biometric data changed:**
  - If device biometrics changed (new fingerprint added)
  - Require re-registration of trusted device
  - Send security alert email

**B8: OAuth App Management**
- **View authorized apps:**
  - User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy-security/authorized-apps`
  - System displays apps with OAuth access
  - Each app shows: Name, icon, permissions, last used date
- **Revoke app access:**
  - User clicks "Revoke Access"
  - System prompts: "Revoke {app_name}'s access?"
  - System calls: DELETE `/v1/users/me/oauth-tokens/{app_id}`
  - Display: "Access revoked. {app_name} can no longer access your account."

**B9: Security Score Calculation**
- **Score components:**
  - 2FA enabled: +30 points
  - Strong password: +20 points
  - Password changed recently (< 90 days): +10 points
  - No recent failed logins: +10 points
  - Email verified: +10 points
  - Phone verified: +10 points
  - Trusted devices registered: +10 points
- Display actionable suggestions to improve score
- Gamify: Badge at 100% ("Security Champion")

**B10: Enterprise/Organization Requirements**
- **Admin enforces 2FA:**
  - Display banner: "Your organization requires 2FA. Enable now to continue."
  - Block access to platform until 2FA enabled
  - Grace period: 48 hours
- **Password policy enforcement:**
  - Organization can require specific password complexity
  - Periodic password rotation (e.g., every 90 days)
  - Display: "Your organization requires password change every 90 days"

#### Notifications

**Password Changed:**
- **Email:** "Your Skillsier password was changed. If this wasn't you, reset your password immediately."
- **In-app:** Toast: "Password changed successfully"
- **Push (mobile):** "Your password was changed"

**2FA Enabled:**
- **Email:** "Two-factor authentication has been enabled on your account"
- **In-app:** Toast: "2FA enabled successfully"

**2FA Disabled:**
- **Email:** "Two-factor authentication has been disabled. Your account is less secure."
- **In-app:** Toast: "2FA disabled"

**New Device Login:**
- **Email:** "New login from {device} in {location}. Was this you? [Yes] [No, Secure My Account]"
- **In-app:** Notification: "New device login detected"
- **Push (mobile):** "New login from {device}"

**Session Revoked:**
- **Push (to revoked device):** "You've been logged out from another location"
- **In-app (to revoked device):** Redirect to login with message: "Your session was revoked"

**Suspicious Activity Detected:**
- **Email:** "Suspicious activity detected on your account. Review your recent logins and secure your account."
- **In-app:** Alert banner: "Suspicious activity detected. Review your security settings."
- **Push (mobile):** "Suspicious activity on your account. Review now."

**Backup Code Used:**
- **Email:** "A backup code was used to log in to your account. {X} codes remaining."
- **In-app:** Toast: "Backup code used. Generate new codes soon."

#### Analytics

- security.overview.viewed (user_id)
- security.password.changed (user_id, password_strength: 'weak' | 'medium' | 'strong')
- security.2fa.enabled (user_id, method: 'app' | 'sms' | 'email')
- security.2fa.disabled (user_id, reason)
- security.2fa.verification_failed (user_id, method, attempts)
- security.2fa.backup_codes.generated (user_id)
- security.2fa.backup_codes.used (user_id, codes_remaining)
- security.sessions.viewed (user_id, session_count)
- security.session.revoked (user_id, session_id, device_type)
- security.sessions.revoked_all (user_id, revoked_count)
- security.login_history.viewed (user_id)
- security.suspicious_activity.detected (user_id, activity_type, severity)
- security.device.registered (user_id, device_type, biometric_enabled)
- security.device.revoked (user_id, device_id)
- security.oauth_app.revoked (user_id, app_id)
- security.security_score.viewed (user_id, score)
- security.security_score.improved (user_id, old_score, new_score)

#### Sources

**Backend:** users-be.user-stories.md (Security domain), users-be.database-design.md (security_events table, two_factor_auth table, sessions table, trusted_devices table, oauth_tokens table)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/settings/security routes, (mobile)/(app)/settings/security routes, hooks/security/use-2fa.ts, hooks/security/use-sessions.ts, components/security/)
