### ACC-3 — Privacy Settings & GDPR

**ID:** ACC-3  
**Persona:** All Users (Client, Freelancer, Hybrid)  
**Description:** Comprehensive privacy management including profile visibility controls, data sharing preferences, GDPR data export/erasure requests, consent management, and communication privacy.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- **Triggers:**
  - User navigates to "(dashboard)/settings/privacy"
  - First-time login prompt to review privacy settings
  - GDPR compliance reminder (annual review)
  - User wants to control who sees their profile
  - User wants to export or delete their data
  - Privacy policy update notification
- **Preconditions:**
  - User is authenticated
  - Email is verified
  - For data export/erasure: identity verification required

#### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/page.tsx` — Privacy overview
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/profile-visibility/page.tsx` — Profile visibility settings
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/data-sharing/page.tsx` — Data sharing preferences
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/gdpr/export/page.tsx` — GDPR data export
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/gdpr/delete/page.tsx` — GDPR account erasure
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/consent-logs/page.tsx` — Consent history
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/communication/page.tsx` — Communication privacy
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/search-visibility/page.tsx` — Search engine visibility
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/data-export/page.tsx` — Data export history

**Mobile:**
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/index.tsx` — Privacy main screen
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/profile-visibility.tsx` — Profile visibility
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/data-sharing.tsx` — Data sharing
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/gdpr/index.tsx` — GDPR requests
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/gdpr/export.tsx` — Export data
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/gdpr/delete.tsx` — Delete account

#### System Touchpoints
- **users-be:**
  - `privacy/entity.go` — Privacy settings
  - `privacy_request/entity.go` — GDPR requests
  - `consent/entity.go` — Consent logs
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/privacy` — Fetch privacy settings
  - PUT `/v1/users/{id}/privacy` — Update privacy settings
  - PUT `/v1/users/{id}/privacy/profile-visibility` — Update profile visibility
  - PUT `/v1/users/{id}/privacy/data-sharing` — Update data sharing
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/privacy/consent-logs` — Fetch consent history
  - POST `/v1/privacy/export` — Request data export
  - GET `/v1/privacy/requests/{id}` — Check request status
  - POST `/v1/privacy/erase` — Request account erasure
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/data-exports` — List export history
  - GET `/v1/users/{id}/privacy/transparency-report` — Privacy transparency report
- **admin-be:**
  - `privacy_request/entity.go` — GDPR request processing
  - POST `/v1/admin/privacy/requests/{id}/process` — Process request (admin)
  - GET `/v1/admin/privacy/requests` — List pending requests (admin)
- **storage-be:**
  - GET `/v1/storage/exports/{export_id}/download` — Download export file
- **all services:**
  - Event: `user.data_export.requested.v1` — Trigger data collection
  - Event: `user.erasure.requested.v1` — Trigger data anonymization

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**A1: View Privacy Overview**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy`
2. System displays privacy dashboard:
   - **Profile Visibility:** Current setting (Public/Connections/Private)
   - **Data Sharing:** Status summary (what's being shared)
   - **Search Engines:** Allow/Block indexing
   - **Communication Privacy:** Who can contact you
   - **Consent Management:** Link to consent logs
   - **GDPR Actions:** Export Data, Delete Account buttons
   - **Privacy Score:** Overall privacy level (0-100)
3. System fetches: GET `/v1/users/me/privacy`
4. Display quick actions and privacy recommendations

**A2: Configure Profile Visibility**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/profile-visibility`
2. System displays visibility controls:
   - **Overall Profile Visibility:**
     - Public (Anyone can view)
     - Connections Only (Only accepted connections)
     - Private (Only you)
   - **Profile Elements Visibility:**
     - Show Full Name (toggle)
     - Show Email (toggle)
     - Show Phone (toggle)
     - Show Location (City/Country/None)
     - Show Earnings (toggle) — Freelancers only
     - Show Activity Status (toggle)
     - Show Online Status (toggle)
     - Show Last Active (toggle)
   - **Discovery Settings:**
     - Allow Search Engines (toggle)
     - Searchable by Email (toggle)
     - Searchable by Phone (toggle)
     - Appear in Recommendations (toggle)
3. User adjusts toggles (e.g., hides email, shows only city)
4. System applies changes in real-time (preview)
5. User clicks "Save Changes"
6. System:
   - Calls PUT `/v1/users/me/privacy/profile-visibility`
   - Updates privacy_settings table
   - Invalidates profile cache
   - Publishes: `user.privacy.updated.v1`
7. System displays: "Privacy settings updated"

**A3: Configure Data Sharing**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/data-sharing`
2. System displays data sharing controls:
   - **Analytics & Improvement:**
     - Share usage data for product improvement (toggle)
     - Share data for research (anonymized) (toggle)
   - **Social & Activity:**
     - Share activity with connections (toggle)
     - Share profile views (toggle)
   - **Marketing:**
     - Allow personalized ads (toggle)
     - Allow third-party data sharing (toggle)
     - Share data with partners (toggle)
   - **Communication:**
     - Allow direct messages (toggle)
     - Allow job invitations (toggle)
     - Allow connection requests (toggle)
     - Allow endorsements (toggle)
3. User adjusts preferences
4. System displays explanations for each option
5. User clicks "Save Preferences"
6. System:
   - Calls PUT `/v1/users/me/privacy/data-sharing`
   - Updates preferences
   - Publishes: `user.data_sharing.updated.v1`
7. System displays: "Data sharing preferences updated"

**A4: Request Data Export (GDPR)**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/gdpr/export`
2. System displays:
   - **Explanation:** "Download a copy of your data"
   - **Data Included:**
     - Profile information
     - Account history
     - Messages and communications
     - Contracts and invoices
     - Reviews and ratings
     - Activity logs
   - **Format:** JSON + CSV
   - **Processing Time:** Up to 48 hours
   - **Previous Requests:** List with status
3. User clicks "Request Data Export"
4. System prompts: "Confirm your identity" (password input)
5. User enters password
6. System:
   - Validates password
   - Calls POST `/v1/privacy/export`
   - Creates export request record
   - Queues async job
   - Publishes: `user.data_export.requested.v1`
7. System displays: "Your export is being processed. We'll email you when ready."
8. System triggers async export job:
   - Collects data from all services (users-be, jobs-be, contracts-be, financial-be, communications-be, etc.)
   - Packages data into ZIP (JSON files + CSV summaries)
   - Uploads to storage-be
   - Updates request status to "COMPLETED"
   - Sends email with download link
9. User receives email: "Your data export is ready"
10. User clicks download link
11. System:
    - Verifies user identity (requires login)
    - Generates signed download URL
    - Logs download event
12. User downloads ZIP file
13. Export link expires after 7 days

**A5: Request Account Erasure (GDPR)**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/gdpr/delete`
2. System displays erasure request form:
   - **Warning:** "This action is permanent and cannot be undone"
   - **What Gets Deleted:**
     - Personal information (name, email, phone)
     - Profile data
     - Messages (anonymized, not deleted)
     - Account history
   - **What Gets Retained:**
     - Transaction records (financial/legal compliance)
     - Anonymized reviews
     - Public work samples (if applicable)
   - **Impact:**
     - Can't reactivate account
     - Pending contracts will be cancelled
     - Unpaid invoices must be settled first
   - **Reason:** Required dropdown (optional explanation)
3. User selects reason (e.g., "No longer need the service")
4. User checks: "I understand this is permanent and irreversible"
5. User enters password for confirmation
6. User clicks "Submit Erasure Request"
7. System validates:
   - No active contracts with pending work
   - No unpaid invoices
   - No ongoing disputes
8. If validation passes:
   - System calls POST `/v1/privacy/erase`
   - Creates erasure request
   - Status: PENDING_REVIEW (requires manual review for legal compliance)
   - Publishes: `user.erasure.requested.v1`
9. System displays: "Your erasure request has been submitted. We'll email you within 30 days with the status."
10. System sends confirmation email
11. Admin reviews request (within 30 days):
    - Verifies no legal holds
    - Approves request
12. System processes erasure:
    - Publishes: `user.erasure.approved.v1`
    - All services listen and anonymize data
    - users-be: Anonymizes user record
    - jobs-be: Anonymizes job postings
    - contracts-be: Anonymizes contracts (retains for compliance)
    - financial-be: Retains transaction records (compliance)
    - communications-be: Anonymizes messages
    - reviews-be: Pseudonymizes reviews
13. System marks request as FULFILLED
14. User receives email: "Your account has been erased"

**A6: View Consent Logs**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/consent-logs`
2. System fetches: GET `/v1/users/me/privacy/consent-logs`
3. System displays consent history:
   - **Date:** When consent was given/withdrawn
   - **Type:** Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, Marketing Communications
   - **Version:** Policy version consented to
   - **Status:** Accepted/Withdrawn
   - **IP Address:** Where consent was given
   - **Method:** Checkbox, Button Click, etc.
4. User can filter by date, type, status
5. User can download consent log (PDF export)

**A7: Configure Communication Privacy**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/communication`
2. System displays communication privacy controls:
   - **Who Can Contact You:**
     - Anyone (Public)
     - Connections Only
     - No One (Block all)
   - **Message Filtering:**
     - Auto-decline messages from users with low ratings (toggle)
     - Minimum rating threshold (1-5 stars)
   - **Job Invitations:**
     - Auto-decline invitations below budget threshold (toggle)
     - Minimum budget (currency input)
   - **Read Receipts:**
     - Send read receipts (toggle)
   - **Typing Indicators:**
     - Show typing status (toggle)
3. User adjusts settings
4. System applies changes
5. User clicks "Save"
6. System:
   - Calls PUT `/v1/users/me/privacy/communication`
   - Updates settings
   - Publishes: `user.communication_privacy.updated.v1`

**A8: Manage Search Engine Visibility**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/search-visibility`
2. System displays:
   - **Allow Search Engines:** Toggle (index profile for Google, Bing, etc.)
   - **Public Profile URL:** `https://skillsier.com/u/{username}` (if public)
   - **Preview:** How profile appears in search results
3. User toggles "Allow Search Engines" OFF
4. System:
   - Updates setting
   - Adds `noindex` meta tag to public profile
   - Removes profile from sitemap
   - Publishes: `user.search_visibility.updated.v1`
5. System displays: "Your profile will no longer appear in search engines. This may take a few weeks to take effect."

**A9: View Data Export History**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/data-export` (alternative route)
2. System displays previous export requests:
   - **Request Date**
   - **Status:** Pending/Processing/Ready/Expired
   - **Expiry Date** (if ready)
   - **Download Button** (if ready and not expired)
   - **File Size**
3. User can re-download unexpired exports
4. User can request new export

**A10: View Privacy Transparency Report**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/transparency-report`
2. System fetches: GET `/v1/users/me/privacy/transparency-report`
3. System displays personalized transparency report:
   - **Data We Collect:** Categories with examples
   - **How We Use Your Data:** Purposes with toggles
   - **Who We Share With:** Third parties (if any)
   - **Your Privacy Choices:** Summary of current settings
   - **Your Rights:** GDPR/CCPA rights explained
   - **Data Retention:** How long we keep data
   - **Contact:** Privacy officer email
4. User can download report as PDF

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: Profile Visibility Conflicts**
- **Public profile with hidden contact info:**
  - Allow: Users can have public profiles without showing email/phone
  - Display: "Your profile is public, but contact info is hidden"
- **Connections Only but no connections:**
  - Display: "Your profile is visible only to connections. Build your network to increase visibility."
- **Private profile impacts:**
  - Display warning: "Private profiles won't appear in search results and may receive fewer opportunities"

**B2: Data Export Issues**
- **Export already in progress:**
  - Display: "An export is already being processed. Check back later."
  - Show progress bar if available
  - Prevent duplicate requests within 24 hours
- **Export generation fails:**
  - System retries (up to 3 times)
  - If still fails: Send email to user with support contact
  - Admin notified for manual intervention
- **Export file too large:**
  - Split into multiple ZIP files
  - Email with links to all parts
  - Display: "Your export is large and split into {X} files"
- **Download link expired:**
  - Display: "This download link has expired. Request a new export."
  - Provide "Request New Export" button
  - Expired exports auto-deleted after 30 days

**B3: Erasure Request Blocked**
- **Active contracts:**
  - Display: "You have {X} active contracts. Complete or cancel them before requesting erasure."
  - List contracts with links
  - Allow cancellation from this page
- **Pending payments:**
  - Display: "You have pending payments. Resolve them before requesting erasure."
  - Show payment summary
  - Link to billing page
- **Ongoing disputes:**
  - Display: "Erasure is blocked due to ongoing disputes. Resolve them first."
  - Link to dispute resolution
- **Legal hold:**
  - Display: "Your account is subject to a legal hold. Contact support."
  - Prevent erasure until hold is released

**B4: Consent Management**
- **Consent withdrawal:**
  - User can withdraw consent for marketing communications
  - System updates consent log
  - Stops marketing emails immediately
  - Cannot withdraw consent for essential services (account, transactions)
- **Policy updates:**
  - When privacy policy updates, prompt user to re-consent
  - Display: "Our privacy policy has been updated. Please review."
  - Block access until consent given
  - Log new consent with policy version

**B5: GDPR Request Processing Times**
- **Export:**
  - Normal: < 24 hours
  - Large account: Up to 48 hours
  - Display estimated time on request page
- **Erasure:**
  - Manual review: Up to 30 days (GDPR requirement)
  - Actual erasure: Within 7 days after approval
  - Email updates at each stage

**B6: Third-Party Data Sharing**
- **View third parties:**
  - Display list of partners we share data with
  - Each partner: Name, purpose, opt-out option
- **Opt-out:**
  - User can opt-out of specific partners
  - System updates sharing preferences
  - Changes take effect within 30 days
- **Required sharing:**
  - Some sharing is required (e.g., payment processors)
  - Display: "This data sharing is required for core functionality"
  - Cannot opt-out

**B7: Communication Privacy Edge Cases**
- **Auto-decline threshold too high:**
  - Display warning: "This setting may significantly reduce opportunities"
  - Suggest recommended threshold
- **Blocking all messages:**
  - Display: "You won't receive any messages. Are you sure?"
  - Allow exceptions for active contracts

**B8: Data Portability (GDPR)**
- **Export format:**
  - JSON (machine-readable)
  - CSV (spreadsheets)
  - PDF (human-readable summaries)
- **Transfer to another service:**
  - Display: "Download your data to transfer to another platform"
  - Provide data schema documentation
  - API endpoints for automated transfer (future)

**B9: Privacy Score Calculation**
- **Score components:**
  - Profile visibility: Private +20, Connections +10, Public +0
  - Contact info hidden: +10
  - Search engine indexing disabled: +10
  - Data sharing minimal: +20
  - Communication restricted: +10
  - Consent logs reviewed: +5
  - Strong privacy choices: +25
- Display actionable suggestions to improve score

**B10: Mobile-Specific Privacy**
- **App permissions:**
  - Display permissions requested (Camera, Contacts, Location)
  - Explain why each permission is needed
  - Allow granular control
  - "Don't ask again" option
- **Offline privacy:**
  - Display: "Some data is cached locally for offline use"
  - Provide "Clear Local Data" button
  - Show cache size

#### Notifications

**Privacy Settings Updated:**
- **In-app:** Toast: "Privacy settings updated"
- **Email:** None (unless significant change like public → private)

**Data Export Requested:**
- **Email:** "We've received your data export request. We'll email you when ready (up to 48 hours)."
- **In-app:** Toast: "Export requested. Check back later."

**Data Export Ready:**
- **Email:** "Your data export is ready for download. [Download Link] (expires in 7 days)"
- **In-app:** Notification: "Your data export is ready" with download button
- **Push (mobile):** "Your data export is ready"

**Erasure Request Submitted:**
- **Email:** "We've received your account erasure request. We'll review it within 30 days as required by GDPR."
- **In-app:** Toast: "Erasure request submitted"

**Erasure Request Approved:**
- **Email:** "Your erasure request has been approved and will be processed within 7 days."

**Erasure Completed:**
- **Email (to registered email before erasure):** "Your Skillsier account has been permanently erased. We're sorry to see you go."

**Privacy Policy Updated:**
- **Email:** "Our privacy policy has been updated. Please review the changes."
- **In-app:** Banner: "Privacy policy updated. Review now."
- **Push (mobile):** "Our privacy policy has been updated"

**Consent Withdrawn:**
- **Email:** "You've withdrawn consent for {consent_type}. This will take effect immediately."
- **In-app:** Toast: "Consent withdrawn"

#### Analytics

- privacy.overview.viewed (user_id)
- privacy.profile_visibility.changed (user_id, old_visibility, new_visibility)
- privacy.data_sharing.updated (user_id, sharing_type, enabled)
- privacy.search_engines.toggled (user_id, allow_indexing)
- privacy.communication_privacy.updated (user_id, setting_type, value)
- privacy.data_export.requested (user_id)
- privacy.data_export.downloaded (user_id, export_id, file_size)
- privacy.data_export.expired (user_id, export_id)
- privacy.erasure.requested (user_id, reason)
- privacy.erasure.blocked (user_id, block_reason)
- privacy.erasure.completed (user_id)
- privacy.consent.viewed (user_id)
- privacy.consent.withdrawn (user_id, consent_type)
- privacy.transparency_report.viewed (user_id)
- privacy.transparency_report.downloaded (user_id, format)
- privacy.score.viewed (user_id, score)
- privacy.score.improved (user_id, old_score, new_score)

#### Sources

**Backend:** users-be.user-stories.md (Privacy domain, Privacy Request domain, Consent domain), admin-be.user-stories.md (Privacy Request processing), users-be.database-design.md (privacy_settings table, privacy_requests table, consent_logs table), storage-be.user-stories.md (Export file storage)

### ACC-4 — Notification Preferences

**ID:** ACC-4  
**Persona:** All Users (Client, Freelancer, Hybrid)  
**Description:** Comprehensive notification management including email, push, SMS, and in-app notifications with granular per-category control, digest settings, quiet hours, and delivery channel preferences.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- **Triggers:**
  - User navigates to "(dashboard)/settings/notifications"
  - User receives notification and wants to customize
  - First-time login prompt to set notification preferences
  - User clicks "Unsubscribe" in email
  - Too many notifications complaint
- **Preconditions:**
  - User is authenticated
  - Email is verified (for email notifications)
  - Phone verified (for SMS notifications)
  - Push notifications enabled on device (for push)

#### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/page.tsx` — Notifications overview
- `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/email/page.tsx` — Email notification settings
- `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/push/page.tsx` — Push notification settings
- `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/digest/page.tsx` — Email digest settings
- `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/quiet-hours/page.tsx` — Quiet hours configuration
- `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/channels/page.tsx` — Channel preferences per category

**Mobile:**
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/notifications/index.tsx` — Notifications main screen
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/notifications/channels.tsx` — Channel management
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/notifications/digests-quiet-hours.tsx` — Digests & quiet hours
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/app-specific/notifications.tsx` — App-specific notification settings

#### System Touchpoints
- **communications-be:**
  - `preferences/entity.go` — Notification preferences
  - `notification_channel/entity.go` — Channel configurations
  - `digest/entity.go` — Digest settings
  - GET `/v1/notifications/preferences` — Fetch preferences
  - PUT `/v1/notifications/preferences` — Update preferences
  - PUT `/v1/notifications/email-preferences` — Update email settings
  - PUT `/v1/notifications/push-preferences` — Update push settings
  - PUT `/v1/notifications/digest-preferences` — Update digest settings
  - POST `/v1/notifications/test` — Send test notification
  - POST `/v1/push/subscribe` — Subscribe to push (with device token)
  - DELETE `/v1/push/{subscription_id}` — Unsubscribe from push
  - GET `/v1/push/subscriptions` — List push subscriptions
- **users-be:**
  - `preferences/entity.go` — Stores notification preferences
  - Publishes: `user.notification_preferences.updated.v1`

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**A1: View Notifications Overview**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/notifications`
2. System displays notification dashboard:
   - **Overall Status:**
     - Email Notifications: ON/OFF toggle
     - Push Notifications: ON/OFF toggle (with device count)
     - SMS Notifications: ON/OFF toggle
     - In-App Notifications: ON/OFF toggle
   - **Delivery Summary:**
     - Total notifications sent (last 30 days)
     - By channel breakdown (pie chart)
   - **Quick Actions:**
     - "Pause All Notifications" (snooze for 1h, 8h, 24h, 7d)
     - "Test Notifications" (send test to all enabled channels)
   - **Categories:**
     - Cards for each category with quick toggles
3. System fetches: GET `/v1/notifications/preferences`
4. Display current preferences with ability to quick-toggle

**A2: Configure Email Notifications**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/email`
2. System displays email notification categories:
   - **Account & Security:**
     - Login alerts (always enabled, cannot disable)
     - Password changes (always enabled)
     - Security events (recommended, toggle)
   - **Jobs & Opportunities:**
     - New job matches (toggle)
     - Job invitations (toggle)
     - Application status updates (toggle)
     - Contract offers (always enabled)
   - **Contracts & Work:**
     - Contract milestones (toggle)
     - Delivery requests (toggle)
     - Timesheet approvals (toggle)
     - Work updates (toggle)
   - **Payments:**
     - Payment received (always enabled)
     - Payment pending (toggle)
     - Invoice reminders (toggle)
     - Refund notifications (toggle)
   - **Messages & Communication:**
     - New messages (toggle)
     - Message replies (toggle)
     - @Mentions (toggle)
   - **Reviews & Ratings:**
     - New reviews (toggle)
     - Rating changes (toggle)
     - Review replies (toggle)
   - **Marketing & Updates:**
     - Product updates (toggle)
     - Tips & best practices (toggle)
     - Platform news (toggle)
     - Promotional offers (toggle, opt-in)
3. Each category shows:
   - Description
   - Frequency estimate (e.g., "~2 emails/week")
   - Last sent date
4. User toggles categories on/off
5. User clicks "Save Preferences"
6. System:
   - Validates selection (some categories cannot be disabled)
   - Calls PUT `/v1/notifications/email-preferences`
   - Updates preferences
   - Publishes: `notification_preferences.updated.v1`
7. System displays: "Email preferences updated"

**A3: Configure Push Notifications (Mobile)**
1. User navigates to `(mobile)/(app)/settings/notifications/channels`
2. System checks push permission status:
   - If denied: Display "Enable push notifications in device settings"
   - If not determined: Display "Grant Permission" button
   - If granted: Show configuration
3. System displays:
   - **Device Management:**
     - List of registered devices
     - Each device: Type, last active, "Remove" button
   - **Push Categories:** (similar to email categories)
     - Account & Security (always enabled)
     - Jobs & Opportunities (toggle)
     - Contracts & Work (toggle)
     - Payments (toggle)
     - Messages (toggle, with priority options)
     - Reviews (toggle)
4. User toggles categories
5. System applies changes in real-time
6. System calls: PUT `/v1/notifications/push-preferences`
7. System tests push: Send test notification to device
8. Display: "Push preferences updated. Check your device."

**A4: Configure Email Digest**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/digest`
2. System displays digest configuration:
   - **Enable Email Digest:** Toggle (consolidate multiple emails into one)
   - **Frequency:**
     - Real-time (no digest, default)
     - Hourly (digest every hour)
     - Daily (digest once per day)
     - Weekly (digest once per week)
   - **Schedule (if daily/weekly):**
     - Time: Dropdown (e.g., 9:00 AM)
     - Day of week (if weekly): Dropdown (e.g., Monday)
   - **Content Preferences:**
     - Include job matches (toggle)
     - Include messages summary (toggle)
     - Include activity summary (toggle)
     - Include tips & articles (toggle)
   - **Digest Preview:**
     - Sample email preview
3. User selects "Daily" at "9:00 AM"
4. User toggles content preferences
5. User clicks "Save Digest Settings"
6. System:
   - Calls PUT `/v1/notifications/digest-preferences`
   - Updates digest schedule
   - Disables real-time emails for included categories
   - Publishes: `digest_preferences.updated.v1`
7. System displays: "You'll receive a daily digest at 9:00 AM"
8. System sends sample digest immediately for preview

**A5: Configure Quiet Hours**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/quiet-hours`
2. System displays quiet hours configuration:
   - **Enable Quiet Hours:** Toggle
   - **Schedule:**
     - Start Time: Time picker (e.g., 10:00 PM)
     - End Time: Time picker (e.g., 8:00 AM)
   - **Timezone:** Auto-detected with manual override
   - **Apply To:**
     - Push notifications (toggle, recommended)
     - Email notifications (toggle)
     - SMS notifications (toggle)
     - In-app notifications (toggle, not recommended)
   - **Exceptions (always notify during quiet hours):**
     - Security alerts (always enabled)
     - Payment notifications (toggle)
     - Urgent contract updates (toggle)
3. User sets quiet hours: 10:00 PM - 8:00 AM
4. User selects apply to Push and Email
5. User enables exception for security alerts and payments
6. User clicks "Save"
7. System:
   - Validates times (end > start or handles overnight)
   - Calls PUT `/v1/notifications/quiet-hours`
   - Updates quiet hours schedule
   - Publishes: `quiet_hours.updated.v1`
8. System displays: "Quiet hours enabled. No notifications between 10:00 PM and 8:00 AM."

**A6: Manage Push Subscriptions**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/push`
2. System fetches: GET `/v1/push/subscriptions`
3. System displays registered devices/subscriptions:
   - **Web Push:** Browser, OS, last active
   - **Mobile:** Device type (iOS/Android), device name, last active
   - Each subscription: "Remove" button
4. User clicks "Remove" on old device
5. System prompts: "Remove push notifications for {device}?"
6. User confirms
7. System:
   - Calls DELETE `/v1/push/{subscription_id}`
   - Unregisters device token
   - Publishes: `push.unsubscribed.v1`
8. System displays: "Device removed"
9. Old device will no longer receive push notifications

**A7: Test Notifications**
1. User clicks "Test Notifications" on overview page
2. System displays test options:
   - **Channels to Test:**
     - Email (toggle)
     - Push (toggle, if enabled)
     - SMS (toggle, if enabled)
     - In-App (toggle)
   - **Test Type:**
     - All categories (send one notification per category)
     - Specific category (dropdown)
3. User selects "Email" and "Push", chooses "Messages" category
4. User clicks "Send Test"
5. System:
   - Calls POST `/v1/notifications/test`
   - Sends test notifications to selected channels
   - Logs test event
6. System displays: "Test notifications sent. Check your email and device."
7. User receives test notifications within seconds

**A8: Pause All Notifications (Snooze)**
1. User clicks "Pause All Notifications" on overview page
2. System displays snooze options:
   - 1 hour
   - 8 hours (until end of workday)
   - 24 hours (until tomorrow)
   - 7 days (vacation mode)
   - Custom (date/time picker)
3. User selects "8 hours"
4. User confirms
5. System:
   - Calls PUT `/v1/notifications/snooze`
   - Sets snooze until timestamp
   - Disables all non-critical notifications
   - Publishes: `notifications.snoozed.v1`
6. System displays banner: "Notifications paused until {time}"
7. Banner shows countdown timer
8. User can "Resume Notifications" early

**A9: Unsubscribe from Email (Email Link)**
1. User clicks "Unsubscribe" link in email footer
2. System navigates to unsubscribe page (one-click, no login required)
3. System displays:
   - "You're about to unsubscribe from {category} emails"
   - Options:
     - Unsubscribe from this category only (recommended)
     - Unsubscribe from all marketing emails
     - Unsubscribe from all emails (except critical)
   - Link to full notification settings (requires login)
4. User selects "Unsubscribe from this category only"
5. User clicks "Unsubscribe"
6. System:
   - Validates unsubscribe token
   - Updates preferences
   - Publishes: `email.unsubscribed.v1`
7. System displays: "You've been unsubscribed from {category} emails"
8. Confirmation email sent (ironically)

**A10: Configure Channel Priorities**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/notifications/channels`
2. System displays channel priority matrix:
   - Rows: Notification categories
   - Columns: Channels (Email, Push, SMS, In-App)
   - Cells: Checkboxes or priority levels (High/Medium/Low/Off)
3. Example configuration:
   - Messages: Push (High), In-App (High), Email (Low)
   - Payments: All channels (High)
   - Marketing: Email (Low), others (Off)
4. User customizes priorities per category
5. System applies changes in real-time
6. User clicks "Save"
7. System:
   - Calls PUT `/v1/notifications/channel-priorities`
   - Updates preferences
8. System displays: "Channel priorities updated"

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: Push Notifications Disabled**
- **Device permission denied:**
  - Display: "Push notifications are disabled in your device settings. Enable them to receive alerts."
  - Provide deep link to device settings (iOS/Android)
- **Device token registration fails:**
  - Retry up to 3 times
  - If fails: Display "Failed to register for push. Try again later."
  - Log error for investigation

**B2: Email Deliverability Issues**
- **Email bounces:**
  - System tracks bounce events
  - After 3 bounces: Disable email notifications
  - Send in-app notification: "Your email is bouncing. Please update it."
- **Email marked as spam:**
  - System tracks spam reports
  - Reduce email frequency automatically
  - Send notification: "We've reduced your email frequency to prevent spam"

**B3: Digest Timing Conflicts**
- **Digest overlaps with quiet hours:**
  - System delays digest until quiet hours end
  - Display warning: "Your digest will be delayed during quiet hours"
- **Multiple digests scheduled:**
  - System consolidates into single digest
  - Display: "Multiple digest settings detected. We'll send one combined digest."

**B4: Quiet Hours Edge Cases**
- **Overnight quiet hours:**
  - Handles crossing midnight correctly (e.g., 10 PM - 8 AM)
  - Validates end time is after start time (or next day)
- **Timezone changes:**
  - If user travels and timezone auto-updates
  - Display: "Your quiet hours have been adjusted for {new_timezone}"
  - User can disable auto-adjust

**B5: Critical Notifications Cannot Be Disabled**
- **Security alerts:**
  - Always enabled, toggle grayed out
  - Display: "This notification type cannot be disabled for security reasons"
- **Payment notifications:**
  - Always enabled for regulatory compliance
  - Display: "Required by financial regulations"
- **Contract deadlines:**
  - Cannot disable to prevent missed obligations
  - Display: "Required to meet contractual obligations"

**B6: Notification Frequency Limits**
- **Too many notifications:**
  - System tracks notification frequency per user
  - If > 50/day: Automatically enable digest mode
  - Display: "We've enabled digest mode to reduce notification volume"
- **Notification fatigue:**
  - System detects low engagement (notifications ignored)
  - Suggest reducing frequency or categories
  - Display: "You're ignoring most notifications. Want to reduce them?"

**B7: Unsubscribe Link Issues**
- **Token expired:**
  - Display: "This unsubscribe link has expired. Please log in to manage preferences."
  - Provide login link
- **Already unsubscribed:**
  - Display: "You've already unsubscribed from this category."
  - Show current preferences
- **Invalid token:**
  - Display: "Invalid unsubscribe link. Please contact support."

**B8: SMS Notifications (Future)**
- **Phone not verified:**
  - Display: "Verify your phone number to enable SMS notifications"
  - Provide verification link
- **SMS rate limits:**
  - Limit to critical notifications only
  - Display: "SMS is limited to urgent notifications due to cost"
- **International SMS:**
  - Display: "SMS notifications may not be available in your country"
  - Fall back to push/email

**B9: Notification Conflicts**
- **Digest enabled but real-time needed:**
  - Allow "urgent" notifications to bypass digest
  - Display: "Some urgent notifications will be sent immediately"
- **Quiet hours but urgent notification:**
  - Display in digest after quiet hours
  - Exception: Security alerts always sent

**B10: Test Notification Failures**
- **Test email not received:**
  - Display: "Test email sent. If not received in 5 minutes, check spam folder."
  - Provide troubleshooting tips
- **Push test failed:**
  - Display: "Push test failed. Check device settings and try again."
  - Verify subscription is active

#### Notifications

**Preferences Updated:**
- **In-app:** Toast: "Notification preferences updated"
- **Email:** None (unless subscribed to preference changes)

**Digest Scheduled:**
- **Email (sample):** "You'll now receive a daily digest at 9:00 AM. Here's a preview."
- **In-app:** Toast: "Digest enabled"

**Quiet Hours Enabled:**
- **In-app:** Toast: "Quiet hours enabled. No notifications between 10:00 PM and 8:00 AM."
- **Email:** None

**Notifications Snoozed:**
- **In-app:** Banner: "Notifications paused until {time}"
- **Email:** None

**Unsubscribed:**
- **Email (confirmation):** "You've been unsubscribed from {category} emails"
- **In-app:** None (user not logged in)

**Push Subscription Added:**
- **Email:** "Push notifications enabled on {device}"
- **In-app:** Toast: "Push notifications enabled"

**Push Subscription Removed:**
- **Email:** "Push notifications disabled on {device}. If this wasn't you, secure your account."
- **In-app:** Toast: "Push notifications disabled"

**Notification Volume Alert:**
- **Email (if high volume detected):** "You're receiving a lot of notifications. Consider enabling digest mode."
- **In-app:** Banner: "Too many notifications? Try digest mode."

#### Analytics

- notifications.overview.viewed (user_id)
- notifications.preferences.updated (user_id, channel, categories_changed[])
- notifications.email.toggled (user_id, category, enabled)
- notifications.push.toggled (user_id, category, enabled)
- notifications.digest.enabled (user_id, frequency, schedule_time)
- notifications.digest.disabled (user_id)
- notifications.quiet_hours.enabled (user_id, start_time, end_time, apply_to[])
- notifications.quiet_hours.disabled (user_id)
- notifications.snoozed (user_id, duration_hours)
- notifications.resumed (user_id)
- notifications.test_sent (user_id, channels[], category)
- notifications.unsubscribed (user_id, category, via: 'email_link' | 'settings')
- notifications.resubscribed (user_id, category)
- notifications.push.subscribed (user_id, device_type, device_id)
- notifications.push.unsubscribed (user_id, subscription_id)
- notifications.channel_priorities.updated (user_id, category, priorities{})
- notifications.volume_alert.shown (user_id, daily_count)
- notifications.digest_suggestion.accepted (user_id)

#### Sources

**Backend:** communications-be.user-stories.md (Notification preferences domain), users-be.user-stories.md (Preferences domain), communications-be.database-design.md (notification_preferences table, digest_settings table, push_subscriptions table)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/settings/notifications routes, (mobile)/(app)/settings/notifications routes, hooks/notifications/use-notification-preferences.ts, hooks/notifications/use-push-subscriptions.ts, components/notifications/)

### ACC-5 — OAuth & Connected Apps

**ID:** ACC-5  
**Persona:** All Users (Client, Freelancer, Hybrid)  
**Description:** Management of third-party OAuth applications with access to user's Skillsier account, including permission management, token revocation, and access audit trail.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- **Triggers:**
  - User navigates to "(dashboard)/settings/privacy-security/authorized-apps"
  - User grants OAuth permission to third-party app
  - Security alert about suspicious app activity
  - User wants to review app permissions
  - App requests additional permissions
- **Preconditions:**
  - User is authenticated
  - User has at least one authorized OAuth app (for management)

#### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy-security/authorized-apps/page.tsx` — Authorized apps list
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy-security/authorized-apps/[appId]/page.tsx` — App detail
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy-security/authorized-apps/[appId]/permissions/page.tsx` — App permissions detail

**Mobile:**
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/authorized-apps/index.tsx` — Authorized apps list
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/authorized-apps/[appId]/index.tsx` — App detail
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/authorized-apps/[appId]/permissions.tsx` — App permissions

#### System Touchpoints
- **users-be:**
  - `oauth_token/entity.go` — OAuth access tokens
  - `oauth_app/entity.go` — Registered OAuth applications
  - GET `/v1/settings/authorized-apps` — List authorized apps
  - GET `/v1/settings/authorized-apps/{app_id}` — Fetch app details
  - GET `/v1/settings/authorized-apps/{app_id}/permissions` — Fetch app permissions
  - DELETE `/v1/settings/authorized-apps/{app_id}` — Revoke app access
  - DELETE `/v1/settings/authorized-apps` — Revoke all apps (bulk)
  - GET `/v1/settings/authorized-apps/{app_id}/activity` — Fetch app activity log
  - PUT `/v1/settings/authorized-apps/{app_id}/permissions` — Update app permissions (if supported)
- **notifications-be:**
  - Publishes: `oauth.access_granted.v1`, `oauth.access_revoked.v1`, `oauth.suspicious_activity.v1`

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**A1: View Authorized Apps List**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy-security/authorized-apps`
2. System fetches: GET `/v1/settings/authorized-apps`
3. System displays authorized apps list:
   - **Each App Card:**
     - App icon and name
     - Developer/company name
     - Authorization date (e.g., "Connected 3 months ago")
     - Permissions summary (e.g., "Read profile, Post jobs, View messages")
     - Last used date
     - "View Details" button
     - "Revoke Access" button
4. System displays summary stats at top:
   - Total authorized apps count
   - Last activity date
   - "Revoke All" button (if > 1 app)
5. Apps sorted by last used date (most recent first)
6. Search/filter options: Name, permissions, date range

**A2: View App Details**
1. User clicks "View Details" on an app
2. System navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy-security/authorized-apps/[appId]`
3. System fetches: GET `/v1/settings/authorized-apps/{app_id}`
4. System displays app details:
   - **App Information:**
     - Icon, name, tagline
     - Developer name and website
     - App description
     - Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links
   - **Access Information:**
     - Authorization date
     - Last used date
     - Total API calls (if available)
     - Token expiry date (if applicable)
   - **Permissions Granted:**
     - List of scopes with descriptions
     - Each scope: Icon, name, description, risk level (low/medium/high)
     - Example: "Read your profile - Allows app to view your name, email, and profile picture"
   - **Recent Activity:**
     - Last 10 API calls with timestamps
     - Actions performed (e.g., "Posted a job", "Sent a message")
   - **Actions:**
     - "Manage Permissions" button (if supported)
     - "Revoke Access" button (red, danger style)
     - "Report App" link

**A3: View App Permissions in Detail**
1. User clicks "Manage Permissions" on app detail page
2. System navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/privacy-security/authorized-apps/[appId]/permissions`
3. System displays detailed permissions breakdown:
   - **Permission Categories:**
     - Profile Access (Read profile, Update profile)
     - Jobs & Opportunities (Read jobs, Post jobs, Manage applications)
     - Messages (Read messages, Send messages)
     - Contracts (View contracts, Create contracts)
     - Payments (View payment history, Initiate payments)
   - Each permission shows:
     - Permission name
     - Description and examples
     - Risk level indicator
     - Date granted
     - Last used date
     - Toggle to revoke individual permission (if supported, usually all-or-nothing)
4. System displays security warnings for high-risk permissions
5. "Update Permissions" button (if changes made)
6. "Revoke All Access" button

**A4: View App Activity Log**
1. User clicks "Recent Activity" tab on app detail page
2. System fetches: GET `/v1/settings/authorized-apps/{app_id}/activity`
3. System displays activity log (last 90 days):
   - **Each Activity Entry:**
     - Timestamp
     - Action performed (API endpoint called)
     - Result (success/failure)
     - IP address (partially masked)
     - Location (if available)
   - Filter options: Date range, action type, result
   - Export activity log (CSV/PDF)
4. Suspicious activity highlighted in red
5. "Report Suspicious Activity" button

**A5: Revoke App Access**
1. User clicks "Revoke Access" on app detail page
2. System displays confirmation modal:
   - "Revoke access for {app_name}?"
   - Warning: "This will immediately revoke all permissions. The app will no longer be able to access your account."
   - Impact explanation: "You may need to reconnect if you want to use this app again."
   - Checkbox: "I understand this action cannot be undone"
3. User checks checkbox and clicks "Revoke Access"
4. System:
   - Calls DELETE `/v1/settings/authorized-apps/{app_id}`
   - Invalidates all access tokens for this app
   - Logs revocation event
   - Publishes: `oauth.access_revoked.v1`
5. System redirects to authorized apps list
6. System displays toast: "Access revoked for {app_name}"
7. System sends confirmation email to user
8. System sends notification to app developer (if configured)

**A6: Revoke All Apps (Bulk)**
1. User clicks "Revoke All" button on authorized apps list
2. System displays confirmation modal:
   - "Revoke access for all {X} apps?"
   - Warning: "This will immediately disconnect all third-party applications from your account."
   - List of apps to be affected
   - Checkbox: "I understand this will disconnect all apps"
3. User confirms
4. System:
   - Calls DELETE `/v1/settings/authorized-apps` (bulk endpoint)
   - Invalidates all OAuth tokens for user
   - Logs bulk revocation event
5. System displays: "All app access revoked"
6. System sends confirmation email

**A7: OAuth Authorization Flow (New App)**
1. User clicks "Connect with Skillsier" on third-party app
2. User redirected to Skillsier OAuth authorization page
3. System displays:
   - App information (icon, name, developer)
   - Requested permissions list with descriptions
   - "What {app_name} will be able to do:"
     - Bullet list of capabilities
   - "What {app_name} won't be able to do:"
     - Reassurance about limitations
   - Privacy policy and terms links
   - "Authorize" button (green)
   - "Deny" button (gray)
4. User clicks "Authorize"
5. System:
   - Creates OAuth authorization record
   - Generates access token
   - Redirects back to app with authorization code
   - Logs authorization event
   - Publishes: `oauth.access_granted.v1`
6. System adds app to user's authorized apps list
7. System sends email notification: "New app connected: {app_name}"

**A8: Update App Permissions (If Supported)**
1. User modifies permissions toggles on permissions page
2. System displays warning: "Changing permissions will require re-authorization"
3. User clicks "Update Permissions"
4. System:
   - Calls PUT `/v1/settings/authorized-apps/{app_id}/permissions`
   - Invalidates current token
   - Sends notification to app to request new authorization
   - Publishes: `oauth.permissions_updated.v1`
5. System displays: "Permissions updated. The app will need to reconnect."

**A9: Report Suspicious App**
1. User clicks "Report App" on app detail page
2. System displays report form:
   - Reason: Dropdown (Spam, Phishing, Data misuse, Other)
   - Description: Text area
   - Include activity log: Checkbox (auto-selected)
3. User fills form and submits
4. System:
   - Creates report ticket
   - Flags app for review
   - Sends report to security team
   - Optionally revokes app access immediately (user choice)
5. System displays: "Report submitted. Our security team will investigate."

**A10: Export OAuth Data**
1. User clicks "Export OAuth Data" on authorized apps list
2. System generates report:
   - List of all authorized apps
   - Permissions per app
   - Activity logs
   - Authorization history
3. System provides download link (CSV/PDF)
4. Export expires after 7 days

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: No Authorized Apps**
- Display empty state:
  - Illustration
  - "No connected apps"
  - "You haven't authorized any third-party apps to access your Skillsier account"
  - Link to "Learn about OAuth and app permissions"

**B2: Expired Tokens**
- Display warning on app card: "Authorization expired. Reconnect to continue using this app."
- Provide "Reconnect" button
- If user hasn't used app in 90 days, suggest revoking access

**B3: Revoked by Admin**
- If app access revoked by admin (e.g., security threat):
  - Display: "This app has been disconnected by Skillsier for security reasons"
  - Prevent reconnection
  - Provide link to security announcement

**B4: App Deleted/Suspended**
- If app no longer exists or is suspended:
  - Display: "This app is no longer available"
  - Automatically revoke access
  - Remove from list after 30 days

**B5: Permission Scope Changes**
- If app requests new permissions:
  - Send email: "{App_name} is requesting additional permissions"
  - Display banner on app detail page
  - Require user re-authorization with new scope
  - Block app access until re-authorized

**B6: Suspicious Activity Detection**
- If system detects unusual API calls:
  - Send email alert: "Suspicious activity detected with {app_name}"
  - Display warning on app card
  - Suggest revoking access
  - Provide "Report" button

**B7: Token Refresh**
- For apps with refresh tokens:
  - Display last token refresh date
  - Show token validity period
  - Option to manually revoke refresh token

**B8: Multiple Devices/Sessions**
- Display app access per device/session
- Show: "Used on Web, iOS, Android"
- Option to revoke access per device

**B9: Developer Mode (For App Developers)**
- If user is also app developer:
  - Display notice: "You're the developer of this app"
  - Link to developer dashboard
  - Cannot revoke own app (must delete from developer dashboard)

**B10: OAuth 2.0 vs OAuth 1.0**
- Handle both OAuth versions
- Display protocol version
- OAuth 1.0 may have different revocation process
- Provide migration notice for OAuth 1.0 apps

#### Notifications

**App Authorized:**
- **Email:** "You connected {app_name} to your Skillsier account. If this wasn't you, revoke access immediately."
- **In-app:** Toast: "{App_name} connected successfully"

**App Revoked:**
- **Email:** "You disconnected {app_name} from your Skillsier account"
- **In-app:** Toast: "Access revoked for {app_name}"
- **To App Developer (optional):** "A user has revoked access to your app"

**All Apps Revoked:**
- **Email:** "You disconnected all third-party apps from your Skillsier account"
- **In-app:** Toast: "All app access revoked"

**New Permission Request:**
- **Email:** "{App_name} is requesting additional permissions. Review and authorize."
- **In-app:** Notification: "New permission request from {app_name}"
- **Push (mobile):** "{App_name} wants more permissions"

**Suspicious Activity:**
- **Email (urgent):** "Suspicious activity detected with {app_name}. Review your authorized apps."
- **In-app:** Alert banner: "Suspicious activity detected. Review your apps."
- **Push (mobile):** "Security alert: Review your connected apps"

**Token Expired:**
- **Email:** "Your authorization for {app_name} has expired. Reconnect to continue using the app."
- **In-app:** None

**App Report Submitted:**
- **Email:** "Thank you for reporting {app_name}. We're investigating."
- **In-app:** Toast: "Report submitted"

#### Analytics

- oauth.authorized_apps.viewed (user_id)
- oauth.app.detail_viewed (user_id, app_id)
- oauth.app.permissions_viewed (user_id, app_id)
- oauth.app.activity_viewed (user_id, app_id)
- oauth.app.authorized (user_id, app_id, scopes[])
- oauth.app.revoked (user_id, app_id, reason)
- oauth.apps.revoked_all (user_id, app_count)
- oauth.app.reported (user_id, app_id, report_reason)
- oauth.app.permissions_updated (user_id, app_id, scopes_added[], scopes_removed[])
- oauth.app.reconnected (user_id, app_id)
- oauth.suspicious_activity.detected (user_id, app_id, activity_type)
- oauth.data_exported (user_id, export_format)

#### Sources

**Backend:** users-be.user-stories.md (OAuth domain), users-be.database-design.md (oauth_tokens table, oauth_apps table)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/settings/privacy-security/authorized-apps routes, (mobile)/(app)/settings/authorized-apps routes, hooks/settings/use-authorized-apps.ts, components/oauth/)

### ACC-6 — Billing & Payment Methods

**ID:** ACC-6  
**Persona:** Clients (Hiring), Freelancers (Receiving Payments)  
**Description:** Comprehensive management of payment methods (credit cards, bank accounts, PayPal) and payout methods, with PCI-compliant handling, verification, and billing history.

#### Preconditions & Triggers
- **Triggers:**
  - User navigates to "(dashboard)/settings/billing"
  - User attempts to fund escrow without payment method
  - Payment method expires or fails
  - User wants to add/update payment method
  - Periodic reminder to verify payment method
- **Preconditions:**
  - User is authenticated
  - For clients: Need to add payment method before posting paid jobs
  - For freelancers: Need to add payout method to receive funds

#### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/settings/billing/page.tsx` — Billing overview
- `(dashboard)/settings/billing/payment-methods/page.tsx` — Payment methods list
- `(dashboard)/settings/billing/payment-methods/add/page.tsx` — Add payment method
- `(dashboard)/settings/billing/payment-methods/[methodId]/page.tsx` — Payment method detail
- `(dashboard)/settings/billing/payment-methods/[methodId]/delete/page.tsx` — Delete payment method
- `(dashboard)/settings/billing/payout-methods/page.tsx` — Payout methods list (freelancers)
- `(dashboard)/settings/billing/payout-methods/add/page.tsx` — Add payout method
- `(dashboard)/settings/billing/invoices/page.tsx` — Billing history/invoices

**Mobile:**
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/billing/index.tsx` — Billing main screen
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/billing/payment-methods.tsx` — Payment methods
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/billing/add-payment-method.tsx` — Add payment method
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/billing/payout-methods.tsx` — Payout methods
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/billing/add-payout-method.tsx` — Add payout method
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/billing/invoices.tsx` — Invoice history

#### System Touchpoints
- **financial-be:**
  - `payment_method/entity.go` — Payment methods
  - `payout/entity.go` — Payout methods
  - `invoice/entity.go` — Invoices
  - GET `/v1/payment-methods` — List payment methods
  - POST `/v1/payment-methods` — Add payment method
  - GET `/v1/payment-methods/{method_id}` — Fetch method details
  - PUT `/v1/payment-methods/{method_id}` — Update payment method
  - DELETE `/v1/payment-methods/{method_id}` — Delete payment method
  - POST `/v1/payment-methods/{method_id}/verify` — Verify payment method
  - POST `/v1/payment-methods/{method_id}/set-default` — Set as default
  - GET `/v1/payout-methods` — List payout methods
  - POST `/v1/payout-methods` — Add payout method
  - DELETE `/v1/payout-methods/{method_id}` — Delete payout method
  - GET `/v1/invoices` — List invoices
  - GET `/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}` — Fetch invoice details
  - GET `/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/download` — Download invoice PDF
- **subscriptions-be:**
  - Publishes: `subscription.payment_failed.v1`, `subscription.payment_succeeded.v1`
- **Stripe/PayPal APIs:**
  - Payment tokenization (client-side)
  - Bank account verification (micro-deposits)
  - Card verification (CVV, AVS checks)

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**A1: View Billing Overview**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/billing`
2. System displays billing dashboard:
   - **Payment Methods (Clients):**
     - Cards on file (count)
     - Default payment method indicator
     - "Add Payment Method" button
   - **Payout Methods (Freelancers):**
     - Bank accounts on file (count)
     - Default payout method indicator
     - "Add Payout Method" button
   - **Billing Summary:**
     - Last payment date and amount
     - Next billing date (if subscription)
     - Outstanding balance (if any)
   - **Recent Invoices:**
     - Last 5 invoices with status
   - **Quick Actions:**
     - "View All Invoices"
     - "Update Billing Info"
3. System fetches:
   - GET `/v1/payment-methods`
   - GET `/v1/payout-methods`
   - GET `/v1/invoices?limit=5`

**A2: Add Payment Method (Credit Card)**
1. User clicks "Add Payment Method"
2. System navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/billing/payment-methods/add`
3. System displays payment method type selection:
   - Credit/Debit Card (most common)
   - Bank Account (ACH - US only)
   - PayPal
4. User selects "Credit/Debit Card"
5. System displays Stripe Elements card form (PCI-compliant):
   - Card number input
   - Expiry date (MM/YY)
   - CVC code
   - Cardholder name
   - Billing address (auto-fill from profile, editable)
   - Checkbox: "Set as default payment method"
6. User enters card details: 4242 4242 4242 4242, 12/25, 123
7. System validates in real-time:
   - Card number format (Luhn check)
   - Expiry date (not in past)
   - CVC length (3-4 digits)
8. User clicks "Add Card"
9. System:
   - Tokenizes card details via Stripe (client-side, no PII to server)
   - Sends token to backend: POST `/v1/payment-methods`
   - Backend stores tokenized card reference
   - Performs AVS and CVV checks
   - Publishes: `payment_method.added.v1`
10. System displays success: "Card ending in 4242 added successfully"
11. System redirects to payment methods list

**A3: Add Bank Account (ACH)**
1. User selects "Bank Account" as payment method type
2. System displays bank account form:
   - Account holder name
   - Routing number (9 digits)
   - Account number
   - Account type (Checking/Savings)
   - Checkbox: "I authorize Skillsier to debit my account"
3. User enters bank details
4. System validates routing number (ABA routing number check)
5. User clicks "Add Bank Account"
6. System:
   - Tokenizes bank details via Stripe
   - Sends token to backend: POST `/v1/payment-methods`
   - Initiates micro-deposit verification (2 small deposits)
   - Publishes: `payment_method.added.v1`
7. System displays: "Bank account added. Please verify using micro-deposits (1-2 business days)"
8. System sends email with verification instructions

**A4: Verify Bank Account (Micro-deposits)**
1. User receives micro-deposits in bank account (1-2 business days)
2. User navigates to payment methods list
3. System displays "Verification Required" badge on unverified bank account
4. User clicks "Verify" on bank account card
5. System displays verification form:
   - "Enter the two deposit amounts to verify your account"
   - Amount 1 input (e.g., $0.32)
   - Amount 2 input (e.g., $0.45)
6. User enters amounts: 0.32, 0.45
7. User clicks "Verify"
8. System:
   - Calls POST `/v1/payment-methods/{method_id}/verify`
   - Validates amounts
   - Marks account as verified
   - Publishes: `payment_method.verified.v1`
9. System displays: "Bank account verified successfully"
10. Account now eligible for transactions

**A5: Add Payout Method (Bank Account - Freelancers)**
1. Freelancer clicks "Add Payout Method"
2. System navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/billing/payout-methods/add`
3. System displays payout method options:
   - Bank Transfer (ACH - US)
   - Wire Transfer (International)
   - PayPal
4. User selects "Bank Transfer"
5. System displays form:
   - Account holder name
   - Routing number
   - Account number
   - Account type (Checking/Savings)
   - Tax information (W-9 form for US, W-8BEN for non-US)
6. User fills form
7. System validates and saves
8. System displays: "Payout method added. Complete tax verification to receive payments."

**A6: Set Default Payment Method**
1. User navigates to payment methods list
2. User clicks "Set as Default" on a payment method card
3. System prompts: "Set {card_type} ending in {last_4} as default?"
4. User confirms
5. System:
   - Calls POST `/v1/payment-methods/{method_id}/set-default`
   - Updates default flag
   - Publishes: `payment_method.default_updated.v1`
6. System displays: "Default payment method updated"
7. "Default" badge moves to selected card

**A7: Delete Payment Method**
1. User clicks "Delete" on payment method card
2. System displays confirmation modal:
   - "Delete {card_type} ending in {last_4}?"
   - Warning: "You won't be able to use this payment method for future transactions."
   - If default: "Please set another payment method as default first"
3. User confirms
4. System:
   - Checks if method is in use (active subscriptions, pending payments)
   - If in use: Block deletion, display: "Cannot delete. This method is used for active subscriptions."
   - If not in use: Calls DELETE `/v1/payment-methods/{method_id}`
   - Publishes: `payment_method.deleted.v1`
5. System displays: "Payment method deleted"
6. Method removed from list

**A8: View Invoices/Billing History**
1. User navigates to `(dashboard)/settings/billing/invoices`
2. System fetches: GET `/v1/invoices`
3. System displays invoices list:
   - **Each Invoice Entry:**
     - Invoice number (e.g., INV-2025-001234)
     - Date
     - Description (e.g., "Monthly subscription", "Job escrow funding")
     - Amount
     - Status (Paid, Pending, Failed, Refunded)
     - Payment method used (last 4 digits)
     - "Download PDF" link
4. Filters: Date range, status, amount range
5. Search by invoice number or description
6. Export invoices (CSV)

**A9: Download Invoice PDF**
1. User clicks "Download PDF" on an invoice
2. System:
   - Calls GET `/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/download`
   - Generates PDF invoice
   - Returns signed download URL
3. Browser downloads PDF:
   - Invoice details (number, date, due date)
   - Billing address
   - Line items breakdown
   - Subtotal, tax, total
   - Payment method used
   - Skillsier company info and tax ID
4. PDF includes: "Paid" stamp with payment date (if paid)

**A10: Handle Payment Failure**
1. System detects payment failure (subscription renewal, escrow funding)
2. System publishes: `payment.failed.v1`
3. System:
   - Retries payment (up to 3 times, with delays)
   - Updates invoice status to "Failed"
   - Sends email: "Payment failed for {description}. Update your payment method."
4. User navigates to billing settings
5. System displays alert banner: "Your last payment failed. Please update your payment method."
6. User adds/updates payment method
7. System retries payment automatically

#### Branches & Edge Cases

**B1: Card Expired**
- Display "Expired" badge on payment method card
- Send email reminder 30 days before expiry: "Your card ending in {last_4} expires soon. Update it to avoid service interruption."
- Block usage of expired card for new transactions
- Allow updating expiry date without re-entering full card number

**B2: Payment Method Verification Failed**
- **Card:**
  - AVS mismatch: Display "Billing address verification failed. Check your address."
  - CVV mismatch: Display "Card verification failed. Check your CVC code."
  - Allow retry (up to 3 attempts)
- **Bank account:**
  - Micro-deposit amounts incorrect: "Verification failed. Please try again."
  - Allow 3 attempts, then lock for 24 hours

**B3: Duplicate Payment Method**
- Detect duplicate card fingerprint
- Display: "This card is already on file. Do you want to update it?"
- Option to update billing address or expiry date

**B4: Payment Method Declined**
- During transaction, if payment declined:
  - Display: "Payment declined by your bank. Please try another method or contact your bank."
  - Provide error code (if available)
  - Suggest contacting bank or trying different card

**B5: No Default Payment Method**
- If user tries to make payment without default method set:
  - Prompt: "Please select a payment method for this transaction"
  - Option to set one as default for future use

**B6: Payout Method KYC Verification**
- For large payouts (> $600/year for US):
  - Require tax form completion (W-9, W-8BEN)
  - Display: "Complete tax verification to receive payments over $600"
  - Link to tax form upload

**B7: Multiple Currencies**
- If user has payment methods in different currencies:
  - Display currency for each method
  - Warn about exchange rate when using non-primary currency
  - Display: "Paying with {currency}. Exchange rate applied."

**B8: Subscription Payment Issues**
- If subscription payment fails:
  - Grace period: 7 days to update payment method
  - Display: "Your subscription is past due. Update payment method by {date} to avoid suspension."
  - After grace period: Suspend account features
  - Send multiple reminder emails (day 1, 3, 5, 7)

**B9: Refunds and Credits**
- Display refunded invoices clearly
- Show credit balance (if refund issued as credit)
- "Apply Credit" option on next invoice
- Display: "You have ${X} in account credit"

**B10: PCI Compliance**
- Never store full card numbers
- Use Stripe Elements for card input (PCI-compliant iframe)
- Display PCI compliance badge
- All card data transmitted via HTTPS
- Backend only stores tokenized references

#### Notifications

**Payment Method Added:**
- **Email:** "A new payment method was added to your account. If this wasn't you, remove it immediately."
- **In-app:** Toast: "Payment method added successfully"

**Payment Method Deleted:**
- **Email:** "A payment method was removed from your account"
- **In-app:** Toast: "Payment method deleted"

**Payment Method Expiring:**
- **Email (30 days before):** "Your card ending in {last_4} expires on {date}. Update it to avoid service interruption."
- **In-app:** Banner: "Payment method expiring soon. Update now."

**Payment Method Verification Required:**
- **Email:** "Verify your bank account to complete setup. Check your account for two small deposits."
- **In-app:** Banner: "Bank account verification pending"

**Payment Succeeded:**
- **Email:** "Payment received for {description}. Invoice: {invoice_number}. Amount: ${amount}."
- **In-app:** Toast: "Payment successful"

**Payment Failed:**
- **Email (urgent):** "Payment failed for {description}. Update your payment method to avoid service disruption."
- **In-app:** Alert banner: "Payment failed. Update your payment method."
- **Push (mobile):** "Payment failed. Action required."

**Default Payment Method Changed:**
- **Email:** "Your default payment method was changed to {card_type} ending in {last_4}"
- **In-app:** Toast: "Default payment method updated"

**Invoice Generated:**
- **Email:** "Your invoice {invoice_number} is ready. Amount due: ${amount}. [View Invoice]"
- **In-app:** Notification: "New invoice available"

**Payout Method Added:**
- **Email:** "A new payout method was added to your account"
- **In-app:** Toast: "Payout method added successfully"

#### Analytics

- billing.overview.viewed (user_id)
- billing.payment_methods.viewed (user_id)
- billing.payment_method.added (user_id, method_type: 'card' | 'bank' | 'paypal')
- billing.payment_method.deleted (user_id, method_id, reason)
- billing.payment_method.default_set (user_id, method_id)
- billing.payment_method.verification_initiated (user_id, method_id, verification_type)
- billing.payment_method.verification_completed (user_id, method_id, success)
- billing.payment_method.expired (user_id, method_id)
- billing.payout_method.added (user_id, method_type)
- billing.payout_method.deleted (user_id, method_id)
- billing.invoices.viewed (user_id)
- billing.invoice.downloaded (user_id, invoice_id, format: 'pdf')
- billing.payment.succeeded (user_id, invoice_id, amount, method_id)
- billing.payment.failed (user_id, invoice_id, amount, method_id, error_code)
- billing.payment.retried (user_id, invoice_id, attempt_number)

#### Sources

**Backend:** financial-be.user-stories.md (Payment Method domain, Payout domain, Invoice domain), financial-be-database-design.md (payment_methods table, payout_methods table, invoices table), subscriptions-be.user-stories.md (Subscription billing)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/settings/billing routes, (mobile)/(app)/settings/billing routes, hooks/billing/use-payment-methods.ts, hooks/billing/use-invoices.ts, components/billing/)
