### **ADM-4 — Support Ticket Management**

**ID:** ADM-4  
**Persona:** Support Agent, Support Manager  
**Preconditions:**
- User has SUPPORT or ADMIN role
- User authenticated and authorized
- Support ticket management permissions granted

**Primary Screens:**

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/admin/support` — Support dashboard
- `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets` — Ticket queue
- `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets/[ticketId]` — Ticket details
- `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets/[ticketId]/reply` — Reply to ticket
- `(dashboard)/admin/support/kb` — Knowledge base management
- `(dashboard)/admin/support/canned-responses` — Canned responses

**Mobile:**
- `(dashboard)/admin/support` — Support dashboard (mobile-optimized)
- `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets/[ticketId]` — Ticket detail (mobile)

**System Touchpoints:**
- **admin-be:** Support ticketing system, KB management, canned responses
- **communications-be:** Email notifications, in-app messaging
- **users-be:** User profile data for ticket context

**Flow Steps:**

1. **Access Support Dashboard**
   - Support agent navigates to `(dashboard)/admin/support`
   - Dashboard displays:
     - Open tickets count (by priority)
     - Assigned to me
     - Unassigned tickets
     - Average response time
     - Average resolution time
     - Today's closed tickets
     - SLA compliance rate

2. **View Ticket Queue**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets`
   - Queue displays tickets with:
     - Ticket ID
     - Subject
     - Category (technical, billing, account, general)
     - Priority (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT)
     - Status (NEW, OPEN, AWAITING_USER, RESOLVED, CLOSED)
     - Assigned agent (or "Unassigned")
     - Timestamp (created, last updated)
     - SLA indicator (time remaining/overdue)

3. **Filter & Sort Tickets**
   - Apply filters:
     - Status (NEW, OPEN, all)
     - Priority
     - Category
     - Assigned agent
     - Date range
     - SLA status (approaching, overdue)
   - Sort options:
     - Priority (URGENT first)
     - Oldest first
     - SLA expiration (soonest first)
     - Newest first

4. **Claim/Assign Ticket**
   - Support agent clicks "Claim" on unassigned ticket
   - OR Support manager assigns ticket to specific agent
   - Ticket status changes to "OPEN"
   - Notification sent to assigned agent

5. **View Ticket Details**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets/[ticketId]`
   - Display:
     - Full ticket description
     - User information (name, email, account type, join date)
     - User's previous tickets (history)
     - Conversation thread (all messages)
     - Attachments (screenshots, files)
     - Internal notes (visible to support team only)
     - Related tickets (if any)
     - System context (user's active contracts, recent activity)

6. **Reply to Ticket**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets/[ticketId]/reply`
   - Compose reply:
     - Use rich text editor
     - Insert canned response (quick replies)
     - Add attachments (max 10MB)
     - Link to KB article
     - Add internal note (optional)
   - Options:
     - "Send & Keep Open": Send reply, ticket remains OPEN
     - "Send & Resolve": Send reply, mark ticket as RESOLVED
     - "Send & Escalate": Send reply, escalate to manager

7. **Update Ticket Status**
   - Change status:
     - NEW → OPEN (when agent claims)
     - OPEN → AWAITING_USER (waiting for user response)
     - AWAITING_USER → OPEN (user responded)
     - OPEN → RESOLVED (issue resolved)
     - RESOLVED → CLOSED (after 7 days or manual close)
     - OPEN → ESCALATED (needs manager review)
   - System logs status change in audit trail

8. **Close Ticket**
   - If ticket RESOLVED for 7+ days:
     - Auto-close with notification to user
   - OR Agent manually closes:
     - Add resolution summary
     - Request feedback (CSAT survey link sent)
     - Ticket status: CLOSED

**Branches & Edge Cases:**

**B1: No Tickets in Queue**
- Show message: "🎉 All caught up! No pending tickets."
- Display summary of today's completed tickets
- Quick links to KB management or canned responses

**B2: SLA Approaching/Overdue**
- Show alert: "⚠️ {count} tickets are approaching SLA deadline."
- Red indicator on tickets past SLA
- Auto-prioritize in queue

**B3: User Responds After Resolution**
- Ticket status changes from RESOLVED → OPEN
- Notification sent to assigned agent: "Ticket #{ticket_id} reopened by user."
- Move back to top of queue

**B4: Duplicate Ticket**
- System suggests: "Possible duplicate of Ticket #{ticket_id}. Link tickets?"
- Option to merge tickets
- Link related tickets for context

**B5: Escalation Required**
- Agent clicks "Escalate"
- Provide escalation reason
- Ticket assigned to support manager
- Notification sent to manager
- SLA deadline extended (if policy allows)

**B6: User Requests Account Deletion (GDPR)**
- If ticket contains deletion request:
  - Show alert: "GDPR Request Detected. Route to compliance team."
  - Auto-assign category: "PRIVACY_REQUEST"
  - High priority assigned
  - Compliance workflow triggered

**B7: Abusive/Threatening Message**
- If ticket contains abusive language:
  - Show warning: "⚠️ Abusive content detected. Review before replying."
  - Option to "Flag user" or "Escalate to moderation"

**B8: Technical Issue Requires Dev Team**
- Agent can create linked issue in dev tracking system
  - Provide issue details
  - Link ticket to bug/feature request
  - Notify user: "Issue escalated to engineering. We'll keep you updated."

**B9: Billing Issue Requires Finance Team**
- If category is "BILLING":
  - Show financial context (recent transactions, disputes)
  - Option to "Loop in finance team"
  - Finance team notified

**B10: Canned Response Used**
- Agent selects canned response
- Response pre-fills reply editor
- Agent can customize before sending
- Track canned response effectiveness

**B11: KB Article Linked**
- Agent links KB article in reply
  - Article embedded in email/message
  - Track: "Was this helpful?" feedback

**B12: Ticket Auto-Escalated**
- If ticket open for 48h with no response:
  - Auto-escalate to manager
  - Notification sent
  - Status: "ESCALATED"

**B13: User Satisfaction Survey**
- After ticket closed:
  - Email sent with CSAT survey (1-5 stars)
  - Optional comment field
  - Responses tracked for agent performance

#### Notifications

**Ticket Created (to Agent):**
- **Email:** "New Support Ticket #{ticket_id}: {subject}. [View ticket]"
- **In-app:** Push: "New ticket assigned to you."

**Ticket Assigned (to Agent):**
- **Email:** "Ticket #{ticket_id} assigned to you: {subject}. [View ticket]"
- **In-app:** Notification with link

**Agent Replied (to User):**
- **Email:** "Response to your support ticket #{ticket_id}. [View response]"
- **In-app:** Notification: "Support team replied to your ticket."

**Ticket Resolved (to User):**
- **Email:** "Your support ticket has been resolved. [View details] [Reopen if needed]"
- **In-app:** Notification: "Ticket resolved. Rate your experience."

**Ticket Closed (to User):**
- **Email:** "Your ticket has been closed. [Leave feedback]"

**SLA Warning (to Agent/Manager):**
- **Email (agent):** "⚠️ Ticket #{ticket_id} approaching SLA deadline ({hours_remaining} hours)."
- **Email (manager):** "⚠️ {count} tickets at risk of SLA breach."

**Escalation (to Manager):**
- **Email:** "Ticket #{ticket_id} escalated by {agent_name}. Reason: {reason}. [Review now]"
- **In-app:** Urgent notification

**Ticket Reopened (to Agent):**
- **Email:** "Ticket #{ticket_id} reopened by user. [View ticket]"
- **In-app:** Notification: "Ticket reopened."

#### Analytics

- admin.support.dashboard.viewed (agent_id)
- admin.support.queue.viewed (agent_id, filters[])
- admin.support.ticket.viewed (agent_id, ticket_id)
- admin.support.ticket.claimed (agent_id, ticket_id)
- admin.support.ticket.assigned (manager_id, ticket_id, assigned_to)
- admin.support.ticket.replied (agent_id, ticket_id, canned_response_used)
- admin.support.ticket.status_changed (agent_id, ticket_id, old_status, new_status)
- admin.support.ticket.escalated (agent_id, ticket_id, escalation_reason)
- admin.support.ticket.closed (agent_id, ticket_id, resolution_summary)
- admin.support.canned_response.used (agent_id, response_id, ticket_id)
- admin.support.kb_article.linked (agent_id, article_id, ticket_id)
- admin.support.satisfaction.survey_completed (user_id, ticket_id, rating, comment)
- admin.support.sla.breached (ticket_id, breach_duration_hours)

#### Sources

**Backend:** admin-be.user-stories.md (support ticketing domain), communications-be.user-stories.md (notifications)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/admin/support routes, hooks/admin/use-support-tickets.ts, components/admin/support/)

### **ADM-5 — Platform Configuration & Feature Flags**

**ID:** ADM-5  
**Persona:** Platform Admin, DevOps, Engineering Manager  
**Preconditions:**
- User has SUPER_ADMIN or CONFIG_MANAGER role
- User authenticated and authorized
- Platform configuration permissions granted

**Primary Screens:**

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/admin/config` — System configurations
- `(dashboard)/admin/config/feature-flags` — Feature flags management
- `(dashboard)/admin/config/feature-flags/[flagId]` — Feature flag details
- `(dashboard)/admin/config/policies` — Platform policies
- `(dashboard)/admin/config/integrations` — Third-party integrations

**Mobile:**
- Not recommended for mobile (complex UI, requires precision)

**System Touchpoints:**
- **admin-be:** System configuration, feature flags, policies
- **All microservices:** Consume feature flag updates

**Flow Steps:**

1. **Access Configuration Dashboard**
   - Admin navigates to `(dashboard)/admin/config`
   - Dashboard displays:
     - Active feature flags count
     - Recent configuration changes
     - Pending configuration reviews (if two-person rule enabled)
     - System health status
     - Quick links to major config sections

2. **View Feature Flags**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/config/feature-flags`
   - Display all feature flags with:
     - Flag name
     - Description
     - Status (ENABLED, DISABLED, PARTIAL)
     - Rollout percentage (if gradual)
     - Target users/segments (if selective)
     - Last modified (by whom, when)
     - Environment (DEV, STAGING, PROD)

3. **Create New Feature Flag**
   - Click "Create Feature Flag"
   - Provide:
     - Flag name (e.g., `freelancer_badge_v2`)
     - Description
     - Default state (ENABLED/DISABLED)
     - Rollout strategy:
       - All users
       - Percentage-based (0-100%)
       - User segment (beta testers, specific user IDs)
       - Geographic (specific countries)
   - Click "Create"
   - System validates and creates flag

4. **Update Feature Flag**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/config/feature-flags/[flagId]`
   - Modify:
     - Status (ENABLED → DISABLED or vice versa)
     - Rollout percentage
     - Target users/segments
   - Provide change reason (mandatory for audit)
   - If two-person rule enabled:
     - Submit for approval
     - Second admin reviews and approves
   - System updates flag and propagates to all services

5. **View System Configuration**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/config`
   - Display configurable settings:
     - **Payment settings:** Transaction fees, minimum payout, currency support
     - **Job posting rules:** Max price, max duration, categories
     - **Contract rules:** Max milestones, payment terms
     - **Search settings:** Result limits, ranking weights
     - **Communication rules:** Rate limits, spam thresholds
     - **Moderation policies:** Auto-flag thresholds, queue priorities
   - Each setting shows: Current value, default value, last modified

6. **Update Configuration Setting**
   - Click "Edit" on setting
   - Modify value (with validation)
   - Provide change reason (mandatory)
   - Preview impact (if applicable)
   - If two-person rule enabled:
     - Submit for approval
     - Second admin reviews and approves
   - System applies configuration change

7. **Manage Third-Party Integrations**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/config/integrations`
   - Display integrations:
     - **Payment providers:** Stripe, PayPal status
     - **Identity verification:** ID verification service status
     - **Email service:** SMTP settings, provider status
     - **Storage:** S3/cloud storage config
     - **Analytics:** Google Analytics, Mixpanel keys
   - Toggle enable/disable
   - Update API keys/credentials
   - Test connection

**Branches & Edge Cases:**

**B1: Two-Person Rule Enabled**
- If critical config (e.g., payment fees):
  - Require approval from second admin
  - Show: "Pending Approval" status
  - Notify approver
  - Approver reviews change and either approves or rejects
  - If rejected: change discarded with reason

**B2: Configuration Change Requires Downtime**
- Show warning: "⚠️ This change may cause brief downtime. Schedule maintenance window?"
- Options:
  - "Apply immediately" (with confirmation)
  - "Schedule for maintenance window"

**B3: Feature Flag Conflicts**
- If new flag conflicts with existing flag:
  - Show warning: "Conflict detected with flag {flag_name}. Enabling this may disable {conflicting_flag}."
  - Require confirmation

**B4: Gradual Rollout in Progress**
- If flag rollout is ongoing:
  - Show progress: "{percentage}% of users enabled"
  - Option to "Complete rollout now" or "Roll back"

**B5: Integration Connection Failed**
- If test connection fails:
  - Show error: "Connection failed: {error_message}"
  - Suggestions: Check API key, verify network access, review logs
  - Link to integration documentation

**B6: Configuration Validation Failed**
- If new config value is invalid:
  - Show error: "Invalid value: {reason}"
  - Provide valid range/format
  - Examples shown

**B7: Audit Trail Required**
- All config changes logged:
  - Who made change
  - What was changed (old value → new value)
  - When
  - Why (reason provided)
  - Who approved (if two-person rule)
- Full audit trail exported for compliance

**B8: Environment-Specific Flags**
- Show environment indicator: DEV, STAGING, PROD
- Warning when modifying PROD: "⚠️ You're modifying production. Proceed with caution."
- Option to sync flags across environments

**B9: Feature Flag Cleanup**
- If flag unused for 90+ days:
  - Show suggestion: "This flag hasn't been accessed in {days} days. Consider removing."
  - Archive old flags

**B10: Rollback Required**
- If feature flag causes issues:
  - One-click "Rollback" button
  - Instantly disables flag
  - Notification sent to admins
  - Incident logged

#### Notifications

**Configuration Changed:**
- **Email (admins):** "System configuration updated: {setting_name}. Old: {old_value}, New: {new_value}. [View change]"
- **In-app (devs):** Notification: "Config change may affect your service."

**Feature Flag Updated:**
- **Email (admins/devs):** "Feature flag {flag_name} {status_change}. [View details]"

**Configuration Requires Approval:**
- **Email (approver):** "Configuration change pending your approval: {setting_name}. [Review now]"
- **In-app:** Urgent notification

**Approval Granted/Denied:**
- **Email (requester):** "Your configuration change was {approved/denied}. {reason if denied}"

**Integration Status Changed:**
- **Email (admins):** "Integration {name} status: {status}. [Check details]"
- **In-app:** Alert if integration down

**Feature Flag Rollback:**
- **Email (admins/devs):** "URGENT: Feature flag {flag_name} rolled back. Reason: {reason}. [View incident]"
- **In-app:** Alert banner

#### Analytics

- admin.config.dashboard.viewed (admin_id)
- admin.config.feature_flags.viewed (admin_id)
- admin.config.feature_flag.created (admin_id, flag_name, rollout_strategy)
- admin.config.feature_flag.updated (admin_id, flag_id, old_value, new_value, reason)
- admin.config.feature_flag.rolled_back (admin_id, flag_id, rollback_reason)
- admin.config.setting.viewed (admin_id, setting_name)
- admin.config.setting.updated (admin_id, setting_name, old_value, new_value, reason)
- admin.config.setting.approval_requested (admin_id, setting_name, requested_value)
- admin.config.setting.approved (approver_id, setting_name, requester_id)
- admin.config.setting.rejected (approver_id, setting_name, rejection_reason)
- admin.config.integration.viewed (admin_id, integration_name)
- admin.config.integration.updated (admin_id, integration_name, action)
- admin.config.integration.tested (admin_id, integration_name, test_result)
- admin.config.audit_trail.exported (admin_id, date_range, format)

#### Sources

**Backend:** admin-be.user-stories.md (config, feature flags), utility/feature-flags (feature flag service)

### **ADM-6 — Compliance & GDPR Management**

**ID:** ADM-6  
**Persona:** Compliance Officer, Data Protection Officer, Legal Team  
**Preconditions:**
- User has COMPLIANCE or LEGAL role
- User authenticated and authorized
- Compliance management permissions granted

**Primary Screens:**

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance` — Compliance dashboard
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/privacy-requests` — GDPR/CCPA requests
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/privacy-requests/[requestId]` — Request details
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/data-retention` — Data retention policies
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/consent-management` — User consent tracking
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/data-exports` — User data exports

**Mobile:**
- Not recommended for mobile (sensitive data, complex workflows)

**System Touchpoints:**
- **admin-be:** Privacy request handling, GDPR compliance
- **users-be:** User data access, deletion, export
- **All microservices:** Data subject access requests (DSAR)

**Flow Steps:**

1. **Access Compliance Dashboard**
   - Compliance officer navigates to `(dashboard)/admin/compliance`
   - Dashboard displays:
     - Open privacy requests (DSAR, deletion, opt-out)
     - SLA status (30-day deadline per GDPR)
     - Recent completed requests
     - Consent tracking summary
     - Data retention audit status

2. **View Privacy Requests**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/privacy-requests`
   - Display requests with:
     - Request ID
     - Request type (ACCESS, DELETION, RECTIFICATION, PORTABILITY, OPT_OUT)
     - User information (name, email)
     - Status (NEW, IN_PROGRESS, IDENTITY_VERIFICATION, COMPLETED, REJECTED)
     - Submitted date
     - SLA deadline (30 days per GDPR)
     - Time remaining/overdue

3. **Process DSAR (Data Subject Access Request)**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/privacy-requests/[requestId]`
   - Review request details:
     - User identity verification status
     - Requested data scope (all data, specific categories)
     - Delivery method (email, download link)
   - Click "Start Processing"
   - System aggregates user data from all services:
     - Profile data (users-be)
     - Job postings (jobs-be)
     - Proposals (proposals-be)
     - Contracts (contracts-be)
     - Messages (communications-be)
     - Financial transactions (financial-be)
     - Reviews (reviews-be)
     - Files (storage-be)
   - Generate data export package (JSON/CSV)
   - Review for PII redaction (third-party PII removed)
   - Click "Approve Export"
   - System sends secure download link to user

4. **Process Deletion Request (Right to be Forgotten)**
   - Navigate to request details
   - Verify user identity (mandatory)
   - Review deletion scope:
     - Full account deletion
     - OR Specific data categories
   - Check constraints:
     - Active contracts (cannot delete until resolved)
     - Pending payments (must be settled)
     - Legal hold (prevents deletion)
   - Click "Start Deletion"
   - System performs:
     - Soft delete user account (anonymization)
     - Remove PII from all services
     - Keep transaction records (financial compliance)
     - Keep audit logs (legal compliance)
     - Anonymize reviews (keep content, remove author PII)
   - Confirm completion within 30 days

5. **Identity Verification**
   - For sensitive requests (deletion, access):
     - User must verify identity
     - Options:
       - Email verification link
       - ID document upload
       - Video call verification (high-risk)
     - Compliance officer reviews verification
     - Approve or request additional verification

6. **Manage User Consent**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/consent-management`
   - View user consent records:
     - Marketing emails: Opted in/out
     - Data processing: Consented/withdrawn
     - Third-party sharing: Consented/withdrawn
     - Cookies: Accepted/rejected
   - Track consent changes over time
   - Export consent audit trail

7. **Data Retention Policy Management**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/data-retention`
   - Configure retention policies by data type:
     - User profiles: Retain until account deletion + 7 years (tax)
     - Messages: 3 years
     - Financial records: 7 years (legal requirement)
     - Audit logs: 10 years
     - Session logs: 90 days
   - System auto-deletes data past retention period
   - Audit trail of deletions maintained

**Branches & Edge Cases:**

**B1: User Identity Verification Failed**
- If identity cannot be verified:
  - Status: "IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_FAILED"
  - Send request to user: "We need additional information to verify your identity. [Submit documents]"
  - Options: Request ID document, schedule video call

**B2: Active Contracts Prevent Deletion**
- If user has active contracts:
  - Show warning: "Cannot delete account. User has {count} active contracts."
  - Options:
    - Wait for contracts to complete
    - Anonymize account but keep contract data
    - Terminate contracts with consent (requires client agreement)
  - Notify user: "Deletion pending contract completion."

**B3: Legal Hold Prevents Deletion**
- If account under legal hold (e.g., fraud investigation):
  - Show alert: "⚠️ Legal hold active. Deletion blocked until {date}."
  - Status: "BLOCKED_LEGAL_HOLD"
  - Notify user: "Your deletion request cannot be processed at this time due to legal proceedings."

**B4: Data Export Too Large**
- If user data exceeds size limit (e.g., 2GB):
  - Split into multiple download packages
  - Send multiple secure links
  - Notify user: "Your data export is large and split into {count} files."

**B5: Third-Party Data Cannot Be Removed**
- If data shared with third parties (e.g., payment processor):
  - Show warning: "Some data may be retained by third parties per their policies."
  - List third parties
  - Provide links to their privacy policies

**B6: SLA Approaching/Overdue**
- If request approaching 30-day deadline:
  - Show alert: "⚠️ SLA deadline in {days} days."
  - Red indicator if overdue
  - Auto-escalate to compliance manager

**B7: Partial Data Deletion**
- If user requests deletion of specific data categories:
  - Display checklist: Messages, reviews, profile bio, etc.
  - User selects categories
  - System deletes only selected data
  - Confirm: "Selected data deleted. Account remains active."

**B8: CCPA Opt-Out Request (California)**
- If California user requests opt-out of data sale:
  - Process: Update consent flags
  - Stop all third-party data sharing
  - Notify user: "You've opted out of data sharing."
  - No data deleted (opt-out ≠ deletion)

**B9: Data Portability Request**
- If user requests data in machine-readable format:
  - Generate JSON export
  - Include all user-generated content
  - Structured for import into other systems
  - Send secure download link

**B10: Rectification Request**
- If user requests data correction:
  - Display current data
  - User proposes corrections
  - Compliance officer reviews
  - Approve or reject with reason

**B11: Request Rejected**
- If request invalid (e.g., fraudulent, excessive):
  - Status: "REJECTED"
  - Provide reason to user
  - User can appeal or resubmit

**B12: Automated Deletion (Inactive Accounts)**
- If account inactive for 3+ years:
  - Auto-trigger deletion review
  - Notify user: "Your account will be deleted in 30 days due to inactivity. [Keep account]"
  - If no response: Proceed with deletion

#### Notifications

**Privacy Request Submitted (to Compliance Team):**
- **Email:** "New privacy request #{request_id}: {request_type} from {user_email}. [Review now]"
- **In-app:** Notification with link

**Privacy Request Processed (to User):**
- **Email (DSAR):** "Your data is ready for download. [Secure link, expires in 7 days]"
- **Email (Deletion):** "Your account has been deleted per your request. Effective: {date}."
- **Email (Rectification):** "Your data has been updated per your request."

**SLA Warning (to Compliance Team):**
- **Email:** "⚠️ Privacy request #{request_id} approaching deadline ({days_remaining} days)."

**Identity Verification Required (to User):**
- **Email:** "Identity verification required for your privacy request. [Verify now]"

**Legal Hold Applied (to Compliance Team):**
- **Email:** "Legal hold applied to user account {user_id}. Deletion blocked."

**Consent Updated (to User):**
- **Email:** "Your consent preferences have been updated. [Review settings]"

#### Analytics

- admin.compliance.dashboard.viewed (officer_id)
- admin.compliance.privacy_requests.viewed (officer_id, filters[])
- admin.compliance.privacy_request.viewed (officer_id, request_id, request_type)
- admin.compliance.privacy_request.processed (officer_id, request_id, request_type, processing_time_days)
- admin.compliance.privacy_request.completed (officer_id, request_id, request_type, completion_time_days)
- admin.compliance.privacy_request.rejected (officer_id, request_id, rejection_reason)
- admin.compliance.identity_verification.completed (officer_id, request_id, verification_method)
- admin.compliance.data_export.generated (officer_id, user_id, export_size_mb)
- admin.compliance.account_deletion.completed (officer_id, user_id, deletion_scope)
- admin.compliance.consent.viewed (officer_id, user_id)
- admin.compliance.consent.updated (officer_id, user_id, consent_type, new_value)
- admin.compliance.data_retention.policy_updated (officer_id, data_type, retention_period_days)
- admin.compliance.legal_hold.applied (officer_id, user_id, hold_reason)
- admin.compliance.legal_hold.lifted (officer_id, user_id)
- admin.compliance.sla.breached (request_id, breach_duration_days)

#### Sources

**Backend:** admin-be.user-stories.md (compliance, privacy requests), users-be.user-stories.md (user data access, deletion)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/admin/compliance routes, hooks/admin/use-compliance.ts, components/admin/compliance/)

## ADM-7: Analytics & Reporting Dashboard

**User Goal:** View platform analytics, generate reports, monitor KPIs  
**Actor:** Admin (SUPER_ADMIN, MANAGER)  
**Preconditions:** Admin account with analytics permissions  
**Triggers:** Need to monitor platform health, generate stakeholder reports, track KPIs

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/admin/analytics` — Analytics overview dashboard
- `(dashboard)/admin/analytics/platform` — Platform-wide analytics
- `(dashboard)/admin/analytics/reports` — Generated reports list
- `(dashboard)/admin/analytics/reports/create` — Report generator
- `(dashboard)/admin/analytics/reports/[reportId]` — View report

**Mobile:**
- `admin/analytics` — Analytics dashboard (read-only)
- `admin/analytics/reports` — Reports list

#### System Touchpoints

- **admin-be:** Analytics data, report generation, KPIs aggregation
- **jobs-be:** Job analytics (views, applications, performance)
- **proposals-be:** Proposal analytics (conversion, acceptance rate)
- **contracts-be:** Contract analytics (value, completion rate)
- **financial-be:** Financial analytics (revenue, transaction volume)
- **users-be:** User analytics (growth, engagement, retention)
- **storage-be:** Report file storage and retrieval
- **notifications-be:** Report completion notifications

#### Flow Steps

1. **View analytics dashboard:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/analytics`
   - Display overview cards:
     - **Total Users:** Count, growth % (vs last period)
     - **Active Jobs:** Current count, posted this month
     - **Active Contracts:** Current count, total value
     - **Revenue:** This month, growth %, trend chart
     - **Pending Support Tickets:** Count, avg resolution time
     - **Moderation Queue:** Pending reports count
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/analytics`

2. **View platform analytics:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/analytics/platform`
   - **User Growth:**
     - New registrations (daily/weekly/monthly)
     - User type breakdown (client/freelancer)
     - Activation rate
     - Retention rate (30-day, 90-day)
     - Churn rate
     - Geographic distribution (map)
   - **Job Market Health:**
     - Jobs posted (trend)
     - Average time to first proposal
     - Average proposals per job
     - Job completion rate
     - Category distribution
   - **Financial Metrics:**
     - Total transaction volume
     - Average transaction value
     - Revenue by category
     - Payment success rate
     - Refund rate
   - **Engagement:**
     - Daily/Monthly Active Users (DAU/MAU)
     - Average session duration
     - Page views
     - Feature usage (top features)
   - **System Health:**
     - API response times (P50, P95, P99)
     - Error rates by service
     - Uptime percentage
     - Database performance
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/analytics/platform?period=30d`

3. **Generate custom report:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/analytics/reports/create`
   - Select report type:
     - **User Analytics:** Registrations, activity, retention
     - **Job Performance:** Job postings, proposals, hires
     - **Financial Summary:** Revenue, transactions, commissions
     - **Moderation Report:** Flags, actions, resolution time
     - **Support Metrics:** Ticket volume, resolution rate, CSAT
     - **Platform Health:** System metrics, performance, errors
   - Configure report:
     - Date range (last 7/30/90 days, custom)
     - Filters (user type, category, region, etc.)
     - Metrics to include (select from checklist)
     - Output format (PDF, CSV, Excel)
     - Recipients (email list)
   - Schedule options:
     - One-time (generate now)
     - Recurring (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly)
     - Next execution date/time
   - Click "Generate Report"

4. **Process report generation:**
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/analytics/reports`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "report_type": "FINANCIAL_SUMMARY",
       "date_range": {
         "start": "2025-10-01",
         "end": "2025-10-31"
       },
       "filters": {
         "categories": ["design", "development"],
         "regions": ["US", "EU"]
       },
       "metrics": ["revenue", "transaction_volume", "avg_transaction_value"],
       "format": "PDF",
       "recipients": ["cfo@company.com", "ceo@company.com"],
       "schedule": {
         "frequency": "MONTHLY",
         "day_of_month": 1,
         "time": "09:00:00"
       }
     }
     ```
   - System aggregates data from multiple services
   - Generate visualizations (charts, graphs)
   - Create PDF/CSV/Excel file
   - Upload to storage-be
   - Send to recipients
   - Status: "PROCESSING" → "COMPLETED"

5. **View generated reports:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/analytics/reports`
   - Display reports list:
     - Report name
     - Type (User Analytics, Financial, etc.)
     - Generated date
     - Period covered
     - Status (Processing, Completed, Failed)
     - Size
     - Generated by (admin name)
     - Actions (Download, View, Schedule, Delete)
   - Filters:
     - Report type
     - Date range
     - Generated by
     - Status
   - Sort by: Generated date, Name, Type
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/analytics/reports?page=1&limit=50`

6. **Download report:**
   - Click "Download" on report row
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/analytics/reports/{reportId}/download`
   - System generates signed URL from storage-be
   - Browser downloads file
   - Track download in audit log

7. **View KPIs dashboard:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/analytics`
   - Display real-time KPIs:
     - **User KPIs:**
       - Total users (Client/Freelancer breakdown)
       - New users today/this week
       - Active users (last 30 days)
       - Verified accounts percentage
     - **Job KPIs:**
       - Active jobs
       - Jobs posted today/this week
       - Average proposals per job
       - Average time to hire
     - **Contract KPIs:**
       - Active contracts
       - Total contract value
       - Average contract value
       - Completion rate
     - **Financial KPIs:**
       - Revenue (today, this week, this month)
       - Transaction count
       - Average transaction value
       - Payment success rate
     - **Support KPIs:**
       - Open tickets
       - Average resolution time
       - Customer satisfaction (CSAT)
       - SLA compliance rate
     - **Moderation KPIs:**
       - Pending reports
       - Average resolution time
       - False positive rate
       - Action distribution
   - Each KPI shows:
     - Current value
     - Change vs previous period (%, arrow up/down)
     - Mini trend chart (sparkline)
     - Link to detailed view
   - Auto-refresh every 30 seconds
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/analytics/kpis?refresh=true`

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Report generation timeout:**
   - Large reports may take time
   - Status: "PROCESSING"
   - Send notification when complete
   - Email: "Your report is ready for download"
   - Push notification
   - Keep processing in background job

2. **Report generation failure:**
   - Data aggregation error
   - Insufficient permissions to access data
   - Service unavailable
   - Status: "FAILED"
   - Error message: "Report generation failed. Reason: {error}"
   - Retry option
   - Notify admin

3. **Large data export:**
   - CSV/Excel file > 50MB
   - Split into multiple files
   - Create ZIP archive
   - Email download link
   - Expire link after 7 days

4. **Scheduled report:**
   - Auto-generate on schedule
   - Email to recipients automatically
   - Store in reports list
   - Status: "SCHEDULED"
   - Show next execution date
   - Edit or cancel schedule

5. **Report access control:**
   - Only admins who generated report or SUPER_ADMIN can view
   - Other admins see "Access denied"
   - Audit log tracks who accessed report

6. **Historical data unavailable:**
   - User requests report for period before system launch
   - Error: "Data not available for selected period"
   - Show available date range
   - Adjust date range

7. **Empty data set:**
   - Filters return no results
   - Display: "No data available for selected criteria"
   - Suggest removing filters
   - Still generate empty report (shows 0 values)

8. **Real-time data delay:**
   - Analytics data aggregated every hour
   - Display: "Last updated: 15 minutes ago"
   - Manual refresh button
   - Auto-refresh option

9. **Export format limits:**
   - PDF: Max 100 pages
   - CSV: Max 1M rows
   - Excel: Max 1M rows
   - If exceeds: Suggest splitting by date range

10. **Custom metric calculations:**
    - Some metrics require complex aggregation
    - May take longer
    - Show progress: "Calculating... 45%"
    - Use cached results if available (< 1 hour old)

11. **Comparative analytics:**
    - Compare periods (MoM, YoY)
    - Show % change, absolute change
    - Highlight significant changes
    - Color code: green (positive), red (negative)

12. **Drill-down analytics:**
    - Click on chart/metric
    - Navigate to detailed view
    - Example: Click "New Users" → User registration details
    - Breadcrumb navigation

13. **Data privacy:**
    - PII redacted from exports
    - User IDs anonymized in CSV exports
    - Compliance with GDPR/CCPA
    - Audit log tracks all data access

14. **Report sharing:**
    - Generate shareable link
    - Link expires after 30 days
    - Password protection option
    - Track who accessed shared report

15. **Dashboard customization:**
    - Admin can pin favorite metrics
    - Drag-and-drop widgets
    - Save custom layout
    - Reset to default layout

#### Notifications

**Report Generated:**
- **Email:** "Your {report_type} report for {period} is ready. [Download now]"
- **Push:** "Report ready for download"
- **In-app:** Notification with download link

**Scheduled Report Sent:**
- **Email:** "Your scheduled {report_type} report for {period}. [Attached/Download link]"
- **Recipients:** As configured in schedule

**Report Generation Failed:**
- **Email:** "Report generation failed. Reason: {error}. [Retry]"
- **Push:** "Report failed"
- **In-app:** Error notification

**KPI Alert (Threshold):**
- **Email:** "⚠️ KPI Alert: {metric} has exceeded threshold. Current: {value}, Threshold: {threshold}."
- **Push:** "KPI alert: {metric}"
- **Slack:** Integration with admin Slack channel (if configured)

**System Health Alert:**
- **Email:** "🚨 System Alert: {service} error rate is high ({rate}%). [View details]"
- **Push:** "System health alert"
- **PagerDuty:** Integration for critical alerts (if configured)

#### Analytics

- admin.analytics.dashboard.viewed (admin_id, role)
- admin.analytics.platform.viewed (admin_id, period, filters)
- admin.analytics.report.created (admin_id, report_type, format, schedule)
- admin.analytics.report.generated (report_id, report_type, processing_time_ms, file_size_mb)
- admin.analytics.report.downloaded (admin_id, report_id, report_type)
- admin.analytics.report.scheduled (admin_id, report_id, frequency)
- admin.analytics.report.failed (report_id, error_reason)
- admin.analytics.kpis.viewed (admin_id, kpis_viewed[])
- admin.analytics.export.created (admin_id, export_type, format, row_count)
- admin.analytics.drill_down.clicked (admin_id, metric, detail_view)
- admin.analytics.dashboard.customized (admin_id, widgets_added[], widgets_removed[])

#### Sources

**Backend:** admin-be.user-stories.md (reporting, metrics), jobs-be.user-stories.md (job analytics), contracts-be.user-stories.md (contract analytics)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/admin/analytics routes, hooks/admin/use-analytics.ts, components/admin/analytics/)

## ADM-8: User Management & Roles

**User Goal:** Manage platform users, roles, permissions, account status  
**Actor:** Admin (SUPER_ADMIN, MANAGER)  
**Preconditions:** Admin account with user management permissions  
**Triggers:** User flagged, role change request, account issue

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/admin/users` — Users list and search
- `(dashboard)/admin/users/[userId]` — User detail page
- `(dashboard)/admin/users/[userId]/edit` — Edit user profile
- `(dashboard)/admin/users/[userId]/roles` — Manage user roles
- `(dashboard)/admin/users/[userId]/moderation` — Moderation actions
- `(dashboard)/admin/users/flagged` — Flagged users list

**Mobile:**
- `admin/users` — Users list (read-only)
- `admin/users/[userId]` — User details (read-only)

#### System Touchpoints

- **admin-be:** User management, role assignment, moderation actions
- **users-be:** User data, profile, account status, verification
- **auth-be:** Authentication, permissions, role validation
- **notifications-be:** User notifications (warnings, suspensions)
- **financial-be:** Financial holds, payment restrictions
- **jobs-be:** Job posting restrictions
- **proposals-be:** Proposal submission restrictions
- **contracts-be:** Contract restrictions

#### Flow Steps

1. **View users list:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/users`
   - Display users table:
     - User ID, Name, Email, Type (Client/Freelancer)
     - Status (Active, Suspended, Banned, Pending)
     - Verified badge (email, phone, identity)
     - Registration date
     - Last active
     - Total jobs/earnings (freelancer)
     - Total jobs posted/spent (client)
     - Risk score (if flagged)
     - Actions dropdown
   - Filters:
     - User type (Client, Freelancer, Both)
     - Status (Active, Suspended, Banned, Pending)
     - Verification (Verified, Unverified)
     - Registration date range
     - Risk level (High, Medium, Low)
     - Has active warnings/suspensions
   - Search: Name, email, user ID
   - Sort: Registration date, Last active, Name, Risk score
   - Pagination: 50 users per page
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/users?page=1&limit=50&filters=...`

2. **View user details:**
   - Click on user row or "View Details"
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/users/[userId]`
   - **Profile Overview:**
     - Avatar, name, email, phone
     - User type, role
     - Account status (Active/Suspended/Banned)
     - Verification status (email, phone, identity, business)
     - Risk score, trust score
     - Registration date, last active
     - Location, timezone, language
   - **Account Activity:**
     - Total jobs posted/completed
     - Total spent/earned
     - Active contracts count
     - Proposals sent/received
     - Messages sent
     - Reviews given/received
   - **Financial Summary:**
     - Current balance
     - Total revenue (platform fee)
     - Refunds issued
     - Payment method status
     - Pending payouts
   - **Verification Details:**
     - Email verified: Date, IP
     - Phone verified: Date, number
     - Identity verified: Date, method, status
     - Business verified: Date, documents
   - **Moderation History:**
     - Warnings count
     - Suspensions count
     - Active restrictions
     - Flags received
     - Reports submitted
   - **Connected Accounts:**
     - Social logins (Google, LinkedIn)
     - Linked payment methods
     - OAuth apps authorized
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/users/{userId}`

3. **Edit user profile:**
   - Click "Edit Profile"
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/users/[userId]/edit`
   - Editable fields:
     - First name, Last name
     - Email (with re-verification)
     - Phone (with re-verification)
     - Bio, headline
     - Location, timezone, language
     - User type (change Client ↔ Freelancer)
     - Role (SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPPORT, USER)
   - Click "Save Changes"
   - BE: `PATCH /v1/admin/users/{userId}`
   - Audit log created
   - User notified of profile changes

4. **Manage roles & permissions:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/users/[userId]/roles`
   - Current role displayed
   - Available roles:
     - **SUPER_ADMIN:** Full platform access
     - **ADMIN:** User management, moderation, analytics
     - **MANAGER:** Limited analytics, support
     - **SUPPORT:** Ticket management only
     - **USER:** Regular user (default)
   - Each role shows permissions:
     - View analytics
     - Manage users
     - Moderation actions
     - Support tickets
     - Financial operations
   - Select new role
   - Add reason for role change (required)
   - Click "Update Role"
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/users/{userId}/roles`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "role": "ADMIN",
       "reason": "Promoted to admin for moderation duties",
       "changed_by": "super_admin_id"
     }
     ```
   - Audit log created
   - User notified: "Your role has been updated to {role}"

5. **Take moderation actions:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/users/[userId]/moderation`
   - Review user's moderation history
   - Available actions:
     - **Warn:** Send warning message
     - **Suspend:** Temporary account suspension
     - **Ban:** Permanent account ban
     - **Unban:** Lift ban
     - **Restrict:** Limit specific features
     - **Clear Flags:** Remove flags/warnings
   - **Warn User:**
     - Select warning reason:
       - Inappropriate behavior
       - Spam/abuse
       - Policy violation
       - Quality concerns
       - Payment issues
       - Communication issues
     - Enter warning message (admin-facing note)
     - Enter user-facing message (visible to user)
     - Severity: Low, Medium, High
     - Click "Send Warning"
     - BE: `POST /v1/admin/users/{userId}/warn`
     - User receives email and in-app notification
     - Warning logged in moderation history
   - **Suspend User:**
     - Select suspension reason
     - Duration: 1 day, 3 days, 7 days, 14 days, 30 days, Custom
     - Restrictions during suspension:
       - Cannot log in (full suspension)
       - OR Cannot post jobs
       - OR Cannot submit proposals
       - OR Cannot message
       - OR Cannot access funds
     - Enter reason (visible to user)
     - Enter internal notes (admin-facing)
     - Click "Suspend Account"
     - BE: `POST /v1/admin/users/{userId}/suspend`
     - Body:
       ```json
       {
         "reason": "SPAM_ABUSE",
         "duration_days": 7,
         "restrictions": ["LOGIN", "POST_JOBS", "SUBMIT_PROPOSALS"],
         "user_message": "Your account has been suspended for 7 days due to spam activity.",
         "internal_notes": "Multiple spam job postings reported",
         "suspended_by": "admin_id"
       }
       ```
     - User receives email: "Your account has been suspended"
     - Cannot log in if LOGIN restriction
     - Suspension expires automatically after duration
   - **Ban User:**
     - Select ban reason:
       - Repeated violations
       - Fraud/scam
       - Illegal activity
       - Severe policy breach
       - Safety concerns
     - Ban type:
       - Permanent
       - With appeal option
     - Enter reason (visible to user)
     - Enter internal notes
     - Confirm: "This action is irreversible" (if permanent)
     - Click "Ban Account"
     - BE: `POST /v1/admin/users/{userId}/ban`
     - User account deactivated
     - All active jobs/proposals/contracts cancelled
     - Funds held in escrow handled per policy
     - User receives email: "Your account has been permanently banned"
     - User can appeal if allowed
   - **Unban User:**
     - Review ban details
     - Enter reason for unban
     - Click "Unban Account"
     - BE: `POST /v1/admin/users/{userId}/unban`
     - Account reactivated
     - User notified: "Your account has been reactivated"
   - **Restrict Features:**
     - Select features to restrict:
       - Job posting (client)
       - Proposal submission (freelancer)
       - Messaging
       - Reviews
       - Withdrawals
       - Connect purchases
     - Duration: Permanent, Temporary (specify)
     - Enter reason
     - Click "Apply Restrictions"
     - BE: `POST /v1/admin/users/{userId}/restrict`
     - User notified of restrictions
   - **Clear Flags:**
     - Review flags/warnings
     - Select flags to clear
     - Enter reason: "False positive", "Resolved", "Other"
     - Click "Clear Flags"
     - BE: `POST /v1/admin/users/{userId}/flags/clear`
     - Flags removed from history
     - Risk score recalculated

6. **View flagged users:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/users/flagged`
   - Display flagged users table:
     - User name, type
     - Risk score (High/Medium/Low)
     - Flags count, reasons
     - Last flagged date
     - Review status (Pending, Under Review, Resolved)
     - Assigned moderator
     - Actions
   - Filters:
     - Risk level
     - Flag reason
     - Review status
     - Date range
   - Sort by: Risk score, Flags count, Date
   - Click "Review" → Navigate to user moderation page

7. **Bulk actions:**
   - Select multiple users (checkboxes)
   - Bulk actions dropdown:
     - Send notification
     - Export selected users (CSV)
     - Apply tag
     - Assign to moderator
     - Mark as reviewed
   - Confirm action
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/users/bulk-action`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "user_ids": ["uuid1", "uuid2", "uuid3"],
       "action": "SEND_NOTIFICATION",
       "payload": {
         "notification_type": "WARNING",
         "message": "Please review our updated community guidelines."
       }
     }
     ```

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **User has active contracts:**
   - Cannot ban if active contracts exist
   - Options:
     - Wait for contracts to complete
     - Cancel contracts with client consent
     - Suspend instead of ban
   - Warning: "User has {count} active contracts"

2. **User has pending payouts:**
   - Cannot ban if pending payouts
   - Options:
     - Complete payouts first
     - Hold payouts pending investigation
     - Cancel payouts (with reason)
   - Warning: "User has ${amount} pending payout"

3. **Role change validation:**
   - Only SUPER_ADMIN can promote to SUPER_ADMIN
   - Cannot demote your own role
   - Error: "You cannot modify your own role"

4. **Email/phone change:**
   - Changing email triggers re-verification
   - Send verification email to new address
   - Old email remains active until verified
   - Changing phone triggers SMS verification

5. **User type change:**
   - Client → Freelancer: Convert profile, hide client data
   - Freelancer → Client: Hide freelancer profile, enable job posting
   - Warn: "This will affect user's access and visibility"

6. **Suspension appeal:**
   - User can submit appeal
   - Admin reviews appeal
   - Options: Uphold, Reduce duration, Lift suspension
   - Reason required

7. **Ban appeal:**
   - If appeal allowed, user submits appeal
   - Admin reviews evidence
   - Options: Uphold, Unban with conditions, Unban fully
   - Reason required

8. **Audit log:**
   - Every action logged
   - Log includes: admin_id, action, user_id, timestamp, reason, details
   - Audit log visible to SUPER_ADMIN only
   - Cannot be deleted

9. **User impersonation (support):**
   - SUPER_ADMIN can impersonate user (for support)
   - Click "Impersonate User"
   - Logged in as user (read-only mode)
   - Banner: "⚠️ Impersonating {user_name}"
   - All actions logged
   - Exit impersonation: Click "Exit"

10. **User merge:**
    - If duplicate accounts detected
    - Merge accounts option
    - Select primary account
    - Merge data: jobs, contracts, messages, reviews
    - Deactivate duplicate account
    - Notify user

11. **Identity verification override:**
    - If verification failed but user seems legitimate
    - SUPER_ADMIN can manually verify
    - Reason required
    - Risk: Logged in audit

12. **Risk score adjustment:**
    - Auto-calculated based on behavior
    - Admin can manually adjust
    - Reason required
    - Example: False flags from competitors

13. **Feature gate management:**
    - Restrict access to beta features
    - Enable premium features
    - Whitelist for experiments

14. **Account recovery:**
    - User locked out
    - Admin can reset password
    - Send recovery link
    - Log action

15. **GDPR/CCPA requests:**
    - User requests data export or deletion
    - Admin reviews and processes
    - Linked from privacy requests module

#### Notifications

**Profile Updated:**
- **Email:** "Your profile has been updated by an admin. [View changes]"
- **In-app:** Notification with details

**Role Changed:**
- **Email:** "Your role has been updated to {role}. [View permissions]"
- **In-app:** Notification

**Warning Issued:**
- **Email:** "⚠️ Warning: {reason}. {message}"
- **In-app:** Banner warning

**Account Suspended:**
- **Email:** "🚫 Your account has been suspended for {duration}. Reason: {reason}. [Appeal]"
- **In-app:** Full-screen modal on login attempt

**Account Banned:**
- **Email:** "🚫 Your account has been permanently banned. Reason: {reason}."
- **In-app:** Full-screen message on login attempt

**Suspension Lifted:**
- **Email:** "✅ Your account suspension has been lifted. You can now access your account."
- **In-app:** Notification

**Ban Lifted:**
- **Email:** "✅ Your account has been reactivated. Welcome back!"
- **In-app:** Notification

**Feature Restricted:**
- **Email:** "⚠️ Some features have been restricted on your account. [Learn more]"
- **In-app:** Banner notification

#### Analytics

- admin.users.list.viewed (admin_id, filters[], result_count)
- admin.users.user.viewed (admin_id, user_id, user_type)
- admin.users.profile.updated (admin_id, user_id, fields_updated[])
- admin.users.role.changed (admin_id, user_id, old_role, new_role, reason)
- admin.users.warned (admin_id, user_id, reason, severity)
- admin.users.suspended (admin_id, user_id, reason, duration_days, restrictions[])
- admin.users.banned (admin_id, user_id, reason, ban_type)
- admin.users.unbanned (admin_id, user_id, reason)
- admin.users.restricted (admin_id, user_id, features[], duration)
- admin.users.flags_cleared (admin_id, user_id, flags_cleared_count)
- admin.users.impersonation.started (admin_id, user_id)
- admin.users.impersonation.ended (admin_id, user_id, duration_seconds)
- admin.users.bulk_action.executed (admin_id, action, user_ids[], success_count, error_count)
- admin.users.flagged.viewed (admin_id, filters[], result_count)
- admin.users.appeal.reviewed (admin_id, user_id, appeal_type, decision)

#### Sources

**Backend:** admin-be.user-stories.md (user management, roles), users-be.user-stories.md (user data, moderation)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/admin/users routes, hooks/admin/use-user-management.ts, components/admin/users/)

## ADM-9: Support Ticket Management

**User Goal:** Manage support tickets, respond to users, track resolution  
**Actor:** Admin (SUPPORT, MANAGER, SUPER_ADMIN)  
**Preconditions:** Admin account with support permissions  
**Triggers:** User submits support ticket, ticket assigned, SLA approaching

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/admin/support` — Support tickets dashboard
- `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets` — Tickets list
- `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets/[ticketId]` — Ticket detail and response
- `(dashboard)/admin/support/analytics` — Support analytics
- `(dashboard)/admin/support/agents` — Support agents management

**Mobile:**
- `admin/support` — Tickets list (read-only)
- `admin/support/tickets/[ticketId]` — Ticket details (read-only)

#### System Touchpoints

- **admin-be:** Ticket management, agent assignment, SLA tracking
- **communications-be:** Ticket messages, email notifications
- **users-be:** User profile, account data
- **notifications-be:** Ticket status notifications
- **storage-be:** Attachment uploads

#### Flow Steps

1. **View support dashboard:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/support`
   - Display overview:
     - **Open Tickets:** Count, % by priority
     - **My Assigned Tickets:** Count, oldest ticket age
     - **Tickets Due Today:** Count, SLA deadline approaching
     - **Avg Resolution Time:** Hours, trend
     - **CSAT Score:** Average rating, trend
     - **Ticket Volume:** Today vs yesterday
   - **Quick Actions:**
     - View my tickets
     - View unassigned
     - View overdue
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/support/dashboard`

2. **View tickets list:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets`
   - Display tickets table:
     - Ticket ID, Subject
     - User (name, type, email)
     - Category (Account, Payment, Technical, General)
     - Priority (Urgent, High, Normal, Low)
     - Status (New, In Progress, Waiting on User, Resolved, Closed)
     - Assigned agent (or "Unassigned")
     - Created date, Last updated
     - SLA deadline (time remaining)
     - Unread messages indicator
   - Filters:
     - Status (all, open, assigned to me, unassigned, resolved)
     - Priority (urgent, high, normal, low)
     - Category
     - Agent (assigned to)
     - Date range
     - SLA status (on track, at risk, overdue)
   - Search: Ticket ID, subject, user email
   - Sort: Created date, Priority, SLA deadline, Last updated
   - Color coding:
     - Red: Overdue SLA
     - Orange: SLA < 2 hours
     - Green: On track
   - Pagination: 50 tickets per page
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/support/tickets?status=OPEN&assigned_to=me&page=1`

3. **View ticket details:**
   - Click on ticket row
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/support/tickets/[ticketId]`
   - **Ticket Header:**
     - Ticket ID, Status badge
     - Subject
     - Priority badge
     - Category badge
     - Created date, Last updated
     - SLA: Time remaining (green/orange/red)
     - Assigned to: Agent name (or "Unassigned")
     - Actions: Assign, Change priority, Close, Escalate
   - **User Info Sidebar:**
     - Avatar, name, email
     - User type (Client/Freelancer)
     - Account status
     - Registration date
     - Total tickets submitted
     - Quick links: View profile, View transactions, View jobs
   - **Conversation Thread:**
     - All messages in chronological order
     - User messages (left-aligned, gray)
     - Agent responses (right-aligned, blue)
     - System messages (center, italic, gray)
     - Attachments (images, PDFs displayed inline)
     - Timestamps (relative time, hover for absolute)
   - **Reply Section:**
     - Text editor (rich text, markdown support)
     - Attachments (drag-and-drop or browse)
     - Canned responses dropdown (templates)
     - Internal note checkbox (visible only to agents)
     - Status change dropdown
     - Send button
   - **Ticket History:**
     - Status changes
     - Priority changes
     - Agent assignments
     - Category changes
     - Resolution notes
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}`

4. **Respond to ticket:**
   - In reply section, compose message
   - **Use canned response (optional):**
     - Click "Canned Responses" dropdown
     - Select template (e.g., "Account Verification Help")
     - Template text inserted
     - Customize as needed
   - **Add attachments (optional):**
     - Click "Attach" or drag files
     - Max 10MB per file, 5 files total
     - Supported: images, PDF, DOC, XLS
     - Upload to storage-be
   - **Set status:**
     - Keep status (In Progress)
     - OR Change to: Waiting on User, Resolved, Closed
   - **Internal note (optional):**
     - Check "Internal note" checkbox
     - Note visible only to support team
   - Click "Send"
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}/messages`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "message": "Hello, I've reviewed your account...",
       "attachments": ["uuid1", "uuid2"],
       "status": "WAITING_ON_USER",
       "is_internal": false,
       "agent_id": "admin_uuid"
     }
     ```
   - Message appears in thread
   - User receives email notification
   - Ticket status updated
   - Last updated timestamp refreshed

5. **Assign ticket:**
   - Click "Assign" in ticket header
   - Select agent from dropdown:
     - List of available agents
     - Show current workload (tickets assigned)
     - Show availability status
     - Option: "Auto-assign" (system chooses based on workload)
   - Add assignment note (optional)
   - Click "Assign"
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}/assign`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "agent_id": "agent_uuid",
       "note": "Assigned due to payment expertise",
       "assigned_by": "manager_uuid"
     }
     ```
   - Ticket assigned
   - Agent receives notification
   - Ticket moves to agent's queue
   - Assignment logged in history

6. **Change priority:**
   - Click "Change Priority"
   - Select: Urgent, High, Normal, Low
   - Add reason (required for Urgent)
   - Click "Update"
   - BE: `PATCH /v1/admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}/priority`
   - Priority badge updated
   - SLA deadline adjusted
   - If Urgent: Manager notified

7. **Resolve ticket:**
   - After resolving user's issue, change status to "Resolved"
   - Add resolution summary (required):
     - What was the issue?
     - How was it resolved?
     - Any follow-up needed?
   - Add resolution category:
     - Account verified
     - Payment processed
     - Bug fixed
     - User educated
     - Escalated to engineering
     - Other
   - Click "Mark as Resolved"
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}/resolve`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "resolution_summary": "Verified user's identity and unlocked account.",
       "resolution_category": "ACCOUNT_VERIFIED",
       "resolved_by": "agent_uuid",
       "resolution_time_minutes": 35
     }
     ```
   - Ticket status: "Resolved"
   - User receives email: "Your ticket has been resolved. [Was this helpful? Rate your experience]"
   - CSAT survey link included
   - Ticket auto-closes after 7 days if no response

8. **Close ticket:**
   - Click "Close Ticket"
   - Confirm: "Are you sure? This ticket will be marked as closed."
   - Click "Confirm"
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}/close`
   - Ticket status: "Closed"
   - Cannot be reopened (user must submit new ticket)
   - Archived in ticket history

9. **Escalate ticket:**
   - Click "Escalate"
   - Select escalation reason:
     - Technical issue (engineering needed)
     - Policy decision (management needed)
     - Complex case (senior agent needed)
     - Legal/compliance issue
   - Add escalation note (required)
   - Select escalation target:
     - Engineering team
     - Management
     - Senior support
     - Legal/compliance
   - Click "Escalate"
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}/escalate`
   - Ticket priority auto-set to "High"
   - Assigned to escalation target
   - Original agent remains cc'd
   - Escalation team notified

10. **View support analytics:**
    - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/support/analytics`
    - Display metrics:
      - **Ticket Volume:**
        - Total tickets (today, this week, this month)
        - Trend chart (daily/weekly/monthly)
        - By category breakdown
      - **Resolution Metrics:**
        - Average resolution time
        - Median resolution time
        - First response time (avg, median)
        - SLA compliance rate
      - **Agent Performance:**
        - Tickets resolved per agent
        - Avg resolution time per agent
        - CSAT score per agent
        - Workload distribution
      - **Customer Satisfaction:**
        - Overall CSAT score
        - CSAT by category
        - CSAT by agent
        - CSAT trend
      - **Status Distribution:**
        - Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed (%)
        - By priority (Urgent, High, Normal, Low)
      - **Response Time:**
        - First response time (avg, P50, P95)
        - Subsequent response time
        - By priority level
    - Filters: Date range, Category, Agent, Priority
    - Export: CSV, PDF
    - BE: `GET /v1/admin/support/analytics?period=30d`

11. **Manage canned responses:**
    - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/support/settings/canned-responses`
    - View list of templates
    - Create new template:
      - Title (e.g., "Password Reset Instructions")
      - Category (Account, Payment, Technical, General)
      - Content (with placeholders: {{user_name}}, {{ticket_id}})
      - Tags (for search)
    - Edit existing template
    - Delete template (MANAGER only)
    - BE: `POST /v1/admin/support/canned-responses`

12. **Manage support agents:**
    - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/support/agents`
    - View agents list:
      - Agent name, email
      - Status (Online, Busy, Offline)
      - Current workload (tickets assigned)
      - Tickets resolved (today, this week)
      - Avg resolution time
      - CSAT score
    - Add new agent:
      - Select user
      - Assign role: SUPPORT
      - Set permissions
    - Update agent status
    - View agent performance details
    - BE: `GET /v1/admin/support/agents`

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **SLA breach:**
   - Ticket not resolved within SLA
   - Status: "Overdue"
   - Red indicator
   - Auto-escalate to manager
   - Manager notified: "Ticket #{ticket_id} is overdue by {hours} hours"

2. **User reopens resolved ticket:**
   - User replies to resolved ticket
   - Status auto-changes: Resolved → In Progress
   - Ticket reassigned to original agent
   - Agent notified: "Ticket #{ticket_id} has been reopened"

3. **Auto-close resolved tickets:**
   - Batch job runs daily
   - Tickets in "Resolved" status > 7 days with no user response
   - Auto-change status: Resolved → Closed
   - User notified: "Your ticket has been automatically closed"

4. **Multiple agents responding:**
   - If multiple agents open ticket simultaneously
   - Lock mechanism: "Agent {name} is currently viewing this ticket"
   - Prevent duplicate responses

5. **Agent unavailable:**
   - Assigned agent goes offline
   - Manager can reassign
   - System suggests: "Agent offline. Reassign?"

6. **Ticket merge:**
   - User submits duplicate tickets
   - Support can merge tickets
   - Select primary ticket
   - Other tickets marked as "Merged into #{primary_id}"
   - Combined conversation thread

7. **Ticket split:**
   - Ticket contains multiple issues
   - Support can split into separate tickets
   - Select messages for new ticket
   - Create new ticket with selected messages
   - Original ticket updated

8. **Attachment virus scan:**
   - User uploads attachment
   - System scans for viruses
   - If infected: Reject upload, warn user
   - If clean: Allow upload

9. **CSAT survey:**
   - After ticket resolved, user receives CSAT survey
   - Questions:
     - "How satisfied were you with the support?" (1-5 stars)
     - "How likely are you to recommend Skillsier?" (0-10 NPS)
     - "Any additional feedback?" (optional text)
   - Submit survey
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/support/tickets/{ticketId}/csat`
   - Results visible in analytics

10. **Internal escalation notes:**
    - Agent can add internal notes
    - Not visible to user
    - Example: "User seems frustrated, handle with care"
    - Visible to other agents working on ticket

11. **Ticket templates (user-facing):**
    - When user submits ticket, select category
    - System suggests template based on category
    - Example: "Payment Issue" → Fields: Transaction ID, Amount, Date
    - Improves ticket quality

12. **Automated responses:**
    - For common issues, system sends automated response
    - Example: "Password reset" → Auto-send reset link
    - Status: "Auto-resolved"
    - User can reply if issue persists

13. **VIP user handling:**
    - High-value users flagged as VIP
    - Tickets from VIP users:
      - Auto-set priority: High
      - Assigned to senior agent
      - SLA: 2 hours (vs 24 hours standard)
      - Manager notified

14. **Off-hours support:**
    - Tickets submitted outside business hours
    - Auto-reply: "Thank you for contacting us. We'll respond within 24 hours."
    - Can enable after-hours on-call support

15. **Multi-language support:**
    - Ticket submitted in non-English language
    - System detects language
    - Auto-translate for agent
    - Agent response auto-translated for user
    - Translation disclaimer shown

#### Notifications

**Ticket Assigned:**
- **Email:** "You've been assigned ticket #{ticket_id}: {subject}. [View ticket]"
- **Push:** "New ticket assigned"
- **In-app:** Notification with link

**Ticket Escalated:**
- **Email:** "Ticket #{ticket_id} has been escalated to you. Priority: {priority}. [View ticket]"
- **Push:** "Ticket escalated"

**SLA Warning:**
- **Email:** "⚠️ Ticket #{ticket_id} SLA approaching (2 hours remaining). [View ticket]"
- **Push:** "SLA warning"
- **In-app:** Red indicator on ticket

**SLA Breached:**
- **Email (to Manager):** "🚨 SLA breached for ticket #{ticket_id}. Overdue by {hours} hours. [View ticket]"
- **Slack:** Alert in #support-alerts channel (if configured)

**User Replied:**
- **Email (to Assigned Agent):** "User replied to ticket #{ticket_id}: {subject}. [View ticket]"
- **Push:** "New reply on ticket #{ticket_id}"
- **In-app:** Unread indicator

**Ticket Resolved (to User):**
- **Email:** "Your ticket #{ticket_id} has been resolved. [Was this helpful? Rate your experience]"
- **Push:** "Ticket resolved"
- **In-app:** Notification

**Ticket Auto-Closed (to User):**
- **Email:** "Your ticket #{ticket_id} has been automatically closed. You can submit a new ticket if you need further assistance."

#### Analytics

- admin.support.dashboard.viewed (agent_id)
- admin.support.tickets.viewed (agent_id, filters[], result_count)
- admin.support.ticket.viewed (agent_id, ticket_id, ticket_status)
- admin.support.ticket.responded (agent_id, ticket_id, response_time_minutes)
- admin.support.ticket.assigned (manager_id, ticket_id, agent_id)
- admin.support.ticket.priority_changed (agent_id, ticket_id, old_priority, new_priority)
- admin.support.ticket.resolved (agent_id, ticket_id, resolution_time_minutes, resolution_category)
- admin.support.ticket.closed (agent_id, ticket_id)
- admin.support.ticket.escalated (agent_id, ticket_id, escalation_reason, escalation_target)
- admin.support.ticket.reopened (ticket_id, reopened_by)
- admin.support.csat.submitted (ticket_id, rating, nps_score)
- admin.support.analytics.viewed (agent_id, period, metrics_viewed[])
- admin.support.canned_response.used (agent_id, response_id, ticket_id)
- admin.support.agents.viewed (manager_id)

#### Sources

**Backend:** admin-be.user-stories.md (support tickets, agents, KPIs)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/admin/support routes, hooks/admin/use-support.ts, components/admin/support/)
