## ADM-10: System Configuration & Settings

**User Goal:** Configure platform settings, manage feature flags, system parameters  
**Actor:** Admin (SUPER_ADMIN only)  
**Preconditions:** Super admin account  
**Triggers:** System configuration change needed, feature rollout, emergency toggle

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/admin/settings` — Settings overview
- `(dashboard)/admin/settings/general` — General platform settings
- `(dashboard)/admin/settings/features` — Feature flags management
- `(dashboard)/admin/settings/integrations` — Third-party integrations
- `(dashboard)/admin/settings/billing` — Billing configuration
- `(dashboard)/admin/settings/email` — Email templates and settings
- `(dashboard)/admin/settings/security` — Security parameters

**Mobile:**
- Not available (SUPER_ADMIN only, desktop required)

#### System Touchpoints

- **admin-be:** System configuration, feature flags
- **auth-be:** Security settings, session parameters
- **notifications-be:** Email templates, notification settings
- **financial-be:** Payment gateway configuration, fee structure
- **storage-be:** Storage quotas, CDN settings
- **All backend services:** Feature flag checks, config overrides

#### Flow Steps

1. **View settings overview:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/settings`
   - Display settings categories:
     - **General:** Platform name, logo, contact info
     - **Features:** Feature flags, beta features
     - **Integrations:** Payment gateways, email providers, cloud storage
     - **Billing:** Fee structure, commission rates, payment schedules
     - **Email:** Templates, sender info, SMTP settings
     - **Security:** Password policies, session timeout, 2FA requirements
     - **Legal:** Terms of service, privacy policy versions
     - **Maintenance:** Maintenance mode, system announcements
   - Quick stats:
     - Active features
     - Pending config changes
     - Last updated by/when
   - BE: `GET /v1/admin/settings`

2. **Manage general settings:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/settings/general`
   - **Platform Info:**
     - Platform name (editable)
     - Tagline (editable)
     - Logo (upload new)
     - Favicon (upload new)
     - Support email (editable)
     - Support phone (editable)
     - Company address
   - **Regional Settings:**
     - Default language
     - Supported languages (multi-select)
     - Default currency
     - Supported currencies
     - Default timezone
   - **Business Hours:**
     - Support hours (Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm)
     - Business days (Mon-Fri)
     - Holidays (list)
   - Click "Save Changes"
   - BE: `PATCH /v1/admin/settings/general`

3. **Manage feature flags:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/settings/features`
   - Display features list:
     - Feature name
     - Description
     - Status (Enabled/Disabled/Percentage rollout)
     - Rollout percentage (0-100%)
     - Target audience (All, Beta users, Specific users)
     - Environment (Production, Staging, Development)
     - Last updated by/when
     - Actions (Toggle, Edit)
   - **Add new feature flag:**
     - Click "Add Feature"
     - Enter:
       - Feature key (e.g., `ai_proposal_assistant`)
       - Display name
       - Description
       - Initial status (Disabled by default)
       - Rollout strategy:
         - **All users:** 100% rollout
         - **Percentage:** e.g., 10% of users
         - **User list:** Specific user IDs
         - **User attributes:** e.g., User type = Freelancer
     - Click "Create"
   - **Toggle feature:**
     - Click toggle switch
     - Confirm: "Enable/Disable {feature_name}?"
     - BE: `PATCH /v1/admin/settings/features/{featureKey}`
     - Body:
       ```json
       {
         "enabled": true,
         "rollout_percentage": 50,
         "target_audience": "BETA_USERS",
         "changed_by": "super_admin_id"
       }
       ```
     - Feature status updated instantly
     - All services receive updated flag via config service
   - **Gradual rollout:**
     - Select feature
     - Click "Edit Rollout"
     - Set percentage: 10% → 25% → 50% → 100%
     - Monitor metrics after each increase
     - Rollback if issues detected
   - **Emergency killswitch:**
     - For critical bugs, instantly disable feature
     - Click "Disable All Rollouts"
     - Confirm: "This will disable {feature} for ALL users"
     - Feature disabled immediately

4. **Manage integrations:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/settings/integrations`
   - **Payment Gateways:**
     - Stripe:
       - Status (Active/Inactive)
       - API keys (Publishable, Secret)
       - Webhook URL
       - Test mode toggle
       - Connected account
     - PayPal:
       - Status
       - Client ID, Secret
       - Webhook URL
     - Configure: Click "Configure" → Enter API keys → Test connection → Save
   - **Email Provider:**
     - SendGrid:
       - API key
       - Sender email
       - Sender name
       - Verified domain
       - Template IDs
     - SMTP:
       - Host, port
       - Username, password
       - TLS/SSL
     - Test: Send test email → Verify receipt → Save
   - **Cloud Storage:**
     - AWS S3:
       - Bucket name
       - Region
       - Access key ID, Secret key
       - CDN domain (CloudFront)
     - Google Cloud Storage:
       - Bucket name
       - Service account JSON key
   - **OAuth Providers:**
     - Google:
       - Client ID, Secret
       - Redirect URI
       - Enabled scopes
     - LinkedIn:
       - Client ID, Secret
       - Redirect URI
   - **Analytics:**
     - Google Analytics:
       - Tracking ID
       - Property ID
     - Mixpanel:
       - Project token
   - **Webhooks:**
     - Slack:
       - Webhook URL
       - Channel (e.g., #alerts)
       - Events to send
     - Custom webhooks:
       - URL, headers, payload template
   - BE: `PATCH /v1/admin/settings/integrations/{provider}`

5. **Configure billing settings:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/settings/billing`
   - **Fee Structure:**
     - Platform commission:
       - Client fee: 5% (editable)
       - Freelancer fee: 10% (editable)
       - Minimum fee: $1.00
       - Maximum fee: $100.00
     - Connect pricing:
       - 1 connect = $1.50 (editable)
       - Bulk discounts: 40 connects → 10% off, 80 → 20% off
   - **Payment Schedules:**
     - Freelancer payout frequency:
       - Weekly (Fridays)
       - Bi-weekly
       - Monthly
     - Minimum payout amount: $50.00
     - Payout method: Bank transfer, PayPal
   - **Tax Settings:**
     - Collect tax info: W9/W8 required
     - 1099 threshold: $600/year
     - Tax ID required for > $600/year
   - **Refund Policy:**
     - Refund window: 7 days
     - Refund fee: $5.00 or 3%, whichever higher
     - Auto-refund conditions: Job closed before hire, spam job
   - BE: `PATCH /v1/admin/settings/billing`

6. **Manage email templates:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/settings/email`
   - **Transactional Emails:**
     - Welcome email
     - Email verification
     - Password reset
     - Payment receipt
     - Contract milestone
     - Dispute notification
   - **Marketing Emails:**
     - Newsletter
     - Product updates
     - Feature announcements
   - **Select template:**
     - Click template name
     - View current version
     - Edit HTML/text content
     - Use variables: `{{user_name}}`, `{{amount}}`, `{{link}}`
     - Preview email (desktop, mobile)
     - Send test email
     - Save changes
     - Version history (track changes)
   - **Email Settings:**
     - From name: "Skillsier Support"
     - From email: support@skillsier.com
     - Reply-to email
     - Unsubscribe link (required for marketing)
   - BE: `PATCH /v1/admin/settings/email/templates/{templateId}`

7. **Configure security settings:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/settings/security`
   - **Password Policy:**
     - Minimum length: 8 characters (editable)
     - Require: Uppercase, lowercase, number, special char
     - Password expiry: 90 days (or never)
     - Password history: Cannot reuse last 5 passwords
   - **Session Management:**
     - Session timeout: 30 minutes (editable)
     - Remember me: 30 days
     - Max concurrent sessions: 3
     - Force logout on password change: Yes/No
   - **Two-Factor Authentication:**
     - Require 2FA for admins: Yes/No
     - Require 2FA for high-value transactions: Yes/No
     - Supported methods: SMS, Authenticator app, Email
   - **IP Whitelisting:**
     - Admin access restricted to whitelisted IPs: Yes/No
     - Whitelist IPs: (list)
   - **Rate Limiting:**
     - Login attempts: 5 per 15 minutes
     - API requests: 1000 per hour per user
     - Password reset: 3 per hour
   - **Audit Log Retention:**
     - Retain audit logs: 10 years (compliance requirement)
     - Export option: CSV, JSON
   - BE: `PATCH /v1/admin/settings/security`

8. **Maintenance mode:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/settings/maintenance`
   - **Enable Maintenance Mode:**
     - Toggle on
     - Maintenance message: "We're performing scheduled maintenance. We'll be back soon!"
     - Estimated downtime: 2 hours (optional)
     - Allow admin access: Yes (admins can still log in)
     - Scheduled start: Now or future date/time
     - Auto-disable after: 4 hours (safety)
   - Click "Enable Maintenance Mode"
   - All users see maintenance page
   - Existing sessions logged out
   - API returns 503 Service Unavailable
   - **Disable Maintenance Mode:**
     - Click "Disable"
     - Platform immediately accessible
     - Users notified: "Maintenance complete. You can now log in."
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/settings/maintenance`

9. **System announcements:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/admin/settings/announcements`
   - **Create Announcement:**
     - Title: e.g., "New feature: AI Proposal Assistant"
     - Message: "We've launched a new AI-powered proposal assistant..."
     - Type: Info, Warning, Success, Error
     - Target audience: All users, Clients, Freelancers, Specific users
     - Display: Banner, Modal, Notification
     - Start date/time
     - End date/time (optional, announcement auto-expires)
     - Dismissible: Yes/No
   - Click "Publish"
   - Announcement visible to target audience
   - **Edit/Delete Announcement:**
     - Click announcement in list
     - Edit details or click "Delete"
   - BE: `POST /v1/admin/settings/announcements`

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Feature flag rollback:**
   - Feature causes issues
   - Instant rollback: Disable feature
   - All services immediately stop using feature
   - Users see old behavior
   - Audit log tracks rollback

2. **Invalid configuration:**
   - Validation errors on save
   - Example: Invalid API key format
   - Error: "API key format invalid"
   - Highlight field
   - Cannot save until fixed

3. **Integration test failure:**
   - Test connection fails
   - Error: "Connection failed. Check API keys and network."
   - Show error details
   - Retry option

4. **Email send test failure:**
   - Test email not received
   - Check spam folder
   - Verify sender email domain
   - Check SendGrid/SMTP logs

5. **Maintenance mode edge case:**
   - Maintenance mode enabled, but user in middle of transaction
   - Graceful handling: Complete transaction, then show maintenance
   - OR: Show warning: "Maintenance starting in 5 minutes. Please complete your actions."

6. **Fee structure change:**
   - Changing fees affects active contracts
   - Warning: "This will affect {count} active contracts. Confirm?"
   - Option: Apply to new contracts only
   - Option: Apply to all (requires client consent)

7. **Feature flag gradual rollout:**
   - Start: 10% of users
   - Monitor error rates, performance
   - If no issues: Increase to 25%, 50%, 100%
   - If issues: Rollback to 0%

8. **Security setting enforcement:**
   - Password policy strengthened
   - All users prompted to update password at next login
   - Cannot proceed until updated

9. **Email template broken:**
   - Variables missing or incorrect
   - Preview shows errors
   - Cannot save until fixed

10. **Audit log export:**
    - Large export (10GB+)
    - Generate in background
    - Email download link when ready
    - Link expires after 7 days

11. **Configuration backup:**
    - Auto-backup before any changes
    - Restore option: "Restore to {backup_date}"
    - Compare versions: Show diff

12. **Emergency config override:**
    - Critical bug requires instant config change
    - Bypass normal approval process
    - Audit log tracks emergency override
    - Alert sent to all admins

13. **Feature flag dependency:**
    - Feature B depends on Feature A
    - Cannot enable B without A
    - Error: "Enable {feature A} first"

14. **Integration downtime:**
    - Payment gateway down
    - Fallback to secondary gateway
    - Banner: "Payment processing may be slower than usual"

15. **Multi-environment sync:**
    - Change in staging
    - Option: "Push to production"
    - Confirm: "This will update production config"
    - Audit log tracks push

#### Notifications

**Configuration Changed:**
- **Email (to all admins):** "System configuration updated by {admin_name}. Changes: {summary}. [View audit log]"
- **Slack:** Alert in #admin-alerts channel

**Feature Flag Changed:**
- **Email (to tech team):** "Feature flag '{feature}' changed to {status} by {admin_name}. [View details]"

**Maintenance Mode Enabled:**
- **Email (to all users):** "Scheduled maintenance: {start_time} to {end_time}. Platform will be unavailable."
- **Push:** "Maintenance scheduled"
- **Banner:** 24 hours before, 1 hour before, 5 minutes before

**Maintenance Mode Disabled:**
- **Email (to all users):** "Maintenance complete. Platform is now available."
- **Push:** "Platform back online"

**Integration Test Failed:**
- **Email (to super admin):** "⚠️ Integration test failed for {provider}. [Check settings]"
- **Slack:** Alert

**Security Setting Changed:**
- **Email (to all admins):** "Security settings updated by {admin_name}. [View changes]"
- **Audit log:** Detailed log entry

**System Announcement Published:**
- **Push (to target users):** "{announcement_title}"
- **Banner:** Displayed on dashboard
- **In-app:** Modal (if configured)

#### Analytics

- admin.settings.viewed (admin_id, section)
- admin.settings.general.updated (admin_id, fields_updated[])
- admin.settings.feature.toggled (admin_id, feature_key, old_status, new_status)
- admin.settings.feature.rollout_changed (admin_id, feature_key, old_percentage, new_percentage)
- admin.settings.integration.configured (admin_id, provider, test_success)
- admin.settings.billing.updated (admin_id, fields_updated[])
- admin.settings.email_template.updated (admin_id, template_id)
- admin.settings.security.updated (admin_id, fields_updated[])
- admin.settings.maintenance.enabled (admin_id, duration_hours)
- admin.settings.maintenance.disabled (admin_id)
- admin.settings.announcement.published (admin_id, announcement_id, target_audience)
- admin.settings.config.backed_up (admin_id, backup_size_mb)
- admin.settings.config.restored (admin_id, backup_id)

#### Sources

**Backend:** admin-be.user-stories.md (system configuration, feature flags)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/admin/settings routes, hooks/admin/use-settings.ts, components/admin/settings/)

# SECTION M: SUBSCRIPTIONS & FEATURE GATING

### **SUB-1: VIEW & COMPARE PLANS**

**Journey Code:** SUB-1  
**User Goal:** Compare subscription plans to find the best tier for my needs  
**Preconditions:** Guest or registered user  
**Triggers:** Visiting pricing page, upgrade prompts, marketing campaigns

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(public)/pricing` — Public pricing comparison page
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions` — Current subscription dashboard
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/plans` — Plan comparison (logged in)
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/upgrade` — Upgrade flow

**Mobile:**
- `pricing` — Pricing page
- `subscriptions` — Subscription dashboard
- `subscriptions/plans` — Plan comparison
- `subscriptions/upgrade` — Upgrade flow

#### System Touchpoints

- **subscriptions-be:** Plan catalog, pricing, features, limits
- **financial-be:** Payment processing for subscriptions
- **entitlements-be:** Feature access validation
- **notifications-be:** Plan change notifications

#### Flow Steps

1. **View plans:**
   - Navigate to `(public)/pricing` or `(dashboard)/subscriptions/plans`
   - Display plan comparison table:
     - **FREE:** $0/month
       - 5 job posts/month
       - 10 connects/month
       - 15 proposals/month
       - Basic profile
       - Community support
     - **BASIC:** $9.99/month
       - 20 job posts/month
       - 50 connects/month
       - 50 proposals/month
       - Enhanced profile
       - Priority search ranking
       - Email support
     - **PLUS:** $29.99/month
       - Unlimited job posts
       - 150 connects/month
       - Unlimited proposals
       - Featured profile badge
       - Advanced analytics
       - Priority support
       - Project management tools
     - **PRO:** $49.99/month
       - Everything in Plus
       - 300 connects/month
       - AI proposal assistant
       - Dedicated account manager
       - API access
       - White-label reports
       - Team collaboration (up to 5 seats)
     - **ENTERPRISE:** Custom pricing
       - Everything in Pro
       - Unlimited connects
       - Custom integrations
       - SLA guarantees
       - Dedicated support team
       - Unlimited seats
   - Show annual billing option: "Save 20% with annual billing"
   - BE: `GET /v1/subscriptions/plans`

2. **Compare features:**
   - Interactive comparison table
   - Hover over features for tooltip explanations
   - Filter by user type (Freelancer/Client)
   - Highlight most popular: "Most Popular: PLUS" badge
   - Show savings: "Save $72/year with annual billing"
   - Calculate custom pricing for Enterprise
   - BE: `GET /v1/subscriptions/plans?compare=true`

3. **View current plan (if logged in):**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/subscriptions`
   - Display:
     - Current plan name and tier
     - Billing cycle (Monthly/Yearly)
     - Next billing date
     - Amount to be charged
     - Payment method
     - Connects balance (150/300)
     - Usage this month:
       - Job posts: 15/unlimited
       - Proposals: 45/unlimited
       - Connects used: 50
     - Plan features (checkmarks)
     - Upgrade/downgrade CTA
   - BE: `GET /v1/subscriptions/current`
   - BE: `GET /v1/entitlements`
   - BE: `GET /v1/connects/balance`

4. **Calculate upgrade cost:**
   - Click "Upgrade to Plus"
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/subscriptions/upgrade`
   - Display:
     - Current plan: Basic ($9.99/month)
     - New plan: Plus ($29.99/month)
     - Proration:
       - Days remaining in current cycle: 15
       - Credit for unused Basic: -$5.00
       - Plus plan (prorated): +$15.00
       - **Total due today:** $10.00
     - Next bill: $29.99 on Dec 1, 2025
     - New features unlocked immediately
   - BE: `POST /v1/subscriptions/calculate-proration`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "current_plan_id": "uuid",
       "new_plan_id": "uuid",
       "effective_date": "2025-11-07"
     }
     ```

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Annual vs Monthly pricing:**
   - Toggle billing cycle
   - Recalculate all prices
   - Show annual savings: "Save $72/year"
   - Highlight annual discount: "20% off"

2. **Free trial eligible:**
   - New users get 14-day Pro trial free
   - Banner: "Start your free 14-day Pro trial!"
   - No credit card required
   - Auto-converts to selected plan after trial
   - Email reminder 3 days before trial ends

3. **Promotional pricing:**
   - Apply promo code: "LAUNCH50"
   - Validation:
     - Code exists and active
     - User eligible (new subscribers only)
     - Not expired
   - Show discount: "50% off first 3 months"
   - Adjusted price: $14.99 (was $29.99)
   - Terms: "Regular price $29.99/month after 3 months"

4. **Plan restrictions:**
   - Clients cannot downgrade to FREE (must have Basic minimum)
   - Agencies require PRO or ENTERPRISE
   - Warning: "This plan is not available for Client accounts"

5. **Feature comparison details:**
   - Click feature name for detailed explanation
   - Modal with:
     - Feature description
     - Usage examples
     - Limitations per plan
     - Video tutorial (if available)

6. **Usage warnings:**
   - Current usage exceeds new plan limits
   - Warning: "You've posted 25 jobs this month. BASIC allows only 20. Choose PLUS for unlimited."
   - Cannot downgrade until usage drops

7. **Grandfathered plans:**
   - User on old "PREMIUM" plan (no longer offered)
   - Display: "PREMIUM (Legacy) — $39.99/month"
   - Note: "This plan is no longer available to new subscribers"
   - Can upgrade but not downgrade to legacy

8. **Enterprise inquiry:**
   - Click "Contact Sales" for Enterprise
   - Form:
     - Company name
     - Team size
     - Use case
     - Expected monthly usage
     - Custom requirements
   - Submit → Sales team notified
   - Email: "Thank you! Our team will contact you within 24 hours."

9. **FAQs:**
   - Expandable FAQ section
   - Common questions:
     - "Can I change plans anytime?" → Yes, instant upgrades, downgrades at period end
     - "What happens to my connects?" → Carried over, expire after 12 months
     - "Is there a contract?" → No, cancel anytime
     - "What payment methods?" → Card, PayPal, ACH (Enterprise)

10. **Plan recommendations:**
    - AI-driven: "Based on your usage, we recommend PLUS"
    - Factors:
      - Historical usage patterns
      - Industry benchmarks
      - Team size
      - Growth trajectory
    - CTA: "See why we recommend Plus"

11. **Team/seat pricing:**
    - PRO includes 5 seats
    - Additional seats: $9.99/seat/month
    - Calculator: "How many team members? → 8 → Total: $49.99 + $29.97 = $79.96/month"

12. **Add-ons preview:**
    - Priority support: +$19.99/month
    - Featured profile: +$14.99/month
    - API access: +$49.99/month
    - Available for PLUS and PRO

13. **Money-back guarantee:**
    - Badge: "30-day money-back guarantee"
    - Terms: "Not satisfied? Cancel within 30 days for a full refund"

14. **Social proof:**
    - "Join 50,000+ freelancers on Skillsier"
    - Testimonials from each tier
    - Case studies linked

15. **Plan change preview:**
    - "Preview changes" button
    - Shows before/after comparison
    - Highlights new features
    - Lists deprecated features (if downgrading)

#### Notifications

**Plan Viewed:**
- **Analytics:** Track plan_viewed event (plan_id, tier, billing_cycle)

**Upgrade Started:**
- **Analytics:** Track upgrade_initiated (from_plan, to_plan)

**Trial Started:**
- **Email:** "Your 14-day Pro trial has started! Explore all features."
- **Push:** "Pro trial activated"

**Trial Ending:**
- **Email (3 days before):** "Your Pro trial ends in 3 days. Subscribe to keep your features."
- **Push (1 day before):** "Pro trial ends tomorrow"

#### Analytics

- subscriptions.plans.viewed (user_id, plans_compared[], source)
- subscriptions.plan.compared (user_id, plan_ids[], feature_clicked)
- subscriptions.upgrade.initiated (user_id, from_plan, to_plan, source)
- subscriptions.promo.applied (user_id, promo_code, discount_amount)
- subscriptions.trial.started (user_id, trial_plan, trial_days)
- subscriptions.enterprise.inquiry (company_name, team_size, use_case)
- subscriptions.faq.clicked (user_id, question)
- subscriptions.recommendation.shown (user_id, recommended_plan, reason)

#### Sources

**Backend:** subscriptions-be.user-stories.md (plan catalog, pricing, proration)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/subscriptions routes, hooks/subscriptions/use-plans.ts, components/subscriptions/plan-comparison.tsx)

### **SUB-2: SUBSCRIBE / UPGRADE PLAN**

**Journey Code:** SUB-2  
**User Goal:** Subscribe to a plan or upgrade from current tier  
**Preconditions:** Registered user with verified payment method  
**Triggers:** Selecting plan from comparison page, upgrade prompt, trial expiration

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/subscribe` — Initial subscription flow
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/upgrade` — Upgrade flow
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/confirm` — Confirmation page
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/success` — Success page

**Mobile:**
- `subscriptions/subscribe` — Subscribe flow
- `subscriptions/upgrade` — Upgrade flow
- `subscriptions/confirm` — Confirmation
- `subscriptions/success` — Success

#### System Touchpoints

- **subscriptions-be:** Subscription creation, plan changes, proration
- **financial-be:** Payment processing, invoicing
- **entitlements-be:** Feature grants, limit updates
- **notifications-be:** Subscription confirmations, receipts
- **auth-be:** Role/permission updates for plan features

#### Flow Steps

1. **Select plan:**
   - From pricing page, click "Subscribe to Plus" or "Upgrade to Plus"
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/subscriptions/subscribe` or `.../upgrade`
   - Display plan summary:
     - Plan name: Plus
     - Billing cycle: Monthly ($29.99/month) or Yearly ($287.88/year, save $72)
     - Features included (expandable list)
     - Connects grant: 150/month
   - Select billing cycle (toggle)
   - Apply promo code (optional)

2. **Review proration (if upgrade):**
   - Display proration calculation:
     - Current plan: Basic ($9.99/month)
     - Days remaining: 15
     - Credit for unused time: -$5.00
     - New plan (prorated for 15 days): +$15.00
     - **Total due today:** $10.00
   - Next bill: $29.99 on Dec 1, 2025
   - Note: "Your new features are available immediately after payment"
   - BE: `POST /v1/subscriptions/calculate-proration`

3. **Payment method:**
   - Select payment method:
     - Default card: •••• 4242 (Visa)
     - Add new card
   - If no payment method:
     - Redirect to add payment method
     - Return to subscription flow
   - For annual: Option for ACH/wire transfer (Enterprise only)

4. **Review order:**
   - Order summary:
     - Plan: Plus (Monthly)
     - Connects/month: 150
     - Promo: LAUNCH50 applied (-$15.00)
     - Subtotal: $29.99
     - Discount: -$15.00
     - Tax (if applicable): +$1.20
     - **Total due today:** $16.19
   - Next bill: $29.99 on Dec 7, 2025
   - Auto-renewal: Enabled (toggle off if desired)
   - Terms: "By subscribing, you agree to our Terms of Service"
   - Checkbox: "I agree to Terms of Service"

5. **Confirm and pay:**
   - Click "Subscribe Now" or "Upgrade Now"
   - BE: `POST /v1/subscriptions/subscribe`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "plan_id": "uuid",
       "billing_cycle": "MONTHLY",
       "payment_method_id": "uuid",
       "promo_code": "LAUNCH50",
       "auto_renewal": true,
       "idempotency_key": "uuid"
     }
     ```
   - Process payment via financial-be:
     - Create payment intent
     - Charge card
     - Create invoice
   - Create subscription record
   - Grant entitlements
   - Allocate connects
   - Update user role/permissions
   - Publish event: `subscription.created.v1` or `subscription.upgraded.v1`

6. **Success:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/subscriptions/success`
   - Display:
     - Success message: "Welcome to Plus! 🎉"
     - Plan details:
       - Plus (Monthly) — $29.99/month
       - Next bill: Dec 7, 2025
       - Connects: 150/month
     - New features unlocked:
       - Unlimited job posts ✓
       - Unlimited proposals ✓
       - Featured profile badge ✓
       - Advanced analytics ✓
       - Priority support ✓
     - Receipt link: "View receipt"
     - CTA: "Explore new features"
   - Email receipt
   - Email welcome to new tier
   - Push notification: "Your Plus subscription is active!"

7. **Access new features:**
   - Redirect to dashboard
   - Feature banners: "NEW: Try AI Proposal Assistant"
   - Tutorial overlays for new features
   - Notification: "Your featured profile badge is now visible"

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Payment failure:**
   - Payment declined
   - Error: "Payment failed. Please try a different payment method."
   - Retry with same card
   - Add new card
   - OR: "Try again later"
   - Subscription not created, remains on current plan

2. **Insufficient funds:**
   - ACH payment fails (insufficient funds)
   - Error: "Payment could not be processed. Please update your payment method."
   - Subscription enters "past_due" status
   - Grace period: 3 days to update payment
   - Daily retry attempts
   - If not resolved: Subscription cancelled, downgrade to FREE

3. **3D Secure authentication:**
   - Card requires 3DS verification
   - Modal: "Please verify with your bank"
   - Redirect to bank authentication page
   - Return to Skillsier after verification
   - Complete subscription

4. **Trial conversion:**
   - User on 14-day Pro trial
   - Trial expiring tomorrow
   - Email: "Your trial ends tomorrow. Subscribe to keep Pro features."
   - On subscribe:
     - Credit remaining trial days
     - Start paid subscription
     - Notification: "Trial converted to paid subscription"

5. **Downgrade restriction:**
   - Cannot downgrade immediately
   - Must wait until end of billing period
   - Schedule downgrade: "Your plan will change to Basic on Dec 1"
   - Confirmation: "You'll keep Pro features until Dec 1"
   - Email reminder 7 days before downgrade

6. **Usage blocker:**
   - Current usage exceeds new plan limits
   - Error: "You've used 120 connects this month. BASIC includes only 50. Please reduce usage or choose PLUS."
   - Options:
     - Wait until next month (usage resets)
     - Purchase additional connects
     - Choose higher tier

7. **Promo code validation:**
   - Invalid code: "Promo code not found"
   - Expired code: "This promo code expired on Oct 31"
   - Already used: "You've already used this promo code"
   - Not eligible: "This promo is for new subscribers only"
   - Usage limit reached: "This promo code is no longer available"

8. **Auto-renewal toggle:**
   - User disables auto-renewal
   - Warning: "Your subscription will not renew on Dec 1. You'll be downgraded to FREE."
   - Confirm: "Yes, cancel renewal"
   - Subscription status: `AUTO_RENEWAL_DISABLED`
   - Email: "Auto-renewal disabled. Your subscription ends on Dec 1."

9. **Subscription pause:**
   - User wants to pause subscription (not cancel)
   - Feature available for PLUS and PRO
   - Pause for 1-3 months
   - No charges during pause
   - Features disabled during pause
   - Auto-resume on scheduled date
   - Email: "Subscription paused until Feb 1"

10. **Seat adjustment (team plans):**
    - PRO includes 5 seats, user has 8 team members
    - Add 3 additional seats: 3 × $9.99 = $29.97/month
    - Proration for current period
    - Total: $49.99 + $29.97 = $79.96/month
    - Confirmation: "Total with 3 additional seats: $79.96/month"

11. **Add-ons during subscription:**
    - Offer add-ons at checkout:
      - Priority support: +$19.99/month
      - Featured profile: +$14.99/month
    - Checkbox: "Add Priority Support (+$19.99/month)"
    - Total adjusted automatically

12. **Currency selection:**
    - User in UK, select GBP
    - Display prices in £
    - Note: "Prices shown in GBP. Converted at current exchange rate."
    - Tax (VAT) calculated based on region

13. **Tax calculation:**
    - Collect billing address
    - Calculate tax based on location:
      - US: Sales tax by state
      - EU: VAT (20% in UK, 19% in Germany, etc.)
      - No tax for business accounts with valid VAT ID
    - Display tax breakdown
    - Total includes tax

14. **Refund window:**
    - 30-day money-back guarantee
    - Banner: "Not satisfied? Cancel within 30 days for full refund"
    - After 30 days: No refund, but can cancel for next period

15. **Subscription stacking:**
    - User already has active subscription
    - Cannot have multiple active subscriptions
    - Must upgrade/downgrade existing
    - OR: Wait until current expires

#### Notifications

**Subscription Created:**
- **Email:** "Welcome to Plus! Here's what you can do now... [Receipt attached]"
- **Push:** "Plus subscription activated"

**Subscription Upgraded:**
- **Email:** "You've upgraded to Plus! New features unlocked. [Receipt attached]"
- **Push:** "Upgraded to Plus"

**Payment Failed:**
- **Email:** "Payment failed for your Plus subscription. Please update your payment method to avoid service interruption."
- **Push:** "Payment failed"
- **Banner:** Persistent banner on dashboard

**Trial Converted:**
- **Email:** "Your Pro trial has been converted to a paid subscription. Enjoy uninterrupted access!"
- **Push:** "Trial converted"

**Auto-Renewal Disabled:**
- **Email:** "Auto-renewal disabled. Your subscription will end on Dec 1."
- **Push:** "Auto-renewal off"

**Subscription Paused:**
- **Email:** "Subscription paused until Feb 1. See you soon!"

#### Analytics

- subscriptions.subscribe.initiated (user_id, plan_id, billing_cycle, source)
- subscriptions.subscribe.completed (user_id, plan_id, amount_paid, promo_code)
- subscriptions.payment.failed (user_id, plan_id, error_code, retry_count)
- subscriptions.promo.applied (user_id, promo_code, discount_amount)
- subscriptions.trial.converted (user_id, trial_plan, paid_plan)
- subscriptions.auto_renewal.toggled (user_id, plan_id, enabled)
- subscriptions.pause.requested (user_id, pause_duration)
- subscriptions.seats.added (user_id, additional_seats, total_cost)

#### Sources

**Backend:** subscriptions-be.user-stories.md (subscription creation, payment, proration)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/subscriptions/subscribe routes, hooks/subscriptions/use-subscribe.ts, components/subscriptions/subscribe-form.tsx)

### **SUB-3: MANAGE SUBSCRIPTION**

**Journey Code:** SUB-3  
**User Goal:** View and manage my active subscription  
**Preconditions:** Active paid subscription  
**Triggers:** Access subscription settings, billing concerns, plan changes

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions` — Subscription dashboard
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/billing` — Billing details
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/usage` — Usage statistics
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/change-plan` — Change plan
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/cancel` — Cancel subscription

**Mobile:**
- `subscriptions` — Subscription dashboard
- `subscriptions/billing` — Billing
- `subscriptions/usage` — Usage
- `subscriptions/change-plan` — Change plan
- `subscriptions/cancel` — Cancel

#### System Touchpoints

- **subscriptions-be:** Subscription management, plan changes, cancellation
- **financial-be:** Billing history, payment methods, invoices
- **entitlements-be:** Usage tracking, limits
- **notifications-be:** Subscription change notifications

#### Flow Steps

1. **View subscription dashboard:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/subscriptions`
   - Display:
     - **Current Plan:**
       - Plan name and tier: Plus (Monthly)
       - Status: Active / Past Due / Cancelled / Paused
       - Billing amount: $29.99/month
       - Next billing date: Dec 7, 2025
       - Auto-renewal: Enabled / Disabled
     - **Payment Method:**
       - Card: Visa •••• 4242 (Expires 12/26)
       - Button: "Update payment method"
     - **Connects Balance:**
       - Available: 120 / 150
       - Reserved: 30 (for pending proposals)
       - Grant next month: 150 on Dec 1
     - **Usage This Period:**
       - Job posts: Unlimited (45 posted)
       - Proposals: Unlimited (78 submitted)
       - Connects used: 30
       - Messages sent: 245
       - Progress bars for limited features
     - **Quick Actions:**
       - Upgrade plan
       - Update payment method
       - View billing history
       - Pause subscription
       - Cancel subscription
   - BE: `GET /v1/subscriptions/current`
   - BE: `GET /v1/connects/balance`
   - BE: `GET /v1/subscriptions/usage`

2. **View billing details:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/subscriptions/billing`
   - Display:
     - **Current Charges:**
       - Plan: Plus (Monthly) — $29.99
       - Additional seats: 3 × $9.99 — $29.97
       - Add-ons: Priority Support — $19.99
       - **Total:** $79.95/month
       - Next bill: $79.95 on Dec 7, 2025
     - **Payment Method:**
       - Card: Visa •••• 4242
       - Expiry: 12/2026
       - Billing address: 123 Main St, San Francisco, CA 94102
       - Button: "Update"
     - **Billing History:**
       - Table of past invoices:
         - Date
         - Description (e.g., "Plus Monthly - Nov 2025")
         - Amount
         - Status (Paid, Failed, Refunded)
         - Receipt link
       - Pagination
       - Filter: Date range, status
       - Export CSV
     - **Upcoming Charge:**
       - Dec 7, 2025: $79.95
       - Payment method: Visa •••• 4242
       - Button: "Preview invoice"
   - BE: `GET /v1/subscriptions/billing`
   - BE: `GET /v1/invoices?subscription_id={id}`

3. **View usage statistics:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/subscriptions/usage`
   - Display:
     - **Usage Summary (Current Period):**
       - Period: Nov 7 - Dec 7, 2025
       - Job posts: 45 (Unlimited)
       - Proposals: 78 (Unlimited)
       - Connects used: 30 / 150 remaining
       - Messages sent: 245 (Unlimited)
       - Storage used: 2.3 GB / 100 GB
       - API calls: N/A (PRO feature)
     - **Usage Trends:**
       - Line chart: Usage over last 6 months
       - Compare to plan limits
     - **Feature Access:**
       - Checkmarks for enabled features
       - Grayed out for disabled features
       - Upgrade CTA for locked features
     - **Alerts:**
       - "You're using 80% of your connects. Consider upgrading or purchasing more."
   - BE: `GET /v1/subscriptions/usage`
   - BE: `GET /v1/entitlements`

4. **Change plan:**
   - Click "Change Plan" or "Upgrade"
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/subscriptions/change-plan`
   - Display:
     - Current plan: Plus ($29.99/month)
     - Available plans:
       - Downgrade: Basic ($9.99/month)
       - Same tier: Plus (Yearly) — $287.88/year (save $72)
       - Upgrade: Pro ($49.99/month)
     - For each option:
       - Proration calculation
       - Feature comparison
       - Effective date (immediate or end of period)
   - Select new plan
   - **Downgrade:**
     - Warning: "You'll lose these features: Unlimited proposals, Featured badge, Advanced analytics"
     - Effective: End of current period (Dec 7)
     - Confirmation: "Are you sure?"
   - **Upgrade:**
     - Effective: Immediately
     - Proration: Credit for unused Plus time, charge for Pro (prorated)
     - Total due today: $10.00
   - Confirm change
   - BE: `POST /v1/subscriptions/change-plan`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "new_plan_id": "uuid",
       "effective_date": "IMMEDIATE" | "END_OF_PERIOD",
       "idempotency_key": "uuid"
     }
     ```

5. **Update payment method:**
   - Click "Update payment method"
   - Modal or navigate to billing section
   - Add new card or select existing
   - Validate card (authorization hold $1, refunded)
   - Set as default
   - Confirmation: "Payment method updated"
   - Next charge will use new card
   - Email: "Payment method updated for your subscription"

6. **Pause subscription:**
   - Click "Pause subscription"
   - Modal: "Pause your subscription"
   - Select duration: 1 month, 2 months, 3 months
   - Confirm: "Your subscription will pause on Dec 7. No charges during pause."
   - Features disabled during pause
   - Auto-resume on selected date
   - Email: "Subscription paused until Feb 1, 2026"
   - BE: `POST /v1/subscriptions/pause`

7. **Cancel subscription:**
   - Click "Cancel subscription"
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/subscriptions/cancel`
   - **Retention flow:**
     - "We're sorry to see you go!"
     - Reason selection:
       - Too expensive
       - Not using it enough
       - Missing features
       - Switching to competitor
       - Other (text field)
     - **Retention offers (based on reason):**
       - If "Too expensive": "How about 50% off for 3 months?"
       - If "Not using": "Pause instead? Keep your data safe."
       - If "Missing features": "Tell us what you need! [Feedback form]"
     - Accept offer OR continue cancellation
   - **Confirm cancellation:**
     - Warning: "Your subscription will end on Dec 7. You'll lose access to:"
       - Unlimited proposals
       - Featured profile
       - Advanced analytics
       - 150 connects/month
     - Note: "Your data will be retained for 30 days. Reactivate anytime."
     - Checkbox: "I understand I will lose access to these features"
     - Final button: "Cancel Subscription"
   - BE: `POST /v1/subscriptions/cancel`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "reason": "TOO_EXPENSIVE",
       "feedback": "Optional feedback text",
       "effective_date": "END_OF_PERIOD",
       "idempotency_key": "uuid"
     }
     ```
   - Confirmation: "Subscription cancelled. You have access until Dec 7."
   - Email: "Subscription cancelled. Access until Dec 7."

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Past due subscription:**
   - Payment failed, subscription past due
   - Banner: "⚠️ Payment failed. Update your payment method to avoid service interruption."
   - Grace period: 3 days
   - Daily retry attempts
   - Features may be limited during grace period
   - If not resolved: Auto-cancel, downgrade to FREE

2. **Subscription expiring soon:**
   - Auto-renewal disabled, subscription expiring in 7 days
   - Banner: "Your subscription expires on Dec 7. Enable auto-renewal to keep your features."
   - CTA: "Enable Auto-Renewal"
   - Email reminders: 7 days, 3 days, 1 day before expiry

3. **Reactivate cancelled subscription:**
   - User cancelled, now wants to reactivate
   - Within 30 days: Data retained
   - Button: "Reactivate Subscription"
   - Select plan (can be different from previous)
   - Process payment
   - Restore entitlements
   - Email: "Welcome back! Subscription reactivated."

4. **Downgrade with usage blocker:**
   - User wants to downgrade to Basic (50 connects/month)
   - Currently has 120 connects used
   - Error: "You've used more connects than Basic allows. Downgrade will take effect next period or purchase fewer connects next month."
   - Schedule downgrade for next period

5. **Change billing cycle:**
   - Monthly → Annual
   - Calculate savings: $359.88/year vs $287.88/year = Save $72
   - Proration: Credit remaining monthly days, charge annual (prorated)
   - Effective immediately
   - Next bill: 1 year from today

6. **Add-on management:**
   - View current add-ons:
     - Priority Support: $19.99/month
     - Featured Profile: $14.99/month
   - Remove add-on:
     - Effective: End of billing period
     - Confirmation: "Priority Support will be removed on Dec 7"
   - Add new add-on:
     - Effective: Immediately
     - Proration: Charge prorated for current period

7. **Seat management (team plans):**
   - PRO plan: 5 included seats, 3 additional ($9.99 each)
   - View team members assigned to seats
   - Add seat: +$9.99/month (prorated for current period)
   - Remove seat: Effective end of period
   - Reassign seat: Change which team member has access

8. **Invoice preview:**
   - Click "Preview next invoice"
   - Display:
     - Billing date: Dec 7, 2025
     - Line items:
       - Plus Monthly: $29.99
       - Additional Seats (3): $29.97
       - Priority Support: $19.99
       - Subtotal: $79.95
       - Tax: $6.40
       - **Total:** $86.35
     - Payment method: Visa •••• 4242
   - Download PDF preview

9. **Refund request:**
   - Within 30-day guarantee window
   - Click "Request Refund"
   - Reason selection
   - Confirm
   - Email: "Refund processed. $29.99 will appear on your statement within 5-7 business days."
   - Subscription cancelled immediately
   - Publish event: `subscription.refunded.v1`

10. **Auto-renewal reminder:**
    - 7 days before renewal
    - Email: "Your Plus subscription renews on Dec 7 for $29.99"
    - Option to update payment method
    - Option to disable auto-renewal
    - No action required if all good

11. **Failed payment retry:**
    - Payment failed, auto-retry in 3 days
    - Email: "Payment failed. We'll try again on Nov 10."
    - User can manually retry: "Retry now"
    - Or update payment method

12. **Grace period expiry:**
    - 3 days passed, payment still failing
    - Final email: "Last chance! Update your payment method by Nov 10 to keep your subscription."
    - If not resolved: Auto-cancel on Nov 10
    - Downgrade to FREE

13. **Subscription transfer:**
    - Transfer subscription to another account (rare, agency use)
    - Requires admin approval
    - Contact support
    - Support initiates transfer
    - Both parties confirm
    - Subscription moved

14. **Multi-currency billing:**
    - User moves to different country
    - Email: "We noticed you're now in UK. Switch to GBP billing?"
    - Convert subscription to GBP
    - Next charge in GBP

15. **Tax status change:**
    - User adds valid VAT ID (EU business)
    - VAT removed from future invoices
    - Email: "Your tax status has been updated. Future invoices will exclude VAT."

#### Notifications

**Plan Changed:**
- **Email:** "Your plan has been changed to Pro. [Details] [Receipt]"
- **Push:** "Plan changed to Pro"

**Payment Method Updated:**
- **Email:** "Payment method updated for your subscription"
- **Push:** "Payment method updated"

**Subscription Paused:**
- **Email:** "Subscription paused until Feb 1, 2026. No charges during this time."

**Subscription Cancelled:**
- **Email:** "Subscription cancelled. You have access until Dec 7. We hope to see you again!"
- **Push:** "Subscription cancelled"

**Subscription Expiring:**
- **Email (7 days):** "Your subscription expires on Dec 7. Renew to keep your features."
- **Email (3 days):** "3 days left! Renew now to avoid service interruption."
- **Email (1 day):** "Last day! Your subscription expires tomorrow."

**Payment Failed:**
- **Email:** "Payment failed. We'll try again in 3 days. Update your payment method now."
- **Push:** "Payment failed"
- **Banner:** Dashboard banner

**Grace Period Expiring:**
- **Email:** "Final notice: Update payment by Nov 10 or your subscription will be cancelled."
- **Push:** "Payment due soon"

**Subscription Reactivated:**
- **Email:** "Welcome back! Your subscription has been reactivated."
- **Push:** "Subscription reactivated"

### **SUB-4: FEATURE GATING & ENTITLEMENTS**

**Journey Code:** SUB-4  
**User Goal:** Understand which features I can access based on my subscription  
**Preconditions:** Any user (FREE or paid subscription)  
**Triggers:** Attempting to use premium features, exploring platform capabilities

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- Various feature screens with paywalls
- `(dashboard)/subscriptions/features` — Feature overview
- Upgrade prompts throughout platform

**Mobile:**
- Feature screens with upgrade CTAs
- `subscriptions/features` — Feature list

#### System Touchpoints

- **entitlements-be:** Feature access validation, limits checking
- **subscriptions-be:** Plan features, usage limits
- **notifications-be:** Upgrade prompts, limit warnings
- **auth-be:** Permission verification

#### Flow Steps

1. **Check feature access:**
   - User attempts to use feature (e.g., AI Proposal Assistant)
   - Frontend checks entitlement:
     - BE: `GET /v1/entitlements`
     - Response:
       ```json
       {
         "plan": "BASIC",
         "features": {
           "job_posts": { "limit": 20, "used": 15, "unlimited": false },
           "proposals": { "limit": 50, "used": 35, "unlimited": false },
           "ai_assistant": { "enabled": false },
           "featured_badge": { "enabled": false },
           "analytics": { "enabled": false }
         },
         "connects": {
           "balance": 30,
           "monthly_grant": 50
         }
       }
       ```
   - Check: `features.ai_assistant.enabled === false`
   - Show paywall

2. **Display paywall:**
   - Modal or inline banner:
     - "🔒 AI Proposal Assistant"
     - "This feature requires Plus or higher"
     - Features of AI Assistant:
       - Generate proposals 10x faster
       - Personalized to job description
       - Optimized for success rate
     - Plans with this feature:
       - Plus: $29.99/month ✓
       - Pro: $49.99/month ✓
     - CTA: "Upgrade to Plus"
     - Alternative: "Not now"
   - Analytics: Track paywall_shown event

3. **Enforce usage limits:**
   - User on Basic plan: 20 job posts/month
   - Used: 18 / 20
   - Warning banner: "You have 2 job posts remaining this month. Upgrade to Plus for unlimited posts."
   - On 20th post:
     - Block action
     - Modal: "You've reached your monthly limit of 20 job posts"
     - Options:
       - "Upgrade to Plus" (unlimited)
       - "Wait until Dec 1" (limit resets)
     - Analytics: Track limit_reached event

4. **Soft limits (with overage):**
   - Feature: Messages to non-hires
   - Basic plan: 10/day limit
   - Used: 10 / 10 today
   - Warning: "You've reached your daily limit. Upgrade to Plus for unlimited messaging."
   - Option: Pay $0.10 per additional message (if enabled)
   - OR: Blocked until tomorrow

5. **Feature discovery:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/subscriptions/features`
   - Display feature catalog:
     - Grouped by category:
       - **Profile & Visibility**
         - Featured Badge (Plus+)
         - Priority Search Ranking (Plus+)
         - Portfolio Showcase (Pro+)
       - **Proposals & Jobs**
         - Unlimited Proposals (Plus+)
         - AI Proposal Assistant (Plus+)
         - Saved Proposal Templates (All)
       - **Communication**
         - Unlimited Messages (Plus+)
         - Video Introductions (Pro+)
         - Priority Support (Pro+)
       - **Analytics & Insights**
         - Basic Analytics (All)
         - Advanced Analytics (Plus+)
         - Competitor Insights (Pro+)
       - **Collaboration**
         - Team Collaboration (Pro+)
         - Project Management Tools (Pro+)
         - API Access (Pro+)
     - For each feature:
       - Name and icon
       - Description
       - Required plan
       - Status: Enabled / Locked / Limited
       - Usage (if applicable): 15 / 20
       - CTA: "Upgrade" or "Learn more"
   - BE: `GET /v1/subscriptions/features`

6. **Usage warnings:**
   - Approaching limit: 80% used
   - Warning notification:
     - "You've used 16 of your 20 job posts this month"
     - "Consider upgrading to Plus for unlimited posts"
     - Button: "Upgrade Now"
   - Email if 90% used
   - Push notification if limit reached

7. **Feature upsell:**
   - Contextual upsell throughout platform
   - Examples:
     - On profile page: "Add a featured badge to stand out → Upgrade to Plus"
     - On analytics: "Unlock advanced insights → Upgrade to Plus"
     - On proposal page: "Let AI write this proposal for you → Upgrade to Plus"
   - Non-intrusive, relevant to current action
   - Dismissible
   - Analytics: Track upsell_shown, upsell_clicked

8. **Time-based limits:**
   - Feature: Job post boosts (make job visible to more freelancers)
   - Free plan: 1 boost/week
   - Used: 1 / 1 this week
   - Blocked until next Monday
   - Banner: "You've used your weekly boost. Upgrade to Plus for 5 boosts/week."
   - Countdown: "Next boost available in 4 days"

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Grandfathered features:**
   - User on legacy plan with features no longer offered
   - Maintain access until plan changed
   - Note: "Your plan includes features no longer available. You'll keep them as long as you don't change plans."

2. **Trial access:**
   - User on Pro trial (14 days)
   - Access to all Pro features
   - Banner: "You're on a Pro trial. {days} days remaining."
   - Email reminder: 7 days, 3 days, 1 day before expiry
   - On expiry: Features locked unless subscribed

3. **Addon features:**
   - User on Plus with Priority Support addon
   - Feature enabled: priority_support
   - If addon removed: Feature disabled at period end
   - Grace period: Until end of billing cycle

4. **Feature flags:**
   - Beta features enabled for select users
   - Not tied to subscription, but to feature flag
   - Example: New AI tool in beta
   - Enabled for Pro users + selected Beta testers
   - Check: `GET /v1/feature-flags`

5. **Soft launch:**
   - New feature: Video Introductions
   - Rolled out gradually: 10% of Pro users
   - Check entitlement + feature flag
   - If enabled: Show feature
   - If not: Feature hidden (no paywall)

6. **Deprecation:**
   - Feature being deprecated: Old analytics dashboard
   - All users redirected to new dashboard
   - Email: "We've upgraded our analytics. Check it out!"
   - Old feature hidden after grace period

7. **A/B testing paywalls:**
   - Variant A: Modal paywall
   - Variant B: Inline banner
   - Randomly assign users
   - Track conversion rates
   - Winner becomes default

8. **Usage reset:**
   - Monthly limits reset on billing date
   - Example: 20 job posts/month resets on Dec 1
   - Notification: "Your monthly limits have reset. You have 20 job posts available."
   - Email: "New month, new limits!"

9. **Grace period for downgrade:**
   - User downgrades from Plus to Basic (end of period)
   - Features remain enabled until Dec 7
   - Warning: "Your Plus features will expire on Dec 7"
   - Countdown in UI

10. **Overage billing (future feature):**
    - User exceeds limit, charged for overage
    - Example: 25 job posts on Basic (20 included, 5 overage)
    - Charge: 5 × $1.99 = $9.95
    - Email: "You exceeded your plan limit. Overage charges apply."
    - Invoice line item: "Overage: 5 job posts"

11. **Team member permissions:**
    - Agency/team account
    - Owner has Pro, team members have role-based access
    - Team member attempts to use Pro feature
    - Check: Owner's plan + member's role
    - If authorized: Allow
    - If not: "Your role does not have access to this feature. Contact your account owner."

12. **Feature request:**
    - User encounters locked feature
    - Link: "Request this feature for FREE users"
    - Feedback form submitted
    - Email: "Thanks for the feedback! We'll consider it."
    - Analytics: Track feature requests by plan tier

13. **Temporary feature grants:**
    - Admin grants temporary access to Pro feature for FREE user
    - Duration: 7 days
    - User sees: "You have temporary access to AI Assistant. Expires in 7 days."
    - After expiry: Feature locked, paywall shown

14. **Bundle promotions:**
    - User on Plus, promoted to Pro for 1 month (free)
    - Access to Pro features temporarily
    - Banner: "Enjoy Pro features free this month! Upgrade anytime."
    - After 1 month: Revert to Plus unless upgraded

15. **Dynamic entitlements:**
    - User's entitlements change mid-session
    - Example: Subscription upgraded in another tab
    - WebSocket or polling: Refresh entitlements
    - Notification: "Your subscription has been updated. Refresh to access new features."
    - Auto-refresh entitlements on next API call

#### Notifications

**Limit Warning (80%):**
- **Push:** "You've used 16 of 20 job posts this month"
- **Email:** "You're approaching your monthly limit. Upgrade to Plus for unlimited posts."

**Limit Reached:**
- **Push:** "You've reached your limit"
- **Modal:** Blocking modal on feature use
- **Email:** "You've used all your job posts this month. Upgrade or wait until Dec 1."

**Usage Reset:**
- **Email:** "Your monthly limits have reset. You have 20 job posts available."
- **Push:** "Limits reset"

**Feature Unlocked:**
- **Push:** "New feature unlocked: AI Proposal Assistant!"
- **Tooltip:** Highlight new feature in UI

**Paywall Shown:**
- **Analytics:** Track paywall views and conversions

**Trial Expiring:**
- **Email (3 days):** "Your Pro trial ends in 3 days. Subscribe to keep your features."
- **Push (1 day):** "Pro trial ends tomorrow"

#### Analytics

- entitlements.checked (user_id, feature_key, has_access)
- entitlements.paywall.shown (user_id, feature_key, plan_required, source)
- entitlements.paywall.clicked (user_id, feature_key, cta_action)
- entitlements.limit.reached (user_id, limit_key, limit_value, used_value)
- entitlements.limit.warning (user_id, limit_key, percentage_used)
- entitlements.upsell.shown (user_id, feature_key, context)
- entitlements.upsell.clicked (user_id, feature_key, plan_selected)
- entitlements.feature.requested (user_id, feature_key, user_plan)
- entitlements.temporary_grant.used (user_id, feature_key, grant_duration)

#### Sources

**Backend:** subscriptions-be.user-stories.md (entitlements, usage limits, feature gates), entitlements-be (if separate service)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md (hooks/entitlements/use-entitlements.ts, components/paywalls/, middleware for feature checks)

# SECTION N: AGENCIES & TEAMS

### **AG-1: CREATE AGENCY / TEAM ACCOUNT**

**Journey Code:** AG-1  
**User Goal:** Create an agency or team account to manage multiple freelancers  
**Preconditions:** Registered user with PRO or ENTERPRISE subscription  
**Triggers:** Growing business, need for team collaboration, hiring additional freelancers

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `(dashboard)/agency/create` — Create agency/team
- `(dashboard)/agency/setup` — Setup wizard
- `(dashboard)/agency` — Agency dashboard

**Mobile:**
- `agency/create` — Create agency
- `agency/setup` — Setup
- `agency` — Dashboard

#### System Touchpoints

- **agencies-be:** Agency creation, team management
- **subscriptions-be:** Seat billing, team plan management
- **auth-be:** Role and permission management
- **notifications-be:** Team invitations, role changes

#### Flow Steps

1. **Initiate agency creation:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/agency/create`
   - Check eligibility:
     - Must have PRO or ENTERPRISE plan
     - If on BASIC/PLUS: Error: "Upgrade to PRO to create an agency"
     - CTA: "Upgrade Now"
   - Display form:
     - Agency name: (required, 3-100 chars)
     - Agency type: Freelancer Agency / Client Team
     - Industry: (dropdown)
     - Company website: (optional)
     - Company size: 2-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-500, 500+
     - Logo: (upload, optional)
     - Description: (optional, 500 chars)
   - Terms: "By creating an agency, you agree to our Agency Terms"
   - Checkbox: "I agree"
   - Button: "Create Agency"

2. **Create agency:**
   - BE: `POST /v1/agencies`
   - Body:
     ```json
     {
       "agency_name": "Acme Digital Agency",
       "agency_type": "FREELANCER_AGENCY",
       "industry": "MARKETING",
       "website": "https://acmedigital.com",
       "company_size": "11-50",
       "logo_url": "https://cdn.skillsier.com/logos/acme.png",
       "description": "Full-service digital marketing agency",
       "idempotency_key": "uuid"
     }
     ```
   - Create agency record
   - Assign creator as Owner
   - Allocate seats based on plan:
     - PRO: 5 seats included
     - ENTERPRISE: Unlimited seats
   - Create default roles: Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer
   - Publish event: `agency.created.v1`

3. **Setup wizard:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/agency/setup`
   - **Step 1: Team Structure:**
     - Define roles:
       - Owner (you) — Full access
       - Admin — Manage members, view all projects
       - Member — Access assigned projects
       - Viewer — Read-only access
     - Note: "You can customize roles later"
   - **Step 2: Invite Team Members:**
     - Add email addresses (comma-separated or list)
     - Assign role to each
     - Example:
       - john@acmedigital.com — Admin
       - sarah@acmedigital.com — Member
       - mike@acmedigital.com — Member
     - Send invitations
     - Note: "They'll receive an email invitation with a link to join"
   - **Step 3: Billing Setup:**
     - Display:
       - PRO Plan: $49.99/month
       - Included seats: 5
       - Team members invited: 3
       - Additional seats needed: 0
       - Total: $49.99/month
     - If more seats needed:
       - Additional seats: 2 × $9.99 = $19.98/month
       - Total: $49.99 + $19.98 = $69.97/month
     - Confirm
   - **Step 4: Permissions:**
     - Set default permissions for roles:
       - Owner: All permissions
       - Admin: Manage members, view all projects, approve proposals
       - Member: Submit proposals, message clients, view assigned projects
       - Viewer: Read-only
     - Customize if needed
   - **Step 5: Finalize:**
     - Review settings
     - Click "Complete Setup"
     - Redirect to agency dashboard

4. **Agency dashboard:**
   - Navigate to `(dashboard)/agency`
   - Display:
     - **Agency Overview:**
       - Name: Acme Digital Agency
       - Type: Freelancer Agency
       - Plan: PRO
       - Seats: 3 / 5 used
       - Members: 3 active, 2 pending invitations
     - **Team Members:**
       - List of members with role, status (Active/Pending/Suspended)
       - CTA: "Invite Member"
     - **Recent Activity:**
       - Member joined: Sarah Smith
       - Proposal submitted: Mike Johnson → Job #12345
       - Project completed: Acme Inc. website redesign
     - **Billing Summary:**
       - Current charges: $49.99/month
       - Next bill: Dec 7, 2025
       - Payment method: Visa •••• 4242
       - CTA: "Manage Billing"
     - **Quick Actions:**
       - Invite member
       - Manage roles
       - View reports
       - Settings
   - BE: `GET /v1/agencies/{agency_id}`
   - BE: `GET /v1/agencies/{agency_id}/members`

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Insufficient plan:**
   - User on BASIC attempts to create agency
   - Error: "Agency accounts require PRO or ENTERPRISE plan"
   - CTA: "Upgrade to PRO"
   - Redirect to subscription page

2. **Name conflict:**
   - Agency name already taken
   - Error: "This name is already in use. Please choose another."
   - Suggest alternative: "Acme Digital Agency 2"

3. **Seat allocation:**
   - PRO includes 5 seats, user invites 7 members
   - Warning: "You're inviting 7 members, but your plan includes only 5 seats. You'll need 2 additional seats at $9.99/seat/month."
   - Options:
     - Proceed with additional seats (+$19.98/month)
     - Reduce invitations to 5
     - Upgrade to ENTERPRISE (unlimited seats)

4. **Invitation failures:**
   - Email address invalid
   - Error: "Invalid email: john@acme" (missing TLD)
   - Highlight invalid addresses
   - User already has account:
     - Auto-link if they accept invitation
   - User doesn't have account:
     - Invitation sent, they must sign up first

5. **Role customization:**
   - Create custom roles beyond defaults
   - Example: "Senior Developer" with specific permissions
   - Granular permissions:
     - Can submit proposals: Yes/No
     - Can approve proposals: Yes/No
     - Can manage billing: Yes/No
     - Can invite members: Yes/No
     - Can view analytics: Yes/No
   - Save custom role

6. **Billing consolidation:**
   - All agency members' subscriptions consolidated into one bill
   - Creator's personal subscription converted to agency plan
   - Other members' subscriptions paused (they're now under agency)
   - Note: "Your individual subscription will be replaced by the agency plan"

7. **Ownership transfer:**
   - Owner wants to transfer ownership to another member
   - Navigate to Settings → Transfer Ownership
   - Select new owner (must be Admin)
   - Confirm with password
   - New owner receives email: "You're now the owner of Acme Digital Agency"
   - Old owner becomes Admin

8. **Agency deletion:**
   - Owner wants to delete agency
   - Warning: "This will remove all members and cannot be undone"
   - Confirm with password
   - All members notified
   - Agency data retained for 30 days (can restore)
   - Members revert to individual subscriptions

9. **Member limit reached:**
   - Agency has 5 seats, all used
   - Owner tries to invite 6th member
   - Error: "You've reached your seat limit. Purchase additional seats or upgrade to ENTERPRISE."
   - Options:
     - Add 1 seat: +$9.99/month
     - Upgrade to ENTERPRISE: Contact sales

10. **Invitation expiry:**
    - Invitation sent, not accepted within 7 days
    - Invitation expires
    - Owner notified: "Your invitation to john@acme.com expired"
    - Option: "Resend invitation"

11. **Multiple agencies:**
    - User owns multiple agencies
    - Example: "Acme Digital" (Freelancer Agency) + "Acme Consulting" (Client Team)
    - Switch between agencies in UI:
      - Dropdown: "Switch Agency"
      - List of agencies with role
    - Billing separate for each

12. **Agency profile:**
    - Public agency profile page
    - URL: `skillsier.com/agencies/acme-digital`
    - Display:
      - Agency name, logo, description
      - Team members (if opted in)
      - Portfolio of projects
      - Reviews/ratings
      - Contact button
    - Visibility setting: Public / Private
    - SEO optimized

13. **Nested teams:**
    - Large agency with sub-teams
    - Example: "Acme Digital" → "Design Team", "Dev Team", "Marketing Team"
    - Each sub-team has lead
    - Hierarchical permissions
    - Feature: ENTERPRISE only

14. **Onboarding checklist:**
    - After agency created, show checklist:
      - ✓ Create agency
      - ☐ Invite team members (0/5 invited)
      - ☐ Complete first project
      - ☐ Set up billing alerts
      - ☐ Customize roles
    - Progress bar: 20% complete

15. **Agency analytics:**
    - Owner/Admin view agency-wide analytics:
      - Total proposals submitted: 45
      - Win rate: 32%
      - Total revenue: $125,000
      - Average project value: $5,200
      - Top performer: Sarah Smith (12 projects won)
    - Export reports

#### Notifications

**Agency Created:**
- **Email (Owner):** "Your agency 'Acme Digital' has been created! [Get started]"
- **Push:** "Agency created"

**Member Invited:**
- **Email (Invitee):** "You've been invited to join Acme Digital Agency as an Admin. [Accept invitation]"
- **Push:** "Agency invitation received"

**Member Joined:**
- **Email (Owner):** "Sarah Smith has joined your agency"
- **Push:** "New member joined"

**Invitation Expired:**
- **Email (Owner):** "Your invitation to john@acme.com has expired. Resend?"

**Seat Limit Reached:**
- **Email (Owner):** "You've reached your seat limit. Add more seats to continue inviting members."
- **Banner:** Dashboard banner

**Ownership Transferred:**
- **Email (Old Owner):** "You've transferred ownership of Acme Digital to John Doe"
- **Email (New Owner):** "You're now the owner of Acme Digital Agency"

#### Analytics

- agencies.created (user_id, agency_id, agency_type, company_size)
- agencies.setup.completed (agency_id, members_invited, seats_allocated)
- agencies.member.invited (agency_id, invitee_email, role)
- agencies.member.joined (agency_id, member_id, role)
- agencies.role.created (agency_id, role_name, permissions[])
- agencies.ownership.transferred (agency_id, old_owner_id, new_owner_id)
- agencies.deleted (agency_id, reason)
- agencies.seat.added (agency_id, additional_seats, total_cost)

#### Sources

**Backend:** agencies-be.user-stories.md (agency creation, team management, roles)  
**Frontend:** combined-fe-folder-structure.md ((dashboard)/agency routes, hooks/agency/use-agency.ts, components/agency/agency-form.tsx)
