## PUB-2: Job Search & Browse (Public)

**Goal:** Visitor can browse and search jobs without logging in to assess platform value  
**Actor:** Unauthenticated visitor  
**Preconditions:** None  
**Triggers:** Click "Find Work" or "Browse Jobs" from landing page, organic search for job

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `/jobs` — Public job listing
- `/jobs/[jobId]` — Public job detail (limited view)
- `/jobs/search` — Job search with filters

**Mobile:**
- Same routes, responsive layout

#### System Touchpoints

- **search-be:** Public job search endpoint
- **jobs-be:** Public job detail endpoint (limited data)

#### Flow Steps

1. **Navigate to job search:**
   - User clicks "Find Work" or "Browse Jobs"
   - Navigate to `/jobs`
   - Load job listing page:
     - Search bar at top
     - Filters sidebar (or collapsible on mobile)
     - Job cards in grid/list view

2. **Browse jobs:**
   - Display featured/recent jobs:
     - Job card:
       - Job title: "Senior React Developer"
       - Company name: "ABC Corp" (or "Client" if confidential)
       - Job type: Full-time, Part-time, Contract
       - Budget: $5,000 - $10,000 (or hourly rate)
       - Location: Remote, San Francisco, etc.
       - Posted: "2 days ago"
       - Proposals: "15 proposals"
       - Tags: React, TypeScript, Node.js
     - Click job card to view details

3. **Search for jobs:**
   - User enters search term:
     - Example: "graphic designer"
   - Tap search button
   - Results update:
     - Display matching jobs
     - Highlight search term in results
   - BE: `GET /v1/public/jobs/search?q=graphic+designer&page=1`

4. **Apply filters:**
   - Sidebar filters:
     - **Category:**
       - Dropdown: Web Development, Design, Writing, etc.
     - **Job Type:**
       - Checkboxes: Full-time, Part-time, Contract
     - **Budget:**
       - Range slider: $0 - $10,000+
     - **Experience Level:**
       - Checkboxes: Entry, Intermediate, Expert
     - **Location:**
       - Input: City or "Remote"
     - **Date Posted:**
       - Radio: Any time, Past 24 hours, Past week, Past month
   - User selects filters
   - Results update dynamically
   - URL updates with query params:
     - `/jobs?category=web-dev&type=full-time&budget=5000-10000`

5. **View job details:**
   - User clicks job card
   - Navigate to `/jobs/abc123`
   - Display job detail page:
     - **Job title:** "Senior React Developer"
     - **Company:** ABC Corp
     - **Posted:** 3 days ago
     - **Budget:** $8,000 fixed price
     - **Duration:** 3 months
     - **Location:** Remote
     - **Description:**
       - Full job description (rich text)
       - Responsibilities
       - Requirements
     - **Skills required:**
       - Tags: React, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL
     - **Proposals:** "18 freelancers applied"
     - **CTA:**
       - Large button: "Apply Now" (requires login)
       - Ghost button: "Save Job" (requires login)

6. **Attempt to apply (requires login):**
   - User clicks "Apply Now"
   - Not authenticated
   - Redirect to signup/login:
     - Modal: "Sign up to apply"
     - Options:
       - "Continue with Google"
       - "Continue with Email"
     - Link: "Already have an account? Log in"
   - After signup/login:
     - Redirect back to job
     - Proceed with proposal submission (now authenticated flow)

7. **Save job (requires login):**
   - User clicks "Save Job"
   - Not authenticated
   - Same redirect to signup/login
   - After login:
     - Job added to saved jobs
     - Notification: "Job saved!"

8. **Pagination:**
   - Job listing shows 20 jobs per page
   - Pagination controls at bottom:
     - Previous | 1 2 3 ... 10 | Next
   - Or infinite scroll (load more on scroll)

9. **Sort options:**
   - Dropdown: "Sort by"
     - Relevance (default)
     - Newest first
     - Highest budget
     - Most proposals
   - Results re-order

10. **No results:**
    - No jobs match filters
    - Display:
      - "No jobs found"
      - Suggestions:
        - "Try different keywords"
        - "Broaden your filters"
        - "Check back later for new jobs"
      - Link: "Clear all filters"

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Limited job details (public):**
   - Some job info hidden from public:
     - Client name (if confidential)
     - Exact budget (show range)
     - Client contact info
   - Message: "Sign up to see full details"

2. **Expired jobs:**
   - Job closed or expired
   - Shown in search results but marked:
     - Badge: "Closed"
     - Grayed out
   - Job detail page:
     - Message: "This job is no longer accepting applications"
     - Suggest similar jobs

3. **Featured jobs:**
   - Paid promotion
   - Display at top of results:
     - Badge: "Featured"
     - Highlighted border
   - Not affected by filters (always visible)

4. **Recommendations:**
   - Logged-in users see personalized recommendations
   - Public users see popular/trending jobs
   - "You might also like:" section

5. **Job alerts:**
   - Option: "Get email alerts for jobs like this"
   - Requires email signup (capture lead)
   - User enters email
   - Subscribe to job alerts

6. **Share job:**
   - Share button on job detail
   - Options:
     - Copy link
     - Share on Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn
   - Shareable URL with job ID

7. **Report job:**
   - Suspicious job posting
   - Link: "Report this job"
   - Reasons:
     - Scam or fraud
     - Inappropriate content
     - Duplicate posting
   - Submit report (anonymous or requires login)

8. **Mobile filters:**
   - Filters in bottom sheet (not sidebar)
   - Button: "Filters"
   - Opens modal with all filters
   - Apply button at bottom

9. **SEO for job pages:**
   - Each job detail page indexed
   - Meta tags:
     - Title: "Senior React Developer at ABC Corp - Skillsier"
     - Description: First 150 chars of job description
   - Structured data (Job Posting schema)

10. **Load more (infinite scroll):**
    - Instead of pagination
    - Load next 20 jobs on scroll
    - Loading indicator at bottom
    - Better UX on mobile

#### Notifications

None (unauthenticated users)

#### Analytics

- public.jobs.viewed (page, filters_applied)
- public.job.detail_viewed (job_id, referrer)
- public.job.apply_clicked (job_id, authenticated)
- public.job.save_clicked (job_id, authenticated)
- public.jobs.search (query, results_count)
- public.jobs.filter_applied (filter_type, filter_value)

## PUB-3: Freelancer Profiles (Public)

**Goal:** Visitor can discover and view freelancer profiles without logging in  
**Actor:** Unauthenticated visitor, potential client  
**Preconditions:** None  
**Triggers:** Search for freelancer, view from featured profiles, organic search

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `/freelancers` — Public freelancer directory
- `/freelancers/[username]` — Public freelancer profile

**Mobile:**
- Same routes, responsive layout

#### System Touchpoints

- **search-be:** Public freelancer search
- **users-be:** Public profile endpoint (limited data)
- **portfolio-be:** Public portfolio items

#### Flow Steps

1. **Navigate to freelancer directory:**
   - User clicks "Find Talent" or "Browse Freelancers"
   - Navigate to `/freelancers`
   - Load freelancer listing page:
     - Search bar at top
     - Filters sidebar
     - Freelancer cards in grid view

2. **Browse freelancers:**
   - Display featured/top-rated freelancers:
     - Freelancer card:
       - Profile photo
       - Name: "Jane Doe"
       - Title: "Senior Graphic Designer"
       - Rating: ⭐ 4.9 (120 reviews)
       - Hourly rate: "$75/hr"
       - Location: "San Francisco, CA"
       - Skills: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma
       - Badge: "Top Rated" or "Rising Talent"
     - Click card to view full profile

3. **Search freelancers:**
   - User enters search term:
     - Example: "React developer"
   - Results update:
     - Display matching freelancers
     - Ranked by relevance
   - BE: `GET /v1/public/freelancers/search?q=react+developer&page=1`

4. **Apply filters:**
   - Sidebar filters:
     - **Skills:**
       - Input: Type to add skills
       - Tags: React, Node.js, etc.
     - **Category:**
       - Dropdown: Web Development, Design, etc.
     - **Hourly Rate:**
       - Range slider: $10 - $200+
     - **Experience Level:**
       - Checkboxes: Entry, Intermediate, Expert
     - **Location:**
       - Input: City or "Anywhere"
     - **Availability:**
       - Checkboxes: Available now, Full-time, Part-time
     - **English Level:**
       - Checkboxes: Basic, Conversational, Fluent, Native
   - User selects filters
   - Results update dynamically

5. **View freelancer profile:**
   - User clicks freelancer card
   - Navigate to `/freelancers/janedoe`
   - Display profile page:
     - **Header:**
       - Profile photo (large)
       - Name: "Jane Doe"
       - Title: "Senior Graphic Designer"
       - Location: "San Francisco, CA"
       - Member since: "2020"
       - Availability: "Available" (green badge)
       - Hourly rate: "$75/hr"
       - Job success: "95%"
       - Rating: ⭐ 4.9 (120 reviews)
       - Badges: Top Rated, Verified
     - **CTA buttons:**
       - "Hire Jane" (primary, requires login)
       - "Contact" (ghost, requires login)
     - **About:**
       - Bio: Full description (up to 500 words)
       - Written by freelancer
     - **Skills:**
       - Tags: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Branding
       - Skill endorsements (count)
     - **Portfolio:**
       - Grid of portfolio items (images/videos)
       - Click to view full project
     - **Work History:**
       - List of past projects (limited to public)
       - Client name: "ABC Corp"
       - Project title: "Brand redesign"
       - Feedback: ⭐ 5.0 "Excellent work!"
       - Note: Some details hidden (requires login)
     - **Reviews:**
       - Recent client reviews
       - Display: Name, rating, comment, date
       - Pagination: Show 5, load more
     - **Certifications:**
       - Badges: "Adobe Certified Expert"
     - **Languages:**
       - English: Native
       - Spanish: Conversational

6. **View portfolio item:**
   - User clicks portfolio item
   - Navigate to `/freelancers/janedoe/portfolio/item123`
   - Or lightbox modal
   - Display:
     - Full-size image/video
     - Project title: "E-commerce Website Redesign"
     - Description: Project details
     - Client (if public): "XYZ Inc."
     - Skills used: Tags
     - Link to live project (if available)
   - Navigation: Previous / Next item
   - CTA: "Hire Jane for a similar project"

7. **Attempt to hire (requires login):**
   - User clicks "Hire Jane"
   - Not authenticated
   - Redirect to signup/login modal
   - After login:
     - Redirect to "Invite to Job" flow
     - Or "Send Message" to discuss project

8. **Contact freelancer (requires login):**
   - User clicks "Contact"
   - Same redirect to signup/login
   - After login:
     - Open message composer
     - Pre-filled: "Hi Jane, I'm interested in hiring you for..."

9. **Similar freelancers:**
   - At bottom of profile:
     - "You might also like:"
     - Display 3-5 similar freelancers
     - Based on skills, category, rate
   - Click to view their profiles

10. **Share profile:**
    - Share button on profile
    - Options:
      - Copy link
      - Share on LinkedIn, Twitter
    - Shareable URL: `skillsier.com/freelancers/janedoe`

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Limited data (public):**
   - Some profile details hidden:
     - Exact earnings
     - Client contact info
     - Full work history
   - Message: "Sign up to see full profile"

2. **Private profiles:**
   - Freelancer set profile to private
   - Not discoverable in public search
   - Only clients who hired them can view
   - Public URL: 404 or "Profile not available"

3. **Featured freelancers:**
   - Paid promotion (like featured jobs)
   - Display at top of directory:
     - Badge: "Featured"
   - Higher visibility

4. **Top Rated badge:**
   - Earned by high-performing freelancers
   - Criteria:
     - Job success > 90%
     - Rating > 4.5
     - Completed 10+ jobs
   - Displayed prominently

5. **Rising Talent badge:**
   - New freelancers with strong start
   - Criteria:
     - Member < 6 months
     - Completed 3+ jobs
     - Rating > 4.5
   - Encourages clients to hire new talent

6. **Profile completeness:**
   - Incomplete profiles rank lower
   - Suggestions shown to freelancer (when logged in):
     - "Add portfolio items"
     - "Complete skills section"
     - "Upload profile photo"

7. **Availability status:**
   - Freelancer can set:
     - Available: Open to new projects
     - Busy: May have limited availability
     - Unavailable: Not taking new work
   - Shown on profile and search results

8. **Verified badge:**
   - Identity verified (ID check)
   - Payment method verified
   - Increases trust

9. **SEO for profiles:**
   - Each profile indexed
   - Meta tags:
     - Title: "Jane Doe - Senior Graphic Designer | Skillsier"
     - Description: First 150 chars of bio
   - Structured data (Person schema)

10. **Report profile:**
    - Suspicious or inappropriate profile
    - Link: "Report this profile"
    - Reasons:
      - Fake profile
      - Inappropriate content
      - Scam
    - Submit report

#### Notifications

None (unauthenticated users)

- public.freelancers.viewed (page, filters_applied)

## PUB-4: Pricing & Plans

**Goal:** Visitor understands pricing structure and can compare plans to make informed decision  
**Actor:** Unauthenticated visitor, potential user  
**Preconditions:** None  
**Triggers:** Click "Pricing" from navigation, landing page CTA

### Primary Screens

**Web:**
- `/pricing` — Pricing comparison page
- `/pricing/freelancer` — Freelancer-specific pricing

**Mobile:**

#### System Touchpoints

- **Static content:** No backend calls (or subscription-be for plan details)

#### Flow Steps

1. **Navigate to pricing page:**
   - User clicks "Pricing" in navigation
   - Navigate to `/pricing`
   - Display pricing page:
     - Toggle at top: "I'm a Freelancer" / "I'm a Client"
     - Default: Show freelancer pricing

2. **View freelancer pricing:**
   - Toggle set to "Freelancer"
   - Display subscription tiers:
     - **Free:**
       - Price: $0/month
       - Features:
         - 10 connects/month
         - 20% platform fee
         - Basic profile
         - Access to all jobs
         - Standard support
       - CTA: "Get Started"
     - **Basic:** (Most Popular)
       - Price: $14.99/month
       - Features:
         - 40 connects/month
         - 15% platform fee
         - Enhanced profile
         - Priority support
         - Access to all jobs
       - CTA: "Start Free Trial" (14 days)
     - **Plus:**
       - Price: $29.99/month
       - Features:
         - 80 connects/month
         - 10% platform fee
         - Premium profile badge
         - Priority in search
         - Dedicated account manager
         - Custom proposals
       - CTA: "Start Free Trial"
     - **Pro:**
       - Price: $49.99/month
       - Features:
         - 120 connects/month
         - 5% platform fee
         - Featured profile
         - Top of search results
         - White-glove support
         - Portfolio showcases
         - Early access to jobs
       - CTA: "Contact Sales"

3. **View client pricing:**
   - Toggle set to "Client"
   - Display client plans:
     - **Pay As You Go:**
       - Price: Free to join
       - Features:
         - Unlimited job posts
         - 5% processing fee
         - Standard support
         - Access to all freelancers
       - CTA: "Get Started"
     - **Small Business:**
       - Price: $49/month
       - Features:
         - Unlimited job posts
         - 3% processing fee
         - Priority support
         - Team collaboration (up to 5)
         - Saved freelancers list
       - CTA: "Start Free Trial"
     - **Enterprise:**
       - Price: Custom
       - Features:
         - Everything in Small Business
         - Custom contract templates
         - Dedicated account manager
         - API access
         - Advanced reporting
         - Onboarding assistance
       - CTA: "Contact Sales"

4. **Feature comparison table:**
   - Below tier cards
   - Expandable table:
     - Columns: Free, Basic, Plus, Pro
     - Rows: All features with checkmarks
   - Detailed breakdown:
     - Connects per month
     - Platform fee %
     - Profile features
     - Search visibility
     - Support level
     - Additional perks
   - Allows detailed comparison

5. **FAQ section:**
   - Common questions:
     - "What are connects?"
     - "Can I change plans anytime?"
     - "What payment methods are accepted?"
     - "Is there a long-term commitment?"
     - "What happens if I cancel?"
   - Expandable answers

6. **CTA buttons:**
   - Each plan has clear CTA:
     - Free plan: "Get Started" → Signup
     - Paid plans: "Start Free Trial" → Signup with trial
     - Enterprise: "Contact Sales" → Contact form

7. **Start free trial:**
   - User clicks "Start Free Trial"
   - Redirect to signup:
     - Pre-selected plan
     - Trial: 14 days free, then $14.99/month
   - After signup:
     - Trial activated
     - Credit card required (not charged during trial)

8. **Contact sales:**
   - User clicks "Contact Sales"
   - Navigate to `/contact-sales`
   - Or modal form:
     - Name
     - Email
     - Company name
     - Team size
     - Message
   - Submit form
   - BE: `POST /v1/contact/sales`
   - Confirmation: "Thanks! We'll be in touch soon."

9. **Calculate savings:**
   - Interactive calculator (optional):
     - "How much can you save?"
     - Input: Average project size
     - Input: Projects per month
     - Calculate:
       - Total fees on Free plan
       - Total fees on Plus plan
       - Savings: $X/month
   - Encourages upgrade

10. **Switch between freelancer/client:**
    - Toggle updates all content:
      - Tier cards
      - Feature table
      - FAQs
    - Smooth transition
    - URL updates: `/pricing?type=client`

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Annual billing discount:**
   - Toggle: "Monthly" / "Annually"
   - Annual: 20% discount
   - Example:
     - Monthly: $29.99/month
     - Annual: $287.90/year ($23.99/month, save $72)
   - Encourage annual commitment

2. **Limited-time promotion:**
   - Banner at top:
     - "Special offer: Get 30% off your first 3 months!"
     - Countdown timer: "Ends in 2 days"
   - Promo code applied automatically

3. **Custom plans for teams:**
   - Large teams need custom pricing
   - Link: "Need a custom plan? Contact us"
   - Or: "Teams of 10+? Special pricing available"

4. **Add-ons:**
   - Additional features available for purchase:
     - Extra connects: $10 for 20 connects
     - Featured listing: $50/month
     - Portfolio showcase: $25/month
   - Display in pricing or separate page

5. **Currency selection:**
   - Detect user location
   - Display prices in local currency:
     - USD, EUR, GBP, etc.
   - Currency switcher in footer

6. **Testimonials:**
   - Include user testimonials:
     - "Upgrading to Plus was the best decision. I tripled my income!"
     - Name, Title, Photo
   - Social proof for paid plans

7. **Compare with competitors:**
   - Section: "How we compare"
   - Table: Skillsier vs Competitor A vs Competitor B
   - Highlight Skillsier's advantages

8. **Money-back guarantee:**
   - Badge: "30-day money-back guarantee"
   - Build trust
   - Details in FAQ

9. **Accessibility:**
   - Ensure pricing table is screen-reader friendly
   - Keyboard navigable
   - High contrast for readability

10. **Mobile optimization:**
    - Pricing cards stack vertically
    - Toggle easily accessible
    - Comparison table scrollable (horizontal)

None (public page)

       - "We use cookies to improve your experience. By continuing, you accept our Cookie Policy."
       - Buttons:
         - "Accept All"
         - "Customize"
         - Link: "Learn More" → Cookie Policy
   - User clicks "Accept All"
   - Store consent in browser (cookie/localStorage)
   - Banner dismissed

5. **Customize cookie preferences:**
   - User clicks "Customize"
   - Modal opens:
     - **Essential Cookies:** ON (cannot disable)
     - **Performance Cookies:** Toggle (ON/OFF)
     - **Functionality Cookies:** Toggle (ON/OFF)
     - **Targeting Cookies:** Toggle (ON/OFF)
   - User adjusts preferences
   - Click "Save Preferences"
   - Store preferences
   - Load scripts accordingly (e.g., Google Analytics only if Performance ON)

6. **Navigate to Acceptable Use Policy:**
   - User clicks "Acceptable Use" in legal footer section
   - Navigate to `/legal/acceptable-use`
   - Display:
     - Prohibited activities:
       - Harassment
       - Spam
       - Fraud
       - Illegal activities
     - Consequences of violations

7. **Navigate to DMCA Policy:**
   - User clicks "Copyright / DMCA"
   - Navigate to `/legal/dmca`
   - Display:
     - Copyright infringement reporting process
     - Form to submit DMCA takedown request:
       - Name
       - Contact email
       - Description of copyrighted work
       - URL of infringing content
       - Sworn statement
     - Submit form
     - BE: `POST /v1/legal/dmca-report`

8. **Data subject rights (GDPR/CCPA):**
   - In Privacy Policy:
     - Section: "Your Rights"
     - List of rights:
       - Right to access your data
       - Right to rectification
       - Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)
       - Right to data portability
       - Right to object
   - Link: "Exercise Your Rights" → Navigate to `/legal/data-request`

9. **Data request form:**
   - Navigate to `/legal/data-request`
   - Display form:
     - **Request Type:**
       - Radio: Data Export, Data Deletion, Correct Data
     - **Email:** (to verify identity)
     - **Description:** (optional)
     - **Proof of Identity:** Upload ID (required for deletion)
     - Submit button
   - User submits
   - BE: `POST /v1/privacy/request`
   - Confirmation:
     - "Request received. We'll respond within 30 days."
   - Email confirmation sent

10. **Legal updates notification:**
    - When Terms or Privacy updated:
      - Email to all users:
        - "We've updated our Privacy Policy"
        - Summary of changes
        - Link to view full policy
        - "By continuing to use Skillsier, you agree to the updated terms"
      - In-app banner (for logged-in users):
        - "We've updated our Terms. Please review."
        - Link to Terms
        - Acknowledge button

#### Branches & Edge Cases

1. **Multiple language versions:**
   - Legal docs translated
   - Language selector at top of page
   - Example: EN, ES, FR, DE
   - Note: "English version is legally binding"

2. **Version history:**
   - Link: "View Previous Versions"
   - Archive of old Terms/Privacy policies
   - User can see what changed

3. **Print-friendly format:**
   - Link: "Print this page"
   - CSS: Hide navigation, optimize for print

4. **Download as PDF:**
   - Link: "Download PDF"
   - Generate PDF of legal document
   - User can save for records

5. **Effective date:**
   - Clearly state: "Effective as of January 1, 2025"
   - If user signed up before this date:
     - Old terms apply unless explicitly agreed to new

6. **Acceptance during signup:**
   - Signup form:
     - Checkbox: "I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy"
     - Links to both documents
     - Required to proceed

7. **Jurisdiction:**
   - Terms specify governing law:
     - Example: "Governed by laws of California, USA"
   - Dispute resolution:
     - Arbitration clause

8. **Contact for legal inquiries:**
   - Email: legal@skillsier.com
   - Address: Legal Department, Skillsier Inc., [Address]

9. **Accessibility:**
   - Legal docs can be long
   - Ensure:
     - Clear headings
     - Skip links
     - Screen reader friendly

10. **Cookie banner compliance:**
    - GDPR requires explicit consent
    - Banner must:
      - Appear before cookies set (except essential)
      - Provide clear options
      - Allow rejection
    - Avoid pre-ticked boxes

#### Notifications

**Legal Update:**
- **Email:** "We've updated our [Terms/Privacy]. Please review."
- **In-app banner:** "Updated Terms. [View]"

**Data Request Received:**
- **Email:** "We've received your data request. We'll respond within 30 days."

**Data Request Completed:**
- **Email:** "Your data export is ready. [Download Link]" (expires in 7 days)
- Or: "Your data has been deleted as requested."

#### Analytics

- legal.page.viewed (document_type, referrer)
- legal.section.viewed (document_type, section_name, scroll_depth)
- legal.cookie_banner.action (action_type)
- legal.cookie_preferences.updated (preferences)
- legal.data_request.submitted (request_type)
- legal.pdf.downloaded (document_type)
- legal.dmca.submitted ()

#### Sources

**Frontend:** apps/web/app/(public)/legal/, combined-fe-folder-structure.md

## SECTION R: COMMUNICATIONS & MESSAGING

### Journey: COM-1 (Conversations & Direct Messaging)

**ID:** COM-1  
**Persona:** All Users (Freelancers, Clients, Admins)  
**Description:** Comprehensive messaging system enabling users to create and manage 1-on-1 and group conversations with features including participant management, conversation metadata, archiving, pinning, muting, typing indicators, read receipts, and message delivery status. Supports project-related conversations, general inquiries, and team collaboration.  

**Preconditions & Triggers:**  
**Triggers:**  
- User clicks "Message" button on another user's profile  
- User clicks "Start Conversation" in messages dashboard  
- User receives a message notification and clicks to view  
- User navigates to (dashboard)/messages  
- Client wants to message freelancer after accepting proposal  
- Freelancer wants to message client about project details  
- User clicks "Message" from job posting, proposal, or contract  
- System creates auto-conversation when contract is signed  
- User searches for existing conversation  
- User receives invitation to join group conversation  

**Preconditions:**  
- User is authenticated  
- User has active account (not suspended)  
- For direct messages: Target user exists and is contactable  
- For group conversations: User has permission to create groups  
- User's account has messaging enabled (not restricted)  
- Conversation limits not exceeded (max conversations per user)  

**Primary Screens:**  
**Web:**  
- `(dashboard)/messages/page.tsx` — Main messages inbox/list  
- `(dashboard)/messages/[conversationId]/page.tsx` — Single conversation view  
- `(dashboard)/messages/new/page.tsx` — New conversation creation  
- `(dashboard)/messages/[conversationId]/settings/page.tsx` — Conversation settings  
- `(dashboard)/messages/archived/page.tsx` — Archived conversations  
- `(dashboard)/messages/search/page.tsx` — Search conversations  
- `(dashboard)/messages/groups/new/page.tsx` — Create group conversation  

**Mobile:**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/index.tsx` — Messages list  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/index.tsx` — Conversation detail  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/info.tsx` — Conversation info  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/settings.tsx` — Settings  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/new/index.tsx` — New message  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/new/select-participants.tsx` — Select recipients  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/search.tsx` — Search messages  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/archived.tsx` — Archived list  

**System Touchpoints:**  
- **communications-be:**  
  - `conversation/entity.go` — Core conversation entity  
  - `conversation_participant/entity.go` — Participant management  
  - `conversation_settings/entity.go` — Conversation settings  
  - `message/entity.go` — Message entity (referenced)  
  - `POST /v1/conversations` — Create conversation  
  - `GET /v1/conversations` — List user's conversations  
  - `GET /v1/conversations/{id}` — Get conversation details  
  - `PUT /v1/conversations/{id}` — Update conversation metadata  
  - `DELETE /v1/conversations/{id}` — Delete conversation (admin only)  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/participants` — Add participant  
  - `DELETE /v1/conversations/{id}/participants/{user_id}` — Remove participant  
  - `PUT /v1/conversations/{id}/participants/{user_id}` — Update participant role  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/archive` — Archive conversation  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/unarchive` — Unarchive conversation  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/leave` — Leave conversation  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/pin` — Pin conversation  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/unpin` — Unpin conversation  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/mute` — Mute notifications  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/unmute` — Unmute notifications  
  - `GET /v1/conversations/{id}/participants` — List participants  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/settings` — Update settings (TTL, legal hold, slow mode)  
  - `GET /v1/conversations/{id}/settings` — Get settings  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/typing` — Send typing indicator  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/read` — Mark as read  
  - `GET /v1/conversations/search` — Search conversations  
- **users-be:**  
  - `GET /v1/users/{id}` — Get user details for participants  
  - `GET /v1/users/search` — Search users for new conversations  
  - `GET /v1/users/{id}/profile` — Get profile info for conversation preview  
  - `GET /v1/users/blocklist` — Check if user is blocked  
- **contracts-be:**  
  - `GET /v1/contracts/{id}` — Get contract details (for contract-linked conversations)  
  - `GET /v1/contracts/{id}/conversation` — Get associated conversation  
- **jobs-be:**  
  - `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` — Get job details (for job-linked conversations)  
- **storage-be:**  
  - `GET /v1/storage/avatars/{id}` — Get conversation avatar image  
  - `POST /v1/storage/avatars` — Upload conversation avatar  
- **moderation-be:**  
  - `POST /v1/moderation/conversation/validate` — Validate conversation title/topic  
  - `GET /v1/moderation/users/{id}/permissions` — Check messaging permissions  
- **Events:**  
  - Publish: `conversation.created.v1`, `conversation.updated.v1`, `conversation.deleted.v1`, `conversation.participant.added.v1`, `conversation.participant.removed.v1`, `conversation.archived.v1`, `conversation.unarchived.v1`, `conversation.pinned.v1`, `conversation.unpinned.v1`, `conversation.muted.v1`, `conversation.unmuted.v1`, `conversation.typing.v1`, `conversation.read.v1`

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**A1: Access Messages Dashboard**  
1. User navigates to messages section:  
   - From navigation: Clicks "Messages" icon/link  
   - From notification: Clicks message notification  
   - From profile: Clicks "Message" button on user profile  
   - Direct URL: (dashboard)/messages  
2. System loads messages dashboard:  
   - Call: `GET /v1/conversations?user_id={user_id}&status=active&limit=50&offset=0`  
   - Fetch user's active conversations  
   - Sort by: Last message timestamp (most recent first)  
   - Include unread count per conversation  
3. Display messages list view with:  
   - Left Sidebar (Web) / Full Screen (Mobile):  
     - Search bar at top  
     - Filter tabs: All | Unread | Archived | Pinned  
     - Conversation list:  
       - Each conversation shows:  
         - Avatar (user/group)  
         - Name/Title  
         - Last message preview (truncated)  
         - Timestamp (relative: "2m ago", "Yesterday", "Jan 15")  
         - Unread badge (if unread messages)  
         - Pin indicator (if pinned)  
         - Mute indicator (if muted)  
         - Typing indicator (if someone typing)  
         - Message delivery status (last message)  
     - New message button (floating action button)  
     - Pinned conversations appear at top  
     - Unread conversations highlighted  
   - Right Panel (Web) / Separate Screen (Mobile):  
     - Empty state: "Select a conversation to start messaging"  
     - Or: Selected conversation view (COM-2)  

**A2: Create New 1-on-1 Conversation**  
1. User clicks "New Message" button  
2. Navigate to: (dashboard)/messages/new  
3. Display new message screen:  
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ New Message                                             [✕ Close] │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ To: [Search users...                                    ] [🔍]   │
│     ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐       │
│     │ Search Results:                                    │       │
│     │ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │       │
│     │ │ 👤 John Smith                                │   │       │
│     │ │    Freelancer • Full-Stack Developer         │   │       │
│     │ │    ⭐ 4.9 (127 reviews)               [Select]│   │       │
│     │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │       │
│     │ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │       │
│     │ │ 👤 Sarah Johnson                             │   │       │
│     │ │    Client • Marketing Agency                 │   │       │
│     │ │    ⭐ 5.0 (45 reviews)                [Select]│   │       │
│     │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │       │
│     └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘       │
│                                                                   │
│ Subject (optional): [_________________________]                   │
│                                                                   │
│ Message:                                                          │
│ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│ │ Hi, I'm interested in discussing...                         │  │
│ │                                                             │  │
│ │                                                             │  │
│ │                                                             │  │
│ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│ 0 / 5000 characters                                               │
│                                                                   │
│ [📎 Attach]    [😊 Emoji]                [Cancel] [Send Message] │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
4. User Searches for Recipient:  
   - User types in "To:" field  
   - System performs live search: `GET /v1/users/search?q={query}&type=messageable`  
   - Display matching users:  
     - Avatar, name, role, rating  
     - Recent interaction indicator (if any)  
     - [Select] button  
   - Filter out:  
     - Blocked users  
     - Users who blocked current user  
     - Suspended/inactive accounts  
5. User selects recipient  
6. System checks existing conversation:  
   - Call: `GET /v1/conversations?participants={user_id},{recipient_id}&type=direct`  
   - If conversation exists:  
     - Display notice: "You have an existing conversation with this user"  
     - Options:  
       - [Open Existing] — Navigate to existing conversation  
       - [Start New] — Create separate conversation  
7. If No Existing Conversation:  
   - User optionally adds subject  
   - User types message  
   - User clicks "Send Message"  
8. System creates conversation:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations`  
   - Request body:  
```json
{  
  "type": "direct",  
  "participant_ids": ["user_id", "recipient_id"],  
  "metadata": {  
    "subject": "Project Discussion",  
    "context": null  
  },  
  "settings": {  
    "ttl_enabled": false,  
    "legal_hold": false,  
    "slow_mode": false  
  }  
}  
```
   - Backend creates conversation:  
     - Generate conversation_id  
     - Add both participants with role: member  
     - Set created_at, updated_at  
     - Initialize message_count: 0  
     - Set is_group: false  
   - Backend publishes event: `conversation.created.v1`  
9. System sends initial message (see COM-2)  
10. Navigate to conversation: (dashboard)/messages/{conversationId}  

**A3: Create Group Conversation**  
1. User clicks "New Message" → "Create Group"  
2. Navigate to: (dashboard)/messages/groups/new  
3. Display group creation wizard:  
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Create Group Conversation                               [✕ Close] │

│ │ 👤 Sarah Johnson           Client              [Remove ✕]   │  │
│ │ 👤 Mike Davis              Designer            [Remove ✕]   │  │

│ Add More:                                                         │

└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
4. Step 1: Select Participants  
   - User searches and adds participants  
   - System validates:  
     - Min participants: 3 (including creator)  
     - Max participants: 50  
     - No blocked users  
     - All users have messaging enabled  
   - Display selected participants list  
   - User can remove participants  
5. User clicks "Next: Group Info"  
6. Display group info step:  
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Create Group Conversation                     [← Back] [✕ Close] │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Step 2: Group Information                                         │
│                                                                   │
│ Group Name*: [E-commerce Project Team__________________]          │
│              (Required, 3-100 characters)                         │
│                                                                   │
│ Description: [________________________________________________]    │
│              [________________________________________________]    │
│              [________________________________________________]    │
│              (Optional, max 500 characters)                       │
│              147 / 500                                            │
│                                                                   │
│ Topic/Tags:  [project  ✕] [urgent  ✕] [+Add Tag]                 │
│                                                                   │
│ Group Avatar:                                                     │
│ ┌──────────┐                                                      │
│ │          │  [Upload Image] [Choose Icon]                        │
│ │   [📷]   │                                                       │
│ │          │  Recommended: 256x256px, max 2MB                     │
│ └──────────┘                                                      │
│                                                                   │
│ Settings:                                                         │
│ ☑ Allow members to invite others                                 │
│ ☑ Allow members to leave                                         │
│ ☐ Only admins can send messages (announcement mode)              │
│                                                                   │
│                                  [← Back] [Create Group]          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
7. Step 2: Configure Group:  
   - User enters group name (required)  
   - User adds description (optional)  
   - User adds topic tags (optional)  
   - User uploads/selects group avatar (optional)  
   - User configures settings:  
     - Can members invite others?  
     - Can members leave?  
     - Is announcement mode? (only admins send)  
8. User clicks "Create Group"  
9. System validates:  
   - Group name not empty  
   - Group name 3-100 characters  
   - Description ≤ 500 characters  
   - Avatar valid format/size (if uploaded)  
10. System creates group conversation:  
    - Call: `POST /v1/conversations`  
    - Request body:  
```json
{  
  "type": "group",  
  "name": "E-commerce Project Team",  
  "description": "Discussion about new e-commerce platform",  
  "topic": ["project", "urgent"],  
  "participant_ids": ["creator_id", "user1_id", "user2_id"],  
  "settings": {  
    "allow_member_invites": true,  
    "allow_leave": true,  
    "announcement_mode": false,  
    "ttl_enabled": false,  
    "legal_hold": false,  
    "slow_mode": false  
  },  
  "metadata": {  
    "avatar_url": "https://storage.skillsier.com/avatars/group_123.png"  
  }  
}  
```
    - Backend creates conversation:  
      - Set is_group: true  
      - Add creator as admin  
      - Add other participants as members  
      - Store group metadata  
    - Backend publishes event: `conversation.created.v1`  
    - Notify all participants: `conversation.participant.added.v1`  
11. Display success: - Toast: "Group created successfully" - Navigate to group conversation  
12. System sends system message: - "[Creator Name] created the group"  

**A4: View Conversation List**  
1. User is on messages dashboard  
2. System displays conversation list:  
   - Sorted by last activity  
   - Pinned conversations at top (max 5 pinned)

     - Online status dot (green/offline)  
3. Conversation Preview:  
   - Avatar: User avatar or group icon  
   - Name: User name or group name  
   - Last message: Preview (max 60 chars)  
   - Timestamp: Relative or absolute  
   - Unread badge: Count of unread messages  
   - Indicators: Pinned, muted, typing  
4. List Actions (Web - hover):  
   - [📌 Pin] — Pin conversation  
   - [🔕 Mute] — Mute notifications  
   - [📦 Archive] — Archive conversation  
   - [⋮ More] — More options menu  
5. List Actions (Mobile - swipe):  
   - Swipe left: Pin, Mute, Archive, More  
   - Swipe right: Mark read/unread  

**A5: Filter & Search Conversations**  
1. User clicks filter tabs:  
   - All: Show all active conversations  
   - Unread: Only conversations with unread messages  
   - Archived: Archived conversations  
   - Pinned: Only pinned conversations  
2. System filters list accordingly  
3. Search:  
   - User types in search bar  
   - System searches:  
     - Conversation names/titles  
     - Participant names  
     - Message content (last N messages)  
   - Call: `GET /v1/conversations/search?q={query}&user_id={user_id}`  
   - Display matching conversations  
   - Highlight search terms  
4. Advanced Filters (dropdown):  
   - Type: Direct | Group | All  
   - Status: Active | Archived | All  
   - Date range: Last day | Week | Month | Custom  
   - Has: Attachments | Links | Unread

│ │ 👤 Lisa Chen             Developer   [+ Add]     │   │
│ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                        │
│ Selected (2):                                          │
│ [Alex Thompson ✕] [Lisa Chen ✕]                       │
│                                                        │
│                              [Cancel] [Add Members]    │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
3. User searches for user  
4. User selects users to add  
5. User clicks "Add Members"  
6. System validates:  
   - User has permission (admin or members can invite setting)  
   - New participants not already in group  
   - Total participants ≤ 50  
   - Users not blocked  
7. System adds participants:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/participants`  
   - Request body:  
```json
{  
  "user_ids": ["user1_id", "user2_id"],  
  "role": "member",  
  "added_by": "current_user_id"  
}  
```
   - Backend adds participants  
   - Publish event: `conversation.participant.added.v1`  
8. System sends notification to new participants  
9. System sends system message: "[Current User] added [New User 1], [New User 2]"  
10. Update participants list in UI  

**A8: Remove Participant from Group**  
1. From group settings, admin clicks [Remove] next to participant  
2. Display confirmation:  
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Remove Member?                                      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Are you sure you want to remove Mike Davis         │
│ from this group?                                    │
│                                                     │
│ They will no longer be able to see new messages.   │
│                                                     │
│                          [Cancel] [Remove Member]   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
3. User confirms removal  
4. System validates:  
   - Current user is admin  
   - Target is not the last admin (if removing admin)  
   - Target is member of group  
5. System removes participant:  
   - Call: `DELETE /v1/conversations/{id}/participants/{user_id}`  
   - Backend removes participant  
   - Publish event: `conversation.participant.removed.v1`  
6. System sends notification to removed user  
7. System sends system message: "[Current User] removed [Removed User]"  
8. Update participants list in UI  
9. Removed user no longer sees conversation in their list  

**A9: Update Participant Role**  
1. Admin clicks [⋮] next to participant → "Make Admin" or "Make Member"  
2. Display confirmation:  
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Change Role?                                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Make Mike Davis an admin?                           │
│                                                     │
│ Admins can:                                         │
│ • Add/remove members                                │
│ • Change group settings                             │
│ • Delete messages                                   │
│ • Manage roles                                      │
│                                                     │
│                          [Cancel] [Make Admin]      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
3. User confirms  
4. System updates role:  
   - Call: `PUT /v1/conversations/{id}/participants/{user_id}`  
   - Request body:  
```json
{  
  "role": "admin"  
}  
```
   - Backend updates role  
5. System sends system message: "[Current User] made [Target User] an admin"  
6. Update UI to reflect new role  

**A10: Leave Conversation**  
1. User clicks "Leave Group" or "Leave Conversation"  
2. Display confirmation:  
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Leave Group?                                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Are you sure you want to leave this group?          │
│                                                     │
│ You will:                                           │
│ • No longer receive messages                        │
│ • Need to be re-invited to rejoin                   │
│ • Lose access to conversation history               │
│                                                     │
│ ⚠️  Warning: If you're the last admin, the group    │
│    may be deleted or orphaned.                      │
│                                                     │
│                          [Cancel] [Leave Group]     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
3. User confirms  
4. System validates:  
   - If user is last admin:  
     - Prompt to assign new admin first  
     - Or: Auto-promote longest member to admin  
   - Check leave permission (allowed by settings)  
5. System removes user:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/leave`  
   - Backend removes user as participant  
   - Publish event: `conversation.participant.removed.v1`  
6. System sends system message: "[User Name] left the group"  
7. Remove conversation from user's list  
8. Navigate to messages dashboard  

**A11: Archive Conversation**  
1. User selects conversation  
2. User clicks [📦 Archive] or swipes → Archive  
3. System archives:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/archive`  
   - Backend marks conversation as archived for this user  
   - Publish event: `conversation.archived.v1`  
4. Remove from active conversations list  
5. Move to "Archived" tab  
6. Display toast: "Conversation archived"  
7. Undo option:  
   - Toast shows [Undo] button for 5 seconds  
   - If clicked, unarchive immediately  

**A12: Unarchive Conversation**  
1. User navigates to "Archived" tab  
2. User selects archived conversation  
3. User clicks [Unarchive] or swipes → Unarchive  
4. System unarchives:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/unarchive`  
   - Backend marks as active  
   - Publish event: `conversation.unarchived.v1`  
5. Move back to active conversations list  
6. Display toast: "Conversation unarchived"  

**A13: Pin Conversation**  
1. User hovers over conversation (web) or swipes (mobile)  
2. User clicks [📌 Pin]  
3. System validates:  
   - Max 5 pinned conversations  
   - If at limit: Display error "You can pin up to 5 conversations"  
4. System pins conversation:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/pin`  
   - Backend stores pin state per user  
   - Publish event: `conversation.pinned.v1`  
5. Move conversation to top of list  
6. Display pin indicator  
7. Display toast: "Conversation pinned"  

**A14: Unpin Conversation**  
1. User clicks [📌 Unpin] on pinned conversation  
2. System unpins:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/unpin`  
   - Backend removes pin state  
   - Publish event: `conversation.unpinned.v1`  
3. Conversation returns to normal sort order  
4. Remove pin indicator  
5. Display toast: "Conversation unpinned"  

**A15: Mute Conversation**  
1. User clicks [🔕 Mute]  
2. Display mute options:  
```
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│ Mute Notifications               │
├──────────────────────────────────┤
│ ○ For 1 hour                     │
│ ○ For 8 hours                    │
│ ○ For 24 hours                   │
│ ○ Until I unmute                 │
│                                  │
│           [Cancel] [Mute]        │
└──────────────────────────────────┘
```
3. User selects mute duration  
4. System mutes:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/mute`  
   - Request body:  
```json
{  
  "duration": 86400,  
  "until": "2025-01-16T10:30:00Z"  
}  
```
   - Backend stores mute setting per user  
   - Publish event: `conversation.muted.v1`  
5. Display mute indicator (🔕)  
6. Suppress notifications until unmuted or duration expires  
7. Display toast: "Muted for 24 hours"  

**A16: Unmute Conversation**  
1. User clicks [🔕 Unmuted] or [🔔 Unmute]  
2. System unmutes:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/unmute`  
   - Backend removes mute setting  
   - Publish event: `conversation.unmuted.v1`  
3. Remove mute indicator  
4. Resume notifications  
5. Display toast: "Notifications enabled"  

**A17: Update Conversation Metadata**  
1. Admin opens group settings  
2. Admin clicks "Edit Group Info"  
3. Display edit form:  
   - Group name field  
   - Description field  
   - Topic/tags field  
   - Avatar upload  
4. Admin makes changes  
5. Admin clicks "Save Changes"  
6. System validates:  
   - Name not empty  
   - Name 3-100 characters  
   - Description ≤ 500 characters  
7. System updates:  
   - Call: `PUT /v1/conversations/{id}`  
   - Request body:  
```json
{  
  "name": "Updated Group Name",  
  "description": "New description",  
  "topic": ["updated", "tags"],  
  "avatar_url": "new_url"  
}  
```
   - Backend updates conversation metadata  
   - Publish event: `conversation.updated.v1`  
8. System sends system message: "[Admin] changed the group name to 'Updated Group Name'"  
9. Update UI across all participants  
10. Display toast: "Group info updated"  

**A18: Configure Conversation Settings**  
1. Admin opens conversation settings  
2. Admin toggles settings:  
   - TTL (Self-Destruct):  
     - Enable/disable  
     - Set duration: 1 hour, 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days  
     - Messages auto-delete after TTL  
   - Legal Hold:  
     - Enable/disable  
     - Prevents message deletion  
     - For compliance/audit purposes  
   - Slow Mode:  
     - Enable/disable  
     - Set interval: 5s, 30s, 1m, 5m  
     - Rate limit user messages  
   - Member Permissions:  
     - Can invite others?  
     - Can leave?  
     - Can send messages (announcement mode)?  
3. Admin clicks "Save Settings"  
4. System updates:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/settings`  
   - Request body:  
```json
{  
  "ttl_enabled": true,  
  "ttl_duration": 86400,  
  "legal_hold": false,  
  "slow_mode": true,  
  "slow_mode_interval": 30,  
  "allow_member_invites": true,  
  "allow_leave": true,  
  "announcement_mode": false  
}  
```
   - Backend updates settings  
5. System sends system message: "[Admin] enabled message self-destruct (24 hours)"  
6. Apply settings immediately  
7. Display toast: "Settings updated"  

**A19: Typing Indicators**  
1. User starts typing in message input  
2. System sends typing event:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/typing`  
   - WebSocket message:  
```json
{  
  "event": "typing",  
  "conversation_id": "conv_123",  
  "user_id": "user_456",  
  "timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:30:00Z"  
}  
```
3. Backend broadcasts to other participants  
4. Other users see typing indicator:  
   - "John is typing..."  
   - For groups: "John, Sarah are typing..."  
5. Typing indicator expires after 5 seconds  

**A20: Read Receipts & Delivery Status**  
1. When user opens conversation:  
   - System marks messages as read  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/read`  
   - Request body:  
```json
{  
  "last_read_message_id": "msg_789",  
  "timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:30:00Z"  
}  
```
   - Backend updates participant's last_read_message_id  
   - Publish event: `conversation.read.v1`  
2. Sender sees read receipts:  
   - Direct conversations:  
     - ✓ Sent (gray)  
     - ✓✓ Delivered (gray)  
     - ✓✓ Read (blue)  
   - Group conversations:  
     - Show count: "Read by 3/5"  
     - Click to see who read  
3. Privacy Settings:  
   - Users can disable read receipts in settings  
   - If disabled: Sender sees ✓✓ Delivered only  
   - Trade-off: User also doesn't see others' read receipts  

---

#### Edge Cases & Alternate Flows

**B1: Blocked User**  
- If user tries to message blocked user:  
  - Display error: "You cannot message this user"  
  - Explain: Blocked or block relationship  
  - Options: [Unblock] [Cancel]  
- If user is blocked by target:  
  - Same error, but don't reveal they're blocked  
  - Generic: "Cannot start conversation"  

**B2: Suspended User**  
- If user is suspended:  
  - Messaging disabled  
  - Display banner: "Your account is suspended. Contact support."  
  - View-only mode: Can view but not send  

**B3: Maximum Conversations Limit**  
- If user exceeds conversation limit:  
  - Display error: "You've reached the maximum number of active conversations (500)"  
  - Suggest: Archive old conversations  
  - [Manage Conversations] button  

**B4: Maximum Participants Limit (Group)**  
- When adding participants, if limit reached:  
  - Display error: "Maximum 50 participants"  
  - Prevent adding more  

**B5: Last Admin Leaving Group**  
- If last admin tries to leave:  
  - Display warning: "You're the last admin"  
  - Options:  
    - Promote another member to admin first  
    - Delete the group  
    - Cancel  
- If user proceeds without promoting:  
  - Auto-promote longest-standing member  

**B6: Group Deletion**  
- Only creators can delete groups  
- When deleting:  
  - Confirmation modal:  
    - "Delete this group permanently?"  
    - "All messages will be deleted for everyone"  
    - "This action cannot be undone"  
    - [Cancel] [Delete Group]  
  - On confirm:  
    - Call: `DELETE /v1/conversations/{id}`  
    - Backend soft-deletes conversation  
    - Removes for all participants  
    - System message in remaining places (if applicable)  

**B7: Conversation Not Found**  
- If conversation_id invalid or deleted:  
  - Display error: "Conversation not found"  
  - Navigate back to messages list  
  - Suggest: "This conversation may have been deleted"  

**B8: Permission Denied**  
- If user lacks permission:  
  - Display error: "You don't have permission to perform this action"  
  - Examples:  
    - Non-admin trying to add participants (if restricted)  
    - Trying to remove admin  
    - Trying to change settings  

**B9: Network Errors**  
- If API call fails:  
  - Display error toast: "Failed to [action]. Please try again."  
  - [Retry] button  
  - Cache local state if possible  
  - Retry on reconnection  

**B10: Concurrent Modifications**  
- If two admins modify settings simultaneously:  
  - Last write wins  
  - Display notification: "Settings were updated by another admin"  
  - Refresh settings view  

**B11: Participant Already in Group**  
- If trying to add existing participant:  
  - Display error: "User is already in this group"  
  - Remove from selected list  

**B12: Empty Group Name**  
- If submitting without name:  
  - Display error: "Group name is required"  
  - Highlight field in red  
  - Focus input  

**B13: Invalid Avatar Upload**  
- If avatar upload fails:  
  - Display error: "Failed to upload avatar"  
  - Reasons: Too large, wrong format, network error  
  - Allow retry  

**B14: Mute Expiry**  
- When mute duration expires:  
  - Auto-unmute conversation  
  - Display notification: "Notifications re-enabled for [Conversation]"  
  - Remove mute indicator  

**B15: Slow Mode Rate Limit**  
- If user tries to send message during slow mode cooldown:  
  - Display error: "Please wait [X] seconds before sending another message"  
  - Show countdown timer  
  - Disable send button until cooldown expires  

**B16: TTL Message Expiry**  
- When message TTL expires:  
  - Backend deletes message  
  - Display system message: "A message was deleted (self-destruct)"  
  - Remove from UI for all participants  

**B17: Legal Hold Conflict**  
- If legal hold is enabled:  
  - Users cannot delete messages  
  - Display info: "Messages cannot be deleted (legal hold active)"  
  - Only admins can disable legal hold  

**B18: Offline Mode**  
- If user is offline:  
  - Queue actions locally  
  - Display indicator: "Offline - changes will sync when connected"  
  - Auto-sync when connection restored  

**B19: Search No Results**  
- If search returns no results:  
  - Display: "No conversations found"  
  - Suggestions:  
    - Try different keywords  
    - Check spelling  
    - Clear filters  

**B20: Pin Limit Exceeded**  
- If trying to pin 6th conversation:  
  - Display error: "You can only pin 5 conversations"  
  - Suggest: Unpin another conversation first  
  - Show list of pinned conversations with [Unpin] buttons

#### Notifications

**In-App:**  
- New conversation created  
- Added to group conversation  
- Removed from group conversation  
- Promoted to admin  
- Conversation muted/unmuted  
- Group name/settings changed  
- User typing indicator  

**Push Notifications:**  
- New message received (if not muted)  
- Mentioned in group message  
- Added to conversation  
- Promoted to admin  

**Email Notifications:**  
- Daily digest of missed messages  
- Weekly summary of active conversations  
- Added to important conversations

#### Analytics Events

- `conversation_created` (type: direct/group)  
- `conversation_opened`  
- `conversation_archived`  
- `conversation_unarchived`  
- `conversation_pinned`  
- `conversation_unpinned`  
- `conversation_muted`  
- `conversation_unmuted`  
- `participant_added`  
- `participant_removed`  
- `participant_role_changed`  
- `conversation_left`  
- `conversation_settings_updated`  
- `conversation_searched`  
- `typing_indicator_sent`  

---

#### Accessibility

- ARIA labels for all interactive elements  
- Keyboard navigation:  
  - Arrow keys to navigate conversation list  
  - Enter to open conversation  
  - Tab to focus message input  
  - Esc to close modals  
- Screen reader announcements:  
  - New message received  
  - Typing indicators  
  - Participant changes  
- High contrast mode support  
- Focus indicators  
- Alt text for avatars and images  

---

#### Performance Targets

- Conversation list load: < 500ms  
- Search results: < 300ms  
- Participant addition: < 200ms  
- Settings update: < 200ms  
- Message send (next section): < 100ms  
- Real-time updates: < 50ms latency  
- Support 1000+ conversations per user  
- Support 50 participants per group  

---

#### Security

- End-to-end encryption for sensitive conversations (optional)  
- Message content never logged  
- User blocking enforcement  
- Permission checks on all actions  
- Rate limiting on conversation creation (max 10/hour)  
- Audit logs for admin actions  
- PII detection in conversation names  
- Secure WebSocket connections (WSS)

### Journey: COM-2 (Messages & Chat Features)

**ID:** COM-2  
**Persona:** All Users (Freelancers, Clients, Admins)  
**Description:** Complete messaging functionality including sending/receiving text messages, rich content (Markdown/HTML), file attachments, threaded replies, message editing/deletion, emoji reactions, message forwarding, search, mentions, pinning, and bookmarking. Provides real-time message delivery, typing indicators, read receipts, and comprehensive message management.  

**Preconditions & Triggers:**  
**Triggers:**  
- User opens conversation (from COM-1)  
- User receives new message (real-time push)  
- User clicks message notification  
- User searches for specific message  
- User wants to reply to message  
- User wants to edit/delete message  
- User wants to attach files  
- User wants to react to message  
- User wants to forward message to another conversation  

**Preconditions:**  
- User is authenticated  
- User has access to conversation (participant)  
- Conversation is active (not archived for sending)  
- User has send permission (not in announcement mode as non-admin)  
- User not suspended or restricted  
- For editing: Message was sent by user and within edit window (15 min)  
- For deletion: Message was sent by user or user is admin  

**Primary Screens:**  
**Web:**  
- `(dashboard)/messages/[conversationId]/page.tsx` — Main conversation view  
- `(dashboard)/messages/[conversationId]/search/page.tsx` — Message search  
- `(dashboard)/messages/[conversationId]/thread/[messageId]/page.tsx` — Thread view  
- `(dashboard)/messages/[conversationId]/pinned/page.tsx` — Pinned messages  
- `(dashboard)/messages/[conversationId]/attachments/page.tsx` — All attachments  

**Mobile:**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/index.tsx` — Conversation  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/thread/[messageId].tsx` — Thread  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/search.tsx` — Search  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/attachments.tsx` — Attachments  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/media-viewer.tsx` — Image/video viewer  

**System Touchpoints:**  
- **communications-be:**  
  - `message/entity.go` — Core message entity  
  - `message_reaction/entity.go` — Reactions (emoji)  
  - `message_mention/entity.go` — User mentions  
  - `message_attachment/entity.go` — File attachments  
  - `thread/entity.go` — Threaded replies  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/messages` — Send message  
  - `GET /v1/conversations/{id}/messages` — List messages (paginated)  
  - `GET /v1/messages/{id}` — Get single message  
  - `PUT /v1/messages/{id}` — Edit message (within 15 min)  
  - `DELETE /v1/messages/{id}` — Delete message  
  - `POST /v1/messages/{id}/reactions` — Add reaction  
  - `DELETE /v1/messages/{id}/reactions/{reaction_id}` — Remove reaction  
  - `POST /v1/messages/{id}/forward` — Forward message  
  - `POST /v1/messages/{id}/pin` — Pin message  
  - `DELETE /v1/messages/{id}/pin` — Unpin message  
  - `POST /v1/messages/{id}/star` — Star/bookmark message  
  - `DELETE /v1/messages/{id}/star` — Unstar message  
  - `POST /v1/messages/{id}/reply` — Reply to message (thread)  
  - `GET /v1/messages/{id}/thread` — Get thread messages  
  - `GET /v1/conversations/{id}/messages/search` — Search messages  
  - `POST /v1/messages/upload-attachment` — Upload attachment  
  - `DELETE /v1/attachments/{id}` — Delete attachment  
- **storage-be:**  
  - `POST /v1/storage/attachments` — Upload file  
  - `GET /v1/storage/attachments/{id}` — Download file  
  - `GET /v1/storage/attachments/{id}/thumbnail` — Get thumbnail  
  - `DELETE /v1/storage/attachments/{id}` — Delete file  
- **moderation-be:**  
  - `POST /v1/moderation/content` — Scan message content (profanity, PII, spam)  
  - `POST /v1/moderation/attachment` — Scan file (virus, malware)  
- **users-be:**  
  - `GET /v1/users/{id}` — Get user info for mentions  
  - `GET /v1/users/search` — Search users for mentions  
- **Events:**  
  - Publish: `message.sent.v1`, `message.edited.v1`, `message.deleted.v1`, `message.reaction.added.v1`, `message.reaction.removed.v1`, `message.pinned.v1`, `message.unpinned.v1`, `message.starred.v1`, `message.forwarded.v1`, `message.thread.created.v1`  

---

#### Flow Steps (Happy Path)

**A1: Open Conversation & View Messages**  
1. User selects conversation from list (COM-1)  
2. Navigate to: (dashboard)/messages/{conversationId}  
3. System loads conversation:  
   - Call: `GET /v1/conversations/{id}`  
   - Call: `GET /v1/conversations/{id}/messages?limit=50&offset=0`  
   - Fetch last 50 messages (paginated)  
   - Fetch participants list  
   - Fetch conversation settings  
4. Display conversation view:  
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ← E-commerce Project Team (5)                     [🔍] [ℹ️] [⋮]         │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                        │
│                        System: Jan 10, 2025                            │
│                   John Doe created this group                          │
│                                                                        │
│ ──────────────────────── Yesterday ─────────────────────               │
│                                                                        │
│ 👤 Sarah Johnson                                    10:30 AM           │
│    Hey team! I've completed the initial design                         │
│    mockups. Take a look and let me know what                           │
│    you think!                                                          │
│    📎 designs.pdf (2.3 MB)                          [⬇] [👁]            │
│    👍 2  ❤️ 1  [💬 3 replies]                                           │
│                                                                        │
│                                            Mike Davis 2:45 PM  👤       │
│                                     Looks great! I especially          │
│                                      like the color scheme.            │
│                                                       ✓✓ Read by 4     │
│                                                                        │
│ 👤 Emily Wilson                                     3:20 PM            │
│    @John Doe Can you review the backend API                            │
│    integration points?                                                 │
│    👍 1  [💬 Reply]                                                     │
│                                                                        │
│ ──────────────────────── Today ─────────────────────                  │
│                                                                        │
│ 👤 You                                              9:00 AM            │
│    Good morning! I'll review everything today.                         │
│    📌 Pinned                                         ✓✓ Read by 3      │
│                                                                        │
│                                         John is typing...              │
│                                                                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ [+] [B] [I] [😊] [📎]                                                  │
│ Type a message...                                          [Send →]    │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
5. Message Display Components:  
   - Header:  
     - Conversation name/title  
     - Participant count (for groups)  
     - Online status (for direct chats)  
     - [Search], [Info], [More] buttons  
   - Message List:  
     - Chronological order (oldest to newest)  
     - Date separators (Today, Yesterday, dates)  
     - System messages (centered, gray)  
     - User messages (left-aligned or right-aligned for current user)  
     - Load more button (infinite scroll)  
   - Each Message Shows:  
     - Avatar (left side)  
     - Sender name  
     - Timestamp  
     - Message content (text, rich formatting)  
     - Attachments (images, files, links)  
     - Reactions count  
     - Reply count (if thread)  
     - Read receipts (for sender)  
     - Edited indicator (if edited)  
     - Pin indicator (if pinned)  
   - Message Input:  
     - Text input field  
     - Formatting toolbar  
     - Emoji picker  
     - Attachment button  
     - Send button  

**A2: Send Text Message**  
1. User clicks in message input field  
2. System shows typing indicator to other participants:  
   - Send WebSocket event: typing  
   - Other users see: "[User] is typing..."  
3. User types message  
4. As User Types:  
   - Character counter (if limit)  
   - Auto-grow input (multi-line)  
   - Real-time validation:  
     - Check profanity  
     - Detect PII (email, phone)  
     - Check spam patterns  
   - Show warnings inline (if issues)  
5. User presses Enter or clicks "Send"  
6. System validates message:  
   - Not empty (after trimming)  
   - Length ≤ 5000 characters  
   - No profanity violations  
   - Passes moderation checks  
7. System sends message:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/messages`  
   - Request body:  
```json
{  
  "content": "Good morning! I'll review everything today.",  
  "content_type": "text/plain",  
  "reply_to_message_id": null,  
  "mentions": [],  
  "metadata": {}  
}  
```
   - Backend:  
     - Create message entity  
     - Generate message_id  
     - Set timestamps  
     - Store sender_id  
     - Process mentions (if any)  
     - Emit event: `message.sent.v1`  
     - Broadcast to participants via WebSocket  
     - Send push notifications (if enabled)  
8. Display message immediately in UI (optimistic update):  
   - Show message with "sending" indicator (⏳)  
   - When confirmed, update to "sent" (✓)  
   - Show "delivered" when received by server (✓✓)  
   - Show "read" when read by recipient (✓✓ blue)  
9. Clear input field  
10. Stop typing indicator  
11. Scroll to bottom of conversation  

**A3: Send Rich Content (Markdown/HTML)**  
1. User clicks formatting toolbar buttons:  
   - [B] Bold  
   - [I] Italic  
   - [U] Underline  
   - [Link] Insert link  
   - [List] Bullet/numbered list  
   - [Code] Code block  
2. Bold/Italic/Underline:  
   - User selects text  
   - User clicks formatting button  
   - System wraps text in Markdown:  
     - Bold: **text**  
     - Italic: *text*  
     - Underline: __text__  
3. Insert Link:  
   - User clicks [Link] button  
   - Display link modal:  
```
┌────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Insert Link                        │
├────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Text: [Check this out____]         │
│ URL:  [https://example.com___]     │
│                                    │
│              [Cancel] [Insert]     │
└────────────────────────────────────┘
```
   - User enters text and URL  
   - System validates URL format  
   - Insert markdown: [text](url)  
4. Code Block:  
   - User clicks [Code] button  
   - System wraps selection in backticks: ```code
   - For inline code: `code`  
5. User sends message  
6. System processes Markdown:  
   - Parse Markdown syntax  
   - Convert to HTML (safe subset)  
   - Sanitize HTML (prevent XSS)  
   - Store both raw Markdown and rendered HTML  
7. Backend sends message:  
   - content_type: "text/markdown"  
   - content: raw Markdown  
   - rendered_content: sanitized HTML  
8. Display rendered message with formatting  

**A4: Send Emoji**  
1. User clicks emoji button [😊]  
2. Display emoji picker:  
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🔍 Search emoji...                         │
├────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 😀 😃 😄 😁 😆 😅 😂 🤣 😊 😇 🙂 🙃 😉     │
│ 😍 🥰 😘 😗 😙 😚 😋 😛 😝 😜 🤪 🤨 🧐     │
│ 🤓 😎 🤩 🥳 😏 😒 😞 😔 😟 😕 🙁 ☹️ 😣     │
│ [Recently Used]                             │
│ 👍 ❤️ 😂 🎉 👏 🔥 ✅                         │
└────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
3. User clicks emoji  
4. Emoji inserted at cursor position in message  
5. Picker stays open for multiple selections  
6. User can:  
   - Search emoji by name  
   - Browse categories: Smileys, People, Animals, Food, etc.  
   - See recently used  
   - See frequently used  
7. User continues typing or sends message  

**A5: Attach Files**  
1. User clicks attachment button [📎]  
2. Display attachment options:  
```
┌────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 📄 Document                        │
│ 🖼️  Image/Video                    │
│ 📁 From Storage                    │
│ 📷 Take Photo (mobile)             │
└────────────────────────────────────┘
```
3. Upload Document/Image:  
   - User selects "Document" or "Image/Video"  
   - System file picker opens  
   - User selects file(s)  
   - System validates:  
     - File type allowed (images, docs, videos, archives)  
     - File size ≤ 25MB per file  
     - Max 10 files per message  
   - Display upload progress:  
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Uploading: design_mockup.pdf             │
│ [███████████░░░░░░░░] 75% (1.7/2.3 MB)   │
│                              [Cancel]     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
   - Upload to storage: `POST /v1/storage/attachments`  
   - Virus scan attachment: `POST /v1/moderation/attachment`  
   - If scan fails:  
     - Display error: "File failed security scan"  
     - Delete uploaded file  
     - Prevent sending  
4. From Storage:  
   - User selects "From Storage"  
   - Navigate to user's storage  
   - User browses folders  
   - User selects existing file(s)  
   - Link to existing storage file (no re-upload)  
5. Take Photo (Mobile):  
   - User selects "Take Photo"  
   - System opens camera  
   - User takes photo  
   - User confirms or retakes  
   - Upload photo  
6. Attachment Preview:  
   - Display attached files below message input:  
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Attachments (2):                               │
│ ┌──────────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐     │
│ │ 📄 design.pdf    │  │ 🖼️  mockup.png   │     │
│ │ 2.3 MB      [✕]  │  │ 1.5 MB      [✕]  │     │
│ └──────────────────┘  └──────────────────┘     │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
   - User can:  
     - Remove attachment [✕]  
     - Reorder attachments (drag)  
     - Add caption per file  
7. User sends message  
8. System creates message with attachments:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/messages`  
   - Include attachment_ids in request  
   - Backend links attachments to message  
9. Display message with attachments:  
   - Images: Inline preview (click to expand)  
   - Documents: File icon, name, size, [Download] button  
   - Videos: Video player (inline)  
   - Archives: File name, size, [Download]  

**A6: Reply to Message (Threaded Reply)**  
1. User hovers over message (web) or long-presses (mobile)  
2. Display message actions menu:  
```
┌────────────────────────────┐
│ 💬 Reply                   │
│ ⭐ Star                     │
│ 📌 Pin                      │
│ ↗️  Forward                 │
│ 📋 Copy                     │
│ ✏️  Edit (if yours)         │
│ 🗑️  Delete (if yours)       │
└────────────────────────────┘
```
3. User clicks "Reply"  
4. Display reply context above message input:  
```

│ ↩️ Replying to Sarah Johnson:                  │
│ "Hey team! I've completed the initial          │
│  design mockups..."                   [✕]      │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
5. User types reply message  
6. User sends message  
7. System creates reply:  
   - Call: `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/messages`  
   - Set reply_to_message_id: parent_message_id  
   - Backend creates message with reply link  
   - Update parent message reply_count  
8. Display reply:  
   - Show reply indicator  
   - Show parent message preview  
   - Indent reply (visual hierarchy)  
   - Link to parent message  
9. Parent message shows reply count:  
   - "💬 3 replies"  
   - Click to view all replies (thread view)  

**A7: View Thread**  
1. User clicks "💬 3 replies" on message with replies  
2. Navigate to thread view:  
   - Web: Side panel opens  
   - Mobile: Navigate to thread screen  
3. System loads thread:  
   - Call: `GET /v1/messages/{id}/thread`  
   - Fetch parent message  
   - Fetch all replies (paginated)  
4. Display thread view:  
```

│    Looks great! The color scheme is perfect.       │

│                                                    │

│                                                    │
