**Edge Cases & Alternate Flows:**

**Export Request Failures:**

16. **Export quota exceeded:**
    - User has 5 pending exports (max allowed)
    - User tries to request another export
    - **API Response:** `429 Too Many Requests`
    ```json
    {
      "error": "EXPORT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
      "message": "Maximum 5 concurrent exports allowed. Please wait for current exports to complete or delete old exports.",
      "quota": {
        "max_pending": 5,
        "current_pending": 5
      }
    }
    ```
    - Error notification: "❌ Export limit reached. You have 5 exports in progress. Please wait or delete old exports."
    - Show list of pending exports with [Cancel] buttons
    - User can cancel one to free up slot

17. **No conversations to export:**
    - User requests export but has no conversations in date range
    - **API Response:** `400 Bad Request`
    ```json
    {
      "error": "NO_DATA_TO_EXPORT",
      "message": "No conversations found matching your criteria.",
      "filters_applied": {
        "date_range": "...",
        "include_archived": false
      }
    }
    ```
    - Error notification: "No conversations found matching your filters. Try adjusting the date range."
    - Suggest: "Include archived conversations?" checkbox

18. **Export processing failure:**
    - During processing, storage service becomes unavailable
    - Export job status changes to "FAILED"
    - **WebSocket Event:**
    ```json
    {
      "event": "export.failed",
      "export_id": "exp_abc123",
      "status": "FAILED",
      "error_code": "STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE",
      "error_message": "Unable to upload export file to storage",
      "retry_available": true
    }
    ```
    - User receives notification: "❌ Export failed due to server error. Please retry."
    - Export page shows:
      ```
      ❌ Export Failed
      
      Error: Storage service temporarily unavailable
      Requested: Jan 15, 2025 at 11:00 AM
      Failed: Jan 15, 2025 at 11:05 AM
      
      [Retry Export] [Delete]
      ```
    - User can retry immediately
    - Failed exports don't count toward quota

19. **Export timeout:**
    - Very large export (1000+ conversations)
    - Processing exceeds 30-minute timeout
    - Job automatically retried with batch processing
    - If retry fails, user notified:
      ```
      Your export is taking longer than expected due to size.
      We'll continue processing and notify you when complete.
      
      Alternatively, try exporting smaller date ranges.
      ```
    - Provide option to split into multiple exports by date range

20. **Download link expired:**
    - User tries to download export after 7-day expiration
    - **API Response:** `410 Gone`
    ```json
    {
      "error": "EXPORT_EXPIRED",
      "message": "This export has expired and is no longer available.",
      "expired_at": "2025-01-22T11:10:00Z",
      "can_regenerate": true
    }
    ```
    - Error notification: "This export has expired. Would you like to generate a new one?"
    - [Regenerate Export] button
    - Clicking regenerate creates new export with same parameters

21. **Attachment download failures:**
    - During export generation, some attachments fail to download
    - System continues export, logs missing attachments
    - Completed export includes `errors.json`:
      ```json
      {
        "missing_attachments": [
          {
            "attachment_id": "att_xyz",
            "message_id": "msg_abc",
            "file_name": "missing_file.pdf",
            "error": "File not found in storage"
          }
        ]
      }
      ```
    - User notified: "⚠️ Export completed with 3 missing attachments. See errors.json for details."
    - Export still downloadable with available content

**Privacy & Security Considerations:**

25. **Anonymized export:**
    - User selects "Anonymize participants"
    - Participant names/emails replaced with IDs:
      ```json
      {
        "participants": [
          {"user_id": "participant_1", "role": "MEMBER"},
          {"user_id": "participant_2", "role": "MEMBER"}
        ],
        "messages": [
          {
            "message_id": "msg_123",
            "sender_id": "participant_1",
            "content": "Hello",
            "sent_at": "..."
          }
        ]
      }
      ```
    - Useful for sharing conversation structure/content without exposing identities
    - Mapping file included (only visible to requester):
      ```json
      {
        "participant_1": "user_abc (Alice Brown)",
        "participant_2": "user_def (Bob Smith)"
      }
      ```

26. **Encrypted exports:**
    - User enables "Encrypt export file"
    - Enter encryption password (min 12 characters)
    - Confirm password
    - Export file encrypted with AES-256
    - File extension: `.zip.enc`
    - Password not stored by system
    - Decryption instructions included in email:
      ```
      Your export is password-protected.
      
      To decrypt:
      1. Download the .zip.enc file
      2. Use OpenSSL or 7-Zip to decrypt
      3. Command: openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -d -in export.zip.enc -out export.zip
      4. Enter your password when prompted
      
      WARNING: If you lose your password, the export cannot be recovered.
      ```
    - Provides additional security for sensitive data

27. **Export with redactions:**
    - Admin exports conversation for legal review
    - Select "Redact PII" option:
      - ☑ Email addresses
      - ☑ Phone numbers
      - ☑ Credit card numbers
      - ☑ Social security numbers
      - ☑ IP addresses
    - System scans content and redacts matches:
      ```
      Original: "My email is alice@example.com"
      Redacted: "My email is [EMAIL_REDACTED]"
      
      Original: "Call me at 555-1234"
      Redacted: "Call me at [PHONE_REDACTED]"
      ```
    - Redaction log included showing what was redacted and where
    - Suitable for sharing with external parties

**Notifications:**

**In-App Notifications:**
- Export request submitted
- Export processing progress (25%, 50%, 75%)
- Export completed (with download link)
- Export failed (with retry option)
- Export expires in 24 hours (reminder)
- Export expired (with regenerate option)
- Auto-export completed (scheduled export)

**Email Notifications:**
- Export ready for download (with direct link)
- Export failed (with support link)
- Export expires soon (24 hours before)
- Weekly digest of completed exports
- Admin export completed (admin-only)

**Push Notifications (Mobile):**
- "Your export is ready! Tap to download"
- "Export failed. Tap to retry"
- "Export expires tomorrow. Download now"

**WebSocket Events:**
- `export.status_changed` — Status updates
- `export.progress_updated` — Processing progress
- `export.completed` — Export ready
- `export.failed` — Processing failed
- `export.expired` — Export no longer available

**Analytics Events:**

Suggested tracking:
- `export_requested` — User requests export
  - export_type (CONVERSATIONS, SINGLE_CONVERSATION, ACCOUNT_DATA)
  - format (JSON, CSV, PDF, HTML)
  - include_attachments (boolean)
  - date_range (days)
- `export_completed` — Export successfully generated
  - processing_time_seconds
  - file_size_bytes
  - conversations_count
  - messages_count
- `export_downloaded` — User downloads export
  - download_number (1st, 2nd, 3rd download of same export)
  - time_to_download (seconds since completion)
- `export_failed` — Export processing failed
  - error_code
  - retry_attempted (boolean)
- `export_expired` — Export reached expiration
  - download_count_before_expiry
  - regenerated (boolean)
- `export_schedule_created` — User sets up auto-export
  - frequency (WEEKLY, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY)
  - format
- `export_format_changed` — User changes format selection
  - from_format
  - to_format

**Accessibility:**

- **Keyboard Navigation:**
  - Tab through export form fields
  - Enter to submit export request
  - Arrow keys to navigate export history table
  - Space to toggle checkboxes
  - Ctrl+D to download export (when focused)
  
- **Screen Reader Support:**
  - Announce export status changes: "Export processing, 50% complete"
  - Announce completion: "Export ready for download. 52 megabytes, expires in 7 days"
  - Describe format options: "JSON format, machine-readable, includes all metadata"
  - Read export history table with proper headers
  - Announce progress updates during processing
  
- **Visual Accessibility:**
  - Status icons with text labels (not icon-only)
  - Color-blind friendly status colors:
    - Pending: Blue with ⏳
    - Processing: Purple with ⚙️
    - Completed: Green with ✅
    - Failed: Red with ❌
    - Expired: Gray with 🗑️
  - High contrast mode support
  - Large touch targets (min 44×44px) on mobile
  - Progress bars with percentage text
  
- **Cognitive Accessibility:**
  - Clear step-by-step instructions
  - Estimated processing time upfront
  - Visual progress indicators
  - Simple language in error messages
  - Confirmation dialogs before destructive actions
  - Help text explaining format differences

**Performance Targets:**

- **Export Request Submission:** < 500ms response
- **Single Conversation Export:** < 1 minute processing
- **Full Export (< 100 conversations):** < 5 minutes processing
- **Full Export (< 1000 conversations):** < 15 minutes processing
- **Full Export (1000+ conversations):** < 30 minutes processing
- **Download Link Generation:** < 200ms
- **Presigned URL expiry:** 7 days
- **Export file expiry:** 7 days (configurable per instance)
- **Auto-delete expired exports:** Daily cleanup job
- **Max concurrent exports per user:** 5
- **Max export file size:** 2 GB (before compression)
- **Compression ratio:** ~60% size reduction for JSON exports
- **Storage optimization:**
  - Deduplicate attachments across exports
  - Clean up failed export artifacts
  - Archive old exports to cold storage (if enabled)

**Security:**

- **Authentication:** All export endpoints require valid JWT
- **Authorization:**
  - Users can only export conversations they participate in
  - Admins can export any conversation (with audit log)
  - Deleted users cannot request exports (must contact support)
- **Rate Limiting:**
  - Max 5 export requests per user per day
  - Max 1 export request per user per hour
  - Admin exports exempt from user limits
- **Data Validation:**
  - Validate date ranges (not in future, not before account creation)
  - Validate format selection (only allowed formats)
  - Sanitize file names to prevent path traversal
  - Limit export size to prevent abuse
- **Secure Download:**
  - Presigned URLs with expiration
  - URLs single-use or time-limited
  - HTTPS required for all downloads
  - No direct file system access
- **PII Protection:**
  - Option to anonymize participants
  - Optional encryption of export file
  - Redaction of sensitive data (admin exports)
  - Audit log of all export requests
- **Deletion:**
  - User can delete their exports anytime
  - Auto-delete after 7 days
  - Secure deletion (overwrite) for sensitive exports
  - Account deletion removes all exports
- **Compliance:**
  - GDPR right to data portability support
  - Include data processing consent in exports
  - Admin exports logged for audit trail
  - Legal hold prevents export deletion
- **Monitoring:**
  - Alert on unusual export patterns
  - Track export failures
  - Monitor storage usage per user
  - Detect potential data exfiltration

### Journey: COM-12 (Moderation & Safety)

**ID:** COM-12  
**Persona:** All Users (Freelancers, Clients, Admins, Moderators)  
**Description:** Comprehensive content moderation and safety system enabling users to report inappropriate messages, block users, manage content filters, and maintain safe communication environment with features including message flagging/reporting, automated content filtering, user blocklists, phrase blocklists, domain blocklists, conversation moderation rules, retention policies, legal hold management, admin moderation tools, automated moderation actions, appeal processes, and compliance with platform safety guidelines.  

**Preconditions & Triggers:**  
**Triggers:**  
- User receives inappropriate/offensive message  
- User wants to report spam or harassment  
- User clicks "Report Message" option  
- User wants to block another user  
- User receives threatening or abusive content  
- Automated filter detects prohibited content  
- Admin reviews flagged content  
- User appeals moderation decision  
- Legal team places conversation under legal hold  
- Platform policy violation detected  
- User wants to set communication preferences  
- Organization admin configures safety rules  

**Preconditions:**  
- User is authenticated  
- User has active account  
- For reporting: Message exists and is accessible  
- For blocking: Target user exists  
- For admin actions: User has moderator/admin role  
- Content filtering service is operational  
- Moderation queue system is available  

**Primary Screens:**  
**Web:**  
- `(dashboard)/messages/[conversationId]/page.tsx` — Message actions (report, flag)  
- `(dashboard)/settings/safety/page.tsx` — Safety settings center  
- `(dashboard)/settings/safety/blocked-users/page.tsx` — Blocked users list  
- `(dashboard)/settings/safety/filters/page.tsx` — Content filters  
- `(dashboard)/settings/safety/reports/page.tsx` — User's report history  
- `(dashboard)/reports/[reportId]/page.tsx` — Report details  
- `(dashboard)/admin/moderation/page.tsx` — Admin moderation queue  
- `(dashboard)/admin/moderation/[reportId]/page.tsx` — Review report  
- `(dashboard)/admin/safety/rules/page.tsx` — Safety rules config  
- `(dashboard)/admin/safety/blocklists/page.tsx` — Platform blocklists  

**Mobile:**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/index.tsx` — Message actions  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/safety/index.tsx` — Safety settings  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/safety/blocked-users.tsx` — Blocked users  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/safety/filters.tsx` — Content filters  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/safety/reports.tsx` — Report history  
- `(mobile)/(app)/reports/[reportId].tsx` — Report detail  
- `(mobile)/(app)/admin/moderation/queue.tsx` — Moderation queue  
- `(mobile)/(app)/admin/moderation/[reportId].tsx` — Review report  

**System Touchpoints:**  
- **communications-be:**  
  - `message_report/entity.go` — Message reporting  
  - `conversation_moderation/entity.go` — Moderation actions  
  - `user_block/entity.go` — User blocklists  
  - `content_filter/entity.go` — Content filtering rules  
  - `moderation_action/entity.go` — Moderation history  
  - `legal_hold/entity.go` — Legal hold management  
  - `POST /v1/messages/{messageId}/report` — Report message  
  - `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/report` — Report conversation  
  - `GET /v1/reports` — List user's reports  
  - `GET /v1/reports/{reportId}` — Get report details  
  - `POST /v1/users/{userId}/block` — Block user  
  - `DELETE /v1/users/{userId}/block` — Unblock user  
  - `GET /v1/blocked-users` — List blocked users  
  - `PUT /v1/settings/content-filters` — Update filters  
  - `GET /v1/settings/content-filters` — Get filter settings  
  - `POST /v1/admin/moderation/review` — Admin review report  
  - `POST /v1/admin/moderation/action` — Take moderation action  
  - `GET /v1/admin/moderation/queue` — Get moderation queue  
  - `POST /v1/legal/hold` — Create legal hold  
  
- **admin-be:**  
  - `moderation_queue/entity.go` — Queue management  
  - `moderator_action/entity.go` — Moderator actions  
  - `safety_rule/entity.go` — Safety rules  
  - `blocklist/entity.go` — Platform blocklists  
  - `GET /v1/admin/moderation/queue` — Get pending reports  
  - `POST /v1/admin/moderation/{reportId}/resolve` — Resolve report  
  - `GET /v1/admin/safety/rules` — Get safety rules  
  - `POST /v1/admin/safety/rules` — Create safety rule  
  - `GET /v1/admin/blocklists` — Get blocklists  
  - `POST /v1/admin/blocklists/phrases` — Add blocked phrase  
  
- **users-be:**  
  - `POST /v1/users/{userId}/suspend` — Suspend user  
  - `POST /v1/users/{userId}/warn` — Warn user  
  - `GET /v1/users/{userId}/violations` — Get violation history  
  
- **notifications-be:**  
  - Send notifications for moderation actions  
  - Notify users of policy violations  
  - Alert admins of flagged content  

**Flow Steps:**

**Phase 1: User Reports Inappropriate Message**

1. **User encounters offensive message:**
   - User receives message: "You're an idiot and your work is garbage"
   - Message appears in conversation
   - User recognizes this as harassment
   - User hovers over message (web) or long-presses (mobile)
   - Message action menu appears:
     - Reply
     - Edit (if own message)
     - Delete (if own message)
     - Copy
     - Quote
     - 🚩 **Report Message**
     - 🚫 **Block User**
   - User clicks "Report Message"

2. **Report message modal opens:**
   - Modal title: "Report This Message"
   - Message preview shown (redacted if very offensive)
   - Form fields:
     
     **Why are you reporting this message?**
     - ○ Harassment or bullying
     - ○ Hate speech or discrimination
     - ○ Spam or unwanted commercial content
     - ○ Threats or violence
     - ○ Sexual content or exploitation
     - ○ Impersonation or fraud
     - ○ Self-harm or suicide
     - ○ False information
     - ○ Other (please specify)
     
     **Additional details (optional):**
     [Text area - max 500 characters]
     "Please provide any additional context that will help us review this report"
     
     **Would you also like to:**
     ☑ Block this user (recommended)
     ☑ Mute this conversation
     ☐ Delete the message from my view
     
   - Privacy notice: "Reports are confidential. The user won't know you reported them."
   - [Cancel] [Submit Report]

3. **User submits report:**
   - User selects: "Harassment or bullying"
   - User adds details: "This user has been sending aggressive messages repeatedly"
   - User checks: ☑ Block this user
   - User clicks "Submit Report"
   - **API Call:** `POST /v1/messages/{messageId}/report`
   ```json
   {
     "message_id": "msg_abc123",
     "conversation_id": "conv_xyz789",
     "reported_by": "user_reporter_id",
     "report_reason": "HARASSMENT",
     "report_category": "BULLYING",
     "additional_details": "This user has been sending aggressive messages repeatedly",
     "also_block_user": true,
     "also_mute_conversation": true,
     "delete_from_view": false,
     "context_messages": [
       "msg_previous_1",
       "msg_previous_2",
       "msg_abc123"
     ]
   }
   ```
   - **Response:**
   ```json
   {
     "report_id": "rep_xyz456",
     "status": "PENDING_REVIEW",
     "submitted_at": "2025-01-15T14:30:00Z",
     "reference_number": "REP-20250115-456",
     "estimated_review_time": "24-48 hours",
     "actions_taken": {
       "user_blocked": true,
       "conversation_muted": true,
       "message_flagged": true
     }
   }
   ```
   - Success notification: "✅ Report submitted. Reference: REP-20250115-456. We'll review within 24-48 hours."
   - If user blocked: "User has been blocked. You won't receive messages from them."
   - Modal closes
   - Message marked with flag icon for reporter
   - User automatically blocked (since checkbox was selected)

4. **Automated content analysis triggered:**
   - System immediately analyzes reported message
   - Content filtering service scans for:
     - Profanity and offensive language
     - Hate speech patterns
     - Threatening language
     - Known spam phrases
     - PII (personal identifiable information)
   - ML model assigns severity score: 0-100
   - Message score: 78 (high severity - harassment detected)
   - Automated preliminary action:
     - Message flagged for priority review
     - User receives automated warning (first offense)
     - Temporary rate limit applied to sender
   - Report moved to high-priority moderation queue
   - Admin notification sent (for high severity)

**Phase 2: Block User**

5. **User blocks another user directly:**
   - Scenario: User wants to block without reporting
   - User opens another user's profile
   - User clicks "⋮ More Actions"
   - Dropdown shows: "🚫 Block User"
   - User clicks "Block User"
   - Confirmation modal: "Block [Username]?"
   - Warning text:
     ```
     When you block someone:
     • They cannot send you messages
     • They cannot view your profile or activity
     ```

**Edge Cases & Alternate Flows:**

**Multiple Reports:**

24. **Same message reported by multiple users:**
    - Message reported 5 times by different users
    - System consolidates reports
    - Creates single moderation case
    - Increases priority automatically
    - Report shows: "Reported by 5 users"
    - Moderator sees all reporters' perspectives
    - Single action resolves all reports
    - All reporters notified of outcome

25. **False reporting (report abuse):**
    - User repeatedly reports valid content
    - System detects pattern:
      - User submitted 10 reports in 1 day
      - 8 reports dismissed as invalid
      - Targeting specific user
    - Automated flag: "Potential report abuse"
    - Admin reviews reporting pattern
    - **Moderator action:**
      - Warning issued to reporter
      - Reporting privileges temporarily restricted
      - Future reports flagged for extra scrutiny
    - **API Call:** `POST /v1/admin/users/{userId}/restrict-reporting`
    ```json
    {
      "user_id": "user_reporter_id",
      "restriction_type": "REPORTING_RATE_LIMIT",
      "duration_hours": 168,
      "reason": "Pattern of false reporting detected",
      "max_reports_per_day": 1
    }
    ```

**Content Filter Edge Cases:**

26. **False positive - Legitimate content filtered:**
    - User sends: "I can help you with investment advice for your 401k"
    - Filter flags: "investment" (blocked phrase)
    - Message filtered to spam folder
    - User doesn't see it in inbox
    - Sender sees: "Message may have been filtered"
    - User checks Filtered folder
    - Clicks "Not Spam"
    - **API Call:** `POST /v1/messages/{messageId}/mark-not-spam`
    - Message moved to inbox
    - Filter learns (machine learning adjustment)
    - Similar messages from this sender whitelisted

27. **Bypass attempt detected:**
    - User tries to bypass filter: "g3t r1ch qu1ck" (leetspeak)
    - Advanced content filter detects:
      - Character substitution patterns
      - Known obfuscation techniques
    - Message still blocked
    - User receives enhanced warning:
      ```
      ⚠️ Message blocked
      
      Attempting to bypass content filters violates our Terms of Service.
      
      • This message appears to contain prohibited content
      • Character substitution detected
      • Repeated attempts may result in account suspension
      ```
    - Incident logged for admin review
    - Pattern added to filter database

**Block/Unblock Issues:**

28. **Mutual blocking:**
    - User A blocks User B
    - User B independently blocks User A
    - Both users' conversations hidden
    - Neither can message the other
    - If User A unblocks User B:
      - User A can now send messages
      - But User B's block remains active
      - User A's messages delivered but User B doesn't receive
      - User A sees "Message sent" (no indication of other's block)
    - Privacy maintained - users not informed of each other's block status

29. **Blocking user mid-conversation:**
    - Active conversation in progress
    - User A blocks User B during chat
    - Conversation immediately hidden for User A
    - User B's typing indicator stops showing
    - User B can still see conversation but cannot send new messages
    - User B sees: "Unable to send message" (generic error)
    - User A's online status hidden from User B

**Admin/Moderator Actions:**

30. **Moderator disagrees with automated action:**
    - Automated system deletes message (spam detection)
    - User appeals
    - Moderator reviews and disagrees with automation
    - **Manual override:**
      - Restore message
      - Whitelist sender
      - Adjust automated rules
      - Add training data to ML model
    - System learns from override
    - Confidence threshold adjusted

31. **Escalation to senior moderator:**
    - Complex case: Unclear if content violates policies
    - Moderator clicks "Escalate"
    - **API Call:** `POST /v1/admin/moderation/{reportId}/escalate`
    ```json
    {
      "report_id": "rep_xyz456",
      "escalated_by": "mod_junior_123",
      "escalation_reason": "Requires policy interpretation - cultural context unclear",
      "urgency": "MEDIUM"
    }
    ```
    - Report moved to senior queue
    - Original moderator notified when resolved
    - Decision used for moderator training

**Notifications:**

**In-App Notifications:**
- Content reported successfully
- User blocked/unblocked
- Report reviewed (outcome)
- Warning issued
- Account suspended
- Message filtered
- Appeal submitted
- Appeal decision
- Legal hold applied (admins only)

**Email Notifications:**
- Report submitted confirmation
- Moderation outcome (action taken)
- Warning notification (policy violation)
- Suspension notification
- Appeal decision
- Legal hold notification (legal team)
- Weekly safety summary (admins)

**Push Notifications (Mobile):**
- "Your report has been reviewed"
- "Important: Policy violation warning"
- "User blocked successfully"
- "Appeal decision: Approved"

**WebSocket Events:**
- `message.filtered` — Message filtered by system
- `user.blocked` — User blocked/unblocked
- `moderation.action_taken` — Moderation action completed
- `report.status_changed` — Report status updated

**Analytics Events:**

Suggested tracking:
- `message_reported` — User reports message
  - report_category (HARASSMENT, SPAM, HATE_SPEECH, etc.)
  - reporter_credibility_score
  - automated_severity_score
- `user_blocked` — User blocks another user
  - also_reported (boolean)
  - block_reason
- `content_filtered` — Message filtered by system
  - filter_type (SPAM, OFFENSIVE, LINK, etc.)
  - confidence_score
  - false_positive (if marked as not spam)
- `moderation_action_taken` — Moderator takes action
  - action_type (WARNING, DELETE, SUSPEND, BAN)
  - time_to_action_hours
  - automated_vs_manual
- `appeal_submitted` — User appeals decision
  - original_action_type
  - appeal_outcome (APPROVED, DENIED, PENDING)
- `safety_filter_updated` — User updates filters
  - filter_type
  - enabled (boolean)
- `false_positive_reported` — Legitimate content filtered
  - filter_type
  - correction_action

**Accessibility:**

- **Keyboard Navigation:**
  - Tab through report form fields
  - Enter to submit report
  - Arrow keys to select report categories
  - Esc to close report modal
  - Alt+R to open report menu (configurable hotkey)
  
- **Screen Reader Support:**
  - Announce blocked user status: "User is blocked. They cannot message you."
  - Read report form labels clearly
  - Announce moderation outcomes: "Your report was reviewed. Action was taken."
  - Describe filter settings: "Offensive language filter: Strong filtering enabled"
  - Alert for filtered messages: "Message filtered. Reason: Contains blocked phrase"
  
- **Visual Accessibility:**
  - Color-coded severity (not color-only):
    - Low: 🟢 Green + "Low"
    - Medium: 🟡 Yellow + "Medium"  
    - High: 🔴 Red + "High"
    - Critical: ⚫ Black + "Critical"
  - Report status icons with text labels
  - High contrast for warning messages
  - Large touch targets for report buttons (min 44×44px)
  - Clear visual indicators for blocked users
  
- **Cognitive Accessibility:**
  - Simple report categories (no jargon)
  - Clear explanations of consequences
  - Step-by-step report process
  - Confirmation dialogs for irreversible actions
  - Plain language in policy violation notices
  - Visual progress through report submission

**Performance Targets:**

- **Report Submission:** < 500ms response
- **Block User Action:** < 300ms
- **Content Filter Analysis:** < 100ms (real-time)
- **Filter Settings Update:** < 400ms
- **Moderation Queue Load:** < 2 seconds for 50 reports
- **Report Review Load:** < 1 second for full context
- **Automated Moderation Decision:** < 200ms
- **ML Content Analysis:** < 150ms per message
- **Legal Hold Application:** < 500ms
- **Blocked User List Load:** < 1 second for 500 users
- **Retention Policy Job:** Process 100k messages/hour
- **Cache Strategy:**
  - Blocked users list cached 5 minutes
  - Filter settings cached 10 minutes
  - Moderation queue cached 30 seconds
  - User violation history cached 1 hour

**Security:**

- **Authentication:** All moderation endpoints require authentication
- **Authorization:**
  - Users can only report messages they can access
  - Moderators require specific role/permission
  - Admins only for sensitive actions (ban, legal hold)
  - Legal team separate permission for legal holds
- **Rate Limiting:**
  - Max 10 reports per user per day (configurable)
  - Max 5 block actions per user per hour
  - Moderation queue: 100 requests/min per moderator
  - Filter updates: 5 per hour per user
- **Data Privacy:**
  - Reporter identity hidden from reported user
  - Message content encrypted in reports
  - Moderator actions logged in audit trail
  - PII redacted in non-essential contexts
  - Legal hold data access restricted
- **Input Validation:**
  - Sanitize report descriptions (prevent injection)
  - Validate report categories (only allowed values)
  - Verify user permissions before actions
  - Validate filter rules before saving
- **Audit Logging:**
  - All moderation actions logged
  - Report submissions tracked
  - Block/unblock actions recorded
  - Filter changes logged
  - Legal holds fully audited
  - Admin actions attributed to specific admin
- **False Positive Protection:**
  - Machine learning model continuously trained
  - Human review for high-severity actions
  - Appeal process for all moderation decisions
  - Regular audit of automated decisions
- **Abuse Prevention:**
  - Detect report spam (too many reports)
  - Detect block spam (blocking many users quickly)
  - Rate limit moderation queue access
  - Monitor moderator actions for abuse
  - Restrict reporting privileges if abused

### Journey: COM-13 (Search & Discovery)

**ID:** COM-13  
**Persona:** All Users (Freelancers, Clients, Admins)  
**Description:** Comprehensive search and discovery system enabling users to find messages, conversations, and content across the platform with features including global message search, conversation-specific search, advanced filters (date range, sender, message type, attachments), full-text search with relevance ranking, search suggestions and autocomplete, recent searches, saved searches, search result highlighting, faceted search navigation, Elasticsearch integration, PII redaction before indexing, search analytics, and mobile-optimized search interfaces.  

**Preconditions & Triggers:**  
**Triggers:**  
- User clicks search icon in messages header  
- User types in global search bar  
- User wants to find specific message/conversation  
- User searches within active conversation  
- User needs to find attachment or file  
- User looks for messages from specific person  
- User searches for messages in date range  
- User wants to find messages with specific keywords  
- User clicks "Search Messages" from profile  
- User accesses search from command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K)  
- User wants to find contract-related discussions  
- User searches for shared links or files  

**Preconditions:**  
- User is authenticated  
- User has active account  
- Search service is operational  
- Elasticsearch cluster is available  
- User has messages/conversations to search  
- Search index is up to date  
- User has not exceeded search rate limits  

**Primary Screens:**  
**Web:**  
- `(dashboard)/messages/search/page.tsx` — Global message search  
- `(dashboard)/messages/[conversationId]/search/page.tsx` — In-conversation search  
- `(dashboard)/search/page.tsx` — Universal search (messages + users + jobs)  
- `(dashboard)/search/results/page.tsx` — Search results page  
- `(dashboard)/search/advanced/page.tsx` — Advanced search filters  
- `(dashboard)/search/saved/page.tsx` — Saved searches  
- `(dashboard)/messages/page.tsx` — Search bar in messages list  
- Header: Global search component (all pages)  

**Mobile:**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/search/index.tsx` — Search home  
- `(mobile)/(app)/search/messages.tsx` — Message search  
- `(mobile)/(app)/search/results.tsx` — Search results  
- `(mobile)/(app)/search/filters.tsx` — Search filters  
- `(mobile)/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/search.tsx` — In-conversation search  
- `(mobile)/(app)/search/saved.tsx` — Saved searches  
- `(mobile)/(app)/search/recent.tsx` — Recent searches  

**System Touchpoints:**  
- **communications-be:**  
  - `message/entity.go` — Message data source  
  - `conversation/entity.go` — Conversation metadata  
  - `message_attachment/entity.go` — Attachment search  
  - `GET /v1/search/messages` — Search messages  
  - `GET /v1/search/conversations` — Search conversations  
  - `GET /v1/search/suggestions` — Search autocomplete  
  - `POST /v1/search/saved` — Save search query  
  - `GET /v1/search/saved` — Get saved searches  
  - `DELETE /v1/search/saved/{searchId}` — Delete saved search  
  - `GET /v1/search/recent` — Get recent searches  
  - `GET /v1/conversations/{id}/search` — Search within conversation  
  
- **search-be:**  
  - `search_index/entity.go` — Search index management  
  - `search_query/entity.go` — Query logging  
  - `search_suggestion/entity.go` — Autocomplete data  
  - `POST /v1/elasticsearch/index` — Index documents  
  - `POST /v1/elasticsearch/search` — Execute search  
  - `GET /v1/elasticsearch/suggest` — Get suggestions  
  - `POST /v1/search/analytics` — Log search analytics  
  - `GET /v1/search/trending` — Get trending searches  
  
- **storage-be:**  
  - `GET /v1/storage/search` — Search file attachments  
  - File metadata for search indexing  
  
- **users-be:**  
  - `GET /v1/users/search` — Search users (for filtering)  
  - User profile data for search context  

**Flow Steps:**

**Phase 1: Global Message Search**

1. **User initiates search:**
   - User in messages dashboard
   - User clicks search icon (🔍) in header or presses Cmd/Ctrl+K
   - Search modal/page opens
   - Search input automatically focused
   - Placeholder text: "Search messages, conversations, people..."
   - Recent searches shown below input (if any):
     ```
     Recent Searches
     • contract terms proposal
     • Alice Brown messages
     • attachments from last week
     ```
   - Trending searches shown (if no recent searches):
     ```
     Trending Searches
     • project deliverables
     • payment schedule
     • milestone updates
     ```

2. **User types search query:**
   - User starts typing: "contract"
   - **Real-time autocomplete triggered after 2 characters**
   - **API Call:** `GET /v1/search/suggestions?q=co&limit=10`
   - **Response:**
   ```json
   {
     "suggestions": [
       {
         "type": "QUERY",
         "text": "contract",
         "highlight": "<mark>co</mark>ntract",
         "frequency": 45
       },
       {

         "text": "contract terms",
         "highlight": "<mark>co</mark>ntract terms",
         "frequency": 23
       },

         "text": "Alice Brown (contractor)",
         "user_id": "user_abc",
         "avatar_url": "...",
         "highlight": "Alice Brown (<mark>co</mark>ntractor)"
       },
       {
         "type": "CONVERSATION",
         "text": "Project Contract Discussion",
         "conversation_id": "conv_xyz",
         "highlight": "Project <mark>Co</mark>ntract Discussion"
       }
     ],
     "query_time_ms": 15
   }
   ```
   - Autocomplete dropdown appears:
     ```

     🔍 contract terms
     👤 Alice Brown (contractor)
     💬 Project Contract Discussion
     ```
   - User continues typing: "contract terms"

3. **User submits search:**

**Phase 3: In-Conversation Search**

7. **User searches within specific conversation:**
   - User in conversation with Alice Brown
   - Conversation has 500+ messages
   - User clicks search icon in conversation header
   - In-conversation search bar appears (sticky at top)
   - Placeholder: "Search this conversation..."
   - User types: "milestone"
   - **API Call:** `GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/search?q=milestone`
   - **Response:**

   ```json
   {

     ```

   - First match highlighted and scrolled into view
   - Yellow highlight on "milestone" in message
   - Navigation arrows to jump between matches

8. **User navigates through search results:**
   - User clicks "Next >" button
   - Page scrolls to second match
   - Counter updates: "Match 2 of 3"
   - Second occurrence highlighted
   - User continues clicking "Next >"
   - Counter updates: "Match 3 of 3"
   - Third occurrence highlighted
   - "Next >" button disabled (at last match)
   - User clicks "< Previous"
   - Returns to match 2
   - User can click "× Clear" to exit search mode
   - All highlights removed
   - Conversation returns to normal view

**Phase 5: Saved Searches**

11. **User saves frequently used search:**
    - User has configured complex search:
      - Query: "payment schedule"
      - Filters: Bob Smith, Last 30 days, With attachments
    - User clicks "💾 Save Search" button
    - Modal appears:
      ```
      Save This Search
      
      Name: [Payment Schedule Updates      ]
      
      Notifications:
      ☑ Alert me when new results match this search
      
      [Cancel] [Save]
      ```
    - User names search and enables notifications
    - **API Call:** `POST /v1/search/saved`
    ```json
    {
      "name": "Payment Schedule Updates",
      "query": "payment schedule",
      "filters": {
        "sender_id": "user_def",
        "date_range": "LAST_30_DAYS",
        "has_attachments": true
      },
      "notifications_enabled": true
    }
    ```
    - **Response:**
    ```json
    {
      "search_id": "search_abc123",
      "name": "Payment Schedule Updates",
      "created_at": "2025-01-15T15:00:00Z",
      "notifications_enabled": true
    }
    ```
    - Success: "✅ Search saved! You'll be notified of new matches."
    - Search appears in saved searches list

**Phase 6: Advanced Search Features**

14. **User uses exact phrase search:**
    - User wants exact match for "final deliverable"
    - User types query with quotes: `"final deliverable"`
    - **API Call:** `GET /v1/search/messages?q="final+deliverable"&match_type=EXACT`
    - Search engine treats as single phrase
    - Results only include messages with exact phrase
    - No results for "final version of deliverable" or "deliverable is final"
    - Only matches: "The final deliverable is ready"

15. **User uses boolean search operators:**
    - User wants messages about contract OR agreement
    - User types: `contract OR agreement`
    - **API Call:** `GET /v1/search/messages?q=contract+OR+agreement`
    - Results include messages with either term
    - User refines with AND operator: `contract AND payment`
    - Only messages containing both terms shown
    - User excludes term with NOT: `contract NOT terminated`
    - Messages with "contract" but not "terminated" shown
    - Search bar shows query tips:
      ```
      💡 Search Tips:
      • Use quotes for exact phrases: "final version"
      • Combine terms: contract AND payment
      • Exclude words: project NOT cancelled
      • Use OR: invoice OR receipt
      ```

16. **User searches by message metadata:**
    - User wants messages sent on specific date
    - User types: `date:2025-01-10`
    - **API Call:** `GET /v1/search/messages?date=2025-01-10`
    - All messages from January 10th shown
    - User searches by sender: `from:alice`
    - All messages from Alice Brown shown
    - User searches attachments: `has:attachment`
    - Only messages with attachments shown
    - User searches by file type: `filetype:pdf`
    - Only messages with PDF attachments shown
    - Advanced metadata operators:
      ```
      Metadata Search Operators:
      • from:username — Messages from specific user
      • to:username — Messages to specific user
      • date:YYYY-MM-DD — Messages on specific date
      • before:YYYY-MM-DD — Messages before date
      • after:YYYY-MM-DD — Messages after date
      • has:attachment — Messages with files
      • has:link — Messages with URLs
      • has:mention — Messages with @mentions
      • filetype:ext — Specific file type
      • size:>1MB — File size filters
      ```

17. **User searches with wildcards:**
    - User searches: `contract*`
    - Matches: contract, contracts, contracting, contractor
    - User searches: `pay*ment`
    - Matches: payment, pavement (if exists)
    - User searches: `proj?ct`
    - Matches: project, projxct (if typo exists)
    - Wildcard support:
      - `*` matches zero or more characters
      - `?` matches exactly one character
      - Useful for finding variations

**Phase 7: Search Analytics & Insights**

18. **System logs search analytics:**
    - Every search query logged for analytics
    - **API Call:** `POST /v1/search/analytics`
    ```json
    {
      "user_id": "user_abc",
      "query": "contract terms",
      "filters_applied": {
        "sender": "user_def",
        "date_range": "last_week"
      },
      "results_count": 27,
      "clicked_results": ["msg_abc123"],
      "search_duration_ms": 45,
      "refinements_count": 2,
      "timestamp": "2025-01-15T15:30:00Z"
    }
    ```
    - Analytics tracked:
      - Popular search terms
      - Zero-result queries (for improving search)
      - Click-through rates
      - Refinement patterns
      - Search abandonment
      - Time to first click
    - Admin dashboard shows search insights

19. **User sees search suggestions based on history:**
    - User has frequently searched "payment"
    - User starts typing "pay"
    - Autocomplete prioritizes based on user history:
      ```
      Suggestions:
      🔍 payment schedule (you searched 5 times)
      🔍 payment terms (you searched 3 times)
      🔍 pay rate
      👤 PayPal Support
      ```
    - Personalized suggestions improve over time
    - Based on user's search patterns
    - Combined with global trending searches

20. **Zero results handling:**
    - User searches: "deliverables milestone 3"
    - No exact matches found
    - **API Response:**
    ```json
    {
      "results": [],
      "total_results": 0,
      "suggestions": {
        "did_you_mean": "deliverable milestone 3",
        "alternative_queries": [
          "milestone 3",
          "deliverables",
          "milestone deliverables"
        ],
        "related_searches": [
          "project milestones",
          "deliverable schedule"
        ]
      }
    }
    ```

    - Zero results page shown:

      ```
      No results found for "deliverables milestone 3"
      
      Did you mean: deliverable milestone 3?
      
      Try searching for:
      • milestone 3
      • deliverables
      • project milestones
      
      Search tips:

      • Use fewer keywords
      • Remove filters
      
      [Clear Filters] [Try Different Search]
      ```

      ```
      │                          │
      │ 📎 contract_draft.pdf   │
      │                          │
      │ ──────────────────────  │
      │                          │
      │ [👤] Alice Brown        │
      │ Legal Review            │
      │ Jan 8, 10:15 AM         │
      │                          │
      │ The contract terms      │
      │ need revision...        │
      │                          │

      ```
    - User swipes left on result card:
      - Reveals quick actions: [Reply] [View] [Save]
    - User swipes right:
      - Reveals: [Archive] [Delete]
    - Tap card to open message in conversation
    - Long-press for context menu

23. **Voice search on mobile:**
    - User taps microphone icon 🎤
    - Voice input starts: "Listening..."
    - User says: "payment schedule from Bob"
    - Speech-to-text converts to query
    - Search bar shows: "payment schedule from bob"
    - Search executes automatically
    - Results shown with voice feedback option
    - System learns voice patterns over time

**Phase 9: Search Index Management**

24. **Real-time search indexing:**
    - New message sent: "Final milestone completed!"
    - Message saved to database
    - **Event published:** `message.created`
    - Search indexing service picks up event
    - **API Call:** `POST /v1/elasticsearch/index`
    ```json
    {
      "document_id": "msg_new123",
      "document_type": "MESSAGE",
      "content": {
        "message_id": "msg_new123",
        "text": "Final milestone completed!",
        "sender_id": "user_abc",
        "sender_name": "Alice Brown",
        "conversation_id": "conv_xyz",
        "conversation_title": "Project XYZ",
        "sent_at": "2025-01-15T16:00:00Z",
        "has_attachments": false,
        "is_deleted": false,
        "pii_redacted": false
      }
    }
    ```
    - Document indexed in Elasticsearch within 1 second
    - Message immediately searchable
    - No delay between send and searchability

25. **PII redaction before indexing:**
    - Message contains: "My email is alice@example.com and SSN is 123-45-6789"
    - Before indexing, PII detection runs
    - Email and SSN detected
    - **Redacted version indexed:**
    ```json
    {
      "text_indexed": "My email is [EMAIL_REDACTED] and SSN is [SSN_REDACTED]",
      "text_original_encrypted": "...",
      "pii_detected": ["EMAIL", "SSN"],
      "pii_locations": [...]
    }
    ```
    - Indexed text: "My email is [EMAIL_REDACTED] and SSN is [SSN_REDACTED]"
    - Original text encrypted and stored separately
    - Search works: user searches "email", finds message
    - But PII not exposed in search index
    - When user views message, original content decrypted and shown
    - Search results show redacted version

26. **Deleted message handling in search:**
    - User deletes message
    - **API Call:** `DELETE /v1/messages/{messageId}`
    - Message marked as deleted in database
    - Search index updated
    - **API Call:** `POST /v1/elasticsearch/update`
    ```json
    {
      "document_id": "msg_abc123",
      "update": {
        "is_deleted": true,
        "deleted_at": "2025-01-15T16:30:00Z"
      }
    }
    ```
    - Default search excludes deleted messages
    - Admin search can include deleted (if retention policy allows)
    - Filter option: "Include deleted messages" (admin only)

**Edge Cases & Alternate Flows:**

**Search Query Issues:**

27. **Malformed or very long query:**
    - User pastes entire email into search: 5000 characters
    - **API Response:** `400 Bad Request`
    ```json
    {
      "error": "QUERY_TOO_LONG",
      "message": "Search query exceeds maximum length of 500 characters",
      "max_length": 500,
      "query_length": 5000
    }
    ```
    - Error shown: "⚠️ Search query too long. Please use fewer than 500 characters."
    - User sees character counter: "500 / 500 characters"
    - Query truncated automatically with warning

28. **Special characters in query:**
    - User searches: `project@#$%&*()!`
    - Special characters sanitized
    - Search processes as: `project`
    - Warning: "Special characters removed from search"
    - User searches with emoji: `contract 🎉`
    - Emoji preserved in search
    - Matches messages with emoji or text

29. **Search timeout:**
    - Very complex search takes too long (>10 seconds)
    - **API Response:** `408 Request Timeout`
    ```json
    {
      "error": "SEARCH_TIMEOUT",
      "message": "Search took too long. Try simplifying your query.",
      "suggestions": [
        "Use more specific terms",
        "Reduce date range",
        "Remove some filters"
      ]
    }
    ```
    - Error shown with suggestions
    - User can retry with simplified query

**Filter Conflicts:**

30. **Contradictory filters:**
    - User selects:
      - Date range: Last week
      - Sender: User who joined yesterday
    - **API Response:** Zero results
    - Smart suggestion: "No messages from [User] in last week. They joined yesterday. Try 'Yesterday' filter?"
    - One-click to apply suggestion

31. **Too many filters:**
    - User applies 10+ filters
    - Very narrow results: 0-2 matches
    - Warning: "Too many filters applied. Results may be very limited."
    - Suggestion: "Remove some filters to see more results"
    - Option to "Reset Filters" prominently shown

**Search Index Issues:**

32. **Search index out of sync:**
    - Elasticsearch cluster temporarily down
    - Search requests fail
    - **Fallback to database search:**
      - Simpler, slower search on PostgreSQL
      - Limited features (no advanced filters, ranking)
      - Warning banner: "⚠️ Search running in limited mode. Advanced features temporarily unavailable."
    - Results still returned but with degraded UX
    - When Elasticsearch recovers, banner disappears

33. **Index rebuild required:**
    - Major search service update requires reindex
    - Admin triggers full reindex
    - **Background job processes all messages**
    - Banner shown to users:
      ```
      ℹ️ Search is being updated
      Search results may be incomplete during this time.
      Estimated completion: 2 hours
      ```
    - Search continues to work during reindex
    - New messages indexed normally
    - Old messages gradually reindexed

**Mobile-Specific Issues:**

34. **Poor network connection:**
    - User on slow mobile connection
    - Search request times out
    - **Offline cache used:**
      - Recent searches cached locally
      - User sees: "⚠️ You're offline. Showing cached results from [timestamp]"
      - Limited results shown from cache
    - When connection restored, fresh results loaded

35. **Voice search errors:**
    - User's speech unclear or noisy environment
    - Speech-to-text fails or produces gibberish
    - Error: "Couldn't understand. Please try again or type your search."
    - Option to type instead prominently shown
    - User can retry voice input

**Notifications:**

**In-App Notifications:**
- New results for saved search
- Search completed (for slow searches)
- Saved search created/updated/deleted
- Search failed (with reason)

**Email Notifications:**
- Daily/weekly digest of saved search results (if enabled)
- New matches for important saved searches
- Search feature updates (new filters, operators)

**Push Notifications (Mobile):**
- "New results match your saved search: [Search Name]"
- "Your search has completed" (for background searches)

**WebSocket Events:**
- `search.completed` — Search finished processing
- `search.saved_match` — New result for saved search
- `search.index_updated` — New messages indexed

**Analytics Events:**

Suggested tracking:
- `search_query_submitted` — User submits search
  - query_length (characters)
  - has_filters (boolean)
  - search_scope (GLOBAL, CONVERSATION, ATTACHMENTS)
  - results_count
- `search_result_clicked` — User clicks search result
  - result_position (1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.)
  - result_type (MESSAGE, ATTACHMENT, CONVERSATION)
  - time_to_click_seconds
- `search_refined` — User refines/filters search
  - filter_types_added
  - filter_types_removed
  - refinement_count
- `search_saved` — User saves search
  - notifications_enabled (boolean)
  - filter_count
- `search_abandoned` — User leaves without clicking
  - results_count
  - time_on_results_seconds
- `zero_results_search` — Search with no results
  - query (for improving search)
  - filters_applied
- `search_voice_used` — Voice search attempted (mobile)
  - success (boolean)
  - language
- `search_autocomplete_selected` — User selects suggestion
  - suggestion_type (QUERY, PERSON, CONVERSATION)
  - suggestion_position

**Accessibility:**

- **Keyboard Navigation:**
  - Tab to focus search input
  - Arrow keys to navigate autocomplete suggestions
  - Enter to select suggestion or submit search
  - Tab through search results
  - Ctrl+F to open search (in addition to existing browser search)
  - Esc to clear search and close
  - Arrow keys for prev/next result in conversation search
  
- **Screen Reader Support:**
  - Announce search results count: "Found 27 results for contract terms"
  - Announce autocomplete suggestions: "5 suggestions available. Use arrow keys to navigate."
  - Read result snippets with highlights: "Message from Bob Smith: I've reviewed the contract terms..."
  - Announce filter changes: "Filter applied: Messages from Bob Smith"
  - Announce navigation: "Showing match 2 of 3"
  - Live region updates for dynamic results
  
- **Visual Accessibility:**
  - High contrast highlight color (WCAG AA compliant)
  - Search term highlight: Yellow background (#FFD700) with dark text
  - Large, tappable search filters (min 44×44px)
  - Clear focus indicators on search input and results
  - Loading states with spinner + text
  - Color-blind friendly filter chips
  - Zoom-friendly text sizes (min 16px)
  
- **Cognitive Accessibility:**
  - Clear placeholder text with examples
  - Search tips and operator help easily accessible
  - Progressive disclosure of advanced filters
  - Undo for cleared searches
  - Confirm before deleting saved searches
  - Simple language in error messages
  - Visual feedback for all actions

**Performance Targets:**

- **Autocomplete Response:** < 100ms
- **Simple Search Query:** < 200ms
- **Complex Search (multiple filters):** < 500ms
- **Search with 1000+ results:** < 1 second
- **In-Conversation Search:** < 150ms
- **Attachment Search:** < 300ms
- **Saved Search Load:** < 200ms
- **Search Index Update:** < 1 second after message sent
- **Search Suggestions Load:** < 100ms
- **Voice-to-Text:** < 2 seconds
- **Mobile Search:** < 300ms (on 4G connection)
- **Results Pagination:** < 200ms per page
- **Filter Application:** < 150ms
- **Search History Load:** < 100ms

**Caching Strategy:**
- Autocomplete suggestions: 5 minutes
- Recent searches: 30 minutes (browser storage)
- Saved searches: 10 minutes
- Popular search terms: 1 hour
- User search preferences: 1 hour
- Search results: 2 minutes (with cache invalidation on new messages)

**Security:**

- **Authentication:** All search endpoints require valid JWT
- **Authorization:**
  - Users can only search own messages/conversations
  - Admin search requires admin role
  - Deleted message search restricted to admins
  - Legal hold content requires special permission
- **Rate Limiting:**
  - Max 100 search queries per user per minute
  - Max 500 autocomplete requests per user per minute
  - Saved searches: Max 20 per user
  - Search API: 1000 requests per minute per user
- **Input Sanitization:**
  - HTML/script tags stripped from queries
  - SQL injection prevention
  - XSS protection in search results display
  - Validate all filter parameters
- **PII Protection:**
  - Redact PII before indexing
  - Encrypt sensitive content
  - Search logs anonymized after 30 days
  - No PII in search analytics
- **Query Logging:**
  - Log all search queries for security monitoring
  - Detect unusual search patterns
  - Flag potential data exfiltration attempts
  - Alert on suspicious query volumes
- **Result Filtering:**
  - Respect conversation permissions
  - Filter results based on user access rights
  - Hide blocked users' messages
  - Respect deleted content (unless admin)
- **Elasticsearch Security:**
  - Separate indices per organization
  - Field-level security
  - Audit logging enabled
  - Encrypted at rest and in transit

### Journey: COM-14 (Webhooks & Integrations)

**ID:** COM-14  
**Persona:** Developers, Organization Admins, Power Users  
**Description:** Comprehensive webhook and integration system enabling developers to receive real-time notifications about platform events, integrate external services, and build custom applications with features including webhook subscription management, event type selection, payload customization, webhook delivery tracking, retry logic with exponential backoff, webhook signatures (Ed25519) for security, replay protection, webhook logs and debugging, integration marketplace, OAuth2 authentication, API key management, rate limiting, and webhook testing tools.  

**Preconditions & Triggers:**  
**Triggers:**  
- Developer wants to integrate external service  
- User navigates to Settings > Integrations  
- Developer wants to receive real-time event notifications  
- Organization admin enables third-party integration  
- Developer creates new webhook subscription  
- System needs to notify external service of event  
- Developer wants to test webhook endpoint  
- Admin reviews webhook delivery logs  
- Integration fails and needs debugging  
- Developer wants to update webhook URL  
- Security team audits webhook activity  
- Rate limit exceeded notification needed  

**Preconditions:**  
- User is authenticated  
- User has active account  
- For webhook creation: User has developer/admin role  
- For integrations: User has integration permissions  
- API access is enabled for account  
- Webhook endpoint is accessible (HTTPS required)  
- User has not exceeded webhook quota  
- Organization allows third-party integrations  

**Primary Screens:**  
**Web:**  
- `(dashboard)/settings/integrations/page.tsx` — Integrations dashboard  
- `(dashboard)/settings/integrations/webhooks/page.tsx` — Webhook management  
- `(dashboard)/settings/integrations/webhooks/new/page.tsx` — Create webhook  
- `(dashboard)/settings/integrations/webhooks/[webhookId]/page.tsx` — Webhook details  
- `(dashboard)/settings/integrations/webhooks/[webhookId]/logs/page.tsx` — Delivery logs  
- `(dashboard)/settings/integrations/webhooks/[webhookId]/test/page.tsx` — Test webhook  
- `(dashboard)/settings/integrations/api-keys/page.tsx` — API key management  
- `(dashboard)/settings/integrations/marketplace/page.tsx` — Integration marketplace  
- `(dashboard)/settings/integrations/oauth/page.tsx` — OAuth connections  
- `(dashboard)/developer/page.tsx` — Developer portal  
- `(dashboard)/developer/docs/page.tsx` — API documentation  

**Mobile:**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/integrations/index.tsx` — Integrations home  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/integrations/webhooks.tsx` — Webhook list  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/integrations/webhooks/[webhookId].tsx` — Webhook detail  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/integrations/webhooks/new.tsx` — Create webhook  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/integrations/api-keys.tsx` — API keys  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/integrations/marketplace.tsx` — Marketplace  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/integrations/oauth.tsx` — OAuth apps  

**System Touchpoints:**  
- **communications-be:**  
  - `webhook/entity.go` — Webhook subscription entity  
  - `webhook_event/entity.go` — Event types and payloads  
  - `webhook_delivery/entity.go` — Delivery tracking  
  - `webhook_signature/entity.go` — Signature generation  
  - `POST /v1/webhooks` — Create webhook subscription  
  - `GET /v1/webhooks` — List webhooks  
  - `GET /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}` — Get webhook details  
  - `PUT /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}` — Update webhook  
  - `DELETE /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}` — Delete webhook  
  - `POST /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}/test` — Test webhook  
  - `GET /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}/deliveries` — Get delivery logs  
  - `POST /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}/deliveries/{deliveryId}/redeliver` — Retry delivery  
  - `GET /v1/webhooks/events` — List available events  
  
- **admin-be:**  
  - `integration/entity.go` — Third-party integrations  
  - `api_key/entity.go` — API key management  
  - `oauth_app/entity.go` — OAuth applications  
  - `POST /v1/admin/integrations` — Create integration  
  - `GET /v1/admin/integrations` — List integrations  
  - `POST /v1/admin/api-keys` — Generate API key  
  - `GET /v1/admin/api-keys` — List API keys  
  - `DELETE /v1/admin/api-keys/{keyId}` — Revoke API key  
  - `GET /v1/admin/webhooks/stats` — Webhook statistics  
  
- **users-be:**  
  - `GET /v1/users/{userId}` — User data for webhook context  
  - User permissions for integration access  

**Flow Steps:**

**Phase 1: Webhook Setup**

1. **User navigates to integrations dashboard:**
   - User clicks Settings > Integrations
   - Dashboard loads showing:
     - Active integrations count
     - Webhook subscriptions count
     - API keys count
     - Recent webhook activity
   - **API Call:** `GET /v1/integrations/dashboard`
   - **Response:**
   ```json
   {
     "summary": {
       "active_webhooks": 5,
       "active_integrations": 3,
       "api_keys": 2,
       "webhook_deliveries_today": 1247,
       "webhook_success_rate": 98.5
     },
     "recent_activity": [
       {
         "type": "WEBHOOK_DELIVERY",
         "webhook_id": "wh_abc123",
         "event_type": "message.created",
         "status": "SUCCESS",
         "timestamp": "2025-01-15T16:30:00Z"
       }
     ]
   }
   ```
   - Dashboard displays:
     ```

     Overview
     • 5 Active Webhooks
     • 3 Connected Integrations
     • 2 API Keys
     • 1,247 Deliveries Today (98.5% success)
     ```

2. **User clicks "Create Webhook":**
   - User navigates to Webhooks section
   - Clicks "+ New Webhook" button

     ```
     Create Webhook Subscription

     ☑ message.updated
     ☐ message.deleted
     ☑ message.delivered
     ☐ message.read

     ☐ conversation.updated
     ☐ conversation.archived
     
     Users

     ☐ user.offline
     
     [Show All Events (24 available)]
     
     ⚠️ Note: Select only events you need to reduce payload
     ```

3. **User configures webhook settings:**
   - User scrolls to advanced settings section:
     ```
     Advanced Settings
     
     Secret Key (for signature verification)
     [Generate Secret] or [Enter Custom Secret]
     
     ℹ️ We'll sign webhook payloads using this secret.
        Verify signatures to ensure authenticity.
     
     Delivery Settings
     ☑ Enable automatic retries (recommended)
     Retry attempts: [3 ▼] (1, 3, 5, 10)
     Retry delay: [Exponential backoff ▼]
     
     Timeout: [30 seconds ▼] (10s, 30s, 60s, 120s)
     
     ☐ Include metadata in payload
     ☐ Compress payloads (gzip)
     
     Rate Limiting
     Max requests per minute: [100 ▼]
     
     Filters (optional)
     Only send webhooks for specific conditions:
     
     Conversation filter:
     ○ All conversations
     ● Specific conversations: [Select ▼]
     
     User filter:
     ○ All users
     ○ Specific users: [Select ▼]
     ```
   - User generates secret key
   - **API Call:** `POST /v1/webhooks/generate-secret`
   - **Response:**
   ```json
   {
     "secret": "whsec_K9v7N2pQ8xR4mT6hJ3cL5bW1dF0gS7yA",
     "algorithm": "Ed25519",
     "created_at": "2025-01-15T17:00:00Z"
   }
   ```
   - Secret displayed with copy button:
     ```
     🔑 Secret Key: whsec_K9v7N2pQ8xR4mT6hJ3cL5bW1dF0gS7yA
     [Copy] [Regenerate]
     
     ⚠️ Save this secret securely. You won't be able to see it again.
     ```

4. **User submits webhook creation:**
   - User clicks "Create Webhook"
   - Validation runs:
     - URL format check (must be HTTPS)
     - URL reachability test (optional)
     - At least one event selected
     - Secret key provided
   - **API Call:** `POST /v1/webhooks`
   ```json
   {
     "name": "Production Message Webhook",
     "url": "https://api.myapp.com/webhooks/skillsier",
     "description": "Webhook for syncing messages to our CRM",
     "events": [
       "message.created",
       "message.updated",
       "message.delivered",
       "conversation.created"
     ],
     "secret": "whsec_K9v7N2pQ8xR4mT6hJ3cL5bW1dF0gS7yA",
     "settings": {
       "retry_enabled": true,
       "retry_attempts": 3,
       "retry_strategy": "EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF",
       "timeout_seconds": 30,
       "include_metadata": false,
       "compress_payload": false,
       "rate_limit_per_minute": 100
     },
     "filters": {
       "conversation_ids": [],
       "user_ids": []
     }
   }
   ```
   - **Response:**
   ```json
   {
     "webhook_id": "wh_abc123",
     "name": "Production Message Webhook",
     "url": "https://api.myapp.com/webhooks/skillsier",
     "status": "ACTIVE",
     "events": ["message.created", "message.updated", "message.delivered", "conversation.created"],
     "created_at": "2025-01-15T17:00:00Z",
     "signing_secret_hint": "whsec_...S7yA",
     "webhook_url_example": "https://api.myapp.com/webhooks/skillsier"
   }
   ```
   - Success notification: "✅ Webhook created successfully!"
   - Redirect to webhook details page

**Phase 2: Webhook Event Delivery**

5. **Event occurs - Message created:**
   - User sends message: "Project update: Milestone 1 complete"
   - Message saved to database
   - Event published to event bus
   - Webhook service picks up event
   - Checks for matching webhook subscriptions
   - Finds webhook subscribed to `message.created`
   - Constructs webhook payload:
   ```json
   {
     "event_id": "evt_xyz789",
     "event_type": "message.created",
     "event_version": "1.0",
     "timestamp": "2025-01-15T17:05:00Z",
     "data": {
       "message": {
         "message_id": "msg_abc123",
         "conversation_id": "conv_xyz789",
         "sender": {
           "user_id": "user_abc",
           "name": "Alice Brown",
           "email": "alice@example.com"
         },
         "content": "Project update: Milestone 1 complete",
         "sent_at": "2025-01-15T17:05:00Z",
         "has_attachments": false,
         "message_type": "TEXT"
       }
     },
     "webhook": {
       "webhook_id": "wh_abc123",
       "subscription_id": "sub_def456"
     }
   }
   ```

6. **Webhook signature generation:**
   - System generates signature for payload
   - Algorithm: Ed25519
   - Signature process:
     1. Serialize payload to JSON (canonical format)
     2. Concatenate: timestamp + "." + payload
     3. Sign using secret key
     4. Encode signature as base64
   - **Signature components:**
   ```
   Timestamp: 1705338300
   Payload: {"event_id":"evt_xyz789",...}
   Signed String: 1705338300.{"event_id":"evt_xyz789",...}
   Signature: v1=a3Rfc2lnbmF0dXJlX2V4YW1wbGVfaGVyZQ==
   ```
   - Headers prepared:
   ```
   X-Skillsier-Signature: v1=a3Rfc2lnbmF0dXJlX2V4YW1wbGVfaGVyZQ==
   X-Skillsier-Timestamp: 1705338300
   X-Skillsier-Event-Id: evt_xyz789
   X-Skillsier-Event-Type: message.created
   X-Skillsier-Webhook-Id: wh_abc123
   Content-Type: application/json
   User-Agent: Skillsier-Webhooks/1.0
   ```

7. **Webhook delivery attempt:**
   - **HTTP POST to webhook URL:**
   ```
   POST https://api.myapp.com/webhooks/skillsier
   Headers:
     X-Skillsier-Signature: v1=a3Rfc2lnbmF0dXJlX2V4YW1wbGVfaGVyZQ==
     X-Skillsier-Timestamp: 1705338300
     X-Skillsier-Event-Id: evt_xyz789
     X-Skillsier-Event-Type: message.created
     X-Skillsier-Webhook-Id: wh_abc123
     Content-Type: application/json
   
   Body:
     {payload JSON}
   ```
   - **Recipient server processes:**
     1. Receives webhook
     2. Verifies signature (recommended)
     3. Checks timestamp (replay protection)
     4. Processes event data
     5. Returns HTTP 200 OK
   - **Response:**
   ```
   HTTP/1.1 200 OK
   Content-Type: application/json
   
   {
     "received": true,
     "processed_at": "2025-01-15T17:05:01Z"
   }
   ```
   - Delivery logged as SUCCESS
   - **Delivery record created:**
   ```json
   {
     "delivery_id": "del_123456",
     "webhook_id": "wh_abc123",
     "event_id": "evt_xyz789",
     "event_type": "message.created",
     "attempt_number": 1,
     "status": "SUCCESS",
     "status_code": 200,
     "delivered_at": "2025-01-15T17:05:00Z",
     "response_time_ms": 234,
     "request_body_size": 512,
     "response_body": "{\"received\":true}"
   }
   ```

**Phase 3: Webhook Failure & Retry**

8. **Webhook delivery fails:**
   - Message created event occurs
   - Webhook payload constructed
   - Delivery attempt to `https://api.myapp.com/webhooks/skillsier`
   - **Response:** Connection timeout / 500 Internal Server Error
   - Delivery marked as FAILED
   - **Delivery record:**
   ```json
   {
     "delivery_id": "del_789012",
     "webhook_id": "wh_abc123",
     "event_id": "evt_def456",
     "attempt_number": 1,
     "status": "FAILED",
     "status_code": null,
     "error_message": "Connection timeout after 30 seconds",
     "failed_at": "2025-01-15T17:10:00Z"
   }
   ```
   - Automatic retry scheduled

9. **Automatic retry with exponential backoff:**
   - Retry schedule calculated:
     - Attempt 1: Failed at 17:10:00
     - Attempt 2: Retry at 17:10:30 (30 seconds later)
     - Attempt 3: Retry at 17:12:30 (2 minutes later)
     - Attempt 4: Retry at 17:17:30 (5 minutes later)
   - **Retry attempt 2:**
     - Scheduled at 17:10:30
     - Same payload and signature sent
     - **Response:** HTTP 503 Service Unavailable
     - Status: FAILED
   - **Retry attempt 3:**
     - Scheduled at 17:12:30
     - **Response:** HTTP 200 OK
     - Status: SUCCESS
   - **Final delivery record:**
   ```json
   {
     "delivery_id": "del_789012",
     "webhook_id": "wh_abc123",
     "event_id": "evt_def456",
     "attempt_number": 3,
     "status": "SUCCESS",
     "status_code": 200,
     "delivered_at": "2025-01-15T17:12:30Z",
     "response_time_ms": 189,
     "retry_history": [
       {"attempt": 1, "status": "TIMEOUT", "timestamp": "2025-01-15T17:10:00Z"},
       {"attempt": 2, "status": "503", "timestamp": "2025-01-15T17:10:30Z"},
       {"attempt": 3, "status": "200", "timestamp": "2025-01-15T17:12:30Z"}
     ]
   }
   ```

10. **All retries exhausted:**
    - Webhook delivery fails 3 times
    - All retry attempts exhausted
    - Status: PERMANENTLY_FAILED
    - User receives notification:
      ```
      ⚠️ Webhook Delivery Failed
      
      Webhook: Production Message Webhook
      Event: message.created (evt_def789)
      URL: https://api.myapp.com/webhooks/skillsier
      
      All 3 retry attempts failed.
      Last error: Connection timeout
      
      [View Details] [Retry Manually] [Disable Webhook]
      ```
    - Email sent to webhook owner
    - Webhook statistics updated (failure count)

      ```
      [Copy to Clipboard]
      
      ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Save this key securely now.
      You won't be able to see it again.
      
      Use this key in API requests:
      Authorization: Bearer sk_example_do_not_copy_1234567890
      
      [I've Saved My Key]
      ```

18. **User uses API key in requests:**
    - Developer integrates API key into application
    - Makes API request:
      ```
      GET https://api.skillsier.com/v1/messages?conversation_id=conv_xyz
      Headers:
        Authorization: Bearer sk_example_do_not_copy_1234567890
        Content-Type: application/json
      ```
    - Backend validates API key:
      - Checks if key exists and is active
      - Verifies key has required permission (messages.read)
      - Checks rate limits
      - Validates IP (if allowlist configured)
    - Request succeeds, returns messages
    - API key usage logged

19. **API key rate limit exceeded:**
    - Application makes 101st request in one minute
    - Rate limit: 100 requests per minute
    - **API Response:** `429 Too Many Requests`
    ```json
    {
      "error": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
      "message": "API rate limit exceeded",
      "limit": 100,
      "period": "minute",
      "retry_after": 42
    }
    ```
    - Headers include:
      ```
      X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
      X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
      X-RateLimit-Reset: 1705338342
      Retry-After: 42
      ```
    - Application should back off and retry after 42 seconds

20. **User revokes API key:**
    - User navigates to API Keys list
    - Finds key to revoke
    - Clicks "Revoke" button
    - Confirmation modal:
      ```
      ⚠️ Revoke API Key?
      
      Key: Production API Key
      ID: key_abc123
      Created: Jan 15, 2025
      Last Used: 2 minutes ago
      
      This action cannot be undone.
      Applications using this key will immediately lose access.
      
      [Cancel] [Revoke Key]
      ```
    - User confirms
    - **API Call:** `DELETE /v1/admin/api-keys/key_abc123`
    - Key revoked immediately
    - All future requests with this key return 401 Unauthorized
    - Success notification: "✅ API key revoked"

**Edge Cases & Alternate Flows:**

**Webhook URL Validation:**

24. **Invalid webhook URL:**
    - User tries to create webhook with HTTP (not HTTPS) URL
    - Validation error:
      ```
      ⚠️ Invalid Webhook URL
      
      Webhook URLs must use HTTPS for security.
      
      Invalid: http://api.myapp.com/webhooks
      Valid:   https://api.myapp.com/webhooks
      ```
    - User corrects URL to HTTPS

25. **Unreachable webhook URL:**
    - User creates webhook with URL: `https://nonexistent-domain.com/webhook`
    - System performs reachability test (optional)
    - Test fails: DNS resolution failed
    - Warning shown:
      ```
      ⚠️ Warning: Webhook URL Unreachable
      
      We couldn't reach your webhook URL during testing.
      
      This might be because:
      • The domain doesn't exist
      • Your server is down
      • Firewall blocking our requests
      
      Webhook will be created but may not receive deliveries.
      
      [Fix URL] [Create Anyway]
      ```
    - User can choose to create anyway or fix URL

**Signature Verification:**

26. **Invalid signature - security breach attempt:**
    - Attacker tries to send fake webhook to user's endpoint
    - User's server receives webhook
    - Verifies signature using stored secret
    - **Verification fails:**
      ```python
      def verify_webhook_signature(payload, signature, secret, timestamp):
          # Check timestamp (replay protection)
          current_time = int(time.time())
          if abs(current_time - int(timestamp)) > 300:  # 5 minutes
              return False
          
          # Reconstruct signed string
          signed_string = f"{timestamp}.{payload}"
          
          # Verify signature
          expected_signature = compute_signature(signed_string, secret)
          
          return signature == expected_signature
      ```
    - Signature doesn't match
    - User's server rejects webhook: 401 Unauthorized
    - Attacker's fake webhook blocked

27. **Timestamp too old (replay attack prevention):**
    - Attacker captures legitimate webhook
    - Tries to replay it 10 minutes later
    - User's server checks timestamp
    - Current time: 1705338900
    - Webhook timestamp: 1705338300 (10 minutes old)
    - Difference: 600 seconds > 300 seconds (5 minute window)
    - Webhook rejected: "Timestamp too old"
    - Replay attack prevented

**Rate Limiting:**

28. **Webhook rate limit exceeded:**
    - High-frequency events (100+ messages per minute)
    - Webhook configured for all message events
    - Rate limit: 100 webhooks per minute
    - 101st webhook in minute blocked
    - **Response to webhook subscriber:**
      ```
      ⚠️ Webhook Rate Limit Exceeded
      
      Your webhook received 100 events in the last minute.
      Further events will be queued and sent when the rate limit resets.
      
      Webhook: Production Message Webhook
      Rate Limit: 100 per minute
      Resets in: 42 seconds
      
      Consider:
      • Filtering events (subscribe to fewer event types)
      • Increasing rate limit (contact support)
      • Batching events
      ```
    - Queued events sent when rate limit resets
    - User notified via email

29. **Burst handling:**
    - 50 messages sent simultaneously
    - 50 webhook deliveries queued
    - System processes in batches
    - Respects rate limits
    - All webhooks eventually delivered
    - Some with slight delay (1-2 seconds)

**Integration Issues:**

30. **OAuth token expired:**
    - Slack integration installed
    - OAuth access token expires after 30 days
    - Integration tries to post notification
    - **Slack API Response:** 401 Unauthorized
    - System attempts token refresh:
      - Uses refresh token
      - **API Call:** `POST https://slack.com/api/oauth.v2.access`
      - Gets new access token
      - Retries notification
    - If refresh fails:
      - Integration marked as "Needs Reauthorization"
      - User notified:
        ```
        ⚠️ Slack Integration Needs Reauthorization
        
        Your Slack connection has expired.
        Please reconnect to continue receiving notifications.
        
        [Reconnect Slack]
        ```

31. **Integration uninstalled by user:**
    - User goes to Slack app settings
    - Uninstalls Skillsier app from Slack
    - Slack sends uninstall webhook to Skillsier
    - Skillsier receives webhook
    - Automatically deactivates integration
    - User receives notification:
      ```
      ℹ️ Slack Integration Disconnected
      
      The Skillsier app was removed from your Slack workspace.
      Your integration has been automatically disabled.
      
      [Reinstall] [Remove Integration]
      ```
