- `webhook.delivery_success` — Successful delivery
- `webhook.delivery_failed` — Failed delivery
- `webhook.disabled` — Webhook disabled
- `integration.installed` — New integration
- `integration.disconnected` — Integration removed

**Analytics Events:**

Suggested tracking:
- `webhook_created` — Webhook subscription created
  - event_types_count
  - has_filters (boolean)
  - retry_enabled (boolean)
- `webhook_delivery_attempted` — Delivery attempt
  - event_type
  - status (SUCCESS, FAILED, TIMEOUT)
  - attempt_number
  - response_time_ms
- `webhook_delivery_failed` — Permanent failure
  - event_type
  - total_attempts
  - final_error_code
- `webhook_tested` — Test delivery sent
  - success (boolean)
  - response_time_ms
- `api_key_created` — New API key generated
  - permissions_count
  - has_expiration (boolean)
  - has_ip_allowlist (boolean)
- `api_key_used` — API request with key
  - endpoint
  - method
  - status_code
- `api_key_rate_limited` — Rate limit hit
  - limit_type (PER_MINUTE, PER_DAY)
- `integration_installed` — Marketplace integration added
  - integration_name
  - auth_type (OAUTH2, API_KEY)
- `integration_configured` — Integration settings updated
  - integration_name
  - settings_changed

**Accessibility:**

- **Keyboard Navigation:**
  - Tab through webhook list
  - Enter to select webhook for details
  - Arrow keys for delivery log pagination
  - Ctrl+N for new webhook (when in webhooks section)
  - Esc to close modals
  
- **Screen Reader Support:**
  - Announce webhook status: "Webhook Production Message Webhook, Status: Active"
  - Read delivery logs: "Delivery at 5:05 PM, Status: Success, Response time 234 milliseconds"
  - Announce test results: "Webhook test successful, Status 200 OK"
  - Alert on failures: "Warning: Webhook delivery failed after 3 attempts"
  - Read API key (only first/last 4 chars): "API key starting with sk_li, ending with S7yA"
  
- **Visual Accessibility:**
  - Color-coded status with icons (not color-only):
    - Active: 🟢 Green + "Active"
    - Disabled: ⚫ Gray + "Disabled"
    - Failed: 🔴 Red + "Failed"
  - High contrast for code snippets
  - Large clickable areas for webhook cards
  - Clear focus indicators
  
- **Cognitive Accessibility:**
  - Step-by-step webhook creation wizard
  - Clear explanations of technical concepts
  - Visual examples of webhook payloads
  - Test functionality to verify before production
  - Helpful error messages with solutions
  - Confirmation dialogs for destructive actions

**Performance Targets:**

- **Webhook Creation:** < 500ms
- **Webhook Delivery:** < 2 seconds (from event to delivery)
- **Signature Generation:** < 50ms
- **Webhook Test:** < 3 seconds (includes HTTP request to user endpoint)
- **Delivery Log Load:** < 1 second for 100 deliveries
- **API Key Generation:** < 300ms
- **API Key Validation:** < 50ms (cached)
- **Integration Marketplace Load:** < 1 second
- **OAuth Flow:** < 5 seconds (total flow)
- **Retry Delay:**
  - Attempt 1: Immediate
  - Attempt 2: 30 seconds
  - Attempt 3: 2 minutes
  - Attempt 4: 5 minutes
- **Event Processing:** < 100ms (from event to queue)

**Security:**

- **Webhook Security:**
  - HTTPS required for all webhook URLs
  - Ed25519 signature on all payloads
  - Timestamp-based replay protection (5-minute window)
  - Secret rotation capability
  - IP allowlist support (optional)
  
- **API Key Security:**
  - Cryptographically secure random generation
  - One-time display (never shown again)
  - Scoped permissions (principle of least privilege)
  - Rate limiting per key
  - IP allowlist support
  - Automatic revocation on suspicious activity
  - Audit logging of all key usage
  
- **OAuth Security:**
  - State parameter for CSRF protection
  - PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) support
  - Short-lived authorization codes
  - Refresh token rotation
  - Scope limitation
  
- **Data Protection:**
  - Webhook secrets encrypted at rest
  - API keys hashed (bcrypt)
  - TLS 1.3 for all communications
  - No sensitive data in webhook URLs
  - PII redaction in logs
  
- **Access Control:**
  - Role-based permissions for webhook management
  - Organization-level integration controls
  - User consent for OAuth integrations
  - Admin approval for sensitive integrations
  
- **Monitoring:**
  - Alert on failed signature verifications
  - Detect unusual webhook patterns
  - Monitor for potential DDoS via webhooks
  - Track API key usage anomalies
  - Log all integration activities

### Journey: COM-15 (Compliance & Data Privacy)

**ID:** COM-15  
**Persona:** All Users (Freelancers, Clients, Admins, Compliance Officers, Legal Team)  
**Description:** Comprehensive compliance and data privacy system enabling users to manage their data rights, export personal information, request data deletion, audit data access, and comply with global privacy regulations with features including GDPR data export requests, right to erasure (data deletion), data portability, audit trails and access logs, data zone segregation (EU/US/Other regions), encryption at rest (KMS integration), end-to-end encryption (E2EE) support, message retention policies, consent management, privacy policy acceptance tracking, data processing agreements, legal holds, data breach notifications, and compliance reporting dashboard.  

**Preconditions & Triggers:**  
**Triggers:**  
- User exercises GDPR/CCPA data rights  
- User requests personal data export  
- User wants to delete account and data  
- User reviews privacy settings  
- Admin needs compliance audit report  
- Legal team places data under legal hold  
- Data breach detection requires notification  
- New privacy policy released  
- User updates consent preferences  
- Organization enables E2EE  
- Compliance officer reviews audit logs  
- User requests data processing agreement  
- System detects unauthorized access attempt  
- Regulatory audit requires documentation  

**Preconditions:**  
- User is authenticated  
- User has active account (or recently deleted)  
- For admin functions: User has compliance/legal role  
- For data deletion: No active contracts/legal holds  
- For EU users: GDPR compliance enabled  
- For CA users: CCPA compliance enabled  
- Encryption keys properly configured  
- Audit logging system operational  

**Primary Screens:**  
**Web:**  
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/page.tsx` — Privacy settings center  
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/data-export/page.tsx` — Data export requests  
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/data-deletion/page.tsx` — Account deletion  
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/consent/page.tsx` — Consent management  
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/audit-log/page.tsx` — Personal audit log  
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/encryption/page.tsx` — Encryption settings  
- `(dashboard)/settings/privacy/retention/page.tsx` — Data retention  
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/page.tsx` — Compliance dashboard  
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/audit-logs/page.tsx` — System audit logs  
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/legal-holds/page.tsx` — Legal holds  
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/data-breaches/page.tsx` — Breach management  
- `(dashboard)/admin/compliance/reports/page.tsx` — Compliance reports  
- `(dashboard)/legal/dpa/page.tsx` — Data processing agreements  

**Mobile:**  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/index.tsx` — Privacy home  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/data-export.tsx` — Export data  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/delete-account.tsx` — Delete account  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/consent.tsx` — Consent settings  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/audit-log.tsx` — Access log  
- `(mobile)/(app)/settings/privacy/encryption.tsx` — Encryption  
- `(mobile)/(app)/admin/compliance/dashboard.tsx` — Compliance (admin)  

**System Touchpoints:**  
- **communications-be:**  
  - `data_export_request/entity.go` — Export requests  
  - `data_deletion_request/entity.go` — Deletion requests  
  - `user_consent/entity.go` — Consent tracking  
  - `audit_log/entity.go` — Audit logging  
  - `encryption_key/entity.go` — Encryption management  
  - `POST /v1/privacy/export-request` — Request data export  
  - `POST /v1/privacy/deletion-request` — Request data deletion  
  - `GET /v1/privacy/audit-log` — Get personal audit log  
  - `PUT /v1/privacy/consent` — Update consent preferences  
  - `GET /v1/privacy/data-report` — Get data usage report  
  - `POST /v1/privacy/encryption/enable` — Enable E2EE  
  
- **admin-be:**  
  - `compliance_report/entity.go` — Compliance reporting  
  - `legal_hold/entity.go` — Legal holds  
  - `data_breach/entity.go` — Breach tracking  
  - `data_processing_agreement/entity.go` — DPAs  
  - `GET /v1/admin/compliance/dashboard` — Compliance metrics  
  - `GET /v1/admin/audit-logs` — System-wide audit logs  
  - `POST /v1/admin/legal-holds` — Create legal hold  
  - `POST /v1/admin/data-breach/report` — Report breach  
  - `GET /v1/admin/compliance/reports` — Generate reports  
  
- **users-be:**  
  - `GET /v1/users/{userId}/data` — User data for export  
  - `DELETE /v1/users/{userId}` — Delete user account  
  - User data anonymization  
  
- **storage-be:**  
  - Encrypted storage (KMS integration)  
  - Data zone segregation  
  - Secure deletion (overwrite)  

**Flow Steps:**

**Phase 1: GDPR Data Export Request**

1. **User initiates data export request:**
   - EU user navigates to Settings > Privacy & Data
   - Clicks "Download Your Data"
   - Data export information page displays:
     ```
     Download Your Data
     
     Under GDPR Article 15, you have the right to access your
     personal data. We'll compile all your data into a
     downloadable file.
     
     What's included:
     ✓ Profile information
     ✓ Messages and conversations
     ✓ Job posts and proposals
     ✓ Contracts and transactions
     ✓ Payment information
     ✓ Settings and preferences
     ✓ Activity logs
     
     Format: ZIP archive with JSON files
     Processing time: Up to 48 hours
     Available for: 30 days after completion
     
     [Request Data Export]
     ```
   - User clicks "Request Data Export"

2. **User confirms export request:**
   - Confirmation modal appears:
     ```
     Confirm Data Export Request
     
     This will create a comprehensive archive of all your
     personal data stored on Skillsier.
     
     ⚠️ The export will include sensitive information:
     • Financial data (payment history)
     • Private messages
     • Contract details
     • Identity verification documents
     
     Please ensure you:
     • Store the export securely
     • Use a strong password if encrypting
     • Delete the export after review
     
     Verify your identity:
     [Enter your password: __________]
     
     [Cancel] [Confirm Export Request]
     ```
   - User enters password for verification
   - User clicks "Confirm Export Request"
   - **API Call:** `POST /v1/privacy/export-request`
   ```json
   {
     "user_id": "user_abc123",
     "request_type": "GDPR_ARTICLE_15",
     "export_format": "JSON",
     "include_sections": [
       "PROFILE",
       "MESSAGES",
       "JOBS",
       "CONTRACTS",
       "PAYMENTS",
       "SETTINGS",
       "ACTIVITY_LOGS"
     ],
     "encryption_requested": false,
     "verification": {
       "method": "PASSWORD",
       "password_hash": "..."
     }
   }
   ```
   - **Response:**
   ```json
   {
     "request_id": "export_xyz789",
     "status": "PENDING",
     "requested_at": "2025-01-15T18:00:00Z",
     "estimated_completion": "2025-01-17T18:00:00Z",
     "legal_basis": "GDPR_ARTICLE_15",
     "request_reference": "GDPR-EXP-20250115-789"
   }
   ```
   - Success notification: "✅ Data export requested. Reference: GDPR-EXP-20250115-789"
   - Email confirmation sent

3. **System processes export request:**
   - Export job queued in background
   - System collects data from all services:
     - **users-be:** Profile, settings, preferences
     - **communications-be:** Messages, conversations
     - **jobs-be:** Job posts, applications
     - **proposals-be:** Proposals sent/received
     - **contracts-be:** Contract details
     - **financial-be:** Payment history, invoices
     - **reviews-be:** Reviews given/received
     - **storage-be:** Uploaded files metadata
   - Data compiled into structured format:
     ```json
     {
       "export_metadata": {
         "export_id": "export_xyz789",
         "user_id": "user_abc123",
         "exported_at": "2025-01-16T10:00:00Z",
         "legal_basis": "GDPR Article 15 - Right to Access",
         "data_controller": "Skillsier Inc.",
         "contact": "privacy@skillsier.com"
       },
       "profile": {
         "user_id": "user_abc123",
         "email": "alice@example.com",
         "name": "Alice Brown",
         "created_at": "2023-05-10T14:30:00Z",
         "location": "Berlin, Germany",
         "timezone": "Europe/Berlin"
       },
       "messages": [...],
       "contracts": [...],
       "payments": [...]
     }
     ```
   - Data packaged into ZIP file
   - File uploaded to secure storage with 30-day expiration
   - Request status: COMPLETED

4. **User receives export ready notification:**
   - Email notification sent:
     ```
     Subject: Your Data Export is Ready
     
     Hi Alice,
     
     Your personal data export is ready for download.
     
     Request Reference: GDPR-EXP-20250115-789
     Requested: Jan 15, 2025
     Completed: Jan 16, 2025
     File Size: 87.3 MB
     
     The export includes:
     • Profile information
     • 1,453 messages
     • 23 contracts
     • 67 payment records
     • Activity logs (2 years)
     
     Download your export:
     [Download Data Export]
     
     Important:
     • Link expires in 30 days
     • Store file securely
     • Delete after review
     
     Questions? Contact privacy@skillsier.com
     ```
   - In-app notification appears
   - User navigates to Privacy settings
   - Download button active:
     ```
     ✅ Your Data Export is Ready
     
     Status: Completed
     File Size: 87.3 MB
     Completed: Jan 16, 2025 at 10:00 AM
     Expires: Feb 15, 2025
     
     [Download Export (87.3 MB)]
     [Delete Export]
     ```

5. **User downloads export:**
   - User clicks "Download Export"
   - **API Call:** `GET /v1/privacy/export-request/{requestId}/download`
   - Presigned download URL returned
   - Browser downloads: `skillsier_data_export_20250116.zip`
   - Download logged in audit trail
   - User extracts ZIP:
     ```
     skillsier_data_export_20250116/
     ├── README.txt
     ├── profile.json
     ├── messages.json
     ├── conversations.json
     ├── contracts.json
     ├── payments.json
     ├── jobs.json
     ├── proposals.json
     ├── reviews.json
     ├── activity_log.json
     ├── settings.json
     └── attachments/
         ├── document1.pdf
         ├── image1.jpg
         └── ...
     ```
   - README.txt explains file structure and contents

**Phase 2: Right to Erasure (Data Deletion)**

6. **User requests account deletion:**
   - User navigates to Settings > Privacy & Data
   - Clicks "Delete My Account"
   - Warning page displays:
     ```
     ⚠️ Delete Your Account
     
     This will permanently delete your Skillsier account and
     all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
     
     Before you proceed:
     
     ✓ Complete all active contracts (2 active)
     ✓ Resolve any disputes (0 disputes)
     ✓ Withdraw available balance ($150.00)
     ✓ Cancel active subscriptions (1 subscription)
     ✓ Download your data (if needed)
     
     What will be deleted:
     • Profile and account information
     • All messages and conversations
     • Job posts and proposals
     • Reviews and ratings (anonymized)
     • Payment history (retained 7 years for tax compliance)
     
     What will be retained:
     • Financial records (legal requirement)
     • Aggregated analytics (anonymized)
     • Fraud prevention data (anonymized)
     
     Retention period: 30 days
     After 30 days, your account will be permanently deleted.
     You can cancel deletion anytime within 30 days.
     
     [Cancel] [Continue to Delete Account]
     ```
   - User reviews information
   - Notices 2 active contracts blocking deletion

7. **User resolves blockers and retries:**
   - User completes active contracts
   - User withdraws balance
   - User cancels subscription
   - User returns to deletion page
   - All blockers cleared:
     ```
     ✅ Ready to Delete Account
     
     All requirements met:
     ✓ No active contracts
     ✓ No pending disputes
     ✓ Balance withdrawn
     ✓ Subscriptions cancelled
     
     Tell us why you're leaving (optional):
     ○ Not using the platform enough
     ○ Found another platform
     ○ Privacy concerns
     ○ Too expensive
     ○ Other: [Please specify]
     
     [Text area for additional feedback]
     
     Final step - Verify your identity:
     [Enter your password: __________]
     
     ☐ I understand this action is permanent
     
     [Cancel] [Delete My Account]
     ```
   - User enters password
   - Checks acknowledgment checkbox
   - Clicks "Delete My Account"

8. **Account deletion initiated:**
   - **API Call:** `POST /v1/privacy/deletion-request`
   ```json
   {
     "user_id": "user_abc123",
     "deletion_reason": "PRIVACY_CONCERNS",
     "legal_basis": "GDPR_ARTICLE_17",
     "feedback": "Concerned about data retention policies",
     "verification": {
       "method": "PASSWORD",
       "password_hash": "..."
     },
     "acknowledge_permanent": true
   }
   ```
   - **Response:**
   ```json
   {
     "deletion_request_id": "del_xyz789",
     "status": "PENDING_GRACE_PERIOD",
     "requested_at": "2025-01-15T19:00:00Z",
     "grace_period_ends": "2025-02-14T19:00:00Z",
     "permanent_deletion_date": "2025-02-14T19:00:00Z",
     "reference_number": "DEL-20250115-789",
     "can_cancel_until": "2025-02-14T19:00:00Z"
   }
   ```
   - Account marked for deletion
   - 30-day grace period starts
   - User immediately logged out
   - Confirmation email sent:
     ```
     Subject: Account Deletion Scheduled
     
     Your Skillsier account is scheduled for deletion.
     
     Deletion Date: February 14, 2025 at 7:00 PM
     Reference: DEL-20250115-789
     
     Grace Period: 30 days
     You can cancel this deletion request anytime before
     February 14, 2025 by logging in and visiting:
     Settings > Privacy & Data > Cancel Deletion
     
     After February 14, 2025:
     • Your account will be permanently deleted
     • All personal data will be removed
     • This action cannot be undone
     
     Need help? Contact support@skillsier.com
     ```

9. **Grace period - User can cancel:**
   - User receives email reminders:
     - 7 days before deletion
     - 3 days before deletion
     - 1 day before deletion
   - User decides to cancel deletion
   - User logs in (account still accessible during grace period)
   - Banner at top of all pages:
     ```
     ⚠️ Your account is scheduled for deletion on Feb 14, 2025
     [Cancel Deletion] [View Details]
     ```
   - User clicks "Cancel Deletion"
   - Confirmation modal:
     ```
     Cancel Account Deletion?
     
     This will stop the deletion process and restore your
     account to normal status.
     
     Your account will remain active with all data intact.
     
     [Keep Deleting] [Cancel Deletion Request]
     ```
   - User clicks "Cancel Deletion Request"
   - **API Call:** `POST /v1/privacy/deletion-request/{requestId}/cancel`
   - Deletion cancelled
   - Account restored to normal
   - Success: "✅ Account deletion cancelled. Your account is active."

10. **Permanent deletion after grace period:**
    - Grace period expires (30 days passed)
    - Automated job runs
    - **Deletion process:**
      1. Hard delete personal data:
         - Profile information
         - Contact details
         - Messages (content)
         - Uploaded files
         - Settings
      2. Anonymize data (can't be deleted due to legal requirements):
         - Financial transactions (7 years retention)
         - Contract records (7 years retention)
         - Reviews (replace name with "Deleted User")
         - Fraud prevention data
      3. Remove all access:
         - Delete authentication credentials
         - Revoke API keys
         - Invalidate sessions
      4. Update related records:
         - Mark conversations as archived
         - Anonymize sender/recipient in messages
         - Update contract party to "[Deleted User]"
    - **API logging:**
    ```json
    {
      "action": "ACCOUNT_PERMANENTLY_DELETED",
      "user_id": "user_abc123",
      "deleted_at": "2025-02-14T19:00:00Z",
      "deletion_request_id": "del_xyz789",
      "legal_basis": "GDPR_ARTICLE_17",
      "data_deleted": {
        "profile": true,
        "messages_content": true,
        "files": true
      },
      "data_anonymized": {
        "transactions": true,
        "contracts": true,
        "reviews": true
      }
    }
    ```
    - Deletion confirmation email sent to registered email (final notification)
    - User ID marked as permanently deleted (cannot be reused)

**Phase 3: Consent Management**

11. **User reviews consent preferences:**
    - User navigates to Settings > Privacy & Data > Consent
    - **API Call:** `GET /v1/privacy/consent`
    - **Response:**

      "consents": [
        {

    - Consent preferences page displays:
      ```
      Consent Preferences
      
      Required Consents (Cannot be withdrawn)
      
      ✓ Terms of Service (Version 2.0)
      Granted: May 10, 2023
      [View Terms]

      Granted: May 10, 2023
      [Withdraw Consent]
      
      Third-Party Data Sharing
      ☐ Share data with integration partners
      [Grant Consent]
      ```

12. **User withdraws marketing consent:**
    - User clicks "Withdraw Consent" for marketing emails
    - Confirmation modal:
      ```
      Withdraw Marketing Consent?
      
      You will no longer receive:
      • Product updates and newsletters
      • Special offers and promotions
      • Feature announcements
      
      You will still receive:
      • Transactional emails (receipts, contracts)
      • Security alerts
      • Account notifications
      
      [Cancel] [Withdraw Consent]
      ```
    - User confirms
    - **API Call:** `PUT /v1/privacy/consent`
    ```json
    {
      "consent_type": "MARKETING_EMAILS",
      "action": "WITHDRAW",
      "timestamp": "2025-01-15T20:00:00Z"
    }
    ```
    - **Response:**
    ```json
    {
      "consent_type": "MARKETING_EMAILS",
      "status": "WITHDRAWN",
      "withdrawn_at": "2025-01-15T20:00:00Z",
      "effective_immediately": true
    }
    ```
    - Success: "✅ Marketing consent withdrawn. You won't receive promotional emails."
    - Marketing system updated immediately
    - Audit log entry created

13. **New privacy policy requires re-consent:**
    - Skillsier updates privacy policy (major changes)
    - All users must re-consent
    - User logs in
    - Modal appears (cannot dismiss):
      ```
      We've Updated Our Privacy Policy
      
      We've made important changes to our Privacy Policy that
      require your review and acceptance.
      
      Key Changes:
      • Updated data retention periods
      • New third-party service providers
      • Enhanced encryption standards
      • Clarified user rights under GDPR
      
      You must accept to continue using Skillsier.
      
      [View Full Privacy Policy]
      [View Summary of Changes]
      
      ☐ I have read and accept the updated Privacy Policy
      
      [Accept and Continue]
      ```
    - User reads policy
    - User checks checkbox
    - User clicks "Accept and Continue"
    - **API Call:** `POST /v1/privacy/consent/accept-policy`
    ```json
    {
      "policy_type": "PRIVACY_POLICY",
      "policy_version": "4.0",
      "accepted_at": "2025-01-15T20:15:00Z",
      "ip_address": "192.168.1.100",
      "user_agent": "Mozilla/5.0..."
    }
    ```
    - Consent recorded
    - User granted access to platform
    - Previous policy version marked as superseded

**Phase 4: Audit Logs & Transparency**

14. **User views personal audit log:**
    - User navigates to Settings > Privacy & Data > Activity Log
    - **API Call:** `GET /v1/privacy/audit-log?limit=50`
    - **Response:**
    ```json
    {
      "audit_logs": [

      End-to-End Encryption (E2EE)

      • Messages encrypted on your device
      • Only you and recipient can read messages
      • Skillsier cannot access encrypted content
      • Keys stored securely on your devices
      
      Important Notes:

      ⚠️ Search functionality limited for encrypted messages

      ✓ No active investigations
      ✓ Two-factor authentication enabled
      
      Status: E2EE is currently OFF

      ```

17. **E2EE setup process:**
    - Setup wizard appears:
      ```
      Enable End-to-End Encryption
      
      Step 1 of 3: Generate Encryption Keys
      
      We'll generate a unique encryption key pair for your
      account. This process takes a few seconds.
      
      Your encryption keys will be:
      • Generated on your device
      • Protected by your password
      • Backed up securely (optional)
      
      [Cancel] [Generate Keys]
      ```
    - User clicks "Generate Keys"
    - Client-side key generation:
      ```javascript
      // Generate Ed25519 key pair
      const keyPair = await crypto.subtle.generateKey(
        {
          name: "Ed25519",
          namedCurve: "Ed25519"
        },
        true,
        ["sign", "verify"]
      );
      
      // Encrypt private key with user password
      const encryptedPrivateKey = await encryptWithPassword(
        keyPair.privateKey,
        userPassword
      );
      ```
    - Keys generated successfully
    - Step 2 appears:
      ```
      Step 2 of 3: Backup Recovery Key
      
      Your recovery key allows you to restore access to
      encrypted messages if you lose your password.

      ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐

      • Do NOT share with anyone
      • Do NOT store digitally (screenshotted, etc.)
      • You will NOT be able to see this again
      
      ☐ I have safely stored my recovery key
      
      [Back] [Continue]
      ```
    - User copies recovery key
    - User checks acknowledgment
    - User clicks "Continue"
    - Step 3 confirms:

26. **User regrets deletion (after grace period):**
    - User contacts support after permanent deletion
    - Data already deleted (cannot be recovered)
    - Support response:
      ```
      Unfortunately, your account was permanently deleted on
      February 14, 2025 after the 30-day grace period.
      
      As stated during the deletion process:
      • All personal data has been removed
      • This action cannot be undone
      • Data cannot be recovered
      
      You are welcome to create a new account, but your
      previous data cannot be restored.
      ```
    - No recovery possible (by design)

**Encryption Issues:**

27. **User loses encryption key:**
    - User forgets password AND loses recovery key
    - Cannot decrypt messages
    - User contacts support
    - Support response:
      ```
      ⚠️ Encryption Key Lost - Cannot Recover Messages
      
      Because you enabled end-to-end encryption, your messages
      are encrypted with your personal key. Skillsier cannot
      access or recover encrypted messages without your key.
      
      This is by design to protect your privacy.
      
      Options:
      • If you remember your password, try logging in
      • If you have your recovery key written down, use it
      • If neither available, encrypted messages are permanently inaccessible
      
      You can still:
      • Access unencrypted messages
      • Continue using your account
      • Start new encrypted conversations
      
      We cannot recover your encrypted messages under any
      circumstances, including court orders.
      ```
    - No recovery possible (security by design)

**Notifications:**

**In-App Notifications:**
- Data export ready for download
- Account deletion scheduled (with cancellation option)
- Consent withdrawal confirmed
- Privacy policy update requires action
- Suspicious activity detected
- Legal hold applied to account
- Data breach notification
- Encryption enabled successfully

**Email Notifications:**
- Data export completed (with download link)
- Account deletion scheduled (reminders at 7, 3, 1 days)
- Account permanently deleted (confirmation)
- Privacy policy updated (re-consent required)
- Suspicious login detected
- Legal hold notice
- Data breach notification (mandatory)
- Encryption recovery key reminder

**Push Notifications (Mobile):**
- "Your data export is ready"
- "Account deletion in 3 days - Cancel anytime"
- "Suspicious login attempt detected"
- "New privacy policy requires review"

**WebSocket Events:**
- `privacy.export_completed` — Export ready
- `privacy.deletion_scheduled` — Deletion started
- `privacy.legal_hold_applied` — Data frozen
- `privacy.breach_notification` — Breach alert

**Analytics Events:**

Suggested tracking:
- `data_export_requested` — User requests export
  - legal_basis (GDPR, CCPA, OTHER)
  - export_size_mb
  - processing_time_hours
- `data_deletion_requested` — Account deletion requested
  - deletion_reason
  - blockers_present (boolean)
- `data_deletion_cancelled` — User cancels deletion
  - days_remaining_in_grace_period
- `consent_withdrawn` — User withdraws consent
  - consent_type
  - had_consent_duration_days
- `consent_granted` — User grants consent
  - consent_type
  - required (boolean)
- `encryption_enabled` — E2EE activated
  - key_backed_up (boolean)
- `audit_log_viewed` — User views activity log
  - entries_shown
- `legal_hold_created` — Legal hold applied (admin)
  - affected_users_count
  - data_types
- `data_breach_reported` — Breach detected (admin)
  - severity
  - affected_users_count
  - time_to_contain_minutes

**Accessibility:**

- **Keyboard Navigation:**
  - Tab through privacy settings
  - Enter to expand/collapse sections
  - Space to toggle consent checkboxes
  - Arrow keys for audit log navigation
  - Ctrl+E for quick data export (when in privacy section)
  
- **Screen Reader Support:**
  - Announce consent status: "Marketing emails consent: Granted"
  - Read privacy notices clearly
  - Alert on important actions: "Warning: Account deletion is permanent"
  - Announce audit log entries: "Login from Berlin, Germany at 6:00 PM, Success"
  - Read legal notices verbatim
  
- **Visual Accessibility:**
  - High contrast for legal text
  - Clear visual hierarchy for consent preferences
  - Status indicators with icons + text:
    - Granted: ✓ Green + "Granted"
    - Withdrawn: ✗ Gray + "Withdrawn"
    - Pending: ⏳ Yellow + "Pending"
  - Large, clear buttons for critical actions
  - Color-blind friendly status colors
  
- **Cognitive Accessibility:**
  - Plain language explanations of legal concepts
  - Step-by-step deletion process
  - Clear warnings before irreversible actions
  - Visual timelines for grace periods
  - Confirmation checkboxes for understanding
  - Help text for complex privacy concepts

**Performance Targets:**

- **Data Export Request:** < 1 second to submit
- **Data Export Processing:** < 48 hours (GDPR requirement)
- **Data Deletion Request:** < 500ms to submit
- **Permanent Deletion:** Within 24 hours after grace period
- **Consent Update:** < 300ms
- **Audit Log Load:** < 2 seconds for 100 entries
- **Encryption Key Generation:** < 3 seconds
- **Legal Hold Creation:** < 500ms
- **Compliance Dashboard Load:** < 3 seconds
- **Breach Notification Send:** < 1 hour after detection

**Security:**

- **Data Export Security:**
  - Require password verification
  - Rate limit: 1 export per 7 days per user
  - Presigned URLs expire after 30 days
  - Downloads logged in audit trail
  - Export files encrypted at rest
  
- **Data Deletion Security:**
  - Require password verification
  - 30-day grace period (mandatory)
  - Cannot be bypassed
  - Secure deletion (7-pass overwrite)
  - Deletion logged permanently
  
- **Encryption Security:**
  - Ed25519 key pairs (256-bit)
  - Private keys never leave client
  - Keys encrypted with user password
  - No server-side key recovery
  - Perfect forward secrecy
  
- **Audit Logging:**
  - All privacy actions logged
  - Immutable audit trail
  - Tamper-evident (cryptographic hashing)
  - Retention: 7 years minimum
  - Regular integrity checks
  
- **Legal Hold Security:**
  - Immutable once applied
  - Cannot be deleted (even by admins)
  - Requires legal role to create/remove
  - Full audit trail
  - Data integrity verification
  
- **Breach Response:**
  - Incident response plan
  - 72-hour notification (GDPR)
  - Chain of custody for evidence
  - Post-incident review mandatory
  - External security audit

# COM-16 — SMS Notifications (Web & Mobile)

## Purpose
Allow users to receive critical platform notifications via SMS (text messages) for urgent updates such as job offers, contract changes, payment confirmations, and security alerts. Users can opt-in to SMS notifications, manage their preferences, view SMS delivery status, and configure which notification types they want to receive via SMS. The system integrates with SMPP gateways for reliable SMS delivery with rate limiting and template management.

## User Personas
* Freelancers — Want SMS notifications for urgent job offers, contract milestones, payment confirmations, and important client messages
* Clients — Need SMS alerts for proposal submissions, milestone completions, deliverable uploads, and critical freelancer communications
* Administrators — Configure SMS templates, monitor delivery rates, manage SMS quotas, and investigate delivery failures

## Preconditions
* User must be logged in with valid session
* User must have a verified phone number in their profile
* SMS gateway must be properly configured and operational
* User must have opted in to receive SMS notifications (GDPR/TCPA compliance)
* Account must have sufficient SMS credits (for paid tiers with SMS allowances)

## Triggers
* Explicit: User navigates to Notification Settings to enable/configure SMS notifications
* Explicit: User clicks "Enable SMS Notifications" prompt in dashboard or notification center
* Explicit: User responds to SMS opt-in confirmation message
* Explicit: User verifies phone number during profile setup or phone number change
* System: Critical event occurs that matches user's SMS notification preferences (job offer, payment received, security alert, etc.)
* System: Daily/weekly SMS digest is scheduled to be sent based on user preferences
* Admin: Administrator sends manual SMS notification for platform-wide announcements

## Primary Screens

### Web Application Screens
1. SMS Settings Page (/settings/notifications/sms)
   * SMS opt-in/opt-out toggle with legal disclaimer
   * Phone number verification status display
   * SMS notification preferences by category (jobs, payments, messages, security)
   * SMS delivery history table with status indicators
   * SMS credit balance display (for paid tiers)
   * Rate limiting information and cool-down period display
   * Test SMS functionality with preview
2. Phone Verification Modal (/settings/notifications/sms/verify)
   * Phone number input with country code selector
   * SMS verification code input field
   * Resend code button with countdown timer
   * Change phone number option
   * Verification success/failure feedback
3. SMS Templates Management (/admin/communications/sms-templates) (Admin only)
   * Template list with categories and usage statistics
   * Template editor with variable placeholders
   * Character count display with multi-part SMS indicator
   * Template preview with sample data
   * Approval workflow for template changes
   * Template versioning history
4. SMS Delivery Dashboard (/admin/communications/sms-delivery) (Admin only)
   * Delivery rate graphs and statistics
   * Failed delivery investigation tools
   * Carrier-specific delivery reports
   * Gateway status monitoring
   * SMS queue depth and processing rate
   * Cost tracking and budget alerts
5. SMS Notification Preferences Modal
   * Category-based preference toggles (Jobs, Payments, Messages, Security, etc.)
   * Quiet hours configuration (no SMS during specified times)
   * Priority filtering (only urgent notifications via SMS)
   * Frequency limits (max SMS per day/week)
   * Save and preview changes

### Mobile Application Screens
1. SMS Settings Screen ((authenticated)/settings/notifications/sms)
   * SMS opt-in/opt-out toggle with legal consent text
   * Phone number display with verification badge
   * "Verify Phone Number" button (if unverified)
   * Notification category list with SMS toggles
   * SMS delivery history list (recent 20 messages)
   * "View All Delivery History" link
   * SMS credit balance card (for paid tiers)
   * "Test SMS" button
2. Phone Verification Screen ((authenticated)/settings/notifications/sms/verify-phone)
   * Phone number input with country selector
   * "Send Verification Code" button
   * 6-digit verification code input
   * Countdown timer for resend availability
   * "Resend Code" button (enabled after cooldown)
   * "Change Number" link
   * Verification success animation
3. SMS Preferences Screen ((authenticated)/settings/notifications/sms/preferences)
   * Scrollable list of notification categories
     * Category name and icon
     * Description of what triggers SMS
     * Toggle switch for enable/disable
     * Example notification preview
   * "Quiet Hours" section with time range picker
   * "Priority Only" mode toggle
   * "Daily Limit" slider (1-20 SMS per day)
   * Save button with loading state
4. SMS Delivery History Screen ((authenticated)/settings/notifications/sms/history)
   * Chronological list of sent SMS messages
     * Notification type and brief content
     * Timestamp of sending
     * Delivery status badge (Sent, Delivered, Failed, Pending)
     * Carrier information
     * Message ID for reference
   * Filter by status and date range
   * Tap to view full SMS content and metadata
5. SMS Credit Management Screen ((authenticated)/settings/notifications/sms/credits) (For paid tiers)
   * Current SMS credit balance
   * Credit usage graph (last 30 days)
   * Credit expiration date
   * "Purchase More Credits" button
   * Usage breakdown by category
   * Auto-recharge settings toggle

**System Touchpoints:**  
**Backend Service Entities/APIs Purpose communications-be**  
- `POST /sms/opt-in`, `POST /sms/opt-out`, `POST /sms/send`, `GET /sms/preferences`, `PUT /sms/preferences`, `GET /sms/delivery-status/:id`, `GET /sms/history`, `POST /sms/verify-phone`, `POST /sms/test`, `GET /sms/templates`, `POST /sms/templates`, `PUT /sms/templates/:id` Manage SMS opt-in/opt-out, send SMS notifications, configure preferences, verify phone numbers, track delivery status, manage templates  

**users-be**  
- `GET /users/me/phone`, `PUT /users/me/phone`, `POST /users/me/phone/verify`, `GET /users/me/phone/verification-status` Manage user phone numbers, verify phone numbers, check verification status  

**subscriptions-be**  
- `GET /subscriptions/me/sms-credits`, `POST /subscriptions/me/sms-credits/purchase`, `GET /subscriptions/me/sms-usage` Check SMS credit balance, purchase additional credits, view usage statistics (for paid tiers)  

**admin-be**  
- `GET /admin/sms/analytics`, `GET /admin/sms/failed-deliveries`, `POST /admin/sms/bulk-send`, `GET /admin/sms/gateway-status`, `PUT /admin/sms/gateway-config` Admin analytics, failed delivery investigation, bulk SMS sending, gateway monitoring and configuration  

## Key Entities
* communications-be:
  * sms_notification (id, user_id, phone_number, message_content, template_id, notification_type, status, sent_at, delivered_at, failed_at, failure_reason, carrier_info, gateway_id, message_parts, credits_used)
  * sms_opt_in (id, user_id, phone_number, opted_in_at, opt_in_method, ip_address, user_agent, consent_text_version, opted_out_at, opt_out_reason)
  * sms_preference (id, user_id, category, enabled, priority_only, quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, daily_limit, weekly_limit)
  * sms_template (id, template_key, category, message_content, variables, character_count, multi_part, language, version, status, approved_by, approved_at)
  * sms_delivery_report (id, sms_notification_id, carrier_status, delivered_at, bounce_reason, carrier_response)
  * phone_verification (id, user_id, phone_number, verification_code, sent_at, verified_at, expires_at, attempts_count, verified)

## User Journey Flow
### WEB - SMS Notification Setup & Configuration
1. User navigates to /settings/notifications/sms from main notification settings page
2. System calls:
* GET /users/me/phone → Retrieve user's phone number
* GET /users/me/phone/verification-status → Check if phone is verified
* GET /sms/preferences → Get current SMS opt-in status and preferences
* GET /subscriptions/me/sms-credits → Get SMS credit balance (if applicable)
3. Page displays:
* SMS opt-in toggle (currently OFF, disabled until phone verified)
* Phone number with verification status
* Legal disclaimer about SMS costs and opt-out
* "Verify Phone Number" button (prominent if unverified)
* Grayed-out notification preferences (enabled after verification)
* SMS credit balance (for paid tiers)

4. User clicks "Verify Phone Number" button
5. System displays Phone Verification Modal:
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Verify Your Phone Number [X]                               │

│                                                            │

│ ┌─────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┐       │

│ └─────────┴──────────────────────────────────────┘       │

└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
6. User clicks "Send Verification Code"
7. System calls:
* POST /users/me/phone/verify with { phone_number: "+15551234567" }
8. Backend (users-be):
* Validates phone number format
* Checks if phone already verified for another user
* Generates 6-digit verification code
* Creates phone_verification record with code and expiry (10 minutes)
* Calls communications-be: POST /sms/send with verification template
* Returns { verification_id: "ver_123", code_sent: true, expires_at: "2025-01-16T10:10:00Z" }
9. Modal updates to show code input screen:
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Verify Your Phone Number [X]                               │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                            │
│ ✓ Code sent to +1 (555) 123-4567                           │
│                                                            │
│ Enter Verification Code                                    │
│ ┌────┬────┬────┬────┬────┬────┐                          │
│ │ 3 │ 7 │ 5 │ 9 │ 1 │ 2 │                          │
│ └────┴────┴────┴────┴────┴────┘                          │
│                                                            │
│ Code expires in 9:47                                       │
│                                                            │
│ Didn't receive a code?                                     │
│ [Resend Code] (available in 00:43)                         │
│ [Change Phone Number]                                      │
│                                                            │
│ [Verify]                                                   │
│                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
10. User enters the 6-digit code received via SMS
11. User clicks "Verify" button
12. System calls:
* POST /users/me/phone/verify/confirm with { verification_id: "ver_123", code: "375912" }
13. Backend (users-be):
* Validates verification code against stored code
* Checks code hasn't expired (within 10 minutes)
* Checks attempts count (max 5 attempts)
* Marks phone_verification.verified = true
* Updates user.phone_verified = true, user.phone_verified_at = NOW()
* Returns { success: true, phone_verified: true }
14. Modal shows success state:
```

17. User configures notification preferences by toggling various categories
18. When user toggles a preference, system makes immediate API call:
* PUT /sms/preferences with { category: "jobs_invitations", enabled: true }
19. System shows inline success feedback: "✓ Preference saved"
20. User clicks "Test SMS" button to verify setup
21. System calls:
* POST /sms/test → Send test SMS notification
22. Backend (communications-be):
* Validates user has verified phone and SMS enabled
* Checks daily rate limit not exceeded
* Creates test sms_notification record
* Queues SMS via SMPP gateway
* Returns { success: true, message_id: "sms_test_789" }
23. System shows toast: "Test SMS sent to +1 (555) ***-4567. Check your phone!"
24. After 30 seconds, system polls:
* GET /sms/delivery-status/sms_test_789
25. If delivered, shows success toast: "✓ Test SMS delivered successfully"
26. User receives test SMS on their phone:
```
Skillsier: This is a test message. Your SMS notifications are working correctly! Reply STOP to opt-out.
```

#### Edge Cases & Conditional Branches

**Phone Verification Issues:**  
**EC1. User enters invalid phone number format**  
- System shows inline validation error: "Please enter a valid phone number"  
- Format hints displayed based on selected country code  
- Backend: POST /users/me/phone/verify returns 400 with validation details  

**EC2. User enters phone number already verified by another user**  
- Backend returns error: "This phone number is already associated with another account"  
- Suggest: "If this is your number, please contact support"  
- System logs potential account takeover attempt  

**EC3. User doesn't receive verification code within 2 minutes**  
- "Resend Code" button becomes enabled after 60-second cooldown  
- System tracks resend count (max 5 attempts per hour)  
- If gateway issue detected, show: "SMS service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later"  

**EC4. User enters wrong verification code 5 times**  
- Account locked from verification attempts for 1 hour  
- Display: "Too many failed attempts. Please try again in 1 hour"  
- Email sent with verification link as alternative  
- Backend: rate limiting on phone_verification.attempts_count  

**EC5. Verification code expires (10-minute window)**  
- System detects expired code: "This verification code has expired"  
- "Resend New Code" button prominently displayed  
- Previous code invalidated in database  

**SMS Opt-In/Opt-Out Compliance:**  
**EC6. User from GDPR-regulated country (EU)**  
- Additional explicit consent checkbox required before opt-in  
- Clear explanation of data processing and storage  
- Right to withdraw consent prominently displayed  
- Backend: sms_opt_in.consent_text_version tracks which consent text user agreed to  

**EC7. User replies "STOP" to any SMS message**  
- Carrier forwards STOP keyword to gateway  
- Gateway webhook triggers: POST /webhooks/sms/opt-out  
- Backend immediately:  
  - Sets sms_opt_in.opted_in = false  
  - Records sms_opt_in.opt_out_reason = "carrier_stop_keyword"  
  - Sends confirmation SMS: "You've been unsubscribed from Skillsier SMS. Text START to re-enable"  
- User account shows SMS as disabled with note: "Opted out via carrier"  

**EC8. User tries to enable SMS after carrier-level opt-out**  
- System shows special re-opt-in flow  
- Must send "START" keyword via SMS first (carrier-level opt-back-in)  
- Then can enable in settings  
- If tries to enable without carrier opt-back-in, shows: "Please reply START to our last message first"  

**EC9. User changes phone number while SMS enabled**  
- System displays warning: "Changing your phone number will disable SMS notifications until the new number is verified"  
- Requires re-verification of new number  
- Old phone number marked as inactive  
- SMS opt-in status preserved but disabled until verification complete  

**Rate Limiting & Quiet Hours:**  
**EC10. User reaches daily SMS limit (configured preference, e.g., 10 per day)**  
- System queues additional notifications for next day  
- User sees banner in notification center: "You've reached your daily SMS limit (10). Additional notifications will be sent tomorrow"  
- Critical security alerts bypass limit (always sent)  
- Backend: sms_notification table tracks daily count per user  

**EC11. Notification triggers during user's quiet hours (10 PM - 8 AM)**  
- System holds non-urgent notifications until quiet hours end  
- Urgent/critical notifications (security alerts, payment issues) bypass quiet hours  
- Notification queued with scheduled_for timestamp for 8 AM  
- User can see queued notifications in SMS history with "Scheduled" status  

**EC12. System detects rapid notification generation (>20 in 1 minute)**  
- Automatic rate limiting activates to prevent spam  
- Notifications grouped into single digest SMS if applicable  
- Admin alert triggered for investigation  
- User sees: "Multiple updates available. View full details in app"  

**EC13. Priority-only mode enabled**  
- System filters all notifications through priority classifier  
- Only "high" and "critical" priority notifications sent via SMS  
- Lower priority sent via in-app and email only  
- Priority determined by notification type + user preferences  

**Gateway & Delivery Failures:**  
**EC14. Primary SMS gateway (Twilio) is down**  
- System automatically fails over to backup gateway (MessageBird)  
- No user-visible disruption  
- Admin receives alert about gateway failover  
- Backend: gateway_id field tracks which gateway sent each SMS  

**EC15. SMS delivery fails with "carrier rejection" (code 21610)**  
- System attempts retry after 5 minutes  
- If second attempt fails, marks as permanent failure  
- User sees failed status in delivery history  
- No further retry attempts (prevents carrier blocking)  
- Notification sent via in-app and email as fallback  

**EC16. SMS delivery fails with "invalid phone number" (code 21211)**  
- System marks phone as invalid in user profile  
- Automatically disables SMS notifications  
- Sends email to user: "We couldn't deliver SMS to +1 (555) 123-4567. Please verify your phone number"  
- User must re-verify phone before SMS can be re-enabled  

**EC17. SMS stuck in "Pending" status for >5 minutes**  
- System queries gateway API for delivery status  
- If still unknown, marks as "Delivery Unknown"  
- Displays to user: "We're not sure if this SMS was delivered"  
- Automatically resends if notification is critical  

**EC18. International SMS to unsupported country**  
- System checks country against supported list before sending  
- If unsupported: don't attempt send, mark as "Not Sent"  
- Show user: "SMS notifications not available for your country (+44). You'll receive in-app and email notifications instead"  
- Admin can configure supported countries list  

**SMS Credits & Billing (Paid Tiers):**  
**EC19. User runs out of SMS credits**  
- System displays warning when credits drop below 20  
- When credits reach 0:  
  - SMS notifications automatically disabled  
  - Banner shown: "You've used all your SMS credits. Purchase more to continue receiving SMS"  
  - Notifications continue via in-app and email  
- Auto-recharge triggers if configured  

**EC20. User's subscription downgrades/expires**  
- SMS credit balance preserved for 30 days  
- If user re-subscribes, credits restored  
- If 30 days pass, unused credits forfeited  
- User notified 7 days before credit expiration  

**EC21. User enables auto-recharge**  
- System monitors credit balance  
- When balance drops below configured threshold (e.g., 20 credits):  
  - Automatically charges payment method  
  - Purchases configured credit package (e.g., 100 credits)  
  - Email confirmation sent  
- If payment fails: retries 3 times over 7 days, then disables auto-recharge  

**EC22. User purchases one-time credit pack**  
- Credits added to account immediately  
- Non-expiring credits (unlike monthly allowance)  
- Used after monthly allowance is depleted  
- Receipt emailed and available in billing history  

**Template & Message Issues:**  
**EC23. Template references undefined variable**  
- Template validation fails during save  
- Admin sees error: "Variable {{undefined_var}} is not defined"  
- Cannot approve template until fixed  
- Existing messages using old template continue working  

**EC24. Rendered message exceeds 160 characters (multi-part SMS)**  
- System automatically splits into multiple parts (up to 4 parts = 640 chars)  
- Each part costs 1 credit  
- User informed in delivery history: "2 parts sent"  
- Admin sees warning in template editor: "This template may generate multi-part SMS"  

**EC25. Message contains special characters (emoji, non-ASCII)**  
- System detects and calculates correct character limit (70 chars for Unicode vs 160 for ASCII)  
- Warns if character limit will be exceeded  
- Emoji count as 2 characters  
- Template preview shows accurate character count  

**EC26. Link shortening failure in message**  
- If URL shortener service fails, use original URL  
- May cause message to exceed character limit  
- System truncates message with "..." if necessary  
- Full link available in in-app notification  

**Testing & Validation:**  
**EC27. User clicks "Test SMS" but phone not verified**  
- Button disabled with tooltip: "Verify your phone number first"  
- Clicking shows prompt to verify  

**EC28. User clicks "Test SMS" and it fails**  
- System provides detailed error message  
- "Test SMS failed: Invalid phone number. Please update your phone and try again"  
- Error details logged for admin investigation  
- User can report issue directly from error message  

**EC29. Admin sends test SMS from template editor**  
- Uses admin's own phone number  
- Rendered with sample data  
- Delivery status shown in real-time  
- Success: "✓ Test SMS delivered to +1 (555) ***-7890"  

**Accessibility & Localization:**  
**EC30. User has visual impairment (screen reader)**  
- All SMS settings have proper ARIA labels  
- Toggle switches announce state changes  
- Delivery status icons have text alternatives  
- History table fully keyboard navigable  

**EC31. User's preferred language is not English**  
- SMS templates available in multiple languages  
- Language selected based on user profile  
- Template: payment_received_v2_es for Spanish users  
- System validates variables exist in all language versions  

**EC32. User in different timezone**  
- Quiet hours automatically adjusted to user's timezone  
- Delivery timestamps shown in user's local time  
- Scheduled SMS sent at appropriate local time  

**Admin & Compliance:**  
**EC33. Admin needs to bulk-disable SMS for maintenance**  
- Can toggle global SMS enable/disable switch  
- All outgoing SMS paused  
- Users see: "SMS temporarily unavailable due to maintenance"  
- Notifications queued for after maintenance  

**EC34. Regulatory audit requested**  
- Admin can export all SMS history for specific user  
- Includes: opt-in/opt-out history, consent timestamps, all sent messages  
- Export includes carrier responses and delivery receipts  
- Downloadable as CSV or PDF  

**EC35. User requests GDPR data deletion**  
- SMS history included in data deletion process  
- sms_notification records for user marked for deletion  
- Opt-in/opt-out history preserved for legal compliance (anonymized)  
- Phone number disassociated from user record  


## Notification Triggers & Event Handling
When SMS Notification is Triggered (Backend):
1. Event occurs in system (e.g., payment received, job invitation, security alert)
2. Notification service (communications-be) receives event:
```
Event: {
  type: "payment_received",
  user_id: "user_123",
  data: {
    amount: 500.00,
    currency: "USD",
    client_name: "TechCorp",
    project_name: "Project Alpha",
    payment_id: "pay_456"
  }
}
```
3. Check user's SMS preferences:
   * Query: GET /sms/preferences?user_id=user_123&category=payments
   * Verify: enabled = true for payment notifications
4. Verify opt-in status:
   * Query: sms_opt_in table for user
   * Check: opted_in = true and phone_verified = true
5. Check rate limits:
   * Query daily SMS count for user
   * If limit reached, queue for next day or skip (depending on priority)
   * Critical/urgent notifications bypass rate limits
6. Check quiet hours:
   * Get user's timezone and quiet hours preference
   * If current time within quiet hours AND notification not critical:
     * Queue notification for end of quiet hours
     * Set scheduled_for timestamp
7. Check SMS credit balance (for paid tiers):
   * Query: GET /subscriptions/me/sms-credits?user_id=user_123
   * If credits = 0, skip SMS and send via other channels only
8. Load SMS template:
   * Query: sms_template where template_key = "payment_received_v2" and status = "active"
   * Get template content and variables
9. Render message with user data:
```
Template: "Payment of {{amount}} received from {{client}} for {{project}}. View: {{link}}"
Rendered: "Payment of $500.00 received from TechCorp for Project Alpha. View: https://sklr.io/p456"
```
10. Generate shortened link:
    * Create short link via link service: https://sklr.io/p456
    * Track click analytics
11. Calculate message parts and cost:
    * Character count: 98 chars
    * SMS parts: 1 (under 160 chars)
    * Credits required: 1
12. Create sms_notification record:
```sql
INSERT INTO sms_notification (
  id, user_id, phone_number, message_content, template_id,
  notification_type, status, credits_used, created_at
) VALUES (
  'sms_msg_789', 'user_123', '+15551234567',
  'Payment of $500.00 received...', 'tmpl_pay_v2',
  'payment_received', 'pending', 1, NOW()
);
```
13. Send to SMS gateway (Twilio/MessageBird):
```javascript
await smsGateway.send({
  to: '+15551234567',
  from: '+15559876543', // Skillsier's sender number
  body: 'Payment of $500.00 received...',
  statusCallback: 'https://api.skillsier.com/webhooks/sms/status'
});
```
14. Gateway returns:

```json
{
  "message_id": "SM0123456789abcdef",
  "status": "queued",
  "to": "+15551234567",
  "price": "0.0075",
  "price_unit": "USD"
}
```

15. **Update sms_notification record:**
```sql
UPDATE sms_notification
SET status = 'sent',
    gateway_message_id = 'SM0123456789abcdef',
    sent_at = NOW()
WHERE id = 'sms_msg_789';
```

16. **Deduct SMS credits** (for paid tiers):
```sql
UPDATE subscription
SET sms_credits_used = sms_credits_used + 1
WHERE user_id = 'user_123';
```

17. **Gateway webhook receives delivery status:**
```javascript
// Webhook: POST /webhooks/sms/status
{
  "message_id": "SM0123456789abcdef",
  "status": "delivered",
  "delivered_at": "2025-01-16T10:03:18Z",
  "carrier": "AT&T"
}
```

18. **Update delivery status:**
```sql
UPDATE sms_notification
SET status = 'delivered',
    delivered_at = '2025-01-16T10:03:18Z'
WHERE gateway_message_id = 'SM0123456789abcdef';

INSERT INTO sms_delivery_report (
  sms_notification_id, carrier_status, delivered_at, carrier_response
) VALUES (
  'sms_msg_789', 'delivered', '2025-01-16T10:03:18Z', '{"carrier":"AT&T"}'
);
```

19. **Send real-time update to user** (if online):
```javascript
// WebSocket notification
socket.emit('sms:delivered', {
  notification_id: 'sms_msg_789',
  status: 'delivered',
  delivered_at: '2025-01-16T10:03:18Z'
});
```

**Failure Handling Flow:**

If gateway returns error at step 13:
```json
{
  "error_code": "21211",
  "error_message": "Invalid phone number",
  "status": "failed"
}
```

- Update sms_notification.status = 'failed'
- Set failure_reason = "invalid_phone_number"
- Create alert for user to update phone
- Send notification via fallback channels (in-app, email)
- If permanent failure (invalid number), disable SMS for user
- If temporary failure (carrier issue), schedule retry in 5 minutes

#### Accessibility Requirements

**Keyboard Navigation:**
- All toggle switches accessible via Tab and Space/Enter
- SMS history table fully keyboard navigable (Tab through rows, Enter to view details)
- Phone verification code inputs auto-advance on digit entry
- Left/Right arrow keys navigate between code input fields
- Escape key closes modals and bottom sheets
- Focus trapped within modals when open
- Focus returns to trigger element when modal closes

**Screen Reader Support:**
- Toggle switches announce state: "SMS notifications, toggle button, currently on/off"
- Verification status announced: "Phone number verified on January 16, 2025"
- Delivery status icons have text alternatives: "delivered", "failed", "pending"
- Character count updates announced: "98 characters, 1 SMS part"
- Rate limit progress announced: "125 of 200 credits remaining, 62% used"
- Error messages announced immediately with role="alert"
- Success confirmations announced with role="status"

**Visual Accessibility:**
- Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for all text
- Status indicators use both color and icons (not color alone)
- Delivery success: green checkmark + "Delivered" text
- Delivery failure: red X + "Failed" text
- Pending status: orange clock + "Pending" text
- Focus indicators visible with 2px outline
- Toggle switches have clear ON/OFF labels
- Form field labels always visible (no placeholder-only labels)

**Mobile Accessibility:**
- Touch targets minimum 44x44pt (iOS) / 48x48dp (Android)
- Sufficient spacing between interactive elements
- Swipe gestures for common actions (swipe SMS history item to delete/retry)
- VoiceOver/TalkBack announce all interactive elements
- Dynamic Type support for text scaling
- Reduce Motion respected for animations

**Error Handling Accessibility:**
- Inline validation errors associated with form fields via aria-describedby
- Error summaries at top of forms for screen readers
- Clear error recovery instructions
- Errors announced without requiring page reload
- Multiple validation errors presented as list with clear structure

**Web Application:**
- SMS Settings page loads in <800ms
- Phone verification modal opens in <200ms
- Preference toggle response time <300ms
- SMS history table renders 50 items in <500ms
- Test SMS sends in <2 seconds (gateway latency)
- Real-time delivery status updates within 5 seconds
- Template editor loads in <600ms
- Admin dashboard loads in <1.2 seconds

**Mobile Application:**
- SMS Settings screen renders in <500ms
- Phone verification screen transitions in <300ms
- Preference toggles respond in <200ms
- SMS history list (20 items) renders in <400ms
- Pull-to-refresh completes in <1 second
- Bottom sheet animations smooth at 60fps
- Test SMS sends in <2 seconds
- Delivery status updates within 5 seconds

**Backend Performance:**
- Phone verification code generation: <100ms
- SMS sending to gateway: <500ms
- Preference update: <200ms
- SMS history query (50 items): <300ms
- Delivery status check: <400ms
- Template rendering: <50ms
- Credit balance check: <100ms

**SMS Delivery:**
- Average delivery time: <5 seconds (US carriers)
- Gateway failover time: <2 seconds
- Webhook processing: <200ms

- Cache invalidation on updates

#### Security Measures

**Phone Number Security:**
- Phone numbers encrypted at rest (AES-256)
- Phone numbers masked in UI (show last 4 digits only)
- Phone verification codes expire after 10 minutes
- Maximum 5 verification attempts per hour per phone number
- Rate limiting on verification code requests (1 per minute)
- Phone numbers not exposed in API responses (except to owner)
- Phone verification codes never logged in plaintext

**SMS Content Security:**
- Message content sanitized to prevent injection attacks
- No PII included in SMS beyond necessary information
- Links in SMS are shortened and tracked
- No executable code or scripts in SMS content
- Template variables validated and escaped
- Character encoding validated (prevent Unicode exploits)

**Opt-In/Opt-Out Security:**
- Opt-in requires verified phone number (prevents spam)
- Double opt-in for compliance (send verification SMS)
- Opt-out processed immediately (TCPA compliance)
- Opt-out history preserved (cannot be deleted)
- Carrier-level opt-outs respected permanently
- Audit log of all opt-in/opt-out actions

**Gateway Security:**
- API keys stored in secrets manager (not code)
- TLS 1.3 for all gateway communications
- IP whitelisting for webhook endpoints
- Webhook signatures validated (HMAC-SHA256)
- Gateway credentials rotated every 90 days
- Separate credentials for production/staging

**Rate Limiting & Abuse Prevention:**
- Per-user rate limits enforced (10 SMS per day default)
- System-wide rate limits to prevent platform abuse
- Unusual sending patterns trigger alerts
- Automatic temporary blocking for suspected spam
- Manual review required for bulk SMS operations
- Phone numbers on abuse lists auto-blocked

**Data Protection:**
- SMS history retention: 90 days (then archived)
- Archived SMS history retention: 7 years (compliance)
- User can request deletion of SMS history (GDPR)
- Opt-in/opt-out records retained indefinitely (legal)
- Phone numbers anonymized in analytics
- PII never sent to third-party analytics

**Access Controls:**
- SMS admin functions require elevated permissions
- Template editing requires approval workflow
- Bulk SMS operations require two-factor authentication
- Gateway configuration changes logged and audited
- User can only access their own SMS history
- Admin access to individual SMS data logged

**Compliance & Auditing:**
- All SMS operations logged with timestamp and user_id
- Opt-in consent text versioned and tracked
- Carrier responses logged for delivery verification
- Failed deliveries investigated and documented
- Regular security audits of SMS infrastructure
- Compliance reports generated monthly

- SMS Character Encoding Standards (GSM 03.38, UCS-2)

### COM-17 — Calendar & Scheduling (Web & Mobile)

**Purpose:**  
Enable users to schedule meetings, send calendar invitations, manage availability, track RSVPs, and integrate with external calendar systems (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar). This feature facilitates professional communication between freelancers and clients by providing seamless scheduling capabilities, meeting reminders, and calendar synchronization.

**User Personas:**  
- **Freelancers** — Schedule client meetings, send availability, manage interview appointments, sync with personal calendar  
- **Clients** — Schedule interviews with candidates, arrange project kickoffs, coordinate milestone reviews  
- **Both** — View upcoming meetings, respond to calendar invitations, set meeting reminders, manage calendar preferences

**Preconditions:**  
- User must be logged in with valid session  
- User must have active project/contract for contract-related meetings (optional for general meetings)  
- Calendar integration must be authorized if using external calendar sync  
- User must have appropriate permissions to create meetings with specific users

**Triggers:**  
- **Explicit:** User clicks "Schedule Meeting" in contract workspace or messaging thread  
- **Explicit:** User navigates to Calendar page and clicks "Create Event"  
- **Explicit:** User clicks "Send Availability" to share available time slots  
- **Explicit:** User responds to calendar invitation (Accept/Decline/Tentative)  
- **Explicit:** User connects external calendar (Google/Outlook/Apple)  
- **System:** Automated meeting reminders sent before scheduled meetings  
- **System:** Calendar event synced to/from external calendar  
- **Explicit:** User searches for meeting in calendar view

#### System Touchpoints

| Backend Service | Entities/APIs | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **communications-be** | `POST /calendar/events`, `GET /calendar/events`, `GET /calendar/events/:id`, `PUT /calendar/events/:id`, `DELETE /calendar/events/:id`, `POST /calendar/events/:id/rsvp`, `GET /calendar/invitations`, `POST /calendar/availability`, `GET /calendar/availability/:id`, `POST /calendar/events/:id/reminders`, `GET /calendar/integrations`, `POST /calendar/integrations/connect`, `DELETE /calendar/integrations/:id`, `POST /calendar/integrations/sync` | Create, read, update, delete calendar events; manage invitations; RSVP handling; availability sharing; calendar integration management; reminder scheduling |
| **users-be** | `GET /users/search`, `GET /users/:id/availability`, `GET /users/me/calendar-preferences`, `PUT /users/me/calendar-preferences` | Search users for meeting participants, check user availability, manage calendar preferences |
| **contracts-be** | `GET /contracts/:id`, `POST /contracts/:id/meetings`, `GET /contracts/:id/meetings` | Link meetings to specific contracts, retrieve contract-related meetings |
| **jobs-be** | `GET /jobs/:id`, `POST /jobs/:id/meetings`, `GET /jobs/:id/meetings` | Link meetings to job applications/interviews, retrieve job-related meetings |
| **notifications-be** | `POST /notifications/meeting-reminders`, `POST /notifications/meeting-invitations`, `POST /notifications/rsvp-updates` | Send meeting reminders, invitation notifications, RSVP update notifications |

**Key Entities:**
- **communications-be:**
  - `calendar_event` (id, creator_id, title, description, start_time, end_time, timezone, location, meeting_link, event_type, recurrence_rule, contract_id, job_id, status, created_at, updated_at, cancelled_at, cancellation_reason)
  - `calendar_participant` (id, event_id, user_id, email, rsvp_status, rsvp_at, is_organizer, is_required, notification_sent)
  - `calendar_reminder` (id, event_id, user_id, remind_before_minutes, reminder_sent, sent_at)
  - `calendar_integration` (id, user_id, provider, provider_user_id, access_token, refresh_token, calendar_id, sync_enabled, two_way_sync, last_sync_at, integration_status)
  - `availability_slot` (id, user_id, availability_link_id, day_of_week, start_time, end_time, is_available, buffer_minutes, created_at, expires_at)
  - `availability_link` (id, user_id, link_code, duration_minutes, date_range_start, date_range_end, exclude_conflicts, created_at, expires_at, times_used)
  - `calendar_sync_log` (id, integration_id, sync_type, events_synced, errors_count, started_at, completed_at, status)

```sql

  id, creator_id, title, description, start_time, end_time,

) VALUES (
  'evt_789', 'user_123', 'Phase 1 Completion Review',
  'Review Phase 1 deliverables...', '2025-01-20 14:00:00',
  '2025-01-20 15:00:00', 'America/New_York',
  'Video Call', 'https://meet.skillsier.com/evt-789',
  'contract_meeting', 'ctr_12345', 'scheduled'
);
```

- Creates `calendar_participant` records:
```sql
-- Creator (organizer)
INSERT INTO calendar_participant (
  event_id, user_id, is_organizer, is_required, rsvp_status
) VALUES (
  'evt_789', 'user_123', true, true, 'accepted'
);

-- Invited participant
INSERT INTO calendar_participant (
  event_id, user_id, is_organizer, is_required, rsvp_status
) VALUES (
  'evt_789', 'user_456', false, true, 'pending'
);
```

- Creates reminder records:
```sql
INSERT INTO calendar_reminder (event_id, user_id, remind_before_minutes)
VALUES 
  ('evt_789', 'user_123', 15),
  ('evt_789', 'user_123', 60),
  ('evt_789', 'user_456', 15),
  ('evt_789', 'user_456', 60);
```

- Sends invitation notifications:
```javascript
await notificationService.send({
  user_id: 'user_456',
  type: 'meeting_invitation',
  title: 'New Meeting Invitation',
  body: 'John Doe invited you to "Phase 1 Completion Review" on Jan 20 at 2:00 PM',
  action_url: '/calendar/meetings/evt_789',
  channels: ['in_app', 'email', 'push']
});
```

- If calendar integration enabled, syncs to external calendar:
```javascript
await calendarIntegration.syncEvent('evt_789', 'create');
```

**22.** User clicks **"Connect Outlook"** button

**23.** System calls:
- `POST /calendar/integrations/connect` with `{ provider: "outlook" }`

**24.** Backend generates OAuth URL and redirects user to Microsoft login:
```
https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/authorize
  ?client_id=skillsier_client_id
  &response_type=code
  &redirect_uri=https://skillsier.com/auth/calendar/callback
  &scope=Calendars.ReadWrite
  &state=random_state_token
```

**25.** User authenticates with Microsoft and grants permissions

**26.** Microsoft redirects back to Skillsier with authorization code

**27.** Backend exchanges code for access token:
```javascript
const tokenResponse = await outlookOAuth.getAccessToken(code);
// Returns: { access_token, refresh_token, expires_in }
```

**28.** Backend creates integration record:
```sql
INSERT INTO calendar_integration (
  id, user_id, provider, provider_user_id, access_token,
  refresh_token, sync_enabled, two_way_sync, integration_status
) VALUES (
  'int_outlook_456', 'user_123', 'outlook', 'outlook_user_789',
  'encrypted_access_token', 'encrypted_refresh_token',
  true, true, 'connected'
);
```

**29.** Backend performs initial sync:
- Fetches events from Outlook calendar (last 30 days + next 90 days)
- Creates corresponding `calendar_event` records for external events
- Returns sync summary

**30.** User redirected back to calendar settings with success message:
"✓ Outlook Calendar connected successfully. Synced 23 events."

**31.** Page refreshes showing both Google and Outlook calendars connected

**38.** Backend (communications-be):
- Generates unique availability link code
- Queries all connected calendars for busy times
- Queries existing Skillsier meetings
- Calculates available time slots:
```javascript
const availableSlots = calculateAvailability({
  dateRange: { start: '2025-01-17', end: '2025-01-31' },
  workingHours: { start: '09:00', end: '17:00' },
  duration: 30, // minutes
  buffer: 15, // minutes
  excludeConflicts: true,
  connectedCalendars: ['google', 'outlook']
});
// Returns array of available time slots
```

- Creates `availability_link` record:
```sql
INSERT INTO availability_link (
  id, user_id, link_code, duration_minutes, date_range_start,
  date_range_end, exclude_conflicts, expires_at
) VALUES (
  'avail_789', 'user_123', 'avl-x7k9p2m',
  30, '2025-01-17', '2025-01-31', true, '2025-01-24'
);
```

- Creates `availability_slot` records for each available slot:
```sql
INSERT INTO availability_slot (
  availability_link_id, day_of_week, start_time, end_time,
  is_available, buffer_minutes
) VALUES
  ('avail_789', 3, '09:00:00', '09:30:00', true, 15),
  ('avail_789', 3, '10:30:00', '11:00:00', true, 15),
  -- ... more slots
```
